proverb: Aarri garaa seene, arrii dha
meaning_om: Aarii, dhiphina yookaan gadda garaatti ukkaamsanii ta'uun qaama fi sammuu namaa miidhee dafee nama dulloomsa
meaning_en: Bottling up anger, stress, or sorrow inside damages one's physical and mental health, leading to premature aging

proverb: Namni aaru, hin gabbatu
meaning_om: Namni yeroo hunda dallanu fi dhiphatu nagaa waan hin arganneef qaamaanis ta'ee jireenyaan hin dagaagu
meaning_en: A person consumed by chronic anger and stress lacks peace of mind, which prevents them from thriving physically, emotionally, or materially

proverb: Namni aaru, dafeeti dullooma
meaning_om: Dhiphinni fi aariin walirraa hin cinne sammuu fi qaama namaa dadhabsiisuun nama moofeessee umurii malee nama dulloomsa
meaning_en: Persistent anger and emotional turmoil wear down the body and mind, accelerating the physical and mental aging process

proverb: Ibiddi garaa, foon hin waadu
meaning_om: Aarii fi gaddi garaatti ukkaamsan nama keessaa gubee ofii nama miidha malee bu'aa tokkollee hin qabu, rakkoos hin furu
meaning_en: Silent anger and suppressed resentment burn a person from within without accomplishing anything productive or solving the underlying problem

proverb: Aarri garaa, foon hin waadu
meaning_om: Aariin garaa keessatti boba'ee aaru ofuma nama keessaa miidhuu malee faayidaa qabatamaa hin qabu, bu'aa tokkollee hin fidu
meaning_en: Fuming silently and holding inner rage only suffocates and damages the person experiencing it, without producing any tangible result or remedy

proverb: Nama hin dhaalletti, hin aarani
meaning_om: Nama hariiroo dhiigaa, dhaala yookaan itti-gaafatamummaa waliin hin qabneetti aaruun bu'aa hin qabu; namni alagaarratti aarii ofii hin gubu
meaning_en: It is pointless to waste emotional energy or anger on someone with whom you have no kinship, stake, or mutual responsibility

proverb: Hunda yaamnaan, hundi hafe
meaning_om: Wanta tokkorratti hunda akka walii-galaatti yoo waamaniifi nama adda baasanii itti-gaafatamummaa hin kennineef, namuu itti-dhimmamuu dhabee hundi hafa
meaning_en: When a call or responsibility is directed at everyone without specific accountability, no one feels personally obligated, resulting in total absence or inaction

proverb: Takka loluun dhiirummaa dha, keeysa ooluun gadhummaa dha
meaning_om: Yeroo dhimmi barbaadetti morkatanii ofirraa ittisuun gootummaa ta'us, jibba fi lola dheeressanii yeroo hunda keessa jiraachuun gadhummaa fi salphina
meaning_en: Standing up for oneself in conflict when necessary demonstrates courage, but holding grudges and perpetually prolonging hostility is petty and dishonorable

proverb: Aarri ijoollee namaa, hidhii jala nama guba
meaning_om: Ijoolleen nama alagaa yoo balleessaa raawwatte akka ijoollee ofiitti ifachuu fi adabuun waan hin danda'amneef, aarii fi dallansuu hidhii qabatanii garaatti ukkaamsanii dhiphachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The frustration caused by another person's children must be swallowed in silence because one lacks the social freedom to discipline or rebuke them as one's own, causing internal distress

proverb: Bakkakkaan qara sodaate, jinfutti bu'a
meaning_om: Humna cimaa yookaan nama jabaa dura dhaabbachuu sodaatanii, humnuma ofii nama dadhabaa fi ofirraa hin qabnetti agarsiisuu yookaan irratti roorrisuu
meaning_en: Avoiding a strong or formidable opponent out of cowardice only to vent aggression on or oppress the weak and defenseless

proverb: Onneellee dhaban, sonbaatu nama duta
meaning_om: Gootummaa fi murannoo dhugaa osoo hin qabaatin, waca fi dhaadannoo sobaatiin akka nama jabaatti of agarsiisuuf yaaluu
meaning_en: Putting on an aggressive, loud, or boastful front to intimidate others despite lacking genuine courage, conviction, or inner strength; empty bravado

proverb: Aarri, arrii dha nama baasisa
meaning_om: Aarii, gaddaa fi dhiphina walirraa hin cinne keessa jiraachuun qaamaa fi sammuu namaa miidhee dafee nama dulloomsa
meaning_en: Chronic anger, grief, and emotional distress take a severe toll on the mind and body, bringing about premature aging and gray hair

proverb: "Tole je'ee sii laannaan, na keeysa laallattaa" jette, intalti
meaning_om: Gaarummaa, tola yookaan eeyyama namaaf godhan akka laaftuutti fudhatanii daangaa darbuu fi fedhii daangaa hin qabneen nama dhiphisuu
meaning_en: Taking unfair advantage of someone's kindness, tolerance, or concession by overstepping personal boundaries; giving an inch and taking a mile

proverb: "Niitiin ani biraa harree salu, ormi haroo arbi dhiite godha" je'e, kan niitiirratti nama qabe
meaning_om: Wanta abbaan ofii tuffatee gate yookaan faayidaa hin qabne jedhee dhiise, namoonni biraa akka waan gati-jabeessa ta'eetti irratti daddafanii wal saamuuf figuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: Satirizes people who aggressively covet, scramble over, or inflate the value of something that its owner disregards, neglects, or finds entirely worthless

proverb: Buli buli jedhanii, kophaa nama bulchani
meaning_om: Afaaniin afeeranii fi simannaa mi'aawaa fakkeessanii, dhuma irratti garuu nama gatuu fi kophummaatti nama dhiisuu ibsa
meaning_en: Extending polite invitations or warm promises only to abandon the person without real hospitality, care, or support when they actually stay; hollow courtesy

proverb: Bishaaniif maraatee, danfa dhuga
meaning_om: Fedhii yookaan dhiphina hamaadhaan muddamee osoo hin tasgabbaayin furmaata barbaaduun, wanta nama gubu fi miidhaa guddaa fidu keessa of buusuu ibsa
meaning_en: Driven by reckless desperation or extreme thirst, a person rushes into a dangerous remedy that scalds and ruins them rather than satisfying their need

proverb: "Maaliif kofalta?" jennaan, "Ilkeetu na adii dha, rifeensaatu na gurraacha" jette
meaning_om: Bakka hin malleetti kofluu fi sababa bu'aa hin qabneen bareedina ofii mul'isuuf jecha of jajuu, koora fi qaanfii dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Laughing inappropriately or putting on frivolous displays merely to show off superficial physical vanity; offering silly, self-absorbed excuses for unbecoming behavior

proverb: Kan du'e awwaalle, kan jiru afaan wallaalle
meaning_om: Wanta darbe fi du'a sirnaan geggeessuun salphaa ta'us, fedhii, yaada fi amala nama jiru hubachuunii fi quubsuun baay'ee ulfaataa akka ta'e ibsa
meaning_en: While burying the dead and resolving past tragedies is straightforward, understanding, managing, and satisfying the unpredictable behavior and complaints of the living is endlessly perplexing

proverb: Ilmi abbaan abaare, gufuu teeysu dheeysa
meaning_om: Namni abaarsa maatii baatee fi qalbii qulqulluu hin qabne nagaa fi jagnummaa dhabee, wanta homaa isa hin goone iyyuu naasuu fi sodaadhaan dheessa
meaning_en: A child bearing a parental curse lacks inner peace and fortitude; burdened by guilt, paranoia, and misfortune, they live in perpetual terror, jumping at shadows and harmless obstacles

proverb: Abaarsa qabaatan, gaangee abaaramte fe'atan
meaning_om: Namni carraa hamaa yookaan abaarsa qabu wantuma akkasaatti carraa hin qabnee fi firii hin baafne waliin walitti dhufuun rakkoo ofii dachaa godhata
meaning_en: A person plagued by misfortune or ill fate often compounds their misery by pairing with something equally barren, ill-omened, or unproductive; misfortune attracts misfortune

proverb: Sa'a abaarsa qabu, kalloon isaa dibbe taati
meaning_om: Namni carraa hin qabne yookaan abaaramte jireenya keessatti qofa osoo hin taane, erga dhumateeyyuu dhiphinni fi tumiinsi walirraa hin cinne hordofee miidhamuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: An ill-fated or cursed person cannot escape suffering; their misfortunes follow them relentlessly, like the hide of an unlucky cow turned into a drum only to be perpetually beaten

proverb: Dhadhaa ibidda bu'e, rabbi si haa godhu
meaning_om: Abaarsa cimaa ta'ee, namni sun akkuma dhadhaa ibidda keessatti baqe dhabamuutti dafee akka lafarraa dhabamu, dhumatu fi faana dhabu hawwuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A severe traditional curse wishing that someone swiftly perishes, melts into complete ruin, and vanishes without a trace, just like butter dropped into a fire

proverb: Cilee bishaan buute, rabbi si haa godhu
meaning_om: Abaarsa cimaa dha; humni, ifti fi lubbuun nama sunii akkuma cilee bishaan keessa buutee tasa dhaamteetti akka dhaamu, akka baduufi deebi'ee hin kaanetti akka dhabamu hawwuu ibsa
meaning_en: A severe traditional curse wishing that a person's vitality, power, and life be permanently snuffed out and rendered utterly dead and powerless, like burning charcoal extinguished in water

proverb: Ilmi abboomii abbaa dide, abaarsa hin didu
meaning_om: Namni gorsa fi ajaja maatii ofii tuffatee dide, badiisaa fi abaarsa maatiirraa dhufu jalaa miliquu hin danda'u; badii fi kufaatiitu isa mudata
meaning_en: A child who rebels against parental guidance and authority cannot evade the inevitable misfortune, ruin, and curse that follows filial disobedience

proverb: Rabbi, buqqee caphxeen si haa waraabsisu
meaning_om: Abaarsa cimaa dha; hojiin, carraaqqiin fi jiruun nama sanaa akkuma bishaan buqqee cabe keessaa yaa'ee baduutti akka dhangala'ee bu'aa malee hafu hawwuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A severe traditional curse wishing that a person's labor, wealth, and endeavors leak away fruitlessly into complete futility, like water drawn with a broken gourd

proverb: Rabbi ilillii dikee irraan biqilte si haa godhu
meaning_om: Abaarsa cimaa dha; akkuma ililliin dikee/kosii irratti biqilte sababa xuriidhaan marfamteef namni fuudhee hin faayyanne fi hin safeeffanne, atis hawaasa keessatti gatami, tuffatami, kabaja dhabi jechuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A severe traditional curse wishing that one becomes like a flower rooted in filth—untouchable, shunned, and degraded so that no one values, plucks, or welcomes them into honorable society

proverb: Ilmi abaarsa haadhaa qabu, "Rooba keessaan dhukkee kaasa" je'eeti, fiiga
meaning_om: Namni abaarsa haadhaatiin qabame qalbii fi sammuu qajeelaa dhabee wanta hin taane fi maraatummaa ta'e haasa'aa of dadhabsa
meaning_en: A child suffering under a mother's curse loses sound judgment and moral grounding, acting delusionally and striving after absurd impossibilities to their own ruin

proverb: "Ani kaniin ureen cuqqaalaa inni kan ure haa cuqqaaluu" jette, jaartiin midhaan dhiiftee lootii gurraa bitatte
meaning_om: Wanta lubbuuf murteessaa ta'e kan akka nyaataa dhiisanii dhimma faayaa fi of-miidhagsuu laafaatiif dursa kennuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Satirizes the foolishness of prioritizing superficial luxury and vanity over essential survival needs like food, accompanied by selfish rationalization

proverb: Rabbi biraan shiira
meaning_om: Rabbi bira gabbina, barakaa fi badhaadhina qofatu jira; namni Rabbitti hirkatee fi abdii godhate gonkumaa hin honga'u, eebba fi quufa argata
meaning_en: With God there is abundant provision, fertility, and prosperity; whoever places their faith and reliance in God flourishes and never suffers true spiritual or material barrenness

proverb: Hamilee fi dhuufuun, garaa namaatii hin dhumani
meaning_om: Hamma lubbuun jirtutti fedhiin, hawwiin fi yaadi namaa yeroo hunda haaromaa jiraata malee gonkumaa keessaa hin dhumu
meaning_en: As long as human beings live, ambition, desires, and inner urges continually renew themselves and never truly deplete

proverb: Qaamaatu dullooma malee, onneen hin dulloomtu
meaning_om: Namni umuriin yoo dabalateyyuu fi humnaan yoo laafe, fedhiin, jaalallii fi kaka'umsi keessa isaa yeroo hunda dargaggeessa ta'ee hafa
meaning_en: While the physical body inevitably ages and frails with time, the spirit, passion, emotional capacity, and heart remain forever youthful

proverb: Tan kutte gundo, tan hafte guddo
meaning_om: Wanti hojjetamee yookaan dhumate muraasa yoo ta'u, wanti fuulduratti nama eeggatu yookaan hojjetamuu qabu baay'ee bal'aa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: What has been completed or harvested is only a tiny portion compared to the vast tasks, journey, or responsibilities that still lie ahead

proverb: Waraabessi bakka takka nyaatetti sagal agaba
meaning_om: Carraa yookaan bu'aa yeroo tokko argatanirratti qofa hirkachuun yeroo hedduu harka qullaa nama hambisa; iddoo tokkotti cichuun kasaaraa fida
meaning_en: Depending persistently on a one-time windfall or opportunity leads to repeated starvation and disappointment; one must actively seek new paths

proverb: Nama jiruutu waa hunda arga
meaning_om: Namni lubbuun dacheerra jiraatu wantoota dinqisiisaa, rakkisaa, gaarii fi hunda ijaan arguuf carraa qaba; jiraachuun barumsa hedduu nama gonfachiisa
meaning_en: So long as a person remains alive, they will witness the unexpected, miraculous, tragic, and astonishing wonders of human existence

proverb: "Haa bariitu" je'e ballaan, kan bariitullee hin argine
meaning_om: Wanta dhuunfaatti bu'aa hin qabne yookaan jijjiirama hin fidne dharra'uu; wanti tokko ta'us dhiisus ofii hin fayyadne beekaa hawwuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Yearning for an outcome or change that brings no personal benefit or difference, or echoing general hopes despite remaining unaffected by them

proverb: Waraabessaatu guyyaa yuuse, gammachuu harree duute
meaning_om: Gammachuu daangaa darbe yookaan faayidaa tasa argameen of to'achuu dadhabanii adabaa fi eeggannoo dhabuun of saaxiluu ibsa
meaning_en: Losing all composure, decorum, and caution due to reckless excitement over an unexpected gain, thereby foolishly exposing oneself to danger

proverb: Gaaffiin nama hin fayyiftu, qalbii nama wayyeessiti
meaning_om: Nama dhukkubsate yookaan dhiphate gaafachuun dhukkuba balleessuu baatus, sammuu fi qalbii isaa jajjabeeffatee nagaa fi abdii akka argatu godha
meaning_en: Inquiring after or visiting the sick does not medically cure their physical condition, but it uplifts their spirits and provides deep emotional comfort

proverb: Kan argatan irra, kan abdataniitu caala
meaning_om: Wanta harka irra jiru caalaa, abdiin fi kajeellaan gara fuulduraa nama jajjabeeffatee sochoosa; abdiin jireenyaaf humna guddaadha
meaning_en: Anticipation and hope for tomorrow provide greater motivation and vital energy than present possessions; hope sustains human vitality

proverb: "Waan waaqaa hin beekanii, haadha Waaqoo naan jedhaa" jette, dullattiin ilma hin qabne
meaning_om: Wanta hin danda'amne fi umuriin darbe abdatee of gowwomsuu, yookaan kabaja fi maqaa bu'uura hin qabneen of waamsiisuuf yaaluu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: Satirizes clinging to completely unrealistic delusions and demanding honorific titles or respect based on sheer fantasy rather than reality

proverb: Moluu koo gulanaaf si abdadhe
meaning_om: Dulluma, jaarsummaa fi muuxannoo fuulduratti dhufu kabaja fi faayidaa argachuuf abdatee ta'uu; akkasumas wanta ofii qaban yeroo dullumaatiif abdatanii of jajjabeessuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Placing hope in one's advancing age and maturity for future wisdom, dignity, and elderhood; relying on accumulated traits for standing in later years

proverb: "Eessatti deemta" jennaan, Raachi "hajjittin deema" je'e, "duuba dhaquu dandeessaa amma kanaan" jennaan "dubbiin niyyaa dha" je'e
meaning_om: Humnaa fi dandeettii ofiitiin ol wanta ta'e karoorfatanii 'yaadni fi fedhiin koo qulqulluudha' jechuun of jajjabeessuu; akkasumas milkaa'inaaf kutannoofi niyyaan gaariin bu'uura ta'uu qoosaan ibsa
meaning_en: Satirizes setting extraordinarily grand, nearly impossible goals far beyond one's physical means while trusting solely in pure intention; humorously highlights the tension between high aspirations and modest capabilities

proverb: Laagaa baname Rabbumaatu cufa
meaning_om: Lubbuu fi afaan uumame hundumaaf kan nyaachisuu fi sooru Waaqayyo qofa; uumamaan namni jireenyaaf waan isa barbaachisu akka hin dhabne abdii Rabbii irratti qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Every mouth that God brings into the world, He faithfully sustains and provides for; affirms complete trust in divine providence for sustenance and survival

proverb: Margi xoolage, mandiisuu jecha dheebuu hin bahu
meaning_om: Namni rakkoo hamaa fi dhiphina keessa jiru haasaa mi'aawaa fi waadaa afaaniitiin furmaata hin argatu; gargaarsa fi gocha qabatamaa barbaada malee waci faayidaa hin qabu
meaning_en: Mere promises, loud declarations, or sympathetic talk cannot relieve deep distress or poverty; practical action and tangible help are required, just as parched grass needs real rain rather than distant thunder

proverb: Hamma qalannee hin nyaannetti beeluma
meaning_om: Wanti tokko qabatamaan harka nama hin seeninitti fi faayidaarra hin oolinitti abdii qofa qabaachuun bu'aa hin kennu; hanga dhimmi xumuramuutti of eeggachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Until a resource or promised gain is actually realized, in hand, and utilized, one remains in lack; having potential assets does not satisfy present need until actual execution

proverb: Bishingaa fi ilmi dhiiraa, torba kufaniiti torba ka'ani
meaning_om: Akkuma bishingaan yoo bubbeen buqqisee kufe deebi'ee ol dhaabbatu, namni jabaanis kufaatii fi dhiphina jireenyaa hundaa mo'ee deebi'ee ka'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Just as hardy sorghum bends or falls before strong winds only to rise back up, a resolute person endures repeated downfalls but persistently rises again; resilience and grit

proverb: Rifaasuu booddi gammachuu dha
meaning_om: Sodaa, rifannoo fi qormaata cimaa booda tasgabbiin, nagaa fi gammachuun bu'aa; dhiphinni hundi darbee boqonnaa akka fidu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Severe fright, dread, and distress are ultimately followed by profound joy and relief once the danger passes; trial gives birth to peace

proverb: Joollee Rabbiitu guddisa
meaning_om: Daa'imman guddifachuun tattaaffii namaa qofaan osoo hin taane eebba fi eegumsa Rabbii irratti kan hirkate ta'uu; maatiin hiyyeessa ta'us ijoolleen akka hin beelofne amanuu ibsa
meaning_en: Raising children safely into adulthood relies upon divine providence, grace, and protection rather than mere human wealth or effort alone

proverb: Akka kufanitti waa hin hafani
meaning_om: Namni yoo kufe yookaan rakkoon qabame akkuma sanatti hafee hin dhumatu; yeroon jijjiiramaa waan ta'eef deebi'anii ka'uun hin oolamu
meaning_en: No one remains permanently stuck in the defeat or misfortune in which they stumbled; time and human resilience ensure recovery and rebirth

proverb: Rabbi, darbee nama hin darbu
meaning_om: Waaqayyo yeroof akka nama dhiiseetti yoo mul'ateyyuu, gonkumaa nama hin dagatu; haqaa fi murtiin isaa yeroo sirriitti hundaan akka qaqqabu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Though divine justice or aid may seem to delay for a season, God never forgets or bypasses anyone; divine balance and judgment reach all in due time

proverb: Kan waaqiin bulu, agabuu hin bulu
meaning_om: Namni Waaqayyoon amanee fi isa irratti hirkate gonkumaa beelaan hin rakkatu; eebbi fi rizqiin uumaa biraa waan hin dhabamneef abdii hin kutatu
meaning_en: Whoever relies on and places their faith in God will never starve or be abandoned; divine providence unfailingly sustains the faithful

proverb: Tasalaq nafsee, abdadhu lubbuu
meaning_om: Rakkina, gidiraa fi dhiphina jireenyaa keessatti obsaan of jajjabeessaa, abdii osoo hin kutatin gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Urging one's soul to persevere patiently through trials and hold fast to hope; a self-comforting expression of resilience in hard times

proverb: Qanqalloo maranii, Rabbi hin mararani
meaning_om: Qabeenyaa fi meeshaa ofii maranii dhoksuun yookaan qusachuun ni danda'ama, garuu murtii, eegumsaa fi beekumsa Waaqayyoo daangessuun yookaan jalaa miliquun gonkumaa hin danda'amu
meaning_en: One can fold up, pack away, or conceal a leather bag, but God's omniscience, justice, and sovereign power cannot be contained, escaped, or manipulated

proverb: Tan kutte qallo, tan hafte bal'oo dha
meaning_om: Wanti dhumate yookaan darbe xiqqoo ta'ee, wanti fuulduratti nama eeggatu bal'aa fi dheeraa ta'uu agarsiisa; dafee of dhiisuu yookaan dagachuu akka hin qabne akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: What you have passed or accomplished is only a narrow slice, while the road, tasks, and future remaining ahead are expansive; caution against complacency

proverb: Nama du'e, mormi dheeraadha
meaning_om: Namni du'e yookaan aangoo dhabee kufe ofirraa falmuu waan hin dandeenyeef, namni hundi irratti dubbata, itti roorrisa yookaan komii hunda irratti fe'a
meaning_en: A deceased or completely incapacitated person has lost the power to resist or defend themselves; thus, anyone can place blame or make claims against them without opposition

proverb: Harreen duute, waraabeessa hin sodaattu
meaning_om: Namni wanta hunda dhabe, miidhame yookaan kufaatii dhumaa keessa jiru sodaa homaayyuu hin qabu; wanti dhabu biraan waan hin jirreef roorroo fi doorsisa hin sodaatu
meaning_en: One who has hit rock bottom or lost everything has nothing left to fear; threats and danger no longer intimidate someone with nothing left to lose

proverb: Namni galaaf ka'e, nama galaafata
meaning_om: Namni bu'aa dhuunfaa yookaan lubbuu ofiitiif jedhee miidhaa namarratti hojjechuuf ka'e, nama biraas miidhee galaafata; badiin isaanii nama biraattis daddarba
meaning_en: Someone determined on reckless exploitation or devastation will ruthlessly destroy others to achieve their aim; malice and desperation bring destruction to those in their path

proverb: Du'aan, waa balleeyseeti du'a
meaning_om: Namni kufaa jiru, kasaare yookaan badii jala gahe osoo ofii hin dhumin wanta biraas mancaasee yookaan nama biraas kuffisee deema; kufaatii ofiitti nama biraa hirmaachisa
meaning_en: A dying, ruined, or falling person rarely goes down alone; in their desperation and collapse, they wreck something or drag others down with them

proverb: Namni garba lixe, hoomacha qaqqabata
meaning_om: Namni rakkoo fi balaa hamaa keessa bu'e furmaata argachuuf jedhee wanta bu'aa hin qabne fi hin dandamachiisne iyyuu qabachuuf yaala; dhiphinni guddaan gowwummaatti nama geessa
meaning_en: A person facing catastrophe or drowning in despair will grasp desperately at even the flimsiest, most futile illusion of rescue; clutching at straws

proverb: Kan tolchuu dadhabe, balleeysuu hin dadhabu
meaning_om: Wanta gaarii ijaaruu fi fooyyessuun dandeettii fi humna guddaa kan barbaadu ta'us, wanta ijaarame diiguu fi balleessuun baay'ee salphaa akka ta'e ibsa; nama gaarummaa hin qabne irraa badiitu eegama
meaning_en: While creating or repairing something takes skill, patience, and effort, destroying or ruining it requires none; an incompetent or ill-willed person can easily cause destruction

proverb: Namni akka fedhu dhabe, akka hin feene taha
meaning_om: Namni wanta hawwuu fi barbaadu dhabe, dirqama haala hin jaalannee fi hin feene keessa jiraachuuf murteeffata; carraa dhabuun jireenya hin feenetti nama geessa
meaning_en: One who fails to achieve or obtain what they desire is forced by necessity to settle for or become what they never wanted; compromise under hardship

proverb: Akki jennu silaa hedduu, akka jenneetu irra hedduu dha
meaning_om: Wanti dubbachuuf yookaan gochuuf yaadame baay'ee ta'us, wanti qabatamaan dubbatamee fi ta'ee darbe dhimma sana caalaa ulfaataa fi bal'aa ta'ee argamuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Although there were countless things intended or planned to be spoken, what actually transpired and was uttered carries far more weight and consequence

proverb: "Duruu foon kee hin mi'aawuu deemi" je'e, kuruphoo reebe qabuu dadhabnaan
meaning_om: Wanta ofii argachuu dadhaban yookaan galma gahuu hin dandeenye tokko tuffatanii fi gatii akka hin qabneetti dubbachuun qaanii ofii dhoksuuf yaaluu
meaning_en: Belittling or pretending to disdain an opportunity, person, or prize simply because one failed to attain it; a classic 'sour grapes' rationalization

proverb: Namni manni itti dhimmisu, rooba dheessuuf waa hin jarjaru
meaning_om: Namni keessi manaa yookaan jireenyi isaa rakkoo walfakkaatuun dhiphachaa jiru, dhibee alaa jalaa dheessuuf hin jarjaru; bakki itti dheessanis rakkoodha waan ta'eef
meaning_en: Someone whose shelter or personal foundation is already troubled feels no urgency to escape external adversity, knowing their refuge offers no better comfort

proverb: Namni ooyruu buraanaa, niin bobbahaaf hin jarjaru
meaning_om: Hojiin yookaan qorumsi nama fuuldura jiru baay'ee rakkisaa, dadhabsiisaa fi nuffisiisaa yoo ta'e, namni itti seenuuf fedhii dhabee dafee hojiitti hin jarjaru
meaning_en: When an upcoming task or responsibility is daunting, backbreaking, and tedious, a person dreads beginning and drags their feet rather than rushing into work

proverb: Osoo nyaadhu naan jedhee maalif ijoollee koo sagal godha
meaning_om: Hiyyummaa fi maatii bal'aa qabaachuun ofiif quufanii nyaachuu akka hin dandeessifne, waan argame hundi ijoolleef oolee ofiif beela'uun dirqama ta'uu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: Reflects the struggle of raising a large family in scarcity, where having many mouths to feed forces self-denial upon parents and prevents them from ever eating their fill

proverb: Manni gubannaan, "nuti duruu gubachaa jirraa, Taguugaaf booyaa" je'e, Qibaabaan
meaning_om: Namni yookaan wanti duruu qormaata fi rakkina keessa ture balaa haaraatti hin rifatu; balaa keessatti isa rakkina bare osoo hin taane, isa laafaa fi qabeenya dhabamuuf dursa yaaddahuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Those already hardened by daily adversity remain unfazed by new crises; in times of disaster, sympathy and protection should be directed toward the truly vulnerable and fragile stores that cannot endure the trial

proverb: Dhadhaa hafeef hin dhugani lafeef dhugan malee
meaning_om: Wanta gati-jabeessa tokko faayidaa malee dhangalaasuu dhiisuuf osoo hin taane, bu'aa fi humna inni qaamaaf kennu beekanii itti fayyadamuun akka barbaachisu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One consumes or utilizes valuable resources not merely to finish leftovers, but for their substantive nutritional benefit and vitality; actions must be purpose-driven

proverb: Bitaan kortuus, mirgaan kortuus, wal gahiin kooraa dha
meaning_om: Malli fi daandiin itti fayyadaman garaagara ta'us, bu'aan, galmi fi xumurri dhimma tokkoo tokkuma ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Though approaches, methods, or angles may differ, they all lead to the exact same destination, outcome, or realization

proverb: Bakka feetetti daakii, daakuun naa gali
meaning_om: Karaan itti hojjetamu yookaan bakki inni itti raawwatamu dhimma hin qabu, wanti dursa barbaadamu bu'aa fi firii qabatamaa argachuu qofaadha
meaning_en: The process, style, or location of execution is secondary; what matters above all else is delivering the tangible end result

proverb: Yaadan waan boruu, nyaatan waan garaa
meaning_om: Fuulduraaf karoorsuu fi yaaduun dirqama yoo ta'ellee, dursa dhimma lubbuu tursiisu fi fedhii bu'uuraa har'aa guuttachuun madaallii jireenyaa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: While planning thoughtfully for tomorrow is vital, satisfying today's immediate basic survival needs is paramount to staying alive

proverb: Kuun garatti, kuun garaachatti una
meaning_om: Namoonni waan tokko hubannoo fi qalbii adda addaatiin fudhatu; tokko ogummaa fi yaadatti yoo jijjiiru, kaan ammoo fedhii qaamaa fi faayidaa laafaaf qofa fayyadama
meaning_en: Different people internalize life experiences quite differently; one transforms things into wisdom and character, while another reduces everything to crude physical appetite

proverb: Hattuu halkanii, gufuun hin dhoorkitu
meaning_om: Namni dhimma hamaa yookaan gaariidhaaf fedhii fi murannoo cimaa qabaatee ka'e gufuu fi rakkoo xixiqqoodhaan karaatti hin dhaabbatu
meaning_en: A person fiercely determined on their mission will not be deterred or halted by minor hazards or obstacles in their path

proverb: Oduufiin ala bule jette tafkiin
meaning_om: Sababa dadhabina, fedhii dhuunfaa yookaan rakkoo ofii dhoksuuf jecha oduu fi dhimma ormaatiin qabame jechuun sababa sobaa dhiheessuu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: Satirizes inventing flimsy or absurd pretexts to disguise personal failure, helplessness, or idle, meddlesome behavior

proverb: Bakakkaa, anaaf taatu muka hin galaafatin; mukaaf taatu ana hin galaafatin
meaning_om: Balaan yoo dhufe isa balleessaa qabu qofa haa mudatu malee, nama nagaa fi wanta dhimma hin qabne balleessuu akka hin qabne; miidhaa qaxxaamuraa balaaleffata
meaning_en: A plea for targeted justice and restraint, emphasizing that calamity or retribution should never needlessly consume innocent bystanders

proverb: Fagoon karaa miti garaadha malee
meaning_om: Fageenyi dhugaa daandii fi deemsa lafaa osoo hin taane wal-jaalachuu fi qalbii walitti qabaachuu dhabuudha; yoo garaan walitti dhihaate fagoon dhihoo ta'a
meaning_en: True distance is never defined by physical miles or geographic roads, but by emotional separation and alienation between hearts

proverb: Qalbii malee, miilli deemeef nama hin geeysu
meaning_om: Karoora, sammuu fi qalbii sirrii malee carraaqqiin qaamaa fi fiigichi qofti nama hin milkeessu; kaayyoo fi ogummaan deemsa dursuu qaba
meaning_en: Without sound judgment, purpose, and thoughtful planning, mere physical exertion and roaming will never lead to genuine achievement; wisdom must guide effort

proverb: Miilli karaa garaan jiru deema
meaning_om: Namni bakka jaalalli, fedhiin fi kajeellaan qalbii isaa jirutti socho'a malee, dirree garaa hin jirre hin deemu; sochiin qaamaa kan hoogganamu fedhii keessaatiini
meaning_en: A person's steps inevitably follow where their heart, desire, and affection reside; human actions are propelled by genuine internal passion

proverb: Bakka garaan jiru, ijji jirti
meaning_om: Xiyyeeffannaan fi ilaalchi namaa yeroo hunda wanta garaan jaalate, kajeelle yookaan yaade irratti kan bu'u ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One's gaze, focus, and visual attention are invariably fixed upon whatever the heart loves and longs for; external attention reflects inner affection

proverb: Laalaa munnee kanniisaa, daymatti obsan
meaning_om: Bu'aa gaarii, qabeenya fi jireenya mi'aawaa argachuuf jecha qormaata, dhukkubbii fi rakkina karaarratti nama mudatu obsaan danda'uun dirqama ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: The painful sting of the bee is willingly endured for the sweetness of honey; great rewards and success require persevering through necessary hardships

proverb: Kan dayma jaalatu, kanniisa hin sodaatu
meaning_om: Namni bu'aa guddaa fi milkaa'ina mi'aawaa dharra'u balaa fi qormaata dhimma sana keessa jiru sodaachuu akka hin qabne, kutannoon akka barbaachisu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One who desires high rewards must not shrink before inevitable risks or hazards; pursuing valuable goals demands boldness and resolve

proverb: Gootni ooleef, lolli hin oolu
meaning_om: Dhimmi, hojiin yookaan qabsoon barbaachisaan tokko sababa nama tokkoo qofaaf hin dhaabbatu; namni kamiinuu yoo hafe wanti ta'uu qabu itti fufa
meaning_en: A vital battle, task, or movement does not halt because of any single person's absence, no matter how distinguished they are; collective duty continues

proverb: Bakka geessu, lafa geessi
meaning_om: Namni aangoo, qabeenya yookaan sadarkaa guddaa irra yoo gaheyyuu, of tuuluu dhiisee gad of qabuu fi lafa yaaduu qaba; dhumni nama hundaa lafuma
meaning_en: No matter how high one rises in status, power, or achievement, one must remain humble, ethical, and grounded, remembering that all mortals return to the earth

proverb: Bofa mata dhawan
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan balaa tokko dhabamsiisuuf damee fi bu'aa isaa osoo hin taane, hundee fi ka'umsa dhimma sanaarratti xiyyeeffachuun tarkaanfii fudhachuu qabu
meaning_en: A crisis or dangerous adversary must be neutralized decisively at its root rather than treating superficial symptoms; strike the snake on the head to end the threat

proverb: Galeen yoo mana gaye
meaning_om: Hojiin, imalli yookaan karoorri tokko hanga milkaa'inaan xumuramee galma gahutti akka waan ta'eetti lakkaa'amuu hin qabu; bu'aan dhuma irratti mirkanaa'a
meaning_en: A journey or endeavor cannot be deemed successful until it is safely concluded and one has arrived home; do not celebrate prematurely

proverb: Miilli amna fuunaan, harki itti akkeeyse
meaning_om: Hojiin tokko yeroo kallattii bu'uuraatiin jalqabame qaamoleen biroos qindoominaa fi wal-ta'iinsaan tumsuu qabu; sochiin jalqabaa isa kaan kakaasa
meaning_en: When an initiative is boldly set in motion, supporting components naturally fall into cadence to cooperate; synergy and rhythm in collective effort

proverb: Bookeen, kan bakka kooban hin qabne na koobaa jette
meaning_om: Namni humna, dandeettii yookaan iddoo gahaa hin qabne tokko wanta guddaa fi madaallii isaatiin hin deemne akka isaaf godhamu barbaaduu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: Satirizes someone of insignificant stature or means who makes absurd, outsized demands for elaborate treatment completely disproportionate to their reality

proverb: Yeroo gabbattuun burraayxu, huqqattuun eege dhaabdi
meaning_om: Namni humnaa fi qabeenya qabu yoo gammachuun mirqane, namni dadhabaan humna hin qabnes isa faana bu'ee akkasaatti of agarsiisuuf yaaluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: When the strong and prosperous celebrate their abundance, the impoverished copycat vainly tries to imitate their antics without the requisite strength

proverb: Hoolaan harree wajjin oolte, nama dhiitu barti
meaning_om: Namni amala gaarii qabu yoo nama badaa wajjin michoome, suuta suutaan amala hamaa fi badiisa nama sanaa baruun miidhama
meaning_en: A well-mannered person who keeps regular company with bad elements eventually adopts their harmful and aggressive ways; corruption through company

proverb: Hiriyaan koo dhale je'eeti, sangaan ittane
meaning_om: Wanta uumamaanii fi humnaan ofiif hin malle tokko ormi waan hojjeteef qofa 'anis nan godha' jedhanii of dadhabsuu fi of salphisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Grotesquely straining to duplicate an impossible feat merely because someone else accomplished it, completely ignoring one's natural limits

proverb: Lukkuun nama agarteeti, mataa gadi jettee mana seenti
meaning_om: Wanta ofiif barbaachisaa hin taane ormi waan raawwateef qofa ofirraan naquu; safeeffannaa fi amala faayidaa hin qabne akkeessuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Adopting unnecessary precautions or pretentious behaviors simply from observing others, without any practical relevance to one's own condition

proverb: Ilkee hin qabduu, rigaa harkaa qabdi
meaning_om: Wanta qabatamaan fayyaduu hin dandeenye qabatanii akka nama qabuutti of agarsiisuu; dandeettii fi bu'uura dhabanii meeshaa alaa qofaan fakkeessuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Displaying the outward tools or pretensions for something one completely lacks the natural foundation or ability to use; empty pretense and vain display

proverb: Ulfaachuun kan ulfaati jennaan, gowwittiin garaa dhiibde
meaning_om: Kabajaa fi ulfina dhugaa qabaachuu dhiisanii, bifa alaa fi wanta sobaatiin kabajamaa of fakkeessuuf yaalee qaaniitti of saaxiluu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Misunderstanding genuine honor and dignity, and foolishly attempting to fake it through superficial, exaggerated posturing; ridiculous mimicry of respect

proverb: Akka abaluuttin jiraadhaan ija nama baysa
meaning_om: Humnaa fi dandeettii ofii osoo hin madaalin nama biraa faana bu'anii jireenya isaanii akkeessuuf yaaluun kasaaraa, badiisa fi qaanitti nama geessa
meaning_en: Striving blindly to mimic someone else's affluent lifestyle beyond one's own means ruins a person financially and socially; perils of foolish envy

proverb: Akka leencaattiin utaala jettee, qamaleen tafaa buqqaate
meaning_om: Humnaa fi dandeettii ofiitiin ol wanta ta'e gochuuf yaaluun miidhaa fi qaama miidhamuutti nama geessa; of-beekuu dhabuu fi dorgommii dogoggoraa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Overestimating one's physical limits by attempting to replicate the feats of the mighty results in severe self-inflicted injury; failure of self-awareness

proverb: Tafkiin akka gaalaattin dhaabbadha jetteet, sombaa dhoote
meaning_om: Wanta uumama ofiitiin ol ta'eef dhaadachuun fi of tuuluun badiisa fida; namni xiqqaan akka nama guddaatti of dhiheessuuf yaalu ofuma balleessa
meaning_en: A tiny entity arrogantly attempting to emulate the towering stature of a giant destroys itself in the process; fatal hubris and megalomania

proverb: Isheen durii akka barte, isheen ammaa akka agarte
meaning_om: Dhalonni durii aadaa, gorsaa fi barsiifata ganamaa hordofee yoo jiraatu, dhalonni ammaa ammoo wanta ijaan arge, dhiibbaa ammayyaa fi amala ormaa hordofee jiraachuu ibsa
meaning_en: The older generation lived anchored in disciplined tradition and moral upbringing, whereas the modern generation is driven by trends and visual impressions

proverb: Soogiddi mataan dhiqadha je'e laga dhaqeeti mataan lagatti hafe
meaning_om: Namni wanta uumama isaatiif balaa guddaa ta'e tokko akka waan gaariitti ilaalee itti seenuun of balleessuu; qorannoo malee bu'aa barbaaduun dhabama fida
meaning_en: Seeking improvement through something inherently incompatible and destructive to one's very existence, leading to total dissolution; fatal folly

proverb: Biyyi ni rafaaf, jaamaan ol dabarti
meaning_om: Yeroo warri dhimmi ilaallatu dagatan yookaan dammaqina dhabanitti, namni dandeettii fi mirga hin qabne carraatti fayyadamee dhimma ofii raawwata
meaning_en: When the community or authorities are negligent or asleep, even the unqualified or cunning slip through unnoticed; the perils of collective apathy

proverb: Haalli gaariin nama guddisa
meaning_om: Amalli gaariin, safeeffannaan, kabajni fi naamusni nama tokko hawaasa keessatti akka kabajamu, sadarkaa akka argatuufi guddatu taasisa
meaning_en: Virtuous character, courtesy, and integrity elevate an individual to honor, maturity, and social distinction; character defines true stature

proverb: Qabriin haala ofiiti
meaning_om: Boqonnaa fi nagaan qabrii keessatti argamu akkuma amala, gocha gaarii fi safuu namni addunyaarratti hojjeteen murtaa'a; namni hojii isaatiin deebii argata
meaning_en: One's peace or torment in the afterlife is directly shaped by their personal deeds and moral conduct; as you sow in character, so shall your grave be

proverb: Ibsaan mana hin ibsuu, amalaatu ibsa
meaning_om: Nagaan, gammachuu fi ifti dhugaan mana keessatti kan mirkanaa'u meeshaa fi ibsaa alaa irraa osoo hin taane, amala gaarii fi safeeffannaa warra manaatiini
meaning_en: Physical light merely banishes darkness, but virtuous character, patience, and love truly brighten and warm a home; material luxury cannot replace good conduct

proverb: Adurreen haala isiitiif, madabaarra bulti
meaning_om: Amalli gaariin, qulqullinni fi tasgabbiin nama tokko bakka kabajamaa fi ol-aanaa akka argatu isa dandeessisa; amala ofiitiin kabajamu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Gentle manners, cleanliness, and agreeable conduct earn one an honorable seat and warm acceptance; courteous behavior opens access to elevated places

proverb: Haalli hamaan hundee nama balleessa
meaning_om: Amalli gadheen, roorroon fi hammeenyi qabeenya, maatii, maqaa fi jiruu namaa hundee irraa dhabamsiisa; namni amala badaa qabu guddina hin qabaatu
meaning_en: A toxic or wicked disposition destroys an individual from their very roots, dismantling their reputation, relationships, and legacy completely

proverb: Amalli bilbilaa abbaa'rraa qillisa
meaning_om: Amalli dhugaa akkuma bilbila rukutamee sagalee ifa ta'e kennutti, gocha, haasaa fi jireenya nama sanaa irraa ifatti mul'ata malee hin dhokatu
meaning_en: A person's character cannot be hidden; just like a ringing bell, one's true nature resounds and reveals itself unmistakably through speech and actions

proverb: Haalli gaariin siree si korsiise alagaa wajjin si nyaachisa, haalli hamaan firarraa kophaa si baaseeti, kophaa si teeysisa
meaning_om: Amalli gaariin nama ormaa fira godhee kabaja guddaa namaaf kenna; amalli hamaan garuu fira ofii iyyuu nama baqachiisee kophummaa fi salphina fida
meaning_en: Virtuous conduct wins honor and hospitality even among distant strangers, while toxic malice alienates one's own kin and leaves them isolated in disgrace

proverb: Waamichi tolu owwaannaan tola
meaning_om: Namatti dhiheenyi, kabajnii fi haasaan yoo gaarii ta'e, deebiin fi hariiroon ormarraa argamus nagaa fi jaalalaan kan guutame ta'a; gaarummaan deebii gaarii fida
meaning_en: When approached with genuine courtesy, respect, and warmth, people naturally respond with goodwill; polite communication elicits cooperative responses

proverb: Lukkuun bineensi qabuus numa iyyiti, abbaan qabus numa iyyiti
meaning_om: Namni amala komii fi waca qabu wanti isa mudate gaarii yookaan hamaa ta'us, bu'aa isaafis ta'e miidhaaf yoo ta'e yeroo hunda komachuu irraa hin dhaabbatu
meaning_en: A chronically discontented or alarmist individual cries out in protest indiscriminately, regardless of whether they are being harmed or safely assisted

proverb: Keessummaan durri fuulaa, nyaanni kuula
meaning_om: Keessummaa simachuuf kan dursa barbaachisu fuula ifaa, nagaa fi gammachuudhaan simachuudha malee, fuula gurraachaan nyaata dhiheessuun gatii hin qabu
meaning_en: In hospitality, a warm, smiling countenance and sincere welcome take priority over all else; lavish dishes are merely secondary adornments

proverb: Keessummaan fuula bulti
meaning_om: Keessummaan boqonnaa fi nagaa kan argatu nyaataa fi firaashii qofarraa osoo hin taane, fuula gammachuu fi simannaa gaarii abbaan manaa agarsiisu irraayi
meaning_en: A guest's sense of peace and comfort depends primarily on the warm, hospitable expression of the host; a smiling face provides the best shelter

proverb: Harreen hoggaa iyyitu malee, hoggaa dhudhuuftu of hin beektu
meaning_om: Namni tokko wanta guddaa fi ifa ta'e kan akka haasaa qofa beeka malee, amala fokkisaa fi badiisa xixiqqoo ofiitiin raawwatu ofirratti arguuf dammaqina akka hin qabne agarsiisa
meaning_en: A person is conscious only of their loud, deliberate pronouncements while remaining entirely oblivious to their own recurring, shameful habits; profound lack of self-awareness

proverb: Harraagessi dhallaa ofii hin arguu, kan namaatti kaakkisa
meaning_om: Hanqinaa fi yeelloo guddaa ofii qaban dagatanii, hanqina nama biraatti kolfuu, qishnaa godhuu fi komachuun fakkeessummaa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: Blind to one's own glaring shortcomings and vulnerabilities while loudly mocking, scolding, and gossiping about the flaws of others; blatant hypocrisy

proverb: Sareen eegee ofii hin argituu, re'een eegee gadi qabi jetti
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa fi hanqina qabu ofii isaatii qulqulluu akka ta'etti ilaaluun, nama biraatiin 'amala kee sirreeffadhu' jedhee gorsuuf yaaluu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: The dog ignores its own permanently lifted tail yet scolds the goat to cover its rear; lecturing others on modesty or propriety while violating it oneself

proverb: Jaldeessi dhallaa isaa hin arguu, kan namaatti kolfa
meaning_om: Namni hanqinaa fi qaanii ofii qabu arguus ta'ee amanuu dadhabee, dogoggora walfakkaataa nama biraatiin argutti kolfuu fi ceepha'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The baboon fails to see its own glaringly red rear, yet laughs mockingly at others; oblivious to one's own absurdities while ridiculing others

proverb: Qaalluun kan ofii hin beektuu, kan namaa raagatti
meaning_om: Namni rakkoo fi dhimma dhuunfaa ofiituu furuu fi baruu dadhabe, nama biraatiif gorsituu fi beektuu of fakkeessuuf yaaluu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: The fortune-teller understands nothing of her own future or struggles, yet presumes to divine the fate of others; pretending wisdom while helpless in one's own life

proverb: Nama sablina ofii kan hanga balbalaa hin argineetu, kan namaa hanga qaawa lilmee arga
meaning_om: Dogoggoraa fi balleessaa ofii isa guddaa akka balbalaatti bal'atu utuu hin argin cal'isanii, dogoggora nama biraa isa baay'ee xiqqoo ta'e barbaadanii ceepha'uu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Utterly blind to one's own colossal, doorway-sized sins while hyper-scrutinizing and magnifying the needle-eye-sized imperfections of others; gross double standards

proverb: Lilmeen ofii kan biraa seenuu malee, kan isii seenu hin agartu
meaning_om: Namni tokko miidhaa, qeeqa fi ceephoo nama biraarratti raawwatu qofa ilaala malee, dogoggora, hanqinaa fi dhiibbaa ofirra jiru hin hubatu
meaning_en: A person is keenly aware of the criticisms, pain, or scrutiny they thrust upon others, yet remains completely blind to what threads through their own flaws

proverb: Ijji halaala agartu, of jala hin agartu
meaning_om: Namni dhimma ormaa fi wantoota fagaatan hubatee hordofuu danda'us, wanta dhihoo isaatti ta'aa jiru, hanqina ofii fi rakkina maatii ofii arguuf dammaqina dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: A person may possess sharp vision for distant affairs and other people's problems, yet remain totally blind to the crises right under their own nose

proverb: Kan Ormi namaan jedhu maaliif wallaalani, kan Ormi isaaniin jedhu maaliif beekani?
meaning_om: Namni qeeqa fi dhimma nama biraatiif gurra cufatee akka waan hin hubannetti callisee, wanta dhuunfaa isaatiin jedhamuuf garuu dammaqinaan qoratamu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Critiques the hypocrisy of selective hearing: playing dumb to the hardships or reputations of others while being obsessively sensitive to what is said about oneself

proverb: Kan akka bultii hin beekne, akka jechaa hin wallaalu
meaning_om: Namni jireenya, maatii fi hojii qabatamaa hoogganuu fi geggeessuu dadhabe, afaaniin nama gorsuu, qeequu fi haasa'uu irratti hayyuu of fakkeessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Those who are utterly incompetent at managing their own lives or households are invariably the first to lecture and preach to others; all talk and no substance

proverb: Yaa saree, osoo waan siin ja'an beeytee, waan siif kennan hin nyaattu
meaning_om: Namni tokko faayidaa xiqqoo yookaan nyaata argatuuf jedhee tuffii fi arrabsoo ormi isa irratti raawwatu osoo hin beekin callisee fudhachuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Accepting meager scraps or favors from people who secretly or openly revile and despise you; sacrificing dignity and self-respect for humiliating handouts

proverb: Sa'a bishaan balfaniitu, bishaan balfa
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiiyyuu ormaan tuffatamee fi lagatamu tokko wanta isaaf kennamuuf tuffii fi diddaa agarsiisuu; madaallii ofii dhabuu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: Someone whom others barely tolerate or accommodate turns around and arrogantly rejects what is offered to them; absurd entitlement and unearned pickiness

proverb: Gangalattuutu, xullubsoo jaja
meaning_om: Namni badii fi xurii guddaa keessa gangalate tokko nama balleessaa xiqqoo qabu ceepha'uu fi komachuu; fakkeessummaa fi madaallii jal'aa balaaleffata
meaning_en: One who is completely wallowing in deep scandal or corruption shamelessly criticizes someone who made a minor slip; extreme hypocrisy

proverb: Of hin argituu, galteeti raafuu lagatti
meaning_om: Hiyyummaa fi sadarkaa ofii osoo beekanii, wanta salphaa fi argame tuffatanii akka nama sooreessaatti of dhiheessuuf yaaluu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Failing to recognize one's own humble poverty and haughtily turning one's nose up at basic available food; foolish and starving snobbery

proverb: Abbaan of hin argu
meaning_om: Namni hanqina, dogoggoraa fi amala badaa ofirra jiru ijaan arguuf dandeettii akka hin qabne, of-ilaaluu dhabuun uumama namaa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: A person cannot objectively see their own faults, blind spots, and shortcomings; human beings naturally lack direct perception of their own defects

proverb: Abbaan of daawwachuu hin dandayu
meaning_om: Akkuma namni fuula ofii ilaaluuf daawwitii barbaadu, amala fi gocha ofiis madaaluuf qeeqa fi ilaalcha nama biraatiin akka of baru agarsiisa
meaning_en: Just as one cannot see their own face without a mirror, an individual cannot dispassionately evaluate their own conduct without external perspective

proverb: Namni rafu, huuruu ifii hin dhagayu
meaning_om: Namni dogoggora yookaan amala nuffisiisaa raawwatu tokko wanti inni godhu namoota biraa akkamitti akka dhiphisu ofii isaatii hin hubatu
meaning_en: One who engages in disruptive, annoying behavior is often the only one in the room completely oblivious to the disturbance they cause to others

proverb: Abbaan if hin himu
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiif beekumsa, gaarummaa yookaan gootummaa ofii afaaniin dhaadachuun fudhatama hin qabu; ragaan amala fi hojii namaati
meaning_en: Self-praise is no recommendation; an individual cannot credibly boast of their own virtues—their actual deeds and the community must testify

proverb: Gurri abbaa duuba
meaning_om: Namni wanta isa duubatti dubbatamu, odeeffannoo dhokataa fi maqaa isaa isa duubaan ka'u arguus ta'ee dafee dhagahuun akka itti ulfaatu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One's ears are positioned facing outward and back, meaning a person is often the last to realize the gossip, plots, or rumors circulating behind their back

proverb: Hudduu fi hamti abbaa duuba
meaning_om: Akkuma qaama ofii isa duubaa ijaan arguun hin danda'amne, hamiin fi hammeenyi namoonni duuba namaatiin dubbatanis nama dhokata; duubaan nama hamachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Just as one's backside is hidden from one's own vision, malicious slander operates behind one's back; condemns the cowardice of backbiting

proverb: Dhadhaan, itittutti kofle
meaning_om: Namni hundee, maatii yookaan ka'umsa isaa isa hiyyeessa dagatee, erga milkaa'ee booda bakka irraa dhufe tuffachuun kolfuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: The butter laughs at the sour milk from which it was churned; mocks someone who attains success only to look down upon and ridicule their humble roots

proverb: Dhawicha guddaa daran, jecha hamaatu lafee cabsa
meaning_om: Miidhaan qaamaa kan akka rukuttaa yeroon fayyuu danda'us, jechi hamaanii fi arrabsoon qalbii keessa seenee lafee cabsee hin fayyu
meaning_en: Physical wounds and beatings heal with time, but cruel and cutting words penetrate deep into the soul, inflicting lasting, bone-deep trauma

proverb: Nama jechi hin madeeysin, waraanni hin madeeysu
meaning_om: Namni kabajaa, qaanfii fi safuu dhabee gorsaa fi jecha qeeqaatiin hin tuqamne, gocha humnaatiinis jijjiiramuu hin danda'u
meaning_en: One who has no shame or conscience to feel the sting of verbal rebuke cannot be moved or reformed even by weapons; complete moral callousness

proverb: Namni xiqqo nama arrabsaa, abbaatu guddisee if arrabsa
meaning_om: Arrabsoon ormaa xiqqoo ta'us, namni ofii isaatii aariidhaan of to'achuu dadhabee, dubbii babal'isee kabaja ofii daran salphisa
meaning_en: Others may offer only a minor slight, but by reacting with explosive rage and indiscretion, a person magnifies the humiliation upon themselves

proverb: Gowwaa takka arrabsi, torba if arrabsa
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan yoo arrabsame deebii sirrii kennuu dadhabee, aarii fi jecha hin malle dubbachuun ofumaa qaanii fi salphina ofitti baay'isa
meaning_en: When provoked with a single insult, a fool loses all composure and, through senseless ranting and blunders, brings sevenfold disgrace upon himself

proverb: Gowwaan yoo si arrabse jalaa callisi, kudhan sitti ida'aa
meaning_om: Nama gowwaa fi safuu hin beekne wajjin falmuun bu'aa hin qabu; yoo deebii laatteef arrabsoo fi salphina dabalataa waan fiduuf callisuutu furmaata
meaning_en: Never enter a battle of insults with a fool; silence is the only defense, as arguing only prompts an avalanche of further vulgarity and abuse

proverb: Kan du'e faarsuun, kan jiru arrabsuu dha
meaning_om: Warra duraan dabaraniin qofa dinqisiifachaa fi faarsaa, carraaqqii, dandeettii fi gaarummaa warra amma jiraniitiin tuffachuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Excessively glorifying figures of the past while ignoring or disparaging the real efforts and contributions of the living insults the present generation

proverb: Ambi takka nama arrabsaa, abbaan lama of arrabsa
meaning_om: Miidhaan ormi nama irraan gahu xiqqoo yoo ta'u, namni ofii isaatii deebii dogoggoraatiin fi gocha hin malleedhaan salphina dachaa ofirratti fida
meaning_en: An outsider may slight a person once, but by reacting without dignity, wisdom, or self-control, the person doubles their own humiliation

proverb: Gowwaa hin arrabsan, waan ifiitiin nama arrabsaa
meaning_om: Nama gowwaa fi safuu hin qabneetti dubbii banuun balaa qaba; wanta iccitiin qabdan afaaniin baasee nama qaaneessa waan ta'eef itti dhiisuutu wayya
meaning_en: Do not provoke or insult a fool, because having no filter or decency, they will weaponize personal secrets or sensitive matters to humiliate you

proverb: Jechi hamtuun, garaa nama yakkiti
meaning_om: Dubbiin hamaanii fi arrabsoon summii qalbii ta'ee garaa namaa madeessa, nagaa fi tasgabbii sammuu namaa dhabamsiisa
meaning_en: Harsh, malicious words pollute and wound the human heart, destroying inner peace, sowing resentment, and leaving deep emotional trauma

proverb: Akkuma garaan si dheeraa, arrabni si dheeraa dha
meaning_om: Namni bololaa fi hawwii garaa daangaa hin qabne qabu, arrabaan wacuufi nama arrabsuu irrattis daangaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A person with insatiable greed and appetite typically possesses an equally uncontrolled, sharp, and insolent tongue; gluttony paired with impudence

proverb: Arrabni lafee hin qabuu, lafe nama cabsa
meaning_om: Arrabni qaama laafaa fi lafee hin qabne yoo ta'eyyuu, jechi inni baasu humna guddaa fi miidhaa cimaa lafee cabsuun qixxaatu qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Though the tongue is soft and boneless, the destructive words it produces possess enough lethal power to break a person's spirit and foundation

proverb: Biyyaa baatulle, afaan namaatiin nama hin arrabsin
meaning_om: Biyya ofiitii fagaattus yookaan bakka amansiisaa teessus, maqaa fi afaan ormaatiin nama arrabsuu fi hamachuun safuu dha; arrabsoon yeelloo dha
meaning_en: Even when safely distant from home, never insult someone using borrowed speech or outsiders' mouths; cowardly attacks from afar remain contemptible

proverb: Ol ajjattuu akka dheeda re'ee, fokkattuu akka kaarruu saree
meaning_om: Amala, bifa yookaan gocha namaatti hin tolle, foolii badaa fi fokkinaan kan beekamu qishnaadhaan ceepha'uu; nama amalli isaa nuffisiisu ibsa
meaning_en: Satirizes someone exceedingly repulsive, offensive, and uncouth in both demeanor and presence; expressing complete revulsion and distaste

proverb: Madaa eeboo ni fayyani, madaa arrabaa hin fayyani
meaning_om: Miidhaan meeshaan qaama irra gahu yeroodhaan wal'aanamee fayyus, madaan jecha hamaatiin qalbii namaatti darbu gonkumaa hin fayyu
meaning_en: Physical wounds inflicted by a spear eventually mend and scar over, but emotional wounds inflicted by a vicious tongue fester forever and never heal

proverb: Bakka leenci oolee, lafee hin dhabani
meaning_om: Namni beekamaan, jabaan yookaan gooti bakka inni jiru hundatti faana fi mallattoo gocha isaa dhiisee darba; namni cimaan wanta ittiin yaadatamu hin dhabu
meaning_en: Wherever a lion dwells, bones remain as unmistakable evidence of its presence; a truly formidable, accomplished person always leaves an enduring mark

proverb: Lolli wadaajaa, hudduuni
meaning_om: Namoonni hariiroo amantii, firoomaa yookaan dhiheenya qaban lola waraanaa osoo hin taane, wal-dhiibuu fi qoccolloo xixiqqoo keessoo qabaatu
meaning_en: Disputes among members of a close-knit circle are merely petty jostling for seating; internal frictions among close allies remain minor and contained

proverb: Intala harma baafte, saphii malli beeke
meaning_om: Wanti ifa bahee mul'atu (kan akka harmaa) erga beekamee, wanta dhokataa (kan akka saphii) beekuuf qorannoo hin barbaachisu; dhugaan ifatti beekama
meaning_en: When the prominent, visible signs of maturity or reality are plain to see (like breasts), the hidden, accompanying facts (like pubic hair) are self-evident; obvious evidence proves the underlying truth

proverb: Gaggabni, du'a gaada
meaning_om: Rakkina yookaan dhukkuba xixiqqoo fakkaatan tuffachuu akka hin qabne, sababiin isaas gaggabni xiqqoon gara du'aatti nama geessuu danda'a
meaning_en: A sudden faint or swoon foreshadows mortal peril; minor collapses and neglected health symptoms can easily lead to fatal outcomes

proverb: Keessummaan ka'i hin je'ani, bakka irraa ka'e ta'ani
meaning_om: Aadaa fi safuu Oromoo keessatti keessummaa ifatti 'ka'i deemi' jechuun fokkisaa dha; garuu mallattoo fi gocha safeeffannaatiin keessummaan akka deemtu hubachiisu
meaning_en: Traditional etiquette forbids rudely ordering a guest to leave; rather, one politely indicates that the visit is over through subtle, refined social cues

proverb: Horii bakka irraa badetti faana dhawani
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan balaa uumame furuuf, dursa bakka fi sababa inni itti jalqabe qorachuun barbaachisaa dha; ka'umsa dhimmaa beekuun furmaataaf bu'uura
meaning_en: To recover lost cattle, one traces their tracks starting from the exact location of disappearance; resolving a crisis requires investigating its root origin

proverb: Asxaa gadi galoo, boona lukkuutiin beekan
meaning_om: Namni kufaatiin itti dhufe tokko, osoo hin kufin dura of tuuluu, boonuufi dhaadachuu baay'isa; booni gowwaa mallattoo gadi bu'iinsaati
meaning_en: Petty, pompous strutting heralds an impending downfall; foolish arrogance and unwarranted boasting are the clearest omens of imminent ruin

proverb: Nama jabaa osoo arganuu, jireenya isaa hin gaafatani
meaning_om: Namni qaamaan, hojiin fi haalaan jabaa ta'ee ifatti mul'atu tokko jireenyi isaa akkam akka ta'e beekamaa dha; wanti ifa ta'e gaaffii hin barbaadu
meaning_en: When looking directly at someone thriving and visibly robust, there is no need to ask how they are doing; obvious prosperity speaks for itself

proverb: Nama bara dhufu leenci nyaatu, barana adurreen kokotteessiti
meaning_om: Badiin guddaan fuulduratti nama mudatu duraan dursee mallattoolee xixiqqoodhaan of mul'isa; kufaatii guddaaf qophii ta'uu xixiqqoon beekama
meaning_en: A catastrophic future fate casts small early shadows; before being devoured by a lion, smaller misfortunes like a cat's scratch begin testing the victim

proverb: Kan bar hegeree maraatu, barana soqolata
meaning_om: Badiin, dogoggorri yookaan maraatummaan fuulduratti nama dhuunfatu mallattoolee fi amala addaa ammaa irraa beekama; wanti bor dhufu har'a eegala
meaning_en: One destined to lose their reason next year already displays strange restlessness and eccentric habits today; deep decline begins with subtle oddities

proverb: Namni bara dhufu maraatu, barana dudubbata
meaning_om: Kufaatiin yookaan rakkon guddaan fuulduratti dhufu mallattoolee jalqabaa kan akka haasaa fi gocha hin malleetiin of mul'isa
meaning_en: A person destined for full-blown madness next year begins by muttering incoherently today; subtle behavioral cues signal an unfolding breakdown

proverb: Ijji baquu teeysu ni diddiimatti
meaning_om: Wanti yookaan dhimmi baduuf deemu duraan dursee mallattoo badiisaa fi dhibee agarsiisa; wanti manca'uuf jiru asxaa duraa qabaata
meaning_en: An eye destined to fail or liquefy becomes inflamed and bloodshot first; imminent ruin or dissolution reveals itself through visible early warning signs

proverb: Gurbaa boru badu, eebootu duraa bada
meaning_om: Namni kasaaruuf yookaan balaan isa mudachuuf deemu, dursa meeshaa fi wanta ittiin of eegu dhabee saaxilamaa ta'a; gargaarsa dhabuun mallattoo kufaatiiti
meaning_en: For a warrior destined to fall tomorrow, he first loses his defensive spear; a person facing ruin is stripped of their tools and safeguards beforehand

proverb: Korma hegere qotu, goorannotti beekan
meaning_om: Namni fuulduratti cimaa, beekaa fi hojjetataa ta'u ijoollummaa fi haala jalqabaa isaatiin beekama; bu'urri gaariin duraan mul'ata
meaning_en: An ox that will make an exceptional plow-bull in the future is recognized early in its calfhood; future diligence and strength manifest in early youth

proverb: Yoo namni haa naa arguu fedhan dhawan adda keessa
meaning_om: Gocha yookaan hojii namoonni akka arganii fi beekan barbaadan bakka ifaa fi mul'atutti raawwachuu qabu; gootummaa fi dhugaa dhoksuun hin ta'u
meaning_en: If you want the world to witness an action or decisive victory, strike directly and openly upon the forehead; bold statements require public clarity

proverb: "Mucaan akkam garaa guddata?" jennaan, "haqqisaa isaati argitee?" je'een
meaning_om: Wanti alaan gabbinaa fi qabeenya fakkaatee mul'atu tokko keessi isaa dhibee fi dhiphina hamaa irraa kan dhufe ta'uu danda'a; bifa alaa qofaan madaaluun sirrii miti
meaning_en: What outwardly appears as abundance or plumpness may actually be symptoms of severe illness and turmoil; deceptive appearances often conceal deep distress

proverb: Nama waan nyaatu beekan, waan udaanu hin gaafatan
meaning_om: Ka'umsi, qabeenyi fi gochi nama tokkoo erga beekamee, bu'aan fi wanti inni maddisiisu maaliif akka ta'e gaafachuun hin barbaachisu; galteen bu'aa murteessa
meaning_en: When a person's inputs, capabilities, and diet are already known, their output holds no mystery; causes directly determine their natural outcomes

proverb: Injireen, hiyyumma farrifti
meaning_om: Injireen uffataa fi qaamarratti baay'achuun mallattoo hiyyummaa fi dhabamuu guddaati; wanti xiqqoon rakkoo bu'uuraa ifatti saaxila
meaning_en: The infestation of lice visibly heralds and exposes deep deprivation; small, undeniable signs lay bare the reality of severe poverty and distress

proverb: Lagni hogguu baduu fedhu maddarraa raammawa
meaning_om: Dhaabbanni, maatiin yookaan sirni tokko yoo manca'uuf deemu, rakkoon isaa hundee fi hoggansa bu'uuraa irraa jalqaba; badiin hundi ka'umsa irraayi
meaning_en: When a river is doomed to rot, decay originates directly at its source; the corruption or collapse of any institution starts at the leadership head

proverb: Bareedinni dhaloota
meaning_om: Bareedinni dhugaa fi uumamaa kennaa dhalootaa kan Waaqayyo namaaf kennedha malee, wanta faaya alaa ittiin bareechaniin qofa hin argamu
meaning_en: True beauty is natural and inherited by birth; it is an innate gift of creation rather than something manufactured through artificial adornment

proverb: Jimaa fi dhalaa, fuula kheeysa laalan
meaning_om: Akkuma qulqullinni fi mi'aan jimaa bifa baala isaatiin beekamu, kabajni, amallii fi gaarummaan dubartiis fuula ifaa fi iftoomina isheetiin hubatama
meaning_en: Just as the freshness and quality of khat are judged by inspecting its leaves, a woman's character, disposition, and demeanor are perceived through her countenance

proverb: Intalti bareedduun, koomee miila isiitiin beekkamti
meaning_om: Qulqullinni fi bareedinni dhugaan kan mirkanaa'u fuula alaa qofaan osoo hin taane, iddoo dhokataa fi qaama guutuu kan akka koomee eeggachuuni
meaning_en: True grooming and beauty are judged not merely by the visible face, but by thorough cleanliness in overlooked details like the heels of the feet; holistic care

proverb: Karkarroo biratti, booyyeen ni bareeddi
meaning_om: Wanti tokko fooyya'aa yookaan gaarii ta'ee kan mul'atu yoo wanta isa caalaa fokkisaa yookaan hamaa ta'e waliin dorgomsiisaniidha; madaallii wal-bira qabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Compared to an even uglier warthog, a pig seems attractive; relative comparison makes the mediocre or unpleasant seem appealing beside something far worse

proverb: Weenniin, bifa isiitiif duuti
meaning_om: Qabeenyi, bareedinni yookaan dandeettiin ol-aanaa ta'e yeroo tokko tokko balaa fi qorumsa nama irratti fiduun badiisaaf nama saaxila
meaning_en: The colobus monkey is hunted and slain solely for its magnificent pelt; exceptional beauty, wealth, or talent can attract deadly envy and cause one's downfall

proverb: Okkoteen quufte, dhadhaa irraan loolaati
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya, barakaa fi quufa qabu badhaadhinni isaa afaan bahee naannoo isaatti mul'ata; akkasumas quufi daangaa darbe of-to'annoo dhabsiisuu danda'a
meaning_en: A pot overflowing with melted butter spills down its sides; great abundance and wealth naturally spill over into generous or visible display

proverb: Farda, bilbilaatu miidhagsa
meaning_om: Wanti uumamaan gaarii ta'eyyuu, wanti faayaa, naamusni fi ogummaan dabalataan itti dabalame daran miidhagsee sadarkaa isaa ol kaasa
meaning_en: Even a fine steed is perfected and made majestic by fitting harness bells; natural nobility and strength are elevated by refinement and proper accessories

proverb: Bareedina Rabbiitu namaan uuma, sansaankaa abbaatu tolfata
meaning_om: Bifa qaamaa Waaqayyotu uumaan namaaf kenna; amala gaarii, safuu fi naamusa garuu namni ofii isaatii carraaqqee ijaarrata
meaning_en: Physical appearance is an unearned divine gift, but moral character, courteous conduct, and ethics are consciously shaped and cultivated by oneself

proverb: Bareedinni fuulaa, foon qabeenyaa wajjiin tola
meaning_om: Bareedinni bifa namaa yoo qabeenyi, soorata gaarii fi nagaan jireenyaa itti dabalame daran ifee miidhaga; beelli bareedina balleessiti
meaning_en: Facial beauty flourishes best when nourished by material prosperity and good health; poverty, malnutrition, and sorrow inevitably wither good looks

proverb: Bareedinni afaaniini nama seena
meaning_om: Bareedinni qaamaa soorata gaarii afaaniin nyaatamuun gabbata; akkasumas jaalallii fi kabajni nama biraa jecha gaarii afaaniin baatuun qalbii seena
meaning_en: Physical vitality is nourished by the food that enters through the mouth, while emotional charm and admiration are unlocked through gracious speech

proverb: Dadhabbiin, bareedina fuulaati balleeysiti
meaning_om: Hojiin humnaa olii, dhiphinni fi dadhabbiin walirraa hin cinne iftoomina qaamaa fi bareedina bifa namaa balleessuun nama moofeesse dulloma fida
meaning_en: Chronic overwork, physical exhaustion, and unrelieved stress drain facial radiance and freshness, bringing on premature wear and aging

proverb: Miidhaga yaadanii, midhama hin yaadani
meaning_om: Bareedina fi faayidaa alaa qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuudhaan, balaa, miidhaa fi qormaata dhimma sana duuba jiru dagatanii rakkina keessa seenuu akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: Becoming so entranced by outward charm, beauty, or glamour that one overlooks the underlying dangers, toxicity, or costs; blinded by aesthetics

proverb: Bareedina fuulaa dhiqanii hin dhugani
meaning_om: Bareedinni bifa alaa qofti jireenya, maatii fi hojii geggeessuuf gahaa miti; wanti bu'uuraa amala, ogummaa fi hojjetanii jiraachuudha
meaning_en: One cannot wash a pretty face and drink the water for food; outward beauty alone cannot sustain a household, feed a family, or replace virtue and work ethic

proverb: Bareedinaaf obboleeytii hin fuudhani
meaning_om: Wanti tokko bareedaa fi hawwataa ta'uyyuu, safuu, aadaa fi seeraan kan dhowwame yoo ta'e gonkumaa itti hin dhihaatan; daangaa safeeffannaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: No matter how beautiful one's sister may be, incest taboos and sacred ethics strictly forbid marrying her; moral laws supersede aesthetic desire

proverb: Yoo if jaalatan fuula dhiqatani
meaning_om: Namni kabaja, ulfina fi jaalala ofiif qabu dursa qulqullina, amala fi eegumsa qaama isaatiif xiyyeeffannaa kenna; of-kabajuun gochaan mul'ata
meaning_en: Self-respect and genuine self-love begin with basic personal care, hygiene, and self-discipline; one who values oneself takes pride in cleanliness

proverb: Umrii mitii, dheengee gaafadhu
meaning_om: Guddinni fi bilchinni namaa lakkoofsa waggaa qaamaan lakkaa'amuun osoo hin taane, muuxannoo, qorumsa fi ogummaa inni jireenya keessatti argeen madaalama
meaning_en: Do not merely measure how many calendar years someone has lived; ask what seasons of trial, experience, and wisdom they have weathered

proverb: Hayyuu, gaadisatti beekan
meaning_om: Beekumsi, dandeettiin murtii fi ogummaan hayyuu kan ifatti bahee beekamu yeroo inni kora, jaarsummaa fi gaaddisa marii jalatti dubbii furuudha
meaning_en: A true scholar, judge, or sage is recognized when they take their place beneath the council shade tree; wisdom proves itself in community deliberation

proverb: Bakka namaa dhaban, muka dhaaban
meaning_om: Yeroo namni dhimma sanaaf ta'u dhabamu, wanta argame yookaan nama dandeettii xiqqaa qabu bakka buusanii dhimma ofii ittiin geggeeffachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When the right, capable person is absent, one makes do with a makeshift substitute or inferior placeholder; settling for stopgaps when help is scarce

proverb: Biddeena nama quubsu, eelee irratti beeku
meaning_om: Hojiin, karoorri yookaan qulqullinni wanta tokkoo jalqaba isaarratti bu'aa gaarii fiduuf jiraachuu isaa beekuun ni danda'ama; milkaa'inni jalqabarraa mul'ata
meaning_en: Bread that will truly satisfy is recognized by its quality while still on the baking griddle; the early promise of an endeavor reveals its ultimate success

proverb: Intala ilma hegeree qabu guddiftu guftaan gara duubaatiin irra hin jiru
meaning_om: Haati ilma bor nama guddaa ta'uuf jiru guddistu aarsaa guddaa kaffalti; hojii fi tattaaffii walirraa hin cinneen of dagattee ijoollee isheef dursa kenniti
meaning_en: A devoted mother rearing a child of great promise has no leisure to fuss over her own appearance; untiring labor and selfless sacrifice consume her days

proverb: Ilmi guddinaa hin teenye, haadha irraa foqqisa
meaning_om: Ijoolleen yookaan namni guddinaaf hin qophoofne ykn carraa guddinaa hin qabne, kunuunsa maatii fi gorsa qajeelaa didee ofumaan of balleessa
meaning_en: A child or person not destined to mature and thrive rejects the patient nurture, foundation, and discipline meant to carry them, recklessly breaking away to their own detriment

proverb: Sa'a huccuu wajji lilmee nyaate, hormaataaf hin eeggatin
meaning_om: Wanti yookaan namni balaa guddaa fi dhibee keessoo isa miidhu qabu bu'aa gara fuulduraa hin fidu; wanta hundeen miidhame irraa firii eeguun kasaaraadha
meaning_en: A cow carrying a swallowed needle within is mortally compromised; do not invest expectations in any venture or person harboring a fatal internal flaw

proverb: Namni guddatu, kana hin dubbatu
meaning_om: Namni fuulduratti nama kabajamaa fi guddaa ta'uu barbaadu haasaa salphaa, arrabsoo, oduu laafaa fi amala gadhee irraa of qusachuu qaba
meaning_en: One who aspires to true maturity, greatness, and respect does not indulge in petty, vulgar, or insolent speech; stature demands refined speech

proverb: Guddina isaa, saruma isa jala deemtu laali
meaning_om: Sadarkaa, qabeenyaa fi arjummaa nama tokkoo baruuf, haala naannoo isaa fi bineensota isa jalatti bulan ilaaluun gahaadha; bulchiinsi qe'ee isaatiin beekama
meaning_en: To evaluate a person's true stature, prosperity, and benevolence, observe the condition of even the dog at their heels; prosperity reflects in dependents

proverb: Jirmi, abbaa mure fakkaata
meaning_om: Firiin, hojiin yookaan ijoolleen nama tokkoo amala, dandeettii fi haala abbaa/nama isa hojjete sana calaqqisa; hojiin amala abbaa qaba
meaning_en: The hewn log reflects the skill and nature of the one who chopped it; a person's creations, workmanship, and children mirror their maker

proverb: Akka deemtu godhan malee, keessumman deemin hin ja'an
meaning_om: Keessummaa afaaniin ifatti 'ka'i deemi' jechuun safuu cabsa; garuu mallattoo, simannaa fi haala qabatamaatiin akka deemtu hubachiisuun aadaadha
meaning_en: Manners strictly forbid bluntly telling a guest to leave; rather, one gracefully arranges subtle circumstances so that they realize it is time to depart

proverb: Ijji alagaa, laagaa laalti
meaning_om: Namni alagaa wanta ati nyaattu, baastu fi fudhattu ija itti baasee si qorata; alagaan faayidaa fi quufa kee irratti hinaaffaadhaan ilaala
meaning_en: An outsider's critical eye stares directly at your throat, watching and counting every bite you take; strangers scrutinize your consumption with envy

proverb: Namni galaa ka'e, dhaamsa dhadhaammata
meaning_om: Namni imala fagoof yookaan dhimma murteessaaf ka'e osoo hin deemin dura maatii fi firaaf dhaamsa xumuraa fi gorsa dhiisa; of eeggannoo imalaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: One preparing for a journey or major departure thoughtfully leaves parting words, messages, and guidance for their loved ones; foresight and proper farewell

proverb: Boochi dhiiraa alaanala
meaning_om: Dhiirri gadda, dhiphinaa fi miidhaa cimaa garaatti ukkaamsee danda'a malee laayyootti hin boo'u; jabina qalbii fi miira ofii to'achuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A man's grief and weeping are internal and suppressed; cultural stoicism dictates enduring deep pain and sorrow inwardly with composure

proverb: Tuttumataa mooyyee, nyaanni isaa fal'aana
meaning_om: Dadhabbiin, wacii fi tattaaffiin godhame baay'ee guddaa ta'us, bu'aan yookaan firiin dhumaa xiqqoo ta'uu agarsiisa; dadhabbii bu'aa hin qabne ceepha'a
meaning_en: Endless pounding in the mortar only to yield a tiny spoonful of food; exhaustive, backbreaking labor that produces disproportionately meager returns

proverb: Namni boru ijji badu, ar'a duudgaan deema
meaning_om: Badiin yookaan kufaatiin bor nama mudatu mallattoo isaa har'a amala dogoggoraa fi qajeelfama dhabuutiin agarsiisa; wanti manca'uuf deemu dursee qajeelloo dhaba
meaning_en: One destined to lose their sight tomorrow already staggers blindly today; an impending failure is preceded by present aimlessness and loss of direction

proverb: Babargaafatu malee, nama hin darbu
meaning_om: Balaan, dhukkubni yookaan qorumsi cimaan nama kuffisuuf ka'e dura qaama namaa dadhabsiisee bargaafachiisa malee tasa nama hin kuffisu; kufaatii dura mallattoon dadhabinaa ni mul'ata
meaning_en: A devastating blow, illness, or crisis destabilizes a person and makes them stagger with wide, unsteady strides before throwing them flat to the ground; a downfall always begins with unsteady wobbling

proverb: Wallaalli dukkana, beekkomsi iftiina
meaning_om: Wallaalummaan jireenya namaa dukkaneessee gara badiitti yoo oofu, beekumsi ammoo daandii ifoomsee gara sirriitti nama qajeelcha
meaning_en: Ignorance is blinding darkness that leads to misdirection and ruin, whereas knowledge and wisdom illuminate the path to truth, progress, and understanding

proverb: Hiyyummaan akka wallaalaa hin jiru, qufinni akka beekkomsaa hin jiru
meaning_om: Hiyyummaan dhugaan dhabamuu qarshii osoo hin taane sammuu beekumsa dhabuudha; akkasumas badhaadhinni guddaan beekumsa qabaachuudha
meaning_en: There is no true poverty greater than ignorance, and no true wealth or fulfillment greater than knowledge; wisdom is the ultimate treasure

proverb: Beekaan ni amana, wallaalaan of malee hin amanu
meaning_om: Namni beekaan dhugaa, gorsa fi dandeettii nama biraa amanee fudhachuu yoo danda'u, namni wallaalaan garuu of tuulee yaada ofiitiin ala hin amanu
meaning_en: A wise person is humble and open to trusting facts, truth, and others, whereas a fool is dogmatic, stubborn, and trusts only their own narrow delusions

proverb: Beekaa ni tuqaniif, gowwaa itti tuqaniif
meaning_om: Nama sammuu qabuuf mallattoo xiqqoon hubachiisuun gahaadha; nama gowwaa garuu irra deddeebi'anii itti himuuniyyuu hubachuun itti ulfaata
meaning_en: A wise person needs only a subtle hint or tap to grasp the situation, whereas a fool must be prodded directly and repeatedly, yet still struggles

proverb: Beekaa fuula deebisi, gowwaa tuqii beeksisi
meaning_om: Nama beekaaf ilaalcha fuulaa fi mallattoo qofaan yaada kee dabarsuun ni danda'ama; gowwaa garuu qaamaan qaqqabanii ifatti itti himuu malee hin hubatu
meaning_en: A simple glance or turn of the face suffices to guide a wise person, but a fool must be physically tapped and spelled out to directly

proverb: Buqqeen guutuun, hin cuqqaatu
meaning_om: Namni beekumsa, qabeenya fi bilchina dhugaa qabu of hin tuulu, waca fi dhaadannoo sobaatiin hin beekamu; beekaan dhugaa tasgabbaa'aadha
meaning_en: A full gourd makes no sloshing sound; truly accomplished, wise individuals remain humble and composed, unlike shallow boasters who make empty noise

proverb: Beekkomsi adunyaa waa lama dadhabe, dhihaa fi baha aduu dhoorguu
meaning_om: Beekumsi fi humni namaa hangamiyyuu yoo guddate, seera uumamaa fi dandeettii Waaqayyoo jijjiiruu hin danda'u; beekumsi namaa daangaa qaba
meaning_en: No matter how vast human knowledge and power become, they cannot alter divine natural laws like the rising and setting of the sun; human intellect has limits

proverb: Beekaan tuffii hin qabu, gowwaan mala hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni beekaan nama kamiinuu hin tuffatu, sababiin isaas hundarraa baruuf gad of qaba; gowwaan garuu mala fi furmaata dhabee of jajuutti kaata
meaning_en: A truly wise person looks down upon no one because wisdom inspires humility; conversely, a fool possesses no resourcefulness or sound counsel

proverb: Beekkomsi xiqqaan, abba galaafata
meaning_om: Beekumsi gartokkee yookaan xiqqoon of tuulummaa fi dogoggora hamaaf nama saaxiluun kasaaraa fi badiisa lubbuu fida; beekumsa guutuu qabaachuun dirqama
meaning_en: Shallow, incomplete knowledge breeds reckless overconfidence, driving a person into fatal miscalculations; a little knowledge is a dangerous thing

proverb: Beekkomsi xiqqaan, hudduu quba nama kaaye
meaning_om: Wanta tokko guutummaatti osoo hin hubatin akka beekaatti keessa seensisuun nama saalfachiisa, amala fokkisaa fi gowwummaa keessa nama buusa
meaning_en: Incomplete or shallow understanding causes a person to commit comical, indecent, and humiliating blunders; acting on half-knowledge breeds absurdity

proverb: Beektu dacha'i jette hibboon
meaning_om: Dhimmi yookaan gaaffiin tokko yoo dhiyaate, beekumsi namaa kan mirkanaa'u deebii qabatamaa fi furmaata sirrii kennuu yoo danda'eedha
meaning_en: 'If you claim to know, solve it and return with the answer,' challenges the riddle; real knowledge is proven only through practical, successful demonstration

proverb: Beekeen, yoo jalaa bahani
meaning_om: Balaa, qorumsa yookaan rakkoo tokko irraa erga nagaan bahee booda qofa 'wanta sana beekeera/mo'adheera' jechuun danda'ama; osoo keessa jiranii hin dhaadatan
meaning_en: One can only claim to have known, mastered, or endured an ordeal after emerging safe from it; do not brag about conquering a hazard while still trapped inside

proverb: Beekaan, Beenjoottuu beekaa dha
meaning_om: Namni dhuguma beekaa ta'e bakka kamiinuu, biyya ormaa fi alagaa keessattis ogummaan isaa ifee mul'ata; beekumsi bakkaan hin daangeffamu
meaning_en: A genuinely wise person displays intellect and capability anywhere, even among distant foreigners in Benjo; authentic wisdom is universal and portable

proverb: Beekaan mootummaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Beekumsi daangaa bulchiinsaa fi aangoo siyaasaatiin hin daanga'u; beekaan bakka hundatti kabajamaa fi bilisaadha, aangoon garuu kan yerooti
meaning_en: Wisdom recognizes no narrow borders or political regimes; a wise person belongs to humanity and is sovereign, whereas worldly political rule is temporary

proverb: Beekan bahar gamattuu, wallaalan of jalattuu
meaning_om: Namni beekaan wanta fagoo jiru, dhimma gara fuulduraa fi dhokataa hubachuuf dandeettii qaba; namni wallaalaan garuu wanta dhihoo isaatti ta'u iyyuu hin argu
meaning_en: The wise perceive and anticipate events across distant oceans, while fools remain blind to what happens right under their feet; vision versus myopia

proverb: Beekaan kan dubbatu beeka, wallaalaan kan beeku dubbata
meaning_om: Namni beekaan osoo hin dubbatin dura yaada isaa madaalee beekumsaan dubbata; gowwaan garuu wantuma sammuu isaatti dhufe calalee osoo hin qoratin dubbata
meaning_en: A wise person carefully measures, filters, and understands what they say before speaking; a fool blurts out everything in their head without filter or discretion

proverb: Beekaa hidhi dubbisani
meaning_om: Nama beekaaf dubbii dheeressanii fi wacanii itti himuun hin barbaachisu; haasaa gabaabaa fi mallattoo afaaniitiin ergaa dabarsuun gahaadha
meaning_en: One communicates with a wise person through subtle lip movements; an intelligent mind requires no loud shouting or long explanations to grasp the core truth

proverb: Beekaa bira dhawan malee isa hin dhawani
meaning_om: Nama qalbii qabu ifatti rukutanii yookaan arrabsanii qaaneessuu mannaa, fakkeenyaan fi mallattoodhaan bira darbanii itti himuun safeeffannaadha
meaning_en: One strikes near a wise person rather than striking them directly; correct a wise person through tactful parables and hints rather than blunt humiliation

proverb: Beekaa dubbiin takka
