meaning_om: Nama beekaa fi qalbii qabuuf dhimma tokko al tokko qofa itti himuun gahaadha; irra deddeebi'anii itti himuu hin barbaadu
meaning_en: For a wise person, a single word suffices; an intelligent mind absorbs the lesson immediately and never requires tiresome repetition

proverb: Dubbiin beekaan malti, duuti nama hin beekneen malti
meaning_om: Dubbiin fi jaarsummaan nama beekaa wajjin yoo ta'e qajeela; akkuma sana gaddi du'aa kan nama hin jeeqne yoo namni du'e sun nama hin beekne (alagaa) ta'eedha
meaning_en: Deliberation and counsel are fitting only with the wise, just as the pain of death is easy to bear only when it touches a stranger; loss feels weightless until it strikes someone you personally know and love

proverb: "Qaroomni maali" jennaan, "qarumaa wajji jiraachuu dha" je'e
meaning_om: Qaroominni dhugaan beekumsa qofa osoo hin taane, ogummaa, dammaqinaa fi nagaan hawaasa waliin walsimanii jiraachuu danda'uudha
meaning_en: True wisdom or civilization is not mere academic knowledge; it is the art of living harmoniously, astutely, and adaptably with others in society

proverb: Dubbiin nama beeku dhibdi
meaning_om: Haasaa fi falmiin ulfaataan yookaan iccitii jireenyaa nama beekaa iyyuu yaaddessuu fi madaallii dhowwuu danda'a; dubbiin salphaa miti
meaning_en: Complex discourse, disputes, and human affairs are so intricate that they perplex and challenge even the wisest individuals; truth is multifaceted

proverb: Shanyiitu diroo raasa
meaning_om: Dandeettiin, gootummaan yookaan amalli namni tokko agarsiisu hundee sanyii fi hidda dhiigaa isaa irraa madda; sanyiin gaariin gochaan of mul'isa
meaning_en: Inherent lineage and breeding reveal themselves in vigor, character, and strength; good stock naturally shakes the saddle and displays its innate power

proverb: Shanyii diroo raaftuutu jira, tan raaftu baaftu
meaning_om: Namoonni yookaan sanyiiwwan sadarkaa garaagaraa qabu; jabaan jiru, isa caalaa jabaatee wanta hundumaa jijjiiruutu jira; dandeettiin wal caala
meaning_en: Among formidable breeds, there are varying tiers: some merely shake foundations, while others shake and shatter them entirely; excellence has degrees

proverb: Abbaa beekuuf lolli tapha
meaning_om: Hojiin yookaan dhimmi ulfaataa ta'e nama ogummaa, beekumsaa fi qophii gahaa qabuuf salphaa fi akka taphaatti kan lakkaa'amu ta'a
meaning_en: For someone who truly understands the art, strategy, and dynamics of a challenge, even grave conflict is handled with effortless skill and calm

proverb: Namni guddaan, yoo ibiddatti darban, gubbaa irra kuta
meaning_om: Namni kabajamaa fi qalbii qabu rakkinaa fi qorumsa guddaa keessa yoo galeeyyuu, salphina jalaa nagaan baha; ulfinni isaa balaa hundumaa injifata
meaning_en: A person of true moral stature, dignity, and wisdom navigates through fiery trials and perils unscathed; their integrity transcends disaster

proverb: Waan galeetu gala, waan gale jaarsaatu fala
meaning_om: Dhimmi yookaan rakkoon tasgabbaa'ee qe'eetti deebi'e jaarsummaa fi ogummaa maanguddoon nagaan furmaata argata; araarri jaarsaan tola
meaning_en: Once a conflict cools down and disputants return home, wise elders can step in and skillfully resolve the issue; wisdom settles disputes once passions subside

proverb: Qaalluun, waan ofii beeku namaa hima
meaning_om: Namni kamiinuu hanguma beekumsaa, muuxannoo fi hubannoo qabu qofa namaaf gumaacha; nama irraa kan eegamu dandeettii isaa qofa
meaning_en: Even a diviner or counselor can only impart what lies within their own knowledge and experience; one cannot expect insights beyond human limits

proverb: Osoo garaan duugda duuba jiraatee, hallayyatti nama gata
meaning_om: Garaan fuuldura ta'ee osoo arganuu bololaan nama dhiphisa; osoo duuba ta'ee immoo balaa fi hallayyaa hin taanetti nama oofa; bolola to'achuu ibsa
meaning_en: Even with the stomach in front where one can see it, its appetites cause trouble; had it been behind, its unchecked greed would lead one off a cliff

proverb: Dubbii jaarsaa, ganama didaniiti galgala itti deebi'ani
meaning_om: Gorsi fi dubbiin maanguddoon dubbatan yeroof didamuu danda'us, dhugaa fi bu'a-qabeessa waan ta'eef booda irra mirkanaa'ee fudhatama argata
meaning_en: The wise advice of an elder might be rashly dismissed in the morning, but by evening, bitter experience and reality force people to accept its truth

proverb: Beekaan si haa argatu, wallaalaan lixee si haa dhabu
meaning_om: Eebba gaarii dha; jireenya keessatti nama ogummaa fi gaarummaa qabuun akka wal bartu, nama gowwaa fi balaa fidu jalaa ammoo akka milqitu hawwuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A traditional blessing wishing that one is discovered and valued by wise benefactors, while remaining completely hidden and safe from destructive fools

proverb: Mataatu luqqa'a malee, arrabni hin luqqa'u
meaning_om: Namni umuriin yoo dulloomee mataan isaa rifeensa dhabellee, arrabni fi haasaan isaa dandeettii dubbachuu hin dhabu; arrabni yeroo hundumaa dammaqaadha
meaning_en: Though age and time may cause hair to fall from the head, the tongue retains its power, sharpness, and capacity to speak; speech outlives physical youth

proverb: Waan manguddoon hin beekne, ijoolleen hin beektu
meaning_om: Muuxannoo, seenaa fi ogummaa maanguddoon jireenya dheeraa keessatti hin arganne ijoolleen beekuu hin dandeessu; beekumsi maanguddootaa bu'uura
meaning_en: If a seasoned elder with a lifetime of experience does not comprehend or know a thing, an inexperienced child cannot possibly know it

proverb: Waa barreessuun waa barachuu dha; wal dhaga'uun humna horachuu dha
meaning_om: Qubee fi barruudhaan beekumsa qabachuun barumsa gabbisa; hawaasni yeroo wal dhaga'ee fi waliigalu ammoo tokkummaa fi humna cimaa gonfata
meaning_en: Recording knowledge through writing deepens learning, while mutual listening and understanding build collective power and community resilience

proverb: "Ofii keetiti beeki, ofii wallaaltu sitti himan beeki, sana dadhabdu naaf hin guddatin" jedhe, abbaan ilmaan
meaning_om: Namni ofumaan dammaqee baruu qaba, yoo sana dadhabe gorsa namaa dhaggeeffatee hubachuu qaba; kan ofiin hin beekne fi kan gorsa hin dhageenye bu'aa hin qabu
meaning_en: A person must either have the insight to understand on their own or the humility to learn when told; one who possesses neither is worthless to society

proverb: Amni abba qaba, duulli abba qaba
meaning_om: Hojiin, adeemsi fi duulli kamiinuu qajeelfama, hoggansa fi itti-gaafatamummaa nama dura bu'uun geggeeffamuu qaba; hoggana malee milkaa'inni hin jiru
meaning_en: Every journey and military campaign requires an authorized leader and clear chain of command; orderly leadership and accountability are essential for success

proverb: Intala daakuu beektu, daakuu hin hatani
meaning_om: Nama dhimma tokko sirriitti beeku, ogeessa fi dammaqaa ta'e gowwoomsuun yookaan waan isaa jalaa saamuun hin danda'amu; ogummaan of eeggachiisa
meaning_en: One cannot steal flour from a girl who knows the exact yield of grinding grain; a knowledgeable and skilled expert cannot be cheated or defrauded in their own craft

proverb: Harka gowwaatti du'uu mannaa, harka beekaatti du'uu wayya
meaning_om: Miidhaan yookaan murtiin nama beekaa fi seera qabu irraa dhufu sababa fi seera qabaata; gowwaan garuu sababa malee salphinaa fi badiisa hamaa fida
meaning_en: Falling or suffering at the hands of an intelligent adversary carries reason and rules, whereas suffering under a fool brings senseless and humiliating ruin

proverb: Gowwaan dabaqata, qarri farajata
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan osoo hin yaadin tarkaanfatee rakkoo fi wal-xaxaa keessa of buusa; namni qaxaleen ammoo haala madaalee, fala barbaadee nagaan baha
meaning_en: A fool blunders recklessly into trouble and complicates matters, whereas an astute, discerning person observes, calculates, and finds an elegant way forward

proverb: Gowwaan wajji taphachuu mannaa, beekaa wajji wal loluu wayya
meaning_om: Gowwaan nagaa fi tapha keessattiyyuu balaa fi salphina fiduu danda'a; beekaan garuu yoo waldhabden jiraateyyuu daangaa fi safuu beeka
meaning_en: Even in jest and play, a fool can inflict lethal harm and unpredictable disgrace; a wise person, even in dispute, observes boundaries, rationality, and ethics

proverb: Qarri dachii dha, gowwaan bilillee dha
meaning_om: Namni qaran akkuma dachee bal'aa, obsaa fi tasgabbaa'aadha; gowwaan garuu akkuma bilillee laafaa, dhiphoo, wacaa fi dafee kan cabuudha
meaning_en: A wise person is like the earth—broad, grounded, enduring, and carrying all; a fool is like a fragile glass vial—narrow, shallow, and quick to shatter

proverb: Dheedhiin baalaa, hamtuun beela
meaning_om: Nyaanni qophii gaarii hin qabne yookaan dheedhii ta'e rakkisaa ta'us, wanti hunda caalaa nama miidhu beelaa fi dhabuudha; wanta argatanitti quufuu ibsa
meaning_en: Poorly prepared or raw food is merely leaves, but the truly lethal enemy is absolute starvation; any available food is far better than dying of hunger

proverb: Beelaan du'uu mannaa eelaan du'uu wayya
meaning_om: Salphina beelaatiin du'uu mannaa, kaayyoo, jaalala, gaddaa fi gootummaa qalbii keessaa qabaatanii du'uutu ulfina qaba; kabajaan du'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Dying of deep sorrow, passion, or noble tribulation is far more honorable than perishing miserably of starvation; choosing dignified demise over shameful deprivation

proverb: Beelaa fi billawni diina
meaning_om: Beelli akkuma billawaa nama muruutti suuta suutaan lubbuu namaa galaafata; lamaanuu miidhaa fi badiisa dafee lubbuu balleessu fidu
meaning_en: Hunger and a knife are both lethal cutthroats; just like a sharp blade, starvation slashes through life, showing no mercy and destroying the human body

proverb: Beelti billawa caalaa marrimaan nama cirti
meaning_om: Miidhaan fi dhukkubbiin beelli qaamaa fi garaa keessatti fidu goraadee nama waraanu caalaa hadhaawaa fi laalessaadha; dhiphina beelaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Starvation tears through human entrails with greater agony than a physical knife; the inner pangs of famine inflict deeper, more torturous pain than an external blade

proverb: Agabuun qoosaa hin taatu
meaning_om: Beelli fi dhabuun dhimma laayyootti kolfamu yookaan qoosaatti fudhatamu miti; dhiphina cimaa lubbuu galaafatu waan ta'eef xiyyeeffannaa barbaada
meaning_en: Hunger and starvation are no laughing matter or joke; going without food is a grave, life-threatening ordeal that demands serious attention

proverb: Wanni calalaqaa hundi, ziqeeyaa fi meetaa miti
meaning_om: Wanti alaan bareedee fi calaqqisee mul'atu hundi gati-jabeessa yookaan qulqulluu ta'uu dhabuu danda'a; bifa alaa qofaan madaaluun gowwummaadha
meaning_en: Not everything that glitters is precious gold or silver; outward shine and dazzling appearances often mask cheap, worthless substance

proverb: Saree dabbassaa, kan duutu hin seehani
meaning_om: Namni bifa, uffannaa yookaan haala alaa furdaa fakkaatu qabu keessi isaa beelaa fi dhukkubaan kan dhumate ta'uu danda'a; bifa alaan quufa sehuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Because a shaggy dog has thick hair hiding its emaciated ribs, people assume it is well-fed and thriving; outward volume disguises lethal weakness

proverb: Nama gabaabaa, joolleen abbaa hin seetu
meaning_om: Namni dheerina qaamaa yookaan humna mul'atu hin qabne hawaasa keessatti kabajaa fi sadarkaa isaaf malu dhabuu danda'a; dhaabbata qaamaatiin nama madaaluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Children mistake a short man for one of themselves and fail to recognize him as a father; people shallowly judge authority by physical stature

proverb: Namni gabaabaan, osoo kabajaa hin arganne du'a
meaning_om: Hawaasni yeroo baay'ee ulfinaa fi kabaja kan kennu dhaabbata qaamaa isa dheeraa fi jabaa mul'atuuf waan ta'eef, namni gabaabaan tuffatamaa jiraachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Society often shallowly equates dignity with towering height, causing a short individual to live and die without ever receiving the reverence they merit

proverb: "Numa qaqallii kanaatu, haadha tumaaleyyiiti" jette, re'eettiin
meaning_om: Namni qaamaan qalloo yookaan salphaa fakkaatee mul'atu bu'aa guddaa fi firii ciccimaa horachuu akka danda'u; bifa qaamaa laafaa irraa bu'aa guddaatu madda
meaning_en: 'Slender as I appear, I am the mother of sturdy, fat young stock,' said the goat; a frail or modest exterior often produces magnificent, powerful achievements

proverb: Qallinaa hin caphani, furdinaa hin tarani
meaning_om: Qallinni qaamaa sababa du'aa yookaan cabsaa hin ta'u; furdinni fi jabinnillee jireenya dheeraaf wabii hin ta'u; jireenyi fi duuti harka Waaqayyoo jirti
meaning_en: Slenderness does not cause one to snap, nor does girth guarantee survival; endurance, vitality, and destiny are determined by inner resilience and divine will

proverb: Nama kofla guddatu, aara/dallansuu isaa hin beekani
meaning_om: Namni yeroo hunda amala gaarii, koflaa fi fuula ifaa qabu yoo dallane iyyuu namoonni aarii isaa akka salphaatti hubachuu hin danda'an; amalli durii aarii dhoksa
meaning_en: One who is habitually smiling and cheerful cannot easily communicate their anger; people fail to take their fury seriously because of their customary laughter

proverb: Nama ilkee kalaadaa, aara/mufii isaa hin beekan
meaning_om: Akkuma namni ilkaan isaa uumamaan bakkee jiru yeroo aaru iyyuu kofla fakkaatu, namni bifa alaa amala tokko qabu miira isaa isa dhugaa beekuun ulfaataadha
meaning_en: Because a person with naturally protruding teeth always appears to be baring their teeth in a grin, others cannot tell when they are genuinely offended or brooding

proverb: Kan ergame erga himaa, kan ergarame bifaatu hima
meaning_om: Ergamaan ergaa afaaniin yoo dabarse, namni rakkinaa fi roorroon irra gahe garuu dhiphina isaa bifa, qaamaa fi haala isaatiin ifatti mul'isa
meaning_en: A designated messenger communicates with spoken words, but one who has suffered mistreatment needs no speech—their haggard appearance tells the whole story

proverb: Nama huccuu carqaa, dubri qaadhimaa hin seetu
meaning_om: Namni uffata moofaa fi carqaa uffate intala biratti akka dhiira fuudhaaf qophaa'eetti hin ilaalamu; bifa alaa fi hiyyummaan hawwannaa jaalalaa dhabsiisa
meaning_en: A maiden will not consider a man dressed in tattered rags as a potential suitor; outward poverty and shabby dress diminish one's romantic and social standing

proverb: Namni huccuun carqii, namatti hin tolu
meaning_om: Namni hiyyeessa uffata gahaa hin qabne hawaasa biratti tuffatama, kabaja hin argatu; ormi nama qabeenyaa fi uffata gaarii qabu qofa jaalata
meaning_en: A person dressed in rags is disdained and unappealing to others; society is superficial and withholds respect and warmth from the visibly destitute

proverb: Abbaan dhoysu, irreetu hima
meaning_om: Namni tokko dandeettii, humna yookaan dadhabina ofii afaaniin dhoksuuf yoo yaaleyyuu, qaamni fi gochi isaa dhugaa jiru ifatti baasa
meaning_en: Even if an individual attempts to conceal their true strength, capability, or exhaustion verbally, their physical build and actions reveal the truth

proverb: Biddeena hamaa, danfa baredaan nyaatani
meaning_om: Haala yookaan wanta rakkisaa ta'e tokko obsaan dabarsuuf, wantoota gaarii fi jaalala naannoo jirutti fayyadamuun dhiphina sana laaffifatu
meaning_en: Coarse or poorly prepared bread is made palatable by pairing it with delicious stew; difficult circumstances are softened by complementary blessings

proverb: Garaacha guddinaa, harreen lakkuu hin dhaltu
meaning_om: Qaamaan guddaa yookaan bololaan bal'aa ta'uun bu'aa dachaa argamsiisa jechuu miti; guddinni alaa firii fi dandeettii wajjin wal hin simatu
meaning_en: Despite having a massive belly, a donkey never bears twins; outward bulk or large capacity does not automatically translate into double productivity

proverb: Mukni daraareef, firii hin dhalu
meaning_om: Wanti tokko jalqabarratti hawwataa fi abdachiisaa mul'ateef dhuma irratti bu'aa qabatamaa fida jechuu miti; abdii fi firiin adda adda
meaning_en: Just because a tree blossoms profusely does not guarantee it will produce ripe fruit; promising starts do not always culminate in tangible achievements

proverb: Yoo heddumminaa, aarri hurree hin taane
meaning_om: Baay'inni yookaan heddumminni qofti wanta tokko gara qulqullinaa fi gatii dhugaatti hin jijjiiru; qulqullinaatu baay'ina caala
meaning_en: If sheer volume were enough, dense smoke would turn into life-giving morning mist; quantity without genuine substance cannot produce true value

proverb: Dheerinni, gobeensaafuu humaa hin goone
meaning_om: Dheerina qaamaa qabaachuun qofti faayidaa yookaan gootummaa hin argamsiisu; wanti bu'uuraa dandeettii fi jabinadha malee dheerina miti
meaning_en: Sheer height did not make the bamboo strong; physical tallness or towering presence is completely useless without inner substance and strength

proverb: Dunfuraa fi huccuun nama bareechani malee humna namaaf hin tahu
meaning_om: Faayanii fi uffanni gaariin bifa alaa qofa miidhagsa malee, jagnummaa, humnaa fi dandeettii dhugaa namaaf hin kennu; humnoon keessaa madda
meaning_en: Fine jewelry and elegant clothes adorn the exterior, but they impart neither physical strength nor inner fortitude; true might is internal

proverb: Namni uffatee qabu, kabaja qaba
meaning_om: Namni qulqullinaan uffatee of qabu hawaasa keessatti kabaja, ulfinaa fi fudhatama argata; of eeguun kabaja fida
meaning_en: One who is properly clothed, well-groomed, and possesses dignity commands social respect and reverence; outward propriety fosters esteem

proverb: Yoo diiminaa, hiddiinuu ala bulte
meaning_om: Bifti diimaan yookaan bareedinni alaa qofti gatii hin qabu; wanti sun faayidaa fi mi'aa qabaachuu baannaan ormi bira darba
meaning_en: If bright red color alone were worthy, the wild bitter-apple berry would not be left neglected in the bush; surface beauty is worthless without character

proverb: Soorti duraa ija
meaning_om: Nyaanni yookaan wanti dhihaatu osoo afaaniin hin nyaatamin dura ijaan ilaalamee miidhaginaan nama hawwachuu qaba; dhiheessi gaariin fedhii bana
meaning_en: The eye eats first before the mouth; visual presentation, cleanliness, and aesthetics stimulate the appetite and welcome the soul

proverb: Ilmi huqqate, abbaa hin fakkaatu
meaning_om: Namni hiyyummaan, beelli fi dhiphinni isa dadhabse ulfinaa fi kabaja sanyii isaa calaqqisiisuu hin danda'u; gadadoon fakkii namaa jijjiira
meaning_en: An emaciated and starved son loses the noble resemblance of his prosperous father; deep deprivation disfigures a person and obscures their heritage

proverb: Tiitichi Kanniisa fakkaateef, damma hin dalagu
meaning_om: Namni hojii fi amala nama gaarii akkeesse qofaan bu'aa guddaa nama sanaa fiduu hin danda'u; fakkeessitoonni firii dhugaa hin qaban
meaning_en: Even if a fly looks like a honeybee, it cannot produce honey; mere mimicry or superficial imitation of a skilled worker yields no productive results

proverb: Boona, booddi bona
meaning_om: Of tuulummaa, qisaasamaa fi boonaan jiraachuun booda isaa hiyyummaa, dhabamuu fi hongee hamaatti nama geessa; booni badiisa dhalcha
meaning_en: Haughty pride, vanity, and squandering lead inevitably to barren winter and drought; arrogance and wasteful living precede destitution and famine

proverb: Boonni, dararaa wajji
meaning_om: Namni of tuuluu fi boonu yeroo hunda qormaata, salphinaa fi dararaa keessa of buusa; booni dhuma irratti gadda fida
meaning_en: Pride and haughtiness inevitably invite suffering, humiliation, and distress; arrogance always carries an agonizing price

proverb: Boonni nama hin dhibu, hudduu miidanii dubbii didanii
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya malee boonu yoo jiraate dhibee miti, garuu osoo harka-qalleessa fi qullaa ta'anii gorsa fi dhugaa diduun gowwummaa cimaadha
meaning_en: Pride itself is common in human nature, but being utterly destitute and exposed while stubbornly refusing all advice and mediation is baffling folly

proverb: Ala taa'anii ol boonuurra, manaa gadi boonuu wayya
meaning_om: Osoo mana fi qe'ee ofii hin qabaatin ala teessanii of tuuluurra, manuma ofii qabaatanii tasgabbaa'anii jiraachuutu ulfina qaba
meaning_en: Rather than being sheltered nowhere and boasting vainly toward the heavens, it is far better to rest in one's own humble home with quiet dignity

proverb: Abbaan fardaa, magaala of seeha
meaning_om: Namni farda yookaan qabeenya hawwataa qabaate tokko, qabeenyuma sanatti amanee akka waan qaamaan bareedaa fi nama hawwatu ta'etti of jaja; wanta qabaniin bareedina dhuunfaa ofirratti fe'uu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: A horse-owner deludes himself into thinking he is handsome and charming simply because he rides a fine mount; mocks someone who mistakes the glamour of their possessions for their own personal attractiveness

proverb: Biyya nama ija hin qabnee yoo dhaqan, ija takka ni qiirrisani
meaning_om: Bakka fi hawaasa dhaqanitti akkaataa aadaa, safuu fi amala isaaniitti walsimanii jiraachuun ogummaadha; aadaa naannoo kabajuu ibsa
meaning_en: When you enter a land where people lack an eye, wink and close one of yours; adapt gracefully to local customs and community norms

proverb: "Deegee, deegeeyii, coraa hin nyaadhu" jette, faaqiin
meaning_om: Hiyyummaan yoo nama qabeyyuu wantuma hojii fi jireenya ofiitiin walqabatu tuffachuu; harka-qalleessa ta'anii soba boonuun of salphisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'Poor as I may be, I will not eat hide scrapings,' said the tanner; satirizes haughty pretense and disdaining the very humble trade that sustains one

proverb: Kan si hin dursine, si hin aarsu
meaning_om: Namni dandeettiidhaan, gochaan yookaan milkaa'inaan si dura hin dabrin aarii fi hinaaffaa sitti uumuu hin danda'u; aariin kan dhuftu isa si caalerraayi
meaning_en: One who does not surpass you in achievement, speed, or merit cannot truly provoke your jealousy or anger; frustration only comes when outstripped

proverb: Boonni hanguma foon fuulaa qabani tola
meaning_om: Namni of tuulu yookaan boonu dura wanta ittiin boonu qabaachuu qaba; osoo beellii fi hiyyummaan fuula namaa qoorsee jiru boonuun of salphisuudha; booni kan malu nama quufa fi qabeenya qabuufi
meaning_en: Pride is becoming only to the extent that one has flesh on one's face; haughtiness is ridiculous when coming from someone who is visibly starving, destitute, and sunken-cheeked; pride requires actual substance and means to back it up

proverb: Garaa qabaachu illee baatan, masaanuu duratti gara dhiibani
meaning_om: Qabeenya yookaan dandeettii dhabanis, diina fi morkataa ofii duratti dadhabina ofii agarsiisuu dhiisanii akka nama cimaatti of dhiheessuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Even if one is not pregnant, one puffs out the stomach before a rival co-wife; never revealing weakness before an adversary, putting up a brave front

proverb: Bultiin wasaasaa dha
meaning_om: Bultiin akkuma wasaasaa gamaa fi gamanaan walmadaalchifamee baatamuuti; abbaan manaa fi haati manaa walta'anii madaala yoo hin eegne jireenyi manaa ni jallata
meaning_en: Marriage is like a two-person litter that requires equal balance from both sides; unless husband and wife share the load cooperatively, the household tilts and collapses

proverb: Dhiirsaa fi niitiin suunsuma
meaning_om: Akkuma suunsummaan eelee fi ittoo utubee ibidda irra dhaabu, abbaan manaa fi haati manaas wal-utubanii jireenya maatii dhaabu; tokko yoo hafe manni hin dhaabbatu
meaning_en: Husband and wife are like the hearthstones that support the cooking pot over the fire; they mutually prop up the warmth, sustenance, and stability of the home

proverb: Niitiin dhirsaaf kafana
meaning_om: Haati manaa hanqina, iccitii fi qaanii abbaa manaa ishee dhoksiti, kabaja fi maqaa isaa eegdee akka uffataatti isa uwwifti; eegduu fi gaachana dhiirsaati
meaning_en: A wife serves as a protective garment for her husband, shielding his vulnerabilities, safeguarding his private secrets, and preserving his honor

proverb: Dhiirri galaanaa, dhalaan kuuri
meaning_om: Dhiirri akkuma yaa'a galaanaatti alaa socho'ee qabeenya fi galii fida; dubartiin garuu akkuma kuurii bishaanii wanta argame sana walitti qabdee, qusattee bultii ijaarti
meaning_en: A man is like a flowing river bringing in provisions from outside; a woman is like a reservoir that gathers, conserves, and manages those resources

proverb: Bultiin kintaalaa, wal qixa qaban malee, hin toltu
meaning_om: Bultiin ulfaataa waan ta'eef abbaan manaa fi haati manaa walqixa itti-gaafatamummaa yoo hin fudhanne kufaatii fi dhiphina fida; walta'iinsa barbaada
meaning_en: Marriage is as heavy as a 100-kg sack; unless both partners lift it with equal strength and commitment, it cannot be carried successfully

proverb: Dhiirsaa fi niitiin laga tokko irraa waraabamani
meaning_om: Abbaan manaa fi haati manaa carraa, fedhii fi jireenya waloomaa tokko qabu; hariiroon isaanii akka bishaan laga tokkoo walitti makamee tokko ta'eedha
meaning_en: Husband and wife are scooped from the same river; their destinies, interests, and lives are inextricably blended into a single shared stream

proverb: Duuti qoricha hin qabdu, yoo qabaatte fuudhanii dhaluu qofa
meaning_om: Du'a jalaa miliquun hin danda'amu; garuu namni fuudhee daa'imman dhalchuun sanyii fi maqaa ofii dacheerra tursiisuun du'a mo'ata
meaning_en: Death cannot be avoided; yet humans achieve symbolic immortality and defeat the finality of death by marrying and continuing their lineage

proverb: Qawween rasaasaan maletti, dhiirri dhalaan maletti faaydaa hinqaban
meaning_om: Akkuma qawween rasaasa hin qabne meeshaa duwwaa fi bu'aa hin qabne ta'e, dhiirri haadha manaa hin qabnes guutuu miti, jireenyi isaa qajeelfama dhaba
meaning_en: Just as a firearm without ammunition is a useless weapon, a man without a wife is incomplete, ineffective, and lacks purpose and defense

proverb: Niitii waan torbaa fuudhanii, waan takkaaf wajjiin jiraatan
meaning_om: Yeroo fuudhaa bareedina, qabeenya, sanyii fi wantoota hedduu ilaalanis, bultii zalaalamiif kan nama tursiisu jaalala, obsa fi amala gaarii qofaadha
meaning_en: While a person may seek a spouse for numerous qualities, lasting coexistence relies upon a single vital core: mutual patience, peace, and love

proverb: Ona taa'uu mannaa, ontuu takkaa wajjiin taa'uu wayya
meaning_om: Kophummaa hamaa fi qe'ee onte keessa jiraachuurra, nama amalli isaa laafaa ta'eyyuu wajjin taa'anii mana qabaachuutu wayya; kophummaan balaadha
meaning_en: Dwelling in an abandoned, empty house in complete isolation is worse than living with a simple companion; domestic company surpasses lonely desolation

proverb: Namni niitii lamaa, qabriin isaa bana
meaning_om: Niitii lama qabaachuun waldhabdee, hinaaffaa fi dhiphina walirraa hin cinne waan fiduuf, abbaan manaa yeroo hunda jireenya cinqii fi du'a jala jiraata
meaning_en: A man who takes two wives lives with his grave perpetually open; the intense rivalry, jealousy, and ceaseless conflict between co-wives torment him

proverb: Namni niitii sadihii, qa'en isaa yaa'ii hin dhabne
meaning_om: Niitii sadi qabaachuun mana keessatti waca, falmii fi jaarsummaa walirraa hin cinne uuma; qe'een isaa akka yaa'ii marii taati
meaning_en: A man with three wives has a household that resembles a perpetual community council; his compound is constantly entangled in debates and disputes

proverb: Namni niitii afurii wadaaja yaa'ii hin qabne
meaning_om: Niitii afur qabaachuun wacaa fi dhiphina to'atamuu hin dandeenye uuma; manni isaa akkuma wadaaja sagantaa hin qabnee nagaa fi tasgabbii dhaba
meaning_en: A man with four wives presides over a chaotic prayer assembly that lacks order; domestic life degenerates into ungovernable noise and fragmentation

proverb: Namni dubra noolee fuudhe, nama wadala qaaqaa manaa qabu
meaning_om: Aadaa fookloorii Harargee keessatti dubartoonni gosa Noolee ija-jajjaboo, afaan-dheeressoo fi sagalee ol-kaasanii dubbatan jedhamee qishnaan mammaakama
meaning_en: Folk satire depicting a maiden of the Noole clan as outspoken, loud, and bold; marrying her is humorously likened to keeping a vocal, braying male donkey

proverb: Namni dubra meettaa fuudhe, nama haraashii qaceelte qabu
meaning_om: Dubartoonni gosa Meettaa hojjetattuu, qonnaa fi bultii kan cimsanii fi itti-gaafatamummaan manaa kan qajeelchan ta'uu faarsuun ibsa
meaning_en: Marrying a maiden of the Metta clan is like acquiring a tireless, straight-plowing cultivator; Metta women are culturally praised for industry and farming stamina

proverb: Namni dubra alaa fuudhe, nama daarota guutuun dikee mataa irratti ba'ate
meaning_om: Aadaa fookloorii keessatti dubra gosa Alaa fuudhuun hojii loonii, dhoqqee fi qormaata baay'ee ofitti fe'uu yookaan aarii guddaa qabaachuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Folk satire comparing marrying an Ala maiden to carrying a heavy basket of ashes or dung upon one's head; teasingly depicting the marriage as bringing endless chores

proverb: Namni dubra ituu fuudhe, nama siree siree irratti jaare
meaning_om: Dubartoonni gosa Ituu aadaa keessatti qananii, boqonnaa, fi kunuunsa guddaadhaan beekamu; ishee fuudhuun jireenya qananii fi boqonnaa dachaa namaaf argamsiisa
meaning_en: Marrying a maiden of the Ituu clan is like building a bed upon a bed, bringing double comfort and pampering; Ituu women are praised for gracious domestic care

proverb: Saani aannan dhabnaan loonii miti, haati manaa fi abbaan manaa walii galtee dhabnaan gaarii miti
meaning_om: Akkuma sa'i aannan hin kennine gatii dhabu, bultii keessattis wanti bu'uuraa waliigaltee fi nagaadha; waliigaltee malee bultiin milkaa'ina hin qabu
meaning_en: Just as a cow yielding no milk fails its primary purpose as livestock, a marriage lacking mutual agreement, peace, and harmony is devoid of goodness

proverb: Namni niitii hamtuu qabu, yeroo malee dullooma
meaning_om: Haati manaa amala badaa, aarii fi qoccolloo baay'iftu abbaa manaa isheef yaaddoo fi dhiphina taatee umuriin osoo hin gahin dafee akka dulloomu taasisti
meaning_en: A man burdened with a quarrelsome, toxic wife ages before his time; constant domestic strife and anxiety rapidly drain a husband's youth and health

proverb: Namni niitii hamtuu qabu, mana keessaa hiyyooma
meaning_om: Haati manaa qusannaa hin beekne, qisaasituu fi amala badaa qabdu qabeenya abbaan manaa alaa fidu barbadeessitee mana keessaa hiyyummaa uumti
meaning_en: A man with an irresponsible, wasteful wife is reduced to poverty right inside his own home; domestic wastefulness bleeds hard-earned wealth dry

proverb: Namni niitii gaarii qabu, mana keessaa dulloma
meaning_om: Haati manaa amala gaarii, nagaa fi qusannaa qabdu abbaa manaatiif boqonnaa taati; abbaan manaa alatti dhiphachuu dhiisee manuma isaa keessatti nagaan dullooma
meaning_en: A man blessed with a virtuous, loving, and supportive wife enjoys lasting domestic peace; he grows old contentedly within his own household without distress

proverb: Niitiin hamtuun kufa
meaning_om: Haati manaa amala badaa fi safeeffannaa hin qabne bultii, kabaja, qabeenya fi jireenya abbaa manaa guutummaatti barbadeessitee gara kufaatiitti oofti
meaning_en: A wicked, irresponsible, or ill-natured wife brings ruin; she destabilizes and collapses the entire foundation, wealth, and reputation of the household

proverb: Niitiin dhiirsa hin qabne, mana utubaa hin qabne
meaning_om: Dubartiin abbaa manaa hin qabne eegumsa, kabaja fi gargaarsa bu'uuraa dhabdi; akkuma manni utubaa hin qabne dafee jiguuf saaxilamu, isheenis qorumsaaf saaxilamtuudha
meaning_en: A woman without a husband is like a house lacking a central support pillar; she is deprived of foundational protection, social defense, and security

proverb: "Maaliif lallabda" jennaan, "niitii natti hammaatteetu na lallabsiisa" je'e, korbeeysi
meaning_om: Dhiirri manatti nagaa fi jaalala dhabee haadha manaatiin dararamu alatti aariin waca, namatti dheekkama, miira tasgabbii dhaba
meaning_en: When asked why he bleats loudly, the he-goat blamed his harsh mate; domestic misery and constant harassment at home cause a man to act irritable and noisy outside

proverb: Ooyruu qa'ee fi niitii ganamaa booddee itti galan
meaning_om: Namni bakka fagoo yoo deemeyyuu gara lafa qe'eetti akkuma deebi'u, jaalallii fi kabajni haadha manaa ishee ganama waliin bultii eegalaniis yoomiyyuu hin badu
meaning_en: One ultimately returns to the plot of land beside the homestead and to the first wife of one's youth; one's primary home plot and first love remain the ultimate refuge

proverb: Mana galgalaaf ijaarratu, niitii bultiif fuudhu
meaning_om: Manni boqonnaa fi nagaa galgalaa kan itti argataniidha; haati manaas wanta yerootiif osoo hin taane jireenya zalaalamii fi bultii itti fufiinsa qabuuf kan fuudhamtuudha
meaning_en: A house is built to provide restful shelter when night falls, and a wife is taken for an enduring, lifelong partnership; marriage demands long-term vision

proverb: Niitii duute faarsuun, tan jirtu jallisuu dha
meaning_om: Haadha manaa duraanii tan duute yeroo hunda faarsuun haadha manaa amma jirtu mufachiisa, garaa ishee gubee bultii ammaa mancaasa
meaning_en: Constantly praising a late wife alienates and embitters the living one, breeding resentment and destabilizing the current marriage through unfair comparison

proverb: Gowwaan niitii mooha, beekaa ammoo niitiitu moha
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan humnaan haadha manaa isaa caccabsee bituu yaala; namni beekaan garuu jaalala fi mariidhaan haadha manaa isaatiif dursa kennee waliigaltee uuma
meaning_en: A fool tries to overpower his wife through brute force, whereas a wise man willingly yields to his wife's counsel and affection to maintain domestic harmony

proverb: Niitii fi irfiin tan ifii gadiiti
meaning_om: Akkuma irfiin qonnaa dheerina namaatiin ol ta'e qotuu nama dhibu, meeshaan hojiis ta'ee bultiin kan nama wajjin walsimuu fi madaalawaa ta'e jireenya salphisee nagaa fida
meaning_en: Just as a plow-handle taller than the farmer makes tilling awkward and unmanageable, practical tools and life partners are best when well-matched and manageable in scale, making life smoother and more cooperative

proverb: Niitiin gowwaan mana ifii diiyde, beeytuun mana ifii jaarte
meaning_om: Dubartiin qalbii hin qabne wacaa fi amala badaadhaan bultii ofii diigdi; dubartiin beektuun garuu obsa, jaalala fi qusannaadhaan maatii ishee cimsitee ijaarti
meaning_en: A foolish woman dismantles her own home through strife and bad temper; an astute and wise woman establishes and nurtures her household through prudence

proverb: Sodaataa du'a dheeysuu fi du'a Goota dheeysituutu walitti dhufa
meaning_om: Namni dabeessi du'a baqachuuf jedhee osoo fiiguu du'uma sanatti kufa; gootni garuu du'a hin sodaatu, duutu isa dheessa; sodaan du'a jalaa nama hin oolchu
meaning_en: The coward fleeing death runs straight into it, while death evades the hero who confronts it fearlessly; cowardice accelerates doom, whereas courage wards it off

proverb: Yaa fuudha baranaa, yaa gursummaa bar hegeree
meaning_om: Fuudhaa fi heeruma jarjaraan, fedhii yeroo fi qorannoo malee raawwatamee dafee gara diigumsaatti jijjiiramu ceepha'a; bultiin qoosaa akka hin taane akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: Alas, the lavish wedding of this year will become next year's bitter divorce; laments hasty, impulsive marriages that collapse almost immediately

proverb: Abbaan intalaan "dhiirsaafiin si kenna" jennaan "na kennuu na kennitaa, ammoo kan yeroo na arrabsu if arrabsuuf na kenni" jette
meaning_om: Intalli yeroo heerumtu nama kabaja qabu kan yoo ishee arrabse kabaja ofiis miidhu akka kennaniif gaafachuu; kabaja ofii eeggachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The maiden asked to be given to someone whose honor is so intertwined with hers that insulting her degrades himself; seeking a partner of mutual honor and respect

proverb: Bultiin raroo harreeti
meaning_om: Bultiin akkuma raroo harree yeroo hunda jallachuu fi garagaluu danda'a; yeroo hunda obsaan qajeelchuu, wal-danda'uu fi kunuunsuu barbaada
meaning_en: Marriage is like a donkey's packsaddle; it constantly tilts and loosens unless spouses continually adjust, balance, and maintain it with patience

proverb: Namni duuydaa fi niitiin ol ka'a
meaning_om: Guddinni, milkaa'innii fi kabajni dhiira tokkoo deeggarsa firaa fi haadha manaa gaarii qabaachuu irratti hirkata; isaan lamaan utubaa jireenyaati
meaning_en: A man rises, prospers, and attains social prominence through two great pillars: a supportive clan backbone and a virtuous, faithful wife

proverb: "Yoo anaa fi ati wal taane, rakkoon hin jiru, hiraanni bilchoodha" jette, niitiin
meaning_om: Abbaan manaa fi haati manaa yoo jaalala fi tokkummaa qabaatan, hiyyummaan fi dhiphinni alaa dhufe hunduu salphaatti danda'ama; tokkummaan bultii hunda mo'ata
meaning_en: 'If you and I stand in unified agreement, no hardship can defeat us; even bitter adversity is easily endured,' said the wife; spousal solidarity conquers all trials

proverb: Himaan numa himaa; dhagayaatu hin jirre
meaning_om: Namni gorsaa fi dhugaa dubbatu hin dhabamu, garuu kan gorsa sana qalbiin dhaga'ee hojiirra oolchutu dhabame; gorsa tuffachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: There is never a shortage of sound advice and warnings; what is truly lacking is an obedient ear willing to listen and act upon the counsel

proverb: Qalameen shanyii gadhee, reeffa fira ofiitti kolfiti
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa fi safeeffannaa hin qabne gadda fi rakkina fira isaatti gammada, itti kolfas; safuu dhabuu fi hammeenya firaa balaaleffata
meaning_en: An ill-bred monkey laughs at the corpse of its own kin; condemns callous, shameless individuals who mock or rejoice in the misfortunes of their family

proverb: Ani hin hanbifannee, ati hin qalbifanne
meaning_om: Namni gorsu dhimma sana osoo hin dhoksin ifatti himee ture, garuu inni gorfamu qalbii kennuu dhabee kufaatiif of saaxile; itti gaafatamummaa ofii agarsiisa
meaning_en: I did not withhold any warning or truth, but you failed to pay attention; said to clear one's conscience when someone ignores advice and suffers ruin

proverb: Wadalli harree, haadha hin xooru
meaning_om: Namni safuu, naamusa fi dhaloota hin beekne maatii ofiitiif illee kabaja hin qabu; amala bineensummaa fi daangaa safuu cabsuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A male donkey has no filial boundary or respect for its own mother; satirizes uncouth, shameless people who violate sacred family taboos

proverb: Yeroo inni kaan dhugaa dubbatu, inni kaan dinnicha kadhata
meaning_om: Yeroo dhimma jireenyaa isa murteessaa fi ulfaataa irratti mari'atan, namni qalbii hin qabne wanta laafaa fi fedhii qaamaa kaasee dubbii jallisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: While one addresses grave, vital truths, the other trivializes the moment by begging for potatoes; contrasts serious matters with absurd, petty distractions

proverb: Hulaa banaa, hundumaatu seena
meaning_om: Bakka eegumsi, seerri fi daangaan hin jirretti namni fedhe seenee wanta fedhe raawwata; daangaa dhabuun saaxilamummaa fida
meaning_en: Everyone walks through an open, unguarded door; when boundaries, rules, or personal dignity are left unprotected, anyone will intrude and exploit them

proverb: Mana abbaan banaa bulche hundumaa itti gala
meaning_om: Namni iccitii, maatii fi qabeenya ofiitiif eeggannoo hin goone orma hundaaf saaxilama; dantaa dhablummaan abbaa qe'ee badiisa fida
meaning_en: A house left open overnight by its negligent master invites every stranger and beast inside; carelessness over one's affairs invites ruin

proverb: Itti irkisaan, cufaa hin taatu
meaning_om: Furmaanni yeroo yookaan wanti lafarratti qofa hirkifame nagaa fi amansiisummaa dhugaa hin fidu; wanta bu'uura hin qabnetti hirkachuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Propping an object against an entrance does not make it a secured door; makeshift, half-hearted solutions provide a false illusion of security

proverb: Tan jiruun duute; dhiirsa jiruun ajjeefti
meaning_om: Haati manaa jireenya keessatti naamusas ta'ee kabaja dhabdee akka du'aatti lakkaa'amtu abbaa manaa ishees dhiphinaa fi salphinaan galaafatti
meaning_en: A woman who is morally or socially dead while breathing brings about the living destruction of her husband; a ruined soul drags down their spouse

proverb: Mana citaa hin qabne, rooba maraatu dhaana
meaning_om: Namni eegumsa, qabeenya yookaan gargaarsa hin qabne rakkinaa fi roorroo dhufe hundaaf dafee saaxilama; dadhabaa irratti hunduu roorrisa
meaning_en: A thatchless hut is battered by every passing storm; a defenseless person without wealth or allies becomes an easy target for every hardship and bully

proverb: Tiksituun waan fagoo malee, waan dhihoo hin fardeeysitu
meaning_om: Namni dhimma fagootti dhiphachaa wanta dhihoo isaatti baduuf deemu dagachuu; wanta dursa barbaadu dhiisanii isa fagoo yaaddahuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The herder frets over distant matters while ignoring immediate dangers; critiquing misplaced priorities that overlook pressing nearby problems

proverb: Tiksituun taakkuu dhiiftee, dhuundhuma dhaqxi
meaning_om: Wanta salphaa fi dhihoo jiru furuu dhiisanii, isa dheeraa fi ulfaataa ta'etti fiiguun dadhabbii fi kasaaraa fida; dursa dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: The herder neglects an immediate handspan only to chase after a cubit's distance; ignoring small, close-at-hand steps to pursue distant burdens

proverb: Namni ijoollee ergate, barbaada deemu mudata
meaning_om: Hojii fi itti-gaafatamummaa guddaa nama dandeettii fi bilchina hin qabneetti kennuun bu'aa fiduu dhiisee dadhabbii dabalataa fida
meaning_en: Sending children on an errand means having to go out searching for them; entrusting important responsibilities to the immature creates double the work

proverb: Namni si ergate, nama okkotee dhaabbate
meaning_om: Namni dhimmaaf nama ergate dafee akka deebi'uuf muddamaan waan eeggatuuf, ergamaan dafee hojii xumuree deebi'uu akka qabu; ariifannaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: The person who sent you on an errand has already set the pot on the fire; an emissary must act with urgency and speed, as the sender anxiously waits

proverb: Kan ijoolleen bukeessite, irbaataaf hin ta'u
meaning_om: Hojiin namoota muuxannoo fi bilchina hin qabneen hojjetame qulqullina hin qabaatu, bu'aa qabatamaa hin fidu; ogeessi hojjechuu qaba
meaning_en: Dough kneaded by children will not make a proper dinner; important tasks undertaken by inexperienced amateurs result in flawed, unusable outcomes

proverb: Namni farra naachaa qabu, afaan lagaatii hin dhabamu
meaning_om: Namni wanta balaa isa irratti fidu beekaa itti dhihaachuu fi iddoo badii sana irraa fagaachuu didu of balleessuuf jiraachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The one whose fatal predator is the crocodile never leaves the water's edge; critiques people who recklessly loiter around the very vices that ruin them

proverb: Aduun guyyaa, harreen ballaadha
meaning_om: Osoo ifti fi dhugaan jiruuyyuu namni hubachuu fi arguun dadhabu gowwummaa cimaa qabaachuu agarsiisa; dhugaa ifa bahe dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Even in the bright midday sun, the donkey is blind; mocks someone who fails to perceive the obvious, plain truth staring directly at them

proverb: Boru hin beekneen, qodaan bukoon ishii lama
meaning_om: Namni gara fuulduraatiif hin qusanne fi boruuf hin yaanne qabeenya qabu hunda guyyaa tokkotti qisaasee boriif hiyyooma; qusannaa dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: She who gives no thought to tomorrow prepares two bowls of dough today; satirizes wasteful people who exhaust all their provisions without saving

proverb: Dhaddeen ooyruu dinnichaatti lama deebite, ni duuti
meaning_om: Namni bakka balaan jiru yookaan hojii seeraan alaa tokkotti irra deddeebi'ee hirmaatu dhuma irratti qabamee badiisa keessa bu'a
meaning_en: If the porcupine returns to the same potato field twice, it gets trapped; pushing one's luck by repeatedly returning to danger leads to destruction

proverb: Warri oduu, naafa dirmachuuf erga, duudaa fi dhegelaa caqasaaf erga, ballaa (jaamaa) ilaalaaf erga
meaning_om: Hawaasni yookaan maatiin hojii dhabee oduu keessa jiru dhimmoota murteessoo hundumaaf namoota hin malle ramaduun hojii fashaleessa
meaning_en: A household consumed by idle gossip sends the lame to rescue, the deaf to listen, and the blind to scout; mocks grotesque organizational incompetence

proverb: Fagaara dagate, tuseen lama ciniinti
meaning_om: Namni bakka dhuunfaa yookaan hanqina ofiitiif eeggannoo hin goone miidhaa deddeebi'eef saaxilama; of-dagachuun miidhaa fida
meaning_en: He who neglects his own backside gets bitten twice by the ant; failing to guard one's blind spots and vulnerabilities invites repeated, preventable injury

proverb: Gaafa namichi foon nyaate, namichi mana ijjaarrate
meaning_om: Namni tokko qabeenya argate nyaata yeroo irratti yoo gubu, namni biraan ammoo qabeenya walfakkaatuun bu'uura jireenyaa ijaarrata
meaning_en: While one man squanders his windfall on a fleeting feast of meat, another uses identical resources to build a permanent home; consumption vs. investment

proverb: Gaafa gaarri gubatu dirreen ni kofla, gaafa dirreen gubattu gaarri ni kofla
meaning_om: Namoonni balaa fi rakkina ormaaratti kolfuun gowwummaadha; har'a isa mudate bor garuu gara ofiitti jijjiirama
meaning_en: When the mountain burns, the plain laughs; when the plain burns, the mountain laughs; gloating over another's misfortune ignores that disaster strikes all in turn

proverb: Hoggaa horiin gadoodu, harreen ni dheeddi
meaning_om: Yeroo namoonni dhimma guddaan dhiphachaa fi boo'aa jiranitti, namni qalbii hin qabne dantaa dhabee fedhii foonii qofatti xiyyeeffachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: While the cattle bellow in distress, the donkey indifferently grazes; critiques callous individuals who satisfy their appetites while others suffer

proverb: Qa'ee gowwaatii, nuguya muratani
meaning_om: Namni dammaqina, ija-jabina fi eeggannoo hin qabne qe'ee fi qabeenyi isaa ormaan dhiitama; akkuma mukti qonnaa isa qaalii ta'e qe'ee gowwaatii heeyyama malee muramu, gowwummaan ormaaf saamicha saaqaa
meaning_en: In the homestead of a fool, people brazenly chop timber to carve a plow-beam; when a person is passive, oblivious, or spineless, outsiders boldly trespass into his private yard and plunder his most prized assets without fear

proverb: Gowwaan sa'a obboleessa isaa shilmii nyaachiseeti sa'a mucha lamaa dhaala
meaning_om: Namni inaaffaa fi gowwummaadhaan qabeenya obboleessa isaa akka badu godhee, dhuma irratti wanta hir'uu fi bu'aa hin qabne dhaaluun kasaaraa fida
meaning_en: The fool lets ticks destroy his brother's cow out of spite, only to inherit a damaged two-teated cow; malicious envy ends in self-inflicted loss

proverb: Biyya duuti hin jirreen dhaqa jedheeti, biyya du'an nama hin awwaalle dhaqe
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan dhibee uumamaa jalaa miliquuf yaalanii wanta isa caalaa fokkisaa fi ulfaataa ta'e keessa of buusuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Seeking a 'deathless land' to escape mortality, he arrived where corpses are left unburied in decay; fleeing unavoidable reality lands one in degradation

proverb: Hancabbii (cabbii) irratti bakakkaa ida'e
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi dhiphina duraan ture irratti balaa dabalataa fi cimaa ta'e fidanii dhiphina dachaa gochuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Adding a lightning strike on top of a violent hailstorm; compounding an already disastrous situation with a fresh, overwhelming catastrophe

proverb: Dhullaa irratti cittoo ida'e
meaning_om: Dhibee fi madaa duraan dhiita'ee nama waraanu irratti dhibee dabalataa kan akka cittoo nama hooqu fidee dhiphina hammaachisuu ibsa
meaning_en: Adding an intensely itchy scabies infection on top of a painful boil; aggravating an already agonizing affliction with yet another maddening hardship

proverb: Cabaa irratti baqaqaa ida'e
meaning_om: Wanta duraanuu cabee miidhame irratti dabalataan tarsaasuu fi caccabsuun badiisa isa dhumaa geessisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Adding a split on top of a broken bone; further fracturing and shattering something already critically damaged into total destruction

proverb: Fincaaniin dheeysa je'eti, albaatirra bu'e
meaning_om: Rakkoo salphaa fi xiqqoo jalaa baqachuuf yaalanii wanta isa caalaa xuraa'aa fi hamaa ta'e keessa lixuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Fleeing from urine, he landed straight in diarrhea; attempting to escape a petty nuisance only to plunge headlong into a repulsive catastrophe

proverb: Anaa abba kiyya dadhabe, abbaan abbaa kiyyaa abbaa isaa qabatee natti dhufe
meaning_om: Osoo rakkoo fi ba'aa duraanii furuu dadhabanii dhiphatanii, rakkoon isa caalaa ulfaataa fi dachaa ta'e dabalataan dhufee nama liqimsuu ibsa
meaning_en: Already overwhelmed managing my father, my grandfather arrives dragging his father along; being crushed by ever-multiplying, heavier burdens

proverb: Bakka si jaalatanii yoo deemte, bakka si jibban dhayxa
meaning_om: Bakka kabaja, jaalala fi nagaa qabdu tuffattee gara ormaatti baqachuun salphinaa fi jibbaaf nama saaxila; iddoo kabajaa ofii eeggachuu gorsa
meaning_en: If you abandon the place where you are loved and cherished, you will end up among strangers where you are hated; treasure your sanctuary

proverb: Kofalteetuu hin bareennee, boochu bareeddii?
meaning_om: Namni uumamaaniifi amalaan yeroo nagaa fudhatama hin qabne, aarii fi komii keessatti ammoo daran nama nuffisiisa malee hin miidhagu
meaning_en: She was unattractive even when smiling; will she look appealing weeping? If someone lacks charm at their best, sulking only makes them repulsive

proverb: Rakkinni koo rakkinaa, haati too ammaas ulfa
meaning_om: Osoo hiyyummaa fi ba'aan duraanii furmaata hin argatin, itti-gaafatamummaan fi rakkoon biraa dabalamee jireenya rakkisaa gochuu ibsa
meaning_en: My troubles are already heavy enough, and yet my mother is pregnant once again; lamenting mounting liabilities when one cannot survive present woes

proverb: Kan kuferratti, kan caphe dhufe
meaning_om: Namni yookaan dhimmi duraanuu kufee rakkachaa jiru irratti, dhimmi isa caalaa miidhamaa ta'e biraa itti dabalamee ba'aa ulfeessuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: On top of the fallen person arrives the one with broken limbs; accumulating miseries where the crippled are burdened with caring for the shattered

proverb: Duruu hin goomtuu, boosattii bokkeenyi dhaane
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu dhibaa'aa fi qulqullina hin qabne yoo balaan xiqqoon itti dhufe akka sababaatti fayyadamee guutummaatti of gata
meaning_en: She was untidy to begin with, and now the downpour has drenched her; an already lazy person finds the perfect excuse in a setback to quit altogether

proverb: Waraabeysaan dheeysattiin, leenca afaan bu'e
meaning_om: Balaa xiqqaa jalaa baqachuuf yaalanii balaa isa duraanii caalaa sodaachisaa fi lubbuu galaafatu keessa of buusuu ibsa
meaning_en: Running away from the hyena, I plunged right into the jaws of the lion; escaping a lesser threat only to fall into fatal, insurmountable peril

proverb: Fanxoo, kan maqaa isii irra kan madaa isii haa caalu
meaning_om: Salphinni, yeelloon fi qaanfiin maqaa balleessaan fidu madaa qaamaa caalaa nama miidha; madaan fayyuu danda'a garuu salphinni hin fayyu
meaning_en: The social dishonor and infamy of a shameful affliction are far more agonizing than physical pain; wounds can heal, but a tainted reputation lingers

proverb: Hiyyeeysa hoggaa bakka bulu dhoorku, dhuufu itti guddisa
meaning_om: Carraan yookaan namni hiyyeessa dhoowwatu dhiphina itti dabala; carraan yoo itti jallatte wanti hunduu dhufee hiyyeessa saaxila, yookaan ormi bakka bulmaa dhoowwachuuf sababa kajeelchaa fi komii dhuufuu itti guddisa
meaning_en: Reflects the compounded misfortune of the poor where even fate and bodily digestion betray a destitute person at the worst moment to deny him shelter; alternately satirizes an inhospitable host inventing or exaggerating a poor guest's flatulence as a petty excuse to turn him out into the cold

proverb: Fardaa bade, kan jiruun badde
meaning_om: Kasaaraan qabeenya bu'uuraa tokkoo jireenyaa fi jiruu namaa guutummaatti mancaasee hiyyummaa keessa nama galchuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Losing a vital asset shatters one's entire livelihood; the collapse of a central foundation brings down the entire life and functioning of a person

proverb: "Tiyya tana, kan ballisu malee, kan dhiphisu hin agarre" jette, namittiin
meaning_om: Rakkina, dhibee yookaan ba'aa yeroo hunda babal'atu malee xiqqaachuu hin beekne qishnaadhaan ibsa; dhiphinni guddachaa deema
meaning_en: 'This affliction of mine only ever expands, never contracts,' said the woman; satirizes problems, debts, or grievances that perpetually grow larger without relief

proverb: "Hiyyeeysaaf maaltu dawa" jennaan, "xanne" je'e
meaning_om: Hiyyummaa fi beela hamaa addunyaa kanaa irratti qishnaa hadhaawaa dubbatamuudha; namni hiyyeessi garaa duwwaa qabaachuu isaatiif yookaan dhiphina jireenyaa jalaa dafee du'aan boqochuuf dhibeen albaatii hamaa akka xannee akka qorichaatti qishnaan dubbatame
meaning_en: A grim, dark satirical proverb on the agony of extreme poverty: when asked what 'medicine' exists for a starving pauper, the cynical answer is 'xanne' (acute diarrhea/dysentery)—a fatal purging illness that empties an already starving stomach and brings quick release from lifelong misery

proverb: Kan cicherratti, kan gaggabu dhufe
meaning_om: Rakkina duraan jiru isa furmaata hin arganne irratti, dhimmi dadhabaan biraa dhufee ba'aa dabalataa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: On top of a situation already strained to the breaking point, arrives another who is collapsing; compounding crises where the strained must carry the fainting

proverb: Raammoo baqattee, bofa afaan buute
meaning_om: Wanta xiqqoo fi balaa hin qabne sodaatanii baqachuudhaan, balaa lubbuu galaafatu isa guddaa keessa of buusuu ibsa
meaning_en: Fleeing in panic from a harmless earthworm, she plunged right into the jaws of a deadly snake; panicking over petty fears only to land in fatal peril

proverb: Kan beekaa mugu, yaaman hin owwaatu
meaning_om: Namni beekaa dantaa dhabuuf jedhee rafe fakkaatu yookaan gurra cufate, hangamiyyuu yoo waaman deebii hin kennu
meaning_en: One who is deliberately feigning sleep will never answer when summoned; there is no waking someone who is intentionally pretending to be oblivious

proverb: Dhagayaa didaan, yaaman hin owwaatu
meaning_om: Namni gurra qabaatee dhaga'uu didee fi mata-jabeessa ta'e, waamicha fi gorsa hundaaf gurra cufata malee deebii hin kennu
meaning_en: One who is obstinately determined not to listen will never respond when summoned; willful deafness cannot be penetrated by reasoning

proverb: Nama beekaa dhukate, yaamiinsi godaa isa hin baasu
meaning_om: Namni beekaa dhimma tokko jalaa dhokatee fi hirmaachuu dide, hangamiyyuu yoo waamanii fi kadhatan bakka dhokateetii hin bahu
meaning_en: A person who has deliberately concealed himself will not be drawn out of the hollow by shouting; you cannot retrieve someone determined to hide

proverb: Gaalli diddaaf deemu cancala hin seenu
meaning_om: Namni yookaan bineensi fincilaa fi diddaadhaaf qophaa'e qajeelfamaa fi to'annoo jala galuu dida; diddaan guutame to'achuun ulfaataadha
meaning_en: A camel bent on resistance will not let its head enter the halter; an individual determined on defiance cannot easily be reined in or disciplined

proverb: Harki diddaa qabu, Afaan Jooniyaa hin seenu
meaning_om: Namni hojii fi gargaarsa diduuf murteeffate carraa fi qajeelfama kamiyyuu keessa hin seenu; harki hojjechuu dide firii hin argatu
meaning_en: A hand determined to resist will not reach into the mouth of the grain sack; one who refuses to cooperate or labor will never share in the harvest

proverb: Harki fuudhutti hin jirre, daduu Balloo hin seenu
meaning_om: Namni carraa yookaan bu'aa tokko argachuuf fedhii fi kutannoo hin qabne, carraan bal'aan yoo dhufe iyyuu itti hin fayyadamu; fedhii dhabuun carraa dhabsiisa
meaning_en: A hand that does not reach out to receive will not enter even a wide pouch; one who lacks the initiative to grasp an opportunity gains nothing even in abundance

proverb: Tika didaan, dhihana dida
meaning_om: Namni hojjechuufi tattaaffii gochuu dide nyaata fi bu'aa hojii sana irraa argamu argachuuf mirga hin qabu; hojiin malee nyaanni hin jiru
meaning_en: He who refuses to tend the flock has no claim to the evening meal; if you do not labor, you shall not eat; work is the prerequisite for sustenance

proverb: Nama dhagayaa rafu, dammaysuun nama dhiba
meaning_om: Namni beekaa akka waan hin hubatinitti of fakkeessu yookaan gorsa dhaga'uu dide gorsanii qajeelchuun baay'ee ulfaataadha; fedhii ofii malee namni hin jijjiiramu
meaning_en: It is impossible to wake someone who is pretending to sleep; one who willfully feigns ignorance and refuses to listen cannot be reasoned with or helped

proverb: Sagaliin akhaafe, diddu diddiimaatti
meaning_om: Dhimma tokko yookaan nama tokko qajeelchuuf hangamiyyuu yoo dhama'anii fi yaalan, amalli isaa jijjiiramuu didee akkuma duraatti diddaa fiduu ibsa
meaning_en: Having shoveled nine times, the stubborn red soil still refuses to yield; describes exhausting, repeated efforts to reform an obstinately intractable problem

proverb: Dhaannaan weywaachuu diddee, yaamnaan owwaachuu diddee, niitiin hamtuun dhiirsa ofii qaanyeeysite
meaning_om: Haati manaa amala badaa fi mata-jabeettiin toftaa kamiyyuu diddee dhiirsa ishee orma duratti qaaneessituu fi bultii keessatti to'annoo dhabsiiftu ceepha'a
meaning_en: When disciplined, she refused to cry; when summoned, she refused to answer; an incorrigible, defiant wife completely humiliates her husband by denying him respect

proverb: Harkifnaan deemuu diddee, yaabbannaan saggaaruu diddee, gaangeen hamtuun abbicha qaanyeeysite
meaning_om: Meeshaan yookaan namni amala hin qabne yeroo barbaadame hundatti tajaajila dhoowwatee abbaa dhimmaa qaanii fi dhiphina keessa buusuu ibsa
meaning_en: Pulled by the rein, she refused to budge; mounted, she refused to trot; a stubborn mule humiliates its master; obstinate assets bring public shame

proverb: Diinni michii jiruuti
meaning_om: Diinni jireenya keessatti akkuma dhibee michiitti nagaa, tasgabbii fi gammachuu namaa dhabamsiisa; jireenyi diina qabu yeroo hundumaa dhukkubbii fi dhiphinaan kan guutamedha
meaning_en: An enemy is like an acute, distressing fever of life; having an adversary continually drains a person's peace of mind, poisons daily well-being, and serves as an unceasing affliction throughout existence

proverb: Dhamalli daaraa keeysaa, osoo hin agarre nama guba
meaning_om: Diinni yookaan balaan dhokataan isa ifatti mul'atu caalaa sodachisaadha; nama nagaa fakkaatee keessaan shira xaxu irraa of eeggachuun barbaachisaa dha
meaning_en: The live ember concealed beneath the ashes burns a person before it is even seen; hidden malice and covert enemies are far more dangerous than open threats

proverb: Bofni afaa jalaa, osoo hin agarre nama ciniina
meaning_om: Namni fira fakkaatee mana keessa nama wajjin jiraatu yoo diina ta'e osoo hin yaadamin miidhaa lubbuu galaafatu fida; eeggannoo cimaa barbaada
meaning_en: A snake concealed beneath the bedsheet strikes unseen; treason or enmity lurking within one's own household strikes without warning and inflicts lethal damage

proverb: Haadhaatu du'e ja'anii, ilmoo bofaa taaziyaa wajjiin hin taa'ani
meaning_om: Diinni yoo dhiphateyyuu yookaan gaddus uumamuma isaatiin summii fi hamaa waan ta'eef amananii itti dhihaachuun balaa guddaadha; diina uumamaa hin amanan
meaning_en: One does not sit to offer condolences to a baby serpent because its mother died; never let misplaced sympathy blind you to the lethal nature of an innate enemy

proverb: Jaalala adurree fi hantuutaa, otuu taphattuu wal nyaatti
meaning_om: Hariiroon namoota uumamaan diina ta'anii yookaan gartuu wal caalu gidduu jiru soba; taphaa fi nagaa fakkeessanis dhuma irratti miidhaan dhufuun hin oolu
meaning_en: In the playful 'friendship' between a cat and a mouse, the cat ends up eating the mouse during the game; alliances between predators and prey end in betrayal

proverb: Diinaa wajjiin diina hin dhukatin, kaka'eeti akka mullattu si godhaa
meaning_om: Balaa jalaa ooluuf jedhanii nama amansiisaa hin taane yookaan diina biraatti hirkachuun balaa fida; inni si saaxilee diinatti dabarsee si kenna
meaning_en: Never share a hiding place with a foe to escape another enemy; he will jump up and expose your position; never trust a rival in moments of vulnerability

proverb: Diina kee naman hin ajjeesisin, harka keetiin ajjeesi, akkasiin du'uu isaa beeytaa
meaning_om: Dhimma murteessaa fi balaa guddaa nama irratti qabu nama biraatti dhiisuu mannaa, ofumaan xumuruutu wabii amansiisaa namaaf kenna; itti-gaafatamummaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Do not delegate the elimination of an enemy to another; dispatch him with your own hands to verify he is dead; verify decisive actions personally

proverb: Waan warri kuun booyuuf dhageenye, jette buutiin, kan ofii abbaa warraa nyaatte
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiiyyuu balleessaa fi yakka hamaa raawwatee maatii ofii miidhe tokko akka waan qulqulluu ta'etti gadda ormaatiif naasuu fakkeessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'Now we understand why people weep,' said the viper, who had devoured her own mate; satirizes hypocritical sympathy from treacherous actors who commit atrocities themselves

proverb: Isa Garaa saree keessa jiruutu, garaa kuruphoo keessaas jiraa
meaning_om: Akkuma sareen adamsituun kajeellaa fi fedhii dhuunfaa qabdu, kuruphoon adamsamtus lubbuu ofii oolchuuf kajeellaa fi dhiphina walqixa qabdi; hundumtuu lubbuuf kaata
meaning_en: What lies inside the belly of the hunting dog also lies inside the belly of the fleeing antelope; pursuer and quarry are both driven by the same survival instinct

proverb: Haati hamtuun waraanaa, aayyadaan hamtuun diina
meaning_om: Namni dhihoo fi fira dhiigaa ta'ee osoo kunuunsuu qabuu nama miidhu akkuma waraanaatti laalessa; firoonni amala hamaa qaban miidhaa guddaa geessisu
meaning_en: A cruel mother pierces like a spear, and a cruel aunt acts like an enemy; cruelty from one's own flesh and blood inflicts deeper, more agonizing trauma than attacks by strangers

proverb: Diinni si wajjin galu malee, si hin qalu
meaning_om: Diinni fagoo jiru salphaatti nama hin miidhu; miidhaan inni cimaan kan nama mudatu yoo inni fira fakkaatee mana namaa seene yookaan iccitii namaa bare qofaadha
meaning_en: An enemy cannot destroy you unless he enters your home and shares your quarters; mortal harm comes only when a foe gains intimate proximity and learns your secrets

proverb: Namtichuma marxoo tiyya argeetu gaala kiyya hate
meaning_om: Namni hiyyummaa, hanqinaa fi qullaa ta'uu koo beeku wanta qabeenya koo isa guddaa ta'e na jalaa saame; namuma dhihoo fi iccitii namaa beekutu nama saama
meaning_en: The very person who saw my poverty and nakedness stole my most prized camel; those who know your deepest vulnerabilities are the ones who rob you of your wealth

proverb: Wajji deemanii waliif deemani
meaning_om: Namoonni hariiroo gaarii qaban waliin socho'uu qofa osoo hin taane, faayidaa, nagaa fi milkaa'ina walii eeguudhaaf waliin dhaabbatu; tokkummaan bu'uura
meaning_en: True companions not only travel side by side, but actively look out for each other's welfare and protection along the way; mutual loyalty and solidarity

proverb: Diinni garaa wal hin argu
meaning_om: Namoonni wal jibban yaada, karooraa fi amala garaa keessaa walii hin beekan; wal shakkii fi wal eeggannoo keessa jiraatu malee amantii hin qaban
meaning_en: Adversaries cannot peer into each other's hearts or read secret thoughts; enemies live in constant suspicion and guardedness without genuine insight

proverb: Dirqiin, sabloo hin qabdu
meaning_om: Wanti humnaan fi dirqiidhaan raawwatamu safuu, seeraa fi qaanfii hin beeku; roorroon fi dirqiin daangaa hundumaa cabsitee namatti dhufti
meaning_en: What is done by force and coercion respects no modesty, decency, or moral boundaries; tyranny and oppression disregard all shame and natural justice

proverb: Nabiilleen du'u, Rabbumatti hafani
meaning_om: Namni fedheyyuu kabajamaa fi qulqulluu yoo ta'e du'a jalaa hin oolu; duuti hundaaf kan taate yoo ta'u uumaa qofatu bara baraan jiraata
meaning_en: Even the most sacred prophets face mortality and return to their Creator; death is the universal fate of all living mortals, and only God endures forever

proverb: Du'a sodaa, hirriiba dhabanii hin bulani
meaning_om: Duuti dhufuun ishee hin oolu jedhanii yaaddoo fi sodaadhaan wanta jireenyaaf barbaachisaa ta'e dhiisuun hin danda'amu; sodaan jiraachuu hin dhowwu
meaning_en: One cannot cease sleeping merely out of fear that death will strike in the night; mortal anxiety must not paralyze the essential rhythms and duties of living

proverb: Harki waaqni kute, hin illaawu
meaning_om: Murtii fi qorumsi uumaan nama irratti fide murtii sirrii waan ta'eef obsaan fudhatama; wanta Waaqayyo godhe komachuun hin jiru
meaning_en: A hand cut off by divine decree does not cause bitter ache; afflictions ordained by God are accepted with patient surrender without bitter resentment

proverb: Dhukkubni kofaan dhufe, saala fixate
meaning_om: Dhibeen karaa kofaa nama qabe qoricha argachuuf jecha qaanii fi saalfannaa nama dhiisiisa; dhukkubni akkasii akka nama hin galaafanneef saalfii dhiisanii ogeessatti himachuu fi mul'isuun dirqama
meaning_en: An illness that strikes the groin puts an end to all bashfulness and shame; to receive medicine and save one's life, a person is compelled to cast aside modesty and openly disclose intimate afflictions to the healer

proverb: Bakka irraa hin oolle, kokkoflaati dhaqani
meaning_om: Dirqama, qorumsa yookaan bakka deemuu hin oolle tokko booyaa fi dhiphachaa osoo hin taane, fuula ifaa fi obsaan dhihaachuutu wayya
meaning_en: To the unavoidable destination or duty, one should go with good cheer and smiles; since an ordeal is inevitable, face it with grace and high spirits

proverb: Waan boochu hin arganne, koflii dhabi
meaning_om: Wanta booyichaa fi gaddaan deebifachuun yookaan argachuun hin danda'amneef of miidhuu dhiisanii, koflaa fi fuula ifaadhaan fudhatanii dabarfatanii dhabuutu wayya; gadda bu'aa hin qabne dhiisuu barsiisa
meaning_en: What could not be gained or saved through tears and mourning, let go with a smile; since weeping cannot alter the outcome or restore what was lost, accept the forfeit with good cheer and stoic equanimity

proverb: Aannan gadi naqame, hammuma dhaqqaban ol qabani
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan kasaaraa uumame keessatti wanta bade hunda deebisuun yoo dadhabameyyuu, wantuma hafe fi danda'ame oolfachuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: When milk is spilled, salvage as much of it as your hands can cup; when disaster strikes, focus on damage control and saving whatever remains

proverb: Gadi hin jennu duugdaafuu, diina gabbaruu nu hin dinnu humnaafuu
meaning_om: Humna dhabuu fi roorroo jala jiraachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa; dugdi dhukkubbiin gadi nama jechisiisuu baatus, humni dhabamuun garuu gabbaruu fi bitamuu diinaa akka hin didne nama godha
meaning_en: Captures the bitter, tragicomic irony of complete physical and political powerlessness: one's aching back prevents bending down for one's own needs, yet sheer lack of strength leaves one unable to refuse subjugation and tribute to an enemy

proverb: Kan obboleettii koo jaalate, anaaf soddaa dha
meaning_om: Namni fira, saba yookaan maatii ofiitiif jaalala, kabaja fi gaarummaa agarsiise fira dhihoo fi kabajamaa ta'ee fudhatama argata; jaalalli fira uuma
meaning_en: He who loves and cherishes my sister is an in-law to me; whoever shows honor, protection, and affection to one's family earns a cherished place of kinship

proverb: Kan aayyoo fuudhe, anaaf aabboo dha
meaning_om: Namni aangoo, bultii yookaan itti-gaafatamummaa haala jiruun qabate dirqama akka abbaatti kabajama; haala qabatamaa fudhachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Whoever marries my mother is a father to me; pragmatic acceptance of unfolding reality and acknowledging whoever legitimately holds the seat of authority

proverb: Akka ifii fedhan, qaama ifii irraahuu hin argatani
meaning_om: Namni qaama ofiituu akka fedhetti to'achuu yookaan guutuu godhachuu osoo hin danda'in, wanti hunduu akka fedha isaatti akka ta'u eeguun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: Even one's own physical body does not obey all of one's wishes; one cannot expect life, people, or external events to conform flawlessly to one's desires

proverb: Niitiin dhiirsi irraa du'e, niitii nama hafeeti
meaning_om: Aadaa dhaala keessatti dubartiin dhiirsi irraa du'e maatii keessaa akka hin baane fira dhiigaa kan hafeen wajjin bultii itti fufti; eegumsa maatii agarsiisa
meaning_en: A widow belongs to the surviving brother or kin in levirate custom; reflects traditional clan solidarity ensuring widows and orphans remain protected

proverb: Balaa yaabbachuutu nama dhiba, yaabbatan gubbaan bal'oo dha
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan qorumsa cimaa tokko jalqabanii itti seenuun ulfaataa ta'us, erga dhimma sana mo'atanii booda boqonnaa fi bal'inni akka jiru agarsiisa
meaning_en: Initiating or ascending a daunting challenge is the hardest part; once you summit and conquer it, the plateau at the top is wide and full of relief

proverb: Balaa samii buute, daachiin hin dadhabne
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi qorumsa guddaa uumaan nama irratti fide obsaan danda'uu fi baachuun akka danda'amu; dacheen akkuma roobaa fi bakakkaa dandamattu namnis ni danda'a
meaning_en: Whatever calamity descended from the skies, the earth was strong enough to absorb; human endurance can bear and absorb any trial ordained from above

proverb: Balaan biyyaa wajjii, balachuu dha
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi dhibee ummata hunda qaqqabe dhuunfaan osoo hin taane waloomaan waan baatamaniif salphaa fakkaata; gaddi waloomaa madaala nama hin dhowwu
meaning_en: A misfortune shared with the entire community feels like a feast; collective hardship is far easier to endure than isolated individual sorrow

proverb: Dhiiga dibatanii, tiiticha hin lagatani
meaning_om: Namni hojii rakkisaa fi xuraa'aa ta'e keessa seene miidhaa fi rakkina xixiqqoo hojii sana hordofee dhufu obsaan fudhachuu qaba malee hin nuffu
meaning_en: Having smeared yourself with blood, you cannot shun flies; when you enter a messy, dangerous enterprise, you must accept its natural consequences

proverb: Namni jiidhe, rooba hin sodaatu
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu dhiphina, hiyyummaa fi qorumsa hamaa keessa jiru balaa dabalataa hin sodaatu; wanta dhabu biraa hin qabu
meaning_en: A person who is already completely soaked does not fear the rain; someone who has hit rock bottom has lost all fear of further misfortune

proverb: Ittiin bulinaaf, sareen udaan nyaatti
meaning_om: Namni yeroo rakkoo fi beela hamaa keessa jiru lubbuu ofii tursiisuuf jecha wanta fokkisaa yookaan salphaa ta'e illee hojjechuuf dirqama
meaning_en: For the mere sake of surviving the night, a dog eats feces; extreme poverty and survival force a creature into humiliating compromises to stay alive

proverb: Kan ciqilee ifii hin dandeenye, kan jaartii soddaa hin dadhabu
meaning_om: Namni hanqina, qoccolloo fi dhibee fira ofii danda'ee hin obsin, dirqamaa fi safeeffannaa warra soddaa isa ulfaataa fi diduun hin danda'amne baachuuf dirqama; fira ofiitti obsuu dhabuun ba'aa ormaa jala nama galcha
meaning_en: One who lacks the patience to tolerate the minor friction or shortcomings of their own kin will inevitably be compelled to endure the far heavier, inescapable trials and strict demands of their in-laws; rejecting the faults of family leaves one at the mercy of unavoidable outside obligations

proverb: Haadha diinni saame, calle irraa kutatani
meaning_om: Namni balaan ormaa irra gahee dadhabe orma duratti qofa osoo hin taane, fira ofiitiinis ni saammama; dadhabaa irratti hunduu roorrisa
meaning_en: Plucking the beads from a mother already plundered by the enemy; opportunistically exploiting and looting a defenseless person devastated by calamity

proverb: Yoo qoricha tahe, udaan namaatiis numa nyaatani
meaning_om: Lubbuu oolchuuf yookaan fayyina argachuuf jecha wanta balfamaa fi jibbisiisaa ta'eyyuu akka furmaataatti fudhachuun dirqama; fayyaaf filannoon hin jiru
meaning_en: If it serves as healing medicine, one would even consume human feces; when survival and health are at stake, all revulsion and pride must be set aside

proverb: Waan barri kenne hin tuffatani
meaning_om: Carraa, qabeenya yookaan haala yeroon sun namaaf fidde xiqqoollee yoo taate tuffachuu dhiisanii galataan fudhachuu qabu; quufa barsiisa
meaning_en: One must not despise whatever portion the season or epoch provides; accept the modest harvest of the current time with gratitude and contentment

proverb: Najisa irraa hin fagaanne, ittuma sagadani
meaning_om: Xurii fi cubbuu ofirraa dhiqanii qulqullaa'uu dhiisanii, gocha qulqulluu fakkaatu raawwachuuf yaaluu; fakkeessummaa fi xuraa'ummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Failing to move away from the filth, they prostrated directly on it; performing holy rituals or pious acts while steeped in corruption and hypocrisy

proverb: Roobuus ganna, roobuu baatuus ganna
meaning_om: Haalli alaa jijjiiramus dhimmi bu'uuraa fi dhugaan jiru hin jijjiiramu; wanti tokko amala uumamaa isaatiin beekama malee jijjiirama yeroon hin badu
meaning_en: Whether it rains or fails to rain, the rainy season remains the rainy season; fundamental identity and reality remain unchanged by temporary anomalies

proverb: Dirqii irrattuu, aakhiraan warra
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi dirqama addunyaa kanarratti nama mudatu keessatti, dhumni nama hundaa du'a fi gara aakhiraatti deebi'uu ta'uu isaa amanuun of tasgabbeessuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Even in the face of bitter coercion and worldly hardship, the hereafter is our ultimate home; finding comfort in knowing that earthly oppression is transient

proverb: Mudattee, aayyoo bultee?
meaning_om: Yeroo rakkoon cimaan nama mudatetti, yaaddoo fi dhiphina keessa taa'anii wal gaafachuu; rakkina dhufe duratti wal jajjabeessuu ibsa
meaning_en: In the thick of an unavoidable crisis, asking 'Mother, did you survive the night?'; expressing solidarity and checking on loved ones during a calamity

proverb: Maal jeenna ree, jedhe abbaan warraa sa'a bachiisee
meaning_om: Itti-gaafatamummaa ofii dagachuudhaan qabeenya bu'uuraa maatii erga balleessanii booda, fala dhabee akka nama dhimmi hin ilaallanneetti 'maal jenna ree' jechuun qaanii fi dantaa dhablummaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Satirizes a negligent custodian or household head who, through sheer carelessness, loses the family's prized cow, and then sheepishly shrugs before his family asking 'What shall we say now?'; helpless hand-wringing after self-inflicted ruin

proverb: Soddaa soddoomuu hin oolle, harka fuudhuu hin laaffisin
meaning_om: Hariiroo hawaasummaa isa hin oolamne fi itti fufiinsa qabu keessatti yeroo hunda kabajaa fi safeeffannaa eeguun barbaachisaa dha
meaning_en: Since in-law ties are permanent and unavoidable, never slacken your respectful courtesies; maintain lifelong respect and honor in essential social bonds

proverb: Hamma jalaa hin baanetti gaaddisa
meaning_om: Wanta yookaan nama yeroof ta'us si gargaaraa jiru hanga jalaa hin baanetti akka waan gaariitti eeggachuu fi galateeffachuu qabda
meaning_en: As long as you remain beneath it, it serves as shade; appreciate and protect whatever shelter or benefactor you rely on until you are self-sufficient

proverb: "Laftiniis bayeessa" jette, jaartiin farda irraa kuftee
meaning_om: Kufaatii, salphina yookaan dadhabina ofii dhoksuuf jecha wanta hamaa mudate akka waan fedhii ofiitiin filatanitti fakkeessanii dubbachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'The ground is quite pleasant too,' said the old woman who fell from the horse; satirizes saving face and pretending an embarrassing failure was deliberate

proverb: Hoodhoon dhumnaan, quufeen dhufte
meaning_om: Keessummaan yookaan namni nyaata dhihaate hunda hanga qodaan qullaa'utti erga nyaatee booda, gaafa kennaan 'hoo/fudhadhu' dhumatu qofa 'quufeera' jedhee fakkeessuu fi qaanii dhokfachuun of jajuu qishnaan saaxila
meaning_en: Only when the generous offers of 'here, take this' (hoodhoo) were exhausted did the guest finally declare 'I am full' (quufe); satirizes consuming until everything is gone and only then putting on a show of polite refusal and modesty

proverb: Saqara dhaban, kocara amanfatan
meaning_om: Yeroo wanti gaariin fi qulqulluun dhabamu, wantuma argametti quufanii fi amanatanii ittiin jireenya geggeeffachuun dirqama ta'a
meaning_en: Lacking prime cuts, one relies on tough scraps; settling for inferior, coarse substitutes when the ideal and finest options are unavailable

proverb: Namni ibidda dhabe, daaratti fuula deebisa
meaning_om: Namni gargaarsa yookaan humna bu'uuraa dhabe wanta laafaa fi hambaa ta'e keessaa abdii barbaaddata; dhabamuu keessatti hambatti hirkachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A person without fire turns his face toward the ashes, searching for a spark; in desperation, one clings to the faint remnants of past warmth

proverb: Harka cabsuu dadhabde, dhungadhu
meaning_om: Humna yookaan diina dura dhaabbachuu fi injifachuu hin dandeenye wajjin nagaan jiraachuuf toftaa fi nagaa buusuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: Kiss the hand you cannot break; pragmatic diplomacy and survival dictate making peace with an overwhelming power you cannot defeat

proverb: Yoo humna qabaatan sagaliin lolani, yoo humna dhaban sagale tolani
meaning_om: Yeroo humna qaban mirga ofii humnan falmachuun ni danda'ama, garuu yoo humni dhabame dubbii laafaa fi nagaadhaan of oolchuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: When possessing strength, one fights with legions; when lacking strength, one softens their voice into diplomatic sweetness; adapting strategy to power

proverb: "Dhiirsuma haa tahuu, dinqaa haa qufa'u" jette, namittiin
meaning_om: Dhiirri manaa qabeenya yoo dhabeyyuu, argamni isaayyuu eegumsa, kabajaa fi sodaa ormaa ittisuuf gahaa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: 'Let him just be a husband, even if he only coughs in the inner chamber,' said the woman; having a husband provides vital social cover and presence

proverb: Haayaa dhaban, waan haayaa fakkaatu fuudhani
meaning_om: Wanta gaarii fi guutuu ta'e yoo dhaban, wantuma isa fakkaatuu fi dhihoo ta'e fudhatanii jireenya itti fufuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Lacking the genuinely noble or ideal, one takes what closely resembles it; when perfection is unavailable, settle gracefully for the nearest facsimile

proverb: Akka dhabduun, ilmoo gabraati guddifti
meaning_om: Namni wanta bu'uuraa dhabe dhiphina sana mo'achuuf wanta argamee fi salphaa ta'e akka qabeenya ofiitti kunuunsuuf dirqama
meaning_en: A childless woman raises the child of a bondservant as her own; deep lack compels a person to pour love and investment into whatever substitute exists

proverb: Namni ilma dhabe, intala taphsiisa
meaning_om: Wanta hawwan yoo dhaban wantuma qabanitti gammaduu fi galateeffachuun jireenya tasgabbeessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A person who lacks a son lavishes affection on his daughter; learning to appreciate, celebrate, and find joy in the blessings one has

proverb: Fardi hokkollaan, dhabaaf harree qabani
meaning_om: Yeroo meeshaan yookaan namni cimaan dhibame, dhimma ofii xumuruuf wantuma argametti dhimma bahuun dirqama ta'a
meaning_en: When the horse is lame, for want of better, one mounts a donkey; in the absence of prime tools, necessity obliges one to use modest substitutes

proverb: Dirqii irrattuu Abdoon damiina
meaning_om: Namni tokko yoo jaalatamees yoo jibbames, dirqama ta'us aangoo fi sadarkaan isaa beekamtii argachuu qaba
meaning_en: Even grudgingly, Abdo is still the chieftain; whether one likes it or not, de facto authority, status, and reality must be acknowledged

proverb: Farda seheetiin, harree irratti kooraa fi'adhe
meaning_om: Nama dandeettii fi naamus-qabeessa seetanii nama dandeettii hin qabneetti dhimma guddaa kennanii booda gaabbuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Mistaking it for a horse, I strapped my saddle onto a donkey; regretting a foolish error where one misjudged an incompetent person for a champion

proverb: Dhiirsa Tamboon huutetti, niitiin kofla duute
meaning_om: Yeroo dhiirri rakkoo fi dhiphina keessa jiru haati manaa gargaaruu dhiistee itti qishnaa gochuu fi tuffachuu ceepha'a
