meaning_en: While the husband was choking on tobacco smoke, the wife died laughing; satirizes an unfeeling, spiteful spouse who finds amusement in distress

proverb: Jaarsa lubbuuf seequ, ijoolleen kan koflu seeti
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi gidiraa cimaa nama guddarra jiru ijoolleen yookaan namoonni dammaqina hin qabne akka taphaatti ilaaluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: An old man grimacing in agony for his dying breath, children mistake for smiling; critiques naive observers who mistake mortal agony for amusement

proverb: Nama Izraa'il Du'aa arihu Jaarsoon waa dhiiraa jettee faarsiti
meaning_om: Namni balaa fi du'a jalaa lubbuu baafachuuf fiigu tokko, namoonni dhimma isaa hin beekne akka waan gootummaan fiiguutti faarsuun gowwummaadha
meaning_en: A man desperately fleeing the Angel of Death is praised by naive onlookers as a dashing hero; outside observers mistake desperate flight for bold heroism

proverb: Gabricha lubbuu kaatu, ormi jabeenya jaja
meaning_om: Namni rakkinaa fi dhiphina keessa jiru lubbuu ofii oolchuuf yeroo dhama'u, ormi garuu dhiphina isaa osoo hin hubatin akka jabinnaatti faarsa
meaning_en: A servant running in terror to save his life, yet spectators applaud his endurance; outsiders admire the speed of someone running in mortal agony

proverb: Takka dhuufuun Dhiirummaa, lama dhuufuun Harrummaa dha
meaning_om: Dogoggora yeroo tokko hojjechuun uumama namaa ta'us, dogoggora sanatti irra deddeebi'anii itti fufuun qaanii fi amala bineensummaa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Slipping or making an embarrassing blunder once is human and excusable, but repeating it shamelessly is donkey behavior; errors must not become habits

proverb: Galataan guddisa je'eeti korbeessi haadha kora
meaning_om: Tola-oolmaa fi guddina maatiif galata deebisuu mannaa, wanta safuu cabsuu fi fokkisaa ta'een maatii ofii salphisuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: 'I will repay her with gratitude,' said the billy goat, and mounted his own mother; biting satire on monstrous ingratitude that repays love with dishonor

proverb: Si akeekkadhe yaa gabaa biyyaa teenyaa, Korbeessa Jetteeti goromtii natti gugurte
meaning_om: Daldala, marii yookaan hariiroo keessatti gowwoomsaan fi sobni jiraachuu isaa hubatanii eeggannoo cimaa gochuu barsiisa
meaning_en: 'I have seen through you, local market: calling it a he-goat, you sold me a female kid'; learning from experience to see through fraud and false advertising

proverb: Nama takka gufateen eeggadhu ja'ani, kan lama gufateen amala isaati ja'ani
meaning_om: Dogoggorri jalqabaa akka tasaatti ilaalamus, namni yeroo lammataaf dogoggora walfakkaataa raawwate akka amala fi dhibaa'ummaa isaatti lakkaa'ama
meaning_en: One who stumbles once is told to take care; one who stumbles twice is told it is his innate character; a repeated mistake defines an ingrained defect

proverb: Bosonni dhiiraa, lama hin gubatu
meaning_om: Namni jabaa fi beekaan balaa yookaan gowwoomsaa yeroo tokko isa mudaterraa barata malee, lammata bakka sanatti hin miidhamu
meaning_en: The forest of a real man does not burn twice; a resolute and intelligent person learns thoroughly from past misfortune and never falls into the same trap

proverb: Tan oolte irra, tan bulte haa caaltuu
meaning_om: Wanta darberratti gaddaa hafuu dhiisanii, jireenyi, carraanii fi nagaan bor dhufu isa har'aa fi kaleessaa caalaa akka tolu hawwuu fi eebbisuu ibsa
meaning_en: May tomorrow surpass what has already passed; an auspicious traditional blessing wishing that the future brings greater fortune and peace than the past

proverb: Gowwaan maaliif iyyita jennaaniin, jawweetu narra bahe je'e; duuba eega kutte maalif iyyita jennaan, akka lammada narra hin kunneefi je'e
meaning_om: Balaan erga darbee booda iyyanii fi wacaniin bu'aan akka hin jirre; gowwaan yeroo eeggannoo gochuu qabu dhiisee yeroo wanti darbe waca bu'aa hin qabne kaasa
meaning_en: Asked why he screams, the fool blamed a crawling python; asked why scream after it passed, he said 'So it doesn't cross again!'; mocks futile panic after danger is gone

proverb: Niin beeka jedheeti namichi saree kolaasee ajjeese
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii fi beekumsa gahaa hin qabne beekaa of fakkeessuun hojii keessa seenee wanta balleessuu hin qabne barbadeessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'I know how it's done,' said the man, and castrated the dog to death; satirizes overconfident meddlers who claim expertise in tasks they ruin catastrophically

proverb: Miila lama kufe, sadeessaan naafa
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu kufaatii fi kasaaraa walitti aaneen miidhamee jiru tokko carraa dhumaa irrattis dadhabee guutummaatti akka hin dandamannetti naafachuu ibsa
meaning_en: He stumbled on two legs, and on the third he is completely crippled; cascading, successive failures that leave a person totally incapacitated and broken

proverb: Bofni boolla takkatti yeroo lama nama hin ciniinu
meaning_om: Namni dammaqaan balaa yookaan gowwoomsaa yeroo tokko isa mudaterraa baratee of eeggata malee, iddooma tokkotti lammata hin gowwoomu
meaning_en: A snake does not bite a wise person twice from the same hole; an alert, prudent person learns immediately from danger and never falls into the same trap

proverb: Ija baduu deemtu, ormi jabdu seeha
meaning_om: Wanti yookaan namni kufaatii fi manca'iinsa dhumaa dura dhihaate yeroof humnaa fi dammaqina sobaa mul'isuun orma gowwoomsa
meaning_en: An eye on the verge of blindness looks intensely bright to outsiders; a collapsing entity often exhibits a brief, deceptive flare of vitality right before ruin

proverb: Gurri dabarsaan, olla walitti naqa
meaning_om: Namni odeessaa fi hasasa gurraan dhaga'e bakka bakkatti deddeebisee odeessu nagaa hawaasaa fi ollaa diigee wal-dhabdee uuma
meaning_en: An ear that carries tales and gossip sets neighbors at each other's throats; tale-bearing and spreading hearsay destroys community harmony and ignites strife

proverb: Guddaa salphaa, Fardi galgala bada
meaning_om: Qabeenyi guddaan fi gati-jabeessi tokko dantaa dhablummaa fi of-dagannoo salphaatiin yeroo murteessaa keessatti jalaa badee nama hongaasa
meaning_en: A major asset lost through casual negligence: the prized horse gets lost at nightfall; grave consequences result from late-hour carelessness

proverb: Dubartii seheetiin Qeeyransa fide
meaning_om: Nama amala gaarii fi tasgabbii qabu sehanii bultii keessatti nama aari-qabeessa, lolaa fi hamtuu ta'e wajjin wal arguun balaa ofitti fiduu ibsa
meaning_en: Thinking I was marrying an agreeable woman, I brought home a leopard; satirizes discovering that an ostensibly gentle bride is ferocious and aggressive

proverb: Namni aalaa nyaatu, haatee duute jennaan kofle
meaning_om: Namni bolola nyaataatiin qabame gadda maatii isaayyuu akka carraa nyaata argachuutti ilaalee gammada; bolola daangaa darbe balaaleffata
meaning_en: The glutton who feasts on offal laughed upon hearing his mother died; condemns monstrous insensitivity where someone rejoices at family tragedy because it offers a feast

proverb: Re'een gamanaa, furguggeen gamasi
meaning_om: Wanta walitti dhiheenya hin qabne walitti fiduu; akkasumas tarkaanfii fageenyarraa bu'aa malee darbatamu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The target goat is on near side while the club is hurled from across the river; attempting an action from an ineffective distance where effort cannot reach

proverb: Yoo ambaatii Gabrichaatu loqoda, yoo gabrichaatii, ambaatu loqoda
meaning_om: Namoonni yeroo dhimmi isaanii hin taane ormarratti oduu fi qeeqa baay'isu; namni hundi dhimma nama biraa irratti afaan banata
meaning_en: When it involves an outsider, the servant gossips; when it involves the servant, the outsider gossips; people eagerly meddle and chatter about others' business

proverb: Gowwaan nyaataa yaamnaan, kan ergaa yaaman sehee hafe
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne carraa fi tola-oolmaa isaaf qophaa'e akka waan miidhaatti yaadee of jalaa balleessa; carraatti fayyadamuu dadhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: Called to a feast, the fool assumed he was being summoned for hard chores and stayed home; suspicious fools miss out on golden opportunities through ignorance

proverb: "Hamashannee hamashadhaa, Namaan hin jettanii" je'e Jaarsi mirqaanaan wadaaja dubartii keessa seene
meaning_om: Namni mirqaana yookaan dhiphinaan qalbii dhabe tokko dogoggora mataa isaatii arguun dhibee, akkuma jaarsa wadaaja dubartootaa seenee dubartoota argee dhiiroota sehee 'maaliif akka keessanitti na hin hamashisiifne' jedhee komateetti, dogoggora ofii dhiisee orma komachuu fi burjaaja'uu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: Satirizes comical disorientation and jumping to absurd conclusions; an elder, disoriented by khat euphoria (mirqaana), wanders by mistake into the women's quarters of a prayer assembly (wadaaja), mistakes the scarf-wearing women for men who put on headscarves (hamasha) without telling him, and hilariously scolds them for not inviting him to wear one too

proverb: Waraabeessa kijiba hokkolu, wallaalaan dhugaa seeha
meaning_om: Diinni yookaan namni mala-ammayyaa ta'e akka waan dadhabaatti of fakkeesse yoo dhufe, gowwaan amanee itti dhihaata; shira dhokataa dammaquu dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A hyena limping deceitfully to ambush prey, the fool assumes is genuinely crippled; warns against falling for feigned weakness displayed by predators

proverb: Gabrittiin gaafa Arafaa bitamte, Guyyuu arafaa dha seeti
meaning_om: Namni yeroo gaarii fi carraa tasaa tokkoon jireenya haaraa eegale, haalli gaariin sun yeroo hundumaa akkuma sanatti itti fufa jedhee yaaduu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A maidservant bought on the festival of Arafah assumes every day is a holiday feast; naively expecting an exceptional luxury to be the daily normal

proverb: Badii awwalaa dubra ta'e, badii lammadaa dubra da'e
meaning_om: Aadaa durii keessatti dubartummaan akka ba'aa fi dhiphinaatti laalamaa ture; dhibee fi roorroo jireenyaa durboonni qabaatan ibsa
meaning_en: Historical folk reflection on the burdens and vulnerabilities placed upon women in traditional agrarian society, lamenting enduring gender hardships

proverb: Dhalaa gurri tokko
meaning_om: Dubartoonni waan tokko yeroo dhaga'an gara tokkotti qofa xiyyeeffatu yookaan qalbii laafina qabu jedhanii ilaalcha aadaa ganamaatiin dubbatu
meaning_en: Traditional adage claiming a woman has a single ear; culturally signifies being single-minded, deeply receptive to immediate influence, or steadfast

proverb: Dhalaan diina gurraacha
meaning_om: Dubartiin mana keessatti dhiirsa wajjin yoo jiraatteyyuu iccitii fi qabeenya dhiirsaa baruudhaan yeroo mufatte miidhaa geessisuu dandeessi jechuun akeekkachiisu
meaning_en: Traditional folk warning cautioning men against revealing strategic secrets to wives who might turn those vulnerabilities against them during discord

proverb: Dubartiin nama dhiiyseef dhiiydi
meaning_om: Aadaa keessatti jaalallii fi amanamummaan dubartii inni dhugaan dhiirsa duraa isa dubrummaa ishee fudhate (isa dhiigse) wajjin akka hidhamu agarsiisa; namni dhiiga ishee arge jaalala fi aarsaa ishee isa dhumaa argata
meaning_en: Culturally refers to the enduring bond of virginity and first marriage: a woman reserves her deepest, lifelong loyalty and devotion for the first husband who took her virginity (the one who made her bleed); she will bleed and sacrifice only for the one who first drew her blood

proverb: Beekkomsi dubartii booroo hin bahu
meaning_om: Ilaalcha aadaa durii isa beekumsi fi dandeettiin dubartootaa dhimma mana keessaa fi qe'ee qofarratti kan daangeffame ta'uu amanu calaqqisa
meaning_en: Traditional patriarchal saying reflecting the historical confinement of women's wisdom and expertise to domestic quarters rather than public assemblies

proverb: Dubartiin dubbii hin tolchituu, soora tolchiti
meaning_om: Aadaa durii keessatti gaheen dubartootaa soorata qulqullinaan qopheessuu yoo ta'u, koraa fi jaarsummaa dubbii fala kennuu garuu dhiiraaf dhiifamuu ibsa
meaning_en: Traditional division of labor asserting that while women excel in culinary care and domestic sustenance, public council debate belongs to men

proverb: Warra jechuun nadhoodha
meaning_om: Haati manaa utubaa fi bu'uura maatiiti; haati manaa yoo hin jirre manni hin dhaabbatu, maatiin hin jiraatu; ulfina guddaa dubartiif kenna
meaning_en: The true cornerstone of a household is the woman; without a woman, there is no home or family; elevates women as the indispensable heart of domestic life

proverb: Guddattullee, dubartiin masgiida hin seentu
meaning_om: Sadarkaa fi umuriin hangam yoo dabalateyyuu, aadaa fi seera amantii keessatti daangaa fi heeyyamni dubartootaa kan murtaa'e ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: No matter how senior she becomes, traditional religious customs and rules define specific boundaries regarding female clerical leadership in sacred spaces

proverb: Qalbiin nadhoo takka, takkittiin sunuu dhungatan ni baddi
meaning_om: Dubartoonni jaalala, mi'eessituu haasaa fi dhungoodhaan salphaatti amantee fi qalbii kennatu jedhamee qishnaan mammaakama
meaning_en: Folk proverb stating that a woman possesses a delicate heart that completely melts when kissed; satirizes female susceptibility to courtship and flattery

proverb: Dubartiin, hamma harmi rarra'u takka, qalbiin rarraati
meaning_om: Dubartoonni yeroo baay'ee yaaddoo, naasuu fi miira laafinaatiin qabamu; qalbii tasgabbaa'aa qabaachuu mannaa yaaddoo maatiitiin rarra'anii dhiphatu
meaning_en: A woman's emotions remain perpetually anxious and suspended; traditional observation on maternal worry and deep emotional vulnerability

proverb: Dubartiin, cinaacha bitaa irraa waan uumamteef, dubbiin isii irruu dha
meaning_om: Aadaa durii keessatti amantii uumamaa irratti hirkachuudhaan dubartoonni yaada fi dubbii madaalawaa hin qaban jedhanii amanuu ibsa
meaning_en: Traditional folk saying drawing from the rib creation narrative, claiming that a woman's logic is curved and deficient compared to male discourse

proverb: Dhalaa fi qottoon tan qara qabduutu gaarii dha
meaning_om: Akkuma qottoon qara qabdu hojiif gaarii taate, dubartiin qaxalee, dammaqxuu fi qalbii qabdus bultii fi jireenyaaf baay'ee murteessituudha
meaning_en: Among axes and women, the sharp one is best; just as a sharp axe cuts cleanly, an astute, intelligent woman manages and elevates the home with excellence

proverb: Dubartiin nama hin bulchituu, dhiiraatu nama bulcha
meaning_om: Aadaa fi sirna ganamaa keessatti hoggansi ummataa fi biyyaa kan dhiiraa akka ta'e, dubartoonni bulchiinsa alaa keessatti qooda hin qaban jedhanii amanuu ibsa
meaning_en: In traditional customary governance, political leadership and public rule were reserved for men, reflecting historical patriarchal views on governance

proverb: Dhadhaan dhadhaa hin caaluu, nadhoon wal hin dhaaltu
meaning_om: Akkuma gosti dhadhaa hunduu walfakkaatu, dubartoonnis aadaa keessatti mirga dhaaltummaa walirraa hin qaban; seera dhaala ganamaa ibsa
meaning_en: Just as one batch of butter is equivalent to another, women traditionally did not inherit property from one another; reflects customary inheritance rules

proverb: Raabsaan raabsaa hin caaltuu, nadhoon wal hin caaltu
meaning_om: Dubartoonni marti gahee qixxee qabu, tokko kan biraa caalteetti of tuuluu hin qabdu; hawaasa keessatti walqixxummaa dubartootaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: One food server is no greater than another; women stand on equal footing with one another without inherent superiority among peers

proverb: Dubartiin lama hin beeytu, takka hin wallaaltu
meaning_om: Dubartiin dhimma tokkorratti xiyyeeffannaa cimaa kan qabdu ta'us, dhimmoota hedduu walxaxaa ta'an al tokkotti madaaluun itti ulfaata jedhanii amanu
meaning_en: A woman may not know multiple complex political matters at once, but she never fails to know the one core domestic truth; singular domestic focus

proverb: Dubraa fi gundoon xiqqoo hin qabdu
meaning_om: Gundoon hangamiyyuu xiqqoo yoo taate wanta qabattu hin dhabdu; dubarris umuriin yoo xiqqooyyuu taate itti-gaafatamummaa bultii fi kabaja qabdi
meaning_en: Neither a woven basket nor a maiden is ever truly small; even a small basket holds grain, and even a young girl carries the full capacity for womanhood

proverb: Dubartiin xiqqoo hin qabdu
meaning_om: Dubartiin umuriin yookaan qaamaan yoo xiqqoollee taate, kabajaa fi gahee maatii keessatti qabduun akka nama guddaatti ilaalamti malee hin tuffatamtu
meaning_en: A woman is never small or negligible; regardless of youth or physical stature, every female embodies the full dignity, power, and potential of womanhood

proverb: Dubartii fi udaan xiqqaa hin qaban
meaning_om: Akkuma xuriin xiqqoon iddoo hunda xureessuu dandeessu, dubartiinis xiqqoo yoo taateyyuu dhiibbaa fi sagalee guddaa qabdi; tuffatamuu hin qabdu
meaning_en: Neither waste nor a woman can be dismissed as negligible; just as the smallest stain alters everything, a woman's influence is never minor or ignorable

proverb: Ibiddi nadhoon qabsiifte hin dhaamu
meaning_om: Lolli, aariin yookaan falmiin dubartiin gidduu seentee kakaafte dafee hin dhaamu; akkasumas jaalallii fi eegumsi dubartii mana keessatti hin badu
meaning_en: A fire kindled by a woman does not easily extinguish; domestic feuds or passions stirred by women burn deeply, just as the home hearth she tends endures

proverb: Nadhoon joollummaa hin qabdu
meaning_om: Intalli akkuma dhalatteen daftee hojii manaa fi itti-gaafatamummaa haadhummaatiif qophoofti; daftee gara bilchinaatti ceeti
meaning_en: A female child has no prolonged childhood; from an early age, girls take on domestic responsibility and caretaking, transitioning rapidly into adulthood

proverb: Kakuun dubartii amalaa, beekaan kana beekeeti gurra keessa kabala
meaning_om: Aadaa durii keessatti dubartoonni yeroo aaran kakuu salphaatti waan seenaniif, dhiirri beekaan kakuu sanatti hin dhiphatu garuu adabaan qajeelcha jedhanii yaadu
meaning_en: Traditional patriarchal saying asserting that emotional oaths taken in marital anger lack permanence and require firm domestic discipline

proverb: Dubartiin Keessummaa hin qabdu
meaning_om: Keessummaan mana dhufu kan abbaa manaati malee kan dubartii qofaa miti; keessummeessuun kan abbaa warrati jedhanii safeeffannaadhaan dubbatu
meaning_en: In traditional protocol, visitors are received as guests of the household head rather than the woman alone; hospitality is collective under the family head

proverb: Bakka dubartiin hin jirre, diggisiin hin tolu
meaning_om: Qophiin, cidhnii fi gammachuun kamiinuu bareedina, soorata mi'aawaa fi ilillee dubartootaa malee mi'aa hin qabu; dubartiin burqaa gammachuuti
meaning_en: Where there are no women, a feast lacks warmth and joy; without women's culinary mastery, singing, and welcoming presence, celebrations are sterile

proverb: Udaan handaaqqoo fi dubbiin dubartii buburree hin dhabu
meaning_om: Akkuma udaan lukkuu bifa garaagaraa qabu, haasaan dubartootaas yeroo tokko tokko jijjiiramaa fi iftoomina dhabuu danda'a jedhanii qishnaan ibsu
meaning_en: Chicken droppings and women's talk are never without variegated speckles; folk satire claiming that women's speech is nuanced, shifting, and indirect

proverb: Mootummaan dubartii, karra cufaa oolcha
meaning_om: Hoggansi sodaa fi of eeggannoo daangaa darbeen guutame tarkaanfii fudhachuu dhowwee hojii fi guddina uggura; murannoo dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The governance of a woman leaves the cattle-pen gate closed all day; traditional critique alleging that overcautious leadership paralyzes enterprise

proverb: Mootummaan dubartii, bishaan ol yaafti
meaning_om: Hoggansi uumamaa fi seera ganamaatiin ala ta'e haala hin taane fi wanta hin danda'amne uumee jeequmsa fida jedhanii amanuu ibsa
meaning_en: The rule of a woman makes water flow uphill; a traditional patriarchal hyperbole claiming that placing women in political command defies the natural order

proverb: Manni dansa jechuun, yoo haadha qabaate qofa
meaning_om: Manni qabeenyaan yoo guutameyyuu haati manaa yoo keessa hin jirre nagaa fi qabbana hin qabu; manni kan bareedu haadhaani
meaning_en: A house is only truly pleasant and good if it has a mother; no amount of material wealth makes a home truly blessed without the warmth of a mother

proverb: Wanti dhiirti tolchite, takkaa hin tolle
meaning_om: Hojiin mana keessaa fi kunuunsi maatii kan dubartootaa waan ta'eef, dhiirri yoo itti seene qulqullinaa fi mi'aa dhabee manca'a; dandeettii dubartootaa faarsa
meaning_en: What men prepare alone never turns out right; celebrates women's domestic mastery, teasing men that when they attempt cooking alone, it ends in clumsy disaster

proverb: Intalti dubraa siree qaraatii, waan niin qaba ja'anii abdatan hin qabdu
meaning_om: Akkuma sireen hundee bishingaarraa (qaraarraa) tolfamte laaftuu fi yeroo gabaabaa qofa turtee dhumattu, intalli dubraas guddannaan heerumtee gara mana dhiirsaatti waan deemtuuf qabeenya dhaabbataa mana abbaatti hafu miti; heerumtee deemuu ishee agarsiisa
meaning_en: Just as a bed constructed from lightweight sorghum roots/stalks (siree qaraa) is fragile, temporary, and lacks durability, an unmarried maiden is not a permanent domestic fixture in her parents' home, for she will inevitably marry and depart for her husband's clan

proverb: Handhura intalaa alatti awwaalan, tan gurbaa mana keessatti awwaalan
meaning_om: Aadaa ganamaa keessatti gurbaan dhaaltuu fi eegduu mana abbaa yoo ta'u, intalli garuu heerumtee qe'ee ormaa akka ijaartu sirnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: The umbilical cord of a daughter is buried outside, while that of a son is buried inside; symbolizes that sons anchor the homestead while daughters marry out

proverb: Jette, jettee nadhoo, balbala booni
meaning_om: Oduu, hasasaa fi 'jette-jettee' ormaa isa nagaa nama dhowwu jalaa of baraarsuuf, manni ofii balbala cufamu qabaachuun qananii fi dahoo guddaa ta'uu ibsa; nagaa fi iccitii manaa eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: When endless neighborhood rumors and 'she said, she said' gossip swirl outside, take pride that you have a solid door to shut them out; emphasizes the immense dignity, peace, and sanctuary of domestic privacy against outside intrusions

proverb: Taa'uu mannaa, dubra dhalchuu wayya
meaning_om: Wanta tokkollee dhabuu yookaan qullaa taa'uurra, wantuma xiqqoo yookaan isa tuffatamu illee argachuutu caala; dhabuurra xiqqoon wayya
meaning_en: Rather than remaining entirely childless or idle, having a daughter is better; possessing something modest is far better than suffering complete lack

proverb: Dubartiin beeka dhalti malee, waan beektu hin qabdu
meaning_om: Aadaa durii isa gahee dubartootaa dhalchuu qofatti daangessee beekumsa isaanii tuffachaa ture calaqqisa
meaning_en: Traditional patriarchal saying claiming that while a woman mothered great leaders, she lacked wisdom herself; reflects historical devaluation of women's intellect

proverb: Biyyeen, namaaf galata hin qabdu
meaning_om: Namni umrii isaa guutuu dacheerra jiraatee, misoomsee, jaareeyyuu, dhuma irratti biyyeen nama liqimsitee awwaalti malee galata hin qabdu
meaning_en: The earth has no gratitude for man; no matter how much a person toils, builds, and cultivates the soil, in the end the earth swallows and buries them without thanks

proverb: Qorichi du'aa, du'a
meaning_om: Duuti dhibee qorichi biraa hin jirre waan ta'eef, furmaanni isaa isa dhumaa du'a fudhatanii boqochuu qofa; duuti hin oolamu
meaning_en: The only cure for death is death itself; mortality has no earthly remedy or escape; death is an absolute certainty that can only be resolved by passing through it

proverb: Kan du'uuf eegani, kan du'u hin beekani
meaning_om: Namni dhukkubsatee du'aaf eegamu jiraatee, inni fayyaa fakkaatu tasa du'uu danda'a; ajalli fi yeroon du'aa harka Waaqayyoo qofa jira
meaning_en: Among those expected to die, one never knows who truly dies first; an ailing person may survive while a healthy youth dies suddenly; death is unpredictable

proverb: Keessummaan keessa hin beeytuu, duuti keessa hin laallattu
meaning_om: Akkuma keessummaan rakkoo manaa hin beekne, duutis namni qophaa'eera moo hin qophoofne osoo hin laalin tasa dhufti; duuti eeyyama hin gaafattu
meaning_en: A guest knows nothing of domestic distress, and death never checks if one is ready; death strikes without warning, indifferent to financial plight or unfinished tasks

proverb: Du'aan wal hin dhaalani
meaning_om: Duuti dhimma dhuunfaati; namni tokko nama biraatiif jedhee du'uu yookaan ajala ormaa baachuu hin danda'u; duuti dhuunfaan nama mudatti
meaning_en: Through death people cannot substitute for one another; death is strictly an individual journey, and no one can die in another's stead or inherit another's mortality

proverb: Du'aa mormi muka
meaning_om: Namni du'e erga lubbuun keessaa baatee deebii kennuu, morkachuu fi ofirraa ittisuu hin danda'u; wanti dhumate hunduu jabinna dhaba
meaning_en: The neck of a dead person is as stiff and unresponsive as wood; once life departs, resistance, defense, and human agency are entirely extinguished

proverb: Hiriyaa ifii, kan ajjeesu hin jaalatani, kan du'uus hin jaalatani
meaning_om: Hiriyaa ofiitiif badii fi salphinni kamiinuu akka hin geenye hawwuu; ajjeesee yoo adabamus ta'ee du'ee yoo dhabamus gadda guddaadha
meaning_en: For one's friend, one desires neither that he become a killer nor that he be killed; an ethical dilemma wishing to spare loved ones from both crime and victimhood

proverb: Kan sodaatan du'a, kan hin oollees isuma
meaning_om: Namni hundi du'a sodaatee baqachuuf yaalus, duuti wanta hin oolle fi dhuma irratti hundumaa eeggatuudha; sodaan du'a jalaa nama hin oolchu
meaning_en: What people fear most is death, yet what is most absolutely certain and unavoidable is also death; paradoxical human anxiety over life's only certainty

proverb: Lubbuun dhaloota hin oolin, du'a hin ooltu
meaning_om: Lubbuun dacheerra dhalattee uumamte hundi dhuma irratti du'uu qabdi; dhalachuun qofti du'aaf wabii ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: A soul that could not escape being born will never escape dying; the very fact of entry into biological life carries the absolute inevitability of departure

proverb: Fagoon, bakkuma irraa hin galle
meaning_om: Fageenyi dhugaan fageenya lafaa osoo hin taane, du'a isa namni deebi'ee hin galleedha; namni lubbuun jiru fagoodhaas ni deebi'a
meaning_en: The only truly distant place is the place from which no one ever returns; so long as a traveler is alive, no geographic distance is insurmountable

proverb: Lubbuu lubbuun dhufte, qaroon hin hidhu
meaning_om: Yeroon du'aa yoo gahe, beekumsi, qarummaan fi toftaan namaa kamiinuu lubbuu baqachuu hin danda'u; ajala uumaatu murteessa
meaning_en: When death comes for a soul, no cleverness, wisdom, or binding charms can restrain it; mortal human ingenuity is powerless against divine decree

proverb: Muka lubbuu, lubbuuf hin hanqatanii, lubbuun jalaa hin bahani
meaning_om: Jireenya keessatti wanti lubbuuf barbaachisu hundi yoo guutameyyuu, du'a jalaa miliquun hin danda'amu; qabeenyi lubbuu hin oolchu
meaning_en: For the tree of life, resources may not be lacking for survival, yet life can never escape its final felling; earthly provisions cannot buy exemption from death

proverb: Lubbuu abbaa warraatiif dhufte, garbichaan hin bitani
meaning_om: Duuti murtii dhuunfaati; yeroon ajala nama tokkoo yoo gahe, qabeenyaan yookaan nama biraa bakka buusuun lubbuu oolchuun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: Death that arrives for the master of the house cannot be bought off by offering a servant; death takes its designated soul without accepting substitutes

proverb: Yaa du'a, yaa dulluma, wanti hamtuun isinuma
meaning_om: Jireenya namaa keessatti wanti akka dullumaa humna nama dhabsiisuu fi akka du'aa lubbuu galaafatu wanti hamaan hin jiru
meaning_en: Oh death, oh old age, the most terrible afflictions are indeed you two!; laments the physical degradation of aging and the finality of death as ultimate trials

proverb: Achi na qabi, as na qabiin, du'a nama hin oolchitu
meaning_om: Dhukkubni cimaan yeroo qabee fi ajalli yeroo gahe tattaaffiin fi kunuunsi namaa du'a jalaa nama hin oolchu; wanta hin oolle danda'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Saying 'Support me here, hold me there' cannot save a dying person; when the appointed hour strikes, no amount of physical propping can ward off mortality

proverb: Waywaanni, du'a nama hin oolchine
meaning_om: Booyichii fi iyyi gaddaa nama du'e hin deebisu, du'as hin dhowwu; gadda keessatti obsaa fi tasgabbii qabaachuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Loud weeping and wailing have never saved anyone from death; grieving and tears, however heartfelt, cannot reverse mortality or stay the hand of fate

proverb: Namni du'e baala kufe
meaning_om: Akkuma baalli muka irraa harca'ee biyyeetti makamu, namni du'es addunyaa kanarraa dhabamee hafe; jireenyi namaa akka baala harca'uuti
meaning_en: A deceased person is a fallen leaf; human life is as transient and fragile as a tree's leaf that withers, detaches, and returns quietly to the soil

proverb: "Siqee dhufe" jette, jaartiin, bakakkaan mana bukkeetti buunaan
meaning_om: Balaan yookaan duuti yeroo dhihoo namaatti qaqqabu, itti aansee isa ofii mudachuu akka danda'u dammaquu fi qophaa'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'It has crept closer,' said the old woman when lightning struck next to the house; recognizing that when disaster strikes a near neighbor, one's own turn is near

proverb: Qurcii, akka duutetti awwaalan
meaning_om: Namni rakkina yookaan dhibee addaa qabu sirna idileetiin osoo hin taane akkuma haala isaatti tajaajilama; haala qabatamaa irratti hundaa'anii murtii kennuu ibsa
meaning_en: A leper is buried just as he died without customary handling; handling an exceptional or contagious crisis requires adapting strict tradition to practical reality

proverb: Natti hin akeekiniin, du'a nama hin oolchu
meaning_om: Sodaa fi dhiphinni akkasumas komachuun qofti balaa dhufu jalaa nama hin oolchu; wanta hin oolle ittisuuf gocha qabatamaa barbaada
meaning_en: Pleading 'Do not aim at me!' does not save someone from death; crying out or complaining in the face of mortal peril cannot stop fate without real action

proverb: Jaarsaa fi moorri, du'a hima
meaning_om: Muuxannoon maanguddootaa fi mallattooleen uumamaa wanta hamaa gara fuulduraatti dhufu dursee beekuu akka danda'u agarsiisa; dur-argummaa ibsa
meaning_en: The seasoned elder and animal-fat divination foretell death; ancient experience and traditional omens accurately foreshadow coming mortality and crisis

proverb: "Kan du'e sodaa hin qabu" jette niitiin leenca morma huutee
meaning_om: Namni wanta hunda dhabe yookaan du'a jala gahe sodaa homaayyuu hin qabu; ija-jabinni dhugaan yeroo abdii kutannaatti mul'ata
meaning_en: 'The dead has nothing to fear,' said the woman seizing a lion by the throat; one who has already faced total ruin fights with desperate, fearless fury

proverb: Hamaan du'a jette dinkiin
meaning_om: Gabaabbina qaamaa yookaan hanqina uumamaa danda'uun ni danda'ama, wanti hunda caalaa hamaa fi furmaata hin qabne garuu du'a qofa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: 'The only truly terrible thing is death,' said the dwarf; physical handicaps or stigmas are manageable; death alone is the irreversible misfortune

proverb: Kufan malee hin caphan, biyya lafaatti (adunyaa irratti) hin hafan
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi qorumsa malee jireenyi hin jiru; akkasumas namni hunduu dhuma irratti dachee kanarraa darbuun isaa hin oolu
meaning_en: Unless one falls, one cannot break, but no one stays on this earth forever; hardships are natural to life, and all mortals must eventually depart

proverb: Gaarummaan, du'a nama hin oolchu
meaning_om: Namni hangamiyyuu arjaa, qulqulluu fi gaarii yoo ta'e duuti nama gaariis ta'ee isa hamaa hin dhiiftu; duuti hundaaf walqixa
meaning_en: Moral goodness and virtue cannot shield a person from death; mortality is strictly impartial and strikes the saintly and the wicked alike

proverb: Namni ija takkaa, namni niitii takkaa, takkuma du'a
meaning_om: Wanta qaban tokkicha irratti hirkachuun balaaf nama saaxila; akkuma ijji takkittiin yoo badde namni jaamu, haati manaa yoo duute bultiin abbaa manaa ni jeeqama
meaning_en: A one-eyed person and a man with a single wife die with a single stroke; relying on a sole support leaves one vulnerable to collapse if it fails

proverb: Dhukkubni deddebi'u hin fayyu
meaning_om: Rakkoon yookaan dhukkubni yeroo hundumaa deebi'ee nama qabu hundee qaba waan ta'eef dhuma irratti badiisa fida; eeggannoo cimaa barbaachisa
meaning_en: A disease that constantly relapses never truly heals; chronic, recurring crises point to an incurable underlying rot that will eventually prove fatal

proverb: Kanniisni, ifirratti qaban malee, nama hin ciniinu
meaning_om: Namni nagaa fi amala gaarii qabu osoo hin tuqamin nama hin miidhu; miidhaan kan dhufu yeroo namni sun tuttuqamee fi aarfame qofaadha
meaning_en: A bee does not sting unless pressed against oneself; peaceful, harmless people will not strike or retaliate unless directly provoked and cornered

proverb: "Na nyaattu na nyaadhuu, afaan na hin mammarinii" jette, Harreen
meaning_om: Yoo nama miidhuu barbaadan kallattiin miidhaa malee fakkeessanii fi qoccolanii nama hin dhiphisinaa; iftoomina barbaaduu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'If you will devour me, devour me, but don't mock me by twisting your lips around my mouth,' said the donkey; do direct harm rather than mocking cruelty

proverb: Nadhoon hamtuun, siin loluu dura meeshaan lolti
meaning_om: Haati manaa aari-qabduun osoo haasaadhaan lola hin eegalin meeshaa manaatiin waca uumtee nagaa dhabsiisti; mallattoo aarii keessoo agarsiisa
meaning_en: A bad-tempered woman fights with the cooking pots and dishes before clashing with you; passive-aggressive clattering of household items signals rage

proverb: Nama wal kajeelu, afaan hin qajeelu
meaning_om: Namoonni fedhii dhokataa yookaan wal kajeellaa qaban haasaan isaanii ifa hin ta'u; yaada dhoksuun wal qoccoluu fi marfachuun dubbatu
meaning_en: Between people who secretly desire or covet each other, speech is never straightforward; secret motives and mutual cravings twist words into evasions

proverb: Ibidda harkaan hin qabani, Qeeyransatti quba hin laatani
meaning_om: Wanta balaa guddaa qabu akka laayyootti tuquun badiisa lubbuu fida; balaa beekamaa irraa of eeggachuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: One does not grasp fire with bare hands, nor point a finger at a leopard; do not recklessly provoke lethal forces or flirt with deadly hazards

proverb: Maraataa hin tuttuqani, tuttuqanii ifitti hin kaasani
meaning_om: Nama qalbii hin qabne yookaan amala hamaa qabu tuquudhaan balaa ofitti fiduu dhiisuu; nama jeequmsaa irraa fagaachuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: Do not provoke a madman, nor tease him into unleashing his fury on you; leave volatile, irrational people alone lest their madness consume you

proverb: Maraataa biraa, dhagaa lafaa hin fuudhan
meaning_om: Nama shakkii fi tasgabbii hin qabne biratti gocha shakkiitti nama geessu raawwachuun balaa fida; inni dursa dhagaan nama rukutuu danda'a
meaning_en: Never pick up a stone near a madman; do not make ambiguous or threatening gestures around an unpredictable person, or they will attack in panic

proverb: Maraataa biratti, dhagaa hin darbatan
meaning_om: Nama daangaa hin beekne duratti gocha waraanaa yookaan jeequmsaa jalqabuun balaa guddaadha; inni deebisee wanta hamaa nama irratti raawwata
meaning_en: Do not cast a stone in the presence of a madman; engaging in aggressive antics around an unhinged person invites them to escalate with unrestrained violence

proverb: Ollaa namaa qubachuun, hamma namaa hubachuu dha
meaning_om: Namni tokko fagootti gaarii fakkaatus, yoo ollaa ta'anii waliin jiraatan amalli isaa inni dhugaa fi hammeenyi isaa ifatti beekama
meaning_en: Settling as a neighbor to someone is the only way to comprehend their true measure; you never know a person's character until you live beside them

proverb: Dubbiitu dubbii fidaa, haadaatu diddiga fida
meaning_om: Dubbiin tokko dubbii biraa kakaasee wal dhabiinsa guddaa fida; akkuma haadaan liqimfame diddiga fidu, haasaan daangaa hin qabnes mufannaa fida
meaning_en: One word leads to another just as poking a cord down the throat induces vomiting; reckless words provoke escalating arguments and bring forth ugly bile

proverb: Bishaan, dhagaa dubbisa
meaning_om: Wanti laafaa fi tasgabbaa'aan yeroo dheeraa keessatti isa jabaa fi cimee jiru jijjiiruu fi mo'achuu danda'a; obsaa fi itti fufiinsi humna guddaa qaba
meaning_en: Gentle water makes stones speak; relentless, patient persistence wears down and moves the hardest obstacles over time; softness conquers hardness

proverb: Barbaacha xurii, gaanii harka kaa'u
meaning_om: Dogoggora yookaan balleessaa xiqqoo nama biraarra jiru qorachuuf jedhanii wanta qulqulluu fi guddaa jiru balleessuu; qeeqa daangaa darbe ceepha'a
meaning_en: In searching for a tiny speck of dirt, one plunges an entire hand into the jar, polluting all the clean water; causing massive damage over a trivial flaw

proverb: Hiyyeessaa fi ibiddi tuttuqaa hin jaalatan
meaning_om: Akkuma ibiddi yoo tuqan boba'ee nama gubu, namni hiyyeessis yoo tuffatamee fi arrabsame aariin kaka'ee balaa fiduu danda'a
meaning_en: A poor man and a fire do not like to be poked; poking a fire makes it flare and burn you, and prodding an impoverished person's pride sparks fierce fury

proverb: Jawwetti dhagaa hin darbani, lola barti
meaning_om: Diina humna qabu fi ciisee jiru qoccolloo xixiqqoodhaan ifatti hin kakaasinaa; inni dammaqee balaa guddaa sitti fida
meaning_en: Do not throw stones at a python, for it will learn to attack; never needlessly tease or antagonize a dormant, formidable power, lest you awaken a monster

proverb: "Akkanumaanuu, haadha teetiin ifirraa dadhabe" jette, baranoon dhiirsaan
meaning_om: Osoo qormaata duraanii furuu dadhabanii ba'aa biraa dabalataan fe'uuf yaaluu ceepha'a; dhiphina maatii keessaa ibsa
meaning_en: 'Even as it is, your mother already exhausts me,' said the bride to her husband; refusing to take on further burdens when existing demands are crushing

proverb: Arrabaatu, arraata fida
meaning_om: Afaan ofiitiin jecha gaarii yoo dubbatan jaalala fida; jecha badaa yoo dubbatan ammoo adabaa fi qaanfii fida; arrabni bu'aa fi balaa murteessa
meaning_en: It is the tongue that brings either a loving caress or a bitter penalty; how one speaks dictates whether one receives affection or severe consequences

proverb: Laga irra deddeemanii bismillaa guddisuun sheeyxaana rafe ifitti kaasuudha
meaning_om: Bakka balaan jirutti deddeebi'anii gocha sobaa agarsiisuun balaa ofitti kakaasa; of eeggannoo dhabanii balaaf of saaxiluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Roaming repeatedly along the river while shouting invocations merely awakens the sleeping demon; loitering near danger under guise of piety provokes doom

proverb: Dubbi barbaad ijji takka kuula
meaning_om: Namni lolaa fi qoccolloo jaalatu hojii fi qulqullina ofii dhiisee wanta nama wajjin wal dhabuuf dafee fiiga; amala lola jaalatu ceepha'a
meaning_en: For a quarrel-monger, only one eye is adorned with kohl; she rushed out so eagerly to start a fight that she couldn't finish putting on her makeup

proverb: Dibbeen nama tokkoo tokkoo, aduu kaayuu hin feetu
meaning_om: Akkuma dibbeen qulqulluun osoo aduutti hin ho'isin sagalee guddaa kennuu danda'u, maqaan, dandeettiin yookaan amalli namoota tokko tokkoo (gaariis ta'ee badaa) ofumaan ifa bahee beekama malee beeksisaa fi faaruu dabalataa hin barbaadu
meaning_en: The drum of certain people requires no warming in the sun to resound; their character, reputation, or actions (whether illustrious or notorious) are completely self-evident and proclaim themselves loud and clear without any need for artificial promotion or fanfare

proverb: Waraabessi foon dhedhiif kofle, osoo waadaniifii akkam haa tahu
meaning_om: Namni waanuma salphaa fi jiruun gammadee dantaa guddaa agarsiise, wanta isa caalu yoo kennaniif ammoo hangam akka to'annaa dhabu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: The hyena was overjoyed at raw meat; how wild would it become if they roasted it?; satirizes someone wildly excited over crumbs, imagining the chaos if given real luxury

proverb: Hamma iyyan, wanti iyyaniif hin geessu
meaning_om: Waci, dhiphinni fi iyyi uumame wanta dhimmi sun baasu caalaa guddaadha; dhimma xiqqoof waca guddaa uumuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: For all the loud shouting and hysteria, the underlying issue does not warrant it; much ado about nothing; a trivial matter exaggerated into theatrical alarm

proverb: Fardi akkana hin kaatu, namninuu akkana hin kaachisu
meaning_om: Haalli yookaan gochi tokko daangaa uumamaa fi aadaatiin ala ta'ee wanta kanaan dura hin baramne ta'uu ibsa; seera fi madaallii cabsuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A horse does not gallop so wildly on its own, nor would any sensible rider drive it so; describes an erratic excess that violates all reason and common sense

proverb: Jaalala keessa, harreen ilmoo ciniinti
meaning_om: Jaalala yookaan kunuunsa daangaa darbeen nama ofii miidhuu; jaalalli qajeelfamaa fi daangaa hin qabne wanta balaa fidu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Out of overwhelming affection, the mother donkey bites her foal; rough, clumsy, or excessive love that ends up injuring the very object of affection

proverb: Jaalala keessa, adurreen ilmoo nyaatti
meaning_om: Kunuunsa, eegumsa fi jaalala garmalee ta'een wanta ofii barbadeessuu; jaalalli madaala dhabe balaa fida
meaning_en: Out of excessive attachment or frantic protection, the cat devours her kitten; smothering overprotection or obsessive control that destroys what one loves

proverb: Sareen dandamattu ooti
meaning_om: Namni miidhaa yookaan rakkina guddaa keessaa bayyanate sagalee dhageessisee dhiphina isaa himata; dhiibbaa jalaa bahanii komii dhageessisuu
meaning_en: A dog that survives the beating yelps in protest; one who survives an injury or oppression complains loudly once they are safely out of immediate danger

proverb: Dandamattu ooti, booyyeen
meaning_om: Akkuma booyyeen yoo rukutamee jalaa bahe wacuu fi ootu, namnis yeroo balaa irraa dandamate aarii fi komii isaa dhageessisa
meaning_en: A wild pig squeals loudly as it escapes the blow; once deliverance is secured, the aggrieved party loudly vents their accumulated pain and indignation

proverb: "Biyya keenyatti, nan garmaamaa" jette, harreen
meaning_om: Bakka ormaa fi namni nama hin beekne keessatti wanta hin taaneen of jajanii fi gootummaa sobaa dhaadachuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'In our country, I prance and gallop like a warhorse,' said the donkey; satirizes boasting of imaginary grandeur and status when far away from verifiers

proverb: Qayyattee hin beektuu, ganda gubdii dhoorkaa
meaning_om: Namni muuxannoo hin qabne hojii haarawa keessa seenee of eeggannoo dhabuun balaa guddaa akka hin fidne duraan dhoowwuu; ogeessa hin taane eeggachuu
meaning_en: She has never perfumed with incense before; stop her before she burns down the village!; an inexperienced novice attempting delicate tasks will cause catastrophe

proverb: Kufe jennaan, cacaphxeetu itti aana
meaning_om: Namni tokko dogoggora yookaan qorumsa xiqqoon yoo gufate, oduun fi hamiin ormaa wanticha garmalee guddisee akka waan inni guutummaatti barbadaa'etti odeessa; kufaatii namaa afarsuu fi guddisee odeessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: When people hear that someone took a minor stumble, gossip and rumors immediately exaggerate it into a catastrophic, total shattering; critiques how society gleefully magnifies, embellishes, and sensationalizes another person's minor setback

proverb: Quufeen bule jette, duutee bultee
meaning_om: Namni tokko haala isaa isa manca'aa dagatee akka waan quufeeraa fi nagaa qabuutti of gowwoomsuu qishnaadhaan saaxila; badiisaa fi du'a dhugaa akka boqonnaa fi quufaatti ilaaluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Satirizes extreme self-delusion where someone boasts of resting in peace and abundant satisfaction, oblivious to the fact that they are utterly ruined and dead; mistaking fatal collapse and numbness for contentment

proverb: Tokkoo hin tollee, budaan lakku deesse
meaning_om: Rakkoon yookaan amalli hamaan duraanuu jiraatee nama dhiphisu dachaa ta'ee baay'achuun dhiphina hammeessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A single evil-eyed creature was already unbearable, and now she has borne twins!; lamenting when an already toxic problem doubles in strength and menace

proverb: Duruu hin qayyattuu, reeffa hin gubinaa
meaning_om: Namni wanta salphaa keessatti of eeggachuu hin dandeenye hojii ulfaataa fi safeeffannaa barbaadu keessa seenee akka hin mancaafne dhoowwuu
meaning_en: She doesn't even know how to burn daily incense; don't let her set fire to the corpse!; keep clumsy individuals far away from solemn, delicate tasks

proverb: Tarkaanfachuu dura, lafa ajjatan laallachuu wayya
meaning_om: Tarkaanfii yookaan murtii tokko fudhachuu dura of eeggannoo gochuu fi qorachuun barbaachisaadha; osoo hin utaalin lafa ilaali
meaning_en: Look before you leap; observe the ground carefully before stepping forward; exercising prudence and foresight before taking action

proverb: Tuujii gobeensa kayaniiti, ifirraa laalan
meaning_om: Akkuma gad-fageenya tuujii yookaan haroo bishaanii beekuuf gobeensa keessa dhaabanii qoratanii fi dheerina ofiitiin madaalan, dhimma balaa qabu keessa seenuu duras qorannoo godhanii humna ofii beekuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: One thrusts a bamboo stalk into a deep pond to gauge its depth, then checks the wet mark against one's own height; test the waters and measure the depth of any venture against your personal capacity before stepping in

proverb: Loonuu, funfateeti ciisa
meaning_om: Bineensonniiyyuu bakka boqotan qoratanii akka eeggatan, namnis iddoo oolu fi nama wajjin michoomu osoo hin qoratin itti seenuu hin qabu
meaning_en: Even cattle sniff the ground before bedding down; if beasts inspect their resting spot for thorns, a human should never enter situations uninspected

proverb: Cuuphatanii laalanii, yoo mi'aawe laaffifatani
meaning_om: Wanta tokko guutummaatti osoo hin fudhatin dura xiqqoo yaalanii qoruun barbaachisaadha; bu'aa isaa erga mirkaneeffatanii booda itti fufu
meaning_en: Dip and sample first; if it proves sweet and wholesome, indulge at ease; test the waters on a small scale before committing fully

proverb: Aannan adii, gadi laalii dhugi
meaning_om: Wanti alaan qulqulluu fi gaarii fakkaatu iyyuu keessoo isaatti xurii yookaan summii qabaachuu waan danda'uuf, osoo hin amaniin dura qorachuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Even pure white milk should be inspected closely before drinking; things that outwardly appear pristine may harbor hidden dirt, poison, or deception

proverb: Sirba bu'an, shanii duraati laallatan
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan walga'ii tokko keessatti osoo dura hin bu'in yookaan murtii hin fudhatin dura haala jiru qorachuun ogummaadha; jarjara dhowwa
meaning_en: When entering a circle dance, observe from the sidelines before joining the front ranks; assess the rhythm and rules of an enterprise before leading

proverb: Sirba bu'uu dura, dhaabbataniiti laallatan
meaning_om: Dhimma kamiyyuu keessatti osoo tarkaanfii hin fudhatin dura dhaabbatanii haala jiru hubachuun murteessaa dha; jarjara dhabuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Before stepping into the arena or dance floor, pause and observe; assess the situation calmly from a standstill before committing yourself to action

proverb: Fuula fardaa ilaalanii, lookoo muru
meaning_om: Hojiin yookaan murtiin kamiinuu akkaataa haala fi guddina dhimma sanaatiin madaalamee hojjetamuu qaba; madaallii sirrii eeguu ibsa
meaning_en: One cuts the leather bridle according to the measurements of the horse's face; tailor your measures, responses, and plans to the exact size of the subject

proverb: Haadha laalanii, intala fuudhan
meaning_om: Amala, naamusaa fi qulqullina haadhaatiin amalli intalaa beekama waan ta'eef, fuudha dura maatii qorachuun barbaachisaadha; sanyiin amala calaqqisa
meaning_en: Observe the mother before marrying the daughter; a daughter's character, domestic skills, and temperament often mirror her mother's upbringing

proverb: Namni dinniina argate, hin a'amu
meaning_om: Namni duraan akeekkachiisa fi odeeffannoo argate of eeggannoo waan godhatuuf balaan tasa isa hin qabu; dur-hubannoon humna
meaning_en: Forewarned is forearmed; a person who has received prior warning is not ambushed; advance intelligence allows one to prepare and avoid calamity

proverb: "Boru ganama masgiida dhayna" jennaan,"dura akka dhiirti itti nu bulachitu hubanna" jette
meaning_om: Karoora gara fuulduraatiif osoo hin jarjarin dura haala qabatamaa ammaa fi wanta dura dhufe madaaluun murteessaa dha; qabatamummaa dursuu ibsa
meaning_en: When invited to the mosque tomorrow, she said, 'First let us see how our husbands treat us tonight'; evaluate immediate reality before committing to future plans

proverb: Bineensi dura argan, nama hin nyaatu
meaning_om: Diina yookaan balaa duraan arganii beekan irraa of eeguun salphaadha; dammaqinni balaa jalaa nama baasa
meaning_en: A wild beast spotted beforehand does not devour a person; a danger detected in advance can be evaded or prepared for; vigilance disarms threats

proverb: Waan booda si miidhaa duraan biraa fagaadhu
meaning_om: Wanta gara fuulduraatti balaa fi badiisa fidu dursee beekanii irraa fagaachuun ogummaa qabaachuudha; ittisaan dura qabachuu
meaning_en: Whatever is bound to harm you later, keep your distance from it in advance; proactive prevention is far better than suffering future devastation

proverb: "Marsaa sirboo ayliin laallachaa sirboo" je'e, hantuutni
meaning_om: Gammachuu fi sirba keessattiyyuu dammaqinaa fi of eeggannoo dhabuu hin qaban; gammachuun akka nama hin dagamsiifne akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: 'Dance in the circle, but dance with your wits alert,' said the mouse; even during celebration and joy, remain vigilant and watch your surroundings for danger

proverb: Dhagaye jettee hin odeessin, arge jettee hin dubbatin, osoo keeysa hin hubatin
meaning_om: Wanta ijaan argan yookaan gurraan dhaga'an hunda dhugaa isaa osoo hin qoratin odeessuun badii waan fiduuf, qorannoo malee dubbachuu dhowwa
meaning_en: Do not spread news merely because you heard it, nor speak merely because you saw it, without understanding the internal truth; verify before speaking

proverb: Osoo hin hubatin, qubaa hin gubatin
meaning_om: Wanta dhimma isaa sirriitti hin beekne keessa seentanii of hin miidhinaa; dura qoradhaa
meaning_en: Do not burn your fingers before understanding the situation; do not meddle or rush into unfamiliar affairs and suffer painful consequences out of haste

proverb: Guyyaa, if maddii laalaniiti dubbatan
meaning_om: Ifa guyyaa keessattiyyuu namni dhaga'u akka hin jirre mirkaneeffatanii of eeggannoon dubbachuun barbaachisaa dha; hasasni balaa qaba
meaning_en: Even in broad daylight, look beside you before speaking; exercise constant discretion, for walls have ears and indiscreet words can easily be overheard

proverb: Gowwaan, kan barihu hin seehu
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne dukkana yerootti amanee wanti hundi akka jijjiiramu hin beeku; dukkanni darbee ifti akka dhufu dagata
meaning_en: The fool does not imagine that daybreak will come; an unprincipled person acts under cover of darkness assuming their deeds will never come to light

proverb: Laalii soomanii, laalii furi
meaning_om: Hojii fi murtii kamiinuu ragaa qabatamaa irratti hundaa'anii jalqabanii fi xumuruun ogummaa ta'uu ibsa; ragaa qabatamaan socho'uu
meaning_en: Fast upon sighting the crescent moon and break fast upon sighting it; base every critical undertaking and its conclusion on verified evidence

proverb: "Hiriirri tolu keysaan jiraa, hiriirri toluu baatu qaataan miila tokko lafaa fudhadhe" jette,huummoon
meaning_om: Haala jiru hordofaa of eeggannoodhaan socho'uu; balaan yoo dhufe dafanii baqachuuf qophaa'aa ta'anii dhimma keessa seenuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'If the battle line holds I am in it; if not, I've already lifted one foot to flee,' said the hornbill; keeping an exit strategy ready while testing waters

proverb: "Sirbi tolu mana sirbaa niin seena, sirbi toluu baatu miilli koo tokko ala na jira" jette, Huummoon
meaning_om: Dhimma tokko keessa guutummaatti osoo hin lixin dura of eeggannoo fi daandii ittiin baafatan qabaachuu ibsa; toftaa of oolchuu
meaning_en: 'If the dance is joyful, I'll step inside; if it turns sour, one foot is outside,' said the hornbill; never commit fully without retaining a secure way out

proverb: Nyaata garii, nyaata hin seehin, nyaadhamaa
meaning_om: Faayidaan yookaan afeerraan tokko tokko alaan gaarii fakkaatus dhuma irratti summii fi balaa nama galaafatu ta'uu danda'a; faayidaa summaa'aa irraa of eeguu
meaning_en: Do not mistake all offerings for nourishment; some meals are baited traps where you are the one being devoured; beware of poisoned gifts and trap offerings

proverb: Waan lafatti kalan (mizaanan) Harree gubbaa kaayan
meaning_om: Wanta tokko osoo hin hojjatin dura dursa madaalanii fi qoratanii murteessuun barbaachisaa dha; madaallii malee fe'uun kasaaraa fida
meaning_en: What has been carefully weighed and measured on the ground is what gets loaded onto the donkey; calculate and balance your loads beforehand

proverb: Harkaan kennaniiti miilaan barbaadani
meaning_om: Liqii yookaan qabeenya ofii namaaf salphaatti kennanii booda deebifachuuf dhiphachuu fi deemsaan miila ofii dadhabsuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Giving easily with the hand, and then running around on foot desperately searching to recover it; cautions against reckless lending without collateral

proverb: Qola gubbaa hin laalini, keysa toohadhuu laali
meaning_om: Bifa alaa qofatti gowwoomuu dhiisanii qulqullina keessoo fi dhugaa jiru qorachuun ogummaa ta'uu barsiisa
meaning_en: Do not merely inspect the outer rind or shell; examine what lies inside; judge by inner substance and character rather than surface packaging

proverb: Namummaan keeysaa, mataan rifensa
meaning_om: Wanti nama nama godhu qalbii, sammuu fi amala keessoo isaati malee bifa alaa fi rifeensa mataa miti; amalaaf dursa kennuu ibsa
meaning_en: True humanity and character reside within; the head outside is just hair; human worth is measured by moral depth and wisdom, not external appearance

proverb: Fuula fardaa laalaniiti, fuuloo muran
meaning_om: Hojiin kamiyyuu akkaataa haala fi guddina dhimma sanaatiin madaalamee hojjetamuu qaba; dhimma hundaaf madaallii kennuu
meaning_en: One cuts the horse's halter by looking directly at the shape of its face; tailor your methods, agreements, and expectations directly to the reality

proverb: Ija laaltu, ijji hin nyaattu
meaning_om: Namni ija-jabaatee dhugaa qabatee nama dura dhaabbatu salphaatti hin miidhamu; sodaa dhabuun kabaja fi eegumsa fida
meaning_en: The eye that looks back steadily is not consumed by the eye; bold, unblinking eye contact wards off intimidation and commands immediate respect

proverb: Didan duruman didanii, hamtuu mataa ifii hin mudani
meaning_om: Wanta sirrii hin taane yookaan kan humnaa olii ta'e jalqabumaan 'lakki' jechuun balaa fi salphina boodarra dhufu jalaa nama oolcha
meaning_en: If you must refuse, refuse from the very outset, lest you bring calamity upon your head; timely, firm refusal saves one from disastrous entanglements

proverb: Dhiirti bakka irraa hin galletti hin duultu
meaning_om: Gootni yookaan namni qalbii qabu bakka abdii fi daandiin nagaan deebi'an hin jirretti lola hin banu; karoora malee waraana hin seenan
meaning_en: A real man does not march to war where there is no path of return; bravery is paired with strategy, and one does not enter conflicts that guarantee slaughter

proverb: Abshir abshiriin, sheeka bishaan nyaachifte
meaning_om: Gorsaa fi jajjabina sobaatiin amansiisanii nama qorumsa hamaa keessa buusuu; of-dagachiisa sobaa irraa of eeggachuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Saying 'Fear not, it's safe!' got the Sheik drowned in the river; false reassurance and reckless encouragement lure people into fatal peril

proverb: Waan lafatti qarqabaniitu, fe'inatti nama hin dhibne
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan qophii tokko jalqabarratti lafarratti tolfanii sirriitti qopheessuun yeroo hojiirra oolchan rakkoo fi dhiphina dhabamsiisa
meaning_en: What is neatly organized and balanced on the ground causes no trouble when loaded; thorough advance preparation ensures effortless execution

proverb: Waan bona kaayan, ganna fuudhan
meaning_om: Yeroo nagaa fi quufaa wanta qaban qusatanii yeroo rakkoo fi hongee keessatti itti fayyadamuun ogummaa jireenyaati; qusannaa barsiisa
meaning_en: What is saved during the dry season is consumed in the lean rainy season; saving resources during plenty ensures survival during harsh times

proverb: Abbaan manaa qorii hin arraabu
meaning_om: Abbaan manaa yeroo hunda of eeggannoo fi qusannaa qabaatee hambaa kahuu qaba malee, wanta hunda fixee harka qullaa hafuun salphinadha
meaning_en: The head of the household does not lick the bowl clean; a dignified provider maintains reserves and leaves food behind for future security

proverb: Farda hidhatan, machiin tolti
meaning_om: Dursa dhimma murteessaa fi qabeenya ofii bakka amansiisaa keessa erga galchanii booda bashannanuun yookaan boqochuun nagaa namaaf kenna
meaning_en: Once your horse is safely tethered, getting drunk is fine; secure your vital assets and responsibilities first before indulging in leisure

proverb: Jaartii (niitii) guyya wajji rafan, dalagaa halkan dalagan
meaning_om: Yeroo boqonnaa fi jireenyaa madaalanii fayyadamuu; haala bultii keessatti yeroo sirriitti karoorsanii hojjechuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Sleeping beside your wife all day forces you to work through the night; neglecting daytime labor for daytime comfort forces grueling night toil

proverb: Buutiinuu biyye qusatti
meaning_om: Wanta lafarraa hin dhumne fakkaatu illee qusachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu; bineensi akka buutii iyyuu wanta xiqqoo hin qisaasu erga ta'ee namni daran qusachuu qaba
meaning_en: Even the puff adder conserves dirt; if even a viper is sparing with the soil beneath it, humans should never be wasteful with any resource

proverb: Tan ulfaan daakuu nyaatte, gaafa deeysu daara nyaatti
meaning_om: Yeroo qabeenyi jiru osoo hin qusatin qisaasanii, yeroo dhiphinaa fi yeroo barbaachisaatti harka qullaa hafanii salphachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: She who devoured raw flour while pregnant eats ashes when delivering; consuming your supplies before the critical hour leaves you destitute

proverb: Dayma, osoo mi'aawu maragani
meaning_om: Wanta gaarii fi mi'aawaa ta'e tokko osoo dhumee hin barbadaa'in, daangaa qabaatanii gara fuulduraatiif qusachuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: Honey is sealed shut while it is still sweet; exercise self-control and store away wealth while abundant rather than exhausting it completely

proverb: Qabeenyi karaa deemeeti, dhabni karaa irraa maqa (galaa qabaachuu)
meaning_om: Namni qabeenyaa fi galaa qabaatee imala deemu rakkoo fi dhabamuu jalaa nagaan baha; qabeenyi daandii jireenyaa namaaf bana
meaning_en: Wealth journeys down the road, and lack steps aside; traveling with ample provisions and resources clears away obstacles and protects against hardship

proverb: Waan jabeysaniitu, nama jabeysa
meaning_om: Hojii, qabeenya, maatii yookaan amantii ofii kunuunsanii fi jabeessanii yoo qabatan, wanti sunis deebi'ee nama utuba, nama jabeessa
meaning_en: It is what you reinforce that reinforces you; whatever foundation, craft, savings, or relationships you faithfully invest in will protect you

proverb: Kan ar'aa nyaattee fixxe, kan boruutif maal keessa ree?
meaning_om: Wanta har'a qaban hunda guyyaa tokkotti qisaasanii boruuf hiyyooma ta'anii dhiphachuu ceepha'a; boruuf yaaduu dhabuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: You have eaten and exhausted everything today; what will you have for tomorrow?; reproaches reckless consumption that leaves tomorrow hungry

proverb: "Yaa namana ani wahiin beekaa, ati wahi feetaa, aannan kana dhugaatii haleelii" jette, niitiin dhiirsaan
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan duula cimaaf osoo hin bobbahin dura soorata gaariin humna horatanii kutannoon deemsa jalqabuu agarsiisa; qophii qaamaa fi sammuu
meaning_en: 'Drink this milk and strike out boldly!' said the wife; fortifying oneself with solid nourishment and encouragement before facing a formidable mission

proverb: Kan qalamu itti hiiysani
meaning_om: Wanta murtaa'e yookaan hojii xumuraaf qophaa'e tokko gara galma isaatti dhiheessuu; dhimma dhumatuuf qophii ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: What is destined to be slaughtered is brought forward to the blade; moving decisively toward the final execution of an inevitable plan

proverb: Bokkaa arfassaa dhufuuf, birraa handaaqqii (shamshiyaa)bitan
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan rooba ji'oota hedduu booda dhufuuf jedhanii dursee yeroo qabbanaatti meeshaa ittisaa qopheeffachuu; dur-argummaa ibsa
meaning_en: Preparing for spring rains by buying an umbrella in autumn; exercising long-range foresight by acquiring defensive tools long before the storm arrives

proverb: Waa arganii, gaachana bitu
meaning_om: Namni dammaqaan mallattoo balaa yeroo argu dafee meeshaa ittiin of eegu qopheeffata; balaa dursee ofirraa ittisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Sighting trouble on the horizon, one purchases a shield; a prudent person prepares defenses the moment early indicators of hostility appear

proverb: Namni akka fardaa beeku, ulee fardaa hin bobeysu
meaning_om: Namni gatii fi faayidaa meeshaa tokkoo beeku wanta xiqqoo ta'ellee hin qisaasu, yeroo isaatiif eeggata; meeshaa hojii kabajuu barsiisa
meaning_en: One who understands horses does not burn the riding switch for firewood; a knowledgeable person preserves specialized tools, never squandering them

proverb: Imaltuun karaa deemaa ooltee, yeroo beelti qabde sinqii hiikkatti
meaning_om: Namni qophii qabu yeroo rakkoon dhufe wanta duraan kuufate fayyadamee nagaan baha; qophiin duraa rakkina salphisa
meaning_en: The traveler marches all day and unties his provision sack only when hunger strikes; relying on carefully prepared reserves at the exact moment of need

proverb: Miila fageeffatan, galaa qopheffatan
meaning_om: Galma fagoo fi hojii guddaa qabaannaan, qophii fi qabeenya isa madaalu qopheeffachuun dirqama; kaayyoo guddaaf qophii guddaatu barbaachisa
meaning_en: If embarking on a long journey, prepare matching travel provisions; ambitious undertakings and distant goals demand proportionally vast preparation

proverb: Tan hin qaanfanne, deessee buna liqii dhaqxi
meaning_om: Osoo dhimmi guddaan akka da'umsaa hin dhufin dura qophii barbaachisu godhachuu dhiisanii yeroo sana kadhaatti fiiguu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A shameless woman gives birth and then goes begging for borrowed coffee; mocks those who fail to prepare for predictable milestones and then frantically beg

proverb: Qaratan gaafa nageyaati jette karkarroon
meaning_om: Yeroo nagaa fi tasgabbii qabanitti qophii waraanaa fi qorumsaa gochuun ogummaadha; rakkoon osoo hin dhufin dura of qopheessuu barsiisa
meaning_en: 'One sharpens one's tusks during days of peace,' said the warthog; hone your skills, weapons, and defenses during tranquil times to prepare for conflict

proverb: Boru hin beekneen, iftaan quba hin qabdu
meaning_om: Namni karoora yeroo dhihoo iyyuu hin qabne wanta fagoo tilmaamuu hin danda'u; qophii fi dur-argii dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: One who cannot even anticipate tomorrow has no clue about the day after; mocks people who lack even elementary, short-term foresight

proverb: Guyyaa fayyaa, guyyaa fayya dhabaatiif dalagadhu
meaning_om: Yeroo qaamni fi humni jiru qabeenya kuufachuun yeroo dhukkubaa fi dadhabbii keessatti nama tursa; humna jiruun boriif hojjechuu
meaning_en: While in robust health, work and save for the days of sickness; invest your peak vigor into building reserves for inevitable seasons of frailty

proverb: Tarkaanfachuu dura, bakka ajjatan ilaallachuu
meaning_om: Tarkaanfii kamiyyuu fudhachuu dura bakka itti ejjetanii fi balaa naannoo jiru qorachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: Inspect the exact spot where your foot will land before stepping; meticulous inspection and prudence prevent painful missteps

proverb: Yogguma sirbaa, dunfurri hin argamu
meaning_om: Wanta qophiif barbaachisu osoo yeroon hin gahin dura qopheeffachuu qabu malee, yeroo qabatamatti hojiin eegale dhabamuun qaanfii fida
meaning_en: At the very hour of the dance, ornaments cannot be found; preparing festive regalia or tools at the last second leads to frantic embarrassment

proverb: Farda dhibbaa fi shantamaan bitteeti, kooraa shantamaan bituu dadhabde
meaning_om: Wanta guddaa erga bitanii wanta xiqqaadhaaf dhabuun wanta sana bu'aa dhabeessa gochuu ceepha'a; qophii guutuu dhabuu
meaning_en: Having bought a horse for a hundred and fifty, you failed to buy a fifty-coin saddle; spending heavily on an asset while skimping on its essential gear

proverb: Allaattiin, kurfooytu malee hin barartu
meaning_om: Hojii kamiyyuu keessatti osoo hin socho'in dura qophii barbaachisaa gochuun murteessaa dha; qophii malee ka'uun kufaatii fida
meaning_en: A bird never takes flight without poising itself first; every successful leap, flight, or project requires proper posture and advance preparation

proverb: Osoo roobni hin roobne, galaana ifirraa baasani
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan rakkoon osoo hin qaqqabin dura daandii fi ittisa isaa tolfachuun ogummaa guddaadha; ittisa dursee qopheessuu
meaning_en: Before the rain even falls, divert the floodwaters away; build trenches and dikes before the storm begins; proactive disaster mitigation

proverb: Leenci, teysuma tolfatu malee hin utaalu
meaning_om: Gootni yookaan ogeessi tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu dura bakka isaatii fi haala isaa madaalatee qophaa'a; jarjaraan utaaluun kufaatii fida
meaning_en: A lion never springs without first adjusting its crouch; great power and decisive strikes require deliberate, patient positioning before the leap

proverb: Shinbirroon bakka qubattu laallattu malee hin barartu
meaning_om: Ka'umsa dura bakka itti gahan beekanii fi galma ifa ta'e qabaatanii socho'uun barbaachisaadha; galma malee imaluu dhowwa
meaning_en: A bird does not take wing without scouting where it will perch; never launch an initiative or dispute without having already secured your landing place

proverb: Rooba bar hegeree roobuuf, ar'a mana jaarani
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan qorumsa gara fuulduraatti dhufuuf jedhanii har'a dursee itti qophaa'uun jireenya nagaa namaaf kenna; karoora fageenyaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: For the rain destined to fall next year, thatch the house today; long-term security requires building robust defenses well before hardship arrives

proverb: Balaan, osoo hin buune maganfatani
meaning_om: Rakkoon osoo hin dhufin dura kadhannaa, of eeggannoo fi ittisa gochuun barbaachisaadha; erga bu'ee booda iyyuun furmaata hin ta'u
meaning_en: Before calamity descends, seek refuge and invoke protection; spiritual and practical precautions must precede the crisis, not follow its arrival

proverb: Namni yeroodhumaan waa argadheen guuza (daboo) oolfadha ja'u wahitti hin bahu
meaning_om: Qophii fi karoora malee tasa waan argatetti dhimma bahuun hojii bu'aa qabeessa hin ta'u; qophiin duraa dirqama
meaning_en: He who says 'I will summon a cooperative labor party on the spur of the moment' achieves nothing; organizing collective labor requires prior planning

proverb: Ijji beekaa, dura boochi
meaning_om: Namni qaxaleen balaa yookaan gadda dhufuuf jiru dursee qalbiin argee itti qophaa'a; dura yaadda'ee furmaata barbaada
meaning_en: The eye of the wise weeps in advance; a perceptive person foresees sorrow and danger early, emotionally processing and planning for it before it strikes

proverb: Qunceen ganama jiisan, hin goggoydu
meaning_om: Hojii ganamaan jalqabanii fi qophii sirrii qabu bu'aan isaa itti fufa; qophii jalqabaa gaarii qabaachuun cichoomina fida
meaning_en: Bark fiber soaked early in the morning stays pliable all day; tasks initiated with early preparation retain resilience and flexibility throughout

proverb: Gowwaan kan beelawu hin seehu
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne yeroo quufe wanti hundi akkuma sanatti hafa sehee boriif hin qusatu; dhabamuu boruuf hin yaadu
meaning_en: A fool does not believe he will ever hunger; when full today, an improvident person assumes plenty is permanent and neglects saving for future scarcity

proverb: Eeyba jaalalaa, kumni gaalaa hin binne
meaning_om: Eebbi jaalalaa fi nagaa kan qabeenya guddaan kan akka kuma gaalaatiin illee hin bitamne ta'uu; eebbi fi jaalalli qabeenya hundarra gatii akka qabu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A blessing born of genuine love cannot be purchased even with a thousand camels; blessings and sincere goodwill hold far greater worth than vast material fortunes

proverb: Eeyba taphaa jaaladhu, abaarsa taphaa sodaadhu
meaning_om: Eebbis ta'ee abaarsi akka qoosaa fi taphaatti kan dubbatamu illee dhiibbaa fi humna qaba waan ta'eef, eebba hawwachuu fi abaarsa irraa of eeggachuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Welcome even a blessing spoken in jest, and beware even a curse uttered in play; spoken words carry spiritual power, so always cherish goodwill and shun curses

proverb: Yayyaamii ergadhu, yayyaamii elmadhu
meaning_om: Namas ta'ee beeylada wanta tokko gochisiisuuf kabajaan, jecha mi'aawaa fi kunuunsaan dhihaachuun bu'aa gaarii fida; humnaa mannaa jecha gaariitu hojjechiisa
meaning_en: Call with gentle endearment when sending someone on an errand, and coax gently when milking; persuasion and courtesy yield far better results than harsh coercion

proverb: Kan si hin aarsine, kan si hin daarsine rabbi sii haa kennu
meaning_om: Eebba jaalalaa fi bultiiti; Waaqayyo nama nagaa fi qananii sitti fidu, kan qalbii kee hin dhiphisnee fi qabeenya sirraa hin dhabamsiifne akka siif kennu hawwuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A traditional blessing wishing that God grant you a companion who neither torments your emotions nor leaves you stripped of provisions; peace and prosperity

proverb: Ayyaana waraabessaa rabbi sii haa kennu
meaning_om: Eebba qoosaa yookaan carraa gaarii hawwuudha; akkuma waraabessi osoo hin dafqin carraan foon quufu argatu, atis carraa fi rizqii salphaatti argadhu jechuudha
meaning_en: May God grant you the uncanny fortune of the hyena; a humorous folk blessing wishing someone effortless luck, finding sustenance without exhausting toil

proverb: Akka hoolaa boodatti si haa gabbisu
meaning_om: Eebba maanguddummaati; akkuma gabbinnii fi coomi hoolaa eegee ishee irratti ta'e, jireenyi kees yeroo dullumaa badhaadhaa fi eebbifamaa haa ta'u jechuudha
meaning_en: May He bless you with prosperity in your later years, just as a sheep's fat gathers at its tail; wishing enduring comfort, wealth, and honor in old age

proverb: Bakka akka dibichaa itti barooddetti, akka raadaa si hin marrachiisin
meaning_om: Bakka duraan gootummaan, kabajaan fi sagalee olkaastanii dhaabbattanitti salphatanii akka dadhabaatti akka hin dhiphanne hawwuu; kabajni kee akka hin banne eebbisuu ibsa
meaning_en: Where you once roared boldly like a young bull, may God never reduce you to weeping like a heifer; praying that one never falls from dignity into humiliation

proverb: Kan ol si fuudhe, lafa si haa Kaayin
meaning_om: Waaqayyo inni sadarkaa fi guddina siif kenne nagaan fi tasgabbiin akka si tursiisu; akkasumas yoo gadi bu'iinsi jiraates nagaan akka lafa si qabachiisu hawwuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: May He who elevated you set you safely upon solid ground; wishing that divine providence preserves an elevated person with grounding and safe stability

proverb: Dura nu tolchee booda nu hin yakkin
meaning_om: Waaqayyo jireenya jalqabaa gaarii nuuf kenne xumura isaas nagaa fi gammachuun akka nuuf godhu kadhachuu; xumura gaarii hawwachuu
meaning_en: May He who made our beginning righteous not ruin or abandon us at the end; a prayer for perseverance and an honorable, unblemished finish to life

proverb: kan manaa handaaqqoo qabuuf gogorriin qabamti
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu qabeenya fi qophii qabu carraan dabalataas isaaf milkaa'a; qabeenyi qabeenya biraa harkisa
meaning_en: For the one who already owns domestic fowl at home, wild partridges are easily snared; established wealth and preparation attract further surplus

proverb: Nama nama obaase, ulfinaa wajji haa obaasu
meaning_om: Namni orma keessummeesse fi gargaarsa kenne Waaqayyo kabajaa fi nagaan akka isa quubsu eebbisuu; tola-ooltummaaf galata kennuu
meaning_en: May He who provided drink to someone quench his thirst accompanied by honor; returning blessings of dignity and sustenance to a generous benefactor

proverb: Re'ee fi nadhoon, lafa rakko jaalatti
meaning_om: Akkuma re'een qilee irra dhaabbachuu filattu, dubartoonnis qormaata cimaa keessatti obsa qabaachuu fi dhimma walxaxaa qabachuu jaalatu jedhanii qishnaan mammaaku
meaning_en: Goats and women love rugged terrain; folk saying observing that just as goats climb precarious cliffs, women navigate the most challenging domestic trials

proverb: Hantuutaa fi namni, karaa ifii baafate jaalata
meaning_om: Namni kamuu akkuma hantuuta boolla ofii jaalattuutti, daandii, mala fi filannoo dhuunfaan tolfate hordofuu filata; bilisummaa fi fedhii ofii ibsa
meaning_en: Both a mouse and a human love the path they made for themselves; people naturally cherish personal autonomy, self-made paths, and their own methods

proverb: Kan haajameetu, hajjii dhaqa
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan imala ulfaataa kan raawwatu nama dhimmichi garaa isaatti dhiphise fi fedhii murteessaa qabu qofaadha; dantaa malee tattaaffiin hin jiru
meaning_en: It is the one with true need and conviction who undertakes the pilgrimage; an arduous journey is only undertaken by someone driven by genuine purpose

proverb: Kan arihu qabu barbaada, kan dheeysu jalaa bahu barbaada
meaning_om: Morkii yookaan waldhabdee keessatti gama lachuuyyuu kaayyoo fi kutannoo cimaa kan mataa isaanii qabu; qabsoon jireenyaa fedhii lamaan geggeeffama
meaning_en: The pursuer seeks to capture; the fleer seeks to escape; in any struggle, both sides are driven by fierce, opposing, and equally determined motives

proverb: Kuruphoon lubbuuf kaatti, sareen qoonqoof ariiti
meaning_om: Namni lubbuu fi bilisummaa isaatiif falmatu isa faayidaa fi qoonqoo qofaaf kaatu caalaa humnaa fi kutannoo guddaa qabaata; qabsoon lubbuu caalti
meaning_en: The duiker runs for its life, while the hound pursues merely for a meal; fighting for survival summons far greater desperation than chasing an appetite

proverb: Kan beelawe ni hata, kan quufe ni bulfata
meaning_om: Haalli qabatamaa jireenyaa fi beelli nama gara gocha hin taanetti yoo dhiibu, quufi fi qabeenyi garuu tasgabbii fi qusannaa fida
meaning_en: The starving person steals, while the well-fed person stores food for tomorrow; destitution drives desperate acts, whereas security fosters thrift

proverb: Wadaaja abbaatu yaammata
meaning_om: Dhimma, eebba fi rakkoo ofiitiif abbaatu dursa dammaqee nama waammata malee, namni ormaa dhufee dhimma kee hin geggeessu; dhimma ofiitiif dursa kennuu
meaning_en: The prayer assembly is summoned by the master himself; an individual must take the initiative to organize their affairs and seek blessings without waiting for others

proverb: Namni maqaa ofii hin tuffatu, "Ajaawee" jennaan owwaate
meaning_om: Namni kamuu maqaa, eenyummaa fi kabaja dhuunfaa isaa ni jaalata; hangamiyyuu maqaan sun badaa yoo ta'e ofii isaaf gatii qaba
meaning_en: A person does not despise their own name; when called 'Foul-smelling one,' he answered; people inherently cherish their identity, however unglamorous

proverb: Haasawaa fi gororri, abbatti mi'aawa
meaning_om: Namni hundi yaada, dubbii fi ilaalcha ofiitti gammada, akka waan hundarra gaarii ta'etti of ilaala; of-jaallachuu uumama namaati
meaning_en: One's own speech and saliva taste sweet to the owner; human beings are naturally infatuated with their own words, even when unpalatable to others

proverb: Dubbiin abbaaf horii dha
meaning_om: Beekumsi, dubbiin sirrii fi dandeettiin haasaa akkuma horii qabeenya gati-jabeessa abbaa isaatiif nagaa, kabajaa fi bu'aa fiduudha
meaning_en: Eloquence and sound counsel are wealth like cattle to their owner; the ability to speak wisely is as valuable an economic and social asset as livestock

proverb: Muyoon dubbi jibba, jabaan dubbi jaalata
meaning_om: Namni dadhabaan dhugaa baasuufi falmii seeraa sodaata; namni jabaan garuu dhugaa fi haqa qaba waan ta'eef marii fi dubbii dura dhaabbachuu hin sodaatu
meaning_en: The weakling shrinks from open debate and inquiry; the strong and confident person welcomes deliberation; those with integrity fear no public examination

proverb: Duudaan, duuda jaalata
meaning_om: Namoonni amala, haala, dhibee yookaan fedhii walfakkaataa qaban salphaatti wal hubatu, walitti dhihaatanii wal jaalatu; wal-fakkaattiin wal barbaada
meaning_en: The deaf person loves another deaf person; people who share identical conditions, limitations, or backgrounds naturally gravitate toward and support one another

proverb: Wal fakkiin, wal barbaaddi
meaning_om: Namoonni amala, ilaalcha fi yaadaan walfakkaatan walitti dhufanii michooma uumu; amalli walfakkaataan wal harkisa
meaning_en: Similar things seek out each other; birds of a feather flock together; people with matching values, habits, or morals naturally associate

proverb: Badduun wal barbaaddi
meaning_om: Namoonni amala badaa fi badiisa qaban salphaatti wal argatanii shiraa fi daba walfaana hojjetu; hamaan hamaa barbaada
meaning_en: Corrupt or straying people invariably seek out and find one another; villains naturally congregate and conspire together

proverb: "Intal si fuudhu" jennaaniin "mala keeti jette, "si fuudhu na jala teeysaa" jennaan "mala kooti" jette
meaning_om: Fuudhuun fedhii dhiiraa yoo ta'e, bultii keessatti amalaa fi akkaataa jireenyaa murteeffachuun immoo mirgaa fi mala dubartiiti
meaning_en: 'If you marry me, that is your choice; and whether I obey you is my choice,' said the maiden; a sharp rejoinder asserting female agency in marriage

proverb: Harmallaa du'a hin geeysani, tan ifii keeysa boochi
meaning_om: Gadda fi miidhaa dhuunfaa nama tokkorra gahe ormi guutummaatti qooddachuu hin danda'u; namni miidhame dhiphina isaa garaa keessatti baata
meaning_en: One cannot accompany a widow all the way into death; she weeps for her own solitary bereavement within; deepest personal grief is borne alone

proverb: Qaadhimaa wal agarsiisan malee, wal hin, barsiisani
meaning_om: Namni hiriyyaa yookaan kadhimaa walitti agarsiisuu danda'us, amala, jaalala fi walsimannaa isaanii murteessuu hin danda'u; bultiin kan abbaati
meaning_en: Outsiders can introduce suitors to one another, but they cannot teach them how to love or live together; marital compatibility is forged by the couple alone

proverb: Qaalli, ajaa udaaniiti nama jaalachiisa
meaning_om: Fedhiin, kajeellaan yookiin jaalalli cimaan wanta tokkorratti qaban humna guddaa qabaachuu isaatiin kan ka'e, wanta xuraa'aa fi jibbisiisaa wanta sana wajjin walqabatu illee akka jaallatan yookiin obsaan simatan nama godhuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Intense fondness, craving, or the compelling pull of an object of desire is so overpowering that it blinds human aversion, making even the most repulsive traits and foul realities—metaphorized by the stench of feces—tolerable and endearing

proverb: Qalbiin saree gara lafee
meaning_om: Namni amala yookaan kajeellaa tokkorratti ciche fedhiin isaa yeroo hunda gara wanta sanaatti harkifama; amala uumamaa geeddaruun rakkisaadha
meaning_en: The heart of a dog is perpetually turned toward bones; an individual's ingrained appetite always gravitates toward its natural obsession

proverb: "Yaa intala koo, koottu gabaa dhaqnaa" jennaan,"yaa soddaa koo, koottu sirba dhaqnaa" jette, intalli
meaning_om: Wanta dhimma bu'uuraa fi hojii ta'e dhiisanii gara taphaa fi bashannaanaatti fiiguu; wal-hubannoo fi dursa hojii dhabuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: When invited by an elder to the market for chores, the maiden retorted, 'Come let's go to the dance!'; satirizes prioritizing partying over serious duties
