proverb: "Waraabeysi heellee utaalaa?" jennaan, "keeysaahuu gama foonii" ja'an
meaning_om: Heellee sirba uumamaan kan dubartootaa qofa ta'ullee, namni bololaa fi dantaa dhuunfaa qabu faayidaa (foon) argachuuf jedhee safuu, uumamaa fi kabaja isaaf hin malle illee cabsee wanta hundumaa keessa lixee akka raawwatu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: Heellee is exclusively a traditional women's rhythmic jump-dance, but when driven by insatiable greed (meat), a shameless opportunist will abandon all decorum, social taboos, and dignity to perform the most uncharacteristic antics if it yields personal profit

proverb: Abjuun lukkuu firii boqqollooti
meaning_om: Namni kamuu wantuma fedhu, dharra'u fi jireenya isaatiif bu'uura ta'e qofa yaada fi abjoota; fedhiin namaa yaada isaa murteessa
meaning_en: The dream of a chicken is grains of corn; human ambitions and dreams strictly reflect their immediate needs, personal capacity, and daily appetites

proverb: Haasoyni waraabeysaa, foon foon ja'a
meaning_om: Namni kajeellaa fi bolola dhuunfaa qabu haasaa isaa hunda keessatti wantuma fedhii isaa guutu qofa kaasa; dantaan afaaniin mul'ata
meaning_en: The conversation of a hyena constantly repeats 'meat, meat'; an obsessed, greedy individual steers every conversation back to their own selfish appetite

proverb: Osoo kan erguus, kan ergamuus anuma tahee
meaning_om: Hojii fi itti-gaafatamummaan hundi harka ofii qofaan utuu raawwatamee nagaa fi qulqullina akka qabaatu hawwuu; namatti amanamuu dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: 'If only I were both the master who sends and the servant who is sent!'; expressing frustration with unreliable helpers and longing to do it all oneself

proverb: Habbuuqqataan wal fakkaata
meaning_om: Namoonni yookaan wantoonni garee ykn amala tokko qaban hundi isaanii walfakkaatu; tokko isa kaanirraa adda bahee kan wayyu yookaan caalu akka hin jirre ibsa
meaning_en: All caterpillars look alike; used to emphasize that individuals belonging to a certain group (especially scoundrels, corrupt actors, or flawed options) are cut from the exact same cloth—none is any better or more trustworthy than the rest

proverb: Waraabeysi guyyaa yuuse, gammachuu harree duute, laafaatu asrii darase gammachuu aduu dhiitee
meaning_om: Namni dhibaa'aan hojii jibbu guyyaan yoo dhihu akkuma waraabessa foon argetti gammada; dhibaa'ummaa fi bu'aa dhablummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: The hyena howled by day celebrating a dead donkey; the lazy sluggard celebrated at dusk that the sun was setting; mocks an idle worker who only rejoices at quitting time

proverb: Qalameen "maal feeta?" jennaan "qabsoo muka'rraati" jette
meaning_om: Namni dhimma uumamaan itti beeku fi dandeettii cimaa irratti qabu yeroo gaafatamu, wantuma isaaf salphaa fi faayidaa qabu filata; iddoo ofiitti dorgomuu filachuu
meaning_en: When asked what contest it desired, the monkey chose wrestling in the treetops; playing to one's natural strengths where one holds total competitive advantage

proverb: Duulli allaattii eege, allaattiin duula eeyde
meaning_om: Gama lachuuyyuu bu'aa walirraa barbaadan eeggachaa turanii yeroo wanti sun raawwatu walitti dhufuu; diinummaa fi dharraa foonii walitti makame agarsiisa
meaning_en: The military campaign awaited the scavenger birds, and the birds awaited the campaign; mutual opportunism where impending slaughter feeds waiting vultures

proverb: Tan akka walii, loon walitti bobbaafti
meaning_om: Namoonni sadarkaa, ilaalcha fi qabeenyaan wal gitan walfaana hojjetu, wal gargaaru; walqixxummaan michooma cimsa
meaning_en: Those of equal stature drive their cattle to pasture together; true cooperation and enduring partnership thrive best among peers of compatible standing

proverb: Hidda malee, xannachi hin dhiigu
meaning_om: Firoonni dhiigaa hangamiyyuu walitti aaran wal hin balleessan; yoo dhiigni fi hidda bu'uuraa hin tuqamin walitti dhiheenyi firaa hin dhumatu
meaning_en: Unless pierced to the deep vein, a gland does not bleed; blood ties and kinship bonds do not dissolve over petty disputes; blood is thicker than water

proverb: Harkisaaf uleen adda hin cinne
meaning_om: Qoccolloo fi wal-harkisuu yeroof uumamuun hariiroon firoomaa isa jabaa ta'e dafee hin citu; firoonni yoo wal dhabanis walitti deebi'u
meaning_en: A solid stick does not snap merely from pulling; strong kinship and bonded relationships do not shatter over temporary domestic tension

proverb: Hanga duuydaa, garaan hin jabaatu
meaning_om: Qophaa ofiitti jabaa ta'uun hin danda'amu; humni fi gootummaan nama tokkoo fira, maatii fi saba isa duuba jiruun mirkanaa'a
meaning_en: Individual courage can never match the strength of a supporting backbone; personal resolve is fragile without the steadfast backing of family and clan

proverb: Foontu fooniif hadooda
meaning_om: Namni fira dhiigaa ofiitiif dhiphata, miidhaan fira irra gahe isa miidha; jaalallii fi mararfannaan dhiigaa uumamaan nama keessa jira
meaning_en: Flesh aches with empathy for its own flesh; blood kin naturally feel deep, instinctual pain whenever disaster or grief befalls one of their own

proverb: Lafeen koo lafee keeti, lafeen kee lafee kooti
meaning_om: Tokkummaa dhiigaa, hidda qulqulluu fi hariiroo maatii isa gargar bahuu hin dandeenye agarsiisa; miidhaan kee kan kooti, guddinni kees kan kooti
meaning_en: My bone is your bone, and your bone is my bone; an expression of inseparable consanguinity and loyalty; your pain is my pain, and your honor is my honor

proverb: Migirri lagaa gubannaan, gingilchaan manaa booche
meaning_om: Balaan fira yookaan saba ofii fagootti mudate isa dhihoos ni gaddisiisa, ni yaaddessas; sababiin isaas hundeen isaanii tokkuma
meaning_en: When the thatch grass burned at the riverbank, the sieve wept in the house; calamity befalling kin at a distance deeply wounds relatives at home

proverb: Harreen wal dhiittu, ilkee walirraa hin cabsitu
meaning_om: Firoonni yoo wal lolanillee wal hin ajjeesan, miidhaa hamaa walirratti hin raawwatan; wal-dhabdeen maatii daangaa qaba
meaning_en: Donkeys kicking each other do not shatter each other's teeth; disputes and squabbles between family members have natural limits and avoid mutual ruin

proverb: Reefka nama ofii torba gara galchan
meaning_om: Gadda fi sirna awwaalcha fira ofiirratti mararfannaa, kunuunsa fi safeeffannaa daangaa hin qabnetu godhama; firaaf dursa kennuu ibsa
meaning_en: The corpse of one's own kin is turned over seven times with deep care; family members spare no tenderness and devotion when burying their own blood

proverb: Gosti gosatti galti jetteeti, erbeen loonitti galte
meaning_om: Namni kamuu akkuma fira fi saba ofiitti deebi'u, wanti hundi gara hundee isaatti harkifama; firoomaa fi hundee ofiitti makamuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Clan returns to clan,' said the scrap of rawhide as it joined the cattle herd; everything naturally gravitates back to its original source and kin

proverb: Maraataan ofii du'aan male, kan ormaa koflaan male
meaning_om: Rakkinni fi salphinni maatii ofii keessaa bahe gadda hamaa fida, kan nama biraa garuu ormaaf qoosaa fi kofla ta'a; firatu dhiphina kee danda'a
meaning_en: A madman in one's own family is a mortal sorrow, while an outsider's madman is a laughing matter; outsiders mock domestic tragedy that breaks a family's heart

proverb: Hiddi odaa gamaa, hidda odaa gamanaati
meaning_om: Sabni Oromoo fi firoonni bakka adda addaatti faffaca'anii jiraatanis, hundeen, aadaan fi dhiigni isaanii tokkuma; tokkummaa sabaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: The root of the sacred sycamore across the river is intertwined with the sycamore on this side; people separated by rivers share one indivisible heritage

proverb: Yoo reefkaa, mixiilleen reefka ofii lafatti hin dhiifne
meaning_om: Bineensi xiqqoon akka mixiituu reeffa fira ishee bakkeetti gattee kan hin deemne erga ta'ee, namni fira ofii gargaaruu fi kabajuu akka qabu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When it comes to a corpse, even the ant does not leave its dead behind; if even ants retrieve their fallen, humans have an inviolable duty to honor kin

proverb: Kan firaa fi kan biraa gara gara
meaning_om: Jaalalli, amanamummaan fi gargaarsi firaa kan nama alagaa wajjin wal hin gahu; yeroo rakkinaa firatu nama cinaa dhaabbata
meaning_en: Kin and outsiders are completely different; the deep loyalty, tolerance, and sacrifice of family can never be matched by a stranger

proverb: Itti aantiin reeffatti aanti
meaning_om: Yeroo gaddaa fi qorumsaa itti-gaafatamummaa guddaa kan fudhatu fi dursa aarsaa kan kaffalu fira dhiigaa isa dhihooti
meaning_en: The next of kin stands closest to the deceased; the greatest emotional, financial, and moral burden in times of tragedy falls squarely on nearest relatives

proverb: Hoomaa waraabessaa keessaa, fira hin dhabani
meaning_om: Bakka hamaa fi diina hedduun marfame keessattiyyuu, namni tokko gargaaraa, nama yaada gaarii qabu dhabuu hin danda'u; abdii hin kutatani
meaning_en: Even amidst a pack of predatory hyenas, one will find an ally; even in the most hostile environments, an unexpected protector will emerge

proverb: Magaalaan nama dhabaa hin iyyitu, fira dhabaaf iyyiti malee
meaning_om: Namoonni baay'een jiraachuu danda'u, garuu yeroo rakkoo nama siif dhimmu fi fira dhugaa argachuutu ulfaata; baay'ina osoo hin taane fira barbaadu
meaning_en: The town does not lament a shortage of people; it laments a shortage of genuine kin; bustling crowds are everywhere, but true allies are rare

proverb: Mixii fi Hookkoon gara ofiitti harkifti
meaning_om: Namni hundi uumamaan faayidaa, qabeenyaa fi nagaa gara ofiitti fi fira isaatti harkisuuf tattaafata; kajeellaa dhuunfaa fi firaaf looguu ibsa
meaning_en: Both the ant and the shepherd's crook pull everything toward themselves; human beings instinctively pull resources and loyalty toward their own kin

proverb: "Warri keessan kami" jennaan "gurguddoo afaan cumaa kana" je'e, waraabessi
meaning_om: Namoonni amala, hojii fi badiisa walfakkaataa qaban salphaatti wal beekanii walitti firoomu; hamoonni hamaa fira godhatu
meaning_en: 'Which ones are your family?' the hyena was asked; 'These big ones with blood-smeared mouths,' it replied; predators naturally identify with their own kind

proverb: "Afaan ajaa wajji yaa'uu dadhabneeti, wajji dhalootaaf addaan bahuu dadhabne" je'e, waraabessi
meaning_om: Fira amala badaa qabu danda'anii wajjin jiraachuun nama dhibus, hidda dhiigaatiif jecha addaan bahuun hin danda'amu; qormaata firoomaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'We couldn't stand roaming together due to foul breath, yet born of the same womb, we couldn't separate,' said the hyena; kinship binds despite flaws

proverb: Adeerri dhagaa baqaqe
meaning_om: Adeerri akkuma dhagaa jabaa fi laafina hin qabneetti ilaallama; mararfannaa fi jaalala haadhaa fi eessumaa hin qabu jedhanii aadaa keessatti ibsu
meaning_en: A paternal uncle is like cracked rock; traditional folk observation contrasting the stern nature of paternal kin with maternal tenderness

proverb: Eysumni, haadha harma hin qabne
meaning_om: Eessumni akkuma haadhaa jaalala, gara-laafina fi kunuunsa guddaa namaaf qaba; hariiroo jaalala eessumaa faarsa
meaning_en: A maternal uncle is like a mother without breasts; celebrates the immense love, tenderness, and maternal indulgence shown by mother's brothers

proverb: Yoo funyaan dhawan, ijji ni imimmaawa
meaning_om: Namni fira dhiigaa ta'e yoo miidhame, firoonni kaan dhukkubbii fi gadda sana qooddachuun waliin miidhamu; tokkummaa dhiigaa ibsa
meaning_en: When the nose is struck, the eye weeps; injury inflicted upon one family member immediately causes shared pain and tears across the entire clan

proverb: Qabeenyaa fi fageenyaatu fira wal jaalachiisa
meaning_om: Firoonni yoo qabeenyaan wal hin sarbin fi yoo iddoon muraasa walirraa fagaatan kabajaa fi jaalalli isaanii daran cimee tura
meaning_en: Wealth and distance make relatives love one another; maintaining independent means and healthy physical space preserves mutual fondness and prevents friction

proverb: Foon gubbaa muran, lafeen jalatti mul'ata
meaning_om: Dhimma alaa fi wanta laafaa erga dhabamsiisanii booda, hundeen fi dhugaan jabaan keessoo ifatti baha; firoonni qorumsa keessatti hundee isaanii calaqqisiisu
meaning_en: Slice off the flesh above, and the underlying bone is revealed; strip away superficial layers, and core structural reality stands bare

proverb: Nafa ofiitu, abbaa naha
meaning_om: Balaan yeroo dhufu kan dhugumaan namaaf nahee birmatee fi yaadda'u fira dhiigaa fi nama ofiiti malee alagaan miti
meaning_en: It is one's own flesh that shudders with protective concern for a person; genuine panic and anxiety for your safety come only from your own family

proverb: Ormi booyeeti galaa, rakkoon warratti hafa
meaning_om: Yeroo gaddaa ormi dhufee yeroof erga boo'ee booda gara mana isaatti gala; ba'aa fi dhiphinni gaddichaa garuu maatiima irratti hafa
meaning_en: Outsiders weep and then go home, but the hardship remains with the household; transient mourners disperse, leaving the permanent loss to the family

proverb: Kan wal hore, wal hin tuffatu
meaning_om: Namoonni sanyii fi dhiigaan walitti hidhamanii fi wal horan wal hin tuffatan; dhaloonni tokkummaa fi kabaja uuma
meaning_en: Those who have multiplied and woven lineages together do not look down upon each other; shared progeny and ancestry demand mutual respect

proverb: Manni harree, dhiitee garaa wal hin baqaysu
meaning_om: Firoonni yoo wal lolanillee miidhaa lubbuu galaafatu walirratti hin raawwatan; qoccolloon firaa daangaa nagaa hin dhabu
meaning_en: A family of donkeys kicks each other, yet they never rupture each other's bellies; internal family strife may involve rough kicks, but kin avoid fatal harm

proverb: Mana kan aaru hin seenanii, kan aanu seenani
meaning_om: Bakka aarii, wacaa fi lolaatti deemuu mannaa, gara fira dhihoo isa nagaa fi jaalala qabuutti deemanii boqochuutu caala
meaning_en: One does not enter the house that fumes with smoke and rage; one enters the house of near kin; seek refuge where genuine kinship and peace exist

proverb: Marrimaan garaa tokkoo, dhiitee wal hin ajjeesu
meaning_om: Obbolaan garaa tokkoo yoo wal dhabanis diinummaa dhugaatiin wal hin galaafatan; tokkummaan garaa tokkoo wal eega
meaning_en: Entrails within the same belly may churn and collide, but they do not slay each other; siblings from the same womb may clash, but blood prevents murder

proverb: Manni arbaa wal hin dhawu
meaning_om: Namoonni gurguddoon, jajjaboon fi maatiin ulfina qaban nagaa isaanii eeggatu malee wal dhiitanii of hin salphisan; kabaja maatii eeguu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A herd of elephants does not turn against one another; mighty, dignified families preserve unity and settle disputes with quiet majesty rather than infighting

proverb: Quba ofii, tortore jedhanii muranii hin darbani
meaning_om: Fira ofii sababa inni hanqina yookaan amala badaa qabaateef salphaatti gatuun hin danda'amu; wal'aananii qajeelchuutu fala
meaning_en: One does not chop off and discard one's finger because it has festered; one does not abandon a flawed relative; family heals and endures its own

proverb: Qunceen muka tokkoo, muka biraa hin taatu
meaning_om: Namni hundee, sanyii fi aadaa isaatiin ala ta'ee gara ormaatti guutummaatti jijjiiramuu hin danda'u; hundeen namaa hin jijjiiramu
meaning_en: The bark of one tree will never fit onto another tree; a person cannot sever their innate roots or pretend to become part of an unrelated lineage; roots are immutable

proverb: Muknilleen baala qaba
meaning_om: Namni kamuu akkuma mukti damee fi baala qabu, fira, maatii fi deggartoota isa utuban qaba; kophummaan kan nama uumamaa miti
meaning_en: Even a lone tree has leaves; every human being has kin, connections, and roots to lean on; complete isolation is contrary to the natural order

proverb: Gaarri dhagaan boona
meaning_om: Sabni yookaan maatiin miseensota, dargaggoota fi firoota jajjaboo qabaniin kabajama, boonas; humni namaa fira isaati
meaning_en: A mountain takes pride in its solid rocks; a community or family derives strength, majesty, and dignity from its steadfast members and loyal kinsmen

proverb: Mataan Karaa baheen hin wallaalu
meaning_om: Namni kamuu bakka dhalootaa, maatii fi hundee isaa gonkumaa hin dagatu; hundee ofiitti deebi'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The head never forgets the path by which it emerged; a person never forgets their origins, mother, and lineage, always recognizing where they came from

proverb: Alagaa gaaffa koflaa, fira gaafa rakkoo
meaning_om: Namoonni ormaa yeroo nagaa fi quufaa nama wajjin kolfanii gammadu, garuu gaafa rakkinaa fi dhiphinaa firatu nama cinaa dhaabbata; fira dhugaa beekuu
meaning_en: Outsiders are companions for days of laughter, but kin are the refuge for days of trial; fair-weather friends feast with you, but family stands with you in adversity

proverb: Alagaa wajjiin nyaadhuu, fira keetitti gara galii liqimsi
meaning_om: Orma wajjin hariiroo fi daldala yoo qabaatteyyuu, amanamummaa, faayidaa fi iccitii kee isa dhugaa gara fira keetti daddabarsi; firaaf dursa kennuu
meaning_en: Dine with the outsider, but turn toward your kin to swallow; conduct business diplomatically with the world, but direct your deepest loyalty and fruits to your own people

proverb: Yoo hojii yaa diina koo,yoo nyaataa yaa fira koo
meaning_om: Namni faayidaa fi quufa qofa barbaadu yeroo hojii baqatee akka diinaatti ilaala, yeroo nyaataa fi qananii ammoo akka fira dhihootti of dhiheessa
meaning_en: 'When it is work, you treat me like an enemy; when it is a feast, you call me your closest kin!'; mocks fair-weather opportunists who shun labor but rush to eat

proverb: Hamaa koo, hamataa koo
meaning_om: Firi ofii hangamiyyuu amala badaa qabaatee nama hamatu, dhuma irratti firummaan isaa hin hafu, namumuma ofiiti; fira ofii qoranii gatuun akka hin danda'amne agarsiisa
meaning_en: Flawed and backbiting though he may be, he is still my kin; acknowledging that one's imperfect relatives remain family and cannot simply be discarded

proverb: Shanyiin lugaama caala nama butti
meaning_om: Dhiigni fi sanyiin namaa amala, dandeettii fi murtoo namaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qaba; akkuma lugaamni farda qajeelchu, sanyiinis gara hundee isaatti nama harkisa
meaning_en: Bloodline and ancestry steer a person more forcefully than a horse's bridle; one's lineage and genetic nature exert an irresistible pull on conduct

proverb: Gaaratti gadamsa waraannaan, danbalitti harree gurri dhiige
meaning_om: Wanta walitti hidhamiinsa hin qabne fakkaatu garuu sababa fageenyaan wal qunnamaa ta'een miidhaan bakka tokkotti dhufe bakka biraattis calaqqisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: They speared a kudu on the mountain, yet the donkey's ear bled down on the plain; satirizes absurd excuses, or how remote disputes hurt distant innocents

proverb: Saani ibidda dhale, arraabuuf ni guba, dhiisuuf ilmoodha itti tahe
meaning_om: Ijoolleen yookaan firi amala badaa qabaatee nama rakkisu garuu gatuun hin danda'amne; jaalala maatii fi rakkina gidduutti cinqamuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The cow gave birth to fire; licking it burns her, but leaving it, it is her calf; captures the dilemma of loving a destructive child whom you cannot abandon

proverb: Firaa fi ijji, tuqaa hin danda'an
meaning_om: Akkuma ijji xurii fi tuqaa xiqqoo hin dandeenye, hariiroon firoomaas baay'ee laafaa fi safeeffannaa kan barbaadudha; miidhaa fi qoccolloo dafee mufata
meaning_en: Relatives and the eye cannot tolerate being poked; just as the human eye is acutely sensitive to dust, kinship bonds are delicate and easily bruised by mistreatment

proverb: Harki, ceekuun garatti aana
meaning_om: Namni kamuu yeroo dhimmi dhufe dursa nama dhiigaa fi fira isaatti aana; namummaan gara maatii ofiitti looga
meaning_en: The hand, through the shoulder, is joined closest to the chest; people naturally side with, defend, and favor their own flesh and blood in times of conflict

proverb: Alagaa koflaatu guddaa dha, fira imimmaaniitu guddaa dha
meaning_om: Ormi yeroo nagaa fi koflaa qofa nama cinaa jiraata; firi dhiigaa garuu yeroo gaddaa fi boo'ichaa dhiphina namaa qooddata; fira dhugaa beekuu
meaning_en: With a stranger, laughter and feasting dominate; with true kin, shared tears and grief are profound; fair-weather companions feast, but family weeps with you

proverb: Obboleessi kan wajji dhalatan qofaa miti
meaning_om: Obbolummaan hidda dhiigaa qofaan osoo hin taane, jaalala, amanamummaa fi wal-deeggarsa dhugaatiinis kan ijaaramu ta'uu ibsa; michuu gaariin akka obboleessaati
meaning_en: A brother is not merely someone born from the same womb; true brotherhood is forged through unwavering loyalty, love, sacrifice, and mutual support

proverb: Wal lolanii, darba wal hin geeysani
meaning_om: Firoonni yoo wal lolanis daangaa eeggatu; diinatti dabarsee wal kennuu yookaan wal barbadeessuun safuu akka ta'e agarsiisa
meaning_en: Relatives may fight among themselves, but they never deliver each other over to destruction or enemies; internal strife observes sacred protective bounds

proverb: Lammiin qola ijaati wal beekti
meaning_om: Namoonni saba, aadaa fi hidda tokko qaban mallattoo xiqqoo fi ilaalcha qofaan wal hubatu; qunnamtiin dhiigaa ifa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: Compatriots and kin recognize one another by a mere flicker of the eyelid; those sharing common blood understand each other through subtle glances

proverb: Lammiin walitti hin keessummattu
meaning_om: Firoonni fi namoonni hidda tokko qaban yeroo wal bira ga'an safeeffannaa fi keessummeessaa ormaa dhiisanii akka nama manaa ta'anii jiraatu; dhiheenya firaa ibsa
meaning_en: Kinsmen do not act like formal guests in each other's homes; true relatives discard stiff formalities and feel completely at home among their own people

proverb: Wasaasaan fira argitee gaggabdi
meaning_om: Wasaasaan reeffa nama kamiyyuu tasgabbii fi garaa jabinaan baachuuf kan tolfamte taatus, gaafa fira ofii argitu garuu baachuu dadhabdee mararfannaa fi gaddaan gaggabdi; namni hammam jabaa, dhibee ormaatiin kan bare yookaan stooyikii ta'ullee, gaafa dhimmi fira dhiiga ofii dhufe garaa laafee kufuu jalaa akka hin oolle agarsiisa
meaning_en: Even the funeral bier, an instrument constructed solely to carry corpses and endure bereavement without flinching, faints with overwhelming grief when it encounters its own kin; illustrates that no matter how hardened, professional, or stoic someone is when dealing with death, no one can remain indifferent when tragedy strikes their own flesh and blood

proverb: "Chaa" jennaan harree gurri tokko
meaning_om: Ajaja yookaan qajeelfama beekamaa tokkoof xiyyeeffannaa guutuu kennuu; akkasumas wanta barame tokkoof gurra qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When the driver commands 'Chaa!', the donkey pricks its ear; obeying an unmistakable call and knowing when a command is directed straight at oneself

proverb: Firii qabaachuu irra, fira qabaachuu wayya
meaning_om: Qabeenyi fi midhaan dhumuu danda'u, garuu firi dhugaan yeroo hundumaa nama cinaa dhaabbata; qabeenya caalaa namatti hirkachuutu caala
meaning_en: Having living kin is far better than merely possessing harvest and wealth; material riches perish, but loyal kinsmen provide enduring protection

proverb: Fira gadab du'ee hin dhaga'anii, gabumaa dhabanii
meaning_om: Firoonni yoo fagaatanii wal dhaban, rakkoon akkamii illee osoo irra ga'ee hin dhaga'amu; fageenyi wal qunnamtii dhowwee gadda nama dhoksa
meaning_en: One never hears whether distant kin perished of famine; one simply lacks news of them; physical alienation keeps relatives tragically ignorant of suffering

proverb: Firri gara firaa jennaan, taguugni gara dikee ceehe
meaning_om: Namni kamuu akkuma fira fi saba ofiitti deebi'u, wanti hundi gara hundee isaatti harkifama; firoomaa fi hundee ofiitti makamuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: When they declared 'Kin gravitates toward kin', the dung-made grain bin hopped straight to the manure pile!; humorously shows return to original roots

proverb: Kan ifiitu kan ifiitii, Gobeelletti naan fiigi
meaning_om: Qabeenyi yookaan firi nama ofii kan dhugaan beekamu yeroo qorumsi cimaan kan akka laga Gobeellee ce'uu nama mudatuudha; nama amansiisaa qabaachuu
meaning_en: 'One's own is truly one's own; now gallop with me across the roaring Gobeelle River!'; the ultimate test of a trusted ally is charging through mortal danger

proverb: Falli galaanaa, seenuu dhabuu dha
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan qorumsa humnaa olii ta'e jalaa ooluuf filannoon duraa itti dhihaachuu dhiisuudha; ittisa dursuu ibsa
meaning_en: The only sure remedy for a raging river is to not step into it; the best solution for overwhelming peril or lethal conflict is total avoidance and prevention

proverb: Uraa huccuu, walitti hodhan
meaning_om: Wal-dhabdee, mufannaa fi qoccolloo maatii yookaan namoota gidduutti uumame nagaan, araaraan fi jaarsummaan walitti dhiheessanii suphuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: A tear in cloth is stitched back together; social tears, disputes, and family rifts must be mended through mediation, forgiveness, and reconciliation

proverb: Hiddaa fi hiddiin tokko miti
meaning_om: Wanti bifa walfakkaatu qabaatus faayidaa fi amalaan adda adda; wanta hundumaa akkuma qulqullina isaatti adda baasuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A deep nourishing root and a toxic, prickly Sodom-apple are not the same; do not equate genuine substance with harmful or cheap phoniness

proverb: Qoree qoreen baasani
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan diina cimaa tokko furuuf wantuma akkasaatti qara qabu fi walfakkaatutti fayyadamuun furmaata fida; toftaa toftaadhaan mo'uu
meaning_en: One removes a thorn with another thorn; resolving a stubborn, sharp problem requires employing an equally sharp, matching counter-measure or strategy

proverb: Heexoo heexoon baasani
meaning_om: Dhukkuba yookaan aadaa rakkisaa tokko fayyisuuf wantuma hadhaawaa fi walxaxaa ta'etti fayyadamuun dirqama ta'a; furmaata hadhaawaa fudhachuu
meaning_en: Tapeworm is purged using bitter tapeworm medicine; bitter and severe problems demand equally bitter, drastic remedies; healing requires enduring medicine

proverb: Kijiba ragaatu fageessa
meaning_om: Sobni fi ololli hangamiyyuu bal'atee yoo odeeffame, ragaan qabatamaan yeroo dhihaatu sobni sun fashalee dhugaan ifatti baha; dhugaan ragaadhaan mul'ata
meaning_en: Clear evidence chases falsehood far away; no matter how loudly lies or slander circulate, presenting verified proof completely shatters the deceit

proverb: Teepha teephaan faxan
meaning_om: Wanta jabaa fi goggogaa ta'e tokko lallafisuuf wantuma akkasaatti jabaa ta'etti fayyadamu; nama cimaa nama cimaatu qajeelcha
meaning_en: A tough leather strap is smoothed and softened by rubbing it against another leather strap; disciplining a stubborn person requires equal fortitude

proverb: Qonna didu, qalma didaa?
meaning_om: Namni yookaan beeyladni hojii fi tajaajila barbaadamu didnaan, murtii dhumaa fi tarkaanfii jabaa irraa ooluu hin danda'u; diddaan adaba dhumaa fida
meaning_en: If the ox refuses to plow, can it refuse the butcher's knife?; if someone stubbornly refuses constructive duty, they will inevitably face harsh consequences

proverb: Sa'a ilmoo dide duratti qaban, ilmoo haadha didde ni qalan
meaning_om: Maatii fi sirna keessatti isa guddaatu obsee akka qajeelu toftaan godhama; garuu inni xiqqaan diddaa kaasee maatii yoo tuffate adabbiin isaa hamaadha
meaning_en: A mother cow refusing her calf is gently restrained to nurse; but a calf that refuses its mother is slaughtered; youth defying parental roots face severe discipline

proverb: Nama dubbiin si dhibe, callisuun dhibi
meaning_om: Nama afaan dheeraa fi falmii hin dhumne qabu wajjin qoccoluu mannaa, callisuudhaan qaanfachiisuun furmaata isa caaluudha; callisuun deebii beekaati
meaning_en: A person whose ceaseless arguing baffles you, confound him with silence; when dealing with an irrational talker, dignified silence is the ultimate weapon

proverb: Karaa dheeraa miilaatu gabaabsa, dubbi dheeraa jaarsaatu gabaabsa
meaning_om: Akkuma deemsi fageenya qabu tarkaanfii walirraa hin cinneen xumuramu, falmiin walxaxaanis ogummaa fi araara jaarsoliitiin furmaata saffisaa argata
meaning_en: A long road is shortened by persistent footsteps; a protracted dispute is cut short by the wisdom of elders; elder mediation resolves bitter feuds

proverb: Malaaf malli jira, mucaaf harmi jira
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan shira kamiifiyyuu furmaataa fi toftaan madaalu akka jiru; akkuma daa'imni harma dhabee hin beelofne dhimmi hunduu fala qaba
meaning_en: For every problem there is a counter-strategy, just as for every infant there is mother's milk; no predicament is without a viable solution in life

proverb: Dubbii jallatte jaarsaatu diriirsa, guyyaa jallate baraatu diriirsa
meaning_om: Wal-dhabdee fi jal'ina yaadaa jaarsolii ogeeyyiitu qajeelcha; rakkinaa fi qorumsa yeroo garuu obsaan yeroo eeggachuutu furmaata fida
meaning_en: A twisted dispute is straightened out by a wise elder; a crooked day or misfortune is straightened out by time and changing seasons; trust in elder wisdom

proverb: Dubbii dhiira dhibde, dhiira itti barbaadani
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan falmii cimaa furamuu dadhabe hayyoota fi namoota dandeettii ol-aanaa qaban waamuun furmaata barbaadu; ogummaa dabalataa barbaaduu ibsa
meaning_en: A dispute that has baffled capable men calls for even wiser men to resolve it; when a complex issue defies local mediation, seek master mediators

proverb: Dubbii yokiin ni fayyisani, yokiin fayya irraa galani
meaning_om: Falmii keessatti yookaan dhimma sana araaraan fixanii nagaa buusu, yoo ta'uu baate garuu lolaa fi badii malee nagaan ofirraa dhiisanii bahuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: In a dispute, either heal and resolve it, or walk away safe and whole; either bring about genuine reconciliation, or disengage without bloodshed

proverb: Wal taatu walitti naqan, wal diddu addaan naqan
meaning_om: Namoonni waliigaltee fi jaalala qaban tokkummaan akka jiraatan godhama; yoo walii galuu dadhaban garuu lola ittisuuf addaan baasuun furmaata ta'a
meaning_en: If they are compatible, bring them together; if they clash in irreconcilable dispute, separate them; enforce peaceful separation when discord is toxic

proverb: Wal taanu miila, wal tahuu dhabnu miila miila
meaning_om: Waliigalteen yoo jiraate tokkummaan wajjin socho'u, garuu yoo walta'iinsi dhabame nagaan addaan fagaatanii daandii dhuunfaa hordofuun lola dhowwa
meaning_en: If we agree, we move together as one; if we disagree, let each walk their own separate way; irreconcilable differences call for peaceful parting

proverb: Qaawa jallaa, muka jalla kaayan
meaning_om: Dhimma yookaan rakkoo walxaxaa fi qajeelloo hin taane furuuf, maluma isa madaalu fi toftaa walfakkaatu fayyadamuun furmaata fida
meaning_en: Into a crooked aperture, place a crooked wooden peg; irregular problems require customized, matching unconventional remedies to fit the irregular gap

proverb: Nama fincaan guddatu, qota jelatti wayyeessani
meaning_om: Hanqina yookaan dadhabina dhaabbataa nama tokkoo erga beekanii booda, ceepha'uu dhiisanii qophii fi ittisa isa madaalu godhanii miidhaa salphisuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: For someone who habitually wets the bed, improve the drainage beneath them; adapt precautions to manage and minimize chronic flaws rather than scolding

proverb: Abaar buusee qanqalloo si hin dhoorkin
meaning_om: Waaqayyo yoo hongee fi rakkina fideyyuu, hamamiyyuu yoo dhiphatee wanta ittiin dabarfataniifi galaa ittiin tursiisan akka hin dhabsiifne hawwuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Even if God sends a drought, may He not deny you the grain sack; wishing that even during severe famine, one retains stored provisions to survive

proverb: Rabbi Cittoo(hooyxoo) namatti buuse, qeensa nama hin dhoorku
meaning_om: Waaqayyo nama irratti qorumsa yoo fide, qorumsa sana ittiin dandamataniifi ittiin of oolchan mala fi dandeettii namaaf kenna; qormaanni hunduu fala qaba
meaning_en: If God afflicts a person with an itch, He does not deny them fingernails; for every trial God ordains, He provides the matching endurance and relief

proverb: Huccuun if dadhabdu, qoybaa hin dadhabdu
meaning_om: Wanti tokko hangamiyyuu yoo dulloome yookaan gatii dhabe, faayidaa xiqqoo tokkoof ooluu hin dhabu; homtuu guutummaatti gatii hin dhabu
meaning_en: Even if a garment is worn threadbare, it can still serve as a waist-tie; even when an asset is past its prime, it retains humble practical utility

proverb: Afaan bal'aa walitti qabanii dhungatan
meaning_om: Dhimma bal'aa, walxaxaa fi rakkisaa ta'e tokko tasgabbaa'anii, yaada walitti qabanii fi toftaan furuun barbaachisaadha; wanta bal'aa to'annaa jala oolchuu
meaning_en: A wide mouth is gathered together to be kissed; managing a sprawling problem requires gathering loose ends and handling it with gentle care

proverb: Dubbi jallatte jaarsaatu diriirsa, gonnoo jallatte harreetu diriirsa
meaning_om: Dubbiin walxaxee fi jallate ogummaa jaarsolii biyyaatiin qajeela; akkuma uumamaan harreen gonnoo ishee qajeelchitu, wanti jallate kamuu qaama uumamaan isa diriirsu qaba; jaarsummaa ol-aanaa fi uumama lafaa wal bira qabuun dhimma hundumaafuu wanti qajeelchu jiraachuu ibsa
meaning_en: A twisted, crooked dispute is straightened out by the wisdom of an elder, just as a crooked member is straightened by the donkey; humorously pairs high-minded council mediation with earthy animal reality to show that every crooked, awkward thing has its own natural rectifier

proverb: Argatan makriibaa, dhaban hirriiba
meaning_om: Yeroo argatan nyaatanii gammaduu, yeroo dhaban ammoo obsaan rafuun jireenya dabarfatanii carraatti quufuu agarsiisa; haala jiru fudhachuu
meaning_en: If they find food, it is a sunset feast; if they find none, it is sleep; philosophical acceptance of life's swings, feasting when blessed and sleeping off hunger

proverb: Qabaattu burree obaafadhu, dhabdu burree qoraafadhu
meaning_om: Yeroo qabeenyi jiru kunuunsanii tursiisuu, yeroo dhabaniis wantuma jiru irraa hanga danda'anitti fayyadamaa jireenya itti fufuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When you have abundance, water and pamper your cow; when destitute, scrape its hide; adjust your methods to fit whether you are in wealth or poverty

proverb: Horii fi maraataa hidhaatu dandaya
meaning_om: Beeylada fi nama qalbii hin qabne afaaniin gorsuun gatii hin qabu; seerii fi to'annoo cimaan qofa toora qabsiisa
meaning_en: Both livestock and a madman can only be controlled by tethering; speech and reason are futile with irrational forces; only firm containment works

proverb: Ebeloo sooraa qirimaatu tolaa, qirima dhaban dhidhimaatu tola
meaning_om: Qorra cimaa fi qabbana keessatti wanti nama ho'isee jireenyaaf tolu qirixxoo yookaan akaayii qirimuudha; yoo wanti nyaatamu dhabame ammoo mana ykn afata keessa dhokatanii qabbana sana ofirraa ittisuun fala ta'uu agarsiisa; haala qorisiisaa fi rakkina keessatti madaqanii of oolchuu barsiisa
meaning_en: In bitter cold weather, warm roasted grain is the ideal comforting food; but if grain is lacking, tucking oneself into shelter and lying low is best; teaches sensible adaptation during harsh seasons—either sustain yourself with warm food, or hunker down under cover to conserve strength

proverb: Nama qarri namaa irratti walii gale, qara waraanaatiin ajjeesan
meaning_om: Namni hawaasni guutuun irratti walii galee maqaa balleesse yookaan jibbetti xumurri isaa salphinaa fi badiisa ta'a; sagaleen ummataa murtii fida
meaning_en: A person against whom community consensus has united will be felled by the spear point; unanimous public condemnation swiftly leads to total ruin

proverb: Bakka adurreen jirtutti, hantuunni hin qooqu
meaning_om: Bakka hoggansi cimaan, seerrii fi qorataan jiru namni badii hojjetu sagalee hin baasu, ni sodaata; to'annoo jabaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Where the cat is present, the mouse does not squeak; petty troublemakers, thieves, and cowards keep utter silence when authority and power are present

proverb: Bakka beekaan jirutti, wallaalli hin heddummaatu
meaning_om: Hawaasa hayyuu fi beekaa qabu keessatti dogoggorri fi wallaalummaan iddoo hin qabaatu; beekaan dhugaa ifoomsee wallaala dhabamsiisa
meaning_en: Where a wise person is present, ignorance does not proliferate; an enlightened mind and righteous leader enlighten the community and check foolishness

proverb: Haa hadhooftu malee, heexoon namaaf qoricha
meaning_om: Dhugaan, gorsi sirriin fi adabbiin hadhaawaa yoo ta'ellee bu'aan isaa fayyina fi guddina fida; dhugaa hadhooftu fudhachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Bitter though it may be, tapeworm medicine is a cure; constructive criticism, hard truths, and painful discipline taste bitter but restore health

proverb: Ijibbaanni surree (shaqaxii dhadhaa) aduu dha
meaning_om: Wanta laafaa fi bu'uura hin qabne tokko qorumsa cimaan salphaatti barbadeessa; fakkeessaan qormaata dura dhaabbachuu hin danda'u
meaning_en: The ultimate ruin of pants made of butter is the scorching sun; a fragile, superficial pretense will melt into utter ruin the moment real pressure is applied

proverb: Hidhaan dhiiraaf qoraasuma
meaning_om: Dhiirri jabaan yoo hidhamee fi qorame hin laafu, caalaatti jabaatee fi bilchaatee baha; qorumsi gootummaa gabbisa
meaning_en: Imprisonment is mere tempering for a real man; hardship, persecution, and jail only temper, steel, and mature a courageous soul like iron in the forge

proverb: Jaarsaaf aduu fi adii qoricha
meaning_om: Maanguddoof wanti humna fi nagaa kennu oowwa aduu fi aannan qulqulluudha; kunuunsa maanguddootaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: For an elder, the gentle sun and white milk are the truest medicine; elderhood requires simple comforts—soothing warmth and wholesome nourishment

proverb: Waraabeysa, ulee beekuuni dhawan
meaning_om: Diina yookaan nama amala badaa qabu to'achuuf wantuma duraan isa cabse yookaan tooftaa inni beekee sodaatutti fayyadamuun bu'aa fida
meaning_en: A hyena is struck with the stick it already knows; subdue a brazen adversary using the exact disciplinary measure and force they have learned to fear

proverb: Buqqeen gadaa argatte dhaga cabsiti
meaning_om: Namni laafaan yookaan harka-qalleessi yeroo carraa fi aangoo argatetti wanta cimaa fi hin yaadamne raawwachuu danda'a; carraan wanta laafaa jabeessa
meaning_en: A fragile gourd that finds its favorable era can shatter a rock; when granted opportunity and power, even the weak and unassuming can topple the mighty

proverb: Bara tokko tokko, hantuunni gaachana qaba
meaning_om: Yeroon yoo geeddaramu wanti laafaan fi sodaataan akka nama cimaatti jabaatee of ittisuu danda'a; jijjiirama yeroo agarsiisa
meaning_en: In certain eras, even a mouse carries a shield; during times of social upheaval, even the timid, meek, and defenseless take up arms and assert themselves

proverb: Bara kanniisni moohe, tiitichi nama sodaachisa
meaning_om: Yeroo warri jajjaboon roorrisanitti, warri laafaanis maqaa isaaniitiin dhaadachaa namatti of gurguru; humna nama biraatti hirkachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: In the era when bees reign supreme, even the fly intimidates humans; weak subordinates exploit the terror of their mighty masters to bully others

proverb: "Bara" jette, handaaqqoon farda dhiitte
meaning_om: Yeroo fi haalli jijjiiramnaan namni laafaan fi humna hin qabne illee nama jabaatti akka roorrisuuf yaalu qishnaan agarsiisa; daangaa ofii beekuu dhabuu
meaning_en: 'Such are the times!' said the chicken as it kicked the horse; satirizes an insignificant person emboldened by chaotic times to insolently challenge the mighty

proverb: Bara bofni hammaate, horanguddaan(looccuun) ija namatti babaasa
meaning_om: Yeroo hamoonni fi roorristoonni biyya dhuunfatanitti, namoonni dadhaboo fi homaa hin taanes akka waan hamaa ta'aniitti namatti boonu
meaning_en: In the season when vipers proliferate, even the harmless skink glares at humans; petty cowards adopt aggressive postures under the shadow of deadly forces

proverb: Bofni baddaa nama nyaannaan, horanguddaan gammoojjii mataa lullule
meaning_om: Wanta namni cimaan bakka fagotti hojjeteen namni laafaan bakka biraatti akka waan ofii hojjetetti dhaadachuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Because a highland serpent bit a man, a lowland lizard bobs its head in triumph; mocks acting tough over terror caused by someone else far away

proverb: Bara leenci nama nyaate, focciin dalga nama ilaalti
meaning_om: Yeroo namoonni jajjaboon namatti roorrisanitti, warri xixiqqoon dandeettii hin qabnes tuffii fi ija laafaan nama ilaaluu jalqabu
meaning_en: In the season when the lion devours men, even the scruffy wildcat glares sideways in contempt; when giants oppress you, even minor pests display disdain

proverb: Awwaanisni samiirra marraan, korophiisni lafaa mumunyuuqe
meaning_om: Namni xiqqaan yeroo warri gurguddoon socho'an wantuma isaaniitiin kaka'ee akkuma isaaniitti of agarsiisuuf tattaafachuu ibsa; hordoffii sobaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: When the locust swarm roared across the sky, the tiny grasshopper wiggled proudly on the ground; mocks minor figures bustling about to mimic vast movements

proverb: Hantuunni guddatu, eebo ofirratti ciniina
meaning_om: Namni xiqqaan yeroo of tuulu wanta humnaa olii fi balaa lubbuu isaatti fidu keessa seenee of miidha; of tuulummaan badiisa fida
meaning_en: A mouse that grows overly bold chews upon the shaft of a spear to its own ruin; when an insignificant person arrogantly challenges lethal weapons, they court doom

proverb: Galanni Siree dha
meaning_om: Namni tola oolmaaf galata deebisu kabajaa, nagaa fi boqonnaa qalbii argata; galanni hariiroo namaa miidhagsee tasgabbii fida
meaning_en: Gratitude is a resting couch; showing heartfelt gratitude provides comfort, peace, and restful harmony in relationships, creating a bed of honor

proverb: Hijaan qoree dha, galanni afata
meaning_om: Haaloo fi hijaa ba'achuun akka qoreetti nama waraanee nagaa dhabsiisa; tola-oolmaaf galata deebisuun garuu akkuma afata laafaatti nagaa, tasgabbii fi boqonnaa qalbii namaaf kenna
meaning_en: Nursing revenge or seeking retaliation pierces and poisons like a sharp thorn; returning kindness with gratitude, however, lays down a soft, welcoming bedding of peace, trust, and mutual comfort

proverb: Farda kennaa, ilkee hin ilaalan
meaning_om: Wanta tola yookaan kennaadhaan namaaf kenname hanqina isaa qoruu dhiisanii galataan fudhachuun aadaa fi safuudha; kennaa tuffachuu dhowwa
meaning_en: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth; one should never inspect or critique the flaws of a free gift, but accept it with gracious gratitude

proverb: Nama goromsa dorrobaa qabu, siila/silga hin dhoorkatan
meaning_om: Nama bor bu'aa fi qabeenya guddaa argachuuf deemuuf har'a tola ooluun gaariidha, sababiin isaas inni bor siif deebisa; wal gargaaruu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One does not withhold colostrum from someone whose heifer is about to calve; sharing with someone who will soon have abundance ensures mutual reciprocity

proverb: Kennaa, abbaatu guddifata
meaning_om: Kennaan Waaqayyo namaaf kenne xiqqoollee yoo taate, abbaatu tattaaffii fi kunuunsaan guddifatee bu'a-qabeessa godhata; dandeettii ofii gabbifachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A gift or talent is magnified by its owner; whether a material present or an innate talent, its ultimate worth depends entirely on how the receiver cultivates it

proverb: Namni shaniin kenne, shan agabuu hin bulu
meaning_om: Namni harka bal'isee, quba shaniinuu gumaachuudhaan arjummaadhaan nama gargaaru gonkumaa beela hamaa fi dararaa dheeraa keessa hin bu'u; doqnummaa malee harka guutuun kennuun eebba fi rizqii Waaqayyoo waan harkisuuf abbaa hin beelessu
meaning_en: One who gives open-handedly with all five fingers (practicing wholehearted, generous charity rather than a stingy pinch) will never be abandoned to prolonged hunger; open-handed benevolence brings divine replenishment and ensures the giver never suffers deprivation

proverb: Wajji nyaatanii, wal hin nyaatan
meaning_om: Namoonni maaddii tokkorraa waliin sooratan amanamummaa fi safuu qabaachuu qabu malee wal irratti shira xaxuu hin qaban; kabaja maaddii eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: Having broken bread and eaten together, people must never devour one another; sharing food establishes a sacred bond forbidding betrayal and malice

proverb: Galata jette moluun, kaniin haaduu si lage
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan qorumsa dabalataa irraa bilisa ta'uun galata guddaa akka barbaachisu ibsa; balaa jalaa ooluun qofti bu'aa guddaadha
meaning_en: 'Thank you,' said the bald head, 'for sparing me the razor'; being spared further scraping, trauma, or taxation is itself a tremendous blessing to celebrate

proverb: Sareen bakka nyaatteeti nama nyaatti
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa fi gantuu ta'e mana keessummoomee tola nyaate sanatti garagalee miidhaa fida; tola-oolmaa nyaatanii nama miidhuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A dog bites a person right where it fed; bites the hand that feeds it; condemns treacherous individuals who turn around and betray their generous host

proverb: Galateeffachuun Jaallachuu miti
meaning_om: Tola namaaf oolaniif galata galchuun dirqama safuuti malee, nama sana jaallachuu yookaan fedhii hundaan walsimuu jechuu miti
meaning_en: To express gratitude is not necessarily to love; being thankful for a favor is basic moral duty, not proof of deep affection or personal allegiance

proverb: Nama siguddise guddisi, Osoo hiyyeessallee tahee
meaning_om: Maatii yookaan nama ijoollummaatti si guddisee fi si qarqaare yeroo inni hiyyoome yookaan dadhabe kunuunsuu fi gargaaruun dirqama safuuti
meaning_en: Honor and support the one who raised you, even if they have become poor; it is a sacred moral duty to care for aging parents who nurtured your youth

proverb: Sareen abbaa warraatti hin duttu
meaning_om: Tajaajilaan yookaan firi gargaarsa abbaa qe'eetiin jiraatu abbaa sana irratti finciluu yookaan sagalee ol kaasuun safuudha; amanamummaa barsiisa
meaning_en: A dog does not bark at the master of the house; loyalty and gratitude dictate that a dependent should never turn against or insult their benefactor

proverb: Waan hiriyyaan qabdu, galanni qaba
meaning_om: Hariiroon fi michoomni nagaan akka itti fufuuf tola oolmaa walii beekuu fi galata galchuun murteessaa dha; galanni michooma cimsa
meaning_en: What friendship possesses, gratitude upholds; genuine gratitude and acknowledgment of mutual favors are what sustain and preserve enduring companionship

proverb: Sareen abbuma guddise dura nyaatti
meaning_om: Namoonni amala badaa fi gantuu ta'an nama yeroo rakkinaa isaan guddisee fi gargaare irratti dura garagaluun miidhaa geessisu
meaning_en: A vicious dog bites the very master who raised it first; treacherous, ungrateful people frequently direct their first venom against their own benefactors

proverb: Nama harree koobe, galanni isaa dhuufuudha
meaning_om: Nama amala hin qabneef tola ooluun deebiin isaa salphinaa fi arrabsoo ta'uu ibsa; nama gatii tolaa hin beekneef tola ooluun kasaaraadha
meaning_en: For one who performs cupping on a donkey, his reward is flatulence; extending favors to an ungrateful boor earns only vulgar insult in return

proverb: Nama hudduu Koobe, galanni isaa dhuufuu dha
meaning_om: Iddoo yookaan nama salphina qabuuf tola oolanii bu'aa gaarii eeguun hin danda'amu; deebiin isaa wantuma fokkisaa ta'a
meaning_en: One who cups the buttocks is rewarded with flatulence; doing a delicate favor in a crude, thankless area yields only offensive, humiliating payback

proverb: Doobbaan, abbaa dhale dire
meaning_om: Loon gaafa dhedheeraa qabu (Doobbaan) isa abbaan kunuunsee guddise deebi'ee abbuma isa guddise sana gaafaan waraanee akka madeessuutti, namni ofii guddifatan, kunuunsanii fi amanan tokko humna erga horatee booda garagalee nama tola isaaf oole sanarratti gantummaa fi miidhaa raawwachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Doobbaa (a beast characterized by massive, long horns) turns its lethal horns to gore the very master who bred and raised it; captures the bitter, monstrous treachery of an ungrateful child, protégé, or dependent who turns their newfound power against the benefactor who nurtured them

proverb: Galanni galataan hin galu hijaan gala
meaning_om: Addunyaa kanarratti yeroo baay'ee tola oolmaaf deebiin argamu gaarummaa osoo hin taane hammeenya fi gantummaa akka ta'e gaddaan ibsa
meaning_en: Favors are not returned with gratitude, but with spite and injury; a cynical observation that worldly kindness is too often repaid with malice

proverb: Harreen dal'uu hin qabdu, muyoon galata hin qabdu
meaning_om: Akkuma harreen uumamaan dal'uu hin qabne, namni amala hin qabnee fi laafaanis tola oolmaa beekee galata galchuu hin beeku; uumama isaati
meaning_en: A donkey has no fatty hump, and an incompetent sluggard has no gratitude; an unprincipled weakling is simply incapable of feeling thankfulness

proverb: Marqaan nyaadhe malee, dhadhaa galanni bade
meaning_om: Wanta bu'uuraa argatanis, isa gati-jabeessa fi mi'aawaa namaaf godhame tuffachuudhaan galata dhabuu ceepha'a; qooda isa guddaa dagachuu
meaning_en: 'I ate the porridge, but the gratitude for the butter was lost'; mocks ungrateful beneficiaries who consume the finest part of a gift while denying thanks

proverb: Danfaan nyaadhe malee, soogidda maqaan bade
meaning_om: Wanta mi'aa fi bu'uura ta'ee hojicha miidhagse dagatanii faayidaa qofa fudhachuu; ogeessa fi qaama gumaacha godheef beekamtii dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: 'I ate the stew, but the salt got no credit'; enjoying the full benefit of an endeavor while failing to acknowledge the vital ingredient that made it good

proverb: Harreen, ilmoo isiitti hara hin baafattu
meaning_om: Ilmoon harree akkuma haadha ishee rakkinaa fi ba'aa baachuu malee haadhaaf boqonnaa hin taatu; ijoolleen maatiif boqonnaa hin taane ibsa
meaning_en: A donkey never finds restful relief through her foal; mocks offspring whose existence brings only continued toil and burden rather than domestic comfort

proverb: Raafuu gurraatu tolee, soogidda gurraatu bade
meaning_om: Wanta hojicha mi'eesse fi humna kenne osoo hin taane, isa mul'atu qofatu faarfama; namni dhugaan hojjete beekamtii dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The cabbage gets all the credit for tasting good, while the salt that gave it flavor is forgotten; credit is stolen by the visible front while the catalyst is ignored

proverb: Namni waa qoodu ni dhaba
meaning_om: Namni arjaa ta'ee hundaaf walqixa qoodu yeroo baay'ee ofiif hambifachuu dhabee harka qullaa hafa; arjummaa keessatti of dagachuu ibsa
meaning_en: He who portions out and shares with everyone ends up with nothing for himself; the generous distributor often exhausts all supplies and goes without

proverb: Wal'aantuun Wallaansa hin argattu
meaning_om: Ogeessi nama hunda tajaajilu fi fayyisu yeroo ofii rakkatu nama isa gargaaru dhaba; hakiimni of hin fayyisu jedhu wajjin walfakkaata
meaning_en: The healer herself finds no healing; caregivers spend their lives nursing others, yet when they themselves fall sick, no one is there to nurse them

proverb: Nama rafe dhungachuun galata of dhoorkuu dha
meaning_om: Wanta tolaa nama dammaqina hin qabneef yookaan nama gatii isaa hin beekneef gochuun galata akka hin argamsiisne agarsiisa; tola nama beekuuf ooluu qabu
meaning_en: Kissing someone who is asleep is depriving oneself of gratitude; doing favors for someone oblivious or unappreciative yields zero recognition or thanks

proverb: Harree duugda nyaatanii, dulloomtu gad harkisani
meaning_om: Namni tokko yeroo humni isaa jirutti faayidaa irraa erga argatanii booda, yeroo inni dadhabu yookaan dulloomu gatuu ceepha'a; gantummaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Having profited from the donkey's back, they discard it when old; condemns heartless opportunists who exploit someone in youth and abandon them in old age

proverb: Galataatu haloo natti ta'e
meaning_om: Tola fi gaarummaa namatti oolaniif deebiin isaa jibba, diinummaa fi haloo ta'ee yeroo namatti deebi'u gaddaan dubbatu; gaarummaan badii itti ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: My favor and kindness turned into a bitter feud against me; lamenting when one's sincere benevolence and help are repaid with hostility and malice

proverb: Mimmixa dhaabanii, buqqisa yaadan
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan hariiroo tokko osoo hin jabeessin yookaan bu'aa isaa hin argatin dura dafanii diiguuf yaaduu ceepha'a; kutannoo dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: Planting chili peppers while already plotting to uproot them; engaging in a venture with a cynical mindset already planning its destruction or abandonment

proverb: Ilmoo namaa guddisuu mannaa, ilmoo saree guddisuu wayya
meaning_om: Namni guddifatan yeroo baay'ee tola-oolmaa dagatee gantuu yoo ta'u, sareen garuu tola abbaa ishee nyaattee hin dagattu; gantummaa namaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Better to raise a puppy than another human's child; bitter commentary observing that dogs stay loyal to providers, while humans often repay care with betrayal

proverb: Namaan ani sabbata je'ee mudhitti hidhadheetu, bofa tahee na nyaate
meaning_om: Nama akka firaatti amananii fi garaatti dhiheessan tokko tasa diina hamaa ta'ee lubbuu namaa saaxiluu ibsa; gantummaa nama dhihoo balaaleffata
meaning_en: The one I thought was a soft sash and tied around my waist turned into a serpent and bit me; expresses devastating betrayal by an intimate confidant

proverb: Meettaan amaara
meaning_om: Aadaa fookloorii keessatti gosa Meettaa amala isaaniitiin, qonnaan yookaan haala jireenyaatiin akka Amaaraatti laaluu qishnaan dubbatu
meaning_en: Folk clan saying likening the Metta clan to the Amhara, culturally stereotyping them as shrewd, formal, or distinct in farming and temperament

proverb: Mukni qottootu nu fixe jennaan, anaa mitii jallaa keeysaniitu isin fixee jette qottoon
meaning_om: Diinni alaa nama miidhuu kan danda'u yoo namni keessaa gantuu ta'ee diinaaf karaa bane qofaadha; miidhaan guddaan kan keessaati
meaning_en: When trees lamented 'The axe destroyed us', the axe replied, 'It is your own crooked branch that destroyed you'; oppressors conquer through internal traitors

proverb: "Qottoo qofaa mitii jallaa kheenyaatu nu fixe" je'e, mukni
meaning_om: Badiisa sabaa yookaan maatiitiif sababni inni guddaan nama keessaa diinaaf meeshaa ta'ee saba ofii rukutuudha; gantummaa keessoo saaxila
meaning_en: 'It is not the iron axe alone, but our own crooked wood that destroyed us,' said the tree; internal betrayal causes far more devastation than external foes

proverb: Osoo jaalatanuu, tiruun nama huuti
meaning_om: Wanta yookaan nama garmalee jaallatan tokkorraa tasa miidhaan yookaan rakkoon namatti dhufuu danda'a; jaalalli qofti balaa irraa nama hin oolchu
meaning_en: Much as one loves liver, it can easily choke a person; even the most cherished person or indulgence can unexpectedly become the source of suffocation

proverb: "Nama ganna wajji baane, bona maaltu adda nu baase" jette, raafuun
meaning_om: Yeroo rakkinaa fi dhiphinaa waliin turanii, gaafa nagaan fi quufi dhufu walirraa fagaachuu yookaan wal dagachuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'Having weathered the rainy season together, what separated us in the dry season?' said the cabbage; satirizes discarding loyal companions once prosperity arrives

proverb: Yoo biraa firaa, yoo duubaa filaa
meaning_om: Namoota fuulduratti fira fi jaalallee fakkaatanii, duubaan garuu nama hamatanii fi maqaa namaa balleessan ceepha'a; fakkeessummaa firaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Face-to-face they act like kin, but behind your back they comb through your faults; critiques two-faced relatives who flatter in person and slander in secret

proverb: Nama dhadhaa afaan kaayaniitu, dhagaa afaan nama kaaya
meaning_om: Nama gaarummaa fi tola guddaa isaaf oolaniitu deebisee miidhaa hamaa nama irratti raawwata; tolaaf hammeenyaan deebisuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: The very person into whose mouth you placed butter puts a stone into your mouth; describes the shocking ingratitude when someone nurtured repays with injury

proverb: Irbuun abbu torba nama jala galti
meaning_om: Kakuu fi waadaa cabsuun abaarsa hamaa kan dhaloota torba miidhu hordofsiisa; amanamummaa fi qulqullina waadaa eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: A violated solemn oath strikes down seven generations; breaking sacred covenants and sworn oaths brings divine retribution pursuing a lineage down seven generations

proverb: "Yaa namana, duuti sitti xinnaate" jette, jeedalloon
meaning_om: Hammeenyi fi shirri namni lafarra jiru hojjetu hangam hamaa fi safuu kan hin qabne ta'uu bineensi illee dinqisiifachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'Oh human being, mere death is too small a penalty for your wickedness,' said the jackal; biting satire on human malice, declaring human treachery worse than beasts

proverb: Wal quba hin qabduu, walii dawaa hin qabdu
meaning_om: Namoonni haala, rakkinaa fi dhiphina walii hin beekne wal gargaaruu yookaan furmaata walii ta'uu hin danda'an; wal-beekuun wal-gargaarsaaf bu'uura
meaning_en: Having no awareness of each other, they possess no remedy for one another; without mutual understanding and empathy, people cannot provide aid or healing

proverb: Wal quba hin qabduu, gola gola galti
meaning_om: Namoonni tokkummaa fi qunnamtii qalbii dhaban mana tokko keessa jiraatanis yaadaan fi jireenyaan gargar bahanii kophummaan jiraatu
meaning_en: Having no care for one another, each retires to their separate room; describes alienated people who share a roof yet live in cold emotional isolation

proverb: Shinbirroon laga lagaa, afaan afaan dubbatti
meaning_om: Ummanni bakka fi naannoo garaagaraa dhufe aadaa, loqoda fi akkaataa jireenyaa mataa isaanii qabu; garaagarummaa naannoo fi aadaa fudhachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Birds of different rivers speak their own languages; people hailing from different valleys possess distinct dialects, customs, and perspectives

proverb: Harmaatu lama malee, aannan tokkichuma
meaning_om: Bifti, karaanii fi wanti alaan garaagara fakkaatan hundee fi faayidaa tokkicha qabu; obbolummaa fi tokkummaa bu'uuraa agarsiisa
meaning_en: The breasts are two, but the milk is one and the same; outward duality or differing approaches share a single, identical nourishing source and purpose

proverb: Tokko hidhateeti, tokko qullaa oola
meaning_om: Addunyaa kanarratti carraan fi qabeenyi nama hundaaf walqixa akka hin taane, tokko quufee yoo jiraatu kaan ammoo dhabee rakkachuu madaala jireenyaa ibsa
meaning_en: One is richly clothed, while another goes through the day naked; captures the stark economic inequality where one feasts while another starves

proverb: Dubbiin gogorrii, lukkuu fi adariif sheekkoo dha
meaning_om: Rakkina, gidiraa fi dhiphina namni tokko keessa jiru warri dhimmi hin ilaallanne akka waan taphaatti yookaan oduu bu'aa dhabeessaatti ilaalu
meaning_en: The ordeal of the wild partridge is just a bedtime story to the domestic fowl and the town-dweller; sheltered people view real mortal struggles as casual amusement

proverb: Teeysoon Hummarro, bultiin Maayaa qallo
meaning_om: Namni bakka tokko jiraachaa qalbii fi jireenyi isaa ammoo bakka biraatti rarra'ee jiru; tasgabbii fi iddoo dhaabbataa dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: Living in Hummarro while one's marriage and livelihood are in Maya-Qallo; describes living in restless fragmentation, pulled between two distant places

proverb: Ragaan hantuutaa biicu
meaning_om: Namni hamaan yookaan hattoon tokko ragaa godhatee nama akkasaatti amala badaa fi dantaa qabu dhiheeffachuu; ragaa sobaa fi michuu dabaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: The rat's witness is the tiny mouse; thieves and corrupt actors produce their own kind as character witnesses; birds of a feather perjure for each other

proverb: Karaa fi garaatu gargar nama baasaa
meaning_om: Fageenyi qaamaa akkuma daandiin nama addaan baasu, garaagarummaan yaadaa, jaalala dhabuu fi ilaalchaatis namoota walirraa fageessa; fageenyi garaa caala
meaning_en: It is the road and the heart that separate people; physical distance parts footsteps, but divergence of values and coldness of heart create the deepest divide

proverb: Sheekni aadaa beeku, aadaan sheeka hin beektu
meaning_om: Namni amantiis ta'ee beekumsa qabu aadaa hawaasaa hubatee walsimuun ni danda'a; garuu aadaan qofti seera amantii fi beekumsa bal'aa hin bakka bu'u
meaning_en: The religious scholar understands custom, but custom does not comprehend the scholar; an educated mind integrates custom, but folklore cannot match scholarship

proverb: Qaluun fannisuu hin tahu
meaning_om: Hojii tokko jalqabuun qofti akka xumurameetti hin lakkaa'amu; xumura gaarii irraan gahuutu bu'aa dhugaa fida; jalqaba qofaan hin dhaadatan
meaning_en: Slaughtering is not the same as dressing and hanging the meat; initiating an endeavor is only the start; true accomplishment lies in completing the process

proverb: Qubaatu quba caala
meaning_om: Akkuma quboonni harka namaa hundi walqixxee hin taane, namoonnis dandeettiin, humnaan fi carraan wal caalu; garaagarummaa uumamaa amanuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One finger surpasses another; just as the fingers on a human hand are naturally unequal in length and strength, human beings differ in talents and roles

proverb: Lameen gargar bule, garaan gargar bule
meaning_om: Namoonni yeroo addaan fagaatanii oolan suuta suutaan jaalallii fi yaanni isaaniis addaan cita; fageenyi jaalala laaffisa
meaning_en: When two people sleep apart, their hearts and thoughts drift apart; physical separation and lack of daily communion gradually erode intimacy

proverb: Saawa ta'eef, saawa nyaataa hin ta'u
meaning_om: Wanti tokko bifa yookaan maqaa walfakkaataa qabaachuun faayidaa fi gaheen isaa tokkuma jechuu miti; loon aannaniitiifi kan qalmaa garaagara
meaning_en: Just because it is a cow does not mean it is meant for slaughter; things belonging to the same category serve different functions; dairy cattle are preserved

proverb: "Nagaya bultanii, warri nagaya hin qabne" jennaan, "isin nagaya bultanii warri joollee hin qabne" jedhan
meaning_om: Namni hanqina ormaatti quba qabu hanqina mataa isaatiin deebii akka argatu; arrabsoof arrabsoon, ceephoof ceephoon deebi'uu qishnaadhaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Did you sleep in peace, you who have no peace?' provoked: 'Did you sleep in peace, you who have no children?'; trading retaliatory barbs targeting deep wounds

proverb: Har'aa fi kalessi irraa jala
meaning_om: Jireenyi yeroo hunda jijjiiramaa akka ta'e, haalli har'aa kan kaleessaa wajjin walirra ooluun garaagara ta'uu danda'a; carraan jireenyaa ni jijjiirama
meaning_en: Today and yesterday lie stacked one upon the other; human conditions are in constant flux, where today's reality builds upon yet contrasts with yesterday

proverb: Tokko dhibdee matatti ba'ata, tokko lafarra harkisa
meaning_om: Namni hundi rakkina qaba garuu akkaataan itti rakkina sana danda'anii fi baatan adda adda; tokko ulfinaan baata kaan ammoo salphinaan dhiphata
meaning_en: One carries his burden on his head with dignity; another drags his trouble messily on the dirt; all bear hardship, but they differ in composure and grace

proverb: Qayyi tokkichumaa, urgaan adda adda
meaning_om: Wanti ka'umsa tokko irraa dhufe illee akkaataa itti fayyadamaa fi qalbii namaatiin bu'aa garaagaraa fida; sanyii tokko keessaa amala adda addaatu baha
meaning_en: The incense gum may be from the same batch, yet the resulting fragrances differ; individuals from the same family emerge with completely different character

proverb: Garaan haadhaa, bofaa fi buuti dhala
meaning_om: Maatii tokko keessaa ijoolleen amalaan garraamii taatee fi isheen amalaan hamtuu fi summaoftuu taate walfaana dhalachuu dandeessi
meaning_en: A mother's womb gives birth to both a benign snake and a venomous viper; the exact same parents give birth to wildly divergent children—virtuous and wicked

proverb: Garaan saara buqqeeti
meaning_om: Akkuma saarri buqqee hundee tokkorraa buqqeelee bifa, gosaafi qooda adda addaa godhatu, gadaamessi haadhaas ijoollee amalaafi carraa garaagaraa qaban dhalcha
meaning_en: Just as a single calabash vine produces gourds of varying shapes, sizes, and purposes, a mother's womb gives birth to children of diverse characters, temperaments, and destinies

proverb: Teenyaa teeysan wal keeysa hin magartu, bakka teenya agartu teeysan hin agartu
meaning_om: Dantaan, qabeenyi fi firummaan 'keenya' fi 'keessan' wal keessa hin lixu, tokkos hin ta'u; bakka kan keenya nuuf argu fi nuuf yaadu, kan keessan nuuf hin argu. Namni hundi fira fi dantaa ofiitiif dursa kenna malee ormaaf hin dhimmu
meaning_en: What is 'ours' and what is 'yours' never intermingle or blend; where our own kin/interest watches out for us, yours will never see or look out for us. People inherently prioritize and protect their own, while outsiders remain indifferent to your welfare

proverb: Re'ee fi yeeyyiin wal keessatti hin hortu
meaning_om: Diinni uumamaa fi inni cunqurfamaan gonkumaa tokkummaa dhugaa uumuu hin danda'an; gartuuwwan bu'uuraan wal faallessan walitti makamuu hin danda'an
meaning_en: The goat and the wolf cannot procreate together; natural prey and natural predator can never forge genuine unity or common lineage; inherent antagonism

proverb: Daddabuus ejersumaatu dongora
meaning_om: Namni sanyii cimaa fi beekaa irraa dhalate hangamiyyuu hiyyoomee yoo argame, amala jabinnaa fi ulfina isaa hin dhabu; guddinni hundee hin badu
meaning_en: Even when worn or slender, it is still olive wood that serves as the sturdy digging stick; noble heritage retains its strength even when distressed

proverb: Akkam bulteen nama alaa dhufee, wayyaa buleen nama rafaa bule, way fitinaa akka abbaan itti bule
meaning_om: Namni alaa dhufe 'akkam bultan' jedhee gaafata; keessummaan ykn namni nagaan rafee bule 'wayyaa bullerra' jedhee deebisa; garuu dhiphina, rakkinaa fi jeequmsa halkan sana dabarse kan dhugaan beeku abbuma manichaa isa cinqamaa bule qofaadha. Haalli alaan nagaa fakkaatu keessi isaa fitinaa guddaa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'How did you spend the night?' asks the outsider; 'I slept well' replies the one who rested easily; but 'Alas the turmoil!' is how the master of the house actually endured it. Highlights the stark contrast between casual social greetings, carefree bystanders, and the private, sleepless agony borne by the person carrying the actual burden

proverb: Qaaniin dubraa ulfa, tan beeraa ulfa dhaba
meaning_om: Aadaa fi safuu keessatti wanti nama tokkoof salphina ta'e nama biraatiif ammoo faallaa ta'uu danda'a; intala dubraatiif osoo hin heerumin ulfaa'uun qaanii fi safuu cabsuu yoo ta'u, dubartii heerumteef (beeraaf) immoo ulfa dhabuun (dhala dhabuun) gadda fi salphina ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: What brings social disgrace to one person is the exact opposite for another depending on their station in life: for an unmarried maiden, conceiving out of wedlock is a devastating disgrace, whereas for a married woman, the inability to conceive (barrenness) is her deepest sorrow and shame

proverb: Joolleen warra godaantotaa fi joolleen warra taa'uu walitti hin dhuftu
meaning_om: Namoonni haala jireenyaa, aadaa fi ilaalcha garaagaraa qaban salphaatti waliigaluu yookaan michoomuu hin danda'an; akkaataan jireenyaa amala addaan baasa
meaning_en: The children of nomads and the children of settled farmers do not readily mix; people shaped by fundamentally different lifestyles struggle to integrate

proverb: Kan quufe, akka kan beelawe itti nyaatu ajaa'iba
meaning_om: Namni qananii fi quufa keessa jiru dhiphina, ariifannaa fi beela nama harka-qalleessaa hubachuu hin danda'u; quufaan beela'aa hin beeku
meaning_en: The well-fed person watches in bewildered astonishment at how the starving person wolfs down food; the wealthy cannot comprehend the urgency of hunger

proverb: Garbuu coraatu gubata, qamadii qaamaatu (nafaatu) gubata
meaning_om: Namoonni qorumsa keessatti bifa garaagaraatiin miidhamu; tokko miidhaan isaa alarratti mul'ata, kaan ammoo keessi isaa gubatee hubama
meaning_en: In roasted barley, only the outer husk scorches; in wheat, the core grain itself burns; different people absorb trials superficially or to the very core

proverb: Ani gamana ilaaleetiin, fardi koo gamas ilaale
meaning_om: Namoonni walfaana hojjetan yookaan michoonni yaadaa fi galma faallaa qabaachuun waldhabdee fida; dursa xiyyeeffannaan tokko ta'uu qaba
meaning_en: While I looked this way, my horse gazed across the other way; describes divided attention, conflicting purposes, and misalignment with a partner

proverb: Wanni biyya takkatti haalaa biyya takkatti saala
meaning_om: Wanti bakka tokkotti akka aadaa gaariitti fudhatamu biyya biraatti akka fokkisaatti lakkaa'amuu danda'a; garaagarummaa aadaa hubachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: What is an accepted custom in one country is a disgraceful shame in another; cultural norms and moral taboos are relative to regional traditions

proverb: Osoo wal bira jirtuu, ijji wal hin argitu
meaning_om: Namoonni dhihoo wal bira taa'an garuu jaalala, wal-hubannoo fi qunnamtii dhugaa dhabuu danda'u; dhiheenyi qaamaa kan qalbii hin ta'u
meaning_en: Though positioned right beside each other, the two eyes never see one another; physical proximity does not guarantee emotional intimacy or insight

proverb: Qorsoon ilkaanii cidhaa, garaa boo'insa
meaning_om: Wanti tokko alaan akka waan quufaatti kolfisiisee mul'atus keessoo isaatti beela fi dhiphina hamaa ta'uu ibsa; bifa alaan gowwoomuu
meaning_en: Parched grain between the teeth gives the sound of a feast, but in the stomach it causes weeping; a superficial crunch leaving the belly starved

proverb: Hamma joolleen muka kuttu, dubbiin kutti
meaning_om: Jechi afaaniin baatu saffisaan qalbii madeessa yookaan dubbii murteessa; arrabni yeroo gabaabaa keessatti miidhaa guddaa geessisa
meaning_en: In the mere moment it takes a child to break a twig, sharp words can permanently sever relationships; a reckless tongue snaps lifelong bonds

proverb: Keessummaan marihattee dhufti, warri manaa marihatee hin eegu
meaning_om: Keessummaan yookaan balaan dhuftu itti qophooftee dhufti, abbaan manaa garuu duraan dursee qophaa'uu dhabuun dhiphina uuma; qophii duraa barsiisa
meaning_en: The guest arrives having carefully planned; the hosts sit unprepared without prior consultation; the initiator holds the advantage over the unprepared

proverb: Dubartiin deessu lubbu eeggatti, biyyi ammoo marqa eeggatti
meaning_om: Namni qorumsa hamaa keessa jiru lubbuu baafachuuf cinqama, ormi garuu bu'aa fi bashannana dhimma sana duubaa eeggata; dantaa dhabummaa ormaa ibsa
meaning_en: The birthing mother struggles in agony to save her life, while the community waits for celebratory porridge; stark contrast between suffering and spectators

proverb: Gabrittiin na gurgurani boochi, warri horiin xinnaate booya
meaning_om: Namni miidhame gidiraa fi salphina isaatiif booyu, warri roorristoonni ammoo bu'aan saamicha isaanii xiqqachuu isaatiif komatu; roorroo hamaa saaxila
meaning_en: The captive maid weeps because her humanity was sold; the sellers weep because the price was too low; exposes the cruelty of oppressors prioritizing profit

proverb: Haadhaan caala jetti niitiin adeeraa, hammaattuus haati haadhuma, toltuus niitiin adeeraa niitii adeeraati
meaning_om: Haati hangamiyyuu hanqina qabaattus jaalala fi mararfannaa ishee namni biraa bakka bu'uu hin danda'u; bakka haadhaa wanti gahu hin jiru
meaning_en: 'I surpass your mother,' boasts the aunt; yet flawed as a mother may be, she is still your mother, and an aunt remains an aunt; none can replace a mother

proverb: Warra ijoollee sagalii beelli fixe, warra ijoollee hin qabne quufni fixe
meaning_om: Jireenyi gama hundaan madaallii barbaaddi; ijoollee baay'ee qabaachuun ba'aa fida, ijoollee dhabuun ammoo kophummaa fi dhabama dhalootaa fida
meaning_en: The family with nine children was ruined by hunger; the childless family was ruined by lonely fullness; the paradox where large broods bring hunger, yet barrenness brings extinction

proverb: Nama keessa, namni jira
meaning_om: Uummata baay'ee keessaa namoota amala gaarii, gara-laafina fi qalbii qaban argachuun ni danda'ama; hundumtuu walfakkaataa miti
meaning_en: Inside humanity, true human beings exist; amidst the teeming crowd of superficial people, there exist rare individuals of genuine nobility and integrity

proverb: Gurraattiin gurraaf boochi, diimtuun fororaaf boochi.
meaning_om: Namni hundi hanqinaafi yaaddoo mataa isaa qaba; wanti tokko nama tokko dhiphisu kan nama biraarraa adda ta'a (namni wanta qabu dhiisee isa dhaberratti booya).
meaning_en: Everyone laments their own specific insecurity, perceived flaw, or lack; while one worries about social recognition or status, another frets over minor physical blemishes like freckles.

proverb: Hawween, yaada yaada.
meaning_om: Hawwii qofti osoo gara hojiitti hin jijjiiramin bu'aa hin fidu; nama dhiphisaafi yaada baay'isa malee homaa hin dhiyeessu.
meaning_en: Mere wishing without concrete action yields no results; it only leads to endless contemplation, anxiety, and daydreaming.

proverb: Namni waa lama beeka, garii lola beeka, garii dada beeka.
meaning_om: Namoonni dandeettiifi amalaan bakka lamatti qoodamu; gariin lolaafi falmatti cima, gariin immoo nagaa, araaraafi tasgabbii beeka.
meaning_en: People naturally possess different dispositions and abilities: some are inclined toward conflict and war, while others are gifted in maintaining peace, harmony, and reconciliation.

proverb: Yoo osoo jirruu wal gargaaruu baanne, duunu biyyee walirraa harraa?
meaning_om: Namoonni osoo lubbuun jiranitti wal gargaaruu fi wal qaqqabuu qabu; erga du'anii booda gadda fakkeessuun bu'aa hin qabu
meaning_en: If we do not support each other while living, shall we brush the dirt off one another when dead?; care must be shown in life rather than in empty funeral tears

proverb: Maraataa firaatu hidha, caphaa ogeeysaatu hidha
meaning_om: Namni sammuu dhabee balaa fidu maatiitu itti-gaafatamummaa fudhatee to'ata; rakkina maatiis maatiitu fala kennaaf
meaning_en: A madman is restrained by his own kin, just as a fracture is bound by a skilled bonesetter; a family must take direct ownership of managing troubled members

proverb: Sa'a gaafa hin qabne, fira gaafa qabuutu jiraachisa
meaning_om: Namni harka-qalleessa ta'e yookaan ofirraa ittisuu hin dandeenye deeggarsa fi eegumsa firoota isaatiin jiraata; firi gaachana dadhabaati
meaning_en: A hornless cow survives through the protection of its horned companions; defenseless individuals survive under the protective shield of capable kin

proverb: Ibiddi wahirra laga baha
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan waldhabiinsi xiqqoon wanta biraatti daddarbaa deemee balaa guddaa laga ce'u ta'a; gargaarsa walitti aanuun wanta ulfaataa milkeessuun ni danda'ama
meaning_en: Fire crosses a river by jumping from brush to brush; small disputes spread across barriers through intermediaries; obstacles are cleared step by step

proverb: Ibiddi Okkotetti dahateeti, bishaan danfisa
meaning_om: Namni tokko wanta yookaan nama biraatti dahatee dhiibbaa fi jijjiirama guddaa fida; qindoomina meeshaa fi humnaatiin galma gahuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Shielding itself behind the earthen pot, the fire brings water to a boil; working through a proper vessel allows heat to accomplish constructive work

proverb: Harreen ilmoorratti, hara baafatti
meaning_om: Namni bakka dhimma isaatiitti roorrifamee yookaan dadhabee aarii isaa nama laafaa fi dadhabaa isa jala jiru irratti baasa; roorroo laafaatti agarsiisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The donkey catches her breath by venting upon her foal; displaced aggression where an overburdened person unfairly vents frustration on vulnerable young

proverb: Quba caphe kan itti aanutti hidhani
meaning_om: Namni miidhame yookaan kufaatiin mudate nama dhihoo isaatti hirkatee fi walitti hidhatee bayyanata; fira dhihootti hirkachuun furmaata fida
meaning_en: A broken finger is splinted to the neighboring one; in times of injury or breakdown, an individual recovers by leaning on the nearest kin

proverb: Yoo mana eegan, saree dhaaf qoricha ta'u
meaning_om: Abbaan qe'ee dammaqee manaa fi qabeenya isaa yoo eeggate, hattuun yookaan diinni akka sareetti isa sodaatee deebi'a; of eeggannoon diina dura dhaabbata
meaning_en: If the owners stay vigilant and guard the house, they serve as the best antidote against dogs and thieves; active vigilance deters intruders

proverb: Eessumaa gootaatu tolaa, soddaa dureeysaatu tola
meaning_om: Eessumni goota ta'e eegumsa fi gootummaa namaaf kenna, soddaan sooressa ta'e ammoo qabeenya fi gargaarsaan nama utuba; faayidaa hariiroo adda addaa ibsa
meaning_en: For a maternal uncle, a brave warrior is best; for an in-law, a wealthy man is best; maternal kin provide protective valor, while in-laws offer economic backing

proverb: Argitee himi, fuutee kenni na baasi (oolchi)
meaning_om: Kadhannaa fi eeggannoo uumaatti dhiyaatuudha; waan ijaan hin argin 'ragaa bahi' jedhamanii qorumsa keessa galuu fi waan hin fudhatin 'deebisi' jedhamanii yakka hin qabneen sobaan himatamuufi itti-gaafatamuurraa Waaqayyo akka nama baraaru (oolchu) kadhachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A traditional supplication seeking protection from false accusation and wrongful liability: praying to be delivered from being coerced into testifying about events one never witnessed ('tell what you saw') and from being unjustly accused of taking something one never touched ('return what you took')

proverb: Ballaan kan arraba dabsu anuu niin beekaa, kan funyaan butu narraa eegaa je'e
meaning_om: Arrabsoo fi ceephoo afaanii dhiisanii miidhaa qabatamaa fi balaa qaamaa nama irra gahuuf dursa kennanii of eeguu akka qaban agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'The one sticking out his tongue I already perceive; protect me from the one swinging at my nose,' said the blind man; disregard harmless taunts for real threats

proverb: Namni xiqqoo namaaf godhe, guddaa humnaaf dadhaba
meaning_om: Namni tola xiqqoo siif oole waanuma danda'e waan gumaacheef galateeffachuu qabda malee wanta humna isaatiin ol ta'e irraa eeguun dogoggora
meaning_en: One who did a modest favor for you simply lacked the means to do more; appreciate small assistance and never resent a benefactor for their limited strength

proverb: Namni du'e ofiif hin booyu
meaning_om: Namni erga kufee yookaan balaan dhumatee booda of gargaaruu hin danda'u; kan gargaaruu fi booyichaan yaadu warra hafe qofa; jiraattotatu itti gaafatama
meaning_en: A dead person does not weep for himself; those who have fallen can no longer advocate, mourn, or fend for themselves; the living must speak on their behalf

proverb: Qottoon of hin qortu
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii fi ogummaa qabaatuyyuu hanqina mataa isaa qorachuu yookaan of yaaluu hin danda'u; gargaarsa nama biraa barbaada
meaning_en: An axe cannot hew its own wooden handle; no matter how skilled or sharp a person may be, they cannot operate on themselves without external help

proverb: Haati mucaa jalaan oolti
meaning_om: Nyaata, aannan, kennaa fi kunuunsa daa'imaaf dhihaatu irraa haatis ni quufti, tajaajilamti, jalaanis oolti; akkasumas kabajaa fi eegumsi mucaaf godhamu haadhaafis dabalatee bu'aa fida
meaning_en: A mother is nourished, cared for, and sheltered through her child; whatever nutritious food, milk, gifts, or honors are provided for the child directly sustain and benefit the mother as well

proverb: Obboleeysa jechuun kan ati rifattu rifatee ati gammadu gammadu
meaning_om: Obbolummaan dhugaan dhiphina fi gammachuu kee guutummaatti kan qooddatuudha; miira walii hubatanii cinaa dhaabbachuu ibsa
meaning_en: To call someone a brother means one who trembles in shock when you are startled, and rejoices when you celebrate; authentic brotherhood is emotional solidarity

proverb: Harka kennu tahi, kan fudhatu hin tahin.
meaning_om: Harka namaa eeggachuu irra arjummaa qabaatanii of danda'uufi nama gargaaruutu caala; arjummaafi of danda'uun kabaja fida.
meaning_en: It is better to be generous, self-reliant, and helpful to others than to depend perpetually on charity and handouts.

proverb: Sadaqaan hammuma abbaan kennate.
meaning_om: Namni tokko wantuma ofuma isaatiin tola oole ykn sadaqatee qofatu galataafi bu'aa isaaf ta'a malee kan biraa isaaf hin ta'u.
