meaning_en: A person receives spiritual merit and blessings strictly in proportion to what they themselves give and sacrifice willingly.

proverb: Kan waa himu hin dhabani, kan waa kennu hin argani.
meaning_om: Dubbiifi gorsi baay'eedha, garuu nama rakkina qabatamaan qabeenyaan ykn gargaarsaan furu argachuun baay'ee rakkisaadha.
meaning_en: Advice and empty words are abundant, but finding someone willing to give tangible assistance or material help is exceedingly rare.

proverb: Kan kadhatu qofa hin jajani(ajaa'ibani)kan kadhatuus nama jaja(ajaa'iba).
meaning_om: Namni hundi qoodaafi ilaalcha mataa isaa qaba; namni akka salphaatti ilaalamu illee nama biraa madaaluu fi qeequu danda'a.
meaning_en: Do not merely mock or judge the disadvantaged; they too observe, judge, and hold opinions about the people around them.

proverb: Kennaan namaa, nama hin quubsitu.
meaning_om: Gargaarsi namarraa argamu yeroo muraasaaf malee jireenya guutuu nama hin dhaabu; of danda'uufi eebba Waaqayyoo qofaatu nama quubsa.
meaning_en: Handouts from fellow humans never provide true, lasting fulfillment; genuine sufficiency comes through self-reliance and God's providence.

proverb: Nama kennee hin beekne, kennaan hija itti fakkaata.
meaning_om: Namni doqni yookiin arjummaa hin beekne, waan xiqqoo kennuun illee akka miidhaa, kasaaraa ykn balaatti itti dhaga'ama.
meaning_en: To a stingy person who has never practiced generosity, parting with anything feels like an intolerable loss or outright injury.

proverb: Gaalli hin waakkatu, yoo abbaan waakkate malee.
meaning_om: Wanti tokko akka nama hin fayyanne kan taasisuu fi qabeenya kan dhoowwatu qabeenyicha osoo hin taane doqnummaa abbaati.
meaning_en: A possession or resource itself does not withhold its benefit; it is the selfish owner who refuses to share.

proverb: Sheenyoon gaafa Doobbaa jalaan bishaan dhuga
meaning_om: Namni humna, meeshaa ykn gaafa ittiin orma lolu hin qabne, malaa fi tooftaadhaan isa humna qabu (isa gaafa dheeraa) jalatti dhihaatee osoo hin miidhamin dantaa fi rizqii isaa argata. Meeshaa dhabanis tooftaan jabaa jalaan jireenya ofii gaggeeffachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The hornless cow drinks water from right beneath the sprawling horns of the long-horned cow; someone lacking weapons or brute force uses clever positioning, humility, and tact to secure sustenance and thrive under the very span of the mighty

proverb: Harreen faraqa wal hooyxi.
meaning_om: Namoonni hawaasa keessatti wal deggeruu, dabareen wal gargaaruu fi waliif tumsuun jireenya akka geggeeffatan ibsa.
meaning_en: Mutual cooperation and reciprocity are essential in community life; individuals help each other in turn.

proverb: Addunyaan wasaasaadha
meaning_om: Akkuma wasaasaan reeffa namaa tokko baattee awwaala geessitee gattee deebitee kan biraa eeggattu, addunyaan kunis nama hundumaa dabaree dabareedhaan gara du'aatti baatti malee namuu irratti hin hafu; jireenyi addunyaa kan yerooti malee qabeenya dhaabbataa miti
meaning_en: Just as a funeral bier (wasaasaa) carries one corpse to the grave, unloads it, and returns to carry the next, this mortal world is merely a vehicle steadily carrying each human being by turn toward death; earthly existence belongs permanently to no one

proverb: Kennaa namaa irra, kennaa Rabbiitu caala.
meaning_om: Wanta namarraa eeggatan caalaa eebbaafi kennaan Waaqayyo namaaf kennutu guutuufi ulfina qaba; namni si komachuu danda'a, Waaqni garuu arjaadha.
meaning_en: The blessings and providence of God are far superior to human charity; humans may reprove and boast, but divine grace sustains abundantly.

proverb: Nama namaa waa kennuuf waaqni ni kennaaf.
meaning_om: Namni arjaa ta'ee namoota gargaaru, Waaqayyo qabeenyaafi eebba isaaf dabalata; tola ooltummaan eebba fida.
meaning_en: Whoever shows compassion and gives generously to their fellow man is rewarded and sustained by God with abundant blessings.

proverb: Harka barsiisan hin dhoowwani.
meaning_om: Wanta baratame ykn aadeffatame tokko tasa addaan kutuun rakkisaadha; yoo nama tokko gargaarsa barechite yeroo mara eeggata.
meaning_en: It is difficult to deny support once you have accustomed someone to expecting it; habits and established dependencies cannot be easily broken.

proverb: Ibidda hin liqeeffatani, kan qabu irraa qabsiifatan malee.
meaning_om: Wanti tokko tokko liqii ta'uu hin danda'u; qabeenya ykn beekumsa qooddachuu fi madda irraa fudhachuudha malee akka meeshaatti hin deebifamu.
meaning_en: Certain things cannot be borrowed and returned; rather, they are shared, lit, or learned from the existing source without diminishing it.

proverb: Garaan jagnaa akka leencaatti koqaa, garaan luynaa akka dhadhaatti baqa.
meaning_om: Gootni yeroo qormaataa fi diinaa akkuma leencaa ni daggala, ni jabaata; sodaataan garuu battalatti rifatee humna dhabee bada.
meaning_en: In the face of peril, a hero's heart roars with unshakeable courage like a lion, whereas a coward's resolve liquefies like butter.

proverb: Garaan jagnaa hurrumaa, kan luynaa marrimaani.
meaning_om: Jagni icciitii qabata, obsa guddaa qaba, miira isaas ni dhoksa; sodaataan garuu dafee rifata, waan garaa qabus amansiisaa miti.
meaning_en: A hero possesses the impenetrable depth, secrecy, and resilience of dense thicket, whereas a coward is shallow, transparent, and gutless.

proverb: Haati gootaa, baddu barbaacha qabdi, duutu awwaala qabdi
meaning_om: Gootummaan ilma dhiiraa maatii fi keessattuu haadha isaatiif kabajaa fi eegumsa olaanaa fida; haati gootaa yoo badde ummanni guutuun birmatee ishee barbaada, yoo duutes ulfina guddaadhaan awwaalcha argatti. Dhiirummaan ilmaa haadha isaatiif dahoo fi kabaja ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The mother of a valiant warrior enjoys great communal reverence and protection because of her son's courage: if she goes missing, the entire community mobilizes a search for her, and when she dies, she receives an honorable, well-attended burial. A child's valor shields and honors his mother in both life and death

proverb: Afaan leencaa, citaan hin seenu.
meaning_om: Gootni ykn namni jabaan wantoota salphaa, arrabsoo fi gochoota xixinnoo gatii hin qabne keessa hin galu.
meaning_en: A formidable predator like a lion does not graze on straw; a dignified, powerful leader does not stoop to petty squabbles.

proverb: Sodaataan, bishaan jannataa hin dhugu.
meaning_om: Namni sodaa of keessatti baatu milkaa'ina guddaa, boona fi qooda olaanaa gonfachuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A fearful person who avoids risk and hardships will never taste the sweetest fruits of victory or divine reward.

proverb: Haati dhiiraa waaqa.
meaning_om: Gootni eegumsa Waaqaatiin jiraata; haati ilma goota deesses eegumsa Waaqayyoo qabdi.
meaning_en: The life of a courageous man and the destiny of his mother rest entirely in God's supreme protection and providence.

proverb: Leencaa fi jagni biyya hin jiru hin ja'inaa.
meaning_om: Biyya tokko keessatti yeroo hundumaa gootonni fi jajjaboon ni jiru; tuffatamuu hin qaban, yeroo isaaniitti mul'atu.
meaning_en: Never disparage a country by claiming it lacks lions or champions; heroes are always present and arise when crisis strikes.

proverb: Lubbuun, gaafa dhalatte duute.
meaning_om: Duuti guyyaa dhalatan irraa eegalee kan murtaa'e waan ta'eef, du'a sodaatanii wareegama gootummaa dhiisuun hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Since mortality is sealed the very instant of birth, paralyzing fear of death should never compromise one's honor and courage.

proverb: Ilmi dhiiraa, gaafa dhalate du'e.
meaning_om: Dhiirri gootni lubbuu isaaf hin mararfatu; kaayyoo fi saba isaatiif jedhee du'a fudhatee jiraata.
meaning_en: A true warrior reckons himself dead to self-preservation from birth, committing fully to valor, duty, and sacrifice.

proverb: Jagni beela hin sodaanne.
meaning_om: Gootni beela, dheebuu fi rakkoolee qaamaa danda'ee kaayyoo isaarratti cicha malee hin laafu.
meaning_en: A true hero is hardened against physical privation, enduring hunger and hardship without relinquishing the objective.

proverb: Dhiiraa fi leenca, yeroo galan hin beekani.
meaning_om: Gootnis ta'e leenci hanga kaayyoo isaanii galmaan ga'anii fi adamsanii xumuranitti yeroo hin qabatan; sochiin isaanii hin tilmaamamu.
meaning_en: Neither a heroic man nor a hunting lion adheres to predictable timetables; they return only when their conquest is fulfilled.

proverb: Lubbuu abbaan Rabbumaa maaliif mukaan korani?
meaning_om: Duuti fi jireenyi harka Waaqaa waan jiruuf, sodaa hamaadhaan dhiphachuun ykn baqachuun hiree hin jijjiiru.
meaning_en: When life and mortality reside solely in God's hands, frantically climbing trees in desperate panic will not alter destiny.

proverb: Namni dubartiin ergite, du'a hin sodaatu.
meaning_om: Namni kabaja, jaalala, waadaa fi quuqama dubartiin kaka'ee socho'u onnee guutuu fi ija-jabina olaanaadhaan lola.
meaning_en: A man dispatched on a mission by a woman's honor, trust, or love fights with unbridled valor, immune to the fear of death.

proverb: Jeyna Rabbiitu tiysa, luyni ifiif if tiysa.
meaning_om: Gootni haqaaf falmee Waaqarratti hirkata, Waaqnis isa eega; sodaataan garuu of qofa eeguuf jecha salphina seena.
meaning_en: God watches over and preserves the hero who stands boldly for truth, while the coward obsesses over self-preservation and falls into shame.

proverb: Jeynummaan horii rabbiiti.
meaning_om: Gootummaan kennaa guddaa fi qabeenya Waaqayyo namaaf kennuudha malee kan humnaan ykn qarshiin bitamu miti.
meaning_en: True courage is a divine wealth and spiritual endowment bestowed by God, rather than a commodity that can be bought or manufactured.

proverb: Eeboon jeynaa jeynummaa namaa hin taatu, akka abaluutiin tahaan dhiirummaa namaa hin taatu.
meaning_om: Meeshaan ykn fakkeessuun gootummaa namaaf hin fidu; gootummaan onnee ofii keessaa madda malee nama fakkaachuun hin argamu.
meaning_en: Bearing the weapons of a warrior does not make one brave, nor does superficial imitation produce authentic valor; courage stems from within.

proverb: Gowwaan miilaan dhoqqee baqateeti, cinaachaan keessa ciisa.
meaning_om: Namni hubannaa hin qabne rakkoo xiqqoo baqachuuf jedhee balaa fi badii guddaa caalu keessa of buusa.
meaning_en: A fool attempts to avoid a minor inconvenience only to plunge headlong into a far greater disaster.

proverb: Gowwaan kennaniif gadi naqa, himaniif gandaan dhaqa.
meaning_om: Gowwaan qabeenya kennameef hin qusadhu, hin kunuunsu; icciitii itti himames dhoksuu hin danda'u, hundaaf labsa.
meaning_en: A foolish person squanders material gifts and immediately broadcasts confidential secrets to the entire community.

proverb: Gowwaan hin weeddisu, weeddisu hin callisu.
meaning_om: Gowwaan dura waan tokko jalqabuuf dafee hin hubatu, yoo eegale immoo daangaa dhabee dafqa itti dhangalaasee nama nuffisiisa.
meaning_en: A fool is slow to participate, but once he starts, he lacks all moderation and does not know when to stop.

proverb: Hoolaan gaafa du'u samii arga.
meaning_om: Namni dantaa dhabeessi ykn gowwaan hanga badiin guddaan ykn balaan dhumaa irra ga'utti dammaqee hin argu; erga hundi darbee booda baru.
meaning_en: An oblivious person or fool only opens their eyes to reality when facing imminent destruction or after it is too late.

proverb: Gowwummaan dhukkuba qoricha hin qabne.
meaning_om: Gowwummaa fi hubannaa dhabuun amala yaalii fi gorsaan jijjiiruu ykn fayyisuun baay'ee ulfaataa ta'eedha.
meaning_en: Foolishness is an incurable affliction; no amount of external advice or remedy can easily fix innate lack of wisdom.

proverb: "Akkana goonee bira teenya" je'e, gowwaan niitii isaa ajjeesee.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan rakkoo salphaa furuuf jedhee tarkaanfii badiisaa fi deebii hin qabne fudhatee wanta qabu balleessa.
meaning_en: A fool destroys what is precious under the absurd delusion of fixing a problem or creating convenience.

proverb: Gowwaaf cooma hin waadani, moora je'eeti namatti dida.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan wanta gati-jabeessaa fi gaarii ta'e addaan baasee hin beeku; waan gaarii kennameefiyyuu tuffata.
meaning_en: A fool cannot distinguish prime quality from worthless matter; he will reject the finest offering believing it is inferior.

proverb: Sareen qalbii hin qabne, hiraata goftaa kajeelti.
meaning_om: Namni sadarkaa fi dandeettii isaa hin beekne waan isaaf hin malle ykn kan isa caalu argachuuf kajeela.
meaning_en: A senseless person oversteps their boundaries, shamelessly coveting what is reserved for their superiors.

proverb: Abbaan manaa gowwaan, eelee caphxetti kofla.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan miidhaa fi balaa maatii isaarratti ga'e hin hubatu; badii ofiirratti qaqqabe akkuma waan nama biraatti kolfata.
meaning_en: A foolish head of household laughs when disaster strikes his own home, blind to the fact that the loss is his own.

proverb: Gowwaa fi sareen, nama kaafatan nama jalaa hin hafani.
meaning_om: Gowwaan fi sareen yeroo nama hordofuu jalqaban addaan cituu hin beekani; nama nuffisiisanii hordofu.
meaning_en: A fool and a stray dog are alike: once encouraged or provoked, they cling relentlessly and become an unshakeable nuisance.

proverb: Yoo faaxee teenyaatii, walleen tanuma gaafa isiin gurra qabduuti.
meaning_om: Wanti tokko yeroo dheeraaf jijjiirama malee bifa tokkoon irra deddeebi'amee faarfamu ykn dubbatamu; haalli isaa duraan beekamaadha.
meaning_en: The same old tired tale or excuse is endlessly repeated without any change; nothing new is being offered.

proverb: Nama mataa hin qabne, gurraatu dhadhaabbata.
meaning_om: Namni bu'uura ykn sammuu hin qabne wantoota alaa fi faaya qofaan of mul'isuuf tattaafata.
meaning_en: A brainless person with no substance focuses on superficial ornaments and outward appearances rather than genuine intellect.

proverb: Gowwaa qabrii hin agarsiisani, mana je'eeti itti didaa
meaning_om: Nama hubannoo hin qabne wanta qorumsa qabu, daangaa qabu ykn iddoo eeggannoo barbaadu agarsiisuun balaadha; inni akkuma gowwaa qabrii argee 'kunoo manaa' jedhee keessaa bahuu dideetti, wanta sana dogoggoraan hubatee gadhiisuu dida
meaning_en: Never introduce an undiscerning fool to a sacred, private, or hazardous place, for he will misinterpret its purpose, make himself at home, and stubbornly refuse to leave; fools misunderstand serious boundaries and cling to them inappropriately

proverb: Gaadii gowwaan hidhan, hidhii isaa irraa baqayfatani
meaning_om: Gowwaan ofuma isaatii afaan baasee waan dubbatuun kiyyoo keessa of galcha; nama gowwaa qabuuf ykn kuffisuuf meeshaa alaa barbaaduun hin barbaachisu, jechaa fi arrabuma isaatiin kiyyoo ofii tolfata
meaning_en: The rope used to bind a fool is stripped right from his own lips; a foolish person incriminates and entraps himself entirely through his own loose, indiscreet words. You need no outside snare to defeat a fool—his own mouth provides all the cord needed to tie him up

proverb: Gowwatti mana hin cufani, meesha(mi'a) caccabsa.
meaning_om: Nama itti gaafatamummaa hin qabne qofaa isaa dhiisanii ykn dhimma guddaa irratti hin dhiisan; waan hundumaa mancaasa.
meaning_en: Never leave an irresponsible fool unattended in charge of valuable property, for he will break and destroy everything.

proverb: Gowwaan yoo ija guddinaatiin ilaalan, kani sodaatani itti fakkaata.
meaning_om: Gowwaaf yoo kabajaa fi obsa guddaa agarsiifte, akka waan sodaa qabdutti hubatee of tuula.
meaning_en: If you treat a fool with patience and courteous restraint, he misinterprets your gentleness as fear and becomes arrogant.

proverb: Gowwaa fi hoolaan, deebii hin qabani.
meaning_om: Gowwaanii fi hoolaan waan itti dubbataniif deebii quubsaa fi yaada qajeelaa hin qaban; dubbii isaaniirraa deebii eeguun gatii hin qabu.
meaning_en: A fool and a sheep offer no meaningful answer; trying to reason with an unintelligent person is as futile as expecting a reply from livestock.

proverb: Gowwittiin haadha dhiirsaa dhiiftee, haadha kanniisaatiin bultee jette.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan nama kabajuu qabuu fi dhimma isaaf murteessaa ta'e dhiisee, waan gatii hin qabnee fi orma ta'e faana fiiga.
meaning_en: A foolish woman neglects the person she owes the most honor and respect (her mother-in-law), prioritizing irrelevant outsiders instead.

proverb: Gowwaan ifii koflee, nama kofalchiisa.
meaning_om: Gowwaan bakka kolfi hin malletti ofumaa kolfuun nama isa ilaalu kofalchiisa; kolfi namaas isa faana utuu hin ta'in isarratti.
meaning_en: A fool laughs at inappropriate moments, prompting onlookers to laugh not with him, but at his absurdity.

proverb: Gowwaan, gaafa cidha ofiiti quufa.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan carraa fi waan gaarii harka isaa jiru kan hubatu ykn kan itti fayyadamu gaafa waan hundi isa jalaa darbe ykn yeroo hin taanetti.
meaning_en: A fool is so thoughtless that he only manages to eat heartily when it is his own wedding, rather than managing his daily welfare properly.

proverb: Lallaba gowwaa, firaatu itti qaanfata.
meaning_om: Gowwaan waan fokkisaa fi qaanii hin qabne dubbatee lallaba; miidhaa fi qaaniin isaa garuu maatii fi firoottan isaa irratti kufa.
meaning_en: A fool shouts his nonsense brazenly without shame, while his family and relatives bear the embarrassment and disgrace.

proverb: Waan ofii jedhee, udaan ulate.
meaning_om: Wanti kan ofii ta'e hundi gaarii akka hin taane hubachuu dhabuu; balleessaa fi xuraa'ummaa ofii sababa 'kan kooti' jedhuun faarsuu qeeqa.
meaning_en: Blindly defending or cherishing something repulsive merely because it belongs to oneself; irrational pride in one's own defects.

proverb: Dukkanti gara gowwaati galti.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan ykn dantaa hin qabne qophii yeroo malee waan hafuuf, rakkoon, dhiphinnii fi gadadoon yeroo hunda isa qunnama.
meaning_en: Darkness and misfortune always overtake the unprepared fool, who fails to plan ahead before night falls.

proverb: Yoo himinaa nutti hin hafnee, warri gowwaa dhale hin rafne.
meaning_om: Nama gowwaa gorsanii jijjiiruun akka hin danda'amnee fi maatiin ilma akkasii qabu yeroo hundumaa yaaddoo fi hirriiba dhabuu keessa akka jiraatan ibsa.
meaning_en: Since advice never deters a fool, the parents who bore him are doomed to perpetual anxiety and sleepless nights.

proverb: Na hin argani jetteeti, haadha ofii kabalti.
meaning_om: Namni badii dhoksaatti raawwadha jedhee yaadu bu'uura amala badaa fi gowwummaa isaatiin badii hunda caalu ofirratti dalaga.
meaning_en: Deluded by secrecy, a fool commits the most heinous sacrilege, unaware that moral destruction cannot be hidden.

proverb: Nama dheeraa, ayliin miila jala kutti.
meaning_om: Dheerina qaamaa qabaachuun beekumsaa fi qalbii qabaachuu wajjin wal hin simatu; namni qaamaan dheeraan sammuun hir'achuu mala.
meaning_en: Physical height does not equate to wisdom; a person may be imposing in stature yet deficient in intellect and good sense.

proverb: Nama dheeraa, takkaa beekkomsaa hanqataa, takkaa huccuu hanqata.
meaning_om: Namni dheeraan yeroo tokko hubannaan isaa hir'ata, yoo beekumsa qabaate immoo uffanni qaama isaa gahu rakkisa; guutuu ta'uun hin jiru.
meaning_en: A tall person is said to lack either wisdom in his head or enough cloth to fit his frame; flawlessness is hard to find.

proverb: Gowwaan bishila eeggatee, qabbana eeggachuu dadhabe.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan wanta dheeraaf itti dhama'e daqiiqaa dhumaatti obsa dhabuudhaan gubatee of miidha; obsa dhabuutu hojii mancaasa.
meaning_en: A fool endures the long wait while food is boiling, yet ruins everything at the last minute because he lacks the patience to let it cool.

proverb: Dubbii guddinaa hin guddatani.
meaning_om: Dubbii baay'isuun ykn dubbii irratti dubbii fe'uun faayidaa hin qabu; dubbiin gabaabinaan fi iccitiin dubbatamuu qaba.
meaning_en: One should not exaggerate speech or speak excessively just to dominate an argument; moderation in talk is wisdom.

proverb: Afaan dubbii bare utubatti haasawa.
meaning_om: Namni baay'ee haasa'uufi oduu bare, nama dhabullee waanuma argatetti haasa'uu hin dhiisu; amala afaan qaqallaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: A talkative or gossipy person cannot remain silent and will talk to inanimate objects if there is no one around to listen.

proverb: Bagaan jedhee irra, bagaan hin jedhiniitu caala.
meaning_om: Dubbachuurra callisuutu gaabbii irraa nama oolcha; waan dubbatan gaabbuu mannaa callisanii darbuutu filatamaadha.
meaning_en: Regretting remaining silent is far better than regretting spoken words; restraining one's tongue avoids remorse.

proverb: Hamtuu nu haasoysiiftee, arraba nu hin muriniin tan ifirra kadhatani.
meaning_om: Wanta badii fi mufannaa fidu akka hin dubbanne Waaqa kadhachuu; dogoggora arrabaa irraa of eeguu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: One must pray to be saved from speaking hurtful words that bring punishment, disgrace, or retribution upon oneself.

proverb: Dubbiin guddatteef, harretti hin fe'ani.
meaning_om: Dubbiin wanta qabatamaa harkaan baatan miti; furmaata kan argatus humnaan osoo hin taane mariifi sammuudhaani.
meaning_en: Verbal disputes or serious issues cannot be resolved by physical force or treated like material loads; they require intellect and dialogue.

proverb: Dubbii boolla hin guuttatani.
meaning_om: Haasa'uun qofti rakkoo hin furu; hojii qabatamaatu barbaachisa malee afaaniin wanti godhamu hin jiru.
meaning_en: Empty talk and endless discussion cannot solve tangible problems; practical action is required.

proverb: Dubbiin shinbirroo nama afaanii baati.
meaning_om: Dubbiin takkaa afaan keessaa baanaan hin deebitu; akka shinbirroo barrifteeti waan ta'eef of eeggannoon dubbachuu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Once a word leaves your mouth, it takes flight like a bird and can never be retrieved; hence one must speak cautiously.

proverb: Hamma hancufa tufan dubbii daddarban.
meaning_om: Dubbii gabaabduu fi ifa taate yeroodhaan dubbatanii dhimma murteessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Speech should be concise, punctual, and delivered with measured timing rather than dragging on uselessly.

proverb: Dubbiin meeshaa dhaa, bakkuma rabbi kaaye jirti.
meaning_om: Dubbiin hundi yeroofi bakka mataa isaa qaba; waan hundumaafuu wanti Waaqayyo murteesse jira.
meaning_en: Truth and spoken matters have their proper place and divine destiny; whatever is meant to be revealed will come to pass.

proverb: Namni beekaan, yoo si dura dubbate dubbii si duraa fixa, yoo si booda dubbate dubbii si duraa ballessa.
meaning_om: Beekaan dubbii sirriitti beeka; yoo dursitee isa dhaggeeffatte furmaata argatta, yoo isa dura sobde immoo dogoggora kee saaxila.
meaning_en: An articulate wise person covers everything if he speaks first, and exposes all flaws if he speaks after you; one should respect true intellect.

proverb: Beekaa biratti dubbii guddisuun, wallaalummaa ifii mul'isuu dha.
meaning_om: Nama beekaa fi hubataa duratti haasaa baay'isuun doofummaa ofii saaxila malee beekumsa namaaf hin tahu.
meaning_en: Talking excessively in the presence of someone truly knowledgeable only exposes one's own ignorance.

proverb: Himanii hin fixanii, birumaa lixani.
meaning_om: Dubbiin ykn dhimmi addunyaa dubbatamee hin dhumu; bakka murtaa'etti dhaabanii dhiisuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: There is no end to grievances, news, or complaints; at some point, one must let them go and move on.

proverb: Gabbinni arrabaa, ilkee jidduu seenuu dha.
meaning_om: Arrabi yoo of wallaalee baay'ee socho'e ni ciniinama; nama afaan qaqallaa balaatu isa eeggata.
meaning_en: A loose or overly proud tongue inevitably gets bitten by the teeth; reckless talk brings suffering upon the speaker.

proverb: Dubbannaan dubbii tahe, hooqqannaan cittoo tahe.
meaning_om: Wanta xiqqoo kaasanii irratti dubbachuun dhimma guddaa fi lola fida; akkuma xannacha xiqqoo hooqqatanii balleessan.
meaning_en: Minor matters escalate into major conflicts when constantly argued over, just as gentle scratching turns an itch into a severe wound.

proverb: Anaatu hafeef dubbatta moo dubbiitu hafeef dubbatta?
meaning_om: Dubbiin dubbatamuu qabu dhumee osoo jiruu, na arrabsuu ykn na faana loluu qofaaf haasofta moo dhuguma dhimmatu jira?
meaning_en: Are you talking because there is an actual point left to discuss, or are you just targeting me personally to argue?

proverb: Dubbiin saara buqqeeti.
meaning_om: Dubbiin akkuma rifeensa ykn saara buqqee kutee kutee hin dhumu, baay'ee fagaatee faca'a.
meaning_en: Words and rumors spread continuously and branch out endlessly, just like the spreading runners of a pumpkin vine.

proverb: Dubbiin hundee manaati.
meaning_om: Haasawa gaariifi marii qajeelaatu maatiifi biyya ijaara; waldhabdeen hundis dubbiidhaan sirreeffama.
meaning_en: Proper communication, truthful speech, and wise counsel are the very bedrock that keeps families and communities united.

proverb: Dubbataan, qullaa haadha isaati hima.
meaning_om: Namni arraba hin qabne iccitii guddaa fi salphina maatii isaa illee osoo hin dhowwatin baasee hima.
meaning_en: A person lacking discretion and self-control in speech will shamelessly expose the most intimate and shameful family secrets.

proverb: Gurrinuu dhagayee, afaan maaliif lallaba?
meaning_om: Wanta ifatti beekamuufi gurri dhaga'e waantee lallabanii dhimma guddaa fakkeessuun hin barbaachisu.
meaning_en: When something has already been clearly heard and acknowledged, there is no need to shout or be dramatic about it.

proverb: Ilmarra, dubbiitu abbaa fakkaata.
meaning_om: Amalliifi ilaalchi nama tokkoo bifa isaarrayyuu caalaa jechaafi dubbii isaatiin mul'ata; akkaataan haasawaa eenyummaa namaa saaxila.
meaning_en: A person's true character and heritage are revealed far more through their words and principles than through mere physical resemblance.

proverb: Coomni foonii qalma keessaa mul'ata, coomni dubbii haasawa keessaa mul'ata.
meaning_om: Mi'aaniifi qulqullinni dubbii tokkoo yeroo haasa'an mul'ata; akkuma foon coomaa yeroo qalmaatti beekamu.
meaning_en: Just as the richness and quality of meat are revealed during butchering, the depth, wit, and wisdom of words shine through natural dialogue.

proverb: Namni dubbii guddatu, afaan qaban cinaan dubbata.
meaning_om: Namni arraba to'achuu hin dandeenye waan hundumaa keessa seenee dubbachuuf qorqalbii dhabuu isaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Someone who is hopelessly addicted to arguing or speaking will find any crack or side angle to insert their commentary, even when told to keep quiet.

proverb: Namni dubbii guddatu, ciniimmuu haadhaa hima.
meaning_om: Namni wanta dubbatu hin beekne wanta dubbatamuu hin malle hunda dubbatee of salphisa.
meaning_en: A person devoid of boundaries in conversation will shamelessly disclose sacred or taboo matters, like the intimacy of maternal labor.

proverb: Abbaan muka alaati, haati utubaa manaati.
meaning_om: Abbaan gaaddisaafi dahoo maatii kan alaa yoo ta'u, haati immoo utubaa fi bu'uura maatiiti; ga'ee abbaafi haadhaa ibsa.
meaning_en: The father provides external protection and shelter, while the mother is the central pillar supporting internal harmony and domestic life.

proverb: Haati hamtuu hin qabdu.
meaning_om: Haati yoomiyyuu ijoollee isheef gaariifi jaalala qofa qabdi; haati ijoollee ofiitiif hammeenya hin hawwitu.
meaning_en: A mother's intentions for her offspring are purely loving and benevolent; a mother bears no malice towards her children.

proverb: Haadhaa fi bishaan hamtuu hin qabani.
meaning_om: Akkuma bishaan jireenyaaf murteessaa ta'ee fi nama hin miine, haatis jireenyaaf bu'uura, jaalalli ishees qulqulluudha.
meaning_en: Just as water is pure and essential for sustaining life, a mother's presence and care are fundamentally benevolent and indispensable.

proverb: Haati namaa gaariin, haadha namaa hin taane, haati ofii hamtuun duutu namaa hin kaane.
meaning_om: Haadha ofii qaban kunuunsuu fi jaallachuun barbaachisaadha; nama biraa kamiyyuu bakka haadha ofii bu'uu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: No other woman, however kind, can replace your biological mother; cherish your own mother because once lost, she is gone forever.

proverb: Haati harma guufti malee, harka hin guuftu.
meaning_om: Haati yeroo ijoolleen guddatan harma hoosisuu dhaabduus, gargaarsaafi kunuunsa ishee hamma dhumaatti ijoollee isheerraa hin kutu.
meaning_en: A mother may eventually wean her child off milk, but she never stops providing lifelong guidance, support, and care.

proverb: Haadha guutee mannaa, haadha duute wayya.
meaning_om: Daa'imaaf haati yoo duute ormi yeruma sana birmatee madda aannanii yookaan haadha hoosiftu barbaadaaf; garuu haati yoo guutte (harmi goge), ormi waan haati jirtuuf quba hin qabu, daa'imnis harma gogaatti marfatee osoo hin beekamin beelaan miidhama. Akkasumas, madda ifatti dhabame caalaa waan jira fakkaatee bu'aa hin qabnetti hirkachuun balaadha.
meaning_en: When a nursing mother dies, the crisis is visible, so the community immediately steps in to find a wet nurse, milk, and foster care to save the infant. But when a mother's milk dries up, outsiders assume the child is fed and do not intervene, leaving the baby to quietly starve at a dry breast. Metaphorically, an open, total absence is better than relying on a hollow source that appears present but yields no sustenance.

proverb: Gadaamessi haadhaa, saara buqqeeti.
meaning_om: Akkuma saarri buqqee buqqee bifaafi gosa adda addaa godhatu, gadaamessi haadhaas ijoollee amalaafi bifa garaagaraa qaban dhalcha.
meaning_en: Just as pumpkin vines produce diverse gourds from the same root, a single mother gives birth to children with vastly different characters.

proverb: Namni haati tiyya fokkattuu dha ja'u hin jiru.
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu haadha ofiitiif jaalalaafi kabaja guddaa qaba; wanti kan ofii yoomiyyuu mi'aawaafi bareedaadha.
meaning_en: Every child perceives their own mother as beautiful and precious; one's own kin and origin are universally cherished without criticism.

proverb: Yemmuu ilma cidhaan diimatu, haadha ijaatu diimata.
meaning_om: Yeroo daa'imni ykn ilmi dhiiraa dhibee, dhukkubbii ykn dhiitoo cidhaaniitiin (cidhaan diimatee) waraanamu, haati dhukkubbii isaa danda'uu dadhabdee mararfannaa fi boo'icha cimaadhaan iji ishee diimata. Dhukkubbiin ilmaa haadhaaf waraansa qalbii fi imimmaan walirraa hin cinne ta'uu ibsa.
meaning_en: When a young boy suffers agonizing pain, swelling, or acute inflammation of the testicles, his mother weeps so uncontrollably in shared anguish that her own eyes turn bloodshot red. It expresses the depth of visceral maternal empathy: when a child hurts in the most sensitive place, the mother's eyes and heart bear the pain.

proverb: Haati hoggaa quufte ilmoo tiyyaaf jetti, ilmoon hoggaa quufte ammoo boruuf kaayatti.
meaning_om: Jaalalli haadhaa ofittoo hin qabu, yeroo hunda ijoollee dursiti; ilmoon immoo ofuma isaatiif dursa kenna.
meaning_en: A mother selflessly prioritizes her child before anything else, whereas offspring naturally prioritize their own personal future and self-preservation.

proverb: Aawliyaan duraa abbaa dha.
meaning_om: Abbaan duraan dursee eegduu, barsiisaa fi dahoo namaati; eebba abbaa argachuun eebba hundumaa caala.
meaning_en: One's father is the primary earthly guardian, protector, and spiritual shelter whose blessing must be honored first.

proverb: Abbaan namaa, abbaa namaaf hin tahu.
meaning_om: Namni ormaa hammam gaarii ta'us abbaa dhugaa namaaf ta'uu hin danda'u; abbaa ofiitu dhimma ofii baata.
meaning_en: No other man can replace the genuine care, authority, and protective instinct of your biological father.

proverb: Intala abbaa qabdu mariin mana, tan abbaa hin qabne mariin ala.
meaning_om: Intalli abbaa qabdu kabajaafi eegumsa maatii qabdi; tan abbaa hin qabne garuu salphinnaafi qeeqa ormaatiif saaxilamti.
meaning_en: A girl with a protective father is treated with dignity and proper domestic deliberation; an orphan girl lacks that shield and faces public vulnerability.

proverb: Abbaan gaariin gaaddisa ilmaaf jaara.
meaning_om: Abbaan amala gaarii qabu egeree ilma isaatiif wanta gaarii qopheessa, qabeenyaafi maqaa bareedaa dhalootaaf dabarsa.
meaning_en: A prudent and loving father prepares a stable future, honorable reputation, and protective shelter for his offspring.

proverb: Abbaan laalee hin quufu, ilmoon nyaattee hin quuftu.
meaning_om: Jaalalli abbaan ijoollee isaatiif qabu daangaa hin qabu; ilmoonis yeroo hunda kennaafi jaalala abbaa barbaaddi.
meaning_en: A father derives endless fulfillment simply gazing upon his child's well-being, while a child has an endless appetite for parental care.

proverb: Abbaan gaariin dayma namaa guduunfa, abbaan hamaan heexo namaa guduunfa.
meaning_om: Abbaan qajeelaan ilmaan isaatiif eebba, beekumsaafi qabeenya mi'aawaa dhaala; abbaan badiin immoo salphinaafi rakkoo dhiisee darba.
meaning_en: A virtuous father leaves behind a sweet legacy of wisdom, wealth, and honor, whereas an irresponsible father leaves bitter shame and suffering.

proverb: Hanga aduun jirtu kaadhu, hanga abbaan kee jiru nyaadhu.
meaning_om: Yeroo abbaan jiru eegumsaafi nyaata gaarii argatan waan ta'eef, carraa qabanitti fayyadamanii jireenya qananiin dabarsuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Seize the day while you have light, and cherish life's provisions while your father is alive to protect and sustain you.

proverb: Abbaan gaangee harree dha.
meaning_om: Gaangeen hammam boonus ykn faayamus abbaan isaa harreedha; namni bu'uuraafi dhaloota ofii ganuu ykn itti qaana'uu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: No matter how proud or elevated a mule appears, its sire is still a donkey; one cannot disguise or disown one's humble origins.

proverb: Abbaan xiqqaa hin qabu.
meaning_om: Abbaan yeroo hunda ulfinaafi aangoo maatii qaba; abbaa ofii xiqqeessanii ilaaluun hin ta'u.
meaning_en: A father's authority, dignity, and position of respect are never minor or negligible, regardless of his material standing or physical stature.

proverb: Dachii fi haadha waan itti kennan irrumaa fudhatani.
meaning_om: Akkuma dachiin wanta facaasan qofa magarsitu, haatis jaalalaafi kunuunsa itti kennan deebistee namaaf laatti; akkuma itti tolan tolti.
meaning_en: The earth yields only according to what is planted, and a mother reciprocates with the love and honor she is given.

proverb: Haadhaa fi adurree hin dhaanani.
meaning_om: Haadha rukutuun safuu fi abaarsa fida; adurreenis bineensa manaa kan miidhaan irra ga'uu hin qabneedha; safuu maatii eeguu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Striking a mother is a grievous cultural and spiritual taboo; gentle treatment and absolute non-violence are owed to maternal figures and domestic companions.

proverb: Namni abbaa fi haadha hin sodaanne waaqa hin sodaatu.
meaning_om: Kabajni maatii bu'uura amantii fi amala gaariiti; nama maatii ofii hin kabajne Waaqayyoon hin sodaatu.
meaning_en: Piety, morality, and reverence for God begin with honoring one's parents; someone who disrespects their parents has no fear of the divine.

proverb: Hamaan hamadayaa, qabatan nama guba.
meaning_om: Namni hamaan akka amadaa ykn qorra nama waxaluuti; itti siquun miidhaa fi balaa fida.
meaning_en: A toxic, malevolent person is like frost or burning embers; getting close to them inevitably brings pain and harm.

proverb: Mukni badaan hin daraaru.
meaning_om: Namni ykn wanti jalqabumaan badii fi faayidaa-dhabeessa ta'e bu'aa gaarii hin argamsiisu.
meaning_en: An inherently corrupt or useless person or thing will never produce good, fruitful results.

proverb: Xannacha xiqqaatu foon ajeeysa.
meaning_om: Wanti xiqqoon tokko yoo amala badaa qabaate waan guddaa hunda xureessa; nama tokkoon maatiin ykn hawaasni xuraa'a.
meaning_en: A tiny tainted lymph gland ruins the whole carcass; similarly, a single corrupt individual can spoil an entire group.

proverb: Nama hamaa duuti lama.
meaning_om: Namni hamaan jireenya isaatti jibbaafi salphinnaan du'a, gaafa du'us gaddaa fi yaadannoo gaarii dhabuun du'a.
meaning_en: A wicked person dies twice: once through social contempt and isolation in life, and again when they perish unmourned.

proverb: Badaa qalbiin lama.
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa badaa ta'e murtee dhaabbataa hin qabu; shakkiifi shira keessa jiraata.
meaning_en: A corrupt or deceitful person is always double-minded, inconsistent, and plagued by guilt and suspicion.

proverb: Ilmi badaan, warra hin badhaadhu.
meaning_om: Ilmi amala badaa qabu, kan dhibaa'aa fi naamus-dhabeessa ta'e, of danda'ee bultii dhaabbachuu fi maatii badhaadhaa ijaarrachuu hin danda'u; amalli hamaan warroomuu fi milkaa'ina bultii nama dhowwa.
meaning_en: An ill-mannered, reckless, or delinquent son never flourishes into establishing a stable, prosperous household of his own. Flawed character and lack of discipline prevent a young man from maintaining a marriage, settling down, and building a thriving family.

proverb: Namni hamaan, bofa afaa jalaati.
meaning_om: Namni amala hamaa qabu osoo hin beekamin dhihootti nama miidha; diina keessaa kan balaan isaa ulfaatuudha.
meaning_en: A treacherous person is like a venomous snake hidden beneath one's bedding: close, stealthy, and fatally dangerous.

proverb: Hamtuun, fardaa fi garbu adda baafti.
meaning_om: Rakkoon yeroo dhufu wanti gaarii fi wanti dhimma hin baafne adda ba'a; yeroo rakkinaatu eenyummaa dhugaa saaxila.
meaning_en: Adversity and critical trials test true worth, separating what is genuine and durable from what is superficial.

proverb: Saani eegee dhiigaa, eegee dhaan loon balleessa.
meaning_om: Namni tokko amala badaa qabaannaan, amala isaa sanaan namoota nagaa fi qulqulluu ta'an hunda xureessa.
meaning_en: A single bleeding cow spatters the entire herd; likewise, one miscreant spreads corruption and taint to everyone around.

proverb: Badaa, fageenyi hin teessifne.
meaning_om: Namni hamaan bakka kamiyyuu yoo deeme amala isaa hin dhiisu; fageenyi amala badaa hin jijjiiru.
meaning_en: Relocation cannot change a wicked nature; troublemakers carry their malice wherever they go.

proverb: Gaangeen hamtuun, abba qaanessiti.
meaning_om: Wanti ykn namni of jala jiru yoo amala dhabe, salphinni isaa gara abbaatti deebi'a.
meaning_en: A recalcitrant mule disgraces its master in public; similarly, the misdeeds of dependents embarrass those responsible for them.

proverb: Warri badaan, wal faana bada.
meaning_om: Warri hundi isaanii amala badaa qaban yoo walitti qabaman, wal deggaranii waliin badu.
meaning_en: A family or group united in corruption and wrongdoing will drag each other down into collective destruction.

proverb: Irraa eegan malee, hamaan naanniga boorata.
meaning_om: Nama amala badaa qabu yoo to'annoo jala hin oolchin wanta qulqulluu hunda ni xureessa.
meaning_en: Unless strictly watched and kept in check, a reckless troublemaker will foul the drinking trough and ruin shared peace.

proverb: Waa lamaatu nama guba, takka qondoo soogidda hin qabne tan lammadaa kofoo injiree qabdu dhukkuba gaaffii hin qabne.
meaning_om: Wanti akka malee nama dhiphisuufi nagaa nama dhowwu wantoota salphoo fakkaatanii nama cinqaniidha.
meaning_en: Insipid nourishment and constant hidden irritation are maddening domestic afflictions that torment a person relentlessly.

proverb: Qaceelaan dhibbaa fi tokko, hamaan dhibbaa fi shantami.
meaning_om: Namni qajeelaan baay'ee muraasa, garuu namni hamaan fi badii hojjetu lakkoofsa hin qabu, lakkoofsaanis baay'eedha.
meaning_en: Upright, noble individuals are exceedingly rare, whereas corrupt and wicked people are found everywhere in abundance.

proverb: Badaan yoo gorsan ni lola.
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa badaan gorsa qajeelaa hin fudhatu; balleessaa isaa itti himnaan aaree lola kakaasa.
meaning_en: A foolish or ill-natured person resents wise counsel and reacts with anger and hostility when corrected.

proverb: Keessummaan hamtuun galuu hin feetu, warri hamaan keessummaa ofirraa hin galchu.
meaning_om: Namni daangaa hin beekne bakka isaaf hin malle tura; warri doqnis simannaa gaarii dhowwata; lamaanuu hanqina naamusaa qabu.
meaning_en: An inconsiderate guest overstays their welcome, while an inhospitable host refuses to bid guests a proper farewell.

proverb: Gaagura seenu damma balleessa amaan, ofii badee nama balleessa hamaan.
meaning_om: Akkuma bineensi gaagura keessa seenee damma barbadeessu, namni hamaanis ofii barbadaa'ee namoota kaanis waliin balleessa.
meaning_en: Just as a destructive pest invades a beehive only to ruin the honey, a corrupt individual self-destructs while dragging others down.

proverb: Hamaan kan ofiituu hamaa dha.
meaning_om: Fira ta'us alagaa, namni hamaan yoomiyyuu miidhaa fida; firummaan hammeenya nama jalaa hin dhoksu.
meaning_en: Evil does not become harmless merely because it comes from a relative; a malevolent kinsperson remains toxic and destructive.

proverb: Hamaan waarii du'eeti, warra hirriiba dhoowwa.
meaning_om: Namni hamaan jireenya isaattis rakkoo fida, gaafa du'us namoota nagaa dhowwee dhiphisa.
meaning_en: A troublesome individual causes distress even in passing, choosing midnight to die just to disrupt everyone's peace and rest.

proverb: "Balleeyso foon hiri" jennaan, "tole inninuu baktii dhaa" je'e.
meaning_om: Nama duraanuu mancaasuu fi badiidhaan beekamu (Balleeysoo) dhimma gati-jabeessa irratti itti-gaafatamummaan akka qoodu yoo itti kennan, inni dantaa fi gammachuun itti seenee wanticha akka baktii fi gati-dhabeessaatti xiqqeessee mancaasuuf qophii ta'uu agarsiisa. Qabeenyaa fi dhimma murteessaa nama amala badii qabuuf kennuun gowwummaa ta'uu akeekkachiisa.
meaning_en: When a notorious ruiner or corrupt figure (addressed by the moniker 'Balleeyso', meaning Spoiler) is foolishly tasked with distributing prized meat, he complies with malicious eagerness, immediately disparaging the meat as mere carrion (baktii) to justify spoiling and plundering it without remorse. It cautions against the folly of entrusting valuable resources or stewardship to someone with a proven track record of destruction.

proverb: Afaan ciniinsa beeku, dhungoo hin beeku.
meaning_om: Namni hammeenyaafi miidhaa nama irratti raawwachuu bare, jaalalaafi gara-laafina agarsiisuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A person whose nature is cruelty and hostility is incapable of genuine tenderness and affection.

proverb: Liqii nama hamaa, bishaan raafuu fudhatani.
meaning_om: Nama hamaa ykn doqna irraa waanuma argatan xiqqoollee taatu fudhatanii irraa fottoquutu wayya; guutuu eeggachuun harka qullaa nama hambisa.
meaning_en: When recovering a debt from a dishonest or hostile person, accept whatever little settlement is offered and cut ties rather than waiting in vain for full repayment.

proverb: Hamaan fira gaariiti.
meaning_om: Gaarummaan kan ifee mul'atu yoo hammeenyi jiraatedha; wanti gaariin gatii kan argatu wanta hamaa wajjin yoo dorgomedha.
meaning_en: The value of goodness and virtue shines most brilliantly in contrast with wickedness; the bad serves to illuminate the good.

proverb: Gaariin jiraannaan, hamtuun jiraatte.
meaning_om: Addunyaa kanarratti wanti hundi faallaa mataa isaa qaba; gaariin qofti osoo hin taane hamaanis wajjuma jiraata.
meaning_en: Good and evil are perpetually intertwined aspects of existence; duality is an inherent reality of human life.

proverb: Hanga tolli ture, hammeenyi hin turre.
meaning_om: Gaarummaafi toli yeroo hunda dhiibbaa hamaa caalaatti tura; hammeenyi yeroof malee bu'uura hin qabu, ni bada.
meaning_en: Benevolence, justice, and good deeds endure across generations, whereas evil and tyranny are ephemeral and doomed to collapse.

proverb: Namni wajji galanii nama nyaatu, bineensa.
meaning_om: Namni nama wajjin nagaan jiraata jedhanii mana ofiitti amananii galchan garuu nama miidhu, bineensa caalaa hamaadha.
meaning_en: An intimate companion or housemate who exploits, backstabs, or preys upon you is no human, but a predator.

proverb: Heexoo fi niitiin namatti hin dabin.
meaning_om: Heexoon akkuma dhukkubsaatti ulfaattu, haati manaa yoo nama jibbite jireenyi manaa abidda ta'a; nagaa maatii eeggachuu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Just as an adverse dose of kosso is agonizing, an antagonistic spouse makes life unbearable; domestic peace is vital.

proverb: Abbaan hamaan ofii foon ciratee nyaateeti, ilma shuumoo nyaachisa.
meaning_om: Abbaan ofittoo ta'e ofii isaatiif qananii barbaadee ijoollee isaa beelaafi dararaaf dhiisa; itti-gaafatamummaa abbummaa dhabuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: A selfish and cruel father indulges in luxury and delicacies for himself while leaving his child with dry, meager scraps.

proverb: Balaan sigicha teesseeti Boorteetti faraqaa seenti.
meaning_om: Balaan ykn hammeenyi bakka tokkotti hin hafu; dabaree dabareedhaan hunda bira ga'a waan ta'eef of eeggannoon barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Trouble and calamity do not remain stationary; misfortunes make their rounds from one community to the next.

proverb: Daddabee na dhibee karaan goda goraa, hamaan sinqii sii hin dhiisu muka keessaan goraa.
meaning_om: Yeroo nama hamaa wajjin walitti dhufan, humnaan wal dura dhaabbachuu mannaa karaan dabarfachuufi irraa fagaachuutu furmaata.
meaning_en: When facing an aggressive rogue who aims to plunder your provisions, it is wiser to bypass them through the trees than invite destruction.

proverb: Ilmi hamaan, abbaa duubaa kasha hata.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen amala dhabduun maatii ofii amanamummaa dhowwattee qabeenya isaanii hatee salphisa.
meaning_en: A disloyal and wicked son betrays his father's trust, stealthily plundering the family stores from behind his back.

proverb: Obbolleessi hamaan, bineensa duratti si dhiiseeti si biraa dheessa.
meaning_om: Obboleessi amala hamaa qabu gaafa balaafi qormaatni dhufu nama dhiisee baqata; obbolummaan gaafa rakkinaa beekama.
meaning_en: A false, cowardly brother abandons you in the face of mortal peril and saves his own skin; true brotherhood is proven in adversity.

proverb: Waraabessi kan boodaa irra hamaa dha.
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan ykn hanni dhufu, inni boodarra dhufu waan duraan hafellee guuree fixa; wanti dhumarratti nama mudatu daran ulfaataadha.
meaning_en: The last scavenger to strike is often the most ruthless, stripping away whatever meager scraps were spared earlier.

proverb: Hamaan kakachuu hin sodaatu, kakateeti du'a.
meaning_om: Namni hamaan kakuu sobaatiin Waaqayyoo fi safuu hin sodaanne, garuu kakuun sun boodarra badiisa isa irratti fida.
meaning_en: An unscrupulous person has no qualms about swearing false oaths, but divine retribution eventually catches up and destroys them.

proverb: Cubbuun harka walirraa murti.
meaning_om: Hojiin cubbuu fi hammeenyaa walitti-dhufeenya obbolummaa, michummaa fi wal-gargaarsa gidduu jiru hunda barbadeessa.
meaning_en: Sin, treachery, and injustice sever the mutual bonds of brotherhood and cooperation that make people assist one another.

proverb: Bofa summii isaatiif sodaatani.
meaning_om: Namni tokko kan sodaatamu ykn kan kabajamu humna miidhuu ykn qulqullina amala isaa isa iccitii ta'eeni.
meaning_en: Respect or fear is commanded by one's capability to defend oneself or strike back, just as a serpent is dreaded for its venom.

proverb: Bakka sareen itti dhuufte, waraabessi hin hanqatu.
meaning_om: Mallattoon ykn malli balaa tokko yoo mul'ate, wanti hamaaniifi guddaan itti aanee dhufuun isaa hin oolu.
meaning_en: Where preliminary signs of vulnerability or disorder appear, greater predators and disasters will inevitably follow.

proverb: Waa qalle jennaan, keessummaan taa'aa bulte.
meaning_om: Namni abdii sobaa ykn wanta dhihootti hin argamne hawwu, dharraafi yaaddoodhaan nagaa dhabee bula.
meaning_en: Lured by grand promises or the prospect of a feast, an eager person waits all night in restless anticipation only to be disappointed.

proverb: Suguyyaan, sangaa jaalatte arrabsiti.
meaning_om: Daldalaan foonii (suguyyaan) gabaa keessatti sangaa gabbataa fi qaalii isa qalmaaf jaalate sana gatii gadi buusuuf jedhee 'ni huqqata, amala hin qabu' jechuun hanqina itti barbaadee arrabsa. Akkasumas, namni wanta tokko garaadhaa kajeelu ykn nama tokko barbaadu salphaatti argachuuf jedhee afaaniin wanta sana tuffatee xiqqeessa.
meaning_en: At the cattle market, a butcher who spots a prime, fat ox he eagerly wishes to buy will deliberately criticize, nitpick, and belittle it—calling it lean, old, or defective—solely to drive down the seller's asking price. Metaphorically, it describes how buyers, competitors, or suitors feign contempt and disparage what they secretly desire in order to deflate its value and secure it cheaply.

proverb: Bishaan shuumoo naa qiciin, shuumoo keessa barbaaduu dha.
meaning_om: Namni waan xiqqoo gaafatu yeroo baay'ee wanta guddaa fi dantaa dhokataa qabaachuu isaa agarsiisa; tooftaadhaan dhiyaachuu.
meaning_en: Asking meekly for the broth of boiled grains is just a polite pretext to get the actual grains; a modest request concealing real desire.

proverb: Harma halaalaa, qalbiin ishii ilaala.
meaning_om: Wanti fagootti mul'atu yeroo hunda dharraafi yaada namaa kakaasa; fageenyi wantoota akka mi'aawaa fakkaatan godha.
meaning_en: Distant attractions or unattainable desires constantly preoccupy the mind; things viewed from afar appear overwhelmingly alluring.

proverb: Olii dhabee, oli dhaqa.
meaning_om: Namni bakka dhimmi isaa hin furamin irraa abdii kutee, ammas gara gubbaatti carraaqqii fi gargaarsa dabalataa barbaada.
meaning_en: Having failed to find help or sustenance from regular higher sources, one ventures even further upward in desperate pursuit.

proverb: Kajeellaan, ijaaf hammaatteeti, garaaf tolti.
meaning_om: Wanta namaa kajeeluun ykn kadhachuun qaanii fi salphina ijaaf fiduus, garaa beela'eef garuu quufa fida.
meaning_en: Begging or coveting another's food embarrasses one's pride and eyes, but satisfies the desperate physical demands of the belly.

proverb: Qalbiin saree, gara mataa.
meaning_om: Namni fedhii foonii ykn faayidaa qofarratti xiyyeeffatu, qalbiin isaa yeroo mara gara dantaa isaatti qajeela.
meaning_en: A dog's entire attention is fixated on the butchered head and scraps; similarly, a self-serving opportunist thinks solely of their immediate cut.

proverb: Ayliin Adurree funyaanirra.
meaning_om: Namni hubannoo fagootti hin yaanne, wantuma dura isaatti mul'atu ykn dhihootti dhuunfatu qofa arga; yaada gabaabaa qaba.
meaning_en: A cat's wit extends no further than the tip of its nose; said of short-sighted individuals who only react to what is directly in front of them.

proverb: Namni ilkee hin qabne, foonitti maraata.
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii wanta tokko itti fayyadamuu hin qabne, wantichuma sana daran hawwa; wanti hin danda'amne nama kajeelchiisa.
meaning_en: A person lacking teeth craves tough meat the most; people often passionately desire what they are least equipped to consume or handle.

proverb: Bishingaan bilchaate, kan muru hin dhabu.
meaning_om: Wanti gaariin, bilchaateefi faayidaaf qophii ta'e yoomiyyuu gatii fi fudhatama hin dhabu; dandeettiin mul'ataan barbaadama.
meaning_en: Ripe grain never lacks harvesters; when talent, beauty, or a valuable opportunity reaches maturity, eager takers will naturally appear.

proverb: Namni nagaan guddate, boo'ichaaf dharra'a.
meaning_om: Namni rakkinaafi qormaata jireenyaa argee hin beekne, wanta nagaa fi tasgabbii qabu tuffatee balaa fi jeequmsa hawwa.
meaning_en: Someone who has known only sheltered tranquility takes peace for granted and perversely flirts with drama or conflict.

proverb: Allaattiin foon argitee, samii'rra marsiti.
meaning_om: Namni dantaa fi faayidaa argachuuf qophaa'e, osoo ifatti hin seenin fagoodhaa naanna'ee carraa eeggata.
meaning_en: When an opportunist spots a lucrative prize, they hover patiently from a distance, watching and circling until the right moment to strike.

proverb: Ijji waan namaa hin fuune.
meaning_om: Ilaaluun qofti miidhaa hin fidu; namni wanta namaa arguun dhoorkamuu hin danda'u, ilaalchi hanna miti.
meaning_en: Merely looking at something does not deplete it or constitute theft; looking is harmless and costs nothing.

proverb: "Ballaa maal barbaadda" jennaan, "ifa" jedhe.
meaning_om: Wanta namatti hir'ate ykn barbaachisaa ta'e ifatti beekuun nama hin dhibu; fedhiin bu'uuraa nama hundumaa ifaadha.
meaning_en: The most urgent need of any deprived person is obvious; one should not ask superfluous questions when the essential necessity is evident.

proverb: Bakka garaan jiru, miilli nama geessa.
meaning_om: Namni bakka dantaan, jaalallii fi faayidaan isaa jiru kamiyyuu akka fedhetti qaxxaamuree ni deema.
meaning_en: Wherever one's desire, heart, or food lies, one's feet will inevitably find a way to travel there; longing motivates action.

proverb: "Waan galgala jedhan san laata ni irraanfatanii" jedhe, waraabessi.
meaning_om: Namni hamaan ykn dantaa barbaadu waan namoonni jedhan irratti qabamee carraa eeggata; yaaddoo dhuunfaatiin burjaaja'a.
meaning_en: An anxious opportunist continually frets that people might have forgotten their promises, hoping against hope to exploit the situation.

proverb: Keessummaan takka bultii, ijji sagal bulti.
meaning_om: Keessummaan mana namaa kan turtu halkanuma tokko qofa ta'ullee, simannaan, kabajni, amallii fi wanti ijaan argan sun garuu yeroo dheeraaf (halkan sagal) yaadatamaa, odeeffamaa fi qalbiitti hafa. Kanaafuu, keessummaa kabajaan simachuun fi keessummaanis naamusaan of qabuun barbaachisaadha; oolmaan halkan tokkoo maqaa yeroo dheeraa fida.
meaning_en: A guest may lodge under your roof for only a single night, but the eye—the impression, memory, reputation, and social scrutiny of that visit—lingers for nine nights. The conduct of both guest and host leaves an enduring legacy long after the visit concludes; therefore, hosts must offer generous hospitality and visitors must observe impeccable decorum.

proverb: "Osoo akka kiyyaatii, warri hundi karra hin cufatu"  jedhe, waraabessi.
meaning_om: Namni hataan ykn dantaa qabu namoonni hundi of eeggannoo akka dhiisanii fi akka saamamaniif mijatu hawwa.
meaning_en: A predator naturally wishes that all gates be left unlocked; enemies always wish for their targets to abandon their defenses.

proverb: "Tiyyaaf illee hin jennee, gurbaan keeysan sun fuudha hin dubbatuu?" jette, haftuun.
meaning_om: Namni dantaa ofii dhoksaan barbaadu akka waan nama biraatiif yaaduutti fakkeessaa haasa'a; sobatti fayyadamu.
meaning_en: Feigning pure altruism or casual curiosity, an eager spinster probes about an eligible bachelor to advance her own marital prospects.

proverb: "Addaan ooluu dhoorkaa, armaa yaa'uu dhoorkaa"  jette, haftuun.
meaning_om: Namni ofiif bakka dhabe ykn hireen irra dabre, walitti dhufuun nama biraa akka hin milkoofneef shiraafi jeequmsa fida.
meaning_en: Having missed her own opportunities, an envious person seeks to dictate, confuse, and obstruct the harmonious unions of others.

proverb: Karra masheenaa, kan haftuun hawwite.
meaning_om: Wanta dhugoomuu hin dandeenye ykn bu'aa hin qabne dharra'uun faayidaa hin fidu; hawwii sobaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Desiring barren livestock or empty prospects brings no real benefit; wishing desperately for unproductive things.

proverb: Asiitu laafa jennaan shilmiin gamaa dhufte.
meaning_om: Namni dantaa fi faayidaa barbaadu bakka wanti salphaatti argamu dhaga'ee dafee itti dhangala'a.
meaning_en: When freeloaders hear of an easy opportunity or tender mark, they flock there immediately from far away.

proverb: "Baasaan baasaa, gadi na baasaa"  jette, haftuun.
meaning_om: Namni wanta tokko baay'ee dharra'e haalaafi qajeelfama osoo hin filatin akkamittiyyuu haa ta'u jedhee wawwaata.
meaning_en: Desperate for a husband or resolution, someone drops all standards, pleading to be accommodated under any condition.

proverb: Silaa hin ooluu, kajeelaa dura waamaa.
meaning_om: Namni osoo hin waaminis dhufuun isaa hin oolle, duraan dursa waamanii kabajaan simachuutu rakkina irraa nama oolcha.
meaning_en: Since an insistent freeloader will inevitably show up uninvited, it is wiser to invite them formally from the start.

proverb: Foon hin nyaannuun, osoo garaachi hin urgaawini.
meaning_om: Namni wanta tokko hin barbaadu ykn hin jaalladhu jedhee waakkatus, yeroo wantichi mi'aawaa dhiyaatu amala jijjiirrata.
meaning_en: People proudly claim they have no appetite for something, right up until the enticing aroma tempts them to indulge.

proverb: Saree warri guddise dhabe, warri raqaa argata.
meaning_om: Namni ykn meeshaan maatiin guddisanii fi kunuunsan dhimma maatiitiif dhabamee, bakka faayidaa hin qabneetti argama.
meaning_en: A household nurtures a dog only to lose its loyalty, while strangers with carcass scraps easily command its presence.

proverb: "Akkam foon jaaladhullee huqqattuu hin nyaadhu" jette, jeedalloon.
meaning_om: Namni dharraa fi fedhii qabaatuyyuu sadarkaa fi ulfina ofii dhiisee wanta gatii hin qabne hin fudhatu.
meaning_en: Despite intense craving, one pretends to maintain high standards and scorns inferior offerings to save face.

proverb: Namni waan hin argin hin abjootu.
meaning_om: Yaada, hawwii fi abjuun namaa wantuma jireenya keessatti argeefi beeku irratti hundaa'a; beekumsa malee dharraan hin jiru.
meaning_en: Human imagination and desires are bounded by what one has observed; you cannot covet what you have never known.

proverb: Ilkaan foonii, garaa keessa jira.
meaning_om: Fedhiin wanta tokko argachuu fi mi'aa isaa dhandhamuu garaadhaani; dharraan dhugaa keessa namaatii madaala.
meaning_en: The true appetite and drive to acquire meat reside deep within the stomach; true determination is fueled by inner hunger.

proverb: Minniin, qabbana diddeeti, oowwatti gamti.
meaning_om: Namni wanta nagaa fi tasgabbii qabu didee fedhii dhuunfaatiin balaa fi dhiphina keessa of seensa.
meaning_en: Recklessly fleeing modest discomfort, the foolish plunge headlong into blazing danger; jumping from the pan into the fire.

proverb: "Hamma ija kootii naaf hin kajeeltu" jette, sareen.
meaning_om: Hawwii fi fedhiin namni dantaa barbaadu qabu hamma namoonni isaaf kennan caalaa baay'ee guddaadha.
meaning_en: The expectations and hungry gaze of the needy far exceed what anyone is willing or able to give them.

proverb: Kajeellaan, waan namaa, nama hin nyaachisu.
meaning_om: Wanta nama biraa ijaan ilaaluufi hawwuun garaa namaa hin quubsu; of danda'anii hojjechuutu furmaata.
meaning_en: Simply lusting after other people's possessions puts no food in your belly; only one's own hard work sustains life.

proverb: Nama fardaan barbaadani, laffatti argatani.
meaning_om: Wanti fagootti baay'ee itti dhama'anii barbaadan salphaatti fi dhihootti osoo hin yaadin argama.
meaning_en: Someone or something sought far and wide with massive effort turns out to be right nearby within easy reach.

proverb: "Waan jaalatan nyaatanii, kan jibban namni haa nyaatuuf hin kennanii?" jedhe, waraabessi.
meaning_om: Namni doqni wanta ofiif hin barbaanne illee nama dhabeef kennuu hin fedhu; amala doqnummaa qeeqaa.
meaning_en: Misers hoard even discarded remnants that they despise rather than letting needy scavengers partake.

proverb: Namni bakka ciisu argate, bakka diriirfatu barbaada.
meaning_om: Namni wanta muraasa yoo argate daangaa dhabee dabalata barbaada; quubsa dhabuu fi kajeellaa babal'atu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Give someone an inch and they will take a mile; once a basic privilege is granted, greed immediately demands full comfort.

proverb: Abjuun bara beelaa, biddeena biddeena jetti.
meaning_om: Yeroo rakkinaafi beelaa, yaadaafi hawwiin nama hundumaa wantuma bu'uuraa dhabame sana qofarratti xiyyeeffata.
meaning_en: In times of severe deprivation, all thoughts, hopes, and dreams are obsessively centered on basic survival and food.

proverb: Rarra'aa foon magaalaa, ijji hin fuune.
meaning_om: Wanta bareedaa fi mi'aawaa ilaaluun qofti nama hin miidhu; wanta fagootti mul'atu arguun dhoorkaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: The hanging cuts of meat in the butchery can be admired by any passerby without penalty; looking costs nothing.

proverb: "Isa kanniisni arge argi" jedheeti, bookee ule.
meaning_om: Wanta namni humna qabu tokko dandamatee dabarse, nama dadhabaa irratti fe'anii adabuun miidhaa fida; wal hin madaalu.
meaning_en: Punishing a frail gnat with the ferocity intended for a bee is disproportionate and unjust; treating unequal things equally.

proverb: Hamma kan nyaatu fixutti, kan kajeelu hin deemu.
meaning_om: Namni dantaa barbaadu hamma carraan dhumatutti ykn abdii kutatutti bakka dantaa sanarraa hin fagaatu.
meaning_en: An expectant freeloader or beggar will not budge an inch until the eater has swallowed the very last morsel.

proverb: "Lukkuun sireerra taa'uun qaanii dha" jette, jeedalloon.
meaning_om: Diinni ykn inaaffaan namaa bakka ulfinaa namaaf hin hawwu; waan ofiif dhabeef nama biraatti hinaafa.
meaning_en: The predator complains of impropriety when its prey is safely elevated out of reach; masking envy as moral outrage.

proverb: Sirba tole, namuu ni jaalata.
meaning_om: Wanti qulqullinaan hojjetameefi bareede hunda biratti fudhatamaafi jaalala argata; hojiin gaariin ofiisaa beeksisa.
meaning_en: Excellence, beauty, and harmonious work are universally appreciated; fine craftsmanship wins universal praise.

proverb: Waan dhoksaan rakkatan, ijaatu keessa jira.
meaning_om: Rakkinaafi dhiphina keessa namaa dhoksuun hin danda'amu; kophummaan dhokatullee ijaafi bifa namaarratti mul'ata.
meaning_en: Internal grief, hunger, or secret anguish cannot stay hidden; the eyes and facial countenance inevitably betray inner torment.

proverb: Kan humnaan lafaa hin kaane, yaadaan Awroophatti daldala.
meaning_om: Namni hojii qabatamaa xiqqoollee raawwachuu hin dandeenye, abjuu fi yaadaan waan guddaa haasa'a; dhibaa'ummaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: One who lacks the energy to get off the floor concocts grandiose fantasies of trading across Europe; idle daydreaming.

proverb: Sagalee kee dhagayeetiin, sagal manaa bahe.
meaning_om: Jaalala, fedhiifi dharraa guddaa irraa kan ka'e, mallattoo xiqqoo dhaga'uun tarkaanfii deddeebi'anii fudhachuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Driven by intense affection and anticipation, one rushes outdoors repeatedly at the slightest sound of a beloved voice.

proverb: Waraabessi waan halkan nyaatu, guyya abjuudhaan arga.
meaning_om: Namni fedhii hamaa ykn dantaa qabu, yeroo hunda waan fuulduratti saamuufi miidhu yaadaatiin qophaa'a.
meaning_en: A predator constantly meditates upon its forthcoming nightly plunder even during broad daylight; ceaseless scheming.

proverb: Adurree nyaattee, sareen afaan haxaawatti.
meaning_om: Namni gocha badaa, dhowwamaa yookaan qaanii ta'e dhoksaan raawwatee, akka waan qulqulluu ta'etti badii isaa dhoksuuf fakkeessu yookaan of qulqulleessu ibsa.
meaning_en: It describes a hypocritical person who secretly commits a shameful or wrongful act and then wipes away the evidence to pretend they are innocent and blameless.

proverb: Dhaltee hin beektuu, dhalaaf jarjarti.
meaning_om: Namni ulfina, rakkinaa fi itti gaafatamummaa hojii yookaan dhimma tokkoo osoo muuxannoo hin qabaatin, salphaa itti fakkaatee gara sanatti kan jarjaru ta'uu ibsa.
meaning_en: It illustrates how an inexperienced person eagerly rushes into a heavy responsibility or difficult challenge without truly understanding the pain, hardship, and effort it demands.

proverb: Garaan gowwaan, ganaana dinnichaati kajeela.
meaning_om: Gowwaan waan gatii hin qabne, hin nyaatamne yookaan nama miidhu hawwuu fi kajeeluun bu'aa dhugaa akka dhabu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: A foolish mind or undisciplined desire covets worthless, inedible, or harmful things instead of seeking genuine value and true nourishment.

proverb: Heerri heeraa, aadaan diqaala.
meaning_om: Heerri Oromoo seera bu'uuraa kan jijjiiramuu hin dandeenyee fi haqa qajeelaadha; aadaan garuu yeroofi bakkaan jijjiiramuu danda'a.
meaning_en: The supreme customary law is immutable and authoritative; local traditions and cultural variations are secondary and flexible.

proverb: Heerri mana qaba, manni abba qaba.
meaning_om: Seerri bakka itti murtaa'uu fi hooggana seera eegsisu qaba; seerri akkasumaan lafatti hin dhiifamu, sirnaan gaggeeffama.
meaning_en: Law resides in an established institutional council, and every council has recognized authority; justice operates through legitimate institutions.

proverb: Leeccaallo soddaaf dhiisan malee, heera soddaaf hin dhiisani.
meaning_om: Qabeenyaan ykn arjummaan soddaa kabajuun danda'ama, garuu dhimma haqaa fi seeraa irratti firummaan hin hojjetu; seerri hundaaf wal qixa.
meaning_en: One can be generous with gifts or property toward in-laws, but the rule of law must never be bent or waived for family ties.

proverb: Oromoon seeraan bulti, sidaamni firdiin bula.
meaning_om: Oromoon heeraafi seera walta'iinsaan tumamee fi waliigalteedhaan kabajamee bula malee firdii gubbaadhaa fe'amuun hin hoogganamu.
meaning_en: The Oromo society governs itself through democratic consensus and internalized constitutional law, rather than imposed authoritarian rulings.

proverb: Barcumarraa waliif ka'an malee, heerarraa waliif hin ka'ani.
meaning_om: Ulfinaafi kabajaaf teessuma namaa kennuun ni danda'ama, garuu haqaafi seera namarra dabsanii dabarfatanii kennuun hin danda'amu; heerri hin cabeessu.
meaning_en: One yields a physical seat out of politeness and respect, but justice and the law can never be surrendered or compromised for anyone.

proverb: Himannoon bilisummaa dha, heera fudhachuuniis bilisummaa dha.
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu mufannaa isaa seeraan himachuuf mirga guutuu qaba; murtee seeraas amanee fudhachuun nagaafi bilisummaa dhugaa mirkaneessa.
meaning_en: Having the right to petition and voice grievances embodies liberty, and willingly submitting to fair judicial verdicts ensures mutual civil freedom.

proverb: Lammiin namatti jiguurra, gaarri namatti jiguu wayya.
meaning_om: Firiifi lammiin ofii yoo nama ganan ykn namatti duulan miidhaan isaa ulfaataadha; dhibdee fira ofiirraa dhufu baachuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: Better that an entire mountain fall on you than to face the devastating betrayal, wrath, and total ostracism of your own clan.

proverb: Gaara namatti jige gosaatu namarraa kaasa, gosa namarratti jiiyde wanni namarraa kaasaa hin jiru.
meaning_om: Rakkina guddaa kamiyyuu gargaarsa gosaafi firaatiin dhabamsiisuun ni danda'ama; garuu yoo gosti ofii namatti dallante wanti nama baraaru hin jiru.
meaning_en: If a mountain falls upon you, your clan can unite to dig you out; but if your own clan turns against you, no earthly power can save you.

proverb: Mormi, qadaaddaa garaati.
meaning_om: Waan garaa keessatti yaadamu yookaan iccitii jiru hunda afaaniin baasanii dubbachuun akka hin malleefi namni iccitii qabachuu akka qabu ibsa.
meaning_en: Just as a lid covers a pot, the neck and throat should contain what is inside the belly; a person must possess self-restraint and keep secrets rather than revealing everything.

proverb: Garaan minnii ba'atu, maaliif dubbii ba'achuu dadhaba.
meaning_om: Garaan namaa dhukkubaa fi wantoota ulfaatoo ba'atee danda'u, maaliif iccitii fi dubbii dhagaye garaatti qabachuu dadhaba jechuun nama arraba laafaa qeequuf dubbatama.
meaning_en: If the human belly can endure physical parasites like tapeworms, it should certainly have the fortitude to hold onto confidential words and keep secrets.

proverb: Hunda dubbatan, garaan duwwa hafa.
meaning_om: Waan beekan, arganii fi dhagahan hunda namatti himuun ulfina nama dhabsiisa; namni waan hunda dubbatu iccitii fi kabaja dhabee gatii dhaba.
meaning_en: Speaking out every single thing one knows drains a person of mystery, dignity, and strategic advantage, leaving them vulnerable and empty.

proverb: Garaan waa heddu ba'ata.
meaning_om: Namni hubataan waan hedduu argaa fi dhagayaa ta'us, hunda namatti baasuu mannaa garaatti qabatee obsaan danda'uu akka qabu ibsa.
meaning_en: A mature and wise person absorbs, endures, and conceals numerous experiences, grievances, and secrets without reacting or exposing them carelessly.

proverb: Duugda hin dhungatani, hunda hin dubbatani.
meaning_om: Akkuma dugda ofii dhungachuun hin danda'amne, waan sammuu fi garaa namaa keessa jiru hunda afaaniin baasanii fixuunis gonkumaa kan hin taaneefi hin malledha.
meaning_en: Just as it is physically impossible to kiss one's own back, it is socially unacceptable and foolish to utter every single thing that crosses one's mind.

proverb: Hundumatti, dubbii hin himani.
meaning_om: Namni hundi nama amanamaa fi iccitii eegu waan hin taaneef, dhimma ofii fi iccitii jireenyaa nama hundaaf facaasuun akka hin taane gorsa.
meaning_en: Not everyone is trustworthy or capable of keeping confidence; therefore, sensitive personal affairs should not be disclosed indiscriminately.

proverb: Keessa marqaa, kokorsaatu beeka.
meaning_om: Iccitii fi haala dhokataa keessa mana yookaan dhimma tokkoo kan beeku nama dhimma sana keessa jiru yookaan itti dhiyaatee qoratu qofadha.
meaning_en: Only the person directly involved, living within a situation, or intimate with the circumstances truly understands what goes on behind the scenes.

proverb: Garaa ilaalaa ooluun, mudaa isaa mullisuu dha.
meaning_om: Waan hanquu yookaan hanqina ofii irra deddeebi'anii namatti himuu fi qeequun, salphinaa fi miidhaa ofii amba duratti fiduu akka ta'e ibsa.
meaning_en: Constantly drawing attention to one's own deficiencies, private shortcomings, or hunger only reveals one's vulnerability and invites pity or disrespect.

proverb: Boolliti qayyaa, "akka agarruun waa hunda hin dubbannu" jette.
meaning_om: Bakka dhokataa fi iccitii hawaasaa yoo argan illee, safuu fi kabaja eeganii wantoota qaanii ta'an garaatti qabachuu malee dubbachuun akka hin taane agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Even if one happens to witness the most intimate, embarrassing, or private occurrences, decency and modesty demand absolute silence and discretion.

proverb: Rifeensi lama, tokko kan dirretti haadani, tokko kan dhoksatti haadani.
meaning_om: Jireenya keessatti wanti hawaasa duratti mul'ifamuu fi wanti dhoksaatti qabamuu qabu jiraachuu, safuu fi daangaa jireenyaa eeguu akka barbaachisu ibsa.
meaning_en: Life consists of public matters that can be openly displayed and private matters that must remain strictly concealed behind closed doors.

proverb: Saddeeta lagatti miicaniiti, guftaa manatti miican.
meaning_om: Wanti tokko tokko hawaasa duratti furmaata kan argatu yoo ta'u, dhimmi iccitii fi kabaja maatii garuu manuma keessatti dhoksaan furamuu akka qabu ibsa.
meaning_en: Ordinary public issues may be aired openly, but delicate, honorable, and intimate family matters must be resolved privately at home.

proverb: Gowwaa hin gorsani, maraataa itti hin himani.
meaning_om: Nama gowwaa gorsanii bu'aa hin argatan, nama sammuun isaa hin guunneettis iccitii fi dhimma ulfaataa himachuun balaa ofitti fiduu ta'uu akeekkachiisa.
meaning_en: Giving advice to a fool is wasted effort, and confiding secrets in an unstable person is disastrous as they cannot maintain discretion.

proverb: Heexoo, abba duubatti obaasan.
meaning_om: Qoricha akka heexoo kan nama haqqisiisu dhoksaan kennan; akkasumas waan nama miidhu yookaan nama dhibu tokko haala eeganii fi of eeggannoodhaan raawwachuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Strong traditional medicine like Hagenia (heexoo) is administered with discretion; delicate or harsh remedies and decisions must be executed with careful tact and privacy.

proverb: Ija nama agartu, udaan nama hin dhufu.
meaning_om: Namni safuu fi qaanii qabu ija namaa duratti waan fokkisaa fi salphisaa hin raawwatu; namoota duratti kabajaa fi of eeggannoon jiraachuu akka qabu ibsa.
meaning_en: Natural shame and moral propriety prevent a person from committing indecent, shameful, or degrading acts in the presence of observers.

proverb: Aannan dhiiraaf kaayan, hafuura hin kakaayan.
meaning_om: Waan kabajamaa namaaf kennamu yookaan dhimma amanamaa qulqullummaan eeguu malee, shakkiifi amala fokkisaadhaan faaluun akka hin malle agarsiisa.
meaning_en: When reserving something special out of respect and duty, one must keep it pristine and untainted by carelessness, suspicion, or deceit.

proverb: Asuu oolle jette, kan gurguramte.
meaning_om: Namni salphinni yookaan balaan guddaan irra ga'e tokko, qaanii fi gadda isaa dhoksuuf waan salphaa fakkeessee dubbatu ibsa.
meaning_en: Describes a person who attempts to cover up their severe misfortune, humiliation, or subjugation by trivializing it to save face.

proverb: Aamminiin dubartii fi dhaga'aan lukkuu garaa keessa.
meaning_om: Akkuma gurri ykn dhageettiin lukkuu alaan hin mul'anneefi garaa keessa jirti jedhamu, aammiiniin (kadhannaan) dubartiis wadaaja fi sirna keessatti sagalee olkaaftee osoo hin taane garaa keessatti dhoksaadhaan qabatti. Wanti tokko alatti osoo hin mul'atin qalbii fi keessa namaatti kan dhokate ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Just as a chicken has no external visible ears and its hearing is proverbially concealed inside, a woman's 'Amen' (supplication and prayer assent) in traditional gatherings is not proclaimed aloud, but whispered and held silently within her chest. Metaphorically, it refers to thoughts, prayers, perceptions, and sentiments that are kept strictly internal, deeply private, and hidden from outside view.

proverb: Wahalle nyaatan malee, wahalle hin dubbatan.
meaning_om: Nyaanni nyaatamu garaa qofa miidhuu danda'a; dubbiin arrabaan ba'u garuu jireenya, nagaa fi hawaasummaa waan balleessuuf of eeggannoo guddaa barbaada.
meaning_en: Indiscreet eating only affects one's stomach, but reckless words can destroy relationships, reputations, and entire communities; speech requires utmost restraint.

proverb: Kofa ofii amba hin argisiisan.
meaning_om: Iccitii fi qaanii mana ofii, hanqina maatii yookaan dhimma dhuunfaa nama ormaatti baasanii mul'isuun salphina waan ta'eef eeggatamuu akka qabu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: One should never expose their private family shame, domestic weaknesses, or intimate vulnerabilities to outsiders and strangers.

proverb: Kofa ifii ajaawaa, abbaatu walitti qabata.
meaning_om: Firaan yookaan maatiin ofii yoo bade illee, ormatti baasanii salphisuu dhiisanii abbumatu dhoksee sirreeffachuu akka qabu ibsa.
meaning_en: No matter how flawed, difficult, or embarrassing one's own kin or domestic situation is, the family must shield it and handle it internally rather than exposing it.

proverb: Mana haajiiti bullee malee, afaan lama nu hin tahin.
meaning_om: Mana kabajamaa fi amantii kan akka mana Haajii erga bulanii booda, oduu fi soba adda addaa uumuun afaan lama ta'uu dhiisanii dubbii qajeelaa fi tokkicha dubbachuu barsiisa. Hiriyyoonni ykn warri waliin oolan bakka tokkotti waan argan irratti afaan wal hin faallessine fi amanamummaa eeggachuu akka qaban agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Beyond simply stating the plain truth that we lodged at the Haji's home, let us not split our story or become double-tongued. When companions share hospitality in an honorable household, they must maintain consistent honesty, avoid gossip, and speak with one unified, truthful voice rather than spreading contradictory or two-faced accounts.

proverb: Dubbiin, hammuma abbaa garaa jirtu mi'ooyti.
meaning_om: Dubbiin yookaan iccitii tokko hanga garaa abbaa keessa jirtutti kabajamaa fi mi'aawaadha; yoo afaaniin baatee facaate garuu bu'aa dhabdee rakkoo uumti.
meaning_en: A word or secret retains its sweetness, value, and safety as long as it remains kept in one's own chest; once spoken, its sanctity and advantage are lost.

proverb: Boolla gaafa beelaa, halkan banan.
meaning_om: Yeroo beelaa fi rakkinaa qabeenya dhokfame halkan namatti hin beekamin baafatu; akkasumas dhimmi iccitii fi yeroo rakkinaaf kuufame dhoksaadhaan to'atama malee dirreetti hin baafamu.
meaning_en: The emergency grain pit kept for drought or famine is opened under the cover of night to avoid alerting others and causing desperation; critical survival measures must be managed with utmost discretion.

proverb: Sagalee jibbu garaan diddiga malee, dubbii jibbu garaan hin didigu.
meaning_om: Nyaanni nama jibbisiise yoo nyaatame namni didigee ofirraa baasuu danda'a; dubbii yookaan iccitii badaa dhagahe garuu didiganii ofirraa baasuun hin danda'amu, garaa keessatti nama guba.
meaning_en: While a stomach can purge unpalatable food by vomiting, it cannot vomit out offensive words or painful secrets once heard; they remain inside to torment or burden the mind.

proverb: Mana manaatu waa daha.
meaning_om: Tokko tokkoon maatii yookaan namni kamuu qe'ee fi mana ofii keessatti iccitii fi rakkoo dhokfatu qaba; namni marti mana ofii keessatti safuu fi qaanii ofii eeggata.
meaning_en: Every household possesses its own hidden realities, privacies, and shortcomings that are shielded within its walls; homes provide mutual privacy and cover for each other's vulnerabilities.

proverb: Maal agarte - Ji'a, maal dhageeyse - Azaana.
meaning_om: Namni iccitii eegu tokko gaaffii dhimma namaa irratti dhiyaatuuf deebii waliigalaa fi kan eenyullee hin miine kennuudhaan, iccitii fi dhimma ormaa akka hin agarree fi hin dhageenyetti amala dhoksuu qabaachuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: When questioned about sensitive private matters or community gossip, the wise answer with obvious, harmless public phenomena (the moon, the call to prayer) to protect confidences and avoid stirring trouble.

proverb: Garaan haa beeku, afaan haa wallaalu.
meaning_om: Waan beekan hunda afaaniin baasanii facaasuun balaa waan ta'eef, namni waan hedduu garaatti beekee haa qabatu garuu afaaniin akka waan hin beeknetti of haa qusatu jechuudha.
meaning_en: Even when one knows the truth or holds sensitive information in one's heart, the mouth should act ignorant and keep silent to avert harm and maintain peace.

proverb: Jaldessi waan dhagaa jalaa "yambar" je'e.
meaning_om: Namni waan barbaadu dhabe yookaan dhimma tokko dhoksuu fedhu, akka waan homaayyuu hin jirretti 'homaa hin jiru' jedhee callisuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: When the baboon overturns a rock and finds nothing (or wishes to conceal what it found), it declares 'nothing'; used to describe brushing off an inquiry or moving on as if nothing exists.

proverb: Haa teeysu garaa, haa nyaattu coraa.
meaning_om: Dubbii yookaan iccitii namatti hadhooftu baasanii lola uumuu mannaa, garaa keessatti obsaan danda'anii qaama ofii gubduu illee garaatti qabachuun wayya jechuudha.
meaning_en: Better for painful grievances or heavy secrets to remain sealed inside the chest, even if it eats at one's inner vitals, rather than venting them and causing destructive conflict.

proverb: Niitiin, dhiirsaaf kafana.
meaning_om: Niitiin gaariin hanqina, qullaa, qaanii fi iccitii dhiirsa ishee hawaasa duratti akka hin saaxilamneef kan dandeessu hundaan dhoksitee kabaja isaa eegdi.
meaning_en: A virtuous wife serves as a protective cloak for her husband, shielding his faults, poverty, and vulnerabilities from the outside world and preserving his honor.

proverb: Ani nama hin agarree malee, namni ana hin agarre hin je'in.
meaning_om: Namni gocha badaa yookaan dhokataa tokko raawwatu, eenyullee na hin argine jedhee of gowwoomsuu akka hin qabne, yeroo hunda iji nama ilaalu akka jiru ibsa.
meaning_en: Do not deceive yourself into believing no one witnessed your secret misdeeds just because you didn't see anyone watching; someone or the divine always watches.

proverb: "Ar'aas waan kiyya hin dubbatanii?" jette, haftuun.
meaning_om: Namni amala of jaalachuu yookaan of tuulummaa qabu tokko, yeroo hunda akka waan dhimmi isaa hawaasa mara keessatti haasa'amuufi namuu isa yaaduutti of he'u ibsa.
meaning_en: Highlights the vain illusion of self-important individuals who narcissistically assume that they are the perpetual topic of everyone else's conversation.

proverb: Kan maraatu hin mari'atu.
meaning_om: Namni gara badiisaa, dogoggora guddaa ykn maraatummaatti deemu duraan dursee firaa fi jaarsa hin mari'atu; ofumaan fedhii fi aariidhaan ka'ee of balleessa. Namni marii didee kophaa tarkaanfatu akka nama maraatetti kan lakkaa'amu ta'uu fi mariin qoricha maraatummaa ta'uu ibsa.
