meaning_en: One who is losing their mind or plunging into ruin never pauses to seek counsel; reckless folly and madness always act unilaterally. When someone makes a shocking, irrational, or self-destructive move without consulting family or elders, this proverb is invoked to show that acting without advice is the very mark of madness—had they consulted, they would not have acted so crazily.

proverb: Kan gabaan dhaga'e, gowwaan galee niitii dhoksa.
meaning_om: Oduu yookaan iccitii ummanni bal'aan duraan beekee hundi odeessaa jiru, gowwaan akka waan iccitii guddaa ta'etti galee nama jalaa dhoksuu yaala.
meaning_en: A fool tries to secretly hide from his wife news that is already common public knowledge throughout the entire market, exposing his utter lack of awareness.

proverb: Kan garatti unu ni machaa'a, kan garaachatti unu ni maraata.
meaning_om: Dhugaatiin yookaan waanti tokko yoo madaallii eegee fudhatame miidhaa salphaa qaba; garuu yoo daangaa darbee sammuu fi qalbii namaa keessa seene nama maraacha.
meaning_en: Imbibing moderately or appropriately merely causes temporary intoxication, but letting excess consume one's core sanity and inner conscience drives a person into total madness.

proverb: Kan balbalaan bahe nama dhiba, kan booroon bahe of dhiba.
meaning_om: Namni waan hundaa ifatti fi seeraan raawwatu nama biraa mormuu danda'a; namni karaa dhoksaa fi dabaan hojjetu garuu ofuma isaatii badii fi salphinatti of geessa.
meaning_en: Acting openly and directly through the front entrance might challenge others, but sneaking out dishonestly through the back door brings self-ruin, shame, and trouble onto oneself.

proverb: Yaa'ii irratti, killa hin qalani.
meaning_om: Dhimmi dhuunfaa fi aadaa dhoksaadhaan raawwatamuu qabu bakka koraa fi yaa'ii hawaasaa duratti hin raawwatamu; bakka fi yeroo waan hundaa eeguu akka barbaachisu ibsa.
meaning_en: Sacred, delicate, or intimate rituals and private disputes must not be exposed or conducted at a large public assembly; every matter has its appropriate place, decorum, and time.

proverb: Hinaafaan haqa qaba.
meaning_om: Namni hinaafaa ta'e yeroo hunda hinaaffaa isaa qajeelfachuuf sababa fi komii uumee of amansiisa; keessi isaa garuu haqa osoo hin taane waanyoodhaan kan guutame ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: An envious or jealous person always invents a grievance or rationalization to justify their resentment, convincing themselves that their malice is warranted.

proverb: Hinaafaan if nyaata.
meaning_om: Hinaaffaan nama itti hinaafan miidhuu mannaa, abbuma hinaafu sana keessaa gubee, boqonnaa fi nagaa dhabsiisee qaamaa fi sammuu isaa miidha.
meaning_en: Jealousy harms the envious person far more than the target of their envy, steadily devouring their peace of mind, health, and happiness from within.

proverb: Kan hinaafi je'een haadha isaatti hinaafa.
meaning_om: Hinaaffaan daangaa dhabee fi shakkii araada ta'e qalbii fi sammuu namaa jaamsee gara maraatummaatti akka nama geessu agarsiisa. Namni hinaaffaa dhaabbataatiin qabame daangaa safuu hundumaa dagatee, haadha ofiirrattillee shakkii fi waanyoo hamaa qabaachuun amala jeeqamaa fi qalbii dhabuu isaa saaxila.
meaning_en: Illustrates pathological, compulsive jealousy and unbridled suspicion that has completely severed all ties with reason. When someone is consumed by obsessive jealousy, their paranoia spirals beyond all logic, decency, and sacred taboos, driving them to direct absurd suspicion and resentment even toward their own mother.

proverb: If jibboon, ilma haadhatti hinaafu.
meaning_om: Namni ofitti hin amanne fi of jibbu milkaa'ina fira dhiyoo fi nama isa gargaaru illee hin fedhu; guddinni nama biraa isa guba.
meaning_en: Individuals plagued by self-hatred and deep insecurity resent even the natural love, blessings, and success between a mother and her child.

proverb: Dhugaa hinaafaan dhabe, namuu hin argatu.
meaning_om: Namni hinaafaa ta'e nama biraa irratti komii, balleessaa fi sababa barbaadee dhabeera taanaan, namni sun dhugumaan qulqulluu fi balleessaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsa.
meaning_en: If even a hypercritical, envious person—who scrutinizes every detail to find fault—cannot find any flaw or blame, then that person is undeniably innocent and blameless.

proverb: "Hinaafuun gaafuma dhaga'ani" jedhee, jaarsi saglii (90) keessa jiru niitii dhaane.
meaning_om: Hinaaffaan umrii, yeroo fi sammuu qabaachuu hin beektu; yeroo hin malleetti aarii fi hinaaffaadhaan kaka'anii gocha gowwummaa fi qaanii raawwachuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Jealousy defies age, dignity, and timing; it illustrates how sudden irrational jealousy drives even an old person into absurd and embarrassing behavior.

proverb: Hinaaffaa fi dhagaa wajji ibidda irra kaayaniiti, dhagaan bilchaatee hinaaffaan bilchaachuu didde.
meaning_om: Hinaaffaan amala akkaan jabaa, hadhaawaa fi dhiifama hin qabne waan ta'eef, dhagaan illee ibiddatti baqee yoo sirraa'e hinaaffaan garuu tasuma hin dhabamtu.
meaning_en: Stone itself can be melted or softened by fire, but the stubborn bitterness of jealousy can never be cured, softened, or reasoned with.

proverb: Dhiirsi niitiin hinaaftuu fi namni manni itti dhimmisu tokko.
meaning_om: Akkuma manni dhimmisu yeroo hunda boqonnaa nama dhowwatu, niitii hinaaftuu wajjin jiraachuunis jireenya nagaa fi tasgabbii nama dhowwata.
meaning_en: Just as living in a house with a leaky roof causes unending irritation and prevents rest, living with an obsessively jealous spouse robs one of daily peace and joy.

proverb: Hawwisoo sagalee tolu dubri ni jaalata, gadheen ni jibbiti.
meaning_om: Waan gaarii, dandeettii fi bareedina namni qabu namoonni qulqulluun yoo jaallatan, namni amala hamaa fi hinaaffaa qabu garuu waan gaarii sana jibbee balaaleffata.
meaning_en: Noble and appreciative people admire talent, beauty, and virtue, whereas the petty and envious despise and resent excellence out of sheer spite.

proverb: Manni namaani cufaa dhaa, hinaafaa ooyruun gaffaa dha.
meaning_om: Manni abbaa iccitii fi kabajaan cufamee kan eegamu ta'us, namni hinaafaan garuu dantaa namaa qorachuuf ooyruu fi qe'ee namaa keessa asii fi gadi fiiga.
meaning_en: While decent people keep their doors closed and mind their own private homes, the restless, jealous person constantly prowls across open fields trying to pry into others' affairs.

proverb: Hiriyaan kafana.
meaning_om: Hiriyaan dhugaa akkuma kafanaa hanqina, qullaa fi iccitii namaa hunda dhoksee kabaja namaa hawaasa duratti eega.
meaning_en: A true friend acts as a protective cloak, shielding one's secrets, shortcomings, and vulnerabilities from public humiliation.

proverb: Horii dhabuu mannaa, haadha dhabuu wayya, hiriyaa dhabuu mannaa, horii dhabuu wayya.
meaning_om: Jireenya keessatti qabeenyi barbaachisaa ta'us, hiriyaan dhugaa kan rakkina keessatti nama bira dhaabbatu qabeenya kamiyyuu caalaa gatii guddaa akka qabu ibsa.
meaning_en: Illustrates the supreme value of true companionship in life; having a loyal, dependable friend outweighs material possessions and wealth.

proverb: Obboleessi, kan wajji dhalatan qofaa miti.
meaning_om: Obbolummaan kan dhiigaa qofa osoo hin taane, namni yeroo rakkinaa si bira dhaabbatee fi jaalalaan si gargaarus obboleessa dhugaati.
meaning_en: Brotherhood transcends mere biological birth; anyone who stands by you in times of adversity with sincere loyalty and love is truly your brother.

proverb: Sa'a tokkootu, sa'a baay'ee barbaada.
meaning_om: Namni qofaa isaa jiraachuu hin danda'u; hawaasummaa, hiriyyummaa fi waliin jiraachuun uumama namaa waan ta'eef namni hiriyaa fi nama biraa barbaada.
meaning_en: An individual naturally seeks community and companionship; humans are inherently social beings who cannot thrive in solitude.

proverb: Hiriyaa malee dhaqxee, geggessaa malee galte.
meaning_om: Namni hiriyaa fi nama waliin deemu hin qabne kabajaa fi gargaarsa dhabee qofummaan akka salphatu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Going forth without a companion leads to returning without an escort; illustrates how isolating oneself leaves a person without honor, security, or support.

proverb: Obbolessa jechuun, kan ati rifattu rifatee ati gammaddu gammadu.
meaning_om: Obboleessi yookaan hiriyaan dhugaa nama miira kee qooddatee gadda keetti gaddus, gammachuu keetti gammadu ta'uu ibsa.
meaning_en: A true brother is someone who genuinely shares your emotional states, suffering when you are distressed and celebrating when you are joyful.

proverb: Akaayiin gita qabaa, mulluun hiriya qaba.
meaning_om: Wanti hundi fira, hiriyyaa fi gita walmadaalu qaba; namni kamiyyuu nama isa madaaluu fi isa fakkaatu wajjin hiriyaa ta'uu akka qabu ibsa.
meaning_en: Everything in life has its proper counterpart and peer; individuals should choose companions who match their temperament, values, and standing.

proverb: Keessummaan saree, dhaga wal arraabsifti.
meaning_om: Hiriyaan yookaan keessummaan hiyyeessa fi qabeenya hin qabne waan kennuuf hin qabu; hiriyaa gadhee wajjin ooluun beelaa fi rakkoo qofa nama dhaalchisa.
meaning_en: Entertaining a worthless or destitute companion leads only to licking bare stones together; associating with incompetent companions yields nothing but shared hardship.

proverb: Kophaa, udaan qofaatu gaarii dha.
meaning_om: Qofummaan waan gaarii miti; hawaasummaan, waliin jiraachuu fi hiriyyummaan jireenya namaaf bu'uura ta'uu ibsa.
meaning_en: Solitude is only fitting when relieving oneself; in all other aspects of life, human beings need companionship, teamwork, and fellowship.

proverb: Hiriyaan wajji baate osoo wajji galtee, akkam gaarii dha.
meaning_om: Hiriyaan jalqaba dhimma tokkootti nama wajjin ba'e hanga dhumaatti amanamummaan osoo nama bira dhaabbatee gaarii ture; garuu hiriyaa gantummaa fi amanamummaa dhabuu ibsa.
meaning_en: Expresses sorrow over fickle companions who start a journey or project enthusiastically but abandon you halfway through adversity.

proverb: Nama dhabaaf, arba dhaban.
meaning_om: Tokkummaa fi gargaarsa namaa dhabuudhaan milkaa'ina guddaa fi carraa guddaa dhabuu agarsiisa; humna namaa fi hiriyyummaan waan hundaa akka caalu ibsa.
meaning_en: Due to a lack of manpower and cooperative companions, a great prize (an elephant) slipped away; emphasizes that great achievements require teamwork.

proverb: Hiriyaan allaattii raqa irra nama geessa.
meaning_om: Hiriyaa gadhee fi amala hamaa qabu wajjin ooluun bakka badii, salphinaa fi wanta fokkisaatti nama geessa.
meaning_en: Associating with a vulture-like, corrupt companion will only lead you to foul, decaying, and dishonorable places.

proverb: Hiriyaan saree, dikee irra nama geeysa.
meaning_om: Hiriyaa qaan-dhabeessa fi salphaa ta'e wajjin michoomuun salphinaa fi iddoo fokkisaa qofaatti nama geessa.
meaning_en: Befriending an undignified, base companion will inevitably lead you to end up on the trash heap of social disrespect.

proverb: Hiriyaan tiitichaa, udaan irra nama geeysa.
meaning_om: Hiriyaa xuraa'aa fi amala badaa qabu wajjin ooluun waan fokkisaa fi xuraawaa keessatti nama kuffisa.
meaning_en: Associating with a fly-like companion will inevitably land you in filth; bad company draws you directly into moral contamination.

proverb: Hiriyaa deesse mannaa, hiriyaa duute wayya (dubra Osoo hin heerumin deesse).
meaning_om: Aadaa fi safuu durii keessatti dubarri osoo hin heerumin ulfooftee da'uun qaanii fi salphina maatii fi hiriyaa hundaa waan ta'eef, salphina sana baachuu mannaa du'atu salphata jechuudhaan qaanii guddaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: In traditional Oromo customary honor (safuu), giving birth out of wedlock brought severe, unbearable stigma to the family and peer group; highlights the extreme cultural horror of social dishonor over death.

proverb: Yaa shuumoo, si nyaachuullee baadhu si tortorse" je'e, jaarsi ilkee hin qabne.
meaning_om: Namni waan tokkotti dhimma ba'uu hin dandeenye, namni biraas akka itti hin fayyadamneef hinaaffaadhaan balleessuu fi mancaasuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: It illustrates a spiteful person who, unable to enjoy or benefit from something themselves, deliberately ruins or spoils it so that no one else can have it.

proverb: Histiin michii jiruuti.
meaning_om: Hinaaffaan akkuma dhukkuba michii tasa nama qabee jireenya gubuu fi boqonnaa dhowwatu, jireenya hawaasummaa keessatti balaa fi madaa guddaadha.
meaning_en: Envy is a chronic affliction of human life that, like a sudden fever, strikes from within and continuously poisons peace, joy, and social harmony.

proverb: Allaattiin waan dhumuu jettee, lafa irratti wal fixxi.
meaning_om: Waan darbuu fi dhumu tokkoof bololuun, namoonni dantaa fi qabeenya yeroof jecha wal nyaatanii wal balleessuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Driven by greed and fear of scarcity over a perishable carcass, birds destroy one another; illustrates how humans foolishly kill each other over fleeting worldly goods.

proverb: Allaattiin waan lafaatiif, samiirratti wal fixxe.
meaning_om: Waan harkatti hin galin yookaan fagoo jiru tokkoof jecha, osoo bira hin ga'in dursee wal loluu fi diinummaa uumuu ibsa.
meaning_en: Fighting in the air over something that still lies untouched on the ground represents premature, senseless conflict over distant or uncertain spoils.

proverb: Osoo abbaan manaa hin jibbine, kajeeltuun maalif wal jibbiti?.
meaning_om: Abbaan qabeenyaa arjummaadhaan osoo homaa hin mormin, namoonni alaa dantaa sana hawwan hinaaffaadhaan wal jibbuu fi wal ceepha'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: When the generous owner of the property has no objection to giving, it is absurd for envious beggars or rivals to despise and fight one another over it.

proverb: Waan abbaan kennuuf, gabrittii hudduun dhukkube.
meaning_om: Qabeenya abbaan fedhii isaatiin arjoomu irratti, namni dhimmi hin ilaallanne hinaaffaadhaan gubachuu fi dhiphachuu ibsa.
meaning_en: Someone with no claim or ownership over the wealth becomes deeply grieved and resentful simply witnessing the rightful owner generously giving it away.

proverb: Waan waaqni namaa tolchetti, namni namatti hammaata.
meaning_om: Eebbaa fi milkaa'ina Waaqayyo namaaf kenne irratti, namoonni hinaaffaadhaan kaka'anii nama sana jibbuu fi miidhuuf yaaluu ibsa.
meaning_en: People often direct hostility, bitterness, and envy toward an individual simply because God has favored, prospered, and blessed them.

proverb: Foon fannoo jiraatiif, adurreen lafatti wal fixxi.
meaning_om: Waan harkatti hin galamneef fagootti mul'atu tokkoof jecha, namoonni lafarratti wal loluu fi nagaa wal dhowwachuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Cats tear each other apart on the ground over hanging meat they cannot even reach; people fight among themselves over unattainable desires.

proverb: Lafee laagaa danqarte hammeenya.
meaning_om: Rakkoon yookaan amalli hamaan yeroo nama keessatti cimee furmaata dhabu, akkuma lafee qoonqotti haftee nama hudhuutti rakkisaa fi dhiphisaa ta'uu ibsa.
meaning_en: A bone caught across the throat brings suffocating agony; represents deep-seated malice, unresolved bitterness, or a suffocating crisis that neither goes down nor comes up.

proverb: Lafee okkotee danqarte jabeenya.
meaning_om: Wanti tokko jabaatee iddoo isaatti dhaabbatee rakkoof hin jilbiffanne, akkuma lafee cimee danqareetti jabinnaa fi obsa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: A sturdy bone that stands wedged across a boiling clay pot resists destruction; symbolizes unwavering fortitude, steadfast endurance, and formidable strength.

proverb: Huqquu nam sadii kaasuu dadhabe, kan nyaachuu fedhuutu keysa jira.
meaning_om: Hojiin yookaan rakkoon namoonni baay'een irratti wal ta'anii furan yoo fashale, namoota sana keessaa namni dhimmi sun akka fashalu barbaadu akka jiru ibsa.
meaning_en: When multiple people fail to rescue a struggling beast, someone among the helpers secretly wants it to die so they can consume its meat; reveals internal sabotage and conflict of interest.

proverb: Waan biraa hunda obseetiin, cirracha anaa fi kophee tiyya jidduu seene obsuu dadhabe.
meaning_om: Namni balaa fi rakkina gurguddaa alaa obsee danda'uu danda'a; garuu miidhaa fi rakkina xixiqqoo kan firaa fi keessoo namaa irraa dhufu obsuun ulfaataadha.
meaning_en: One can tolerate immense external hardships, but an intimate, persistent irritation or betrayal from within one's immediate inner circle is impossible to endure.

proverb: Beela anaatu isinitti hin dhiifne, quufa isiniitu walitti hin dhiifne.
meaning_om: Sagalee Waaqayyoo kan ilmaan namaatti dubbatu dha; Waaqayyo arjummaa fi mararfannaa isaatiin beela hamaadhaan akka uummanni hin dhumne yeroo hundumaa nama baraara (anaatu beela isinitti hin dhiifne). Garuu namoonni gaafa quufanii fi badhaadhan of tuuluu, doqnummaa, fi roorroodhaan wal nyaatu (quufa isiniitu walitti hin dhiifne). Badiin guddaan beela uumaa osoo hin taane, quufa keessatti gara-jabina namootaa ta'uu saaxila.
meaning_en: Framed as the Creator indicting humanity: 'As for famine, it is I who showed mercy and spared you from starvation; but as for abundance, it is you yourselves who showed no mercy to one another.' While God sustains and spares mortals from being destroyed by famine, human beings respond to blessings of plenty with arrogance, hoarding, and ruthless exploitation of their fellows. It condemns human greed and social cruelty during seasons of prosperity.

proverb: Hiyyeessa hidhiin korbeessa.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi waan nyaatu dhabee yookiin qabbanni rukutee hidhiin isaa qoora; hiyyummaan bifa balleessa.
meaning_en: Deprivation and malnutrition leave stark, dry, weathered marks on the physical appearance of the poor.

proverb: Hiyyummaan dararummaa dha.
meaning_om: Hiyyummaan jireenya namaa hiraarsa; kabajaa fi nagaa nama dhabsiisa.
meaning_en: Poverty is sheer affliction and suffering that strips away comfort, dignity, and peace of mind.

proverb: Hiyyeessaa fi daaraan fira.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi yeroo hunda wayyaa qulqulluu fi gaarii dhabuun beekama.
meaning_en: Destitution and a lack of decent clothing are inseparable companions of impoverished people.

proverb: Hidhiin hiyyeessaa hin xuraawu.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi coomaa fi foon nyaatee afaan dibachuuf carraa hin qabu.
meaning_en: The poor rarely enjoy the privilege of dining on rich, fatty meats and festive delicacies.

proverb: Hiyyeessaa fi qilleensi hin taa'ani.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi qodhaa fi bu'aa guyyaa barbaachaaf akkuma qilleensaatti olii gadi fiiga.
meaning_en: Like the wandering wind, a poor person must hustle ceaselessly from dawn to dusk to find bread.

proverb: Qoonqoon saree nama gooteeti, daarri hiyyeessa nama godha.
meaning_om: Beelli kabajaa namaa cabsa, huccuu dhabuun ammoo salphina namaa baasa.
meaning_en: Desperate hunger compromises human dignity, while threadbare rags expose vulnerability to the world.

proverb: Daarrii hamaan, hudduun nama qullachuu dha.
meaning_om: Salphinni hamaan yeroo hanqinni ofii orma hundatti ifa bahuudha.
meaning_en: The ultimate degradation occurs when one's deepest private vulnerabilities are exposed to all.

proverb: Deegaa, haadha deeyseetu jibba.
meaning_om: Namni deegaa ta'e yeroo hunda eeggataa waan ta'eef fira dhihoo birattillee gatii dhaba.
meaning_en: Unrelenting poverty and dependency are so exhausting that even a mother grows weary of her penniless son.

proverb: Deegaan hiriyaa hin qabu.
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya hin qabne namni itti michoomu dhibee kophaa hafa.
meaning_en: A person without means is shunned; fair-weather companions vanish when one is penniless.

proverb: Deegaa fi huqquun abbaa hin fakkaanne.
meaning_om: Hiyyummaan bifa, qomoo fi ulfina namaa dhabamsiisee nama jijjiira.
meaning_en: Crushing destitution and physical starvation disfigure a person until all noble lineage is masked.

proverb: Rakkataan fira hin qabu.
meaning_om: Yeroo namni qabeenya dhabe firoonni duraan qabu hundi biraa fagaatu.
meaning_en: When misfortune and bankruptcy strike, relatives scatter and pretend they do not know you.

proverb: Deegaan, kaartuumittuu deegaa dha.
meaning_om: Bakka jijjiirrataniif qabeenyi hin argamu; namni carraan isaa deega ta'e bakka deemetti deegaadha.
meaning_en: Migrating to a prosperous city changes nothing if one lacks the means and fortune to escape poverty.

proverb: "Amoolee dhibba ba'attaa" jennaan, "wahi deega caalaa ulfaattii" je'e.
meaning_om: Hojiin kamiyyuu akka deegaa fi hiyyummaatti nama hin ulfaatu; hojjetanii deega jalaa bahuun caala.
meaning_en: No physical toil, however exhausting, is heavier to shoulder than the humiliating misery of poverty.

proverb: Hiyyeessi mala hin qabu, boosattiin hiree hin qabdu.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi carraa fi tooftaa dhabee rakkata; boosattiin ammoo hireen ishii hin tolin hafti.
meaning_en: A poor man is handicapped by lack of capital and connections, while a lazy woman is abandoned by luck.

proverb: Hiyyeessi, Osoo mana ambaatii foon nyaachuu baatee, addaateeti du'a.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi gargaarsa fi cidha hawaasaatiin lubbuu tursa.
meaning_en: The destitute survive physically largely because of community feasts and neighborly charity.

proverb: Hiyyeessaa fi ibiddi tuttuqan ni dhaamani.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessa tuttuqanii dhiphisuun humna isaa fixeeti isa balleysa; rakkataarraa of eeggatu.
meaning_en: Constantly harassing a poor, fragile soul completely snuffs out their spirit, just like poking dying embers.

proverb: Hiyyeessaa fi ijji tuttuqaa hin danda'ani.
meaning_om: Akkuma ijji xiqqoo tuttuqamnaan boossu, hiyyeessis dhiphina dabalataa danda'uu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: Just as the eye is hypersensitive to the slightest speck, an impoverished person is deeply vulnerable.

proverb: Hiyyeessa taraf itti ja'a malee, taraf irraa hin ja'u.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessarratti rakkinni walitti ida'ama malee salphaatti hin furamu.
meaning_en: Calamities continuously pile onto the poor, while relief and breakthroughs never seem to happen.

proverb: Hiyyeessi hin qalatu, kan Rabbi qale hin dhiisu.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi horii qalee nyaachuuf dandeettii dhabus, waan argate hunda nyaachuuf dirqama.
meaning_en: The poor cannot afford to slaughter livestock, but they gratefully accept whatever sustenance comes.

proverb: Deegaan deegaarra hamaa, nama deegni namaa itti gale.
meaning_om: Deegaa ta'uun miidhaa qaba, garuu deegaa nama biraatti ba'aa ta'ee nama qaanessuun caalaatti ulfaata.
meaning_en: Being poor is painful, but imposing the shameful burden of your poverty upon others is even worse.

proverb: Madaan hiyyeessa, madaa bineensaati.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi yaala fi wal'aansa dhabee akkuma bineensa bosonaa madaa'ee dhiiga.
meaning_en: An impoverished person's sickness or injury is neglected without medical care, just like a wild animal's.

proverb: Fuulli namaa, ibidda caala nama guba.
meaning_om: Fuula namarraa tuffii fi dallansuu arguun ibidda nama gubu caalaa garaa nyaata.
meaning_en: Contemptuous scowls and disdainful human expressions inflict deeper pain than scorching flames.

proverb: Fuudha hiyyeessaarra, taaziyaa dureessaatu oowwa.
meaning_om: Namoonni gammachuu hiyyeessaa caalaa iddoo dhiphina dureessaa deemuu filatu; qabeenyi nama hawwata.
meaning_en: Society eagerly gathers at a wealthy man's mourning wake, while ignoring a poor man's joyful wedding.

proverb: Deegaa dura rakkinni gabaa baha.
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi yeroo gabaa dhaqu mi'aan gatiin isaa dabalee dhabamuu carraan isaa ta'a.
meaning_en: Whenever a poor man heads to market, prices spike and misfortunes precede his arrival.

proverb: Hantuunni haadha hin qabdu, ilmooniis akkoo hin qabdu.
meaning_om: Namni deegaa fi dararama keessa jiru maatii fi gargaaraa hin qabu; kophaa isaa jiraata.
meaning_en: The utterly destitute have no protective relatives, elders, or lineage to turn to in times of distress.

proverb: Dibichi deegaa, haalayyaarra oola.
meaning_om: Qabeenyi hiyyeessaa yeroo hunda balaa fi badii jala jiraata; carraan isaa yaaddoo qofa.
meaning_en: The meager assets of a poor man are perpetually in peril and teetering on the brink of disaster.

proverb: Rakkataan, buqqee kudha shani ba'ata.
meaning_om: Namni rakkatte dirqamaa fi ba'aa hedduu tokkummaatti baachuu qabaata; dhiphinni walirra dhangala'a.
meaning_en: An impoverished, desperate person is forced to juggle an overwhelming number of heavy burdens at once.

proverb: Sheekni yoo dhuufe, darasaan ni albaati.
meaning_om: Hoggantoonni badii xiqqoo yoo hojjetan, hordoftoonni isaanii badii guddaa raawwatu.
meaning_en: If leaders commit a minor fault, their followers will commit far greater transgressions.

proverb: Waan harreen deemtuun galti goda waraabessaati.
meaning_om: Namni of eeggannoo dhabee bakka balaan jirutti deddeebi'u dhumni isaa badiidha.
meaning_en: A careless person who repeatedly flirts with danger inevitably meets destruction.

proverb: Kanniisni mooti qaba, tiitichi mootii hin qabu.
meaning_om: Hawaasni qajeelaan hoggansa fi sirna qaba, kan heera hin qabne garuu bitaa gala.
meaning_en: An orderly, productive community thrives under leadership, unlike chaotic wanderers.

proverb: Bishaan yaa'uutu, kan ciisu kaasa.
meaning_om: Namoota dammaqoo fi carraaqqoo ta'antu warra rafee fi doofe kakaasa.
meaning_en: Active, energetic people inspire and mobilize those who are stagnant or passive.

proverb: Gaalli, hiriira duraati laallata.
meaning_om: Namni karoora qabu fulduratti ilaalee deemedha; hoggantoota fi deemsa dhufu hordofa.
meaning_en: A wise traveler keeps focus on the leadership and the direction ahead.

proverb: Mootiin hayyuu hin qabne, bara tokko hin kunne.
meaning_om: Hoggantoonni gorsa hayyootaa hin fudhanne aangoo isaaniirra hin turan.
meaning_en: A ruler without wise counselors cannot sustain power and will quickly fall.

proverb: Mootiin kanniisaa, nama hin ciniinu.
meaning_om: Hoggantoonni dhugaa fi kabajamoon nama hin miidhan; kabajaan bulchu.
meaning_en: True noble leaders govern with dignity and do not stoop to petty cruelty.

proverb: Kanniisaatu daraaraa guura malee, mootiin daraaraa hin guuru.
meaning_om: Hojii fi dadhabbii hunda uummatatu ba'ata; mootiin sirna qofa eega.
meaning_en: Labor and groundwork are done by the common workers, while leaders steer and manage.

proverb: Nama biyyi jirtuun, duula hin geessani.
meaning_om: Nama fedhii fi kutannoo hin qabne dhimma guddaaf qooda kennuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: One whose heart longs for home cannot be entrusted with the rigors of battle.

proverb: karaan jaldeessaa fi firoomni waanbadee hallayyatti nama geessa.
meaning_om: Karaa badaa hordofuu fi nama badii wajjin michoomuun gara hallayyaatti nama geessa.
meaning_en: Following reckless paths and befriending outlaws inevitably leads to catastrophe.

proverb: Harki mootiin mure, dooluu hin qabu.
meaning_om: Murtiin seeraa fi mootummaa yoo dhufe komiin hin jiru; fudhatama qaba.
meaning_en: Justice administered legitimately by sovereign authority admits of no legal dispute.

proverb: Yaa korma saree, atummaan seera murii, atummaan dhagaa arraabi.
meaning_om: Namni amala fi kabajaa hin qabne murtii haqaas kennuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A base and unprincipled person cannot be trusted to judge or uphold justice.

proverb: "Goftaan koo goofta qaba" jette, gabrittiin.
meaning_om: Namni hunduu abbaa aangoo ol'aanaa qaba; namni daangaa hin qabne hin jiru.
meaning_en: Even the mightiest master is subject to higher authority; earthly power has limits.

proverb: "Waanuma nuti hadhaa gooneetu hadhaa taha" jette, buutiin.
meaning_om: Namni humnaa fi dhiibbaa qabu akka barbaadetti dhimma murteessa ykn summeessa.
meaning_en: Those with the power to poison determine how bitter things turn out.

proverb: Jaldeessa illee taatu, booyraa tahi.
meaning_om: Sadarkaa kamiyyuu keessa yoo jiraatte, kutannoo fi hoggansa qabaadhu; mul'adhu.
meaning_en: Whatever your station in life, strive to lead and stand out with courage.

proverb: "Guutee si agarsiise, huursee si dhageeysisee, yoo didde kan azaabaa tahi" je'e, bishaan.
meaning_om: Mallattoon akeekkachiisaa ifatti erga kennamee namni of eeggachuu dide badii keessa gala.
meaning_en: When clear warnings have been both shown and sounded, ignoring them leads straight to doom.

proverb: "Hanga'ee sitti ibsee, mandihee si dhageessisee, hammaan sitti titiifu na eeydaa" je'e, roobni.
meaning_om: Mallattoon duraa osoo ifa jiruu namni hanga rakkoon isa qunnamutti caldhisee eeguu hin qabu.
meaning_en: Obvious signs precede disaster; one should take precautions before catastrophe actually strikes.

proverb: Mukni adda dhawe, ija heere.
meaning_om: Balaan xiqqoon dhufe gara isa hamaatti deema; balaa xiqqaa tuffachuu hin qaban.
meaning_en: A blow that strikes the brow came perilously close to the eye; small threats signal grave danger.

proverb: Namni qabrii hiriyaa arge, kan ifii arge.
meaning_om: Balaa fi du'a nama biraarraa barnoota fudhachuun carraa ofiis yaadachuu qabu.
meaning_en: Witnessing the mortality and downfall of a peer is a sober reminder of one's own inevitable fate.

proverb: Aaggannoon cinaa dhawinaati.
meaning_om: Nama sodaachisuun ykn itti aggaamuun akkuma miidhaa qaamaa geessisuuti.
meaning_en: Menacing intimidation and threatening gestures carry half the trauma of an actual physical blow.

proverb: Aaggannoon dhawina irraa hin oolle.
meaning_om: Wanti itti aggaamamee fi sodaachifame yeroo baay'ee gara rukuttaatti jijjiirama.
meaning_en: Threats and aggressive posturing rarely remain idle; they usually escalate into actual attacks.

proverb: "Daandiin kun si hin baasu" jette, jaartiin.
meaning_om: Gorsa manguddootaa tuffachuun karaan namni filate kisaaraa fi badii fida.
meaning_en: Experienced elders perceive early when a reckless course of action is headed for a dead end.

proverb: Ilkee waraabeysaa, lafee irratti sodaatani.
meaning_om: Humnaa fi hammeenya nama tokkoo yeroo inni waan jabaa cabsu argan sodaatu.
meaning_en: The true destructive power of an enemy is respected when they are seen crushing tough obstacles.

proverb: Dhukkubni funyaan qabe, hidhii hin hanqatu.
meaning_om: Balaan ykn rakkoon nama dhihoo miidhe salphaatti gara ofiitti ce'a.
meaning_en: Misfortune or contagion that strikes an adjacent neighbor will inevitably spread to oneself.

proverb: Shinbirroon muka kanarra qubatte, kaaniif dinniinoyte.
meaning_om: Namni bakka eeggannoo fi dawoo qabu ta'ee ormarratti of tuula ykn akeekkachiisa.
meaning_en: Someone from a position of absolute safety boldly taunts, boasts, or challenges rivals afar.

proverb: Waraabeysi guyyaa yuuse, mana seenuu hin oolu.
meaning_om: Hammeenyi ifatti mul'ate gara badii guddaatti akka deemu beekamaadha.
meaning_en: When a predator acts with blatant boldness in daytime, a direct invasive attack is imminent.

proverb: Waraabeysi guyyaa yuuse, lixa aduutiin nama hin afu.
meaning_om: Diinni saafaa ija jabaatee mul'ate dhiheenya sanatti balaa geessisa.
meaning_en: An adversary displaying abnormal daytime boldness will strike ruthlessly before nightfall.

proverb: Sii himee, sitti himee, hin fuudhin dubra Huumee.
meaning_om: Waan balaa qabu duraan dursa irra deddeebi'anii gorsu; gorsa diduun gaabbii fida.
meaning_en: Repeated and explicit warnings were given against a foolish choice; ignoring counsel brings ruin.

proverb: " Siitu waa tan araddaa irraa hidhan tahee mitii, anaatu waa kan soban tahee mitii" je'e,waraabeysi harree dhaan.
meaning_om: Gammachuu fi nagaa sobaa hin amaninaa; diinni amala isaa hin jijjiiru.
meaning_en: False security cannot deceive a predator; a natural adversary will never abandon its true nature.

proverb: "Eeysuma kiyyaatu qeerransa" jette, Adurreen.
meaning_om: Namni humna hin qabne fira humna qabuun dhaaddata; of tuulummaa bu'uura hin qabneedha.
meaning_en: A small, weak individual boasts of a powerful relative to project false grandeur.

proverb: Harki taa'u, galata hin qabu.
meaning_om: Namni hin hojjenne kabajaa fi galata nama biraa hin argatu; hojiitu galata fida.
meaning_en: Idleness earns neither respect nor gratitude; only diligent labor brings honor.

proverb: Harki taa'u huji ballessa, garaan taa'u ilmo ballessa.
meaning_om: Hojii dhabuun jireenya balleessa, kunuunsa dhabuun ammoo ijoollee mancaasa.
meaning_en: Idleness ruins livelihoods, just as negligence spoils children.

proverb: Dalagan, sooratan.
meaning_om: Nyaata fi jireenya argachuuf hojiin dirqama; hojii malee quufi hin jiru.
meaning_en: Sustenance is the direct fruit of labor; without working, one cannot eat.

proverb: Harka taa'u irra, kan udaaniin haraniitu caala.
meaning_om: Hojii tuffatamaa hojjetanii of danda'uutu hojii malee taa'uu caala.
meaning_en: Any productive, humble labor—even cleaning filth—is far better than shameful idleness.

proverb: Eelanii, eelee dhaabbatan.
meaning_om: Osoo hin dadhabin bu'aa fi nyaata qophaa'aa argachuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: Hard labor and toil must precede the enjoyment of a hot, prepared meal.

proverb: Jaaruu malee, diiguun nama hin dhibu.
meaning_om: Waan tokko ijaaruun dadhabbii fi yeroo gaafata, garuu balleessuun salphaadha.
meaning_en: Constructing and creating require immense dedication, whereas destruction is effortless.

proverb: Hedduu dubbachuu irra, xiqqo dalaguu wayya.
meaning_om: Odeessuu fi afaaniin dhaaddachuu irra hojii qabatamaa xiqqoo hojjechuutu caala.
meaning_en: A small tangible action is vastly superior to endless boasting and idle words.

proverb: Hedduu naannawuu irra, xiqqo dalaguu wayya.
meaning_om: Bakka malee asii fi achi fiiguu irra hojii bu'aa qabu hojjechuutu wayya.
meaning_en: Performing focused, modest labor is far more fruitful than aimless wandering.

proverb: Facaasan malee, hin mayru/margu.
meaning_om: Hojii fi carraaqqii osoo hin jalqabin bu'aa eeggachuun gatii hin qabu.
meaning_en: Without planting seeds of hard work, expecting a fruitful harvest is impossible.

proverb: Qotan malee, hin quufan.
meaning_om: Lafa qotanii midhaan oomishu malee beela ba'uun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: Abundance and fullness can only be achieved through strenuous plowing and agricultural toil.

proverb: Kan akkanaatu, qotaa midhaanii namatti singiggessa.
meaning_om: Wanti rakkisaan yookiin nama hin beekne mudannaan namni hojii isaa nuffa.
meaning_en: Frustrating interferences or petty nuisances make even essential labor feel exasperating.

proverb: Boolla jaartii jalloo, jallisaniiti qotan.
meaning_om: Haala dhimmi tokko qabu ilaaluun furmaata isaaf malu mijeessu.
meaning_en: Work must be adapted to fit the specific idiosyncrasies or shape of the task at hand.

proverb: Kan taa'e ilaaluuf, daakuun boqqolloo dinbilaal.
meaning_om: Nama alaan ilaaluuf hojiin hundi salphaa fakkaata; garuu keessi isaa dadhabbii qaba.
meaning_en: To a bystander who does no work, heavy labor appears completely effortless.

proverb: Dubbii guddoon qabaarra, dalagaa xiqqoon qabaa wayya.
meaning_om: Odeessaa fi lola keessa jiraachuu irra hojii xiqqoo hojjetanii jiraachuutu caala.
meaning_en: Holding a small honest job is far better than being embroiled in endless talk and litigation.

proverb: Waa guddifannaan, waa dhaba dhoowwiti.
meaning_om: Hojii fi horii xiqqoo kunuunsanii guddifachuun yeroo rakkinaa nama baasa.
meaning_en: Nurturing and investing in small assets or dependents shields one against future destitution.

proverb: Gurri ameysa hin qabu, ameysi isaa oduu dha.
meaning_om: Gurri yeroo hunda oduu fi haasawa dhaga'uu barbaada malee hojii qabatamaa hin ta'u.
meaning_en: The ear generates no tangible produce; its only endless intake is hearsay and rumors.

proverb: Hoggaa dalaydu gabra fakkaadhu, hoggaa nyaattu mootii fakkaadhu.
meaning_om: Yeroo hojjettu qullaa fi dadhabbii hin jibbini, yeroo nyaattu garuu kabajaan jiraadhu.
meaning_en: Work with relentless, unpretentious humility; then enjoy the fruits of your labor like royalty.

proverb: Halchaan, waan ormaa hin fuudhu
meaning_om: Wanta nama biraa ijaan kajeeluun yookaan garaadhaa dharra'uun qofti qabeenya sana kan ofii hin godhu; kajeellaa fi hawwiin qofti bu'aa hin fidu, hojjetanii horachuu yookaan fedhii ofii to'achuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Mere coveting, longing, or eyeing what belongs to others cannot make it yours; wishing or lusting after someone else's possessions acquires nothing; one must work to earn their own livelihood rather than harboring futile envy

proverb: Okkoteen mukaa, osoo hin bilcheessine gubatti.
meaning_om: Meeshaan ykn namni dandeettii hin qabne dhimma guddaaf hin ta'u; osoo bu'aa hin argamsiisin bada.
meaning_en: An unfit tool or incompetent person fails and is ruined before accomplishing the task.

proverb: Okkoteen mukaa, ofii hin taatuu kan keeysaa hin baaftu.
meaning_om: Namni of hin dandeenye nama kaaniifillee faayidaa kennuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: One who is inherently inadequate cannot take care of oneself, let alone help others.

proverb: Ilkeen haancaan dhaaban, ilkee namaa hin taatu.
meaning_om: Wanti namtolchee fi sobaa bakka dhugaa hin bu'u; faayidaa yeroo gabaabaa qofa qaba.
meaning_en: Artificial substitutes or superficial imitations never truly replace the genuine article.

proverb: Lubbuun qubaan qabanii taa'ani, gaafa quba hin qabne baati.
meaning_om: Lubbuun namaa wanta laafaa fi eeggannoo guddaa barbaadduudha; gaafa hin yaadin dhumti.
meaning_en: Human life is fragile and held tentatively; it departs when least anticipated.

proverb: Buqqeen, buqqoominaaf caphuu hin oolle.
meaning_om: Wanti uumamaan laafaa ta'e balaa fi caccabuu jalaa bahuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: What is inherently fragile and vulnerable cannot avoid eventual fracture or destruction.

proverb: Garaa fi humni wal quba hin qabu.
meaning_om: Fedhiin garaa guddaa ta'uu danda'a, garuu humni namaa isa raawwachuuf gahaa miti.
meaning_en: One's inner desires and ambitions often vastly exceed one's actual physical capacity.

proverb: Hedduminaaf tiitichi, kaasa hin jiiysine
meaning_om: Baay'inni namoota dadhaboo fi humna hin qabnee wanta jabaa yookaan dhimma bu'uuraa tokko diiguu ykn kuffisuu hin danda'u; qulqullinaa fi humnatu baay'ina caala malee waci lakkoofsaa gatii hin qabu
meaning_en: Despite their vast numbers, powerless individuals cannot topple a solid obstacle or overturn an established institution; sheer numerical quantity without strength or substance accomplishes nothing

proverb: Wadala hashara shifuutiin kufe.
meaning_om: Namni jabaan wanta xiqqoo fi salphaa taateen kufuu danda'a; tuffiin balaa fida.
meaning_en: Even a strong, sturdy individual can be brought down by a seemingly trivial blow.

proverb: Du'aan, du'a namatti hin dhaqu.
meaning_om: Namni ofiifuu rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru nama kaan gargaaruu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: One who is already ruined or in agony cannot offer assistance to others in distress.

proverb: Nama taaytaan dadhabe, cidhaantu itti ulfaata
meaning_om: Namni humni fi jabinnii isaa dhume yookaan dadhabbiin guddaan isa miidhe, wanti uumamaa isa wajjin jiruuyyuu akka ba'aa ulfaataatti itti dhaga'ama; dadhabbii fi humna dhabuu daangaa darbe agarsiisa
meaning_en: To a man whose physical strength and vigor have completely drained away, even his own testicles become a burdensome weight; when utterly depleted, even one's own natural body and basic existence feel heavy to bear

proverb: Tan deeysu, ta deeysu jala hin teeysu.
meaning_om: Namni dhiphina keessa jiru yeroo sanatti nama dhiphatu biraaf gargaarsa hin ta'u.
meaning_en: A person actively enduring intense crisis cannot spare attention to assist someone in the same state.

proverb: Wal jaalateef, lafoon wal hin huddeellatu.
meaning_om: Jaalalli daangaa fi dandeettii qaba; wanta humnaa olii walirraa eeguun hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Affection has practical limits; love cannot accomplish what physical capacity forbids.

proverb: Jaarsaa fi dhuufuu tabbatti dhiisani.
meaning_om: Wanti humna hin qabnee fi dadhabaan iddoo rakkisaa fi dhibeetti duubatti hafa.
meaning_en: Weakness and inevitable infirmities cannot withstand steep uphill challenges and fall away.

proverb: Akka dhabee, akka dhabdeen dhaalte.
meaning_om: Namoonni rakkatoo fi hiyyeeyyii ta'an walitti dhufanii gargaarsa dhabuu waloo mudatu.
meaning_en: Two equally destitute or incapacitated partners pair up, doubling their helplessness.

proverb: Tiruu tiruurratti hin murani.
meaning_om: Waanuma tokko irra deddeebi'anii hin raawwatan; dubbiin daangaa qabaachuu qaba.
meaning_en: One should not pile unnecessary redundancies or compound sensitive injuries upon each other.

proverb: Gurmuu guddateef, tiitisni qadaada hin banu.
meaning_om: Humna dhabeeyyiin yoo baay'atan illee wanta jabaa jijjiiruu hin danda'an.
meaning_en: A multitude of weak, powerless individuals remains incapable of moving solid obstacles.

proverb: Dhuullee dhibba, dhagaa tokkoon.
meaning_om: Wanti baay'ee garuu laafaa ta'e tokkummaa jabaa tokkoon salphaatti barbadaa'a.
meaning_en: A multitude of fragile, brittle things can all be shattered by one single solid force.

proverb: Culullee dhibba mannaa, risaa tokkicha wayya.
meaning_om: Namoota dadhaboo baay'ee qabaachuu irra nama qajeelaa fi jabaa tokko qabaachuutu caala.
meaning_en: Having one truly formidable, high-performing ally is far superior to a flock of mediocre helpers.

proverb: Dubartiin gonnoo dureysaa irra kan hiyyeessaati jaalatti.
meaning_om: Qabeenya qofa caalaa jaalalli, nagaan fi kabajaan jireenya maatii keessatti bakka guddaa qaba.
meaning_en: Genuine affection, warmth, and peace outweigh cold material wealth in a relationship.

proverb: Dardarummaan wadalummaa dha.
meaning_om: Dargaggummaan yeroo humnaa, jarjaraa fi of eeggannoo dhabuuti; qalbii gaafata.
meaning_en: Youth is a season of unbridled physical vigor, impulsiveness, and raw energy that needs guidance.

proverb: Jabaan dhaaneeti, boo'icha dhoowwa.
meaning_om: Namni aangoo fi humna qabu nama miidhee sagalee mormiillee akka hin baafne dhowwa.
meaning_en: A tyrant or oppressor inflicts painful injuries and forbids the victim even the solace of lamenting.

proverb: Jabeenyi, harreefuu humaa hin goone.
meaning_om: Humna qaamaa qofa qabaatanii ogummaa fi sammuu dhabuun ba'aa fi salphina jalaa nama hin baasu.
meaning_en: Raw muscle power without intelligence and wisdom leaves one an exploited beast of burden.

proverb: Cimeessa fardi hin buusu.
meaning_om: Namni hojii isaa beekuu fi of to'atu rakkina kamiyyuu danda'ee milkaa'a.
meaning_en: An expert, resolute, and balanced individual cannot be easily unseated by turbulent crises.

proverb: Humna ofii hin beektuu, lafoon farda jala duulti.
meaning_om: Dandeettii ofii osoo hin madaalin nama humna guddaa qabu wajjin dorgomuun of miidha.
meaning_en: Unaware of their limitations, the weak vainly attempt to keep pace with the swift and mighty.

proverb: Haada haarayaatu waa hidha.
meaning_om: Humni haarayaa fi qophiin ammayyaa rakkoo jiru furuuf bu'aa guddaa qaba.
meaning_en: Fresh resolve, new methods, and vigorous new talent are what securely bind and resolve challenges.

proverb: Yoo utaalchaa, fardi muka hin korre.
meaning_om: Wanti hundi dandeettii qabaatus daangaa uumamaa qaba; wanta hin danda'amne hin eegan.
meaning_en: No matter how extraordinary one's abilities, natural limitations prevent impossible feats.

proverb: Burcuqqoo shantamaaf, uleen tokko qorich.a
meaning_om: Wanti baay'ee garuu laafaa ta'e meeshaa jabaa tokkicha qofaan salphaatti barbadaa'a.
meaning_en: A multitude of delicate, fragile targets is easily smashed by a single solid weapon.

proverb: Jeedalloo dhibba tokkootu leenca harkisa jechuu mannaa, leenca tokkootu jeedalloo dhibbaa harkisa jechuu wayya.
meaning_om: Baay'ina gowwootaa fi dadhabootaa caalaa goota fi hogganaa jabaa tokko qabaachuutu wayya.
meaning_en: A single true lion-hearted hero outweighs and commands an entire pack of mediocre followers.

proverb: Baayyateef, tiitisni qadaada hin banu.
meaning_om: Baay'inni qofti humna hin ta'u; dandeettii fi humna qabatamaa malee wanti guddaan hin hojjetamu.
meaning_en: Mere numerical abundance cannot compensate for inherent weakness when moving solid obstacles.

proverb: Hantuunni taaytaa hin qabne, Aduurretti utaala.
meaning_om: Namni hubannoo fi daangaa ofii hin beekne balaa guddaa fi diina isa balleessutti of kenna.
meaning_en: A reckless person ignorant of their own limits foolishly pounces straight into mortal danger.

proverb: Masalooleen adaba hin qabne, dhagatti oriiti.
meaning_om: Namni adaba hin qabne fi qalbii malee fiigu waan jabaatti bu'ee of miidha.
meaning_en: An undisciplined, reckless person dashes against immovable obstacles and destroys themselves.

proverb: Okkoteen dhagaa lagaatti oriite, ni caccaphxi.
meaning_om: Namni laafaan nama jabaa wajjin wal dorgomuuf yaalu ofumaa caccabee bada.
meaning_en: A fragile person who challenges a rock-solid, immovable power will only shatter themselves.

proverb: Nama dhagaa ciniine, ilkumaatu hadooda.
meaning_om: Nama waan hin danda'amne qabachuuf yaalu ofumaa miidhamee gaabba.
meaning_en: Whoever attempts to bite into an impossible, rock-hard obstacle only hurts themselves.

proverb: Re'eettii taaytaa hin qabne, tan afaanii adaba hin qabne.
meaning_om: Namni of hin to'anne waan hin malle hunda dubbata ykn nyaatee of miidha.
meaning_en: An undisciplined person lacks all restraint in speech, blurting out disgraceful words.

proverb: Qarri qottoo, dhagaa hin murre.
meaning_om: Dandeettiin namaa yoo cimaa ta'e illee wantoota uumamaan hin danda'amne hin jijjiiru.
meaning_en: Even the sharpest tool or keenest mind cannot cut through impossible, immovable realities.

proverb: Re'een hoggaa du'aa kaate, funyaan qeeyransaati arraabdi.
meaning_om: Namni badiin itti dhufe waan lubbuu isaa balleessutti beekaa of dhiiba.
meaning_en: When someone is doomed by arrogance, they foolishly taunt the very predator that can kill them.

proverb: Hudduu hin qabne dhiiban, duugdaa citani.
meaning_om: Humnaa fi bu'uura osoo hin qabaatin waan ulfaataa dhiibuuf yaaluun of cabsa.
meaning_en: Attempting to exert heavy force without adequate foundation or strength only breaks oneself.

proverb: Hammaan dandayurraan tarkaanfadhaan, kofa nama baqaysa.
meaning_om: Dandeettii ofiitiin ol waan ta'e hojjechuuf yaaluun miidhaa guddaa ofirratti fida.
meaning_en: Overextending beyond one's true capacity leads to painful, embarrassing self-injury.

proverb: Bakka hin dhaqqabne hin hooqqatani.
meaning_om: Dhimma humna ofiitii olii fi bakka itti dhiibbaa hin qabne keessa hin lixani.
meaning_en: One should not obsess over or meddle in matters that lie entirely beyond one's reach.

proverb: Lukkuun quufte, guuza risaa dhayxi.
meaning_om: Namni quufe wanta balaa fidu dagatee gara diina isaatti deema.
meaning_en: Pampered overconfidence makes one reckless, blindly venturing into the clutches of the enemy.

proverb: Qooqu malee, bofni karaa irratti hin bahu.
meaning_om: Namni callisaan jiru sababa malee nama hin lolu; wanti hundi sababa qaba.
meaning_en: Even a dangerous adversary does not act aggressively without provocation or extreme distress.

proverb: Hantuutni quufe, qa'ee adurreeti dhaqa.
meaning_om: Namni quufaan of tuule balaa guddaa jala akka jiru dagatee diinatti of laata.
meaning_en: Over-satiated arrogance blinds a person to danger, leading them straight to their nemesis.

proverb: Tumaalessi coome, abletti rigata.
meaning_om: Namni milkii argate wanta isa balleessutti beekaa dhihaatee of miidha.
meaning_en: A prosperous but foolish person flirtatiously plays with the very blade that will slaughter them.

proverb: Harreen gaafa quufte, sirba waraabooti dhayxi.
meaning_om: Namni quufaan qalbii dhabe iddoo balaan jiru deemee of balleessa.
meaning_en: Reckless overconfidence leads a foolish creature to party in the lair of its mortal enemies.

proverb: Harreen growwaan, waraabessa geggessiti.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan diina isa nyaachuuf deemu akka firaatti ilaalee wajjin deema.
meaning_en: A naive fool treats their own mortal enemy as an ally, accompanying them to their own demise.

proverb: Gaayriin hoggaa dhumaa kaate, karaa irratti baati.
meaning_om: Namni badiin itti dhufe bakka balaan jirutti of saaxilee mul'ata.
meaning_en: When an elusive creature is fated for doom, it abandons cover and exposes itself on the open road.

proverb: Osoo haatuu, lukkuun waan itti qalamtu baafte.
meaning_om: Namni waan of miidhu ykn balaa ittiin badu ofumaan barbaadee argata.
meaning_en: By unthinking, incessant scratching, one unwittingly unearths the very weapon of one's demise.

proverb: Qubni dhadhayxuun, hudduu abbaa dhaqa.
meaning_om: Namni dhimma ormaa fi wanta hin malle tuttuqu salphina ofirratti fida.
meaning_en: A meddlesome, restless person who probes inappropriately only brings foul shame upon themselves.

proverb: Haqaan guddoon, udaan fiddi.
meaning_om: Dhimma tokko daangaa malee qorachuun yookiin falmuun wanta fokkisaa baasa.
meaning_en: Excessive meddling and relentless probing into an issue only unearths shameful dirt.

proverb: Joolleen, "hiriyya kiyya narraa dhoorkii, kan narra guddaa natti gadi dhiisi" jette.
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan balaa guddaa tuffatee isa xiqqaatti lola; humna ofii hin madaalu.
meaning_en: A foolishly stubborn person ignores their true equal and recklessly challenges a much bigger giant.

proverb: Tiitichi baaduu keessa daakuu bare, danfa seena.
meaning_om: Namni iddoo salphaa fi amansiisaatti bare iddoo balaa keessa seenee of guba.
meaning_en: Habituated to easy, harmless indulgences, one carelessly plunges into boiling, deadly traps.

proverb: Hantuutni quufe, karaa irratti taphata.
meaning_om: Namni quufe sodaata dhabee bakka balaan jirutti of saaxila; quufi qalbii balleessa.
meaning_en: A mouse full of grain loses all fear, foolishly dancing in open sight of lurking predators.

proverb: Re'een farra qabdu, mataa qeerransaa arraabdi.
meaning_om: Namni carraan isaa badii ta'e diina isa nyaatutti beekaa dhihaata; balaatti of kenna.
meaning_en: An ill-fated, doomed creature boldly courts death by caressing the head of the predator.

proverb: If qolli hin huqqatu.
meaning_om: Namni ofittoo ta'ee fi waan qabu ormarraa qusatu qabeenya fi qaamaan of hin miidhu.
meaning_en: A self-centered miser who hoards everything for oneself never suffers lack or wasting.

proverb: If hifanni hin dulloomu, if qolli hin huqqatu.
meaning_om: Namni dadhabbii fi dhiphina ofirraa qusatu umriin isaa ni tura, ofittoonis ni gabbata.
meaning_en: One who avoids grueling strain ages slowly, and one who hoards food stays well-fed.

proverb: If qolli, harka hin qabu.
meaning_om: Namni ofittoo ta'e nama gargaaruuf harka hin diriiyrfatu; kennuu hin beeku.
meaning_en: A tight-fisted, selfish person has no open hand to extend charity or help to others.

proverb: Arjaan dhadha kenna, if qolli bishaan dhoowwata.
meaning_om: Namni arjaan waan mi'aawaa fi kabajamaa kenna, doqni garuu waan salphaallee hin kennu.
meaning_en: A magnanimous soul shares rich delicacies, whereas a stingy person withholds basic water.

proverb: Of jettuun, dhiirsa koo hin jettu.
meaning_om: Namni ofittummaan qabame nama kaaniif kabajaa fi jaalala hin kennu; of qofa yaada.
meaning_en: An entirely self-absorbed partner thinks only of herself and never honors her spouse.

proverb: Namni garaa bal'atu, jaalala hin beeku.
meaning_om: Namni fedhii qodhaa fi garaa ofii qofa hordofu jaalala dhugaa namaaf hin qabu.
meaning_en: One whose heart is dominated by bottomless appetite and greed is incapable of selfless love.

proverb: Niitiin dhiirsa ishii irraanfattee, dinnichaa funaannatte.
meaning_om: Namni ofittoo ta'e dhiphina fira dhihoo dhiisee faayidaa xiqqaaf fiiga.
meaning_en: A self-serving individual completely ignores a grave family crisis to pursue trivial food.

proverb: Ati naa hooysi, ani niin luugaa.
meaning_om: Hojii fi dadhabbii nama biraatti dhiisanii bu'aa qofa dhuunfaatti eeggatu.
meaning_en: Leaving all the labor and preparation to another while eagerly claiming the benefit for oneself.

proverb: A'oon waraabeysaa, keysaa duubaan walitti qooyti.
meaning_om: Balaan yookiin diinni hamaan kallattii hundaan nama marsee nama liqimsa.
meaning_en: A ruthless predator or vicious predicament surrounds and crushes a victim from every direction.

proverb: Of argaan, nama hin argu.
meaning_om: Namni of tuuluu fi of qofa ilaalu hanqina ofiis ta'ee rakkoo nama biraa hin argu.
meaning_en: A narcissistic, arrogant person is so blinded by self-worship that they see no value in others.

proverb: Haati if qaqqabdu, ilmoo isii hin dhaqqabdu.
meaning_om: Namni ofittummaan jireenya dhuunfaa qofa eeggatu itti gaafatamummaa maatii dagata.
meaning_en: A mother or guardian preoccupied solely with her own grooming neglects the urgent needs of her child.

proverb: Namni ollaaf hin hille, soddaaf hin hilu.
meaning_om: Namni amala gaarii fi gara laafina hin qabne nama dhihoo fi firaafuu hin ta'u.
meaning_en: A cold-hearted person who lacks empathy for neighbors will never show genuine kindness to in-laws.

proverb: Yaa rabbi na baasi, kan feete albaasi.
meaning_om: Namni ofittoo ta'e ofii isaa baqachuuf jedhee ormi yoo badeyyuu hin dhimmu.
meaning_en: The selfish person prays only for personal salvation while wishing calamity on everyone else.

proverb: Mana keetitti nyaannaa, mana kootitti udaanna.
meaning_om: Bu'aa fi waan gaarii ormarraa nyaatanii, rakkinaa fi kosii ammoo achitti dhiisu.
meaning_en: Exploiting another's hospitality for food and joy while reserving nothing valuable for them in return.

proverb: Kan tokkoo kan barbaadu kan ofiiti dhaba.
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya ormaatti bololee fudhachuuf fiigu waan duraan qabu dhabee deegaa hafa.
meaning_en: One who covetously grasps for someone else's sole possession risks forfeiting their own goods.

proverb: Harreen, "ergaan ani du'e araddaan hin mayrin" jette.
meaning_om: Namni ofittoo ta'e yeroo inni hin jirretti wanti hundi yoo barbadaa'eyyuu homaa itti hin fakkaatu.
meaning_en: A thoroughly selfish soul cares nothing for the future or posterity once their own life ends.

proverb: joolleen garaatu na dhukkubee malee, niin quufee hin beektu.
meaning_om: Namni kajeellaa qabu yeroo hunda dhabeera jedhee komata malee quufeera jedhee hin galateeffatu.
meaning_en: Insatiable people constantly complain of lack and pain, but never acknowledge their abundant blessings.

proverb: Nama hoodhoo hin beeyne, kennii maaltu barsiise.
meaning_om: Namni uumamaan doqna ta'ee fi arjummaa hin beekne salphaatti nama gargaaruu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: One who was never habituated to sharing in childhood cannot easily be taught generosity in adulthood.

proverb: Harreen, "anaa wayyaawe nattti dhiitee, anaa du'a gaye naa bariite" jette.
meaning_om: Namni rakkataarratti carraan yeroo hunda micciiramee dhibee fi dhiphina itti dabala.
meaning_en: A wretched creature finds that timing is always perverse—respite arrives too late and toil resumes too soon.

proverb: "Ani waraabessaan tahee dhufaa, ati harree tahii na eegi" je'e namichi.
meaning_om: Waliigaltee sobaa fi miidhaa ifa ta'e namarratti fe'uun nama gowwoomsuuf carraaqu.
meaning_en: Proposing a preposterously one-sided, predatory arrangement that guarantees the partner's destruction.

proverb: Soddaan hamaan kan waan qabu soddaa isaa dhoyfatu, kan san daran hamaa kan waan soddaan isaa hin qabne fidi ja'u.
meaning_om: Doqnummaan hammaadha, garuu nama rakkataarraa waan inni hin qabne dirqiin barbaaduun daran hammaata.
meaning_en: Stinginess is offensive, but extorting and demanding nonexistent resources from an in-law is far worse.

proverb: Ho'o jennaan didde, achi keenyaan hatte.
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa qabu waan kabajaan kennamuuf tuffatee dhoksaatti hatuu filata.
meaning_en: A perverse person spurns an honest, dignified gift only to dishonorably steal it when left unattended.

proverb: Yaa dagate, yammuu biyyi nyaattu ni dhokatte, yammuu biyyi rafu ni nyaatte.
meaning_om: Namni ofittoo ta'e hawaasa wajjin qooddachuu dhiisee dhoksaatti nyaata; kabajaa fi firummaa dhabata.
meaning_en: The selfish glutton cowers in secret to avoid sharing with the village, only to feast alone in the dark.

proverb: Sareen abbaa warraa hin jettu, ijoolleen haadha koo hin jettu.
meaning_om: Sareen nama nyaata kennuuf hunda hordofti, ijoolleeniis nama isaan gargaare hundatti fiigu.
meaning_en: A dog is loyal to anyone who feeds it, and naive infants gravitate toward whoever provides sustenance.

proverb: Nama yoo du'an nama dhiqu, jiruun saala hin dhoyfatan.
meaning_om: Nama yeroo rakkinaa fi dhiphinaa sitti dhihaatutti iccitii fi rakkoo kee dhoksuun hin malle.
meaning_en: Do not hide your vulnerabilities or secrets in life from the trusted one who will handle you in death.

proverb: Nama yoggaa hamtuun dhufte gayaniin, gaafa nagayaa hin dhoyfatan.
meaning_om: Fira yeroo dhiphuu si bira dhaabbate gaafa nagayaas kabajuu fi iccitii qooduufiin barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Never keep secrets in prosperous peace from the loyal soul you rely upon during crises.

proverb: Dhukkuba himatan, qoricha argatan.
meaning_om: Rakkoo fi dhibee ofii yoo ifatti himatan furmaata fi gargaarsa argatu.
meaning_en: Concealing an affliction brings ruin; openly disclosing one's trouble invites relief and healing.

proverb: Dhukkuba dhoysan, qorichi dhokate.
meaning_om: Rakkoo ofii dhoksuun furmaata dhabuu fi miidhaa guddaa fida.
meaning_en: When an ailment or crisis is concealed, its cure and solution naturally stay out of reach.

proverb: Dubbiin Yoo garaa baqaysan fayyiti, wanti biraa yoo garaa baqaysan duuti.
meaning_om: Dhimma fi aarii garaa keessaa baasanii dubbachuun araara fida, caldhisuun garuu nama miidha.
meaning_en: Speaking out inner grievances resolves them, whereas physical wounds to the belly prove fatal.

proverb: Dubbiin adiitu tola.
meaning_om: Dubbiin iftoomina qabduu fi soba hin qabne nagaa fi haqa buufti.
meaning_en: Straightforward, transparent, and honest words are far superior to devious ambiguity.

proverb: Waan abbaan himate, yaadni guura.
meaning_om: Namni yeroo dhimma isaa ifatti baasee dubbatu, marii fi yaadaan furmaata argata.
meaning_en: Once an owner states their problem clearly, collective wisdom can assemble a solution.

proverb: Waan hidhiin geeyse, heerri mura.
meaning_om: Waan afaaniin baatee dubbatamte hundaaf namni itti gaafatamummaa seeraa qaba.
meaning_en: Whatever words are spoken across the lips fall under the jurisdiction and judgment of the law.

proverb: Dubbiin fuula hammenyaaf nama hin nyaattu.
meaning_om: Dubbii haqaa fi qajeelaan yoo dubbatame bifti nama dubbatuu rakkina hin ta'u.
meaning_en: The validity and weight of truthful words do not depend on the physical beauty of the speaker.

proverb: Dubbii baha hin dhoorkan, gala dhoorkan malee.
meaning_om: Namni akka fedhe dubbachuu danda'a, garuu miidhaa fi bu'aa dubbii sanaa to'achuutu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: You can easily utter words into the open, but you cannot stop the disastrous backlash they bring home.

proverb: Arrabni, waan garaa jiru hata.
meaning_om: Yaada dhokataa nama keessa jiru arrabni osoo hin beekin baasee ifa godha.
meaning_en: The tongue inadvertently slips and reveals the innermost secrets locked in the heart.

proverb: Waan garaan yaade, arrabni fuudha.
meaning_om: Wanti sammuu fi garaa namaa keessa deddeebi'u yeroo booda afaaniin bahee dubbatama.
meaning_en: Whatever deeply occupies the heart and mind will eventually find expression through the tongue.

proverb: Akkuma waa argan, waa haasa'an.
meaning_om: Dubbiin namaa ragaa fi wanta ijaan argan irratti hirkatee dubbatama.
meaning_en: Speech naturally reflects what one has witnessed; observations shape conversation.

proverb: Dullachi, waan garaa qabu qufa'a.
meaning_om: Namni muuxannoo fi umrii qabu dhimma isa dhibe caldhisee hin dhiisu; dubbatee baasa.
meaning_en: An elder or experienced person cannot harbor grievances silently; they clear their chest openly.

proverb: Wal argan, dubbii argan.
meaning_om: Namoonni yoo wal argan dhimmoota jiran mari'atanii furmaata itti gooluu danda'u.
meaning_en: Meeting in person brings dialogue, clarity, and the natural resolution of standing disputes.

proverb: Lafa qabbanaan tiratu, waan dhufaniif ofiin himatu.
meaning_om: Yeroon nagaa fi tasgabbiin dhufetti namni dhimma isaa ifatti dubbatee dhiheessa.
meaning_en: In a calm, cooled atmosphere, one proceeds unhurriedly and discloses one's true mission.

proverb: Waliisaa fi maraataan, waan garaa qabu dubbata.
meaning_om: Namni garaa qulqulluu qabu ykn maraataan waan keessa isaa jiru dhoksaa malee baasa.
meaning_en: Both the visionary poet and the madman speak without filters, blurting out raw unvarnished truths.

proverb: Yaada garaa namaa jiru, arraataatu irraa gad hin teenye.
meaning_om: Wanti namatti yaaddoo ta'e afaaniin bahee odeeffamuu jalaa hin oolu.
meaning_en: The tongue can never stay still over pressing concerns that continuously agitate the heart.

proverb: Bakka gubbaa nama nyanyaattu, harkaa irraa gad hin teenye.
meaning_om: Namni yeroo hunda dhimma isa dhiphisee fi isa miidherratti xiyyeeffata.
meaning_en: One's hand constantly returns to the itchy spot; similarly, one's mind constantly attends to pain.

proverb: Waan warri waarii dubbatu, jooleen waaree dubbatti.
meaning_om: Iccitii maatii halkan dubbatame ijoolleen ifatti gabaatti baaftee odeessiti.
meaning_en: Confidential matters discussed by parents at night are innocently blurted out by children by day.

proverb: Waa'en garbaa qoraani.
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu dhimma hojii fi gahee isa ilaallatu qofarratti xiyyeeffachuu qaba.
meaning_en: Each person should attend diligently to their assigned duty and station in life.

proverb: Abbaan waraanaa, waan waraanaati dubbata.
meaning_om: Namni hundi dhimma ogummaa, hojii fi muuxannoo ofiirraan kan hafe hin odeessu.
meaning_en: Every professional or specialist naturally converses about their own craft and experience.

proverb: Dubbii garaa argan, galataan dayani.
meaning_om: Dubbii qajeelaa fi dhugaan garaarraa madde namni kabajaan simatee galateeffata.
meaning_en: Sincere, heartfelt communication that touches the core is received with gratitude and peace.

proverb: Dhagaa, xiqqaa dha darbatani.
meaning_om: Wanti salphaa fi xiqqaatee mul'atu hojiif ykn balaaf salphaatti itti fayyadama.
meaning_en: A small, manageable stone is chosen to throw; small beginnings or small things are readily utilized.

proverb: Jaldeessi, xixiqqaatu waa arga.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen yookiin warri xixinnoon waan haaraa fi balaa dhufe dafanii hubatu.
meaning_en: Among baboons (and people), the young, agile ones possess sharp eyes and spot changes first.

proverb: Ilmi, fakkeessaa abbaati.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen amala, bifa fi hojii warra isaanii hordofanii dhalatu; dhalootatu wal fakkaata.
meaning_en: A son mirrors his father in temperament, character, and conduct; like father, like son.

proverb: Joolleen dhabnee hin beektu.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen daangaa fi dhabamuu qabeenyaa hin beektu; waan barbaaddu yerooma sana fedha.
meaning_en: Young children cannot understand scarcity or economic hardship; they demand what they want immediately.

proverb: Booda dhalateeti, gaafni gurra dabra.
meaning_om: Namni yeroo booda dhufe ykn dargaggoon dandeettii fi guddinaan warra duriirra darba.
meaning_en: Though emerging later in time, horns grow longer than the ears; juniors often surpass their seniors.

proverb: Joolleen daaraa dha, dhawan ni facaati.
meaning_om: Ijoollee gara-jabinaan reebuu dhiisanii obsaan qajeelchu; rukuttaan ijoollee faffacaasa.
meaning_en: Children are as fragile and volatile as loose ashes; harsh beatings only scatter and alienate them.

proverb: Ji'a halkan ifu, joolleen adu seeti.
meaning_om: Hubannoo dhabuudhaan wantoota gurguddoo fi wal fakkaatan adda baasuu dadhabu.
meaning_en: In their naive innocence, children mistake the soft glow of the night moon for the radiant sun.

proverb: Joolleen baasa hin beektuu, moofoo abbaati quba keessi.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen hiyyummaa fi qaanfannaa hin beektu; hanqina maatii ifatti baasti.
meaning_en: Innocent of financial embarrassment, a child naively pokes fingers through the holes in a father's rags.

proverb: Joolleen ganama waaqa ilaaltu, galgala lafa ilaalti.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen ganama abdii fi gammachuun kaati, garuu beelaa fi dadhabbiin galgala isaan kuffisa.
meaning_en: Children wake full of exuberance gazing at the sky, but weary hunger has them staring at the dirt by sunset.

proverb: Joolleen gaafa du'aa kolfiteeti, gaafa taskaaraa boochi.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen yeroo gaddaa fi gammachuu sirriitti hin beektu; qalbii bilchaataa hin qabdu.
meaning_en: Children lack social awareness, giggling during solemn funerals and crying during festive memorial feasts.

proverb: Joolleen ormaa, nyaatteeti balbala ilaalti.
meaning_om: Nama fira hin taane yoo nyaachisan illee gara maatii isaatti deebi'uuf yaada malee hin amanamu.
meaning_en: A neighbor's child happily consumes your meal and promptly looks toward the door to run back home.

proverb: Joolleen haati irraa duutee fi kan laga biraa dhaqxe wal qixa boochi.
meaning_om: Ijoolleef haadha dhabuun yeroofis ta'u du'aanis dhiphina wal fakkaataa fida.
meaning_en: To a small child, a mother absent across the river feels just as devastating as a mother lost to death.

proverb: Mucaan gonnoo isaa haadha argisiisee "kookkoo" jennaan "Osoon kana sodaadhee siihuu hin dhalu" jetteeni.
meaning_om: Wanta namni biraa akka balaa guddaatti ilaalu nama muuxannoo fi beekumsa qabu hin sodaachisu.
meaning_en: What an innocent youth thinks is an alarming terror is ordinary reality to an experienced elder.

proverb: Ilmaan abbaa, mariin ardaaga.
meaning_om: Obboolaan abbaa tokkoo dhimma lafaa fi qabeenyaa ifatti bakkee irratti mari'atu.
meaning_en: Brothers sharing the same father settle their public, territorial, and inheritance affairs in the open commons.

proverb: Ilmaan haadhaa, mariin ibidda keessaa.
meaning_om: Ijoolleen garaa tokkoo dhimma iccitii fi jaalalaa manuma keessatti dhoksaatti mari'atu.
meaning_en: Maternal siblings discuss intimate, emotional, and confidential matters privately by the domestic hearth.

proverb: Ilmaan adeeraa, mariin araddaa keessa.
meaning_om: Firoonni dhihoo fi ilmaan adeeraa dhimma gosaa fi hawaasummaa waliin qooddatu.
meaning_en: Cousins of the extended paternal clan meet in the village square to coordinate community solidarity.

proverb: Abbaan kufan, ilmaan ka'ani.
meaning_om: Dhaloonni duraa yoo darban ilmaan bakka bu'anii seenaa fi maatii itti fufsiisu.
meaning_en: When the fathers age or pass away, the sons rise to take their place and carry forward the legacy.

proverb: Dal'uun, gurmuu irra teeyseeti gabbatti
meaning_om: Namni tokko deeggarsa fi gargaarsa warra kaaniitiin kabajama ykn badhaadha.
meaning_en: One prospers or gains prominence by leaning on the strength and support of others.

proverb: "Bakki na dhukkubu bakka biraatii, ammoo bakkuma goftaan koo je'e na koobaa" jette, gabrittiin
meaning_om: Dirqisiifamuun waan sirrii hin taane ajaja nama aangoo qabuuf jedhanii raawwachuu.
meaning_en: Yielding to the orders of an authority figure against one's own truth or better judgment.

proverb: Namni niitiin bulu, ollaa hin bulu
meaning_om: Namni mana ofii irratti murtoo bilisaa hin qabne hawaasa keessattis kabajaa dhabuu.
meaning_en: Someone who cannot govern their own household lacks standing or authority in the broader community.

proverb: Mukni mukarra taa'u hundee hin qabu
meaning_om: Wanti of danda'ee hin dhaabbannee fi nama biraa irratti hirkatu bu'uura cimaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: That which relies entirely on another without standing on its own lacks a solid foundation.

proverb: Ilma gadhee dhalchuu mannaa, dubra gaarii dhalchanii, soddaa arkachuu wayya
meaning_om: Ilma maqaa balleessu qabaachuu irra intala amala gaarii qabduun fira kabajamaa argachuu wayya.
meaning_en: A virtuous daughter who brings respected in-laws is far better than an unruly son who brings disgrace.

proverb: Keessummaa fi joolleen, galgala beelaaf duuti
meaning_om: Keessummaa fi daa'imman yeroodhaan nyaachisuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Guests and young children have low tolerance for prolonged hunger and need prompt hospitality.

proverb: "Maaltu ajaawa" jennaan, "soddaa soddaarra ta'u jiraa ajaawaan" Ja'an
meaning_om: Soddaan soddaa irratti qubachuun ykn hirkachuun safeeffannaa fi kabajaa kan dhabsiisu ta'uu.
meaning_en: Overstaying or imposing oneself upon one's in-laws destroys mutual respect and causes severe discomfort.

proverb: Kan itti kufan lafa, kan qabatanii ka'aniis lafa
meaning_om: Madduma rakkoo ykn kufaatii keessaa furmaanni fi jajjabinni akka argamu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: The very place where one stumbles or suffers defeat is where one must find the leverage to rise again.

proverb: Harreen mana hin qabduu mana looniiti galti, nadhoon mana hin qabduu mana dhiiraati galti
meaning_om: Aadaa durii keessatti bakka bu'iinsa fi jireenya dubartootaa heerumaan ibsuuf kan dubbatamu.
meaning_en: A traditional reflection on a woman building her life and home through marriage.

proverb: Hora malee hin horan, horii malee hin tolan
meaning_om: Bu'uura qabeenyaa fi wantoota jireenya fooyyessan malee badhaadhinni akka hin argamne.
meaning_en: Just as livestock need mineral spring water to flourish, human well-being requires resources and wealth.

proverb: Gowwaa fi sareen bakka itti quufanii hin galani
meaning_om: Namni hubannaa hin qabne bakka faayidaa yeroo argatetti dafee rarra'ee hafa.
meaning_en: A foolish person and a dog linger excessively wherever they find momentary food or satisfaction.

proverb: Soddaa fi surree wajjin kufan
meaning_om: Soddaa waliin wal dhabuun ykn qaanofsiisuun akka saalfannaa surreen kufuutti ilaalamuu.
meaning_en: One must uphold shame and honor with in-laws as intimately as guarding one's clothes from falling.

proverb: Barcuma irra taa'anii, muka hin hamatani
meaning_om: Waan ofii itti fayyadamaa jiran ykn irraa fayyadaman tuffachuu fi arrabsuun sirrii miti.
meaning_en: One should not insult or undermine the very source of one's own comfort and benefit.

proverb: Keessummaan taguuga, akka abbaan godhe taati
meaning_om: Keessummaan simannaa fi heera abbaan manaa qopheesseen qajeelfamti.
meaning_en: A guest follows the lead, hospitality, and arrangements provided by the host.

proverb: Duuti koo dinnichaarratti jette dhaddeen
meaning_om: Fedhiin garmalee fi jaalalli waan tokkoo nama galaafachuu ykn balaatti geessuu akka danda'u.
meaning_en: Excessive greed or passion for a particular indulgence will eventually bring about one's doom.

proverb: Jaalala qabaatan, namni lama ganda
meaning_om: Yoo jaalalli fi walii galli jiraate, baayyinni osoo hin taane tokkummaan gahaadha.
meaning_en: Where true love and unity exist, even two people constitute a complete and thriving community.

proverb: Jaalalti fala gooytaati
meaning_om: Jaalalli rakkoolee fi mudannoowwan hedduudhaaf furmaata hunda caalu ta'uu.
meaning_en: Love is the ultimate remedy that overcomes the greatest difficulties and disputes.

proverb: Ijji jaalalaa hamtuu dha
meaning_om: Namni waan jaalatu irratti hinaaffaa fi quuqama guddaa akka qabu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Love is fiercely protective and easily provoked to intense jealousy or concern.

proverb: Aalaa jaalatani, hundee qoqorani
meaning_om: Wanta tokko jaalachaa garmalee keessa lixanii qorachuun balleessuu danda'uu.
meaning_en: Loving something so excessively that over-scrutinizing or meddling ruins its very foundation.

proverb: Haati ilmoo hin obsitu
meaning_om: Jaalalli fi dhiifamni haati ilmoo isiitiif qabdu kan hin dhumnee fi obsa hin dhabne ta'uu.
meaning_en: A mother's boundless love and instinct cannot endure seeing her offspring suffer or stay estranged.

proverb: Abbaa jaalatani, ilma isaa dhungatani
meaning_om: Nama tokko jaalachuu irraa kan ka'e firaa fi maatii isaas kabajuu fi jaalachuu.
meaning_en: One honors, cherishes, and cares for someone's offspring out of respect and love for the parent.

proverb: Nama jaalatani, harka itti maratani
meaning_om: Nama jaalatan haala hundaan gargaaruu, qooda fudhachuu fi cinaa dhaabbachuu.
meaning_en: True love expresses itself through protective embrace, steadfast support, and closeness.

proverb: Nama jaalatan bakka raffisan hin dhabani, hidhii fi funyaan jidduun ni fuuti
meaning_om: Namni jaalalli dhugaa qabu nama jaalatu simachuu fi qubsiisuuf sababa hin dhabu.
meaning_en: When there is true affection, space and resources are always found to welcome and shelter the beloved.

proverb: Waan jaalalti si muddu, jibbansi si hin mudu
meaning_om: Jaalalli fedhii, dhiphinaa fi qormaata jibbansi nama hin mudsiifne keessa nama galcha.
meaning_en: The vulnerability, heartache, and tribulations born of love are far more overwhelming than those of hatred.

proverb: Shumburaa goggoyduun nama huuti, jaalalti goggoyduun qalbi nama fuuti
meaning_om: Jaalalli deebii hin qabnee fi qallaan nama dhiphisee yaada namaa fudhata.
meaning_en: Just as dry chickpeas cause choking, dry or unrequited love consumes and unsettles one's peace of mind.

proverb: Kan jaalatan jaala
meaning_om: Namni waan jaalatu eeggata, cinaatti dhiheeffata, akkasumas wanti jaalatamu hunda caala.
meaning_en: That which one cherishes is held closest to the heart and protected above all else.

proverb: Baayyisanii wal jaalachuu irra, xinnessanii wajji jiraachuu wayya
meaning_om: Jaalala humnaa olii kan dafee badu irra, jaalala tasgabbaa'aa wajjin wal danda'anii itti fufan wayya.
meaning_en: Enduring, modest mutual tolerance is far better than an overwhelming passion that burns out quickly.

proverb: Warra wal jaalatu, dhihanni hin hanqatu
meaning_om: Bakka jaalallii fi walhubannaan jirutti hanqinni nyaataas ta'e wantootaa hin dhiphisu.
meaning_en: Where people love and share with one another, sustenance and contentment are never in short supply.

proverb: Jaalalti goggoyduun, lafe nama dhukkubsiti
meaning_om: Jaalalli kabajaa fi deebii hin qabne qaamaa fi sammuu namaa miidha.
meaning_en: Empty, unresponsive love inflicts deep, agonizing torment that permeates right to the bones.

proverb: Yaa jiruu, kan si jibbu hin jiru
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu lubbuun jiraachuu fi lubbuu ofii jaalachuu irratti wal hin dhabu.
meaning_en: Everyone cherishes living; no one truly despises existence when faced with its preservation.

proverb: Saani bahuu gahe wal arraaba, namni du'uu gahe wal jaalata
meaning_om: Yeroo addaan bahuun ykn duuti dhiyaatu namoonni araaramaa fi jaalala walii mul'isu.
meaning_en: When departure or death draws near, people reconcile and express tender love and reconciliation.

proverb: "Yaa kan dur na fuudhe", jette, namittiin
meaning_om: Jaalallii fi kabajni namni yeroo jalqabaaf waliin tureef qabu yoomiyyuu akka hin banne agarsiisa.
meaning_en: The memory and deep affection for one's first love or initial spouse remain indelible.

proverb: Bakka jaalalti geeyse, jibbansi hin geenye
meaning_om: Dhiibbaa fi humni jaalalli uumu kan jibbansi gonkumaa dhaqqabuu hin dandeenyedha.
meaning_en: The depth and transformative power achieved by love far surpass anything hatred can accomplish.

proverb: Qulfiin waa hundaan banatan jaalala, sanduuqni keeysa kaayatan obsa
meaning_om: Jaalalli hundaa kan furu yoo ta'u, jaalalli sun akka itti fufu garuu obsi barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Love is the master key to open every heart, while patience is the vessel that preserves it.

proverb: Jaalalti ammaan tanaa, durri gaggabaa boodi arraba
meaning_om: Jaalalli yeroo ammaa bu'uura dhugaa hin qabne dafee dhooyee gara wal-arrabsuutti deebi'a.
meaning_en: Superficial modern infatuation begins with dramatic swooning but quickly degenerates into bitter insults.

proverb: Jaalalti fiiginsaa, jibba fiiginsaati fiddi
meaning_om: Jaalalli tasgabbii malee ariitiin jalqabame, dafee gara jibbansa cimaatti garagala.
meaning_en: A hasty infatuation that rushes without foundation brings equally rapid and bitter resentment.

proverb: Jaalalti mormaa olii hin turtu
meaning_om: Jaalalli afaanii fi qalbii irraa hin maddine yeroo muraasa booda bada.
meaning_en: Superficial love that comes only from the lips rather than from the heart is fleeting.

proverb: Lameen wal jaalate, biddeena tokkootu quubsa
meaning_om: Bakka jaalallii fi waliigalteen jiru qabeenyi xiqqoonis namaaf gaha.
meaning_en: Where two people truly love each other, even a single piece of bread is more than enough to satisfy them.

proverb: Jaalalti guddoon jibbansa gudda fiddi
meaning_om: Jaalalli humnaa olii yoo cabe gara jibbansa cimaa fi hammeenyaatti jijjiirama.
meaning_en: Intense passion, when broken or betrayed, turns into an equally fierce and profound hatred.

proverb: Jaalalti soddaa takka, jaalala goggoyduu
meaning_om: Jaalalli soddaan walii qaban daangaa fi safeeffannaa qabaachuu akka qabu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Affection between in-laws is cautious, formal, and strictly governed by boundaries of modesty.

proverb: Ana jaalattu, furrii tiyyaa wajji
meaning_om: Nama tokko yoo jaalatan hanqinaa fi amala isaatis dabalanii fudhachuu qabu.
meaning_en: True love embraces the beloved unconditionally, flaws, imperfections, and all.

proverb: Joollee jaalatanii, gorora hin jibbani
meaning_om: Wanta tokko yoo jaalatan dhibaa fi rakkoolee isa wajjin dhufan obsaan simachuu qabu.
meaning_en: When one genuinely loves children or undertakes a passion, one tolerates the inevitable mess and hardships.

proverb: Abbaa fardeessanii, haadha hin shalleeysani
meaning_om: Maatii keessatti abbaa fi haadha qixxee kabajuu fi wal caalchisuu dhabuu.
meaning_en: One should not glorify the father while disrespecting or neglecting the mother; both deserve equal honor.

proverb: Namni jaalala warra ifii hin qabne, jaalala biyyaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Jaalallii fi kabajni hawaasaa fi biyyaa maatii ofii jaalachuu irraa eegala.
meaning_en: Patriotism and genuine care for one's community begin with affection and loyalty toward one's own family.

proverb: Jaalalti bara ammaa, kan isniina (dafinoo) haarawaa, salaasaa (lammaffoo) moofoyteeti, arbaa (roobii) gasaroomti
meaning_om: Jaalalli yeroo ammaa bu'uura dhugaa dhabee dafee dhumuu fi jijjiiramuu isaa ibsa.
meaning_en: Modern shallow infatuation flares up quickly, fades overnight, and decays within days.

proverb: jibbansi gaange, jaalalti gaala
meaning_om: Jibbansi akka gaangee dafee nama dhiita, jaalalli garuu akka gaalaa obsa qabaatee fagootti nama geggeessa.
meaning_en: Hatred is stubborn and treacherous like a mule, while love is patient, resilient, and far-reaching like a camel.

proverb: Jaalalaan maletti nageenyi, duumeysaan maletti roobni hin jiru
meaning_om: Nageenyi hawaasaa fi namootaa jaalala irratti kan bu'uureffame ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Peace cannot exist without love, just as rain cannot fall from cloudless skies.

proverb: Niitii jechuun, tan abbaa manaa jaalattu
meaning_om: Gaa'ela keessatti jaalallii fi amanamummaan haadha manaa bu'uura maatiiti.
meaning_en: The essence of a true wife and harmonious marriage is genuine devotion and love for her partner.

proverb: Namni duumeysa kiyya hin jaalanne, rooba kiyyaas hin jaalatu
meaning_om: Namni haala qormaataa fi rakkina koo keessatti na cinaa hin dhaabbanne, milkaa'ina kootis hin qooddatu.
meaning_en: Whoever rejects me through my gloomy struggles does not deserve to share in the blessings of my success.

proverb: Yoo wal jaalatan, mixiin cidha galcha
meaning_om: Jaalallii fi tokkummaan yoo jiraate, wanti danda'amuu hin fakkaanne illee ni milkaa'a.
meaning_en: When there is mutual love and unity of purpose, even the smallest and weakest can accomplish wonders.

proverb: Yoo jaalatan jaldeeysaaf illee ni booyani
meaning_om: Jaalalli dhugaa madaallii miidhaginaa fi uumamaa dhabamsiisee maraammartoo guddaa nama keessatti uuma.
meaning_en: Love knows no prejudice; when the heart is deeply attached, it mourns even the most uncomely creature.

proverb: Guddisaan ganama
meaning_om: Daa'ima yoo xiqqaa ta'ee eegalee naamusa fi aadaa barsiisan malee yoo guddate sirreessuun rakkisaadha.
meaning_en: Proper upbringing and character formation must begin in early childhood; early training shapes the future.

proverb: Manni bareedaan asaasara
