meaning_om: Wanti kamuu miidhagaa fi cimaa kan ta'u yoo bu'uura gaarii fi xiyyeeffannoo jalqabaa qabaatedha.
meaning_en: A beautiful and lasting house relies on proper laying of foundation and continuous tidying.

proverb: Gundoo jalqaba tolteetu, goolabbii tola
meaning_om: Hojiin kamiyyuu jalqabni isaa yoo sirraa'ee fi tole xumurri isaas gaarii taha.
meaning_en: A task that begins with sound preparation and precision will conclude successfully.

proverb: Kan barana soqolatte, bara hegeree wayaa darbiti.
meaning_om: Badiin ykn gochi qaanlessaan har'a xiqqaatee jalqabame bor garmalee bal'atee ifatti baha.
meaning_en: Modest misconduct or improper behavior initiated today will escalate into shameless abandon tomorrow.

proverb: Gaafa dhudhuufaa karra baateen, akka harree boojitee galtu si beeke
meaning_om: Jalqabuma sochiitiin hubannoo fi amala namaa irraa ka'uun bu'aan isaa maal akka ta'u beekuun ni danda'ama.
meaning_en: An undisciplined and boastful beginning reveals in advance how mediocre or disgraceful the outcome will be.

proverb: Dura liqimsaniif dura hin quufani
meaning_om: Wanta tokko ariitiin jalqabuun ykn liqimsuun guutuu ta'uu fi milkaa'ina isa duraatiif wabii miti.
meaning_en: Swallowing early does not guarantee early fullness; rushing does not ensure lasting fulfillment.

proverb: Gaafni Hoolaa, qaama keessatti jallatee baha
meaning_om: Amalli badaaniis ta'e gaariin nama keessatti uumamaan ykn ijoollummaadhaan hidda qabatee mul'ata.
meaning_en: An inherent flaw or crooked disposition is formed inside long before it manifests openly on the outside.

proverb: Ilkaan mutaan seene, muddaan seene
meaning_om: Rakkoo ykn madaa xiqqoo keessa quba naquun gara miidhaa cimaa fi muddamaatti geessuu.
meaning_en: Tampering rashly with a delicate vulnerability turns a small irritation into an excruciating ordeal.

proverb: Karaa mana biraa fuudhani, dubbii afaan irra fuudhani
meaning_om: Dhugaa fi odeeffannoo sirrii argachuuf madda isaattii fi afaan abbaa irraa dhagahuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Just as one takes a clear path starting from the homestead, reliable information must be gathered from the source.

proverb: Bakka sareen banteeni, waraabessi seena
meaning_om: Bakka eeggannoon fi ittisni maatii ykn biyyaa laafeetti diinni fi miidhaan dafee seena.
meaning_en: Where the internal guard slacks or leaves a breach, danger and enemies swiftly break in.

proverb: Anaa bakka hamtutti godaane, intalti tiyya heeruma hamaa mudatte
meaning_om: Rakkina irratti rakkinni dabalamuun ykn maatii guutuu irratti carraan badaa walitti dhufuun.
meaning_en: Misfortunes compounded upon misfortune; while the parent faces hardship, the child falls into misery.

proverb: Harfiin aliifitti jallatte, aliif laamitti hin diriirtu
meaning_om: Wanti jalqaba irraa bu'uura dhabee fi jallatee eegale boodarra sirraa'uu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: What is warped at the very first step will not straighten out in subsequent advanced stages.

proverb: Bishaan maddarraa qalqullaawa
meaning_om: Dhugaan, qulqullinni fi amalli gaariin hundee fi madda ofii irraa eegalee qulqulluu ta'a.
meaning_en: Water is purest at its spring; purity and authenticity originate directly from the source.

proverb: Dubbii abbaa biraa dhaban, ilma biraa hin argani
meaning_om: Ogeessummaa fi dhugaa abbaan dhabe ilmi biraa argachuun fagoo ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: If wisdom or integrity is missing in the father, one will seldom find it in the son who was raised by him.

proverb: Bishaan lagaa dhabame, manaa hin argamu
meaning_om: Wanti madda guddaa irratti dhabame bakka xiqqoo fi gadi aanaatti argamuun hin yaadamu.
meaning_en: If a commodity is missing from its primary, vast source, it certainly cannot be found in smaller confines.

proverb: Jarjaraan, xaafii hin galchu
meaning_om: Xaafii sassaabuun obsa fi of eeggannoo waan barbaaduuf namni jarjaru kasaaraa keessa gala.
meaning_en: Harvesting delicate teff requires patience; a hasty person will spill the grain and harvest nothing.

proverb: Jarjarri, hujii sheeyxaanaati
meaning_om: Ariifannaan dantaa fi karoora malee raawwatamu badii fi dogoggora qofa hordofsiisa.
meaning_en: Rash haste is destructive and impulsive, leading only to error and regret.

proverb: Waraabeysi jarjaraan, gaafa ciniina
meaning_om: Jarjarri wanta fayyadaa hin qabne akka fudhatan ykn miidhaa akka ofirraan gahan nama godha.
meaning_en: In reckless haste, one bites into useless bone or horn instead of meat.

proverb: Marxoon fiigaa hidhatan, osoo fiigan namarraa hiikkatti
meaning_om: Qophii fi hojiin ariitiidhaan fi tasgabbii malee tolfame yeroma sana diigama.
meaning_en: What is prepared carelessly in a rush will easily fall apart in the middle of action.

proverb: Jarjaraan re'ee hin horu, lama taatu ni qala, sadi taatu ni gurgura
meaning_om: Namni obsa hin qabne qabeenya guddisuu hin danda'u, dafee balleessa.
meaning_en: An impatient person cannot build wealth; they squander every small accumulation before it grows.

proverb: Jarjaraan, dhihana ifiiti gadi naqa
meaning_om: Ariifannaan waan ofii qabanillee akka dhabanii fi akka qisaasessan nama godha.
meaning_en: Impatience causes one to ruin or spill the very nourishment prepared for oneself.

proverb: Nama dura dubbatu, namaatu jibba
meaning_om: Osoo hin tasgabbiin dursanii arraba dheereffachuun mufannaa fi jibbansa namootaa kakaasa.
meaning_en: Speaking out impulsively before thinking or hearing others generates resentment and ill will.

proverb: Midhaan dura bilchaatu, shinbirrootu nyaata
meaning_om: Wanti yeroo isaatii dura ifatti bahe ykn dhufe balaa fi miidhaaf saaxilama.
meaning_en: The crop that matures ahead of its time falls prey to birds; precocity attracts early vulnerability.

proverb: Ar'a dhaale, ar'a dhaane
meaning_om: Wanta carraan ykn dhaalaan argatan yeroma sana kabaja dhabsiisanii miidhuu.
meaning_en: Acquiring something through sudden inheritance and immediately abusing or mismanaging it.

proverb: Osoo loon hin galin, hattuun mooraa guutte
meaning_om: Wanti barbaadamu osoo hin argamin ykn hin gayin wantoonni badaa dursanii qophaa'uu.
meaning_en: Premature anticipation; thieves crowding the pen before the livestock have even returned.

proverb: Kan dammi lafa jiru, jarjaraan haphee guura
meaning_om: Obsa dhabuun wanta qaalii fi mi'aawaa dhiisanii waan gatii hin qabne akka qabatan nama godha.
meaning_en: Through impatient rushing, one settles for sticky tree sap while real honey lies nearby.

proverb: Jarjaraan, ilmoo hin dhalchu
meaning_om: Dhimmoota bu'uuraa fi gurguddoo ta'an keessatti obsaa fi yeroon murteessaa ta'uu.
meaning_en: Great and natural processes require their due time and patience; haste produces nothing viable.

proverb: Biyya aannaniitti galla jennaan, jaartiin aannan dhangalaafte
meaning_om: Abdii fi waadaa fuulduraatiin dogoggoranii wanta harkaa qaban gatuu ykn mancaasuu.
meaning_en: On hearing rumors of future abundance, the foolish person discarded the actual provisions at hand.

proverb: "Boru ijji siif banamti" jennaan, "edanu akkamittin bula" je'e, ballaan
meaning_om: Namni rakkina hamaa keessa jiru abdii boruu caalaa fala har'aa fi ammaa barbaada.
meaning_en: A person in acute desperation cares about surviving tonight rather than vague promises of tomorrow.

proverb: "Gaafa roobaa dhadhaa si dibna" jennaan, gaafa qacace dhufte
meaning_om: Haala hin guutamneen waadaa qabachuuf ariifachuu fi wanta xiqqoo argatetti fiiguu.
meaning_en: Impatiently rushing to claim a promise at the slightest sign, even when conditions are not yet met.

proverb: Jarjaraan namaa, qaanawu malee hin du'u
meaning_om: Ariifannaan lubbuu baasuu baatus yeroo hundumaa qaanii fi salphina keessa nama buusa.
meaning_en: Reckless haste may not kill you, but it guarantees an endless cycle of public shame and regret.

proverb: Jarjarree "aabboo" jenneeti, "aboo" jechuun nu dhibde
meaning_om: Osoo eenyummaa namaa hin beekin kabaja guddaa kennaniifii booda garuu salphina arguun gaabbuu.
meaning_en: Elevating someone prematurely with excessive respect leaves one awkwardly unable to redress it later.

proverb: Ariifataan hori gata
meaning_om: Namni ariifatee murtoo dabarsu qabeenya isaa dhabuu fi kasaaruuf saaxilama.
meaning_en: Impulsive and hurried decisions cause a person to squander and forfeit their possessions.

proverb: kan ganna bahuu isii hin beekne, wayaan ganna na hin baasu jetti
meaning_om: Lubbuu fi jireenya ofii irratti amantee osoo hin qabaatin wantoota xixiqqoo irratti dhiphachuu.
meaning_en: Uncertain of whether she will survive the winter, she worries about whether her dress will survive it.

proverb: Hatattamaan quufani, jarjaraan deegani
meaning_om: Waan tokko dafanii fixachuun yeroof qofa tola, ariifannaan dheeraa keessatti hiyyummaatti nama geessa.
meaning_en: Rushing through provisions offers only momentary satisfaction, but habitual haste leads straight to poverty.

proverb: "Waan hin beeyne hin beeynu ja'anii, harka maa hudduu irraa na fuutaa" je'e, gurbaan jaartii soddaatiin
meaning_om: Namni gocha safuu cabse hojjechaa osoo jiruu 'waan hin beekneefan godhe' jechuun soba ta'uu.
meaning_en: Feigning innocence or ignorance while deliberately engaging in taboo or shameful transgression is transparent deceit.

proverb: Hantuutni dhaltee dhalteeti, eegeen hafnaan oote
meaning_om: Hojii ykn rakkoo guddaa danda'anii erga xumuranii dhumarratti waan xiqqoodhaan dhibamuu ykn nuffuu.
meaning_en: Having endured through the overwhelming bulk of a trial, crying out in defeat over the final little detail.

proverb: Waan fardaatuu hin beeknuu, kooraan nuun ceceete
meaning_om: Dhimma bu'uuraa hin hubanne keessa seenanii waan dabalataa irratti wal dhiphisuu fi muddamuu.
meaning_en: Knowing nothing about the primary subject, yet getting completely entangled and agitated by secondary matters.

proverb: Garaan waa jibbe diinaa, gaarii jaalateehuu jibbe
meaning_om: Garaan yoo nama ykn waan tokko jibbe, wanti gaariin inni hojjetullee akka hamtuutti mul'ata.
meaning_en: Once the heart turns bitter against something, it becomes prejudiced and rejects even the good in it.

proverb: Namni nama jibbu, nama hin faarsu
meaning_om: Diinni ykn namni jibbansa qabu gonkumaa milkaa'inaa fi gaarummaa kee hin himu.
meaning_en: One who harbors resentment will never speak well of you or acknowledge your achievements.

proverb: Jibbansi soddaa takka, jibbansa goggooyduu
meaning_om: Soddaan yoo wal jibbe wal-saalfannaa fi daangaa dhabee dhimmi isaanii garmalee qallata.
meaning_en: Enmity between in-laws is rigid, bitter, and stripped of all traditional modesty and warmth.

proverb: Haada cite hidhan malee, garaa cite hin hidhani
meaning_om: Wanta meeshaatiin miidhame suphuun ni danda'ama, garuu jaalala fi amantaa cabe deebisuun baay'ee rakkisaadha.
meaning_en: A snapped rope can easily be knotted together, but a deeply broken heart and trust can never be seamlessly mended.

proverb: Namni wal jaalatu, wal jibbuu hin oolu
meaning_om: Walitti dhufeenya jaalalaa keessatti wal mufachiisuun fi wal dhabuun uumama waan ta'eef hin oolu.
meaning_en: Where there is deep affection, occasional friction, misunderstanding, or resentment is inevitable.

proverb: Ilmaan masaanuu, abbu torbatti masaanuu dha
meaning_om: Dorgommiin fi hinaaffaan haadholii gidduu jiru dhaloota irraa dhalootatti ilmaan gidduutti darba.
meaning_en: Rivalry born between co-wives persists as deep-seated competition across generations of their descendants.

proverb: Saree masgiida seente nu hin godhin
meaning_om: Bakka hundi itti nama ari'uu fi jibbutti akka hin qaanofne kadhachuu ykn himachuu.
meaning_en: A plea not to be placed in an utterly despised, unwanted, and relentlessly chased-out position.

proverb: Funyoo udaan seente nu hin godhin
meaning_om: Wanta namni hundi itti dhihaachuu sodaatu, balfuufi gatu akka hin taane dubbatan.
meaning_en: A plea not to become so contaminated and despised that nobody wants to touch or associate with one.

proverb: Eegaan Aamina jibbeen, aammiinii wadaajaa jibbe
meaning_om: Nama tokko jibbuu irraa kan ka'e waan isa fakkaatu ykn isa wajjin wal qabatu hunda jibbuu.
meaning_en: Because of despising one particular person, one develops an aversion to everything associated with them.

proverb: Waan jibbaniin kakatu
meaning_om: Wanta jibban ykn sodaatan akka waadaa fi kakuutti dhiyeessanii of qulqulleessu.
meaning_en: People often swear oaths by the very abominations they dread, to prove their innocence or resolve.

proverb: Nama balfan, irrumaa balaaleeffatan
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu hawaasa keessatti maqaa qabu yoo waan xiqqoo balleesse akka malee itti jabaatama.
meaning_en: When someone is already despised, even their harmless actions or minor errors invite exaggerated condemnation.

proverb: Intala jibban, soddaa hin gabbarani
meaning_om: Wanta jaalala hin qabneef qabeenyaa fi yeroo ofii dabarsee kennuun hin jiru.
meaning_en: If you have no genuine affection for the bride, you do not invest dowry or honor in her family.

proverb: Barbareen mana bulteeti, garaan agabuu bule
meaning_om: Wanti jiru nyaatamuuf hin ta'u ykn nama gargaaruu hin danda'u taanaan qabeenyi sun faayidaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: The pepper was present in the house, but one still went to sleep hungry; useless presence yields no sustenance.

proverb: Diina bishaan fuudhe jannaan, kan quluu itti gadi naqe
meaning_om: Diinni yoo miidhame ykn kufe dabalataan miidhaa irraan gahuuf ariifachuu.
meaning_en: Hearing that one's enemy was drowning, one poured an extra gourd of water to ensure his demise.

proverb: Haadha ilmoo didde wal'aanuun nama hin dhibu, ilmoo haadha didde wal'aanuun nama dhiba
meaning_om: Daa'imni uumama isaatii kaasee haadha jibbee fi didde garaa jabeessa waan ta'eef sirreessuun rakkisaadha.
meaning_en: It is manageable to counsel an estranged mother, but reforming an ungrateful child who spurns their mother is hard.

proverb: Du'a ga'ii nama hamaa, gammachuuf dhaqu
meaning_om: Namni hammeenya baay'ise yeroo du'u hawaasni boochuu mannaa boqonnaa fi gammachuu argata.
meaning_en: When a notorious oppressor or wicked person dies, people attend the funeral not in sorrow, but in collective relief.

proverb: Biddeena warra jibbanii nyaatan, galaniiti haqisan
meaning_om: Wanta nama jibban biraa qaanfachuun ykn dirqamaan fudhatan booda miidhaa fi nuffii qofa uuma.
meaning_en: Food accepted reluctantly from those one hates brings no peace and causes nothing but nausea upon return.

proverb: "Haatee duute" jennaan, "rabbi abaarsa jalaa na baase" je'e
meaning_om: Walitti dhufeenyi maatii garmalee manca'ee gara jibbansa fi boqonnaa barbaaduutti darbuu.
meaning_en: Expressing relief at a parent's demise due to the cessation of relentless bitterness and curses.

proverb: "Waan na godhe anaatu beekaa, karaa awwaala abbaa keetii hin bahin" jette, haati intalaan
meaning_om: Haaloo fi mufannaan gaa'ela keessatti dhalate hanga du'aa boodaattis ilmaan irratti dhiibbaa uumuu.
meaning_en: A mother transmitting her deep-seated marital trauma and grudge against her late husband to her daughter.

proverb: Marqaa tana daakittiis itti hafte, affeellittis itti hafte,
meaning_om: Wanti kamuu seeraan osoo hin xumuramin karaatti dhumee faayidaa dhabe.
meaning_en: This porridge was neither properly ground into flour nor boiled to readiness; a complete botched compromise.

proverb: "Hinaafaan kale du'ee, allaattiin cinaacha isaa haa nyaattu" jette, dubri
meaning_om: Nama dorgomaa fi hinaaffaadhaan nama dhiphisaa ture irratti gammachuu fi abaarsa ibsuu.
meaning_en: Voicing harsh schadenfreude upon the death of an envious persecutor, rejoicing in their complete downfall.

proverb: Akka gaara gamaa, gamana namni hin jiru
meaning_om: Namni of tuulu ykn orma faarsu tokko namoota cinaa isaatti argaman akka homaatti lakkaa'uu dhiisuu.
meaning_en: Fixating admiringly on distant peaks while ignoring or belittling the people right beside oneself.

proverb: Namni, jireenya isaati fakkaata
meaning_om: Haalli jireenyaa, hojiin fi naannoon namni keessa jiraatu bifa, amala fi ilaalcha isaa irratti calaqqisa.
meaning_en: A person's appearance, demeanor, and character reflect the living conditions and livelihood they experience.

proverb: Akkuma itti jiraniitu jiruu dha
meaning_om: Jireenyi akkaataa namni itti fudhate, madaqee fi carraaqetti hiika kan argatu ta'uu.
meaning_en: Life is defined by how one navigates it; adapting to one's reality constitutes living.

proverb: Nama jiruutu, waa arga
meaning_om: Hanga lubbuun jiranitti wanta haaraa, jijjiiramaa fi carraawwan arguun kan danda'amu ta'uu.
meaning_en: So long as one is alive, one witnesses wonders, endures trials, and experiences opportunities.

proverb: Jiruu hin tuffatani, du'an sanuu dhabani
meaning_om: Jireenyi rakkisaa ta'ullee lubbuun jiraachuun wanta hunda caalaa qaalii ta'uu.
meaning_en: Never disdain even the humblest life or struggle, for in death one loses even that.

proverb: Ulfi xiqqaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Dhimmi lubbuu, ulfinnii fi guddinnii kamuu xiqqoo jedhamee kan tuffatamu hin jiru.
meaning_en: Life, honor, and gestation know no minor scale; every beginning carries total weight and dignity.

proverb: Bokkaan jireenya, jireenya hin tuffatan
meaning_om: Roobni madda jireenyaa waan ta'eef eebba uumaa fi jireenya ofii galataan simachuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Rain brings sustenance and life; one should never despise life or the blessed showers that maintain it.

proverb: Caphuu mannaa, deega galuu wayya
meaning_om: Fayyaa fi guutummaa qaamaa dhabuu irra qabeenya dhabanii hiyyooma ta'anii jiraachuu wayya.
meaning_en: It is far better to endure material poverty in one piece than to be physically maimed or destroyed.

proverb: Hanga jiran mandheerani, du'an ni suntuurani
meaning_om: Yeroo lubbuun jiranitti carraawwan jiranitti fayyadamanii socho'uu fi jiraachuu qabu.
meaning_en: While alive, one moves and explores the open world; once dead, one is confined and still in the earth.

proverb: Kan du'e biyye, kan jiru abbaa biyyaati
meaning_om: Namni du'e dacheetti makama, kan dachee fi jireenya bulchu garuu nama lubbuun jiru qofaadha.
meaning_en: The deceased turns to earth, while the living remains the inheritor and master of the land.

proverb: Kan du'e hin deebi'u, kan hafeetu waan jireenyaa hojjata
meaning_om: Nama darbeef garmalee boo'anii jireenya ofii laamshessuu dhiisanii kan jiruuf carraaquu wayya.
meaning_en: The deceased cannot return; those who remain must carry on the responsibilities of living.

proverb: Abbaatu jiruu tuffata malee, jiruun abbaa hin tuffattu
meaning_om: Jireenyi carraa fi madda hojii hundumaaf banaa dha; namatu nuffee ykn dadhabee tuffata malee.
meaning_en: It is the person who spurns livelihoods and opportunities; living itself is always willing to sustain anyone.

proverb: Biyya hoggaa ja'an, kan du'e hin kaafatanii, kan jiru gaafatani
meaning_om: Haala hawaasaa fi biyya tokkoo hubachuuf namoota har'a jiran fi qabatama ammaa ilaaluun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: When seeking news of a land, one inquires about the living, not the buried; current reality takes precedence.

proverb: Du'a dansaa irra, jireenya hamaa wayya
meaning_om: Duuti bareedaan tokkoyyuu hin jiru; rakkoo wajjinillee taatu lubbuun jiraachuun du'a caala.
meaning_en: Even a harsh, impoverished life is preferable to death; life always holds inherent worth.

proverb: Kabajaan sire, arrabni qore
meaning_om: Namoota kabajuun boqonnaa fi nagaa fida, arrabni hamaa garuu madaa fi dhibee uuma.
meaning_en: Respect provides resting comfort like a bed, while a sharp, insolent tongue pricks like a thorn.

proverb: "Abbaa" ja'anii, "aboo"  hin ja'ani
meaning_om: Namaaf kabaja erga kennanii booda kabaja sana dhabsiisanii salphisuun sirrii miti.
meaning_en: Once you have bestowed high respect upon someone, you must not demote them to disrespectful familiarity.

proverb: Furdatan illee, nama hin tuffatani
meaning_om: Qabeenya, aangoo fi humna qabaatanillee namoota hiyyeeyyii fi dadhaboo tuffachuun sirrii miti.
meaning_en: Even if you grow wealthy and influential, you should never look down upon or disdain others.

proverb: Waamicha ulfinaa, ooluun salphina
meaning_om: Yeroo kabajaan nama waaman kabajicha fudhatanii argamuun aadaa fi naamusa gaariidha.
meaning_en: Failing to honor a dignified invitation brings shame upon oneself and insults the host.

proverb: Jiruu fi jaartii soddaa, hin tuffatani
meaning_om: Hojiin jireenyaa fi safeeffannaan soddaa yoomiyyuu kabajamaa ta'uu qaba.
meaning_en: One should never despise honest work, nor should one ever show disrespect to one's mother-in-law.

proverb: Gabaabbattullee, jaartii soddaa hin tuffatani
meaning_om: Dhaabni qaamaa ykn haalli uumamaa akkamillee yoo ta'e ulfinni soddaa hin hir'atu.
meaning_en: Regardless of physical diminutive stature, a mother-in-law's traditional authority and honor remain absolute.

proverb: Hamma fedhe guddatan, gosa ifii hin dabrani
meaning_om: Namni sadarkaa akkamii irra yoo gahellee eenyummaa, gosaa fi fira ofii irra deemuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: No matter how wealthy or powerful one becomes, one can never outgrow or disregard one's clan roots.

proverb: Namni sii taa'u si hin argine, olkaatuus si hin argu
meaning_om: Namni si tuffatee kabaja siif hin qabne haala kamiinuu ulfina siif kennuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: Someone predisposed to ignore or belittle you will never acknowledge your worth, whatever you do.

proverb: Namuu wal sodaateeti bula
meaning_om: Nageenyi fi walii galiin hawaasa keessaa kan argamu yoo hundi wal kabajee fi wal safeeffatedha.
meaning_en: Society survives and prospers because people hold healthy mutual fear, respect, and restraint.

proverb: Nama guddisuun if guddisuu dha, nama xiqqeessuun if xiqqeessuu dha
meaning_om: Namootaaf ulfina kennuun kabajaa ofii kan dabalu yoo ta'u, orma salphisuun of salphisuudha.
meaning_en: Honoring others magnifies your own dignity, while denigrating others only diminishes your own standing.

proverb: Qallatullee, abbuma warraatu dinqa rafa
meaning_om: Namni haala kamiin yoo dadhabeyyuu aangoo fi mirga abbummaa mana ofii keessaa hin dhabu.
meaning_en: Even if physically frail or impoverished, the master of the house retains the rightful inner chamber and authority.

proverb: Abbaan laafullee, hagicha hin taa'u
meaning_om: Abbaan ykn maanguddoon hiyyooma ta'us kabajaa fi teessuma isaaf malu hin dhabu.
meaning_en: Even if an elder or father has grown frail, he is never relegated to a disgraceful or unworthy seat.

proverb: Waaqni , abbaa gadaa dura hin deemu
meaning_om: Seeraa fi heera uumaan qajeelche keessatti hayyuu fi hoogganaan ummataa iddoo olaanaa qaba.
meaning_en: Under the sacred order, the divinely sanctioned leader commands supreme social legitimacy.

proverb: Maqaa ilaaltu hambisi, garaa ilaaltu fixi
meaning_om: Namni maqaa fi safuu ofii eeggatu qusannaa qabaata, kan dantaa garaa qofa hordofu garuu salphata.
meaning_en: If you care about your reputation and dignity, practice restraint; if you care only for your belly, devour it all.

proverb: Niitiin dhiirsa ishii malee kan biraa goota hin seetu
meaning_om: Jaalallii fi kabajni haadha manaa abbaa manaa isiitiif qabdu nama biraa caalchisee akka ilaaltu taasisa.
meaning_en: Out of devotion and respect, a loyal wife perceives her own husband as the greatest of heroes.

proverb: Waamichi tolu, owwaannaan tola
meaning_om: Haalli namatti dubbatan fi waaman yoo tole, deebiin argamus kabajaa fi mi'aawaa ta'a.
meaning_en: When an approach or invitation is polite and respectful, the response received is equally gracious.

proverb: Hamma isiitti, injireen gaafa qabdi
meaning_om: Uumamni xiqqoonis ta'ee namni hiyyeessi hanga humna isaatti kabajaa fi of ittisa mataa isaa qaba.
meaning_en: Even within its minute scale, a louse has its own horns; every being possesses intrinsic dignity and defense.

proverb: Dhagaan gaayyaa, xinnaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Meeshaan ykn namni bakka murteessaa irratti tajaajilu xinnaachus gatii guddaa qaba.
meaning_en: The pipe-stone knows no insignificant size; essential elements are priceless regardless of smallness.

proverb: Bilisa maddi dhawan malee isa hin dhawan
meaning_om: Nama bilisaa fi kabajamaa ta'e salphisuun fi qaamaan tuquun safuu cabsuudha.
meaning_en: A free man's bodily dignity is inviolable; one may gesture near him, but striking him directly breaches honor.

proverb: Namni warra qabu, gosa qaba
meaning_om: Maatii cimaa qabaachuun bu'uura walitti dhufeenya gosaa fi hawaasummaa bal'aati.
meaning_en: One who is grounded in a strong, respected family naturally commands the backing of the wider clan.

proverb: Arrii, azaabnilleen ni sodaata
meaning_om: Maanguddummaa fi arriin bakka hundatti kabajaa fi safeeffannaa olaanaa qaba.
meaning_en: Even the abyss respects gray hair; venerable age commands fear and reverence in every realm.

proverb: Hammaattullee, dubbii jaarsaa hin tuffatan
meaning_om: Gorsi maanguddootaa yoo hadhaayellee dhugaa fi bu'aa guddaa waan qabuuf tuffatamuu hin qabu.
meaning_en: Even if an elder's counsel stings or seems severe, one must never disregard their seasoned wisdom.

proverb: Walillee jibban, wal hin tuffatan
meaning_om: Diinummaan jiraatus namoota jidduutti kabajaa fi safeeffannaan namummaa eegamuu qaba.
meaning_en: Even where animosity exists, basic mutual respect and recognition of human dignity must be maintained.

proverb: Sareen qe'ee ifiitti nama hin nyaattu
meaning_om: Bakka ofiitti keessummaa fi nama dhufe miidhuu dhiisanii safeeffannaa fi aadaa keessummeessuu eeguu.
meaning_en: Even a dog exercises restraint and does not bite visitors within its own home; hospitality obligates forbearance.

proverb: Soddaan sodaa dha
meaning_om: Walitti dhufeenyi maatii soddaa guutummaatti kabajaa, safeeffannaa fi of eeggannoo irratti kan bu'uureffame ta'uu.
meaning_en: In-laws embody solemn reverence and modesty; distance and deep respect are sacred duties.

proverb: Jaarsi du'aaf deemu si hin abaarin
meaning_om: Abaarsi maanguddoo gara dhuma jireenyaa jiru balaa guddaa waan qabuuf isaan mufachiisuu irraa of eeggachuu.
meaning_en: Avoid at all costs provoking the curse of an elder on their deathbed, for their parting words carry immense weight.

proverb: Kabajaa balbalaa, andaaqqoon gadi jetti
meaning_om: Manaa fi hawaasa kamuu keessatti safuu fi kabajaa jiruuf jedhanii gad of deebisuun uumama gaariidha.
meaning_en: Out of instinctive deference to the portal, even the hen bows its head; showing humility before boundaries is virtue.

proverb: Bakka itti dhalattetti, buqqeen dhaga cabsiti
meaning_om: Bakka dhalootaa fi gosa ofii keessatti namni hiyyeessa ykn dadhabaa ta'us humnaa fi kabajaa qaba.
meaning_en: In its native soil where it sprouted, even a fragile gourd can crack a stone; home turf grants innate strength.

proverb: Saree nama jala deemtu, abbaaf dhaban
meaning_om: Nama dhiibbaa qabu ykn kabajamaa ta'eef jedhanii nama isa duukaa bu'uufis obsa fi kabaja agarsiisuu.
meaning_en: One refrains from striking a companion dog solely out of respect for the dignity of its master.

proverb: Wayyaatu soddaa qaba, nama qaanfatuutu kabajaa qaba
meaning_om: Uffannaan safeeffannaa maatii soddaa eega, namni safuu fi qaanii qabus kabajamaa ta'a.
meaning_en: Proper dress maintains sacred modesty before in-laws, and one who preserves moral shame earns enduring respect.

proverb: Mana balbala malee hin seenani, utubaa bakka malee hin dhaabani
meaning_om: Wanti hundi seera, tartiiba fi iddoo mataa isaa qaba; seeraan ala socho'uun badii fida.
meaning_en: Everything has its proper procedure, order, and position; acting disorderly brings failure.

proverb: Mana balbalaan seenani
meaning_om: Dhimma kamuu karaa sirrii, ifa ta'ee fi seera qabeessaan qabachuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: One approaches matters through the proper, direct, and legitimate channel.

proverb: Yoo akkaan ol fuudhan, gaarallee ol fuudhani
meaning_om: Humni, tokkummaan fi carraaqqiin guddaan yoo dabalame wanta ulfaataa ta'ellee raawwachuun ni danda'ama.
meaning_en: With overwhelming collective effort, determination, and unity, even a mountain can be moved.

proverb: Yoo akka malee ol fuudhan, Mixiinuu duuyda nama kutti
meaning_om: Wanta xiqqaa ta'ellee yoo seeraan ala ulfeessan ykn qabatanii garmalee ol kaasan miidhaa fida.
meaning_en: If handled improperly or exaggerated beyond measure, even the smallest burden will break your back.

proverb: Afaan jiru biraa, mallaa hin dhungatani
meaning_om: Wanta dura dhiyaatee fi ijoo ta'e dhiisanii wanta cinaa fi gadi aanaatti goruun sirrii miti.
meaning_en: When the direct and essential option is right in front of you, you do not divert to secondary substitutes.

proverb: Afaan jiru biraa, afaa hin haadhani
meaning_om: Dhimma afaaniin mari'atanii furuun osoo danda'amu waan alaa fi dallaa irratti qorqoruun gatii hin qabu.
meaning_en: While the principal party is available to speak, one does not busy oneself with peripheral trivialities.

proverb: Jinnii akkuma heera isiitti sagadaniif
meaning_om: Nama ykn haala kamuu amala, aadaa fi heera isaatiin dhihaatanii waliin jiraachuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: One deals with different powers or temperaments strictly according to their specific customs and rules.

proverb: Nama gad godhatee nyaatu, ciisaniiti kajeelan
meaning_om: Namni waan qabu dhoksee fi qusatee nyaatu, warra of saaxilanii kajeelaniif hawwii ta'a.
meaning_en: One envies in longing the quiet sustenance that another consumes discreetly and without ostentation.

proverb: Bishaan olii gad yaa'a
meaning_om: Seerri uumamaa fi tartiibni jireenyaa yoomiyyuu qajeeltoo uumamaa hordofee deema.
meaning_en: Water naturally flows downhill; natural hierarchy and the universal order of things cannot be inverted.

proverb: Muka jalaa ol koran malee, gubbaa gad hin koran
meaning_om: Guddinni, beekumsi fi hojiin kamuu bu'uura irraa suuta suutaan gara gubbaatti kan ijaaramuudha.
meaning_en: One ascends a tree from the roots upward, not downward; progress and mastery require sequential steps.

proverb: Qilbaa dhiisanii, waa kiibbati hin salaatani
meaning_om: Kallattii fi qajeeltoo sirrii dhiisanii karaa faallaa fi sobaa hordofuun fudhatama hin qabu.
meaning_en: Abandoning the true direction, one does not pray toward an arbitrary orientation; deviation brings invalidity.

proverb: Sa'a ganni ajjeese, waraabeessi maqaa itti fuudhe
meaning_om: Badii ykn balaa uumamaatiin dhufe tokko namuma duraanuu maqaan isaa badetti laachuun himachuu.
meaning_en: The cow that died from harsh weather is blamed on the hyena; an already notorious party takes the fall.

proverb: Ofii daddabanii, Rabbi hin sakkabani
meaning_om: Hanqinaa fi dadhabina ofiitiin kufee sababa uumuu fi waaqa komachuun sirrii miti.
meaning_en: Failing through one's own laziness or incompetence, one should not blame God or fate.

proverb: Ofii hammaatanii, nama hin hammeeysani
meaning_om: Ofii amala badaa qabaatanii namoota qulqulluu fi gaarii ta'an xureessuun ykn komachuun dhorkaa ta'uu.
meaning_en: Having moral defects oneself, one has no right to slander, corrupt, or blame others.

proverb: Kan Miha(meeshaa) nyaate hantuutaa, raachi garaa guddinaaf duuti
meaning_om: Badii nama biraatiif namni qulqulluun bifa ykn haala uumama isaatiin shakkamee miidhamuu.
meaning_en: The mouse ate the leather, yet the frog gets killed just for having a swollen belly; circumstantial blame.

proverb: "UUF" je'e kan harree dhaanee dhuufe
meaning_om: Badii ofiitiin qaana'uu dhiisanii akka waan namni biraa balleesseetti of mul'isuuf yaaluu.
meaning_en: Making a disgusted sound to deflect attention from a disgraceful blunder that one committed oneself.

proverb: Waraabeysi nyaatu tokkumaa, hunda maqaan bade
meaning_om: Balleessaa namni tokko raawwateen maatiin, gosti ykn gareen guutuun maqaa xuraa'uu.
meaning_en: One hyena scavenges, but the entire pack gets a bad name; collective stigma from individual fault.

proverb: "Ana maqaa balleeysuuf, Harree alatti dhiisani" je'e, waraabeesi
meaning_om: Hattuun ykn namni hammeenya hojjetu sababa uumuun miidhaa ofii fi fedhii ofiif qooda qulqulluu fakkaachuu.
meaning_en: "They left the donkey out just to frame me," said the hyena; the predator rationalizing its crime as victimhood.

proverb: "Aannan banaa dhiisaniiti, hattuu namaan ja'anii" jette, adurreen
meaning_om: Wanta ofii eeggachuu dadhabanii banaa dhiisaniif orma qoruu fi hannaaf saaxilanii komachuu.
meaning_en: "Leaving milk uncovered and then labeling people thieves," said the cat; careless owners invite theft.

proverb: Bakka sareen jirtutti, nama dhuufe hin gaafatan
meaning_om: Bakka wanti salphaatti itti sababeessan jirutti namni badii ofii dhokfatee gara biraatti qajeelchuuf qophaa'a.
meaning_en: In the presence of a dog, no one asks who passed gas; a convenient scapegoat is always blamed.

proverb: Dhiirsi dhuufee, "barana tanuma biyyatti buuse" jennaan "tana sumatti buusee, biyyaaf nagaya buuse," jetteen, niitiin
meaning_om: Badii fi qaanii ofii akka waan dhimma guddaa biyyaatti uumuu fakkeessanii of jajaniif deebii sirrii kennanii salphisuu.
meaning_en: Rebuking a boastful spouse who turns a petty, vulgar personal fault into grand, pretentious rhetoric.

proverb: Walii qaceelaniiti, Rabbi kajeelani
meaning_om: Eebbaa fi araara Waaqayyoo argachuuf dura namoota waliin qajeelummaa fi jaalalaan jiraachuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: One must first deal justly and uprightly with fellow human beings before hoping for God's blessings and favor.

proverb: Kijibaan, nama gobeensa akaafu
meaning_om: Kijibaan wanta bu'aa hin qabnee fi hin nyaatamne odeessuun yeroo ofii fi kan namaa gubaa.
meaning_en: A liar produces nothing of genuine substance, just like roasting inedible, prickly quills.

proverb: Kijibni nama oolcha malee, nama hin bulchu
meaning_om: Sobni yeroo gabaabaaf nama baasu danda'us dheerina keessatti salphina fi balaa fida.
meaning_en: A lie may provide brief, temporary escape, but it cannot offer enduring security.

proverb: Kijibni karaa nama dabarsa malee, galti qoronfilaa dha
meaning_om: Sobdani wanta tokko yoo darbanillee bu'aan dhumaa salphinaa fi miidhaa ta'a.
meaning_en: A lie may get you past a checkpoint, but your return home will be met with thorns and shame.

proverb: Karaa sobaan dabran, gala debiin nama dhiba
meaning_om: Nama sobdanii bira darban gaafa deebitanii arguuf deemtan qaaniin nama dhoowwa.
meaning_en: Deceiving people along the road makes it impossible to face them on your journey back.

proverb: Goda kijibaa, takka malee lama hin bulan
meaning_om: Sobni takkaaf nama gowwomsuu danda'a malee lammata hin hojjetu.
meaning_en: You can deceive someone once with a lie, but you will never succeed in tricking them a second time.

proverb: Sobni hin coomu
meaning_om: Sobni bu'aa qabatamaa, guddina dhugaa fi qabeenya itti fufiinsa qabu hin argamsiisu.
meaning_en: Lies never fatten into true substance; dishonesty yields no lasting prosperity.

proverb: Kunoo arba gama jennaan, jala ilmaan jette
meaning_om: Oduu sobaa fi garmalee guddisame irratti soba dabalataa itti dabalanii odeessuu.
meaning_en: Hearing an already exaggerated tall tale, a bigger liar chimes in with an even more absurd embellishment.

proverb: " Gama xaafii tuman" jennaan "kunoo habaqni isaa ija na bu'e" jette
meaning_om: Oduu sobaa nama biraa fiiganii qabatanii soba biraatiin mirkaneessuuf dhama'uu.
meaning_en: Hearing a rumor of distant threshing, she claimed the flying chaff hit her eye; absurd collusion in lies.

proverb: Kijibaa arbi hin nyaatu, ulateeti bira dabra
meaning_om: Namni sobdun uumama hundaan tuffatamaa fi balfamaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Even an elephant finds a liar too repulsive to touch, merely sniffing and moving past in disgust.

proverb: Namni hiriyaan biraa dhumte, sobuu hin saalfatu
meaning_om: Namni ragaan duraanii jalaa dhabame seenaa fi dubbii jijjiiree of jajuuf sobuu hin sodaatu.
meaning_en: Someone whose generational peers have died lies boldly without shame, knowing no witnesses remain.

proverb: Dubbiin sobaa, dhaga huba
meaning_om: Sobni fi oduun sobaa dhiibbaa fi balaa hamaa waan hunda mancaasu fiduu danda'a.
meaning_en: Malicious falsehood is so corrosive and damaging that it can wear away even solid rock.

proverb: Horiin kijibaa, nama qaanessa
meaning_om: Qabeenyi sobaan, hatuun ykn gowwomsaan argame dhumarratti salphina qofa fida.
meaning_en: Property gained through dishonesty and fraud ultimately exposes the possessor to disgrace.

proverb: Reebuun dharaa ni beeksisa
meaning_om: Wanta sobaa mirkaneessuuf humnaan reebuu fi dhiibuun dhugaan akka ifatti baatu taasisa.
meaning_en: Excessive torture or blustering interrogation reveals that the underlying accusation is baseless.

proverb: Dubbiin dhugaa gaggabaabaa dha, dubbiin soba dhedheeraa dha
meaning_om: Dhugaan ifaafi salphaa yoo taatu, soba uumuuf garuu odeeffannoo fi sababa dheereffachuu barbaada.
meaning_en: Truth is concise and direct, whereas falsehood requires endless explanations and winding words.

proverb: Waraabessi  "mukarraa bu'i si hin tuquu"  jennaan "si hin tuquu kana maaltu fide" jette ,jeedalloon
meaning_om: Waadaa diinaa shakkisiisaa ta'e daddafanii amanuu dhiisuun of eeggannoo gochuu.
meaning_en: Unprompted reassurances of safety from a predator only confirm its underlying malicious intent.

proverb: Sobduu fi galaanni lakkuma bulaniin sablatan
meaning_om: Sobni fi bishaan dhangala'e yeroo booda hir'atee dhugaan qullatti baha.
meaning_en: Just as floodwaters recede with time, a liar's pretensions wither and get completely exposed.

proverb: Kijibaan torba dafqa
meaning_om: Namni sobu soba isaa dhoksuufi mirkaneessuuf dhiphinaa fi naasuu guddaa keessa gala.
meaning_en: A liar breaks into a cold sweat repeatedly, tortured by the constant terror of exposure.

proverb: Kjiibaan sagal kakata
meaning_om: Namni sobdun wanta sobaa amansiisuuf kakuu baay'isa malee dhugaan kakuu hedduu hin barbaadu.
meaning_en: A liar multiplies desperate oaths; an honest person needs no excessive swearing to be believed.

proverb: Namni soba baayyisaa, kakachuu keessa amala isaa beeksisa
meaning_om: Kakuu baay'isuun soba dhoksuuf osoo hin taane eenyummaa sobdummaa ofii calaqqisiisa.
meaning_en: Chronic lying and frantic oath-taking only serve to expose one's untrustworthy character.

proverb: Dhiirsa kijibu haati manaa garaa isii keeysatti taajjabdi
meaning_om: Dhiirsi soba baay'isu haadha manaa isaa duratti kabajaa dhabee garaadhaan tuffatama.
meaning_en: A deceitful husband loses all genuine moral standing; his wife silently measures and pities his dishonesty.

proverb: Dhiirsa kijibu, niitiin lafa laalti
meaning_om: Haati manaa soba dhiirsa isheetiif qaanfattee fuula buustee lafa ilaalti.
meaning_en: When a husband lies, his wife hangs her head in secondhand embarrassment and shame.

proverb: Foon naa kenneeti, ablee na dhoorkate
meaning_om: Wanta tokko kennuuf fedhii akka qaban fakkeessanii garuu itti fayyadama isaa dhorkachuun gowwomsuu.
meaning_en: Offering someone meat while deliberately withholding the knife; giving a useless, obstructed favor.

proverb: Ulfi kuni bokoka
meaning_om: Wanti akka guddaatti odeeffamee fi eegamu dhugaa hin qabne, qilleensa qofa ta'uu.
meaning_en: What was heralded as a grand creation or genuine pregnancy turns out to be hollow swelling.

proverb: Sobni abbaa warraa nama hin godhu
meaning_om: Sobanii fi afaanumaan of jajuun kabaja fi itti-gaafatamummaa dhugaa namaaf hin kennu.
meaning_en: Pretending and spinning falsehoods will never endow a person with genuine maturity and leadership.

proverb: Biya itti hin deebinetti, dhaabbatanii hagan
meaning_om: Bakka ormaa kan deebi'anii hin yaanne yoo ta'e namoonni safuu malee badii raawwatu.
meaning_en: People act without shame or restraint in a land to which they believe they will never return.

proverb: Sunnaan dhiiraa kijiba
meaning_om: Dhiironni fedhii isaanii galmaan gahachuuf soba akka tooftaatti fayyadamuun aadaa ta'uu ibsuuf.
meaning_en: A satirical observation that men frequently resort to fabrications and flattery to achieve their ends.

proverb: Bara lolaa, kijibaatu wal lola
meaning_om: Yeroo waldhabdee fi lolaa odeeffannoon sobaa fi propagaandaan hundarra heddummaata.
meaning_en: In times of conflict, rumors clash against rumors, and propaganda battles propaganda.

proverb: Cubbuun  dura nama furdifti, booda nama qallifti
meaning_om: Badii fi dhugaa dabsuun yeroof bu'aa guddaa qabaatus boodarra kasaaraa fi badii fida.
meaning_en: Injustice and sin enrich a person initially, but ultimately bring devastating ruination and decay.

proverb: Maraatan malee, mara hin bahani
meaning_om: Rakkoo cimaa fi xaxamaa keessaa bahuuf yeroo tokko tokko kutannoo addaa fi tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuun dirqama.
meaning_en: Desperate crises require bold, seemingly irrational resolve; one cannot break a tight bind without daring measures.

proverb: Adurreen garaa muratte, leencaan qixa nama sodaachifti
meaning_om: Namni ykn uumamni dadhabaan yoo garaa kutee fi du'aaf qophaa'e nama kamiinuu sodaachisuu danda'a.
meaning_en: A desperate, cornered cat fights with such fierce abandon that it terrifies as much as a lion.

proverb: Hiyyeessa garaa murate, bishaan raafuutu gabbisa
meaning_om: Namni kutannoo fi quuftummaa qabu wanta xiqqoo argatetti gammadee jireenya isaa milkeessa.
meaning_en: A determined pauper thrives and gains strength even on simple cabbage broth; resolve nourishes the spirit.

proverb: Garaan murtii hin qabne, diina abbaati
meaning_om: Namni murtoo dabarsuu dadhabee fi shakkiin dhiphatu ofumaan of miidha, kasaaraattis gala.
meaning_en: An indecisive, wavering heart is its possessor's worst enemy, leading to paralysis and ruin.

proverb: "Namni namumaa, ija nyaadhu" jette allaattiin
meaning_om: Diinni ykn nama miidhaa barbaadu tokko carraa argannaan bakka laafaa fi murteessaa irratti miidhaa geessa.
meaning_en: "A human is formidable, but go straight for the eyes," said the vulture; strike ruthlessly at the vulnerable spot.

proverb: Kulkatan malee, kulkaa hin bahani
meaning_om: Bu'aa gaarii argachuu fi rakkoo keessaa bahuuf dhiphinaa fi miidhaa yeroo sanaa obsuun dirqama.
meaning_en: Unless you endure the sharp sting of treatment, you will never be cleansed of the throbbing infection.

proverb: Dhiiraan qabsoo qabanii, lafa hin laalani
meaning_om: Dorgommii ykn qormaata cimaa keessa erga seenanii booda sodaatanii ija gadi qabuun hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Having locked horns in wrestling with a formidable opponent, one cannot afford to look down in fear.

proverb: Dhiiraan qabanii ija lafaan hin qaban
meaning_om: Qormaata jabaa wajjin wal qunnamanii of dagachuu fi hamilee dhabuun kufaatiitti geessa.
meaning_en: When grappling with serious stakes, dropping your vigilance or courage guarantees defeat.

proverb: Gara jabeeysa, heexoon hin albaafne
meaning_om: Namni garaa jabaate fi murate dhiibbaa fi qoricha akkamitiyyuu akka laayyootti hin jijjiiramu.
meaning_en: A truly hardened, unyielding person cannot be shaken or purged even by the strongest bitter medicine.

proverb: Deemuun nama hin dhibu, itti deemuutu nama dhiba
meaning_om: Wanta tokko jalqabuun salphaadha, garuu hanga dhumaatti cichanii milkeessuun dhimma ulfaataadha.
meaning_en: Commencing a journey is easy; persevering and seeing it through to the end is the real test.

proverb: Toltu garbu, baddu darbu
meaning_om: Wanta murteessan tokko bu'aa isaas ta'ee miidhaa isaa fudhachuuf garaa murachuu.
meaning_en: Whether it turns out favorably or collapses, one accepts the outcome with resolute stoicism.

proverb: Qabbanooytu harkaa, oowwitu fal'aana
meaning_om: Haala qabatamaa jiru irratti hundaa'uun tooftaa mijataa fi barbaachisaa ta'etti fayyadamuu.
meaning_en: If the food is cool, eat with your hands; if it is piping hot, use a spoon; adapt tools to conditions.

proverb: Dheerattu jalaan, gabaabbattu gubbaan
meaning_om: Gufuu fi haala mudate hundaa akkaataa qabatama isaatiin furuun deemuu.
meaning_en: If an obstacle hangs high, duck beneath it; if it sits low, step over it; adapt smoothly to difficulties.

proverb: Karaa caphxeen haa yaaftuu
meaning_om: Wanta uumamaa ykn murtoo darbe tokko hordofanii dhiisuu, wanta ta'e dhiisanii itti fufuu.
meaning_en: Let the breach flow where it has broken; let events run their irreversible course without futile resistance.

proverb: Qeeyransa eegee hin qabanii, qaban gad hin dhiisan
meaning_om: Hojii ykn qabsoo balaa qabu osoo hin beekin seenuu hin qaban, erga seenanii garuu cichuu malee karaan hin jiru.
meaning_en: Never rashly seize a leopard by its tail, but once you do, letting go is fatal; you must see it through.

proverb: Du'a qurxama wayyaa, dubbii qurxii wayya
meaning_om: Duutii fi dubbiin dheeratee nama dhiphisuu mannaa hatattamaan murtii qulqulluu argachuu wayya.
meaning_en: Better a swift, clean death than agonizing lingering; better a crisp, decisive settlement than dragging disputes.

proverb: "Maaltu oola jettanii ibidda na dhoorkitan" jette maraattuun
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu balaa fi badiif qophaa'e wanta miidhaa fidu tokko dhoowwuun hiika dhabuu.
meaning_en: "What are you hoping to save by withholding fire from me?" said the madwoman; total recklessness unleashed.

proverb: Namni hannaa murate, kakuu murate
meaning_om: Namni gocha seeraan alaa fi badii guddaa raawwachuuf ka'e kakuu fi safuu cabsuuf hin qussatu.
meaning_en: Someone who has made up their mind to steal will have no qualms about swearing false oaths.

proverb: Morkiidhaaf haaduu liqimsu
meaning_om: Dorgommii fi morkii dantaa hin qabneef jedhanii balaa lubbuu galaafatu keessa of galchuu.
meaning_en: For the mere vanity of spiteful competition, one recklessly swallows a deadly blade.

proverb: Intala dhabnu haadhaan galla
meaning_om: Wanta yaadan yoo dhabanis ta'e hamilee fi kabaja ofii eeggachuun galuun nidanda'ama.
meaning_en: Even if we fail to secure the bride, we return home holding our heads high with pride in having made the bid.

proverb: Murti guuto calanqo dhaqa
meaning_om: Wanta tokkoof murtoo guutuu fi kutannoo cimaa godhanii dirree qabsootti seenuu.
meaning_en: Having made a steadfast, total resolve, one marches straight into the historic battleground of Calanqo.

proverb: Ciiq jettuu , ciriq jettuu, bakka isii waa hin hanqattu
meaning_om: Namoonni mormanii fi iyyaniyyuu wanti murtaa'e fi uumamaan dhufuuf jiru hin hafu.
meaning_en: Complain and squawk as they might, nothing will stop destiny and rightful order from taking their place.

proverb: Baasaan Musxafaa, qawween bishaani
meaning_om: Yeroo qabsoo fi balaa keessatti meeshaan abdachiisaan yoo nama harkatti hojii dhabe mudannoo cimaadha.
meaning_en: Mustafa's tragic predicament: facing battle with a gun disabled by water; weapon failure at the critical hour.

proverb: Takka  lolan, hin koflani
meaning_om: Dhimma jabaa fi qabsoo keessatti taphaa fi qishnaan iddoo hin qabu; xiyyeeffannaa fi kutannoon barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: In the middle of war, there is no place for frivolous laughter; gravity and fierce focus are demanded.

proverb: Ijji dhugaan booche, imimmaan hin dhabdu
meaning_om: Miirri fi gaddi garaa irraa dhufe mallattoo qabatamaa fi dhugaa ta'een mul'ata.
meaning_en: An eye weeping in genuine sorrow never runs dry of real tears; authenticity is naturally evident.

proverb: Jabduu jajjabduun ,dhiirsa hin dadhabdu
meaning_om: Dubartiin ogummaa, ciminaa fi hubannaa qabdu maatii fi abbaa manaa ishee seeraan geggeessiti.
meaning_en: A truly strong, competent, and wise woman never finds herself helpless in guiding her husband.

proverb: Rakkataan ija hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni rakkinni hamaa isa mudate qaanii fi saalfannaa dhiisee gargaarsa barbaada.
meaning_en: A desperate, destitute person has no room for shame or modesty; survival strips away embarrassment.

proverb: Kormi ceehu,barooduu hin haleelu
meaning_om: Namni hojii fi tattaaffii keessa jiru dubbii fi of jajuu baay'isuu dhiisee hojii irratti xiyyeeffata.
meaning_en: A bull leaping into action does not waste time roaring; real doers focus on the deed rather than noisy bluster.

proverb: Adeemaan sarbaa luleeti, koomee gad taa'uu dhoorke
meaning_om: Namni jabaatee socho'u fi imalu milkaa'ina fi beekumsa guddaa argachuun teessuma nuffa.
meaning_en: An active traveler builds hardy legs and keeps his heels from sinking into idle sitting; restless drive brings vigor.

proverb: Namni waa hunda kajeelu, takkallee hin argatu
meaning_om: Dharraan fi sassattiin garmalee waan hunda qabachuuf nama dhiphisu dhumarratti harka duwwaa nama hambisa.
meaning_en: One who greedily covets everything ends up with nothing; excessive greed leads to total loss.

proverb: Kan lama arihu, tokkollee hin qabu
meaning_om: Wanta lama yeroodhaa tokkotti argachuuf fiiguun xiyyeeffannoo dhabsiisee lamaanuu nama dhabsiisa.
meaning_en: Chasing two targets simultaneously divides focus and ensures you capture neither.

proverb: Haashaan (goromsi) korma lama hente(qaadhimte) rimaya hin fuutu
meaning_om: Murtii tokko irratti cichuu dhabanii fedhii lama gidduutti oliif gadi jechuun bu'aa dhabeessa nama godha.
meaning_en: A heifer that wavers between two bulls never conceives; indecision and divided loyalty yield no fruit.

proverb: Hudduun takka, farda lama irra hin teessu
meaning_om: Namni tokko yeroma tokkotti bakka lama ta'uu ykn hojiiwwan wal faallessan lama raawwachuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: One cannot ride two horses at the same time; divided commitments are physically impossible.

proverb: Bololaa tan afaanii ni huutii, tan harkaa duraa buuti
meaning_om: Sassattuun dharraa garmaleetiin wanta qabu nyaachuufi qabachuu dhabee lamaaninuu miidhama.
meaning_en: In greedy haste, the mouthful chokes the glutton while the morsel in the hand falls to the ground.

proverb: Tan lafaatiin fuudhatti, tan ukaa buute
meaning_om: Wanta dabalataa argachuuf jedhanii kan of harkaa qaban qisaasessuu ykn dhabuu.
meaning_en: Bending down to grab something extra from the ground, the precious item tucked in one's bosom dropped.

proverb: Tan fannootiin fuudhatti, tan bobaa darbite
meaning_om: Wanta fagootti laalanii hawwan qaqqabuuf jedhanii wanta dhiyoo fi eeggatan dhabuu.
meaning_en: Stretching upward to reach what hung high, she dropped what was held securely under her arm.

proverb: Gowwaan dubra morma lamaatti duraa duubaan sirba
meaning_om: Namni hubannaa dhabe carraawwan lama jidduutti daddafamee qisaasama malee tokkollee hin milkeeffatu.
meaning_en: A fool dances indecisively between two maidens, pleasing neither and exhausting himself.

proverb: Biyya abbaa kootii jetteeti, injirreen moluurratti hafte
meaning_om: Bakka mijataa hin taanee fi dhabama ta'etti sababa qabachuun cichanii miidhamuu.
meaning_en: Claiming ancestral entitlement, the louse clung to the bald head only to starve and be crushed.

proverb: Namni lama qabate, tokkollee hin argatu
meaning_om: Dantaa fi hojii lama yeroodhaan wal bira qabuun dhumarratti kasaaraa qofa fida.
meaning_en: One who attempts to clutch two things at once ends up grasping nothing at all.

proverb: Harree lafa lamaa dheeddu, waraabeessi jiddutti nyaata
meaning_om: Bakka lamaan faayidaa barbaacha deddeebi'uun balaaf saaxilamuu fi dhumarratti baduu fida.
meaning_en: The donkey that splits its grazing between two distant pastures gets devoured by the hyena in between.

proverb: Waa lama dhabuun abaabuu dhabu
meaning_om: Filannoo lamaan keessaa tokkoyyuu osoo hin argatin harka duwwaa hafuun gadda guddaadha.
meaning_en: Failing on both fronts leaves one completely stripped of bloom, promise, and seed.

proverb: Bara hammaatte, qocaatu nama nyaata
meaning_om: Gaafa barri fi carraan nama irratti jijjiirame uumamni dadhabaaniis nama salphisa.
meaning_en: When times turn cruel and adverse, even a harmless tortoise turns to bite; misfortune emboldens the meek.

proverb: Leenci dulloome, booke funaana
meaning_om: Namni gootaa fi dandeettii guddaa qabu yeroo dadhabu wantoota xixiqqoo fi salphaa irratti rarra'a.
meaning_en: An aged, enfeebled lion gathers mosquitoes; diminished prowess reduces the mighty to trivial pursuits.

proverb: Leenca dulloome, daaraan haran
meaning_om: Gootni ykn mootiin yeroo humna dhabu tuffatamee akka xuraawaatti ilaalamuu danda'a.
meaning_en: An aged lion gets swept aside with ashes; loss of strength invites utter disrespect and contempt.

proverb: Intala lafa deemtu, wayyaaleetu qalbisa
meaning_om: Namni yeroo deemsaa fi hawaasa keessa deemu uffannaa fi qulqullina isaatiin kabajama.
meaning_en: A traveler or young woman on the road commands respect through her modest and tidy attire.

proverb: Tiitichi mana buleeti, kanniisni ala bule
meaning_om: Namni gatii hin qabnee fi xuraawaan qananii keessa taa'ee, inni damma oomishe rakkachuun loogii ta'uu.
meaning_en: The nuisance fly stays pampered inside, while the productive honeybee is left outside; unfair injustice.

proverb: Bara sareen gabbatte, aayyoon saree hanqatte
meaning_om: Yeroo barri jal'ate wanti gatii hin qabne qanani'ee, namoonni kabajamoon garuu rakkinaaf saaxilamu.
meaning_en: In a corrupted era when the dog thrives, the venerable mother starves; complete moral inversion.

proverb: Gaafa rakkoo, gaangeen abbaa hin ba'attu
meaning_om: Wanti ykn namni yeroo hundumaa abdannu yeroo rakkina cimaa nama ganuu danda'a.
meaning_en: In the fateful hour of crisis, the mule balks and throws its master; treacherous unreliability.

proverb: Bara barri nama qabe, joollee fi baalaatu nama qaba
meaning_om: Yeroo rakkinnii fi carraan badaa nama mudatu wanti xiqqoon hunduu nama dhibuu fi nama saaxiluu danda'a.
meaning_en: In the season when calamity strikes, even children and falling leaves become burdens that overwhelm you.

proverb: Beekaan dulloome, qaama ifiitiin haasawa
meaning_om: Dullooma hamaa keessatti beekumsi fi dandeettiin hir'atee gara ofii qofatti dubbachuutti akka jijjiiramu.
meaning_en: A once-great sage who reaches extreme senility ends up muttering and conversing with his own limbs.

proverb: Leenca rakkoon goda osolee neyxe, osoleen wallaalaaf matarratti fincaanti
meaning_om: Gootni yeroo rakkoon dadhabee gad of qabu, dadhaboonni hubannaa dhabuudhaan isa salphisuuf yaalu.
meaning_en: A lion driven by dire straits to a hare's burrow; the foolish hare, failing to recognize majesty, urinates on his head.

proverb: Leenca dulloome, weessoo ittiin raasan
meaning_om: Goota duraan sodaatamaa ture yeroo inni dulloomu akka meeshaa laayyootti itti fayyadamuun salphisuu.
meaning_en: An aged, toothless lion is treated like an idle churning stick; the fallen mighty made into domestic objects.

proverb: Leenca dulloome, ijoolleen iyya seeti
meaning_om: Humnaa fi kabajaa dhabuun goota duraanii dhaloota haaraa biratti akka nama dadhabaatti ilaalamuu fida.
meaning_en: When an aged lion roars, ignorant children mistake the thunder for mere crying; lost authority.

proverb: Leenca dulloome, adurreetu ija arraaba
meaning_om: Goota duraan sodaatamaa ture namni dadhabaan duraan sodaatu ija dura dhaabbatee salphisa.
meaning_en: An aged lion suffers having its very eyes licked by a common cat; the ultimate reduction in stature.

proverb: Leenca dulloome, titichaa itti taphata
meaning_om: Namni duraan ulfinaa fi humna qabu erga dadhabee booda wanti xiqqoon hunduu isa tuffatti.
meaning_en: Upon an aged, helpless lion, even flies swarm and play; total loss of protective deterrence.

proverb: Ija darratte, tiitichaa itti gama
meaning_om: Bakka laafaa, madaa ykn qormaata namatti dhufe irratti rakkoowwan dabalataa fi wantoonni badaa walitti qabamu.
meaning_en: Toward an already afflicted, suppurating eye, flies naturally swarm; troubles compound on the vulnerable.

proverb: Namni aanaa muyoo, haluu hin baafatu
meaning_om: Firoottan ykn deeggartoota dadhaboo qabaachuun haqa ofii kabachiisuu fi diina ofirraa ittisuu dhabsiisa.
meaning_en: One whose primary kin is a spineless coward cannot hope to extract vengeance or defend family honor.

proverb: Akka durii seetee garaa jala na hin dhawin jette intalti
meaning_om: Haalli jijjiiramuu isaa hubachuu dhabanii akka yeroo duraaniitti nama salphisuuf yaaluu dhoorkuu.
meaning_en: "Do not strike me beneath the belly assuming I am still as vulnerable as before," said the girl; times have changed.

proverb: Hiyyeessa mastiin miite, gaalaatu gobeelle seenaan
meaning_om: Rakkina hamaa keessa osoo jiranii balaan hin eegamne kan biraa itti dabalamee mana jilbeenfachiisuu.
meaning_en: While the pauper suffered the agony of intoxication and debt, a rogue camel barged into his fragile grass hut.

proverb: Abbaa ooyruu, jaldeessi keessaa baafate
meaning_om: Ormi ykn diinni dhufee abbaa qabeenyaa fi abbaa biyyaa irratti aangoomee qe'ee isaarraa ari'uu.
meaning_en: The baboon drove the farmer out of his own field; the brazen intruder usurping the rightful master.

proverb: Mari'ataan gowwaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Mariidhaan wanta hundumaa kan qajeelchan yoo ta'e gowwummaan fi dogoggorri bakka hin qabu.
meaning_en: Those who seek counsel and consult together harbor no fools; collective wisdom protects everyone.

proverb: Ni oriinaa dura garam oriinaatu dura
meaning_om: Hojii fi sochii ariifannaa dura galmaa fi kallattii sirriitti mari'atanii beekuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Before sprinting off, one must first decide where to run; purpose and strategy precede haste.

proverb: Maraatanii biyya hin bulchani, mari'atanii malee
meaning_om: Biyya fi hawaasa geggeessuuf aariin fi garmalee oofuun osoo hin taane marii fi heeraan ta'uu qaba.
meaning_en: A nation is never governed by reckless rage or madness, but through patient, democratic consultation.

proverb: Warri marii qabu Arba hidheeti, warri marii hin qabne tafkii qabuu daadhabe
meaning_om: Marii fi waliigalteedhaan wanta guddaa fi ulfaataa danda'u, marii dhabuun garuu waan salphaattillee gufachiisa.
meaning_en: A united family acting with counsel tethered an elephant, while a discordant family failed to catch a flea.

proverb: Warri marii qabu dibicha (sangaa) gurgureeti, warrii marii hin qabne raada gurgure
meaning_om: Warri mari'atu qabeenya bu'aa fidu qusatee kan biraa gurgura, kan marii hin qabne madda dhalaati balleessa.
meaning_en: A family that consults sells an ox for cash, while an uncoordinated family sells the reproductive heifer.

proverb: Namni akkam taana je'ee wal gaafate, akka tahu  hin dhabu
meaning_om: Namoonni waliin mari'atanii yaada wal jijjiiran furmaata dhabanii hin rakkatan.
meaning_en: Those who gather to ask "How shall we proceed?" will never lack an effective path or solution.

proverb: Dhuufuun marii qabdu hin ajooytu
meaning_om: Gochi ykn murtoon duraan irratti mari'atamee fi beekame yoo rakkoo qabaatelluu mufannaa hin uumu.
meaning_en: Even an unpleasant blunder does not cause offense if it was agreed upon or disclosed beforehand.

proverb: Garaan "cirachaan nyaadha"  jennaan, ilkeen "eenyuun marihatte" jetteen
meaning_om: Qaamni ykn namni tokko fedhii ofiitiif qofa ka'ee yoo murteesse, inni itti fayyadamu mormuun seera.
meaning_en: When the belly declared "I will feast on gravel," the teeth demanded "Whom did you consult to chew it?"

proverb: Kadhatanii niitii fuudhanii, kadhattee warra isii dheeyxi
meaning_om: Gaa'elli fi aadaan heera, safeeffannaa fi wal-dhaggeeffachuu irratti kan ijaaramedha.
meaning_en: Begged for in marriage through humble petition, the wife in turn petitions for leave to visit her kin.

proverb: Waliif galan malee, alaa hin galan
meaning_om: Namoonni waliin jiran yoo marii fi waliigaltee qabaatan qofa nagaan manatti deebi'uu danda'u.
meaning_en: Unless travelers agree in harmony among themselves, they can never make a successful return home.

proverb: Maqaan baduu mannaa, mataan badu wayya
meaning_om: Kabajaa fi maqaa gaarii ofii dhabanii salphachuu irra lubbuun darbuu wayya.
meaning_en: Better that the physical head perish in honor than that one's name and dignity be ruined in disgrace.

proverb: Maqaa ni bitan malee, hin gurgurani
meaning_om: Maqaan gaariin hojii gaarii fi arjummaan kan ijaaramu malee qarshiidhaan kan gurguramu miti.
meaning_en: A noble name is painstakingly earned and cherished; it is never auctioned away for petty material gain.

proverb: Mataa tikfatani, maqaa hin dagatani
meaning_om: Lubbuu ofii eeggachaa maqaa fi naamusas cinaatti dagachuun hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Even while taking measures to protect one's physical life, one must never lose sight of honor and reputation.

proverb: Barri hamaan ni dabra, maqaa hamaan hin dabru
meaning_om: Rakkinnii fi beelli yeroof dhufanii darbu, badii fi salphinni maqaa irratti hafe garuu hin dhabamu.
meaning_en: A harsh season or drought eventually passes, but an infamous, tarnished name endures forever.

proverb: Gurri nama du'uu mannaa lubbuun du'uu wayya
meaning_om: Salphinaa fi maqaa badiin jiraachuu irra kabajaan du'uutu caala.
meaning_en: Better that physical breath expire than that one's good name and public standing suffer mortal death.

proverb: Itti qalaniiti duutee fi osoo itti hin qalin duuteen walirraa jala
meaning_om: Haalli wanta tokko raawwatan, seera hordofanii xumuruun fi seera malee kufuun garaagarummaa guddaa qaba.
meaning_en: Dying having been properly consecrated and slaughtered differs vast worlds from dying as unhallowed carrion.

proverb: Maqaa hamaa, abbaatu ifirraa eega
meaning_om: Maqaa fi kabajaa ofii eeggachuun dhimma nama biraa osoo hin taane itti-gaafatamummaa nama mataa isaati.
meaning_en: A person's reputation is their own solemn responsibility; only you can protect your own name from stain.

proverb: Baale hin baduu, gurra hin badin
meaning_om: Faayaa fi kabajaa ofii eeggachuun, keessattuu maqaa gaarii qabaachuun wanta hundarra dursuu qaba.
meaning_en: Guard your plume of honor; above all, never let your good name and renown be tarnished.

proverb: Abaar ni bahaa, maqaa hamaan hin bahu
meaning_om: Beellii fi dheebun yeroon darbee nyaata argataniyyuu maqaan baduu garuu seenaa keessatti hafa.
meaning_en: A season of famine eventually ends, but an evil reputation remains indelibly stamped upon history.

proverb: Barri hin darbaa gurri hin darbuu, hin hatinii hin sobinii nyaattuus garbuu
meaning_om: Hiyyummaa fi rakkina keessatti sobaa fi hanna irraa of qusatanii wantuma jiruun qulqullummaan jiraachuu wayya.
meaning_en: The hard year will pass, but your name endures; do not steal or lie, even if you subsist on raw barley.

proverb: Waywaanni kan du'a nama hin oolchine, abaabuu nama yakka
meaning_om: Wanta hin oolleef garmalee iyyanii fi dhiphatanii of miidhuun furmaata osoo hin taane miidhaa dabalataati.
meaning_en: Frantic lamentation that cannot prevent destined death only exhausts and disfigures one's vital beauty.

proverb: Ganama rafuun, tokkicha deegaati nama dhoorka
meaning_om: Ganama bariidhaan ka'anii hojjechuu dhiisanii rafuun gara hiyyummaa fi deegumsa daangaa hin qabneetti nama geessa.
meaning_en: Sleeping late into the morning yields nothing but a direct ticket to extreme poverty and ruin.

proverb: Hirriibni, duumessa hiyyummaati
meaning_om: Hirriibni garmalee baay'atu akkuma duumessi rooba fidu hiyyummaa fi dhabinsa nama irratti fida.
meaning_en: Excessive sleep is the dark cloud that heralds poverty; sloth precedes economic destitution.

proverb: Akka dhabduun, afaan malee afaa hin qabdu
meaning_om: Namni hojii hin hojjenne afaaniin nama loluu fi dhaadachuu qofa beeka malee mana isaatti wanti jiru hin jiru.
meaning_en: The shiftless, impoverished person possesses plenty of mouth, but lacks even a sleeping mat.

proverb: "Bishaan lagaa dhume" jennaan, boosattiin "ilil"  jette
meaning_om: Namni dhibaa'aan hojii mana keessaa fi bishaan waraabuu jibbu sababa hojii dhiisuu ittiin argateef gammada.
meaning_en: Hearing that the river dried up, the lazy woman rejoiced; the sluggard celebrates excuses to avoid work.

proverb: Mana boosoo, utubaan waddeetsa
meaning_om: Meeshaan ykn manni wanta gaarii qabaatus qulqullinaa fi kunuunsa dhabuudhaan faayidaa fi bifa dhabuu.
meaning_en: Even if a lazy person's house has fine wooden pillars, complete neglect leaves it unsightly.

proverb: Deeraan naa taateeti, dhandhaarraan narra guddate jette booso
meaning_om: Dhibaa'aan wanta hundaaf sababa dhiheessa; rakkoo ofii danda'ee qulqulleessuu mannaa komii uuma.
meaning_en: "The crawl-space suited me, but the soot defeated me," said the sluggard; making endless excuses for filth.

proverb: Ala boon dhihanni shuumoo dha
meaning_om: Alatti of tuuluun fi akka waan sooromaatti of mul'isuun mana keessatti garuu rakkina beelaa dhandhamuu.
meaning_en: Putting on arrogant airs in public while subsisting on mere boiled grain at home; hollow pride.

proverb: If dadhabduun, udaan dhuufutti fixxi
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii fi kutannoo hin qabne hojii qabatamaa dhiisee sochiilee bu'aa dhabeeyyiin yeroo guba.
meaning_en: The utterly incompetent person wastes energy on noisy, fruitless efforts instead of achieving results.

proverb: Hemelaal ganda teeysii, qooshaan dhagarra teeysi
meaning_om: Hojii mana ofii dagatanii ganda keessa nanna'uun oduu funaanuu fi mana ofii boosoomsuu.
meaning_en: Gossiping idly through the village while her empty cooking pot gathers dust upon the cold hearth.

proverb: Gandaan martuu, sareen qoosharra teeysi
meaning_om: Bakka manaa dhiisanii ganda irratti garagaluun qabeenyi ofii xuraawuu fi manca'uu isaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: While the homemaker gossips through the village, stray dogs climb and sit upon her bread pans.

proverb: Boosattiin kajeellaaf mana namaatti tiratti
meaning_om: Hojjatanii nyaachuu dhiisanii mana ormaatti kajeeluu fi hirkattummaadhaan jiraachuuf yaaluu.
meaning_en: The shiftless woman drags herself to neighbors' homes, coveting a handout rather than cooking.

proverb: Haati masluufaa ,qanqalloo bobaa  kaayyateeti, uuda teeysee callaa kadhatti
meaning_om: Dhibaa'ummaan fi qisaasamni maatii dhumarratti maatii guutuu gara kadhaattii fi salphinatti geessa.
meaning_en: The shiftless wastrel's mother tucks a sack under her arm to sit at others' threshing floors begging.

proverb: Muudee warra gaaraa, osoo hin miiccine daara
meaning_om: Qulqullina eeggachuu dhiisanii wantuma qaban xuraawaa taasisanii uffachuu fi itti dhibaa'uu.
meaning_en: The finery of backward folks is worn day in and day out without ever being washed; unwashed squalor.

proverb: Qoree dur dirteef, hiyyeessi hokkola
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi ykn dadhabaan madaa fi dhibee durii yaalii dhabuun yeroo dheeraa ittiin dhiphachaa jiraata.
meaning_en: For a thorn that pricked him long ago, the poor man still limps; poverty leaves minor injuries untreated.

proverb: Gaalii kan bishaanii du'eeti, kan qoraanii gala
meaning_om: Hojii fi iddoo balaan irraa hin eegamnetti namni dhabamuu danda'a, carraan namaa kan hin beekamne ta'uu.
meaning_en: The camel sent to the water-source dies, while the one sent for firewood returns; unpredictable fate.

proverb: Hadaamiin ollaa hagamsaa immimmaan hin qoorfattu
meaning_om: Nama hamaa fi qoreessaa wajjin walitti dhufeenya qabaachuun yeroo hundumaa madaa fi boo'icha fida.
meaning_en: The euphorbia neighboring the thorny carissa shrub never dries its weeping sap; living beside toxicity brings sorrow.

proverb: Aayyadaan(haati biddeenaa) aduu ganamaati
meaning_om: Aduun ganamaa yeroof kan ho'istu fakkaattus boodarra gara qorrisiisaatti akka jijjiiramu, haati biddeenaas garaa dhugaa hin qabdu.
meaning_en: A stepmother is like the early morning sun; seemingly gentle and warm at first, but harsh and deceptive beneath.

proverb: Aduu ganamaatii fi aayyadaan osoo hin bekne nama miiti
meaning_om: Miidhaan isaanii suuta suutaan kan dhufu waan ta'eef osoo of hin barin nama hubu.
meaning_en: Both the morning sun and a stepmother inflict harm insidiously, damaging you before you even notice.

proverb: Tiifuu fi aayyadaan, malaan nama miiti
meaning_om: Tiifuun suuta jiistee akka nama qorrisiiftu, haati biddeenaas tooftaa dhokataan daa'ima miiti.
meaning_en: Drizzle and a stepmother erode one by stealth; gentle drops soak through just as covert spite wounds deep.

proverb: Joolleef taphaa, billaachaaf lubbu
meaning_om: Wanti namoota humna qabaniif taphaa fi bashannana ta'e namoota dadhaboof balaa lubbuuti.
meaning_en: What is careless play for the children is a matter of life and death for the butterfly.

proverb: Adurree taphaa, hantuutaa lubbu
meaning_om: Dhiibbaa fi gidiraan abbaa humnaatiin akka taphaatti raawwatamu miidhamaadhaaf dhimma du'aa fi jireenyaati.
meaning_en: What is a game of cat-and-mouse to the predator is a fight for sheer survival to the prey.

proverb: Sangaa ofiinuu alba'u eegee qabdee raaftaa?
meaning_om: Rakkoo duraanuu dhangala'ee fi manca'aa jiru keessa harka naqanii qisaasama itti dabaluu.
meaning_en: Would you grab the tail and shake an ox that already has diarrhea? Rashly aggravating a messy disaster.

proverb: Bakakkaan titiifuu keessa hammaata
meaning_om: Wanta salphaa fi nagaa fakkaatu keessaa balaan guddaan fi hin eegamne dhohuu danda'a.
meaning_en: Lightning strikes most destructively from within deceptive, gentle drizzle; quiet waters conceal fierce peril.

proverb: Abbaa dhiiraa cittooyte jennaan bubu'e je'e
meaning_om: Badii fi dhibee qaamaa ofii kabajaan ibsuu yaaluun salphina dhoksuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: When told "Sir hero, you have scabies," he replied, "I have merely exfoliated"; dressing a flaw in grand words.

proverb: Rabbi balbala foonii tan adurreen keessaan nyaattu, tan waraabeysi alaan nyaatu nu hin godhin
meaning_om: Miidhaa karaa lamaanuu namatti dhufu irraa, diina keessaa fi diina alaa jidduutti saamamuurraa Rabbiin akka nama baraaru kadhachuu.
meaning_en: May God not make us a door of meat devoured by the domestic cat from within and the savage hyena from without.

proverb: Willee fi dhakaa wal daaku, kan jidduu jiruutu miidhama
meaning_om: Humnoonni gurguddoon lama yoo wal lolu ykn wal morkatan, namni hiyyeessi fi dadhabaan jidduu jiru miidhama.
meaning_en: When two heavy millstones grind against each other, whatever lies caught between them gets crushed to powder.

proverb: Qaaceelchaan Rabbuma
meaning_om: Namni karaa qajeelaa qabsiisuu fi jireenya namaa sirreessu Waaqayyo qofa ta'uu.
meaning_en: True guidance, righteousness, and direction come from God alone; human effort without divine favor fails.

proverb: Dubbiin Rabbii suuta
meaning_om: Murtii fi adabbiin Waaqayyoo yeroo isaatti suuta dhufa malee hin hafu.
meaning_en: God's justice and providence unfold patiently and deliberately; divine timing never rushes nor fails.

proverb: Namni kadhachuu hin dhiisu Rabbi waan murate hin dhiisu
meaning_om: Namni abdii fi kadhannaa godha, garuu dhumarratti fedhii fi murtiin Waaqayyoo qofti raawwatama.
meaning_en: Man never ceases praying, while God never wavers from His decree; human prayer meets sovereign will.

proverb: Rabbi duubaa lafti hin baaftu
meaning_om: Eebbaa fi hayyama Waaqayyoo malee carraaqqiin lafaa fi qonnaan bu'aa hin argamsiisu.
meaning_en: Without the will and blessing of God, the earth will yield no harvest; all bounty stems from grace.

proverb: Amrii Rabbi duubaa baalli mukaa hin buune
meaning_om: Uumama guutuu keessatti fedha fi beekumsa Waaqayyoo malee wanti xiqqoon tokkollee hin raawwatamu.
meaning_en: Not a single leaf falls from a tree without God's command; absolute divine omniscience and control.

proverb: Nama Rabbiin itti jiru, dhagaatu oloo jala borora
meaning_om: Namni eebba fi eegumsa Waaqayyoo qabu balaa fi rakkina keessaa haala nama dhibuun nagaan baha.
meaning_en: For the one whom God favors, even a sharp stone slides smoothly under them; divine favor eases all friction.

proverb: Nama Rabbiin itti jiru, hantuutaa qara qottoo duraa nyaata
meaning_om: Eebbi Waaqayyoo namaaf yoo ta'e, wanti balaa guddaa qabu illee bu'aa fi nagaa namaaf ta'a.
meaning_en: For the one blessed by God, even a mouse feeds safely right at the edge of the axe; peril turns harmless.

proverb: Namni Rabbiin itti jiru, tan garaa qabdu fuudha
meaning_om: Namni eebbi Waaqaa isa qaqqabe carraa fi bu'aa saffisaa ta'e kan hin eegamne argata.
meaning_en: The man favored by God marries a woman already expecting; gaining an instant family through luck.

proverb: Kan Rabbiin baasa itti fide, abjuudhaan dibaa guura
meaning_om: Namni carraan isaa badee fi adabbiin itti dhufe abjuu sobaatiin of gowwoomsaa kasaaratti deema.
meaning_en: One marked for misfortune by fate gathers imaginary wealth in dreams while hurtling toward ruin.

proverb: Jiga Rabbii, ol qabanii hin dandayan
meaning_om: Namni ykn motummaan Waaqayyo kuffise humna namaatiin ol qabamuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: That which God has brought to ruin, no human effort can ever lift or prop back up.

proverb: Bakka Rabbi itti nama hidhe, funyoo male jaajju
meaning_om: Murtiin Waaqayyoo yoo nama qabate hidhaa malee bakka sanatti hafuu fi murtoo fudhachuun dirqama.
meaning_en: Where God confines a person, they remain immobilized and bound even without a physical rope.

proverb: Warra Rabbi buqqaase, buqqe guurratan
meaning_om: Maatiin ykn namni Waaqayyo qabeenyaa fi kabajaa isaa irraa buqqise wanta xiqqoo qabatee rakkata.
meaning_en: A household uprooted by divine misfortune is reduced to scrounging for hollow gourds and scraps.

proverb: Sagaleen waaqayyoo, akka dhagaa daakuuti
meaning_om: Sagalee fi seerri Waaqayyoo suuta jedhee garuu hundumaa daakee qulqulleessa.
meaning_en: The voice and justice of God are like a grinding mill; slow, heavy, relentless, and all-crushing.

proverb: Kan Rabbi guute, hin jigu
meaning_om: Wanta Waaqayyo ijaare, eebbisee fi guute namni kamiyyuu diiguu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: That which God has filled and sustained will never topple; divine protection is invulnerable.

proverb: Tan Rabbi faale, hin hootu
meaning_om: Wanta Waaqayyo abaaree fi eebba irraa dhoowwate faayidaa fi eebba hin qabaatu.
meaning_en: The udder that God has cursed yields no milk; that which is divinely unfavored will never bear fruit.

proverb: Manni waaqni ijaare, hin jigu
meaning_om: Maatiin, jireenyi fi hawaasni heera uumaatiin ijaarame yoomiyyuu diigamuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: The house founded and erected by God will never fall; divine foundations endure all storms.

proverb: Tan Rabbi guuse, hin hootu
meaning_om: Wanta Waaqayyo madda isaa cufe ykn dhoowwate namni humnaan bu'aa irraa argachuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: The udder dried up by God cannot be suckled; when divine providence closes a source, effort cannot force it.

proverb: Manni Rabbi ijaare, akka dhagaga daakuti
meaning_om: Wanti bu'uurri isaa eebba Waaqaatiin dhaabbate cimaa fi kan hin jijjiiramne ta'uu.
meaning_en: The house established by God is as solid and unyielding as a grinding mill; indestructible foundation.

proverb: Nama waaqi ijaare, hin jigu
meaning_om: Namni gargaarsaa fi eebba Waaqayyootiin bakka ga'e diina kamiinuu kuffifamuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A person uplifted and sustained by God will never fall; no human conspiracy can topple divine favor.

proverb: Nama Rabbi fayyaa kenneef namni itti hin gababsu
meaning_om: Umurii fi fayyaa Waaqayyo namaaf kenne namni kamiyyuu mulqachuu ykn hir'isuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: The life and health that God has decreed for a person cannot be cut short by any human being.

proverb: Afaan, waaqaa fi duumessaan nyaata
meaning_om: Sustenance fi nyaanni namaa kamuu rooba uumaan roobsuu fi eebba Waaqaatiin kan dhufuudha.
meaning_en: The human mouth depends directly upon God and rain clouds for food; all nourishment is heaven-sent.

proverb: Kennaan Rabbii shakamii hin qabdu
meaning_om: Wanti Waaqayyo namaaf kenne qulqulluu, guutuu fi kan shakkii hin qabneedha.
meaning_en: What God bestows is beyond doubt and question; divine gifts are whole, unblemished, and certain.

proverb: Shukukkul nama hin urgeeysuu, xiifa dibaan gooytaa dha
meaning_om: Yaaliin namaa fi faayileen alaa nama hin qulqulleessu; kabajaa fi urgooftuun dhugaa kan Waaqaati.
meaning_en: Rubbing oneself with dry shrubs brings no true fragrance; true sweet anointing and dignity come from God.

proverb: Kan waaqayyoo namatti fidu, bakakka jala mataa qabatu
meaning_om: Murtii fi balaa Waaqayyo namatti fide jalaa baqachuun waan hin danda'amneef obsaan jilbeenfachuu.
meaning_en: Against that which God brings upon you, you can only bow and cover your head under lightning; submit to fate.

proverb: Ba'aa Rabbi namarra kaaye, namni namarraa hin buusu
meaning_om: Qormaata fi itti-gaafatamummaa Waaqayyo namaaf kenne namni tokkollee dhoowwuu ykn kaasuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: The burden or trial that God has assigned to a person cannot be lifted by any mortal hand.

proverb: "Bagaan kufee, bagaan ka'e, kan na qabuu fi kan na dhabu addaan hubadhe" je'e, namichi
meaning_om: Kufaatii fi rakkina keessatti fira dhugaa fi diina gowwoomsaa adda baasanii beekuun bu'aa guddaadha.
meaning_en: Adversity serves as a crucible to distinguish true supporters from deceitful, fair-weather associates.

proverb: "Bagaan kufee, bagaan ka'e, kan billawaan natti kaatuu fi kan margaan natti kaatuus nan arge"  jette, dullattiin sa'aa
meaning_om: Rakkina keessatti namoota warra si gargaaruuf fiiganii fi warra si dhabamsiisuuf fiigan beekuu.
meaning_en: "Glad I stumbled and rose, for I saw who brought fodder and who brought the slaughter-knife," said the cow.

proverb: Akka duraa agarree, akka boodaa ni eegganna
meaning_om: Muuxannoo fi seenaa darbe irraa ka'uun wanta fuulduratti dhufu of eeggannoodhaan tilmaamuu.
meaning_en: Having witnessed how past events unfolded, we watch with seasoned anticipation to see how the future turns out.

proverb: Namni kan dabre hin yaadanne, kan dhufu hin yaadu
meaning_om: Seenaa fi muuxannoo darbe irraa kan hin baranne egeree isaatiif karoora sirrii baafachuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: Whoever fails to remember and learn from the past is incapable of planning wisely for the future.

proverb: Lubbuun du'aa turte, waa heddu agarte
meaning_om: Namni balaa fi qormaata jireenyaa hedduu keessa darbe muuxannoo fi beekumsa gadi fagoo qabaata.
meaning_en: A person who has repeatedly brushed against death and severe hardship gains profound wisdom.

proverb: Kan kitaabni gorse caalaa, kan rakkoon gorsiteetu waa beeka
meaning_om: Barnoota waraqaa irraa caalaa qabatamni jireenyaa fi qormaanni nama barsiisu baay'ee cimaadha.
meaning_en: More than one schooled by books, the one tutored by lived hardship and adversity possesses genuine insight.

proverb: Miila arri moo mata arri wayya jennaan, miila arri wayya je'e
meaning_om: Teessumaan beekaa ta'uu irra biyya deemanii arguun fi muuxannoo qabatamaa horachuun caala.
meaning_en: When asked whether wisdom lies in an old head or well-traveled feet, he chose the traveling feet.

proverb: Nama dulloomee, waa hima
meaning_om: Maanguddoon umurii fi seenaa dheeraa waan dabarseef gorsaa fi oduu bu'aa qabu qaba.
meaning_en: An elder who has lived through long eras naturally serves as a fountain of stories and wisdom.

proverb: Gaggaba dhiiraa, hin qabuu, yeroo sagaliin heerumee jette gursummaan
meaning_om: Afaaniin fedhii dhabuu dubbachaa gochaan garuu deddeebisanii wantuma sana raawwachuu.
meaning_en: "I have no infatuation for men, yet I married nine times," said the divorcée; actions mocking words.

proverb: Waa argan malee hin dulloomani
meaning_om: Dulloomni dandeettii fi beekumsa wantoota hedduu arganii hubachuu wajjin kan dhufuudha.
meaning_en: One does not attain old age without having witnessed countless events; age is the accumulation of experience.

proverb: Soddaa fi hudduu itti dhihaatan malee maalummaa hin beekani
meaning_om: Wanta tokko fagootti laaluun osoo hin taane yoo itti dhihaatanii fi waliin jiraatan qofa amala isaa beekuun danda'ama.
meaning_en: Like in-laws, you can never truly fathom someone's inner character until you enter close proximity.

proverb: Booroytu malee hin xaliilooytu
meaning_om: Wanti kamuu qulqulluu fi tasgabbaa'aa ta'uun dura qormaata, jeequmsaa fi dhiphina keessa darbuun dirqama.
meaning_en: Water must churn turbid before it settles crystal clear; turmoil precedes clarity and breakthrough.
