proverb: Gubattee hin agarree ibidatti gamti
meaning_om: Namni balaa fi miidhaa duraan dhandhamee hin beekne of eeggannoo malee balaatti seena.
meaning_en: Having never experienced burns, one heedlessly rushes toward the flames; naivety invites danger.

proverb: Hantuunni boolaa qotuu haadha jalaa barti
meaning_om: Daa'imman amala, hojii fi dandeettii jireenyaa maatii fi haadha ofii irraa akka baratan agarsiisa.
meaning_en: The young mouse learns burrow-digging from its mother; essential survival skills are modeled at home.

proverb: Raaddi harree jala ooltu dhuufu barti
meaning_om: Namni hiriyaa badaa fi amala dhabeessa wajjin oolu amala isaanii isa xuraawaa dhaala.
meaning_en: A heifer that spends its days grazing alongside donkeys learns only to fart; bad company corrupts.

proverb: Jabbiin haada nyaachuu wal irraa barti
meaning_om: Badii, dhoowwaa cabsuu fi gocha seeraan alaa namoonni wal irraa laalanii daddafanii baru.
meaning_en: Calves learn to chew through their tether from one another; destructive mischief spreads by imitation.

proverb: Namni waan sodaatu hin qabne, mataan isaatuu sodaa dha
meaning_om: Namni safuu, seeraa fi Waaqayyo hin sodaanne ofumaa isaatiiyyuu balaa fi diina hawaasaati.
meaning_en: A person who fears nothing is a terror in himself; one lacking moral restraint poses danger to all.

proverb: Adurree, saree fi dubartii adabaan guddisan
meaning_om: Dhaabbilee fi miseensota maatii naamusaa fi sirna aadaatiin qajeelchuun barbaachisaa ta'uu.
meaning_en: Domestic companions and family members require steady discipline, manners, and customary guidance.

proverb: Dubraa fi jiboota, garaa goggoga leenjisan
meaning_om: Ijoollee fi beelladoota umurii ijoollummaa fi qananii malee leenjisuun bu'a qabeessa ta'a.
meaning_en: Maidens and young bulls are trained when young and austere; discipline is instilled before comfort spoils.

proverb: Mucaan hin dhaanne, yoo itti dheekkaman booya
meaning_om: Daa'imni ijoollummaatti adaba fi qajeelcha hin argatin waan xiqqoodhaan naha, hamilee dhabeessa ta'a.
meaning_en: A pampered child who was never corrected with discipline breaks into tears at the mildest rebuke.

proverb: Uleen, okkotee qofa cabsa
meaning_om: Humni fi adabbiin qaama laafaa fi dadhabaa irratti qofa hojjeta malee jabaa hin jijjiiru.
meaning_en: The rod breaks only the fragile clay pot; physical violence shatters the brittle without curing the deep flaw.

proverb: Uleen, buqqee qofaaf hin tolle
meaning_om: Adabbiin fi qajeelchi nama tokko qofaaf osoo hin taane hundaafuu barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: The rod is not crafted for the gourd alone; discipline and accountability apply universally.

proverb: Mootii karaa deemaa, adabaa namaan deema
meaning_om: Mootiiniis ta'ee abbaan aangoo kabajaa fi adaba hawaasaa eegee yoo deeme qofa nagaan jiraata.
meaning_en: Even a king traveling abroad must journey with courtesy and respect toward ordinary people.

proverb: Naamusni birille, eeggatan malee ni capha
meaning_om: Naamusni fi amalli gaariin akkuma meeshaa birilleetti salphaatti kan badu waan ta'eef of eeggannoo guddaa barbaada.
meaning_en: Character and integrity are like fine crystal; fragile and easily shattered unless carefully guarded.

proverb: Garaa fi ijoolleen hin dhagoomamani
meaning_om: Beelli fi daa'imman wanta nyaatamu yeroodhaan yoo hin arganne obsa hin qaban, mariin hin deebisan.
meaning_en: Neither the belly nor young children can be put off with persuasive excuses; hunger demands real food.

proverb: Adaba dhaba, sareen magaalaa dhayxi
meaning_om: Namni naamusaa fi daangaa ofii hin beekne bakka isaaf hin malle deemee salphinaaf saaxilama.
meaning_en: Lacking domestic discipline, the stray dog roams into the crowded marketplace and gets beaten.

proverb: Oduun, soora gurraati
meaning_om: Gurri oduu fi odeeffannoo dhagahuu akka uumamaatti kan jaalatu fi ittiin sooramu ta'uu.
meaning_en: News and stories are food for the ears; human nature is innately hungry for information and tales.

proverb: Asii baatee, biyyaa hunda deemti
meaning_om: Oduun ykn afaan namni tokko buuse saffisaan fagaatee bakka hundatti faca'a.
meaning_en: Originating right here, a rumor travels to every distant land; news travels with lightning speed.

proverb: Gurraa fi garaan walii diina
meaning_om: Gurri oduu fi haasawa dhagahuu jaalata, garaan garuu nyaata qofa barbaada; oduun beela hin baasu.
meaning_en: The ear and the stomach are mutually hostile; listening to tales feeds the ears but starves the belly.

proverb: Gabaan (magaalaan) hin argin farso qabdi
meaning_om: Bakka hin geenye fi hin beekne garmalee faarsuun fi akka waan wanti hundi guutuu ta'etti hawwuun amala namaati.
meaning_en: The distant, unseen market is always imagined to sell the finest beer; distant grass seems greener.

proverb: Maqaan guyyaa magaalaa bade, guyyaa magaalaati deebi'a
meaning_om: Salphinni fi odeeffannoon sobaa bakka heddumminaatti faca'e bakka sanattiyyuu ifatti qulqullaa'uu qaba.
meaning_en: A reputation tarnished on market day must be cleared on market day; public slander demands public redress.

proverb: Waan odeessanii fi waan bobeessan hin dhabani
meaning_om: Namoonni haasawaaf yoo ta'e oduu fi qoraan bobeessan yoomiyyuu sababa hin dhaban.
meaning_en: One never lacks fuel to kindle a hearth, nor gossip to fuel an idle tongue; talk is ever-abundant.

proverb: Lubbu dheeraa'rra, miila dheeraa dubbii gaafadhaa
meaning_om: Nama umuriin dheerate caalaa namni biyya arge fi imale oduu fi haala qabatamaa beeka.
meaning_en: Rather than consulting the long-lived, inquire of the long-traveled; mobility teaches current realities.

proverb: Dhiirti gurraan rimayooyteeti, afaaniin dhalti
meaning_om: Namoonni oduu gurraan dhagahanii qabatanii battaluma sana afaaniin nama hundatti odeessanii facaasu.
meaning_en: Men impregnate their minds with what they hear and give birth to it through their mouths; rumors spread fast.

proverb: Bira hin jirreen, gaafa bira jiraniif hin tolle
meaning_om: Nama bakka hin jirretti hamachuun gaafa inni dhufe wal qunnamtii fi nagaa balleessa.
meaning_en: Slandering someone in their absence ruins the relationship and poisons the air when they are present.

proverb: Gurri, bishaan isa seenu qofa jibba
meaning_om: Gurri oduu kamuu—gaariis ta'ee hamaa—dhaggeeffachuuf banaa dha; wanta isa miidhu qofa dhoowwa.
meaning_en: The ear rejects only water pouring into it; otherwise it eagerly absorbs all manner of gossip and tales.

proverb: Sa'idoon faltii nyaateen, labsuma Rabbiiti
meaning_om: Oduun salphinaa fi maqa-balleessii nama irratti faca'e balaa cimaa uumaan fide fakkaata.
meaning_en: The shocking rumor that Sa'ido ate dung strikes like a cruel divine decree; scandalous news destroys.

proverb: Jaartiin Baalee, harkaan buna akoofti,afaaniin waan baraa qaaqxi
meaning_om: Hojii ofii hojjechaa oduu fi dhimma biyyaa odeessuun amala namoota hedduu ta'uu.
meaning_en: The old woman of Bale roasts coffee with her hands while ceaselessly babbling about current affairs.

proverb: "Waan argani dhagayan" jette, harreen
meaning_om: Oduu nama biraa amanuu mannaa wanta ijaan argan irratti xiyyeeffachuun mirkanaa'aadha.
meaning_en: "One heeds only what one witnesses firsthand," said the donkey; prioritize direct sight over hearsay.

proverb: Ilma duuti ankoobarrii, haati gaafa dhageesse boochi
meaning_om: Gaddi fi dhiphinni kan namatti dhufu yeroo oduun nama qaqqabeedha malee gaafa ta'ee miti.
meaning_en: For the son who perished in distant Ankober, his mother mourns on the day the news reaches her; grief awaits word.

proverb: Waan biyya biyyaa, bilbillii iyya
meaning_om: Dhimmi fi oduun biyya hundaa karaa adda addaatiin mul'atee ifatti baha.
meaning_en: Concerning the affairs of every land, the alarm bell tolls; every region's news eventually sounds aloud.

proverb: Qaban qabaa hin guuttu, gadi dhiisan lafa guutti
meaning_om: Dubbii ykn oduun afaan keessatti xiqqoodha, garuu yoo baaftee dubbatte biyya guutuu qaqqabdi.
meaning_en: Cupped in secret it does not fill a palm; once released into speech it floods the entire land; words' reach.

proverb: Bira hin jirreen, nama yarsiti
meaning_om: Bakka dhimmi ofii irratti mari'atamu ykn falmatamutti argamuu dhabuun haqa ofii akka dhaban godha.
meaning_en: Being absent causes one to be belittled and cheated; absence forfeits representation and voice.

proverb: Dhagaan darban dhihoo bu'eeti, gurri darban fagoo bu'e
meaning_om: Dhagaan fagootti darbatamuu baatus, dubbiin fi maqaan garuu dachee guutuu qaqqaba.
meaning_en: A stone hurled falls close by, but a word or rumor cast travels vast distances.

proverb: Duulli hamma oduu hin gahu
meaning_om: Oduun lolaa fi waraanaa yeroo baay'ee garmalee guddisama malee qabatamni isaa sanaan wal hin gahu.
meaning_en: The actual battle never matches the terrifying scale of the rumors; reports are always exaggerated.

proverb: Harka abbaa qabuun, buutii qabachuu hin sodaatani
meaning_om: Qaama ykn qabeenya nama biraatiin balaa keessa seenuuf namoonni hin qussatan; miidhaan kan nama biraati.
meaning_en: One does not hesitate to grab a viper using someone else's hand; people recklessly risk others' lives.

proverb: Hudduun abbaa tokkoo, muka itti dhiiban hin laalattu
meaning_om: Miidhaan nama biraa irra gahu nama ofittotti akka homaattuu hin mul'atu; quuqama dhabuu.
meaning_en: The hindquarters belonging to someone else don't bother the callous spectator; total lack of empathy.

proverb: Harka nama biraatiin, ibidda qabachuu hin sodaatani
meaning_om: Miidhaan nama biraa irratti kan qaqqabu yoo ta'e namoonni balaa fi qormaata jabaa raawwachiisuuf hin sodaatan.
meaning_en: Using another person's hand, one does not fear grasping fire; using others as disposable pawns.

proverb: Madaa nama biroo, mukaan diruun nama hin dhibu
meaning_om: Dhukkubbiin fi gaddi nama biraa abbaa irra gahe qofaaf ulfaata malee warri kaan akka laayyootti laalu.
meaning_en: Poking another's wound with a stick causes you no pain; it is easy to be callous about unfelt pain.

proverb: Ani mataa kootiin ba'eeraa, kan ilmaa fi intalaa hin beeku jedhe abbaan warraa
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan cimaan dhufu ofittummaan garmalee dhufee maatii ofiillee dagachiisuu danda'a.
meaning_en: "I have escaped with my own skin; I care not for son or daughter," said the householder; raw survival.

proverb: Harki waa namaa hiru dhedheeraa dha
meaning_om: Arjummaan fi qoodiinsi gaariin kabajaa fi jaalala bal'aa namoota biratti namaaf kenna.
meaning_en: The hand that shares and dispenses with others reaches far; generosity extends one's reach and renown.

proverb: Harki waan ofii nyaattu waay jetti, tan waan namaa nyaattu haay jetti
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya ofii yeroo baasu ni qusata fi ni mararfata, kan nama biraa garuu daangaa malee qisaasessa.
meaning_en: The hand that spends its own groans in grief, but when devouring another's resources it shouts in glee.

proverb: Ani gallaan, gabaan wal haa loltu
meaning_om: Dantaa fi nageenyi ofii yoo eegame wanti orma irra gahu kan nama hin dhibne ta'uu.
meaning_en: "Once I am safely home, let war break out in the market"; total apathy toward collective well-being.

proverb: Duudaa ifii abbaatu afaan beeka
meaning_om: Hanqinaa, amalaa fi haala nama ofii warra dhiyootti jiran qofatu sirriitti hubachuu danda'a.
meaning_en: As for one's own mute child, only the parent understands the signs; intimate defects are best known to kin.

proverb: Hamaa ifii abbaatu beeka
meaning_om: Hanqina, balleessaa fi amala badaa of keessa jiru namni hunda caalaa ofumaan beeka.
meaning_en: One's own secret wickedness and deepest flaws are best known to oneself; conscience knows the truth.

proverb: Giingee, warra horeetu beeka
meaning_om: Amala fi rakkoo nama tokkoo warra waliin guddatee fi waliin ture qofatu sirriitti danda'a.
meaning_en: A stammerer is understood best by the household that reared him; intimate habits require familiar patience.

proverb: Sa'a mucha gabaabbatu, abbaatu akka itti elman beeka
meaning_om: Wanta ykn nama amala rakkisaa qabu tooftaa ittiin qabatan abbaa dhimmaatu danda'a.
meaning_en: A cow with short teats is known only to its owner how to milk; handling tricky assets takes insider skill.

proverb: Quuqaa cinaacha jalaa, abbaatu beeka
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi gadda gadi fagoo garaa keessa jiru abbaa irra gahe qofatu dhandhama.
meaning_en: The sharp ache tucked beneath the ribs is known only to the sufferer; inner torment is invisible outside.

proverb: Ollaan bulte beekaa akka itti bule abbaatu beeka
meaning_om: Hawaasni jireenya kee gubbaa qofa arga malee dhiphinaa fi rakkina keessa dabarte abbaatu beeka.
meaning_en: Neighbors only know that you survived the night; the agony of how you endured it is known to you alone.

proverb: Ibiddi abbaa irra bu'e guba
meaning_om: Balaan, gaddi fi miidhaan dhiyeenyaan kan miidhu abbuma qabeenyi ykn lubbuun irraa miidhamedha.
meaning_en: Fire only burns the one upon whom the embers land; direct catastrophe hurts the victim, not bystanders.

proverb: Namni akka ifii beeku, alaa ol hin lallabu
meaning_om: Namni hubannaa fi eenyummaa ofii beeku of tuulummaa fi afaan bal'isuu dhiisee tasgabbaa'a.
meaning_en: One who accurately knows his own limitations does not brag loudly from the threshold.

proverb: Namni bakkuma nyanyaatte hooqqata
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu rakkina isa quunnamee fi bakka isa dhukkubu qofa irratti furmaata barbaada.
meaning_en: A person scratches right where it itches; one focuses directly where the pain or immediate problem lies.

proverb: Kan abbaa caalaa beeku budawwaa fi qoricha
meaning_om: Dhimma ofii irratti nama biraatu na caalaa beeka jechuun soba; abbaatu wanta ofii hunda caalaa beeka.
meaning_en: Only an evil eye or medicine claims to know a person's insides better than the person themselves.

proverb: Namni waan qabu hin beekne, waan dhabu hin beeku
meaning_om: Qabeenyaa fi eebba ofii hin beekne yoo dhabes dhabamuu isaa hin hubatu; qisaasamaa ta'uu.
meaning_en: One who fails to appreciate what they possess will never understand the magnitude of what they lose.

proverb: Qoreen, abbuma keeysa jirtu quuyxi
meaning_om: Dhukkubbii fi dhiphina madaa ofii abbauma keessa jiru qofatu dhugaan beeka.
meaning_en: The thorn pains only the one whose flesh it pierces; inner anguish is known directly only by the sufferer.

proverb: Harki jallatuus, afaan hin wallaalu
meaning_om: Namni akkamiyyuu yoo dadhabaa ta'e dantaa fi faayidaa ofiitiif qajeelfamuu hin dadhabu.
meaning_en: Even if the arm is twisted and crooked, it never forgets the way to the mouth; self-interest is instinctive.

proverb: Gaggabanillee if hin wallalani
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi jeequmsa hamaa keessatti illee namni eenyummaa fi dantaa ofii guutummaatti hin dagatu.
meaning_en: Even in the throes of a fainting swoon, one does not forget self-preservation; self-awareness endures.

proverb: Dhuundhuma ifii abbaatu dhawata
meaning_om: Hamma dandeettii, humnaa fi daangaa ofii hunda caalaa nama mataa isaatu beeka.
meaning_en: One measures one's own forearm; every person knows their own reach, capacity, and limits best.

proverb: "Bakka koo hin wallaalu" jette harreen daaraa keessa gangalattee
meaning_om: Namni eenyummaa, sadarkaa fi naannoo isaaf malu beeku bakka isaatti gammada.
meaning_en: "I know my proper place," said the donkey rolling in the ashes; accepting one's humble station contentedly.

proverb: Kan namni namaan jedhu irra kan abbaan ofiin jedhuutu caala
meaning_om: Oduu fi ilaalcha ormaa caalaa dhugaan eenyummaa ofii isa namni keessaan of beekudha.
meaning_en: What you truly know of yourself within matters far more than what others say or speculate about you.

proverb: Magaallee anuu hin arguu, diimtuu anuu hin barbaadu
meaning_om: Wanta argamuuf hin dandeenye hawwaa kan jiru garuu tuffachuu; madaallii dhabuu fi fedhii wal dhibe.
meaning_en: "The brunette I cannot find, and the fair one I do not desire"; paralyzed by impossible standards and pride.

proverb: Daddaaloo ganda keeysaa eenyuutu fuudhuu na dhoorka
meaning_om: Wanta sadarkaa ofiitiin wal gitu ykn salphaa ta'e filachuu irratti ormi mormuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: "Who can prevent me from wedding the village simpleton?"; settling comfortably for humble choices.

proverb: Gowwaa qurxamaa mitii, beekaa qurxaa sii mitii, ol ka'u niin daddaaqaa, dubbadhuus walittiin laaqaa, na dhiisaa je'e jaarsi
meaning_om: Dadhabinaa fi hanqina ofii beekanii gad of deebisuun wal falmii fi itti-gaafatamummaa humnaa olii dheessuu.
meaning_en: "Neither a pure fool nor a sage, I stumble when rising and ramble speaking; let me be," said the elder.

proverb: Lubbuun tun illimaa, yoo kajeelte cooma qicadhu qirima
meaning_om: Jireenyi gabaabaa fi lubbuun yeroo hundaa kan hin jiraanne waan ta'eef yeroo carraa qabanitti qananiin jiraachuu.
meaning_en: This life is a fragile snare; when the soul craves, carve the rich fat and feast; enjoy life while it lasts.

proverb: Hantuutni, hamma isiiti, ciiftee hoosifti
meaning_om: Uumamni kamuu hanga dandeettii fi humna isaatti itti gaafatamummaa maatii isaa guuttata.
meaning_en: A mouse, within her humble proportion, lies down to nurse her young; every creature fulfills its duty to scale.

proverb: Gaalli, muka dhaqqabu raaba
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu wanta dandeettii, humnaa fi carraan isaa hayyame qofa irratti hojjechuu qaba.
meaning_en: The camel feeds on the tree branch it can reach; one acts within the natural bounds of one's reach.

proverb: Re'een, muka dhaqqbdu dheeddi
meaning_om: Uumamni ykn namni hundi hanga carraa fi dandeettii isaatiin jiraata.
meaning_en: The goat grazes the leaves it can reach; everyone subsists according to their realistic possibilities.

proverb: Kuruphoon, hamma ifiit dorrobdi
meaning_om: Wanti hundi hamma, uumamaa fi dandeettii mataa isaa hordofee bu'aa argamsiisa.
meaning_en: The small duiker carries offspring proportionate to her size; all endeavors must align with natural capacity.

proverb: Teeyriin, hamma nyaatu haga
meaning_om: Bu'aan ykn baasiin kamuu wantuma galii fi soora ta'ee seeneen wal madaala.
meaning_en: A bird excretes in direct proportion to what it consumes; output always reflects input.

proverb: Akkuma caphanitti hokkolani
meaning_om: Haala rakkoo fi miidhaa nama mudatee irratti hundaa'uun jireenya ofii madaqsanii deemuu.
meaning_en: One limps in accordance with how one was broken; adapt your gait and pace to your specific handicap.

proverb: Tuujiin hamma seenanitti garba
meaning_om: Wanti tokko osoo keessa hin seenin fagootti sodaachisaa fi ulfaataa fakkaatus yoo itti dhihaatan salphaadha.
meaning_en: A stream seems as deep as an ocean until you step into it; perceived terrors shrink once confronted.

proverb: Horiin akkuma beekutti walii gadooda
meaning_om: Namoonni aadaa, beekumsaa fi haala walii hubataniin qofa nagaan waliigaluu danda'u.
meaning_en: Cattle low to each other in their accustomed, familiar tongue; mutual understanding fosters harmony.

proverb: Namni harree hin qabne, farda hin arrabsu
meaning_om: Wanta xiqqaa of harkaa hin qabne wanta qaalii fi guddaa ta'e tuffachuu fi arrabsuun safuu miti.
meaning_en: One who lacks even a lowly donkey does not belittle a noble horse; know your station before criticizing.

proverb: Warqeen namaa nama hin boonsu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi, milkaa'innii fi faayilli nama biraa ofiif kabaja dhugaa hin fidu; namni qabeenya fi dandeettii mataa isaatiin qofa boona
meaning_en: Another person's gold brings you no true pride; flaunting borrowed luxury or relying on the wealth of others does not elevate your own personal worth

proverb: Hudduu ambaatiin hin hagani
meaning_om: Dhimma, itti-gaafatamummaa fi ba'aa dhuunfaa ofii nama biraatiin ba'achuun hin danda'amu; hojii ofii abbaatu hojjetata
meaning_en: One cannot defecate using someone else's body; you cannot delegate your fundamental personal bodily needs, moral duties, or debts to someone else

proverb: Hudduu ifii, huqqattuuni taa'ani
meaning_om: Qabeenyi, maatiin fi iddoon ofii hangamiyyuu hiyyeessa yoo ta'e, sanumaan tasgabbaa'anii jiraachuun orma dharra'uurra caala; waan qabanitti quufuu
meaning_en: One sits upon one's own buttocks, lean and bony though they may be; make your stand upon your own modest resources rather than relying on another

proverb: Qalbiin ergisaa fi midhaan bitii hin barakatani
meaning_om: Yaada ormaatiin jiraachuunii fi wanta bitamu qofatti hirkachuun yeroo dheeraaf nama hin gahu; beekumsa fi qabeenya ofii qabaachuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Borrowed wits and purchased grain never yield lasting abundance; copying another's thoughts and living hand-to-mouth on bought food provide no true prosperity

proverb: Hangam safii guutu, biddeenni namaa kanuma namaati
meaning_om: Nyaanni yookaan qabeenyi ormaa hangamiyyuu baay'ee yoo ta'e, kan ofii hin ta'u; wanta ormaatti amanamuu dhiisanii kan ofii horachuu qabu
meaning_en: However high it heaps the serving tray, another person's bread is still another person's bread; wealth belonging to someone else will never be your own

proverb: Bultii ifii, abbaatu itti yaada
meaning_om: Jireenya, maatii fi bultii ofiitiif kan dursa yaaduu fi itti gaafatamummaa baachuu qabu abbuma sanaadha malee ormi dhimma kee hin bulchu
meaning_en: Over one's own marriage and livelihood, it is the owner who must ponder; no neighbor or outsider will take thoughtful responsibility for your home's future

proverb: Uffanni abbaa tokkoo, daara nama hin baasu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi nama tokkoo qofti nama lamaaf hin gahu; hiyyummaa keessaa bahuuf hundi isaaniiyyuu hojjetanii of danda'uu qabu
meaning_en: One person's garment cannot clothe two from nakedness; a single breadwinner's resources cannot fully sustain multiple idle dependents; all must labor

proverb: Namni mataa isaatii hin tolle, namaaf hin tolu
meaning_om: Namni jireenya, amala fi qe'ee ofii sirreessuu dadhabe nama biraatiifis bu'aa tokkollee hin fidu; of tolchuutu orma tolchuu dursaa
meaning_en: A person who cannot do good for his own self will never do good for anyone else; someone who mismanages their own life cannot be trusted to help others

proverb: Balballi mana kanaa, mana kaaniif hin tahu
meaning_om: Furmaanni fi karaan mana yookaan nama tokkoo kan nama biraatiif hin ta'u; qe'ee fi haalli hundi furmaata mataa isaa barbaada
meaning_en: The door of this house does not fit that other house; what suits or solves the problem of one household will not work for another; customize solutions

proverb: Ifaan mana kanaa, mana biraatii hin ibsu
meaning_om: Milkaa'inni, nagaan fi qabeenyi nama tokkoo dhuunfaatti mana isaaf malee kan nama biraatiif ifa hin ta'u; hundi ifa ofii qabaachuu qaba
meaning_en: The lamp burning in this house does not illuminate another house; another family's fortune and enlightenment do not shine into your dark corners

proverb: Dhuufuu fi liqiin yoo namarraa baate namatti haffallatti
meaning_om: Liqii baafachuun akkuma dhuufuu keessaa bahuutti qalbii fi sammuu namaa boqochiisa; liqii jalaa bahuun nagaa dhugaa fida
meaning_en: Intestinal gas and financial debt, once discharged from a person, bring profound lightness and relief; debt is an agonizing internal pressure

proverb: Ollaa abdattee, dhiirsa heexoo obaafte
meaning_om: Wanta ormi waadaa galeefitti amantee wanta balaa qabu keessa seenuun miidhaa fida; ormarratti hirkachuu dhiisanii dura of qopheessuu qabu
meaning_en: Relying on the neighbor's promised broth, she gave her husband harsh tapeworm medicine; administering drastic treatments dependent on others brings peril

proverb: Abbaan damma nyaateef ilma afaan hin mi'aawu
meaning_om: Qananiin, milkaa'innii fi gootummaan abbaa dhuunfaatti ilmaaf hin darbu; ilmi wanta mataa isaatiin hojjete qofa dhandhama
meaning_en: Just because the father ate honey, the son's mouth does not taste sweet; ancestral or parental glory and wealth do not satisfy the child's hunger

proverb: Abbaan daadhii dhugeef, ilma afaan hin urgaawu
meaning_om: Kabajaa fi ulfinni abbaa ilma hin faayu; namni hunduu maqaa fi kabaja mataa isaatiin beekamuu qaba malee kan maatiin hin dhaadatan
meaning_en: Because the father drank sweet mead, the son's breath does not smell sweet; you cannot borrow reputation or dignity from your father's past indulgences

proverb: Dallayni halaalaa, qabbana hin dahu
meaning_om: Firi yookaan qabeenyi fagoo jiru rakkina dhihoo nama mudatu jalaa nama hin oolchu; wanti dhihoo jiruutu dursa nama baraara
meaning_en: A distant fence does not block the cold wind; wealth or relatives far away cannot protect you from immediate storms right on your doorstep

proverb: Aabboon jagnaan, jagnummaa namaaf hin taatu
meaning_om: Gootummaan abbaa dhuunfaatti ilma goota hin godhu; ilmi ofii isaatii gootummaa fi murannoo qabaachuu qaba malee faaruun abbaa nama hin baraaru
meaning_en: Though your father was a renowned warrior, his valor does not make you a hero; courage and fortitude cannot be passively inherited; you must prove yourself

proverb: Soddom dhaluus, loon abbumaaf waa godha
meaning_om: Qabeenyi ormaa hangam yoo baay'ateyyuu bu'aan isaa abbuma isaatiif malee nama biraatiif hin ta'u; qabeenya ofii horachuutu furmaata
meaning_en: Even if the herd calves thirty times, the cattle only benefit their rightful owner; another person's multiplying wealth enriches them, not you; build your own herd

proverb: "Na abdattee, ilma hin guddisin" jette re'een
meaning_om: Qabeenya laafaa fi dafee dhumatu irratti hirkachuudhaan karoora guddaa jireenyaa karoorfachuun balaa akka qabu; wabii cimaa barbaaduu ibsa
meaning_en: 'Relying on my meager milk, do not try to raise a growing son,' said the goat; warns against anchoring massive, long-term ambitions on flimsy, fragile assets

proverb: Magaalaa fi aakhiraa, waan ifiitiin jiraatan
meaning_om: Magaalaa keessatti qabeenya ofiitiin, aakhiraattis hojii ofiitiin malee namarraa gargaarsi hin jiru; bakka hundatti of danda'uutu furmaata
meaning_en: In the city and in the hereafter, you survive only on what is your own; in town cash is required, and in eternity one answers for one's own deeds

proverb: Bakka oolmayaarra bakka bultii wayya
meaning_om: Bakka yeroof oolanii bashannanan caalaa iddoon boqonnaa fi nagaan itti galan dursa qabaata; mana ofiitiif kabaja kennuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Better than the place where one idles during the day is the shelter where one sleeps at night; permanent domestic sanctuary is far superior to temporary public haunts

proverb: Bakka hin rafnetti, hin mugan
meaning_om: Bakka nagaa hin qabne yookaan qe'ee ormaatti of dagatanii gowwoomuu hin qaban; eeggannoo cimaa qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Where you do not plan to sleep, do not even doze off; never drop your guard or display vulnerability in an untrusted or foreign place

proverb: Bareedduu gandaa mannaa, fokkottuu ifii wayya
meaning_om: Wanta ormaa isa alaan bareedu hawwuu mannaa, wantuma qulqullinaan kan mataa ofii ta'e qabatanii nagaan jiraachuutu caala; quufa barsiisa
meaning_en: Rather than the village beauty who belongs to someone else, one's own modest partner is far better; cherishing what is yours brings true peace over outside lust

proverb: Mana ambaa bareedaa mannaa, goojjoo ifii jalloo wayya
meaning_om: Mana ormaa isa qananiin guutame keessatti hirkattuu ta'uurra, goojjoo ofii ishee xiqqoo keessatti bilisummaa fi kabajaan jiraachuutu caala
meaning_en: Rather than a stranger's beautiful mansion, one's own humble, crooked hut is better; independent poverty carries more dignity than living as a parasite in a palace

proverb: Namni du'e nama hin dhiqu
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiiyyuu dadhabaa, kasaaraa yookaan rakkina keessa jiru nama biraa gargaaruu yookaan oolchuu hin danda'u; of danda'uutu nama gargaaruu dursaa
meaning_en: A dead person cannot wash another; one who is powerless, ruined, or destitute cannot provide aid, healing, or rescue to someone else; helplessness cannot serve helplessness

proverb: "Ureetiin nyaadhaa, qotaa qotiinsaan maaltu na gaye" jette, daanayoon
meaning_om: Namni tola nyaachuu fi bu'aa hojii nama biraa qofa saamuuf yaadu dadhabbii fi dafqa hojichaa akka waan isa hin ilaallannetti tuffachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'I bore into the grain and eat; what business do I have with plowing?' said the weevil; satirizes parasitic opportunists who effortlessly consume others' toil

proverb: Darasaan yoo khabiirummaa barbaadde, qaariyaa kopha baafatti
meaning_om: Namni tokko beekamtii, hoogganummaa fi bilisummaa argachuu yoo fedhe, nama biraa jala jiraachuu dhiisee of danda'ee qe'ee fi hojii mataa isaa jalqabuu qaba
meaning_en: If a disciple desires to become a recognized master, he sets up his own settlement; to attain true authority, one must step out from another's shadow

proverb: Akka caphanitti hokkolan
meaning_om: Namni akkuma rakkoo, dandeettii fi haala isa mudateetti madaalamee socho'uu fi jireenya isaa geggeeffachuu qaba; haala qabatamaa fudhachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One limps according to how one was broken; adapt your pace, actions, and expectations realistically to your actual wounds, resources, and limitations

proverb: Rabbiit jira ja'anii, karaa keessa hin rafani
meaning_om: Eegumsa Waaqayyoorratti amanamuun of eeggannoo dhabuu hin jechuu miti; Waaqa abdatanii of eeggannoo gochuu qabu malee balaaf of saaxiluu hin qaban
meaning_en: Saying 'God exists' does not justify sleeping in the middle of the road; faith in divine providence must never replace personal prudence or excuse reckless exposure

proverb: Akka malee rafteeti, rabbi maqaa balleysiti
meaning_om: Namni ofuma isaatii dhibaa'ummaa fi of-dagannoodhaan balaa ofitti fidee, booda garuu 'Rabbiitu natti fide' jedhee Waaqayyoon komachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: You slept carelessly and then you blame God's name for your misfortune; criticizing those who cause their own ruin through negligence and blame fate

proverb: Waaqi, karaa keessaa gorii, na yaammadhu jedhe
meaning_om: Waaqayyoon gargaarsa kadhachuu dura wanta balaa qabu irraa of fageessanii tarkaanfii barbaachisaa fudhachuu qabu; kadhannaan gocha wajjin deemti
meaning_en: God said: 'Step out of the middle of the road, and only then call upon Me'; divine aid requires human prudence; take practical safety measures before praying

proverb: Lubbuuf abbaatu luka
meaning_om: Balaa jalaa baqachuufi lubbuu ofii oolfachuuf kan dursa fiiguu fi tattaaffii gochuu qabu abbuma sanaadha malee namni ormaa si hin oolchu
meaning_en: For one's own life, the owner himself is the legs; when mortal danger threatens, you must run with your own legs; self-preservation demands personal effort

proverb: Lubbuu abbaatu dikee itti guurrata
meaning_om: Lubbuu, nagaa fi qabeenya ofiitiif kan eeggannoo godhuu fi dhama'ee itti cimu abbuma isaati; namni of eeguu qaba
meaning_en: For one's own life, the owner himself heaps up protective mounds; an individual is the primary custodian of their own safety, health, and survival

proverb: Tiitichi hin madeeysuu, madaa keeysa nyaata
meaning_om: Namoonni hamoon rakkoo guddaa ofumaan uumuu baatanis, rakkoo fi hanqina kanaan dura turetti dhimma bahee nama saama; faayida-dhablummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: The fly does not cause the wound; it feeds upon the festering wound; opportunistic enemies do not create the crisis, but exploit existing fractures

proverb: Wanti hin beekne, nama hin beektu
meaning_om: Wanta beekumsa irratti hin qabnee fi hin baratin keessa yoo seente balaan isaa gara-jabummaan si miidha; wanti hin beekamne safeeffannaa hin qabu
meaning_en: What you do not know does not know you either; an unfamiliar machine, beast, or terrain shows no mercy to ignorant meddlers; unfamiliarity breeds hazard

proverb: Galaanni galuu ka'e, nama fudhatee gala
meaning_om: Rakkoon yookaan diinni yeroo dhumachuuf deemu illee of eeggannoo dhabnaan miidhaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a; balaan yeroo xumuraa dafee nama hin dagachiisu
meaning_en: Floodwaters that begin to recede sweep people away; a receding flood or retreating enemy remains lethal to careless onlookers; vigilance is required to the end

proverb: Hubattu malee, huuba irraa fixattu malee, lola ajjeechaa hin seenin
meaning_om: Osoo sababa, bu'aa fi balaa isaa sirriitti hin qoratin waldhabdee lubbuu galaafatu keessa lixuun gowwummaadha; dursa qorachuun barbaachisaa dha
meaning_en: Unless you understand the cause and clear away all murky dust, do not enter a lethal battle; never commit to deadly conflict without absolute clarity

proverb: Galaanni dabruu taa'u si hin fuudhin, dullachi gala deemu si hin abaarin
meaning_om: Balaa yeroo gabaabaa keessatti darbuun akka hin liqimfamne, akkasumas abaarsa maanguddoon du'aaf deemu irratti darbatu jalaa akka eeggatan eebbisaa gorsuudha
meaning_en: May the passing flood not sweep you away, and may an elder departing for the grave not curse you; beware of transient floods and avoid the curses of the dying

proverb: Namni ija takkaa biyyeen hin taphatu
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya yookaan carraa tokkicha qabu wanta sana balaaf saaxiluu hin qabu; wanta bu'uuraa eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A one-eyed person does not play with dust; one who has only a single asset or opportunity must never flirt with hazards that threaten its loss

proverb: Qarree irra hin deemin, mucucaattu hin beeytuu
meaning_om: Bakka balaa fi qilee ta'erra deemanii of saaxiluu dhiisuu; amala shakkisiisaa fi daangaa dhiphoo keessa deemuu dhowwa
meaning_en: Do not walk along the slippery precipice; you never know when you will slip; stay far away from hazardous margins, moral gray zones, or reckless risks

proverb: "Hamma dhaabbannu teenya, hamma qalbiin deemnu fiigna" jette, sareen
meaning_om: Namni madaallii humnaa fi dandeettii ofii beekee, hamma sammuun isaa eeyyamu qofa carraaqee jiraachuu qaba; dandeettii ofiitiin socho'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'We stand as far as our footing holds, and we run as far as our wits guide us,' said the dog; pacing action and retreat according to capability and alert intelligence

proverb: Laga irraa hin galletti, hin duulani
meaning_om: Bakka baafannaa fi daandiin nagaan itti deebi'an hin jirretti lola yookaan hojii balaa qabu keessa hin seenan; karoora baafannaa qabaachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Do not campaign across a river from which there is no return; never commit to an enterprise, conflict, or crossing without securing a clear path of withdrawal

proverb: Ija hamma jirtu kuulani
meaning_om: Wanta qaban kunuunsuu fi bareechuun kan danda'amu hanguma inni jirutti waan ta'eef, yeroo carraan jiru wanta sirrii ta'e raawwachuu qabu; yerootti fayyadamuu
meaning_en: Adorn the eye with kohl so long as it is whole; cherish, beautify, and make the most of your health, opportunities, and youth while you still possess them

proverb: Namni citaa keysa galu, mana namaa hin gubu
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatii hanqinaa fi saaxilamummaa qabu nama biraa irratti roorrisuu yookaan balaa kakaasuu hin qabu; daawwitii keessa taa'anii dhagaa hin darbbatan
meaning_en: Those who live in thatched houses do not set fire to other people's homes; those in glass houses should not throw stones; vulnerability demands peaceful restraint

proverb: Nama ablee harkaa qabu, foon hin hudhu
meaning_om: Namni meeshaa, mala fi dandeettii qabu rakkoo isa mudate salphaatti kukkutee furuu danda'a; qophiin rakkoo ittisa
meaning_en: A person holding a knife is not choked by meat; one who possesses the proper tools, preparation, and skills is never overwhelmed by challenges

proverb: Jilbaa ol, abbaatu of dhiqa
meaning_om: Dhimma iccitii fi qaama keessoo ofii kan qulqulleeffachuu fi eeggachuu qabu abbuma sana; itti gaafatamummaa dhuunfaa ibsa
meaning_en: Above the knees, one must wash oneself; intimate, personal responsibilities and inner integrity must be maintained by oneself, not left to others

proverb: Okkotee beelaa, abbaatu jala tuqata
meaning_om: Rakkoo fi beela mana ofii keessaa ba'uuf kan dhama'ee ibidda qabsiisuu qabu abbuma dhimmaati; rakkoo ofiitiif abbaatu dursa ka'a
meaning_en: The cooking pot of hunger is kindled by the owner himself; to overcome personal famine and crisis, you must tend your own fire and take direct action

proverb: Geggeeysaan, nama hin galchine
meaning_om: Namni si gargaaru hamma tokko qofa si geggeessa malee, galma kee isa dhumaa siif hin dhaqsiisu; dhuma irratti ofumaan galma gahuu qabda
meaning_en: An escort does not bring you all the way home; external assistance can only guide you part of the way, but crossing the final threshold requires personal effort

proverb: Maluma ifiitu, aara nama baasa
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi dhiphina cimaa keessaa kan nama baasu malaa fi qalbii ofiiti malee ormatti hirkachuun furmaata hin ta'u
meaning_en: It is one's own wit that leads one out of choking smoke; escaping suffocating predicaments demands your own ingenuity and practical resourcefulness

proverb: Achi ejjadhuun, muka nama hin korsiiftu
meaning_om: Gorsaa fi dubbii afaaniitiin qofa namni wanta ulfaataa hin raawwatu; gocha qabatamaa fi humna mataa isaatii barbaada
meaning_en: Saying 'Step there' does not make someone climb a tree; verbal prompting alone cannot accomplish a difficult physical ascent; action requires personal ability

proverb: As ajjadhuun, nama hin deemsiftu
meaning_om: Namni fedhii fi humna deemsaa hin qabne afaaniin yoo qajeelchanillee tarkaanfachuu hin danda'u; kaka'umsi keessaa madda
meaning_en: Telling someone 'Step here' does not make them walk; you cannot impart motivation or locomotion to someone who lacks the internal will to move

proverb: Bakka nama nyanyaattu, abbaatu hooqqata
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi dhukkubbii ofii kan sirriitti beekee furmaata barbaadu abbuma dhimmaati malee ormi bakka si dhukkubu hin baru
meaning_en: Where it itches, the person himself scratches; no one knows where your pain pinches better than yourself; address your own troubles directly

proverb: Adurreen "miyaaw" jettu malee, aannan hin argattu
meaning_om: Namni waan barbaadu afaaniin yoo hin gaafatin fi hin iyyanne namuu isaaf hin kennu; fedhii ofii ifatti gaafachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Unless the cat meows, it gets no milk; a closed mouth does not get fed; you must voice your needs, ask clearly, and make requests to receive help

proverb: Callisaa, haati hiraataaf hin yaadanne
meaning_om: Namni callisee wanta isa barbaachisu hin dubbanne haadha isaatiinuu ni dagatama; wanta ofii afaaniin himachuu dhowwa
meaning_en: The silent child is forgotten even by his own mother at dinner; keeping quiet about your hunger or rights causes even your closest protectors to overlook you

proverb: Usuun hoolaafuu hin tolle
meaning_om: Dhimma ofiirratti callisuu fi sagalee dhabuun cunqursaa fi balaaf nama saaxila; callisuun akka hoolaatti qalamuu fida
meaning_en: Total silence did not help even the sheep; meek, passive muteness only leads to slaughter; suffering in silence invites continuous exploitation

proverb: Abbaan iyyu, firri dirmata
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan dhufe dursa abbaan dhimmaa iyya dhageessifachuu qaba; yoo inni iyyuu baate firi dhugaa jiru hin baru, hin birmatus
meaning_en: When the victim cries aloud, the clan rushes to the rescue; sounding the alarm is the prerequisite for mobilizing solidarity and aid from kin

proverb: Kanuma iyyuutu, haqa qaba
meaning_om: Namni sagalee ol kaasee mirga isaaf falmatu haqa isaa argata malee, inni callise mirga isaa ni dhaba; falmachuun haqa namaaf kenna
meaning_en: It is the one who actively cries out who secures justice; rights and justice belong to those who boldly vocalize their grievances rather than enduring abuse

proverb: Gowwaa mannaa, iyyaa wayya
meaning_om: Namni dhimma isaa himatu, wacus yoo ta'e isa homaa hin dubbannee fi callisee miidhamu caala; sagalee qabaachuun faayidaa qaba
meaning_en: Better a loud complainer than a mute fool; an irritating squeaker who speaks up secures assistance and alerts others, whereas passive fools are ruined quietly

proverb: Dhabaa mannaa, falma wayya
meaning_om: Harka kennatanii mirgaa fi qabeenya ofii dhabuurra, morkatanii fi falmatanii wanta danda'an oolfachuutu caala; falmuun dursa qaba
meaning_en: Better a dispute than total forfeit; it is far more honorable to stand and contest your rights through struggle than to meekly surrender everything without a fight

proverb: Soogiddi dantaaf mi'aawa
meaning_om: Namni kamuu wanta tokko kan mi'eessu fi gaarii godhu faayidaa fi kaayyoo dhuunfaa qabuufi; dantaan bu'uura sochiiti
meaning_en: Salt makes itself savory for a purpose; actions, sweetness, and efforts in human life are driven by underlying utility, self-interest, and necessity

proverb: Yaa Soogiddaa ofii jedhii mi'aawi yoo didde dhagaadha jedhani si darbani
meaning_om: Namni faayidaa fi amala gaarii qabaatee of kabachiisuu qaba; yoo gatii dhabe akkuma dhagaa gatii hin qabneetti gatama
meaning_en: 'Oh Salt, be flavorful for your own sake; if you fail, they will take you for a rock and cast you out'; maintain your value, lest society discard you

proverb: Dhadhaan, "ofii jedhii na dhugi" jedhe
meaning_om: Gorsi fi wanti gaariin namaaf kennamu faayidaa nama sanaatiif malee nama biraatiif miti; wanta tolaa ofiif fayyadamuu barsiisa
meaning_en: The butter said, 'Consume me for your own benefit!'; good counsel, education, and nourishing opportunities are provided for your own elevation

proverb: Dantaaf, Kalloo saree irra rafan
meaning_om: Faayidaa fi dantaa argachuuf jecha namni wanta safuu hin taane yookaan balfamaa ta'eyyuu danda'ee keessa darba; dantaan nama dhiiba
meaning_en: For the sake of self-interest, one sleeps upon the pelt of a dog; when necessity and personal interest demand it, people swallow pride and endure compromises

proverb: Dantaa jala kufaniiti, ofirratti qaban
meaning_om: Faayidaa dhuunfaatiin mo'atamee wanta ofii miidhu illee akka waan gaariitti qabatanii jiraachuu ceepha'a; dantaan ija jaamsa
meaning_en: Succumbing to narrow self-interest, they clutch it closely; blind pursuit of personal gain causes people to cling to toxic, demeaning conditions

proverb: Dantaan abbaan ganda
meaning_om: Hawaasa fi jireenya keessatti wanti namoota sochoosu fi walitti fidu dantaa dhuunfaati; dantaatu hunda hooggana
meaning_en: Self-interest is the ruler of the village; personal interest, profit, and utility govern human affairs and dictate community alliances more than ideals

proverb: Gosa lama hin gaafatani
meaning_om: Eenyummaan, amanamummaan fi dhaabbiin namaa tokko ta'uu qaba malee kallattii lamaan dhaabbachuun hin danda'amu; qajeelummaa fi tokkummaa ibsa
meaning_en: One does not ask for two clans; an individual can only have one true ancestral allegiance; be straightforward and singular in your commitment

proverb: Ofii dhuundhuma irra kaayattu, obboleessa keetiif taakkoo irra kaayi
meaning_om: Qabeenya yookaan bu'aa argatterraa ofii harka guddaa yoo fudhatteyyuu, nama biraatiifis xiqqoo qooduun safuudha; haqa fi arjummaa barsiisa
meaning_en: If you set aside a cubit for yourself, at least spare a handspan for your brother; practice fairness and share a portion of your gains with your kin

proverb: Si ergan kaadhu, sii kennan nyaadhu
meaning_om: Yeroo hojiin si eeggatu kutannoon hojjedhu, yeroo qananiin dhufe ammoo nagaan nyaadhu; itti-gaafatamummaa fi carraatti fayyadamuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When dispatched on duty, run swiftly; when offered nourishment, eat heartily; be diligent and prompt in service, and grateful when rewarded

proverb: Osoo taanitti jirtuu, qoricha ija tiyyaa haa dubbaannuu jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Osoo dhimmi guddaan tokko furmaata hin argatin wanta dhuunfaa fi xiqqoo dursa kennuuf dhiphachuu ceepha'a; dursa dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'While we are discussing that catastrophe, let's talk about my eye drops,' said the man; satirizes derailing collective crises for selfish trivia

proverb: Keessummaan bulteeti deemti
meaning_om: Keessummaan kan yeroo gabaabaati malee dhaabbataa miti; obsaan keessummeessuun nagaa fida; akkasumas jireenyi addunyaa akka keessummaati
meaning_en: A guest stays the night and then moves on; hospitality demands patience because visitors are temporary; worldly existence itself is a brief overnight stay

proverb: Keessummaan, taligaa namaaf hin dhooytu
meaning_om: Keessummaan wanta dhihaate nyaata malee itti-gaafatamummaa manaa hin qabu; qusannaa fi bulchiinsi kan abbaa warrati
meaning_en: A guest does not balance or ration your household provisions; visitors consume what is set before them; domestic budgeting rests solely with the master

proverb: Namni sii wajji hin deemne, harree sii wajji hin fe'in
meaning_om: Namni dhibee fi dhiphina imala keetii hin qooddanne murtii fi karoora kee keessa lixuu hin qabu; itti-gaafatamummaa kan baatu qofatu murteessa
meaning_en: Let not someone who isn't traveling with you load the pack-donkey with you; do not let non-participants dictate plans whose consequences only you bear

proverb: Hemelaal ka'ii gali, masaanuun si dhageessii
meaning_om: Bakka saaxilamaa ta'etti komii yookaan iccitii ofii baasanii dubbachuun diinaaf carraa waan kennuuf, of eeggannoodhaan gara mana ofiitti deebi'anii dhimma ofii dhoksuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Warning someone against airing domestic grievances or vulnerabilities in public where rivals can overhear and exploit them; domestic discretion

proverb: Uleen muka irraa citti, dubbiin abbaa irraa citti
meaning_om: Akkuma uleen damee mukaarraa kukkutamtu, dhimmii fi falmiin tokkos dhuma irratti kan murtee argatu abbuma dhimmaa isa dhimmi ilaallatuuni
meaning_en: Just as a staff is cut directly from a tree, a dispute is definitively settled by its owner; only the directly involved party can resolve it

proverb: Sareen, hamma gadi teeyse, abbaa dabarte
meaning_om: Namni suuta jedhee, gadi of qabee fi obsaan haala hordofaa ture yeroo booda isa dura ture caalaa milkaa'ee sadarkaa guddaarra gaha
meaning_en: The dog, by crouching low and biding its time, ended up overtaking its master; patient, humble perseverance allows one to surpass former superiors

proverb: Ciqilee, jaartiin soddaatuu hin dandeenye
meaning_om: Wanta uumamaan hin danda'amne fi carraa hin qabne gochuuf yaaluun bu'aa akka hin qabne; dandeettii uumamaa beekanii fudhachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The elbow, even an experienced old mother-in-law could not lick it; attempting an inherently impossible feat is an exercise in utter futility

proverb: Tan itti yaadan illeen, wahuma yaaddatti
meaning_om: Osoo ati nama tokkoof yaaddoftuu fi dhiphattuu, inni garuu fedhii fi karoora mataa isaa qofa yaada; yaada ormaaf of dhiphisuu dhiisuu ibsa
meaning_en: The very person you are fretting over is consumed with her own separate thoughts; do not exhaust yourself obsessing over someone preoccupied with self

proverb: Shanyiin, akkuma abbaan facaasetti magarti
meaning_om: Hojiin, amallii fi guddinni ijoollee akkuma gorsaa fi barsiifata maatiin facaaseetti firii kenna; wanta facaasan haammachuun seera uumamaati
meaning_en: The seed sprouts exactly as the sower cast it; as you sow, so shall you reap; the character and moral outcomes of children mirror their upbringing

proverb: Qanqalloo, waanuma itti naqan, irraa naqani
meaning_om: Namarraa wanta inni qabu yookaan wanta barsiifatanii itti kennan qofatu baha; nama sammuun isaa duwwaa ta'e irraa beekumsa eeguun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: From a leather sack, you can only pour out what was poured into it; one can only give what one possesses; do not expect wisdom from an empty mind

proverb: Nama nyaatarraa ergan, daddafii koottu hin jedhaniin
meaning_om: Namni osoo nyaatuu hojiif ka'e dursa fedhii qaamaa isaa waan hin guuttatiniif, isa dirqisiisuun yookaan jarjarsuun safuu miti
meaning_en: When you dispatch someone right from their meal, you do not press them to rush back; show basic consideration to someone who interrupted their food for you

proverb: Arrabni, abbaaf iyya
meaning_om: Namni mirgaa fi dhiphina isaatiif afaan isaatiin dubbatee falmachuu qaba; arrabni meeshaa ittiin dhimma ofii himatan ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: The tongue cries out for its owner; speech is given to articulate your own needs, defend your rights, and voice your pain; use your voice boldly

proverb: Ijji, abbaaf waraanti
meaning_om: Ijji balaa dursee arguun, carraa ilaaluun abbaa isheetiif eeggannoo gooti; dammaqinni ijaa eegumsa lubbuuti
meaning_en: The eye pierces and watches sharply on behalf of its owner; sight is the sentinel of the soul, actively scouting threats to keep the person secure

proverb: Kan mataan nyaatuus, kan miilaan nyaatuus lubbuu isaatiif deema
meaning_om: Uumamni hunduu bifa garaagaraatiin yoo jiraateyyuu kaayyoon isaanii tokko, inniis lubbuu ofii tursiisuuf dhama'uudha; qabsoon jireenyaa kan hundaati
meaning_en: Whether an organism feeds with its head or feeds with its feet, each toils for the preservation of its life; all creatures share the common quest for survival

proverb: Muka abbaan namaa kenne, hudduutti muratani
meaning_om: Yeroo carraan yookaan eeyyamni bilisaan namaaf kenname, namoonni faayidaa sana hanga dhumaatti dhuunfachuuf tattaafatu; carraatti guutummaatti fayyadamuu ibsa
meaning_en: A tree whose harvest the owner permitted, one fells right to the stump; when given free access, people exploit the concession to the absolute maximum limit

proverb: Abbaan qottoo, muka hin dhabu
meaning_om: Namni meeshaa, ogummaa fi dandeettii hojii qabu yeroo hundumaa jireenya isaa geggeeffachuu hin dadhabu; qophiin qabeenya fida
meaning_en: The owner of an axe never lacks firewood; one who possesses the primary tools, practical skills, and determination will never suffer destitution

proverb: Tittirsi hin gootomsu, gorsi hin qaroomsu
meaning_om: Kaka'umsa alaa qofaan gootummaan hin dhalatu; akkasumas namni sammuun isaa hin dammaqin gorsa qofaan beekaa hin ta'u; jabinni keessaa madda
meaning_en: Chanted cheering cannot make a coward a hero, nor can mere advice make a fool clever; true courage and wisdom are inborn qualities that cannot be coached

proverb: Xaaliyaanii as, abbaatu if faarsa
meaning_om: Yeroo ammayyaa kana keessatti namni hundi of faarsuu fi of jajuu malee warri nama faarsan dhabamuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a; jijjiirama aadaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Ever since the Italian era, everyone sings their own praises; satirizes modern self-promotion, where traditional modesty has dissolved into rampant bragging

proverb: Naamusa ifii, abbaatu eeggata
meaning_om: Kabaja, naamusa fi amala ofii kan ormi eegu osoo hin taane, abbuma sanaatu gochaa fi haasaa isaatiin of kabachiisuu qaba; kabajni ofii kan ofiiti
meaning_en: One's own dignity and decorum are guarded by oneself; respect is not given by others unless you actively protect your own boundaries and conduct yourself with honor

proverb: Joolleen ilkee aqartu, kofa nama banti
meaning_om: Ijoollee wajjin garmalee qoosuun yookaan daangaa dhabuun akka isaan nama hin safeeffanne fi qaanii nama irraan gahan godha; ijoollee wajjin daangaa eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: Playful children with teething teeth end up uncovering one's lap; over-familiarity and lack of boundaries with youngsters lead them to strip away your dignity

proverb: Namni mooyyee irra taa'u, kabajaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni meeshaa ulfinaa fi nyaata irratti hojjetan akka barcumaatti irra taa'ee safuu cabsu nama naamusa fi kabaja hin qabne ta'uu ibsa; safuu aadaa kabajuu
meaning_en: A person who sits upon a grain mortar possesses no dignity; someone who disrespects domestic taboos and culinary tools demonstrates a total lack of breeding

proverb: Gowwaan wajji hin haasawin, bakka hin taanetti si odeessaa
meaning_om: Nama qalbii fi daangaa hin beekne wajjin iccitii yookaan haasaa qabaachuun balaa qaba; inni bakka hin malleetti waan dubbattan baasee nama qaaneessa
meaning_en: Do not converse with a fool, for he will blab about you in inappropriate places; sharing words with an indiscreet fool inevitably results in public embarrassment

proverb: Ijoolleen qixa wajji nyaatan, qixxe nama seeti
meaning_om: Maanguddoon yookaan namni guddaan ijoollee wajjin osoo daangaa hin eeggatin yoo jiraate, ijoolleen kabaja dhowwatanii akka hiriyyaa isaaniitti tuffachuu danda'u
meaning_en: Children with whom an adult eats on equal terms consider him their equal; excessive familiarity and blurring social hierarchy cause youth to lose respect

proverb: Kabajaan kintaalaa, abbaatu ifirratti qaba
meaning_om: Kabajni wanta baay'ee ulfaataa fi gati-jabeessa waan ta'eef, namni kamuu amala, safeeffannaa fi gocha isaatiin ofirratti baatee eeggachuu qaba; of kabachiisuun kan abbaati
meaning_en: Respect weighs as heavy as a quintal sack; the owner himself must bear it with strength; personal honor is a substantial responsibility maintained by self-discipline

proverb: Kabajaa fi wayaa abbaatu ofirratti qaba
meaning_om: Akkuma uffata ofii qulqulleeffatanii uffatan, kabaja fi maqaa gaarii ofiis abbuma sanaatu gocha gaariin ofirratti eeggata malee ormi nama hin uffisu
meaning_en: Honor and clothing are maintained upon oneself by the owner alone; just as you dress your body, your dignity must be preserved through your own ethical conduct

proverb: Garbaan hin qoosin daaraa dhaan si qabdii, durbaan hin qoosin mutaa dhaan si waraantii
meaning_om: Namoota bakka hojii isaaniitti jiran wajjin qoccolloo fi qoosaa hin taane dhiisuu; qoosaan daangaa darbe deebii hamaa fi miidhaa fida
meaning_en: Do not tease a servant, for she will throw ashes on you; do not tease a maiden, for she will stab you with her awl; teasing working folks invites sharp retaliation

proverb: Barcuma kabajaa, abbaatu of jalaan deema
meaning_om: Bakka kamiyyuu yoo deeman namni kabaja kan argatu akkuma amala, naamusa fi safeeffannaa mataa isaa isa waliin deemuuni; kabajni keessaa madda
meaning_en: The stool of honor is carried beneath oneself wherever one goes; dignity is not provided by the venue, but is an internal posture carried into every room

proverb: Keessummaa galaatu mi'eessa
meaning_om: Keessummaan yeroo gabaabaaf ooltee yoo galte jaalallii fi kabajni ishee eegama; nuffisiiftee yoo turte garuu kabajni ishee hir'ata; yeroon galuu barsiisa
meaning_en: For a guest, it is departure that sweetens the visit; hospitality stays warm and cherished when visits are brief; overstaying one's welcome breeds annoyance

proverb: Anaaf haa ka'uuf gabrichaaf ka'u
meaning_om: Namni of tuuluu fi kabaja dharra'u tokko akka waan ormi isaaf ol ka'eetti yaadee yeroo nama biraatiif ka'an argu qaaniitti of saaxila; koora sobaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Expecting 'They are surely rising to honor me', while they actually rose for the servant; satirizes vain presumption where someone mistakes general motion for adulation

proverb: Fuula dureessaa deddeebi'uu hin guddisin, si tuffataa
meaning_om: Nama qabeenya qabu biratti yeroo hunda deddeebi'anii mul'achuun hirkattuu nama fakkeessee tuffii fida; of eeggannoo fi kabaja ofii eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Do not frequent the presence of the rich too often, lest he despise you; constantly hovering around affluent patrons reduces you to a beggar and breeds contempt

proverb: Joolleen nama odeessiti, adurreen nama kotteessiti
meaning_om: Ijoollee duratti iccitii yookaan amala dhokataa dubbachuun balaa qaba, isaan ormatti baasanii nama saaxilu; akkuma adurreen nama qoccoltu ijoolleenis nama saaxilti
meaning_en: Children report and blab about a person, just as cats scratch; beware of displaying secrets before children, for they will innocently broadcast them to everyone

proverb: Joollee fi ibiddaa wajji hin taphatani
meaning_om: Ijoollee fi ibidda wajjin qoosaa daangaa darbe gochuun balaa tasaa fi miidhaa guddaa fida; lamaanuu of eeggannoo cimaa barbaadu
meaning_en: One does not play with fire or young children; both lack disciplined control and can turn a moment of careless play into devastating burns or public calamity

proverb: Gaangeen haada kutte jennaan, ifittuu gabaabsite je'e
meaning_om: Namni gocha seeraan alaa raawwatee yookaan diddaa agarsiisee gabaabbinaa fi rakkina dabalataa ofirratti fida; diddaan ofuma miidha
meaning_en: When told the mule broke its tether, he said she only shortened it on herself; reckless rebellion against proper bounds only restricts one's own freedom

proverb: Dhiheeysi jennaan, beera fuudhi jette
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan dhimma tokko jarjarsuuf yoo yaalan, furmaata salphaa fi bu'aa dhabeessa ta'etti nama qajeelchu; jarjarri madaallii dhabsiisa
meaning_en: When told 'Hasten it', she replied 'Marry an old woman!'; satirizes looking for reckless shortcuts to achieve quick results, resulting in unviable compromises

proverb: Nama warri ajjeese fi sa'a ganni ajjeese, alagaan humaa hin godhuufi
meaning_om: Namni maatii fi firoota isaatiin miidhamee fi tuffatame ormarraa gargaarsa hin argatu; akkuma sa'i ganni fixe hin deebine, firi yoo nama gate ormi hin baasu
meaning_en: A person destroyed by his own family and a cow destroyed by the rainy season, an outsider cannot save; when kin abandon a person, strangers will not help

proverb: Nama ifitti jiru; namuu itti hin jiruufi
meaning_om: Namni gochaa fi amala isaatiin of miidhuu fi of balleessaa jiru diina dabalataa hin barbaadu; badiin isaa isaaf gahaadha
meaning_en: A person working against his own self; nobody needs to be against him; someone whose own foolish habits ruin their life needs no enemies from the outside

proverb: Manni abbaan gube, iyyaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Badiisa yookaan kasaaraa namni ofuma isaatii ofirratti fideef namni biraan itti gaafatamaa hin ta'u, iyyannoonis gatii hin qabu; ofiin of miidhuu ibsa
meaning_en: A house that the owner himself set on fire has no alarm; there is no sympathy, rescue, or outcry for disasters that a person willfully brings upon themselves

proverb: Kaasa abbaan irrise, namni guutuuf hin jiru
meaning_om: Kabaja, qabeenya yookaan dandeettii ofii kan ofumaan hir'ise namni biraa dhufee guutuu hin danda'u; of salphisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A cup the owner himself has diminished, no outsider will fill to the brim; if you demean your own stature and worth, no one else will restore your fullness

proverb: Lubbuu abbaan geggeeyse, anbiti dhoorkuu hin dandeeysu
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiif badiisa fi du'atti fiigu ormi qabee isa oolchuu hin danda'u; namni of baraaruu dide hin bararamu
meaning_en: A life that the owner himself marches to destruction, outsiders cannot hold back; you cannot save someone who is hell-bent on their own ruin

proverb: Sangaa abbaan gaafa cabse, alagaan ija buruysa
meaning_om: Qabeenya, maatii yookaan kabaja ofii yoo abbaan ofii miidhee fi salphise, ormi dhufee isa caalaa barbadeessa; ofii of eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: The ox whose horns the owner broke, outsiders will blind; if you humiliate or mistreat your own kin, strangers will ruthlessly finish their destruction

proverb: Abbaan if arrabsu malee, alagaan nama hin arrabsitu
meaning_om: Namni gocha, amala fi haasaa isaatiin of salphisee qaanii ofitti yoo fide malee, namni ormaa dursee nama hin arrabsu; kabajni ofii kan ofiiti
meaning_en: Unless a person degrades himself first, an outsider cannot insult him; external disrespect only occurs when one has already compromised one's own dignity

proverb: Farda abbaan dikeen darbate, alagaan dhagaan darbatti
meaning_om: Wanta yookaan nama ofii yoo abbaan tuffatee fi miidhe, ormi dhufee daran caccabsa; firaa fi qabeenya ofii kabajuu barsiisa
meaning_en: The horse its owner pelted with dung, strangers will pelt with stones; if you treat your own asset with contempt, outsiders will treat them with violence

proverb: Harkki abbaan if kaaye, koottaa irraa baasaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi ba'aa namni ofii isaatii fedhiin ofirratti fide nama biraatti iyyatee furmaata barbaaduun bu'aa hin qabu; itti-gaafatamummaa ofii baachuudha
meaning_en: A hand that a person laid upon themselves has no 'Come and pull it off!'; you cannot beg others to rescue you from a burden you intentionally embraced

proverb: Nama taa'in dadhabde waan teeysisaa itti dhufa
meaning_om: Namni nagaa fi tasgabbii dide wanti humnaa ol ta'e dhufee akka inni boqotu isa dirqisiisa; daangaa malee fiiguun balaa fida
meaning_en: To the person who refused to sit down, an affliction that forcefully seats him will arrive; those who refuse healthy restraint will be stopped by disaster

proverb: Abbaan ifirra ajjate, waa if hin dandamu
meaning_om: Namni ofuma isaatii of miidhee fi of salphise orma dura dhaabbatee of kabachiisuu hin danda'u; of balleessuun humna nama dhabsiisa
meaning_en: One who has trampled upon himself cannot defend or support himself; someone who destroys their own self-respect is powerless to resist external pressure

proverb: Namni ganama gorsa manguddoo dide, galgala udaan nyaata
meaning_om: Gorsa maanguddoo tuffachuun yeroo gabaabaa keessatti gara salphinaa fi badiisa qaanfachiisaatti nama geessa; gorsa dhaga'uu dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: He who rejects the counsel of an elder in the morning will be eating filth by evening; despising elder wisdom leads swiftly to humiliating regret

proverb: Namni tan nabi muussaa dide, tan Fariownaa hin dadhabu
meaning_om: Namni qajeelfama gaarii fi haqa dide dirqama garbummaa fi roorroo hamaa jala kufa; seera qajeelaa diduun garbummaa fida
meaning_en: He who refused the guidance of Prophet Moses will be subjected to the tyranny of Pharaoh; rejecting benevolent discipline drives one under cruel oppression

proverb: Harreen fe'ina feete, qa'ee musaafiraa dhayxi
meaning_om: Namni ofuma isaatii ba'aa fi rakkina barbaadu bakka dhiphinni jirutti of geessa; balaaf of saaxiluu ibsa
meaning_en: A donkey looking for a heavy load wanders into the traveler's compound; people who invite trouble or burdens seek out environments that will exploit them

proverb: Jecha namaa kan dide, kan Sheeyxaanaa fudhata
meaning_om: Namni gorsa gaarii fi qajeelfama hawaasaa dhaga'uu dide gara kajeellaa badaa fi gowwoomsaa badiitti oofama; gorsa diduun gara badiitti nama geessa
meaning_en: He who refuses the counsel of good people inevitably falls for the whispers of Satan; rejecting communal advice leaves one vulnerable to evil delusion

proverb: Saani abbaan hate, hin mullatu
meaning_om: Badii yookaan shira abbaan dhimmaa ofumaan dhoksee raawwatu ormi qoratee baruun ulfaataadha; gantummaa keessoo saaxila
meaning_en: A cow stolen by its own owner is never found; an embezzlement or sabotage committed by the very custodian is impossible to trace from outside

proverb: "Amma naa ife" jette maraattuun, mana ofii gubdee
meaning_om: Badiisa guddaa ofirratti raawwatanii akka waan milkaa'inaatti gammaduu ceepha'a; gowwummaa fi qalbii dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Now there is light for me!' said the madwoman, having set her house ablaze; satirizes fools who destroy their livelihood for a moment of fleeting excitement

proverb: Hudduu abbaan kenne, alagaan solloqsee mura
meaning_om: Namni kabaja fi qaanii ofii eeggachuu dhiisee ifatti of saaxile, ormi dhufee daran isa salphisa malee hin mararfatu; of eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: The backside exposed by the owner himself, the stranger flays to the bone; if you surrender self-respect, strangers will strip you bare without mercy

proverb: Namni fiigicha quufuu dadhabe, handaaqqoo gurgureeti, gogorrii ariisaa dhaqa
meaning_om: Qabeenya amansiisaa harkaa qaban gurguranii wanta hin qabamne fi dadhabsiisaa ta'e duukaa fiiguu ceepha'a; qananii dhiisanii dadhabbii filachuu
meaning_en: The man who couldn't get enough of running sold his domestic chicken to chase wild partridges; trading secure assets for exhausting, wild goose chases

proverb: Qubni abbaan of kaaye, hin ajaawu
meaning_om: Hanqinni fi dogoggorri ofii nama hin jibbisiisu; namni wantuma ofii hundatti ni gammada malee salphina ofii hin argu
meaning_en: The finger one inserted into oneself does not stink; human beings are blind to their own moral stench and tolerate in themselves what they revile in others

proverb: Harki ofii of kaayan, hin quqquuqu
meaning_om: Wanta abbaan ofiif godhe yookaan ba'aa ofirratti fe'e namatti hin ulfaatu; ormi yoo godhe garuu nama dhukkubsa
meaning_en: One's own hand resting upon oneself does not pinch; burdens, discipline, or hardships chosen voluntarily feel natural, while outside impositions grate

proverb: Amba diddu, Ambaayee hin diddu
meaning_om: Namni nama dhuunfaatiin mormuu danda'us seera uumamaa, fuudhaa fi heeruma, yookaan aadaa waliigalaa jalaa miliquu hin danda'u; aadaa fi seera dirqamaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: You may reject the individual stranger, but you cannot reject the wedding song; you may disdain a suitor, but you cannot escape social destiny

proverb: Bokkuu diddu, Bokkoo hin diddu
meaning_om: Namni seera, nagaa fi jaarsummaa kabajuu dide dhuma irratti humnaa fi reebichaan jilbeeffachuuf dirqama; seera kabajuu dhabuun adaba fida
meaning_en: If you refuse the moral scepter of customary law, you will not refuse the crushing cudgel; those who refuse lawful authority will be subdued by force

proverb: Ifiifuu duutii, maa if huuti
meaning_om: Wanta akkasumayyuu darbuuf jiru yookaan namni dhumachuuf deemu maaliif dhiphina dabalataatiin of miidha; wanta hin oolle obsaan eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: She is dying naturally anyway; why does she hang herself?; why compound an inevitable decline with frantic, self-inflicted violence and panic?

proverb: Jaartiin cufantaa ergiftee, balbalarra bulte
meaning_om: Wanta jireenyaa fi nageenya ofiitiif murteessaa ta'e ormaaf kennanii ofii qullaa hafuu fi rakkina keessa seenuu ceepha'a; of eeggannoo dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: The old woman lent out her door latch and spent the night stranded outside; satirizes giving away your essential security to your own severe detriment

proverb: Gabrittiin gargaarsa argannaan, majii dhoksite
meaning_om: Namni dhibaa'aan yeroo deeggarsa yookaan gargaarsa argatu hojii hojjetamuu qabu fashaleessuuf mala dhokataa barbaada; dhibaa'ummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: When the servant was given help, she hid the grinding stone; mocks lazy workers who, instead of using assistance to finish work, sabotage the tools

proverb: Kan namatti gore nama dhibe, kan namatti hin gorre of dhibe
meaning_om: Hawaasummaa keessatti keessummaa ta'anii nama rakkisuun mufannaa yoo fidu, kophaa of danda'anii rakkina baachuun immoo of miidha; madaallii barbaada
meaning_en: He who turned in as a guest burdened others; he who stayed away burdened himself; highlights the dilemma between imposing on hosts and suffering alone

proverb: Fayyaa tapha seetee, gaayyaan laga dhaqxe
meaning_om: Namni qaama laafaa fi saaxilamaa qabu bakka balaan jirutti of saaxiluun caccabee akka badu agarsiisa; daangaa humna ofii beekuu dhabuu
meaning_en: Mistaking durability for a joke, the fragile smoking-pipe went to the river; someone delicate recklessly ventures into rough environments, courting ruin

proverb: Tana waddaa ganda raftaa, haatee duubaanuu si fuuti
meaning_om: Osoo hojii qabatamaa hin hojjetin faayidaa xixiqqoo qofa barbaadaa ganda keessa jooruun salphinaa fi to'annoo ormaa jala nama galcha; dhibaa'ummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Roasting tidbits and lounging through the village, your mother will marry you off behind your back; idly wandering leads to losing control of one's destiny

proverb: Sumaatu karaarra dhaabee, rabbumaa irra nu dhaabe
meaning_om: Namni nama gargaaruu yookaan karaa qabsiisuu danda'us, eegumsi fi milkaa'inni dhugaan kan Waaqayyooti; nama galateeffachaa uumaa amanuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: You placed us on the road, but God kept us upright upon it; acknowledging human guidance while affirming that true preservation comes from God alone

proverb: Akka hin galle beektee, akka malee ba'atte
meaning_om: Namni bakka dhimmi sanaa deebi'ee hin dhufne beeku, wanta danda'u hundumaa qisaasee yookaan ba'aa humnaa olii fe'atee deemuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Knowing she was never returning, she piled on an outrageous load; when planning a final exit, an opportunist greedily loots with no regard for consequences

proverb: Dheeysee si agarsiiseeti, arihuu barte
meaning_om: Namni jabaan toftaadhaan yeroof si duraa sossokku akka waan inni dabeessa ta'eetti yaaduun ari'uuf yaaluun gowwummaadha; deebisee nama galaafata
meaning_en: He only feigned flight to test you, and you took it as license to chase him!; mistaking an adversary's tactical retreat for weakness to your own doom

proverb: Namni qubni shanan ajjeese, diyaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni ofuma isaatiin of ajjeese yookaan of balleesse beenyaa fi gumaan ormarraa eegamu hin jiru; itti-gaafatamummaan kan abbaati
meaning_en: A person killed by his own five fingers has no blood-money; one who causes their own destruction has no claim to compensation or restitution from others

proverb: Waraabeessi waan halkan balleesseef, guyyaa muka oola
meaning_om: Namni yakka fi shira dhoksaatti raawwate ija hawaasaa sodaatee qaaniidhaan guyyaa dhokata; gochi badaa nama dheessisa
meaning_en: Because of the havoc he wreaked by night, the hyena hides in the brush all day; secret crimes force a wrongdoer to hide from the light of scrutiny

proverb: Namni ijji dhukkubdu, aduu ilaaluu hin dandayu
meaning_om: Namni hanqina, cubbuu yookaan dhugaa jibbisiisaa qabu dhugaa ifaa fi qeeqa ifatti bahe dura dhaabbachuu hin danda'u; dhugaan nama madeessa
meaning_en: A person with diseased eyes cannot gaze at the sun; one who is ethically compromised or guilty cannot bear the searing light of open truth and exposure

proverb: Namni dhuufuu qabu, utaaluu hin dandayu
meaning_om: Namni iccitii yookaan dhibee dhokataa qabu tarkaanfii cimaa fi sochii bilisaa gochuu hin danda'u; wanti dhokataan nama daangessa
meaning_en: A person holding in gas cannot leap; one burdened by secret guilt, vulnerabilities, or hidden flaws is paralyzed and cannot take bold leaps

proverb: Namni albaatiin itti jirtu Utaaluu hin dandayu
meaning_om: Namni rakkoo fi dhibee keessoo isa mudate qabu dorgommii fi sochii guddaa keessatti of saaxiluu hin danda'u; dura dhukkuba ofii qulqulleeffachuu qaba
meaning_en: A person afflicted with diarrhea cannot leap; anyone suffering from acute internal turmoil cannot engage in public contests without humiliating disaster

proverb: Namni minnii qabu, dhagaa hin utaalu
meaning_om: Namni dadhabina qaamaa yookaan dhibee qabu wanta humnaa olii fi isa miidhu keessa lixuu hin qabu; daangaa fayyaa ofii beekuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A person with a hernia does not leap over boulders; know your limitations, and do not attempt reckless physical or financial leaps that will rupture you

proverb: "Namni hoolaa hate, wallaalcha hin qabu, rifeensa isaatu mataa irraa mullata" jennaan, tokko Mataa haxaawwate
meaning_om: Namni yakka hojjete qalbii isaatiin shakkee ofuma isaatiin gocha isaatiin of saaxila; hattuun yeroo hunda of eegaa of saaxilti
meaning_en: When told 'The sheep thief is obvious; wool is stuck to his head!', one suspect frantically wiped his hair; a guilty conscience exposes itself through telltale nerves

proverb: Namni hoolaa aawbarree nyaate ofiin dudubbata
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya eebbifamaa, kan uummataa yookaan kan amantii hatee nyaate qalbii nagaa dhabee yaaddoo fi sodaan maraata; cubbuun dhiphina fida
meaning_en: The person who ate the sacred sheep of the holy shrine mutters to himself; misappropriating sacred trust or public charity drives a person mad with paranoia

proverb: Taaziyaan, qaanii fuulaati
meaning_om: Gadda namaatiif dhaquun yeroo baay'ee safeeffannaa fi aadaa hawaasummaa eeguuf kan raawwatamuudha; kabaja namaaf qaban mul'isa
meaning_en: Attending a condolence visit is driven by facial shame and social honor; showing up to mourn with neighbors is a sacred social obligation to preserve dignity

proverb: Namni gabaabaa hin qabu, gabaabaan namaa nama taaziyaa namaatti hin dhayne
meaning_om: Gabaabbina qaamaa osoo hin taane, wanti nama xiqqeessu yeroo gaddaa fi rakkinaa fira cinaa dhaabbachuu dhabuudha; kabajni kan arjummaa fi gadda qooddachuuti
meaning_en: Physical stature does not make a person small; the truly small person is the one who fails to pay condolences; human stature is measured by solidarity

proverb: Hattuun hattuu hin hattu
meaning_om: Namoonni shira fi hojii seeraan alaa walfakkaataa hojjetan tooftaa walii waan beekaniif wal eegu, wal hin saaman; seera gartuu shiraa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Honor among thieves; a thief does not rob another thief; rogue actors recognize each other's tricks and respect mutual turf out of complicity

proverb: Ana anaa, booddeen bada ana
meaning_om: Namni of tuuluu, of jajuu fi of dura oofuu baay'isu dhuma irratti kufaatii fi salphina guddaa keessa gala; booni booda isaa badiisa
meaning_en: 'It's all about me, me!', but in the end it's 'Woe is me!'; vanity and boastful arrogance invariably culminate in humiliating ruin and bitter regret

proverb: Na argaa na argaa, booddeen na dhoysaa dha
meaning_om: Namni of mul'isuu fi of jajuuf wacu yeroo balleessaan isaa bahee qaaniin dhufu orma duraa dhokachuuf fiiga; of argisiisuun booda qaanii fida
meaning_en: 'Look at me, look at me!', but the end of it is 'Hide me, hide me!'; ostentatious exhibitionism ends in desperate attempts to hide from public disgrace

proverb: "Gaarri nuti keessatti hin dhuufin hin jiru" jette, harreen
meaning_om: Gocha salphaa fi fokkisaa ta'e akka waan gootummaatti lakkaa'anii dhaadachuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a; qaanfii dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: 'There isn't a mountain where we haven't farted,' said the donkey; satirizes boorish fools who proudly boast of their vulgar antics as grand conquests

proverb: "Manni gowwaa eessa" jennaan "karaarra" je'e
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan iccitii, maatii fi qabeenya ofiitiif eeggannoo hin goone hundumaaf saaxilamaa ta'ee jireenyi isaa karaarra bula; daangaa dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: When asked 'Where is the fool's house?', he replied, 'Right on the roadside!'; fools leave their lives, secrets, and private business exposed to every passerby

proverb: Namni hundaan beeka je'u, takkallee hin beeku
meaning_om: Namni waan hunda beeka jedhee dhaadatu bu'uura beekumsaa akka hin qabnee fi of tuulummaan qalbii isaa akka jaamse agarsiisa; beekaan dhugaa of hin jaju
meaning_en: The one who claims to know everything knows nothing at all; professing universal knowledge is the surest proof of deep ignorance and intellectual vanity

proverb: Namni if faarsu, mucha re'ee hin gahu
meaning_om: Namni afaaniin of faarsu hojii fi bu'aan isaa baay'ee xiqqoodha; namni of jaju gatii qabatamaa hin qabu
meaning_en: A person who sings his own praises does not even measure up to a goat's teat; chronic self-promoters possess negligible substance and true worth

proverb: Nama caalaan beeka jettee, jaldhaaba na hin dhaabin
meaning_om: Beekumsa sobaatiin dhaadatanii nama biraa akka meeshaa qorichaatti yookaan bakka bu'aa bu'aa dhabeessaatti fayyadamuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Saying 'I know better than anyone', don't set me up like a scarecrow!; do not let arrogant overconfidence push others into exposed, sham positions

proverb: Of jajjuun mana ishee gubdeeti, ofii keessatti gubatti
meaning_om: Of jajuu fi boonaan daangaa darbe nama qalbii dhabsiisee wanta mataa ofii balleessu keessa nama buusa; of tuulummaan badiisa fida
meaning_en: The boastful woman sets her own house on fire and ends up burning inside it; unchecked vanity and showy recklessness consume the boaster herself

proverb: Namni niin beeka jedhu, of malee hin argu
meaning_om: Namni beekumsa ofiitti boonu yaadaa fi dandeettii ormaa hin argu, of tuulummaan ija isaa jaamsa; beekumsi sobaa nama kophummaa keessa galcha
meaning_en: The person who constantly declares 'I know' sees none but himself; intellectual arrogance blinds a person to the wisdom and perspectives of others

proverb: Ni beeyta ni beeyta jennaan, jaartiin kabiiraa kitaaba dhiyxe
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii hin qabne faaruu fi jaja sobaatiin boonee wanta miidhaa guddaa fidu akka waan gaariitti raawwatee qabeenya mancaasuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Flattered by people telling her 'You know everything!', the scholar's wife washed his manuscript in water; flattery emboldens incompetence to ruin treasures

proverb: Daalleen dhaqa hin du'uu, galee oduun du'a
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan balaa fi qorumsa keessaa nagaan bahee booda afaan isaatiin wanta hin malle odeessee badiisa ofitti fida; afaan ofiitiin of saaxiluu ibsa
meaning_en: The fool does not perish on the hazardous journey; he dies of foolish chatter once he returns home; surviving real dangers only to die by loose talk

proverb: Of argisiisuun, nama qaanessa
meaning_om: Of jajuu fi akka nama guddaatti of mul'isuuf tattaafachuun dhuma irratti salphinaa fi yeellootti nama geessa; gad-of-qabuutu ulfina fida
meaning_en: Showing off and ostentatious posturing inevitably bring disgrace; boastful vanity ends up exposing one's flaws and humiliating the boaster

proverb: Namni waan arge kadhataa, okkotee koo naa dhoksaa jette jaartiin
meaning_om: Wanta gatii hin qabne akka waan gati-jabeessaatti yaaduun ormarraa dhoksuuf dhiphachuu qishnaan ceepha'a; doqnummaa fi yaaddoo sobaa ibsa
meaning_en: 'People beg for whatever they see; hide my earthenware pot!' said the old woman; satirizes paranoid stinginess and inflating the value of common items

proverb: If dhaadaan dhagaa, awwaalamu'llee hin tortoru ja'a
meaning_om: Wanta faayidaa fi lubbuu hin qabne akka waan gati-jabeessaatti faarsuun gowwummaadha; faayidaa dhugaa dhabuu dhoksuuf qooda laafaa jajuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The one who boasts of stone says 'Even when buried, it never rots!'; praising a dead, useless object for an irrelevant trait to distract from its lack of worth

proverb: Udaan koo nyaattee, foon koo lagatte jette hantuuni
meaning_om: Namoonni wanta xuraa'aa nama tokkoo osoo hin balfin fayyadamanii, gaafa dhimmi guddaan dhufu garuu qulqulluu of fakkeessanii tuffachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'You ate my droppings, yet you act squeamish about my meat,' said the rat; exposes hypocrisy in people who swallow corrupt benefits yet feign purity

proverb: Wayaan of jajaa, utuu nafa hin ga'in lafa geessi
meaning_om: Namni of tuuluu fi dhaadachuun beekamu wanta hojjetu madaaluu dadhabee qaanii fi salphinatti of geessa; koorri salphina fida
meaning_en: The garment of a boastful man sweeps the ground before it properly covers his body; pretentious vanity makes a person drag their dignity in the dirt

proverb: Waan bareedinaa kanaan, kaarruu koo hin agartanii jedhe gaalli
meaning_om: Namni bifaaniis ta'ee amalaan guutuu hin taane wanta xiqqoo tokko akka waan bareedina guddaatti faarsee of jajuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'With all this beauty of mine, don't you see my charming tooth-gap?' said the camel; mocks an unattractive person boasting over an absurd minor feature

proverb: Intala sirba jajan, booda ulfa jajani
meaning_om: Gocha daangaa darbee fi bashannana qaanfii hin qabne faarsuun dhuma irratti salphinaa fi badiisa guddaatti akka geessu akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: The maiden whose wild dancing they applauded, later they gossip over her pregnancy; reckless vanity and wild applause lead to predictable social disgrace

proverb: Wal jajjuun wal quba hin qabduu wal duubaa laga dhaqxi
meaning_om: Namoonni fuulduratti wal faarsanii garuu dhugaan wal hin jaallanne shira walirratti xaxu, dhoksaatti wal miidhu; michooma sobaa saaxila
meaning_en: Mutual flatterers who care nothing for each other slip down to the river behind each other's backs; flatterers exchange praise while scheming in secret

proverb: Achi na hin qabin jette, kan hudduu hin qabne
meaning_om: Namni wanta sana hin qabne akka waan qabuutti kajeellee eeggachuuf yaaluu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a; hanqina ofii dhoksuuf qoollifachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Don't touch me there!' said the one who has no buttocks; satirizes acting touchy, coy, or protective over assets or virtues that one does not even possess

proverb: Ejersa halaalaarra, qobboo qa'ee wayya
meaning_om: Wanta qabatamaan dhihoo jiru isa salphaa ta'eyyuu itti fayyadamuun, isa gati-jabeessa ta'ee fagoo jiru hawwuu caala; wanta dhihoo jiruuf dursa kennuu barsiisa
