meaning_en: Better a humble castor-oil plant by the yard than a noble olive tree far away; immediate, available resources are far more practical than distant, inaccessible treasures

proverb: Fira fagoorra, ollaa dhihoo wayya
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan tasaa yookaan rakkon dhufe kan dafee nama qaqqabee nama oolchu ollaa dhihooti malee fira fagoo jiru miti; ollaa kabajuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Better a close neighbor than a distant relative; when emergency strikes, it is the nearby neighbor who arrives first to rescue, while distant kin are far away

proverb: Nama ollaan nagayaatu, nagaya qaba
meaning_om: Nageenyi nama dhuunfaa kan mirkanaa'u yoo ollaan nagaa qabaate qofa; jeequmsi fi dhiphinni ollaa gara manaa darbuun nagaa nama dhorka
meaning_en: He whose neighbor is at peace enjoys peace; one cannot enjoy personal safety and domestic tranquility while one's neighbor's house is in turmoil

proverb: Ollaa fi garaan nama hin dhibin
meaning_om: Rakkina nama dhiphisu keessaa ollaa hamaa fi beela/dhibee garaati; lamaan kanarraa nagaa ta'uun bu'uura jireenyaati
meaning_en: May neither your neighbor nor your stomach trouble you; the two greatest daily sources of ceaseless torment are an evil neighbor outside and chronic hunger within

proverb: Booyichi ollaa, rafu nama dhoowwa
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi gaddi ollaa keessatti uumame dhiibbaa isaa gara ofiitti fida malee callisanii dantaa dhabuun hin danda'amu; gaddi ollaa kan hundaati
meaning_en: The wailing of a neighbor prevents one from sleeping; a neighbor's grief or crisis inevitably breaches your walls and disrupts your peace; communal interdependence

proverb: Ati nagaa dhaan buluuf, ollaan kee nagaa dhaan haa bulu
meaning_om: Nageenyi kee nageenya ollaa keetiin walqabata; ollaan kee yoo balaa fi dhiphina keessa bule atis nagaan buluu hin dandeessu; nagaa ollaa eeguun kan ofiiti
meaning_en: For you to spend the night in peace, your neighbor must spend the night in peace; your personal security is inseparable from the safety and calm of your neighbors

proverb: Ollaan hamaan, kafana injiraawe
meaning_om: Ollaan amala badaa qabu dhiphina walirraa hin cinne fiduun akkuma uffata xuraa'aatti nama ciniina, boqonnaa nama dhorka; ollaa hamaa irraa fagaachuu ibsa
meaning_en: A wicked neighbor is like a lice-infested burial shroud; an inescapable, creeping torment that clings to you and denies you rest even in your shelter

proverb: Akkoon namaa hin taane, ollaan gargar nama baafti
meaning_om: Namni maatii keessatti kabajamaa ta'ee osoo nagaa buusuu qabuu odeessaa fi hasasaan ollaa walitti naqu nagaa diiga; jaarsa yookaan akkoo hamtuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: An unprincipled, meddlesome grandmother causes estrangement between neighbors; an elder who should anchor peace can tear apart harmony through gossip

proverb: Ollaan hamaan, dhukkuba sonbaati
meaning_om: Ollaa amala badaa qabaachuun akkuma dhibee sonbaa suuta suutaan nama nyaatuutti, jireenya fi nagaa namaa guyyuma guyyaan mancaasa
meaning_en: A bad neighbor is like a lung disease; a chronic, debilitating affliction that drains your vitality and happiness from within, offering no relief

proverb: Obsan warroomani
meaning_om: Maatiin, bultiin fi hariiroon jabaan kan ijaaramuu fi itti fufiinsa qabaatu obsa cimaan yoo qorumsa danda'an qofaadha; obsi bu'uura bultiiti
meaning_en: Through patience, people establish a family and household; enduring domestic trials, forgiveness, and forbearance are the foundation of lasting marriage

proverb: Obsaan aannan goromsaa dhuga
meaning_om: Namni obsaan eeggatu wanta jalqabarratti hin danda'amne yookaan fagoo fakkaatu dhuma irratti firii isaa dhandhama; obsi bu'aa mi'aawaa fida
meaning_en: The patient person drinks the milk of a young heifer; by waiting for a heifer to mature and calve, the patient shepherd enjoys rich milk; patience yields sweet fruit

proverb: Obsaatu daadhii bar hegeree dhuga
meaning_om: Namni dharraa fi jarjara yeroo qofaan hin oofamne, obsee yeroo eeggachuudhaan wanta gati-jabeessa gara fuulduraatti qophaa'u dhandhama
meaning_en: It is patience that drinks next year's honey-mead; delay of gratification allows fine things to ferment and mature; the patient enjoy tomorrow's bounty

proverb: Laga boorawe, xaliilchan malee hin dhugani
meaning_om: Dubbii yookaan haala aariin jeeqame tasgabbeessanii fi qulqulleessanii malee murtii keessa hin seenan; aarii jiddutti murtii dhowwa
meaning_en: A muddy river is not drunk until allowed to settle clear; never make decisions or drink from a dispute while emotions churn; wait for waters to clear before acting

proverb: Obsan qaalloman
meaning_om: Sadarkaa guddaa, beekumsaa fi kabaja ol-aanaa argachuun obsa cimaa fi qorumsa danda'uu gaafata; obsi gara guddinaatti nama ceesisa
meaning_en: Through patience, people attain the stature of a revered Qaalluu; spiritual elevation, moral authority, and community reverence are achieved only through patience

proverb: Kokkoflii taphadhu, garaan madaa hin dhabuu
meaning_om: Namni gammadus, koflus jireenya keessa dhibee fi gaddi akka jiru dagachuu hin qabu; kofla keessattis madaallii fi qalbii qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Laugh and play heartily, yet know that the heart is never without its wounds; enjoy festivity with balance and empathy, mindful of human vulnerability

proverb: Osoo beeknuu, huubaa wajji jette sareen
meaning_om: Namni haala rakkisaa fi hanqina jiru osoo beekuu dirqama jireenyaatiif jedhee wanta hin tolle danda'ee fudhachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'Fully aware, we gulp it down along with the dirt,' said the dog; pragmatically accepting flaws, imperfections, or compromised terms out of necessity

proverb: Akka aaraniin, muka hin darbani
meaning_om: Aarii fi dallansuu qabaatanis meeshaa fi qabeenya ofii isa jireenyaaf barbaachisu gatuu yookaan caccabsuun hin ta'u; aariin qabeenya akka hin balleessine of to'achuu barsiisa
meaning_en: One does not throw away the firewood in the heat of rage; do not destroy vital household assets, burn bridges, or wreck your tools simply because you lost your temper

proverb: Akka aaraniin muka darbani, waan bobeeysan dhabani
meaning_om: Namni aariidhaan wanta harkaa qabu mancaase booda yeroo rakkootti wanta ittiin jiraatu dhabee gaabba; aariin kasaaraa fida
meaning_en: Having hurled away the firewood in a fit of rage, they found themselves with nothing to burn; rash destructive anger leaves one cold, hungry, and full of regret

proverb: Turri damma hin busheeysu
meaning_om: Wanti qulqulluu, bu'uura gaarii fi dhugaa qabu yoo tureyyuu hin badu, gatiin isaa hin hir'atu; dhugaan yoomiyyuu dhuguma
meaning_en: Aging and delay do not spoil pure honey; true virtue, justice, quality, and proven character do not deteriorate with the passage of time; patience preserves goodness

proverb: Sabrii qocaa, Rabbi sii haa kennu
meaning_om: Eebba obsaa fi tasgabbiiti; akkuma qocaan suuta jedhee deemsa isaa itti fufu, atis jireenya keessatti obsa cimaa fi tasgabbii hin dhumne qabaadhu jedhanii eebbisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: May God grant you the patience of a tortoise; a blessing wishing someone unflinching, slow, and indestructible patience to endure life's longest trials without losing heart

proverb: Garaan, waa hunda baadhata
meaning_om: Qalbiin namaa dhiphina, gadda, aarii, gammachuu fi iccitii hundumaa of keessatti ukkaamsee danda'uu akka qabu; bal'ina sammuu fi obsa agarsiisa
meaning_en: The heart/belly bears all things; the human spirit has the profound moral and psychological capacity to absorb sorrows, insults, and secrets with silent fortitude

proverb: Garaan waraanuma jibba
meaning_om: Namni qalbii qabu jecha, komii fi arrabsoo salphaatti danda'a; wanti inni dhugumaan sodaatu yookaan balaa guddaan isa miidhu waraana qabatamaa qofaadha; obsa cimaa ibsa
meaning_en: The heart hates only a literal piercing spear; a resilient soul absorbs insults, gossip, and hardships without flinching, recoiling only from lethal physical destruction

proverb: Aannan itittuutu, dhadhaa baha
meaning_om: Wanti tokko firii gaarii fi mi'aawaa kan kennu yoo yeroo kennameefii obsaan ititeedha; jarjarri firii gaarii hin fidu
meaning_en: It is milk that has curdled and settled that yields butter; great, rich, and lasting achievements are only produced through patient maturation and steady processing

proverb: Namni Qoree hin bulfanne, dubbii hin bulfatu
meaning_om: Namni miidhaa yookaan dhukkubbii xiqqoo obsee yeroo hin kennine, waldhabdee fi aarii cimaa obsee nagaan furuu hin danda'u; obsa dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A person who cannot sleep through the night with a thorn in his foot will never sleep over a dispute; one who cannot endure minor irritation cannot handle conflict

proverb: Araarsaan hin aaru
meaning_om: Namni araara buusu fi jaarsummaa taa'u aarii fi dheekkamsa irraa bilisa ta'uu qaba; aariin araara barbadeessa
meaning_en: A peacemaker does not lose his temper; anyone undertaking customary arbitration and reconciliation must possess absolute emotional discipline and impartiality

proverb: Raabsaan, nama qoma bal'atu
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya yookaan soorata qoodu komii, inaaffaa fi aarii namootaa obsaan danda'uuf qalbii bal'aa fi arjummaa qabaachuu qaba
meaning_en: The distributor must be a person of broad chest; anyone in charge of apportioning scarce resources must have vast patience to absorb complaints without bitterness

proverb: Gaalli sagal dhabsuu bule, kurneessaaf hin duune
meaning_om: Qorumsaa fi dhiphina dheeraa erga dandamatanii booda abdii kutachuu hin qaban; obsaan cichanii xumura gaariitti gahuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The camel went without water for nine days, yet it did not perish on the tenth; do not surrender to despair at the final hour; hold out for deliverance

proverb: Madaa ramachaa oobsanii, dhullaa dhaaf hin dhukkubsani
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi qorumsa guddaa isa duraanii erga dandamatanii booda, rakkoo xiqqoo ammaa dhufeef dhiphachuu fi nuffuun hin barbaachisu; jabinna agarsiisa
meaning_en: Having endured a maggot-infested ulcer, one does not whine over a simple boil; someone who has survived catastrophic agony should not lose composure over minor pains

proverb: Waan dabruuf jecha, if hin dabarsani
meaning_om: Dhiphinni, beellii fi qorumsi yeroodhaaf dhufe ni darba waan ta'eef, sababa sanaan lubbuu yookaan naamusa ofii barbadeessuu hin qaban; obsuu barsiisa
meaning_en: For the sake of what will pass, do not destroy yourself; temporary hardship is fleeting; never compromise your honor, life, or integrity over a passing storm

proverb: Bakka fiiganii dhaqan, suuta deemaniis numa dhaqani
meaning_om: Jarjaraan osoo hin taane, suuta jedhanii fi of eeggannoodhaan deemuun nagaan galma gahuuf bu'uura; saffisni tasgabbii hin caalu
meaning_en: The destination reached by running is also reached by walking slowly; steady, methodical steps bring you safely to your goal without the hazards of rushing

proverb: Namni suuta deemu, daddagalfateetuma dhaa'uu nyaata
meaning_om: Namni tasgabbaa'ee fi of eeggannoodhaan deemu carraawwan gaarii karaarratti argee fayyadama; jarjarri carraa nama jalaa dhabsiisa
meaning_en: The one who walks slowly and observes carefully grazes on sweet berries; a measured pace allows you to harvest opportunities that reckless rushers bypass

proverb: Duula dhaqa hin faarsan, gala faarsan malee
meaning_om: Hojii yookaan murtii tokko jalqaba isaatti osoo hin taane, firii fi milkaa'ina dhuma irratti argameen madaalanii faarsu; xumuraaf dursa kennuu
meaning_en: A military expedition is not praised on the march out, but on the return; never boast at the launch of an endeavor; praise belongs only to victorious returns

proverb: Dura koruphoon foon haa taatu
meaning_om: Wanti tokko qabatamaan osoo harka hin galin fi hin xumuramin akka waan milkaa'eetti itti hin fayyadaminaa; qabatamummaa dursuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: First, let the duiker actually become meat in the pot; do not divide the feast while the quarry is still running in the bush; secure results before celebrating

proverb: Jarjaranii nama hin faarsani deebi'ani arrabsuutu nama dhibaa
meaning_om: Nama tokko osoo amala isaa hin qoratin dafanii faarsuu dhiisuu; booda yoo inni balleesse deebisanii arrabsuun qaanii fida
meaning_en: Do not lavish praise on someone in a rush; having to reverse course and curse them later brings embarrassment; measure character over time before celebrating

proverb: Karfaffuu hin dubbannee, karkarsuuf maa boocha?
meaning_om: Rakkoon xiqqoon yeroo jalqabamu osoo hin mormin cal'isanii, gaafa inni guddatee balaa fidu iyyuun bu'aa hin qabu; jalqabarratti furmaata barbaaduu ibsa
meaning_en: You said nothing at the light drizzle; why do you weep now at the torrential storm?; ignoring early warnings leaves you with no right to cry when disaster strikes

proverb: Haa bariitu, waa akkanatti hin haftuu
meaning_om: Dukkanni, rakkinnii fi dhiphinni ammaa akka darbuu fi wanti hundi iftoomina fi furmaata akka argatu abdachuu; abdii jabaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Let the day break; things will not remain like this!; a resolute cry of hope that the darkness of present oppression will be swept away by morning light

proverb: Hamma raatu, diroon dhadhaa baati
meaning_om: Namni tattaaffii fi carraaqqii isaa walirraa hin kunne dhuma irratti firii fi bu'aa milkaa'inaa argata; cichoominni bu'aa fida
meaning_en: As long as it is churned, the vessel will yield butter; continuous, rhythmic exertion and patient labor will inevitably produce sweet, rich results

proverb: Rakkattu malee, hin bal'attu
meaning_om: Qorumsa, beelaa fi dhiphina danda'anii yoo keessa hin darbine badhaadhinaa fi guddina dhugaa argachuun hin danda'amu; qorumsi bu'uura milkaa'inaati
meaning_en: Unless you pass through narrow constriction and hardship, you will not attain expansive prosperity; struggle and tight straits precede broad flourishing

proverb: Hadhaaf hargeeysa dhuguu hin dadhabne
meaning_om: Wanti tokko hangamiyyuu hadhaawaa fi rakkisaa yoo ta'e, bu'aa fi fayyina isaatiif jedhanii obsaan danda'anii fudhachuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: For all its bitterness, they did not refuse to drink healing aloe; humans readily swallow the most pungent remedies when they know it brings genuine recovery

proverb: Waan nama afaan deemaa, afaan hin deemani
meaning_om: Oduu, ololaa fi arrabsoo namaatiin dhiibamanii karoora fi jireenya ofii jallisuu hin qaban; qalbii ofiitiin socho'uu barsiisa
meaning_en: One does not direct one's speech or life according to whatever babbles from other people's mouths; do not allow public rumors or gossip to dictate your path

proverb: Lolaaf ootaa, lollinuu nama oosa
meaning_om: Namni osoo waraana hin argin afaaniin dhaadatu yeroo lola qabatamaa keessa seenu naasuu fi reebichaan cal'isa; gootummaan dhaadannoo miti
meaning_en: One brags eager for battle, but the battle itself silences the boaster; those who boast of fighting are swiftly and violently humbled once true warfare begins

proverb: Haa usnuu hamma hubannuu, haa bariitu waa akkanatti hin haftuu
meaning_om: Dhimmi tokko osoo hin qulqullaa'in dura callisanii ilaaluu fi yeroon dhugaa akka baasu obsaan eeggachuun ogummaa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Let us remain silent until we fully comprehend; let the day break, for things will not remain like this; practice dignified silence and wait for clarity

proverb: "Haati kee bareeddii" jennaan, "karaa kana dhuftii eegii laalii" jedheen
meaning_om: Wanta ijaan mirkaneeffachuun danda'amu afaaniin faarsuu mannaa, ragaa qabatamaa dhiheessuutu amansiisaa dha; ragaaf dursa kennuu
meaning_en: Asked 'Is your mother beautiful?', he said, 'She walks down this road; wait and see!'; let facts and direct evidence speak rather than boasting with words

proverb: Iftaan fago seetee, borumaatu jidduu jiraa
meaning_om: Wanti fuulduraa dafee akka qaqqabu, yeroon saffisaan darbuu isaa beekanii boriif qophaa'uu akka qaban akeekkachiisa; fageenyi yeroo soba
meaning_en: You think the day after tomorrow is far away, yet only tomorrow stands between; time rushes by with speed; the future is much closer than you think

proverb: Qilee, osoo hin bayne, harka hin kaayani
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan qorumsa keessaa guutummaatti osoo hin ba'in dura afaan guutanii hin dhaadatani; milkaa'ina dhuma irratti mirkaneeffatu
meaning_en: Do not throw your hands in celebration until you have safely climbed out of the abyss; never celebrate victory while still standing in the pit of danger

proverb: Qaaliin ni bahaa, Qaaniitu hin baane
meaning_om: Qaalinni fi gabaan yeroo tokko mi'aawus yeroodhaan gadi bu'uu danda'a; yeelloon fi qaaniin namarra gahe garuu yoomiyyuu hin dhabamu
meaning_en: High prices and economic inflation pass away, but shame and dishonor never fade; material hardship is temporary, but a stain upon one's honor endures forever

proverb: Qaanawan malee, hin du'ani
meaning_om: Qaaniin yookaan salphinni hangamiyyuu nama gubee nama dhiphisu, lubbuun namaa akkuma jirutti itti fufti; salphina danda'anii jireenya itti fufuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One endures shame, but does not die from it; however agonizing public embarrassment may feel, physical life goes on and one must endure and overcome it

proverb: Guyyaan qaanii tokkuma
meaning_om: Qaaniin yookaan salphinni namarra gahu yeroo gabaabaa keessatti ifatti mul'atee darba; yeroo dheeraaf dhiphachuurra gaafa sana danda'anii dabarsuutu fala
meaning_en: The day of acute shame is but one day; the sharp sting of public humiliation is concentrated on the day of exposure; face it bravely and it will pass

proverb: Qaaniin qaamaa (nafaa) huccuu keeysa
meaning_om: Akkuma uffanni hanqinaa fi qaanii qaamaa uwwisu, amalli gaariin fi safeeffannaanis hanqina namaa dhoksee kabaja namaaf kenna; of uwwisuu barsiisa
meaning_en: The shame of the body is kept hidden inside clothing; just as clothes cover physical nakedness, modesty and decorum conceal human flaws and protect dignity

proverb: Kan hin saalfanne, nama saalfachiisa
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatii qaanfii fi safuu hin qabne gocha fokkisaa raawwachuudhaan namoota naannoo isaatti argaman saalfachiisa, qaanii itti ta'a
meaning_en: One who lacks shame makes others feel ashamed for him; a shameless person behaves with such brazen indecency that onlookers cringe on his behalf

proverb: Namni hin saalfaattuu, eegee soqolatee sussukti
meaning_om: Namni qaanfii fi safeeffannaa hin qabne qaanii ofii osoo hin dhoksin bakkeetti mul'isee akka waan homaa hin taaneetti boonuu fi socho'uu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A shameless person hikes up their tail and trots along; satirizes a brazen person who flaunts their moral indecency in public without the slightest blush

proverb: Fokkataan hin qaanfatu
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa yookaan gochi isaa duraanuu fokkisaa ta'e qaanii fi yeelloo hin beeku; duraanuu safuu waan hin qabneef wanta fedhe raawwata
meaning_en: The repulsive person feels no shame; someone of ugly character or base habits is immune to shame; lacking moral sensitivity, they cannot be humbled

proverb: Fokkataan qaanii hin qabuu, dukkanaa ka'eeti ifa dhaabbata
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa xuraa'aa fi fokkisaa ta'e qaanii dhabuudhaan bakka hundatti of mul'isuuf ifatti baha; qaanfii malee of saaxiluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The shameless, repulsive person has no modesty; emerging from shadows, he brazenly stands in the bright light, thrusting his flaws into the public glare

proverb: Yoo qaanawuu fedhan, dheeysan ganda keeysa
meaning_om: Wanta qaanii fi salphina fidu dhoksuu dhiisanii bakkee fi hawaasa keessatti baasanii dhiheessuun qaanii dachaa fida; dhimma ofii bakkeetti baasuu dhowwa
meaning_en: If you desire to be completely disgraced, run for refuge through the center of the village; fleeing through the public square broadcasts your shame to all

proverb: "Kan baranaa lakkisii, Koottuu harka koo harkisi" jedhe hattuun haadha manaatiin, harki okkotee keessatti didnaan
meaning_om: Namni shiraa fi daba raawwachuuf dhufe osoo hojii isaa hin xumurin yeroo qabamu qaanfatee gargaarsa nama duraan miidhuuf ka'e sana kadhata
meaning_en: 'Forget about the theft; just pull my hand out!' said the thief to the housewife when his hand got stuck in the pot; caught red-handed in comical trapped greed

proverb: "Yaa aayyoo ana kan qaanii hin beeyne malee, Kan qaanii beeku qaata du'e" je'e jaartii soddaatiin, kan buqqee daymaa keeysatti harki dide
meaning_om: Namni safuu fi qaanii hin qabne erga gocha fokkisaadhaan qabamee boodallee ija-jabinnaan wanta dubbatu hin dhabu; qaanfii dhabuu cimaa ibsa
meaning_en: 'Mother, only a shameless wretch like me could survive; anyone decent would have dropped dead of shame!' said the son-in-law caught with his hand in the honey gourd

proverb: Tan qullaa kaate daran, tan ibsaa ofiitti qabde
meaning_om: Balleessaa hojjechuurra, balleessaa sana beekaa ifatti baasanii dhaadachuun fi of saaxiluun daran qaanii guddaadha; safuu dhabuu daran caalaa ibsa
meaning_en: Far worse than the woman who ran naked is the one who held up a lamp to illuminate her nakedness; committing a vice is bad, but proudly flaunting it is depravity

proverb: Akka lama jedhe, Kan re'ee irraa kufe
meaning_om: Wanta salphaa fi gabaabaa ta'erraa kufuun ofuma isaatiiyyuu qaanii ta'ee osoo jiruu, dabalataan miidhaan irra gahuun salphina dachaa ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: 'Double disgrace!' said the man who fell off a goat; falling from a tiny, low goat is already a ridiculous embarrassment, and getting injured doubles the humiliation

proverb: "Baasa lama" je'e, kan kufee dhuufe
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan kufaatii mudate irratti wanti qaanii fi salphina fidu biraa itti dabalamee qaanii dachaa fiduu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'A double catastrophe!' said the one who stumbled and broke wind simultaneously; suffering an embarrassing physical fall compounded by an audible social indignity

proverb: Baranoon hin saalfattuu, fokkattuun hin qaanfattu
meaning_om: Namoonni haala isaaniitti amantee hin qabne yookaan qaanfii hin beekne bakka hundatti ija-jabinnaan dhihaatanii safuu cabsu; qaanfii dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The new co-wife feels no modesty; the repulsive woman feels no shame; those who have cast off natural social restraint act with brazen, disruptive boldness

proverb: Fira duraa bahan malee fafa duraa hin bahani
meaning_om: Firaa fi maatii ofii dheessanii fagaachuun danda'amuyyuu, maqaa badaa, fafa fi salphina dhalootaa jalaa miliquun hin danda'amu; fafi nama hordofa
meaning_en: You may run away from your relatives, but you can never escape your disgrace; public scandal and ancestral stigma follow wherever you relocate

proverb: Ija jechuun tan waa argitu, tuun xannacha
meaning_om: Ijji dhugaan ishee hubattuu fi dursee argituudha malee, qaamni wanta mul'atu ilaalee hin hubanne akka xannachaatti gatii hin qabu; dammaqina qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: An eye is that which actually perceives; otherwise, it is merely a gland of flesh; true vision consists of discernment and insight, not mere physical eyeballs

proverb: Namni dubbii cinaa hin beekne, cinaacha cabsan hin beeku
meaning_om: Namni dubbii marfataa, gorsaa fi mallattoo xiqqoo hubachuu dadhabe balaa guddaa qaama isaarratti dhufu illee duraan dursee baruu hin danda'u
meaning_en: One who fails to grasp a subtle hint in speech will not even know when his ribs are broken; someone obtuse to social cues will be blindsided by ruin

proverb: Yaada malee, ijji ilaaleef hin argu
meaning_om: Sammuun yoo xiyyeeffannaa hin qabaanne ijji wanta ilaaltu sirriitti hubachuu hin dandeessu; arguun bu'aa yaadaati
meaning_en: Without mindful reflection, the looking eye does not truly see; vision requires an engaged mind; without mental focus, the eyes stare in blindness

proverb: Ija gara duubaatiin hin argine, mutaan ifirraa baasuu wayya
meaning_om: Dammaqinni fi eeggannoon fuuldura qofa osoo hin taane dhimma duubaan dhufuufis barbaachisaadha; namni naannoo isaa hunda hin eegganne saaxilamaadha
meaning_en: An eye that cannot watch one's back, better to pluck it out with an awl; vision which fails to detect dangers coming from behind is useless

proverb: Sa'a jechuun jabbi, nama jechuun qalbi
meaning_om: Akkuma horiin jabbileen itti fufiinsa qabaatu, namummaan dhugaanis qalbii, sammuu fi naamusaan madaalama malee qaamaan qofa miti
meaning_en: Cattle are defined by their calves, and humans by their intellect and heart; what makes cattle valuable is progeny, and what makes a human worthy is moral intellect

proverb: Dhiira qaamtu ijaa, saree ayliin funyaani
meaning_om: Dhiirri dammaqinaa fi qalbii isaa ijaan calaqqisiisa, sareen ammoo funyaan isheetiin wanta hunda adda baafatti; dandeettii uumamaa ibsa
meaning_en: A man's perception and sharpness are in his eyes; a dog's wits are in its nose; each species relies on its primary sensory organ to discern truth

proverb: Gurra qabaataniif hin dhaga'ani, qalbii qabaatan malee
meaning_om: Gurri qaamaa sagalee qofa qabata malee ergaa fi dhugaa hubachuuf qalbii fi sammuun xiyyeeffannaa kennuun dirqama; dhaggeeffachuun qalbii gaafata
meaning_en: Having ears does not mean one hears, unless one possesses an attentive heart and mind; true listening requires intellectual engagement and comprehension

proverb: Ijaan ballaan karaa hin argu, Yaadaan ballaan dubbii hin argu
meaning_om: Akkuma namni jaamaan daandii qabatamaa arguun dadhabu, namni sammuun jaamees ergaa, gorsaa fi dhugaa dubbii hubachuu hin danda'u
meaning_en: The physically blind cannot see the road, and the mentally blind cannot perceive the truth of discourse; intellectual blindness is far more crippling

proverb: Eegaan gale, naaf gale
meaning_om: Dhimmi yookaan gorsi tokko yeroo haasa'amu osoo hin taane, booda yeroo namni qofaatti galee tasgabbaa'ee yaadu ifa ta'ee hubatamuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Only after I arrived home did it finally dawn on me; deep realization or understanding of a subtle counsel often sinks in only after quiet reflection at home

proverb: Faltii qaawaan darbi, dubbii qaamaan bari
meaning_om: Akkuma dhoqqee fi xurii irraa fagaatanii karaan darban, dubbiis odeessa ormaatiin osoo hin taane qaama dhimmi ilaallaturraa qabatamaan hubachuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Step around dung through the clear gap; verify disputes directly from the primary party; avoid stepping in messy gossip and ascertain facts directly

proverb: Kan aalaa baalaan hin beekne, dubbii haalaan hin beeku
meaning_om: Namni mallattoolee xixiqqoo uumamaa hubachuu dadhabe akkaataa haasaa fi ilaalcha namootaa qoratee baruu hin danda'u; dammaqina dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: One who cannot identify wild plants by their leaves cannot read human intention through speech and mannerisms; lacking basic observation blinds one

proverb: Haadha namatti dabdu, abbaatu beeka
meaning_om: Namni alaan akka gaariitti mul'atus, amala isaa isa dhokataa fi jal'ina isaa kan sirriitti beeku nama dhihoo isaati; dhugaa keessoo beekuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The mother who is deceitful to outsiders, her husband knows her true nature best; intimate household partners see the unvarnished character hidden from the public

proverb: Garaa garaa hatu, garaan haa too'atu
meaning_om: Namni shiraa fi yaada dhokataadhaan nama miidhuu fedhu, qalbii fi qulqullummaa keessa isaatiin of qorachuutu irra jiraata; of-to'annoo qalbii barsiisa
meaning_en: The heart that secretly steals from another heart, let its own conscience restrain it; moral self-scrutiny must curb secret malice and deceit

proverb: Namatti himan malee, namatti hin hidhani
meaning_om: Namni nama gorsuu fi dhugaa itti himuu danda'a malee, dirqamaan yaada ofii nama irratti fe'uu hin danda'u; filannoon kan abbaati
meaning_en: You can give advice to a person, but you cannot bind it onto their limbs; you can offer wisdom, but acceptance remains an individual's sovereign choice

proverb: Re'ee dhiirti hin elmitu, hamma cophxu hin wallaaltu
meaning_om: Namni dhimma tokko kallattiin yoo hojjechuu baateyyuu, bu'aa fi adeemsa isaa beekuu irraa hin hafu; beekumsi daangaa hojii hin qabu
meaning_en: A man does not milk a goat, yet he knows full well how many drops she yields; one does not have to perform a manual chore personally to understand its output

proverb: Waan gowwaan gorsani, beekaan fudhata
meaning_om: Namni qaxaleen gorsa nama gowwaadhaaf kenname dhaga'ee ergaa isaanii ofiif fayyadama; beekaan dogoggora ormaarraayyuu ni barata
meaning_en: What is advised to the fool, the wise person absorbs; an intelligent person listens to warnings directed at fools and applies the lessons to himself

proverb: Gowwaa sadi keessaa, gammi tokko hin dhabamu
meaning_om: Namoota gowwaa ta'an keessattiyyuu yeroo tokko tokko yaanni sirriin yookaan qabxiin gaariin ni argama; homaa tuffatamuu hin qabu
meaning_en: Among three fools, a flash of cleverness is never missing; even among simpletons, an occasional stroke of brilliance or accidental truth emerges

proverb: Namni aaggata dhawina hin seene, dhawaniis hin dubbatu
meaning_om: Namni akeekkachiisa duraa tuffatee hin dammaqne gaafa miidhaan qabatamaan irra gahu fala dhabee cal'isa; dursee akeekkachiisa baruu dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: He who did not take a raised fist as a blow will not utter a word when struck down; one who ignores obvious warnings is paralyzed when disaster arrives

proverb: "Utuu haasofnuu, suni Nagarii Gundee mitii" jette maraattuun
meaning_om: Osoo dhimma murteessaa irratti haasa'anii yaada fageessanii wanta dhimma sanaan wal hin qabne kaasanii marii jallisuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'While we are talking, isn't that Nagarii Gundee over there?' said the madwoman; satirizes abruptly derailing a serious conversation with random trivia

proverb: Hoggaa lafaa fuudhuun, bakka na waraanu beeke
meaning_om: Wanta yookaan nama tokko wajjin hariiroo yeroo jalqaban balaa fi miidhaan inni boodarra fidu dursee beekama; balaa beekamaatti seenuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The moment I picked it up from the ground, I knew where it would stab me; taking on an inherently dangerous asset with foreknowledge of its inevitable bite

proverb: Dubbiin ijaani nama seenti
meaning_om: Namni wanta dubbatamu caalaa wanta ijaan arge amana, gochi haasaa caalaa dhiibbaa uuma; fakkeenyi ijaan mul'atu qalbii seena
meaning_en: Truth and speech enter a person through the eyes; people are persuaded far more by what they visibly observe than by mere words; actions speak louder

proverb: Namni waan gale hin beekne, ta boruu hin beeku
meaning_om: Seenaa fi wanta darbe kan hin beekne gara fuulduraa tilmaamuu fi karoorfachuu hin danda'u; seenaan barumsa boruuti
meaning_en: He who does not understand what has transpired cannot understand what tomorrow will bring; one ignorant of history cannot anticipate the future

proverb: Nama hashara afuufu hin tahin
meaning_om: Wanta salphaa, bu'aa hin qabnee fi nama miidhu keessa lixanii of hin rakkisinaa; dhimma gatii hin qabne dhiisuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Do not be one who blows upon light coffee chaff; do not meddle with frivolous trivialities that will only blow back and blind your eyes with dust

proverb: Soddaan hogguu gu'a himate, dabarsa himate
meaning_om: Namni haala rakkisaa tokko yeroo himatu gargaarsa yookaan bakka bu'iinsa akka barbaadu beekanii hubachuun ogummaa ta'uu ibsa; haasaa keessa ergaa baruu
meaning_en: When the son-in-law announces that the cow is dry, he is asking for a replacement; understand the underlying request beneath a polite report of depletion

proverb: Yoo akkaan gadi ilaalan mixiin ija qabdi
meaning_om: Wanti yookaan namni kamuu yoo xiyyeeffannaan qoratame dandeettii fi gatii mataa isaa qaba; homaa tuffatamuu hin qabu
meaning_en: If you look closely enough, even the tiny ant possesses eyes; no creature, person, or detail is entirely without perception, value, or capability

proverb: Harka mirgaa kutuun, harka bitaa darbannaa barsiisuu
meaning_om: Goota yookaan fira jabaa miidhuun nama dhihoo jiru kan biraa akka inni jabaatee qabsootti ka'u taasisa; hacuuccaan qabsoo dhalcha
meaning_en: Chopping off the right arm only forces the left arm to master hurling spears; persecuting champions only steels their brothers to rise up in resistance

proverb: Gaalli muddamu malee, hin albahu
meaning_om: Namni yookiin wanti tokko hamma dhiphinni ykn rakkoon guddaan isa mudatutti waan hin eegamne hin raawwatu.
meaning_en: One only resorts to unusual or extreme behavior when pushed to severe crisis or extreme pressure.

proverb: Roorroon jabaattu malee, abbaan ilma hin gurguru
meaning_om: Namni hamma rakkinni fi roorroon daangaa dhabdutti waan jaallatu fi kabaju hin laadhu.
meaning_en: A person never sacrifices their most precious possession unless driven by intolerable hardship or tyranny.

proverb: Rakkataan, farda billawaan dhawa
meaning_om: Namni dhiphate ykn rakkoon itti jabaate tooftaa fi meeshaa sirrii hin taaneen tarkaanfii fudhata.
meaning_en: A desperate person takes irrational or damaging actions when under immense stress.

proverb: Beerri irraa dhumtu malee, qirima hin nyaatu
meaning_om: Hamma wanti sirriin dhabamutti wanta qulqullina hin qabne ykn gadi aanaatti hin dhimmaaman.
meaning_en: One only accepts poor substitutes when proper alternatives are utterly exhausted.

proverb: Waraabeysi waan ollaa hin kajeelu, yoo dhabe ammoo biraa agabuu hin bulu
meaning_om: Namni yoo haalli rakkisaa tahe seeraa fi hariiroo ollummaa cabsuu danda'a.
meaning_en: Even those who claim restraint will break boundaries when hunger or necessity strikes.

proverb: Dhibeen niitii gabra nama godha
meaning_om: Haati manaa yoo dhukkubsatte hojiin manaa fi rakkon maatii abbaa irratti kufee isa rakkisa.
meaning_en: When the matriarch of the house falls ill, household duties overwhelm the family head.

proverb: Dheefni gaara gaye, nama afaan debi'a
meaning_om: Baqaafi dhiibbaan yeroo daangaa dhabu namni sodaa dhiisee diina dura dhaabbata.
meaning_en: When pushed to the absolute edge, even the timid will turn and fight back.

proverb: Jabaattu malee, jabaa hin yaamani
meaning_om: Rakkoon cimaan yoo uumame malee furmaata fi gargaarsa jabaa hin barbaadatan.
meaning_en: Strong measures and formidable allies are only called upon during severe crises.

proverb: Osoon kofluun gubadhe, jette akaawwiin
meaning_om: Gammachuu fi qoosatti osoo jiranii tasa miidhaan fi balaan nama mudachuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Disaster struck in the midst of amusement and carefree laughter.

proverb: Dheefa goda tuqate, gara galli hammaate
meaning_om: Rakkoorraa baqachuun yeroo tokko tokko gara kufaatii fi rakkina caaluutti nama geessa.
meaning_en: Running away recklessly leads to places from which return is extraordinarily difficult.

proverb: Maraataa fi rakkataan, daggalatti nama baqata
meaning_om: Namni rakkinni itti cime fi kan sammuun jeeqame namootarraa fagaatee qofaatti dheessa.
meaning_en: Both the mentally afflicted and the deeply impoverished often isolate themselves from society.

proverb: Mudattu malee, raada hin qalani
meaning_om: Horii fi qabeenya boru horuuf ta'u hamma rakkinni hamaan dhufullee hin qisaasan.
meaning_en: One does not consume reproductive capital or future assets except in direst need.

proverb: Biyya ambaa dhaquun nama hin dhibu, galuutu nama dhiba
meaning_om: Biyya ormaa deemuu danda'u garuu nagaan fi qabeenyaan deebi'uun daran rakkisaadha.
meaning_en: Leaving home for foreign soil is easy, but achieving a successful return is hard.

proverb: Namuu beekaa hin mucucaatu
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu dogoggora fi kufaatii fedhii isaatiin hin uumu; tasa uumama.
meaning_en: No one errs or stumbles with deliberate intent; mistakes happen involuntarily.

proverb: Namni biyya hin qabne, bakka itti koflu dhiisi, bakka itti booyuuf ni rakkata
meaning_om: Namni biyya fi dachee mataa isaa hin qabne kabajaa fi nagaa guutuu dhabee rakkata.
meaning_en: A stateless person is denied dignity both in joy and in sorrow.

proverb: Abjuu jibbanii, qaaxiiraa bulani
meaning_om: Wanta sodaatan tokko jibbanii wanta caalaatti nama miidhu keessa seenuu.
meaning_en: Fear of bad outcomes leads people into sleepless anxiety, worsening their plight.

proverb: Dugda aduun gube, garaa beelli gube
meaning_om: Rakkina bifa hedduun kallattii maraanuu nama irratti wal geeddarame agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Beset by hardship from every direction; external toil matched by inner hunger.

proverb: Iyyuu hin beekuun hamma rakkoon hin dhufinitti
meaning_om: Namni hamma dhiphinni fi roorroon itti dhufutti waan dandeettiisaa hin beeku; yoo rakkate ni lallaba.
meaning_en: Everyone learns to cry out when genuine agony or peril strikes.

proverb: Anuu badee tan intala tahee, badii lammataa kan intala da'ee jette niitiin
meaning_om: Rakkina duraan jiru irratti dabalanni dhiphina biraa yoo dhufu kan himamuudha.
meaning_en: A lament over double misfortune and compounding social vulnerability.

proverb: Rakkinni hundee manaatii, achi hiiqii hin qabu
meaning_om: Rakkoon jireenyaa waan hundee qabuuf salphaatti dhiisanii baqachuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: Poverty and hardship are deeply rooted and cannot be easily shrugged off.

proverb: Gaafa haftuun heerumtu, galaanni guuta
meaning_om: Nama carraan isaa guyyaa dheeraaf kuteef, yeroo carraan argamtullee danqaan biraa dhufti.
meaning_en: When an unlucky person finally gets a break, unforeseen obstacles still arise.

proverb: Anaa abbaa kiyya dadhabee, abbaan abbaa kiyyaa abbaa isaa qabatee natti dhufe
meaning_om: Rakkina xiqqaa ba'achuu dadhabee osoo jiruu dhiphina isa caalaa ulfaataatu itti dabalame.
meaning_en: Unable to cope with one burden, a whole lineage of heavier burdens arrived.

proverb: Duuti haadhaa fi bakki ciisan bubbuleeti nama quuqa
meaning_om: Miidhaan haadha dhabuu fi iddoon jireenyaa mijaawaa hin taane miidhaa isaanii yeroo booda mul'ata.
meaning_en: The loss of a mother and chronic discomfort leave deep, lasting aches that time reveals.

proverb: Rakkinni koo rakkinaa, haati koo ammaas ulfa
meaning_om: Rakkina duraan qaban ba'achuu dadhabanii osoo jiran dhibee fi ba'aan dabalataa dhufuu.
meaning_en: When already struggling with scarcity, more dependants or responsibilities are added.

proverb: Osoo nyaadhu naan jedhee maaliif ijoollee koo sagal godhaa jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Qabeenyi jiru xiqqoo ta'ee maatiin immoo baay'atee yeroo hiyyummaan nama cinqu kan dubbatamuudha.
meaning_en: When resources are scarce, having many mouths to feed feels like an impossible burden.

proverb: Harkaan hidhanii, ilkaaniin hiikuu dhaqani
meaning_om: Wanta ofii salphaatti dogoggoraan ykn of eeggannoo dhabuudhaan xaxan rakkina guddaan furuuf dhama'u.
meaning_en: What is tied easily by hand requires painful effort with teeth to undo.

proverb: Mucaas na dhoowwattee, fayyaas na hin dhoowwatin yaa maaramii jette dhabduun facaafattee
meaning_om: Wanta guddaa tokko dhabnullee fayyaa fi lubbuun jiraachuun wanta hunda caala.
meaning_en: Even when denied one great blessing, preserving life and health remains paramount.

proverb: Natti hin dhufin, anuu sitti niin dhufaa, jette buseen
meaning_om: Balaan ykn wanti hamaan ofumaanuu osoo hin waamin nama barbaadee dhufa.
meaning_en: Trouble needs no invitation; it arrives on its own momentum.

proverb: Duruu hin jirtuu, sanuu mana hin jirtu
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii fi humna xiqqaa qabu ammas itti gaafatamummaa isaa dagatee baduu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Someone of little utility who fails even to fulfill the simplest minimal obligation.

proverb: Mana abbaan waggaa keessa ture, keessummaan halkan tokkoo dadhaba
meaning_om: Rakkina abbaan danda'ee keessa jiraatu namni alaa dhufe yeroo gabaabaafiyyuu danda'ee hin obsu.
meaning_en: What a homeowner endures indefinitely, an outsider cannot tolerate for even one night.

proverb: Akka fardaaf tolutti, gafarsi hin kaatu
meaning_om: Diinni yookiin wanti tokko fedhii fi faayidaa keetiif jedhee akka siif mijatutti hin socho'u.
meaning_en: Your quarry or rival will never play according to rules convenient for you.

proverb: Horiin lafa jabaan qixxe
meaning_om: Qabeenyi qabaachuun akkuma lafa jabaa qabaachuutti nama tasgabbeessa, kabajaas namaaf kenna.
meaning_en: Possessing wealth provides as much firm footing and security as solid ground.

proverb: Ayyaanaa ayyaanaa, kan koo gagaa hin qabu jedhe, namtichi damma gagaa wajji liqimse
meaning_om: Nama of jajuuf jedhee miidhaa ykn hir'ina qabu akka waan qulqulluutti sobee himu.
meaning_en: Claiming spotless perfection while blatantly tolerating or swallowing flaws.

proverb: Mall jedhu jedhee, jaarsi dubbii fuudhe
meaning_om: Jaarsi yeroo dubbatu yaada namaa fi miira namootaa tilmaama keessa galchuun of eeggannoodhaan dubbata.
meaning_en: A wise elder speaks with great deliberation, considering societal reactions beforehand.

proverb: Muka jigetti, qottootu baayyata
meaning_om: Nama kufetti yookiin humna dhabetti namoonni hedduun itti roorrisuuf yaalu.
meaning_en: When a mighty figure falls, opportunistic attackers readily multiply.

proverb: Korommii wal nyaatte lachuu gurguruu dha, nadheen wal arrabsite lachuu misirroo dha
meaning_om: Horii lolaa qisaasa hambisuuf gurguru, dubartoota wal lolanis akka maatii haaraatti kabajanii araarsu.
meaning_en: Belligerent bulls are best liquidated, while quarreling women must both be reconciled as prized household members.

proverb: Intalti garaa laaftu, garaa qullaa hin taatu
meaning_om: Nama laafaa fi tolaa tahe namoonni faayidaa irra oolchuun miidhuu ykn dharraasisuu danda'u.
meaning_en: An overly yielding or naïve person easily becomes vulnerable to exploitation.

proverb: Ija laaftuun, obbolessaaf ulfooyti
meaning_om: Qaanii fi ija-laafummaan daangaa darbe wanta farrummaa fi safuu cabsu keessatti nama kuffisa.
meaning_en: Excessive timidity and inability to say no can lead to catastrophic boundary violations.

proverb: Intalti "haayaa" guddattu, obbolessarraa fafaan galti
meaning_om: Ijoollee murtii ofii akka hin qabaannee fi diduu akka hin dandeenyetti guddifamte salphaatti miidhamti.
meaning_en: A child trained only to comply without questioning becomes an easy victim of abuse.

proverb: Keessummaan qaanfattuun (zigaal guddattu) abbaa warratiin nyaadhu jetti
meaning_om: Qaaniin daangaa dabarte iddoo fi gahee namaa dogoggorsiisuun nama saalfachiisa.
meaning_en: Excessive diffidence causes an awkward reversal of proper social roles.

proverb: Zigaal guddateetu, lukkuu maxxanaan kuffisa
meaning_om: Of eeggannoo fi qaanii humnaa oliin wanta salphaa fi adda hin taane xaxanii miidhuu.
meaning_en: Exaggerated hesitation or timidity turns trivial actions into clumsy mishaps.

proverb: Sareen, waa agartu malee hin duttu
meaning_om: Wanti tokko sababa malee hin ta'u; dubbiin ykn iyyi uumame wanta ka'umsa tahe qaba.
meaning_en: There is no smoke without fire; an outcry or alarm always has a root cause.

proverb: Yoo roobni roobe, bakakkaan bu'a
meaning_om: Wanta guddaan yeroo uumamu balaan ykn miidhaan isaa wajjin wal qabatee dhufuun isaa hin oolu.
meaning_en: Major events naturally carry unavoidable and sometimes dangerous repercussions.

proverb: Qoreen dirraan, dhiigni dhufe
meaning_om: Miidhaa ykn dogoggorri raawwatame battalumatti bu'aa hamaa fi madaa fida.
meaning_en: Harmful actions or injuries instantly produce pain and visible consequences.

proverb: Qoraan yoo dhoowwatan malee, ibiddi hin dhaamu
meaning_om: Lolaa fi waldhabdee dhaamsuuf wanta isa kakaasu dhabamsiisuun dirqama.
meaning_en: To extinguish a conflict, one must cut off the fuel and incitement feeding it.

proverb: Bishaan dhugan malee, hin fincaanani
meaning_om: Wanti tokko osoo hin jalqabamin ykn sababni hin jiraatin bu'aan isaa hin mul'atu.
meaning_en: Without prior intake or action, there can be no subsequent output or outcome.

proverb: Midhaan nyaatan malee, hin udaanani
meaning_om: Wanta hojjetan ykn gumaachan irratti hundaa'ee bu'aan argama malee duwwaarraa homaa hin dhalatu.
meaning_en: Outcomes depend entirely on what has been invested or done; nothing comes from nothing.

proverb: Dhagaa keessa jiruutu, bishaan dubbisa
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi haala dhimma tokkoo kan beeku nama dhimma sana keessa jiru qofaadha.
meaning_en: Only those immersed in a difficult situation truly fathom its depth and pressure.

proverb: Muka jigu bira, muka dhiibuutu jira
meaning_om: Nama kufu ykn miidhamu duuba humna ykn nama isa suuquu fi kuffisuutu jira.
meaning_en: Behind every sudden downfall, there is often an unseen instigator or pushing force.

proverb: Dubbataa jiru, callisaan hin jiru
meaning_om: Dubbiin yoo ka'e namni hundi yaada kennuuf kaka'a malee namuu callisee hin dhiisu.
meaning_en: Active discussion compels engagement; silence disappears once a matter is voiced.

proverb: Sareen nagaya hin iyyine, waatu gurrarra bahe
meaning_om: Namni tasuma komii fi mufannaa hin dhageessisu, yoo miidhaan cimaan isa mudate malee.
meaning_en: A peaceful creature does not raise a commotion unless provoked or tormented.

proverb: Roobu malee, firiin lafaa hin magarre
meaning_om: Gargaarsa, carraaqqii fi eebba malee milkaa'inni fi firii gaariin hin argamu.
meaning_en: Without the necessary nurturing conditions and effort, no growth or success occurs.

proverb: Uleen, ofii nama hin dhooytu
meaning_om: Meeshaan ofiin miidhaa hin fidu; namni isa fayyadameetu itti gaafatama fudhachuu qaba.
meaning_en: Inanimate weapons do not harm; human intent and action bear the sole responsibility.

proverb: Dhagaan, of hin darbu
meaning_om: Balaa fi dubbii dhufe hunda duuba nama isa raawwateetu jira malee ofumaan hin dhufe.
meaning_en: Every act of aggression or harm is initiated by a person, not spontaneous coincidence.

proverb: Ulaanula haati madda, madda haati bishaani
meaning_om: Wanti guddaan kamiyyuu wanta xiqqoorraa ka'ee gabbata; hundi hundee qaba.
meaning_en: All mighty rivers trace back to modest springs, which themselves begin as mere drops.

proverb: Dubbii dubbii fidaa, haadaa diddiga fida
meaning_om: Dubbii baay'isuun wal morkii fi aarii caalaa fiduun madaa keessoo babal'isa.
meaning_en: Endless arguing only drags up deeper bitterness, just as excessive vomiting yields bile.

proverb: Dibicha haadaatu harkisa
meaning_om: Humna guddaa to'achuuf tooftaa, seeraa fi to'annoo sirriitu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Even raw physical strength is steered and constrained by simple, firm control.

proverb: Hudhaan, ofii nama hin hudhu
meaning_om: Rakkina namatti dhufu baay'een isaa sababa of eeggannoo dhabuu ykn bolola ofiitiini.
meaning_en: Choking is caused by greedy or reckless swallowing; misfortune is often self-inflicted.

proverb: Warra soddaatu, sadeeniinuu nama gaya
meaning_om: Firoomni fi kabajaan soddaarraa argamu bal'aa fi guutuu ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: In-laws fulfill and test a person across all dimensions of respect, duty, and aid.

proverb: Maqaa baduuf mana tokko seenani, biyyaa bahuuf guyyaa tokko deemani
meaning_om: Maqaa gaariin waggaa hedduun jaarratan dogoggora guyyaa tokkootiin baduu danda'a.
meaning_en: A lifetime's sterling reputation can be demolished by a single indiscreet step.

proverb: Balaan mixii, mana guba
meaning_om: Wanti xiqqoon yoo daganatame balaa guddaa qabeenya guutuu balleessu fida.
meaning_en: A seemingly insignificant trigger can precipitate total devastation.

proverb: Gaddaafaan banjii, qobboo galaafatti
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa qabu ofii baduu bira darbee nama isa gargaare ykn ollaa isaa miidha.
meaning_en: A destructive and cursed dependent drags down the very host that shelters it.

proverb: Anaa iyyuu taa'u, waatiin miila'rra na ajjatte
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi gadda guddaa keessa osoo jiranii dhibeen biraa itti dabalamee nama miidhuu.
meaning_en: Suffering an additional affliction right when one is already in agonizing pain.

proverb: Osoo namni hin dhufin, dubbiin hin dhuftu
meaning_om: Oduun, xaxaan fi waldhabdeen hundinuu namootaan dhufa malee qofaatti hin uumamu.
meaning_en: Controversies and rumors do not walk by themselves; human carriers bring them.

proverb: Taakka ja'aniiti, laama ja'ani
meaning_om: Wanti hundi tokkorraa jalqabee gara lamatti lakkaa'ama; sadarkaa fi tartiiba eeggachuun waan guddaa bira gahu.
meaning_en: Everything begins from one before reaching two; progress requires following proper sequence step by step.

proverb: Miila wal faraqa fudhatan
meaning_om: Imalli yookiin guddinni suutuma suuta tarkaanfii wal hordofuun dhufa malee altokkotti miti.
meaning_en: Progress and journeys happen step-by-step in alternation, not all at once.

proverb: Tusaawan malee hin daggalaawani
meaning_om: Wanti tokko guddatee fi bal'atee mul'achuuf xiqqoorraa kuufamuu qaba.
meaning_en: A dense forest only forms when small bushes sprout together; greatness builds up gradually.

proverb: Suuta suuta killeen, miila baaftee deemti
meaning_om: Obsaan yoo eeggatan wanti hin danda'amne fakkaatullee yeroo isaa eeggatee jijjiirama.
meaning_en: With patience and time, even what seems impossible like an egg hatching develops legs and walks.

proverb: Quraana fixan malee, ilmii hin muxaalani
meaning_om: Bu'uura jabeessanii beeku malee gara beekumsa bal'aa fi ulfaataatti hin darban.
meaning_en: Without mastering the fundamentals, one cannot advance to higher levels of knowledge.

proverb: Cululleen goblaa jabaattu malee hin barartu
meaning_om: Namni humnaa fi dandeettii barbaachisu osoo hin qabaatin hojii guddaatti hin hirmaatu.
meaning_en: A young hawk cannot soar until its feathers are fully developed; capability precedes achievement.

proverb: Harka fixaniiti, lukatti dabran
meaning_om: Hojiin tartiibaan adeemsifama; dura kan dhihoo xumuranii booda itti aanuuf qophaa'u.
meaning_en: Tasks are done in sequential order; one completes the immediate before moving to the next.

proverb: Saksaakaatu gulufa fida
meaning_om: Adeemsa suutaa fi qophiitu fiigicha guddaa fi milkaa'ina fida.
meaning_en: Trotting steadily leads to galloping; small steady efforts pave the way for fast progress.

proverb: Roobni titiifuun jalqaba
meaning_om: Wanti guddaan kamiyyuu jalqabni isaa xiqqaadha.
meaning_en: Every great phenomenon or event starts from a small, modest beginning.

proverb: Shanyiin bulti lakkaawwatti
meaning_om: Midhaan biqiluuf yeroo akka barbaadu hunda, milkaa'inni jireenyaas yeroo eeggata.
meaning_en: Just as a seed requires days underground before sprouting, success demands patient waiting.

proverb: Xiqqoo argatan, guddoo abdatan
meaning_om: Waan harkaa qabanitti galateeffatanii, gara fuulduraatti kan caaluuf tattaafatu.
meaning_en: Being grateful for small gains while keeping hope and ambition for greater things.

proverb: Hattuun qacceen jalqabdeeti, sangaa dhaan saaxil baati
meaning_om: Badiin xiqqoon yoo hin sirreeffamne guddachaa deemtee salphina guddaa fiddi.
meaning_en: A thief starts by stealing a small whip cord, but unchecked bad habits escalate into stealing an ox and being disgraced.

proverb: Sissiqaati goobana
meaning_om: Ji'i guyyaa guyyaan dabalamaa akkuma goobanu, namnis suuta suutaan guutuu ta'a.
meaning_en: Just as the moon waxes little by little to become full, human progress and wisdom mature gradually.

proverb: Sissiqaati bokkaan abbayya dhaqe
meaning_om: Cophni bokkaa suutuma suuta dhangala'ee laga guddaa Abbayyaatti makama; waan xiqqoon fagoo gaha.
meaning_en: Drop by drop, rainwater trickles and eventually feeds the mighty Blue Nile; small steps reach distant horizons.

proverb: Dhaph-dhaphiitu galaana fida
meaning_om: Copha bishaanii xiqqootu walitti qabamee galaana bal'aa uuma; qusannaa fi tattaaffiin xiqqoon waan guddaa taha.
meaning_en: Individual drops of water gathered together form a mighty flood; minor savings or continuous efforts create massive wealth.

proverb: Siqee siqeeti, waraabessi qa'ee gahe
meaning_om: Wanti hamaan yoo ofirraa eeggachuu baatan suutuma suuta balbala namaatti dhihaata.
meaning_en: Inching stealthily bit by bit, the hyena reaches the front yard; danger creeps in unawares if vigilance is lax.

proverb: Gaala kiraatiin daldalaati, kan bitii keessa laallatani
meaning_om: Qabeenya namaan yookiin carraa jiruun fayyadamanii suuta kan ofii ijaarrachuuf abdatu.
meaning_en: Starting business with a rented camel, one gradually plans to purchase one's own.

proverb: Manarratti mana hin ijaarani
meaning_om: Dubbii yookiin sirna dura jiru osoo hin xumurin waan biraa walirra tuuluun jeequmsa fida.
meaning_en: One should not pile a new problem or structure atop an unsettled one; resolve issues systematically.

proverb: Heerri heerarratti hin tahu
meaning_om: Seerri yookiin murtii tokko osoo jiru seera biraa walfaallessu itti fe'uun sirna hin qabu.
meaning_en: A legal rule or precedent cannot contradict or overlap clumsily on top of an existing established law.

proverb: Sooraa hancufaatu duraa, amnaa balbalaatu dura
meaning_om: Wanti kamiyyuu bu'uuraa fi tarkaanfii jalqabaa qaba; wanti hunduu qophii barbaada.
meaning_en: Saliva comes before swallowing food, and crossing the doorway comes before embarking on a journey.

proverb: Guyyatti hanga sijaajaa qotaa yoo oofan, buraanaa ni baasani
meaning_om: Hojii guddaa yoo guyyaa guyyaan xiqqo xiqqoon hojjetan dhumarratti xumuruun ni danda'ama.
meaning_en: Even plowing an area as small as a prayer mat daily will eventually clear an expansive farming field.

proverb: Gaaraa fi gaarii itti hin fiigani
meaning_om: Gaara ol ba'uuf akkuma obsa barbaadu, wanti gaariinis obsaa fi qalbii itti dhimmuun hojjetama.
meaning_en: One does not dash up a steep mountain, nor should noble deeds be done impulsively; both require steady patience.

proverb: Da'uuf durri ulfa
meaning_om: Waan tokko bu'aa isaa arguuf dura rakkoo fi dhiphina isaa baachuu qabu.
meaning_en: Before the joy of birth, one must endure the nine months of pregnancy; every harvest requires preceding toil.

proverb: Harka argatani, lukatti hiixatani
meaning_om: Nama arjummaadhaan waan xiqqoo kenneef daangaa dhabanii waan guddaa irraa fudhachuuf kajeeluun sirrii miti.
meaning_en: Given the hand, they reach greedily for the foot; taking unfair advantage of someone's generosity.

proverb: Miila lama qabna je'anii yeroo tokkotti muka lama hin korani
meaning_om: Humni namaa daangaa waan qabuuf hojiiwwan gurguddoo lama altokkotti raawwachuuf yaaluun kasaaraa fida.
meaning_en: Having two legs does not allow one to climb two trees simultaneously; do not scatter your energy on split goals.

proverb: Gaara tokko yaaban, gaara tokkootu mul'ata
meaning_om: Jireenya keessatti qorumsa tokko yoo dabarzan kan biraatu dhufa; ilaalchi namaas bal'achaa deema.
meaning_en: When you climb one summit, another peak comes into view; overcoming one hurdle reveals the next horizon.

proverb: Halkan bahaniif, bara hin bahani
meaning_om: Rakkoo guyyaa tokkoo yookiin yeroo gabaabaa bira darbuun qorumsa jireenyaa guutuu dhiifame jechuu miti.
meaning_en: Surviving through the night does not mean you have outlived the epoch; momentary relief is not permanent safety.

proverb: Karaa dheeraa hin ceehani, dubbii dheertuu itti hin jarjarani
meaning_om: Imala dheeraa akkuma suuta tarkaanfatanii dhumarratti gahan, dhimma ulfaataas obsaan xiinxalu.
meaning_en: A long road cannot be crossed in a single leap, nor can profound, complex disputes be resolved in haste.

proverb: Ar'uma horraan hin tahu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi yookiin beekumsi guyyaa tokkotti hin argamu; tattaaffii dheeraa eeggata.
meaning_en: Wealth and prosperity do not happen in a single day; it takes continuous accumulation over time.

proverb: Kan haaddatee fi kan jiifate waluma faana
meaning_om: Namoonni karaa garaagaraatiin qophaa'an yookiin hojjetan dhumarratti sadarkaa fi bu'aa walfakkaatu qabaachuu danda'u.
meaning_en: The one who shaved completely and the one who trimmed down close end up looking virtually identical.

proverb: Arriin mukattuu ni baati
meaning_om: Dullumni yookiin jijjiiramni yeroo fi umrii uumama hunda irra kan gahuudha malee nama qofaa miti.
meaning_en: Ageing and the passage of time affect every living creation, even trees; it is a universal law of nature.

proverb: Gubbaa tuulee, keessa duule
meaning_om: Nama alaan tolaa fi jaalalloo fakkaatee keessaan ammoo miidhaa fi badii dalagu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Refers to a hypocrite who acts beneficent on the surface while secretly plotting harm or destruction within.

proverb: Hiddiin ol hin guddattu
meaning_om: Wanti uumamaan daangaa qabu hamma fedhe tattaafatu daangaa uumamaa isaa dabruu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A low bush like Sodom apple cannot grow into a towering tree; everything has inherent limitations.

proverb: Foon harree, sireerra kaayan illee daaraa hin hanqatu
meaning_om: Wanti yookiin namni gatii fi kabajaa hin qabne bakka ol aanaas yoo kaa'an gara salphina isaatti deebi'a.
meaning_en: No matter how elevated an ignoble person or thing is made, their vulgar nature will inevitably show.

proverb: Harreen yoo sireerra kaayan, daaraa keessa gangalatti
meaning_om: Namni kabajaa fi bakka guddaa hin malleef kennameef kabajicha eeggachuu dadhabee salphinatti deebi'a.
meaning_en: Place a donkey upon an elevated bed, and it still leaps into dust; uncultured people ruin exalted honors.

proverb: Sareen faaya hin beektuu, kan ofii ofirratti nyaatti
meaning_om: Namni qaroomaa fi kabajaa hin beekne waan miidhaginaa fi faayidaa qabu balleessa malee itti hin gammadu.
meaning_en: A dog lacks appreciation for fine adornment and chews off its collar; unrefined individuals destroy elegance.

proverb: Osoo beektee haga hin buutuu, kan namuu sii gaggabuutu
meaning_om: Namni kabajaa fi jaalala namoonni isaaf qaban osoo beekee amala gadhee fi gocha nama jibbisiisu hin raawwatu ture.
meaning_en: If one recognized the immense honor and goodwill shown to them, they would not act so disgraced and crude.

proverb: Haa fifiigduu malee, harreen daaraa dhaa hin baatu
meaning_om: Namni bu'uura amala isaa hin jijjiirre hamma fedhe yoo ifaaje sadarkaa fi amala gadhee isaa jalaa hin bahu.
meaning_en: No matter how fast a donkey runs, it belongs to the dust; superficial motion changes neither nature nor fate.

proverb: Osoo kan deemuun hin dadhabin, kan deemaniin dadhabe
meaning_om: Namni tajaajilamaa jiru osoo hin quufin, namni isa gargaaru yookiin tajaajilu humna dhabee rakkata.
meaning_en: Before the rider tires of travelling, the beast being ridden collapses; beneficiaries overworking their providers.

proverb: Osoo odaan hin dadhabin, qalameen dadhabdi
meaning_om: Maddi inni guddaan osoo hin raafamin namni isa irratti hirkatee jiru dura dadhaba.
meaning_en: The mighty Odaa fig tree endures effortlessly, whereas the climbing parasite vine supporting itself on it withers.

proverb: Dachiin "ani tan isin ba'atte isin hin dadhabnee isin maaliif wal dadhabdani" jette
meaning_om: Uumamni bal'aan hunda keenya baachaa osoo jiruu ilmaan namaa waldanda'uu fi nagaan waliin jiraachuu dadhabuun isaanii kan nama gaddisiisuudha.
meaning_en: Earth tolerates bearing everyone without complaint, yet human beings fail to tolerate living peacefully beside one another.

proverb: Waraabeysi soogiddaan hin nyaatu
meaning_om: Bineensi yookiin namni dharraan qabame wanta fedhu qofa qulqullinaa fi sirna malee fedhii isaa raawwachuuf ariifata.
meaning_en: A hyena devours without seasoning or etiquette; raw greed and savagery have no decorum or refinement.

proverb: Tiitichaa fi gadi galoon tokkicha
meaning_om: Namni bakka hin malle hunda dhaquu fi xuraawaa jaallatu akka tiitichaatti salphaa fi nama jibbisiisaadha.
meaning_en: A fly and an aimless, shameless hanger-on share the same nature; both pester people and hover over filth.

proverb: Jaarsa dardarummaa hin fixatin mana ambaatti hin ergatani
meaning_om: Namni yeroo dhimma guddaaf ergamu tasgabbii fi bilchina hin qabne salphina fida malee hojii hin hojjetu.
meaning_en: One should not send an elder who never shed youthful impulsiveness to negotiate, for he will bring disgrace.

proverb: Handaaqqootti lootii keenyaan, ofitti harkiftee kutte
meaning_om: Namni gatii fi ulfina wanta tokkoo hin beekne kabajaa fi carraa kennameef ofumaan balleessa.
meaning_en: Adorn a hen with a golden jewel, and it will peck and snap it off; uncouth people ruin high honors bestowed on them.

proverb: Dhadhaan garaa saree hin bulu
meaning_om: Namni iccitii baachuu hin dandeenye waan argee fi dhaga'e hunda hatattamaan baasee dubbata.
meaning_en: Clarified butter cannot be retained in a dog's stomach; a loose-tongued person cannot keep a secret.

proverb: Gandi gaara jalaa, barumaan bara jala
meaning_om: Haalli yookiin bakki jireenyaa tokko jijjiirama hin qabne yeroo hunda akkuma jirutti tura.
meaning_en: A village situated beneath a towering mountain remains sheltered beneath it year after year; immutable constants in life.

proverb: Namni kabajaa hin beekne, maqaa yaamaniin owwaata
meaning_om: Namni of hin kabajne fi gatii ofii hin beekne salphinaaf saaxilamaa ta'ee maqaa salphaattiyyuu tole jedha.
meaning_en: Someone devoid of self-respect responds blindly to any degrading label; they lack dignity and boundaries.

proverb: Namni kabajaa hin beekne, maqaan yaamtu hin owwaatu
meaning_om: Nama ulfinaa fi safuu hin beekne akkamittiiyyuu yoo kabajan kabaja sanaaf iddoo hin kennu.
meaning_en: An uncultured person ignorant of decorum fails to appreciate or respond to respectful addressing.

proverb: "Haadha dhiiraa" jennaan diddeet, "haadha qoraanii" jennaan owwaatte
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan yookiin salphate kabajaa fi maqaa gaarii dhiisee gara waan salphaa fi gadi aanaatti kajeela.
meaning_en: Offered the noble title 'mother of brave men', she declined; addressed as 'carrier of firewood', she eagerly answered.

proverb: Sodaataa uleen kudhani
meaning_om: Namni sodaataan waan xiqqoo akka waan guddaatti argee naasaa fi shororkaa keessa gala.
meaning_en: A fearful person exaggerates minor risks into massive threats; fear multiplies danger tenfold in the mind.

proverb: Haftuun goota hin qabdu
meaning_om: Namni abdii kutatee fi carraan jalaa dabre nama hundumaa tuffata, wanti gaariin jiras jedhee hin amanu.
meaning_en: A bitter, disillusioned person sees no merit or heroism in anyone around them.

proverb: Luyni kan haadhaati
meaning_om: Jagni biyyaa fi lammiif duulaa oolee seenaa yoo hojjetu, luyni garuu mana haadhaa taa'ee of dhoksa.
meaning_en: While heroes serve their country and make history, cowards hide at home under their mothers' apron.

proverb: Jiileeti bahee, udaan huddutti hin deebi'u
meaning_om: Wanti tokko sodaadhaan yookiin gowwummaadhaan erga badee booda deebisanii sirreessuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: An irreversible blunder or action committed in panic cannot be undone once it has happened.

proverb: Sodaataan, niitii irraa ilma hin dhalchu
meaning_om: Namni sodaa qabu jireenya keessatti ija jabina dhabee waan kabajamaa fi dhaabbataa hin milkeeffatu.
meaning_en: A timid, indecisive person lacks the boldness required to achieve lasting honor and legacy in life.

proverb: Namni guyyaa bofa arge, halkan teepha dheessa
meaning_om: Namni duraan balaa yookiin miidhaan irra gahe wanta balaa sana fakkaatu hunda naasuudhaan sodaata.
meaning_en: Someone traumatized by a real danger becomes hyper-vigilant and fears anything that vaguely resembles it.

proverb: Waan roobaa, jooba keessa hin dubbatani
meaning_om: Rakkina guddaa keessa osoo jiranii dhimma rakkichaa lafa bal'aatti kaasanii morkuun yeroo isaa miti; dura jalaa bahuutu dursa.
meaning_en: One should not engage in leisurely analysis of an ordeal while still actively drowning in it; escape first.

proverb: "Osoo wacaafaan jiraachuu baatee, ashiitaan numa qoyxuu dha" jette, shinbirroon
meaning_om: Hattuu fi diinni yoo eeggannoo fi waardiyyaan jabaan jiraachuu baate qabeenya namaa saamuuf qophiidha.
meaning_en: Thieves and adversaries would effortlessly plunder resources if not for constant vigilance and deterrence.

proverb: Harree dadhaban, gorboota dhawani
meaning_om: Nama balleessaa qabu yookiin jabaa ta'e adabuu dadhabanii nama dadhabaa fi balleessaa hin qabne miidhuu.
meaning_en: Failing to confront the powerful wrongdoer, one vents frustration upon the innocent or helpless scapegoat.

proverb: Bakakkaan qara sodaate, jinfutti bu'a
meaning_om: Diinni yookiin namni hamaan nama jabaa fi qophaa'aa morkachuu sodaatee kan dadhabaa irratti miidhaa geessisa.
meaning_en: An aggressor terrified of confronting strength targets the soft, blunt, and defenseless flank.

proverb: Loon leenca argee hin fincaanne, garaa keessaa humaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Balaa guddaa fi sodaachisaa duratti sodachuu dhabuun hin danda'amu; sodaan uumama keessa jira.
meaning_en: Facing terrifying peril, extreme dread is completely natural unless one has lost all sensation.

proverb: Mataa leencaa, loon hin arraabani
meaning_om: Dadhabaan diina isa duguugee balleessu duratti taphachuu yookiin jaalala barbaaduun balaa fida.
meaning_en: The vulnerable do not seek playful affection from a mortal predator; beware of fatal folly.

proverb: Joolleen hiriyaa sodaannaan, karaa golaa (alawaadaa) na baasaa jetti
meaning_om: Namni walmorkii fi dhugaa fuullee ba'uu sodaatu karaan dhoksaa fi daddaaqaan baqachuuf yaala.
meaning_en: When someone dreads facing peers or accountability, they seek secretive backdoors to sneak away.

proverb: Haadha dhiiraa dhaananii, mudhii hiikkatanii hin rafani
meaning_om: Nama fira jabaa fi haloo baafatu qabu yoo miidhan tasgabbaa'anii taa'uun balaa fida; haloon ni dhufa.
meaning_en: Having provoked or harmed the kin of a formidable warrior, one cannot relax; retribution will follow.

proverb: Duulli dheessu halkan gala
meaning_om: Salphinaa fi injifatamuu ofii dhoksuuf jecha namni gocha gadhee hojjete halkan dukkana fayyadama.
meaning_en: Cowardly retreat and shameful defeat seek the dark of night to hide from public humiliation.

proverb: Luyni niitii irraa dheeysa
meaning_om: Namni gootummaa fi jabina hin qabne dhimma mana isaa iyyuu itti gaafatamummaa fudhachuu dadhabee baqata.
meaning_en: A thoroughly spineless person lacks courage even to face domestic disputes and flees from his wife.

proverb: Gaala xaan lafa taa'uufiitu, raroof gadooda
meaning_om: Namni hojiif yookiin deemsaaf fedhii dhabee dadhabe sababa salphaa lakkaa'ee komii baay'isa.
meaning_en: A person already looking for an excuse to quit blames small burdens for their inevitable failure.

proverb: Namni bofa baqate, bofni nama baqate, karaan jiddutti hafe
meaning_om: Gareewwan lamaanuu wal sodaatanii walirraa yoo baqatan nagaan bu'ee lola malee walirraa fagaatu.
meaning_en: When both adversaries fear each other and mutually withdraw, open conflict is averted peacefully.

proverb: Shahaadaa guddisuun, du'a sodaa dha
meaning_om: Namni yeroo baayyee dhiphuu fi duuti itti dhihaatu qofa kadhannaa fi qalbii jijjiirrata.
meaning_en: People often intensify religious fervor only when cornered by mortal danger or the fear of death.

proverb: Waraabessi, kan boodaa irra guddaa dha
meaning_om: Balaan yookiin rakkoon tokko darbe jennaan inni boodarra dhufu daran jabaatee dhufeera ta'a.
meaning_en: One cannot breathe easy after one calamity passes, for what follows is often even more daunting.

proverb: Qara dabre, jinfuun nama hin waraanu
meaning_om: Balaan inni guddinni erga dabarsee booda, wanti hafe miidhaa guddaa nama irraan hin gahu.
meaning_en: Once the sharpest edge of danger has safely passed, the remaining blunt end cannot pierce or harm you.

proverb: Ibiddi dhaamu, daaraan nama hin gubu
meaning_om: Aariin yookiin balaan inni ulfaataan erga qabbanaa'ee booda wanti hafe sodaachisaa miti.
meaning_en: Once the flames of conflict or danger have died down, the cold ashes left behind pose no threat.

proverb: Leenca dabre, eegeen dabarte
meaning_om: Balaan inni guddaan nama dabarraan wanti isa hordofu kamiyyuu dhiibbaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: When the apex danger itself has moved past, its trailing tail will not harm you; the peril is fully over.

proverb: Yaa'a qallate, Kopheen bahani
meaning_om: Rakkina salphaa fi dhiphaa ta'e osoo dhiphina hin uumin salphaatti tarkaanfatanii bira darbu.
meaning_en: A shallow, narrow stream is crossed easily with one's shoes on; minor hurdles require no fuss.

proverb: Yaa'a qallateef, kophee hin baafatani
meaning_om: Waanuma salphaa fi xiqqoof jecha qophii guddaa fi dhiphina hin malle keessa hin galani.
meaning_en: One does not go to the trouble of removing shoes for a mere trickle; avoid overreacting to petty hurdles.

proverb: Galaanni dabru, cirrachi nama hin fuudhu
meaning_om: Qorumsa jabaa fi balaa guddaa erga dandamatanii booda, wanti xiqqoon nama hin kuffisu.
meaning_en: Having withstood the ferocious raging flood, the remaining pebbles cannot sweep you away.

proverb: "Nu ofii rimayaa, mooji tumaalessa" jette, re'eettiin
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiifiyyuu ba'aa fi rakkina guddaa keessa jiru waa'ee dhimma nama biraatiif yaaddoo hin qabu.
meaning_en: We are occupied with our own heavy burdens; we have no energy to fret over the affairs of others.

proverb: Boru heerumtaan, waan haftuun sossobani
meaning_om: Namatti abdii sobaa fi waadaa yeroo dheeraa kennanii garaa ciibsuuf yookiin sossobuuf itti dhimma bamu.
meaning_en: Giving someone false hope and empty promises merely to pacify them temporarily.

proverb: Bareedinaa fi horiin, nama gowwoomsiti
meaning_om: Miidhagina alaa fi qabeenya qofaan qalbii dhabanii gara murtee dogongoraa fi gowwummaatti galu.
meaning_en: Superficial beauty and riches can easily bewitch a person, blinding their judgment.

proverb: "Kookkoo ala jiraan", waan joolleen sossobani
meaning_om: Waan hin jirre uumanii fi sodaachisanii nama hubannoo xiqqaa qabu to'achuuf fayyadamu.
meaning_en: Fabricating imaginary monsters or fears to keep the naive and vulnerable compliant.

proverb: Haftuu mana haadhaatti hin beekanii, dhadhaa dibanii, ambaan dhibani
meaning_om: Wanta yookiin nama amalli isaa beekamu faayanii fi miidheysanii nama biraa gowwoomsuuf yaalu.
meaning_en: Cosmetically adorning someone whose serious flaws are known at home in order to deceive strangers.

proverb: Nama waan namaatti ija dhiibu, laaffisoo agarsiisaniiti faltii guurshani
meaning_om: Nama bololaan qabeenya namaa saamuuf ija godhatu kiyyoo keessa galchanii salphisu.
meaning_en: An envious, greedy opportunist eyeing others' property is lured with a treat and fed humiliation.

proverb: Daa'imni ol daddarban, kan ifii isaatii ol utaalu itti fakkaata
meaning_om: Namni gargaarsa fi tumsa namootaatiin bakka guddaa gahe humna ofiitiin akka waan ka'eetti of tuula.
meaning_en: Someone lifted to prominence on the shoulders of others foolishly imagines they soared on their own power.

proverb: Namni kan humaa hin kennineef, hiyyessa mataa qaqqabata
meaning_om: Gargaarsa qabatamaa kennuu dhiisanii jaalalaa fi garaa laafina sobaa afaaniin agarsiisu.
meaning_en: Offering empty affectionate gestures and words to the needy without providing tangible help.

proverb: Shumburaa goggoyduun, nama huuti
meaning_om: Wanti tolaa fi laafina hin qabne, yookiin jaalala dhugaa hin qabne nama miidha malee bu'aa hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Dry, dry things without water choke; similarly, harsh treatment and dry appeasement harm rather than nourish.

proverb: Gabra biddeena furdaan maxaysani
meaning_om: Nama hirkataa ta'e waanuma xiqqoo fi salphaa kennaniifii akka inni mirga isaa hin gaafanne callisiisu.
meaning_en: Throwing a subordinate coarse sustenance just to keep them quiet and prevent them from demanding their rights.

proverb: Gabra, huddu dhoysani, garaa guutani
meaning_om: Hojjetaa yookiin nama gadi aanaa waan lubbuun turuuf isa dandeessisu qofa kennaniifii itti fayyadamu.
meaning_en: Subjugating a laborer by providing only bare clothing and food merely to maintain their working capacity.

proverb: Osoo jajuu, jajihe
meaning_om: Faaruu fi jajuun daangaa darbe nama afaan faajjessitee akka inni of tuulee hojii balleessu taasifti.
meaning_en: Unrestrained flattery and inflated praise went straight to his head, leading to total ruin.

proverb: Quufni dubbaa, galaa male, imaltuu nama oofa
meaning_om: Wanti yeroo gabaabaaf qofa quubsu nama gowwoomsee eeggannoo fi qophii barbaachisaa akka dhiisan godha.
meaning_en: The short-lived, watery satiety of pumpkin deludes a traveler into hitting the road without real provisions.

proverb: Haa corattu jennaan, dal'uu qaqqabe
meaning_om: Eeyyamaa fi arjummaa namni sitti agarsiisetti fayyadamtee daangaa dabartee waan hunda saamuuf yaaluu.
meaning_en: Granted permission to take a modest piece, he immediately overreached and laid hands on the prized hump.

proverb: Garii anaatu galchaa, garii dhihaatu galchaa jette tumtuun
meaning_om: Hojii qulqullina hin qabne xumuruuf sababa dukkanaa fi yeroo gabaabaa fayyadamuun nama gowwoomsu.
meaning_en: Shoddy craftsmen rush their poor work and count on the falling dusk to hide imperfections from customers.

proverb: Garaan quufu rafa malee, sossobaan hin rafu
meaning_om: Dhimmi yookiin beelli qabatamaa furmaata qabatamaa barbaada malee jecha sobaatiin hin callisu.
meaning_en: A starving stomach rests only with real nourishment, not with empty soothing and smooth talk.

proverb: Namni ifii nyaateeti, gowwaa afaan diba
meaning_om: Qabeenyaa fi bu'aa dhugaa ofii fudhatanii gowwaa immoo akka waan inni argateetti itti fakkeessanii gowwoomsu.
meaning_en: The cunning takes the whole feast for himself, and merely smears greasy residue on the fool to trick him.

proverb: Gowwaa nyaataa yaami, ergaa si hin didu
meaning_om: Nama hubannoo hin qabne waanuma xiqqoo kennaniifii hojii ulfaataa fi ergaa barbaadan hunda itti fe'uun danda'ama.
meaning_en: Feed a simpleton a single meal, and he will eagerly run all your exhausting errands without question.

proverb: Yoo namni ilkee sitti mul'ise, if hin dagatin
meaning_om: Kolfi alaa fi ilkaan adii hundi jaalala miti; diinni kolfaa nama nyaatu waan jiruuf of eeggannoon barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: A friendly display of gleaming teeth does not guarantee goodwill; never lower your guard before a charming smile.

proverb: Gaafaan nama diraniiti, eegeen nama hooysani
meaning_om: Miidhaa fi balaa guddaa erga nama irraan gahanii booda jaalala fi marrummaa fakkeessuun nama gowwoomsu.
meaning_en: Inflicting devastating injury with the horns, and then soothing the victim with gentle strokes of the tail.

proverb: Allaattiin fira fakkaattee, moora ijaa nyaatti
meaning_om: Diinni fira fakkaatee dhihaatu iddoo hunda caalaa nama miidhu irratti balaa fida.
meaning_en: An enemy masquerading as a loyal friend strikes treacherously at your most vulnerable and precious spot.

proverb: Jeedalloon, gogaa hoolaa uffatteef, hoolaa hin taatu
meaning_om: Namni hamaan uffata qulqullummaa fi amala gaarii yoo uffateyyuu amala bineensummaa isaa dhoksuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A predator wrapped in a fleece remains a predator; superficial disguise cannot alter wicked inner nature.

proverb: Gaangee sibiila cancalaa afaanitti darbaniiti, isii lubbuuf fiiyduun waa deemtii ja'ani
meaning_om: Nama dhiphinaa fi miidhaa guddaadhaan rakkatu argaa akka waan inni fedhiidhaan tattaafatuutti faarsuun madaallii dhabuudha.
meaning_en: Inflicting excruciating agony on someone and then cynically complimenting how remarkably fast they flee.

proverb: Alagaa ilkeen adii, alangaan sa'aa sadihi
meaning_om: Namni ormaa kolfee sitti dhihaatullee keessaan gara jabeenya fi miidhaa qabaachuu waan danda'uuf amanuun balaadha.
meaning_en: A stranger may greet you with charming, dazzling smiles, yet conceals a vicious whip of harsh treachery.

proverb: "Buutii lafa buute, dhagaa lafa guute, malli abbaarra" jette, jeedalloon
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan bifa adda addaatiin nama marsu, namuu of oolchuuf tooftaa fi dandeettii mataa isaatti dhimma bahuu qaba.
meaning_en: When peril abounds on every side, every individual must rely on their own wits and vigilance to survive.

proverb: Sussuuqachuu fi harka marachuun, nama hin jagnoomsitu
meaning_om: Taa'anii ilaaluu fi sodaadhaan lafa qabachuun bu'aa homaatuu hin fidu; gootummaan socho'uu barbaada.
meaning_en: Hesitating and passively folding one's arms will never conquer adversity; courage requires proactive deeds.

proverb: "Iyyan malee, korbeessa hin dhalchanii ?" je'e Hoolaan korbeessa re'eetiin
meaning_om: Waanuma uumamaan raawwatamu hundaaf iyyaa fi waca baay'isuun gatii akka hin qabne qeequuf dubbatama.
meaning_en: Mocking someone who creates needless noise, drama, and fanfare over ordinary, natural duties.

proverb: "Wanti barbaaddu gara duubaa jirtii, maaliif gurra irrati iyyitaa "jette re'eettiin korbeessaan
meaning_om: Dhimma furmaata barbaadu dhiisanii kallattii dogongoraatti wacuun yookiin nama hin taane dhiphisuun bu'aa hin qabu.
meaning_en: Clamoring loudly at the wrong person or place instead of directing effort toward the true objective.

proverb: Qalan malee, cooma hin argani
meaning_om: Aarsaa barbaachisu kaffalanii fi hojii qabatamaa keessa seenan malee bu'aa guddaa argachuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: One cannot enjoy rich fat without the willingness to slaughter; greatness requires sacrifice and effort.

proverb: Kan qalu hin qaanfannee, kan gogaa irraa baasu maaliif qaanfata?
meaning_om: Abbaan dhimmaa inni guddaan balleessaa isaatti osoo hin qaanfatin, namni isa gargaare qaana'uun hin malu.
meaning_en: If the primary perpetrator feels no embarrassment for his bold act, the subordinate helper has no reason to feel shame.

proverb: Uf ufiin, madaa hin fayyifne
meaning_om: Jecha afaanii yookiin sossobaa qofaan dhibee fi rakkina jabaa furuun hin danda'amu; furmaata qabatamaa barbaada.
meaning_en: Blowing cool air over a gaping wound cures nothing; real problems require substantial remedies, not mere sympathy.

proverb: Jibbansi, mujjaa hin balleessu
meaning_om: Wanta tokko jibbuun qofti wanticha hin dhabamsiisu; socho'anii hojjechuun buqqisuutu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Simply resenting troublesome weeds does not clear the field; elimination requires bending down to uproot them.

proverb: Haa na nyaatuun, beela hin baasu
meaning_om: Abdii kutannaa fi of ajeessuudhaan rakkina jalaa hin bahan; tattaaffii godhanii nyaata barbaaddachuutu mala.
meaning_en: Despairing cries of "let hunger consume me" fill no stomach; survival demands rising up to look for food.

proverb: Erga teenye, urji lakkoofna jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Namni hojii dhabee fi yeroo gubu waan bu'aa hin qabne fi dhumti isaa hin jirre keessa gala.
meaning_en: "Since we have nothing to do, let's count the stars"; idle people occupy themselves with endless, futile tasks.

proverb: nama dhaabbateetu, nama taa'urra jira
meaning_om: Namni socho'aa fi qophaa'ee jiru isa dantaa dhabee callisee taa'u caalaa carraa fi guddina qaba.
meaning_en: The person standing alert and active is in a far better state than the indolent person sitting inert.

proverb: Jibbi, waraabessa'lee hin hobbaafne
meaning_om: Waan tokko jibbuun qofti humna isa dhabamsiisu hin qabu; tarkaanfii qabatamaatu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Universal hatred never drove the hyena to extinction; emotional despise without action accomplishes nothing.

proverb: lafa citanitti, citaa guurratan
meaning_om: Bakka carraan jiru fi yeroo carraan argametti fayyadamanii bu'aa ofii sassaabbatu.
meaning_en: One gathers thatch right where it is cut; seize opportunities on the spot wherever and whenever they arise.

proverb: Namni dalagaa hin qabne, xaafii gadi naqee guura
meaning_om: Namni hojii qajeelaa dhabe dhiphinaa fi hojii bu'aa hin qabne of irratti uuma.
meaning_en: A person without meaningful work creates pointless chores, spilling grain only to collect it again.

proverb: Sagal dhuufuu mannaa, takka haguu wayya
meaning_om: Waan bu'aa hin qabne deddeebisanii dubbachuu yookiin hojjechuu mannaa murtee tokko murteessanii xumuruutu wayya.
meaning_en: Rather than repeated annoying half-measures, it is far better to take one decisive, thorough action.

proverb: Malli abbaa, karaan labba
meaning_om: Namni karoora ofii yoo baaseyyuu haalli qabatamaa karaa irratti mul'atu akka fedha isaatti ta'uu dhiisuu mala.
meaning_en: A person may formulate their clever plan, but the unpredictable realities of the road chart their own course.

proverb: Afaan lafa taa'u, hoo shuumoo
