meaning_om: Nama dalagaa malee afaaniin qofa wacu wanta salphaa itti kennanii callisiisu.
meaning_en: A loud mouth that contributes no real labor is readily shut up by stuffing it with modest boiled grain.

proverb: Ka'an fiigu, taa'an rafu jedhe hilleeysi
meaning_om: Yeroo hojjetan dandeettii guutuun hojjechuu, yeroo boqotan immoo tasgabbiin boqochuutu mala; laafina hin qabaatin.
meaning_en: "When awake, sprint with all your might; when resting, sleep deeply"; commit whole-heartedly to whatever you do.

proverb: Yoo anatti dalagattan, akkaan ani qaamaa ol ooletti namaa ol ooltan jedhe mataan namaan
meaning_om: Sammuu, beekumsaa fi hubannaadhaan yoo hojjetan jireenya keessatti kabajaa fi sadarkaa ol aanaa argatu.
meaning_en: Using your intellect and wisdom elevates your station in life above others, just as the head sits atop the body.

proverb: Namni utaalee mogolee caphe, kan ciisee cinaacha caphe ni caala
meaning_om: Tattaafachaa fi yaalii gochaa miidhamuun callisanii taa'aa yookiin ciisaa salphina keessa galuu caala.
meaning_en: Failing while daring bold endeavors is far nobler than suffering misfortune through lazy, cowardly stagnation.

proverb: Waan qaban darbannaan, sodaataa hin tahani
meaning_om: Humnaa fi carraa qaban hunda dhimma tokkoof oolchuun gootummaa fi murannoo guutuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Giving all the strength and weapons at your disposal into the struggle completely clears you of cowardice.

proverb: Miila deemuutu gala
meaning_om: Namni bahee socho'ee fi tattaafatu muuxannoo fi qabeenya argatee gara manaa milkaa'inaan deebi'a.
meaning_en: Only the foot that ventures forth travels, learns, and returns home enriched with success and experience.

proverb: Deddeebi'ii keessa, haadni dhagaa mure
meaning_om: Tattaaffiin walirraa hin cinne wantoota ulfaatoo fi jabaa fakkaatan hunda injifachuu danda'a.
meaning_en: Through constant, unrelenting friction, a soft rope eventually carves into solid rock; persistence conquers all.

proverb: Jala shidan malee hin bilchaatu
meaning_om: Hojiin bu'aa gaarii akka kennuuf aarsaa fi tattaaffii dabalataa itti gochuun dirqama.
meaning_en: Nothing cooks or ripens without fueling the steady fire of hard work underneath it; passion drives results.

proverb: Waan booda sii tolaa, garaa hidhadhuu itti jabaadhu
meaning_om: Rakkina yeroo ammaa obsaan dandeessanii gara fuulduraatti jireenya gammachiisaa argachuuf cichuu qabu.
meaning_en: Brace yourself and endure present trials with resolute courage, for the eventual outcome will be sweet.

proverb: Fagoon laga gama
meaning_om: Wanti fagoo fakkaatu yoo deemsa itti jalqaban salphaatti bira gahuun danda'ama; qorumsa sodaachuu hin qaban.
meaning_en: What appears unimaginably distant is simply across the river; once you take the first steps, distance shrinks.

proverb: Garaa dhibuu mannaa, miila dhibuu wayya
meaning_om: Miidhaa qaamaa caalaa murannoo, kaka'umsaa fi abdii garaa keessaa dhabuutu nama kuffisa.
meaning_en: Physical impairment of the feet is manageable, but lacking heart, spirit, and resolve is total defeat.

proverb: Teenyee maa gubannaa, deemnee hubanna
meaning_om: Taa'anii yaaddoodhaan dhiphachuu mannaa socho'anii dhugaa jiru baruu fi furmaata barbaaduutu caala.
meaning_en: Rather than agonizing in passive paralysis, step out into the field to investigate and understand reality directly.

proverb: Hormaanni, hiree hin tahu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi baay'achuun qofti nagaa fi gammachuu hin fidu; eebbaa fi hiree gaarii qabaachuutu caala.
meaning_en: Mere multiplying of worldly herds does not guarantee happiness; true well-being requires peace and blessed fate.

proverb: Tuffataan hiree hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni carraa fi waan xiqqoo argate tuffatu dhumarratti qoodaa fi milkaa'ina guddaa dhabee qullaa hafa.
meaning_en: He who scorns modest opportunities or gifts ends up missing out on real fortunes and blessings.

proverb: Itti buufan malee, sibiilli hin finiinu
meaning_om: Dandeettii fi humna jiru ifatti baasuuf tattaaffii jabaa fi kaka'umsa itti dabalanii hojjechuun dirqama.
meaning_en: Latent potential and raw steel remain cold and inert until the relentless bellows of labor ignite them.

proverb: Sossohuun, bakkaa nama hin siysu
meaning_om: Sochii galma fi qajeelfama hin qabneen yeroo gubuun gara guddinaatti nama hin geessu.
meaning_en: Aimless fidgeting and chaotic movement without true directional purpose yield no meaningful progress.

proverb: Kennaan guyyaa tokkoo, hiyyeessa hin guddisu
meaning_om: Gargaarsi al tokkoo rakkoo hiyyummaa bu'uuraan hin furu; hojjetanii of dandeessisuutu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: A one-off charitable handout cannot solve long-term poverty; sustainable livelihood demands work and self-reliance.

proverb: Akkumaan xullub xullub ja'u kanaaniin gaara xuulloo bahuu taa'aa je'e raachi
meaning_om: Dandeettiin ofii xiqqoo yoo ta'eyyuu obsaa fi cichoominaan galma guddaa bira gahuun akka danda'amu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: "Hop by humble hop, I will scale Mount Xuulloo"; small but steadfast strides conquer the highest peaks.

proverb: Rakkattu malee hin bal'attu
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi qorumsa jireenyaa osoo hin baatin gara badhaadhinaa fi nagaa bal'aatti bahuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: One must pass through narrow straits of hardship before reaching the wide, glorious plains of prosperity.

proverb: Hanga raatu diroon dhadhaa baati
meaning_om: Hojii tokko irratti yoo yeroo fi aarsaa gahaa kennan, bu'aa mi'aawaa fi gatii qabu argatu.
meaning_en: By patiently churning milk in the gourd, rich butter eventually separates; endurance produces sweet rewards.

proverb: Dhalti guddoon wahitti nama baafti
meaning_om: Ijoollee gaarii guddifachuu fi qabeenya bu'a qabeessa horachuun dhumarratti nama milkeessa.
meaning_en: Rearing virtuous progeny and nurturing productive stock eventually raises a household to high standing.

proverb: Nama irraa baratanii, nama irra baratani
meaning_om: Jalqaba beekumsa namootarraa fudhatanii booda dandeettii ofii guddifachuun namoota caaluu danda'u.
meaning_en: One begins by humbly learning from mentors, and by mastering that craft, one eventually excels and surpasses them.

proverb: Mixiin of hin tuffattuu, dhaga ba'attee deemti
meaning_om: Qaamaan xiqqaa ta'aniyyuu of tuffachuu dhiisanii murannoo fi cichoominaan ba'aa guddaa baachuun ni danda'ama.
meaning_en: The little ant never looks down upon its small size; it hoists heavy stones and moves purposefully forward.

proverb: Bakka aalaa itti nyaatan hin taa'ani, taa'an alotti deebi'ani
meaning_om: Milkaa'ina yeroo tokkootti gammadaa taa'uun qabeenya balleessa; hojii haaraaf socho'uutu mala.
meaning_en: Do not linger passively celebrating past bounty; complacently resting on laurels returns you straight to poverty.

proverb: Boolla arbaaf qotan, ifiif dura itti badani
meaning_om: Namni nama biraatiif kiyyoo fi hammeenya guddaa qopheessu ofuma isaatii dura itti kuffee miidhama.
meaning_en: He who digs a massive pitfall for an elephant falls into it himself first; wicked plots backfire on the plotter.

proverb: Boolla namaaf hin qotin, qottuus qad hin fageessin ifiif itti galtu hin beektuu
meaning_om: Nama miidhuuf kiyyoo qopheessuu dhiisuu wayya; yoo qopheessanis kiyyichi deebi'ee of kuffisuu mala.
meaning_en: Do not dig a trap for your fellow man, and if you do, keep it shallow; you may be the one who ends up tumbling in.

proverb: Haachuu abbaan qaree, abbaa qale
meaning_om: Wanti yookiin namni ofii jabeessanii fi qopheessan deebi'ee of irratti gara galee miidhaa geessisa.
meaning_en: The very blade sharpened carefully by its owner ended up slitting his own throat; one's creation causing ruin.

proverb: Barbareen, abbuma dhaabe gubdi
meaning_om: Hammeenyi fi bu'aan badaa namni qopheesse duraan dursee abbuma qopheesse sana guba.
meaning_en: Fiery pepper burns the very hands and mouth of the farmer who planted it; cultivating bitterness harms the cultivator.

proverb: Amiiroo keeyruma dalagi, sharriin abbuma eeggattii
meaning_om: Yeroo hunda gaarummaa fi tola qofa hojjedhu; hammeenyi fi daboon gara abbaa isaatti deebi'uun hin oolu.
meaning_en: Strive always to practice goodness and charity; wickedness inevitably lies in ambush for its own author.

proverb: Ifii ja'aniit, namaaf dhabani
meaning_om: Ofittummaan waan hunda dhuunfachuuf yaaluun dhumarratti firummaa fi gargaarsa namaa dhabsiisa.
meaning_en: Greedily hoarding everything for self-interest eventually alienates the community and leaves one helpless.

proverb: Akkuma intalti tiruu goote, tiruun intala goote
meaning_om: Gochaan namni tokko namatti raawwate akkuma jirutti deebi'ee bu'aa walfakkaataa fida; wanti kennan ni deebi'a.
meaning_en: Just as the girl treated the liver, the liver reciprocated; every action triggers an exact corresponding consequence.

proverb: Karaan ganama hijaan dabran, gala nama dhiba
meaning_om: Yeroo carraan jiru nama miidhanii darbuun yeroo rakkinaa deebi'anii nama biratti fudhatama dhabsiisa.
meaning_en: Traveling a road with malice in the morning makes returning along it in the evening impossible; do not burn bridges.

proverb: Malaani bishaan waadan;
meaning_om: Beekumsa, malaa fi tooftaa qajeelaadhaan wanta hin danda'amne fakkaatu hunda raawwachuun ni danda'ama.
meaning_en: With sharp intelligence and ingenuity, one can even roast water; clever strategy accomplishes the impossible.

proverb: Ijji taa'aa hin agartuu, malaani udaan irraa haqan,
meaning_om: Wanta ijaan kallattiin hin argineyyuu hubannoo, ogummaa fi tooftaa barataniin to'atanii qulqulleessu.
meaning_en: Though the eyes cannot see the sitting rear, practiced technique wipes it clean; intellect manages unseen matters.

proverb: Dukkana Keessaa ifaa si baasaa, rakkoo keessaa malaa si baasa
meaning_om: Akkuma ifaan dukkana dhabamsiisee qajeelcha kennu, beekumsaa fi falli qajeelaan rakkina keessaa nama baasa.
meaning_en: Just as bright light delivers one from deep darkness, sound ingenuity and wisdom guide one out of severe crisis.

proverb: Adunyaan aylumaa, aakiraan amaluma
meaning_om: Jireenya addunyaa keessatti qaroomaa fi malaan jiraatan, aakiraa keessatti garuu amala qajeelaa fi hojii gaariitu faayidaa qaba.
meaning_en: Surviving this earthly world requires sharp wits and intelligence; attaining eternal salvation demands moral virtue.

proverb: Marqa afuufuun, sossobanii liqimsuufi
meaning_om: Wanta jabaa fi ulfaataa ta'e obsaan tasgabbeessanii fi laaffisanii dhimma ofii galmaan gahatu.
meaning_en: Blowing gently upon steaming porridge is merely a patient tactic to cool it down and swallow it smoothly.

proverb: Yaa marqa wanniniin si afuufuuf si liqimsuufi malee, si dhiisuufii miti
meaning_om: Tasgabbiin yookiin laafina yeroof agarsiisan dhimma sana dhiisuuf osoo hin taane tooftaadhaan milkeessuufi.
meaning_en: Patience and gentle delay should never be mistaken for surrender or abandonment; the objective will be seized.

proverb: Muccaa abbaa lafaa utuu irratti kufuu beekanuu jalatti kufu
meaning_om: Abbaa taayitaa yookiin nama aangoo qabu kabajuu fi balaa irraa eeguuf jecha miidhaa ofitti fudhatu.
meaning_en: Knowing the powerful landlord's heir is falling, subordinates dive beneath him to cushion the impact and absorb injury.

proverb: Hantuutni boolla lamaa hin du'u
meaning_om: Namni karoorawwan filannoo fi mala dabalataa qabu balaa fi rakkoo tasa mudatu keessaa salphaatti baha.
meaning_en: A mouse that prepares two exit holes rarely gets trapped; having contingency alternatives ensures survival.

proverb: Allaatti nyaachuu kajeelan, sololiyaa jedhanin
meaning_om: Wanta dhowwamaa yookiin seeraan ala ta'e raawwachuuf fedhaniif maqaa gaarii fi fudhatama qabu kennaniifii gocha sana dhiheessu.
meaning_en: When craving to eat a taboo scavenger bird, they re-label it a delicious partridge; justifying vices by rebranding them.

proverb: Saalaa haada sa'aatiin qabani
meaning_om: Meeshaa fi tooftaa salphaa harkaa qabaniin wanta guddaa, sodaachisaa fi rakkisaa ta'e to'achuun ni danda'ama.
meaning_en: A fierce, wild oryx can be secured with a simple domestic cow-rope; accessible tools tame mighty wild challenges.

proverb: Ilma abaan kiyyaatu tahaan ergachuu dadhabe, ormi keetiitu tahaan ergate
meaning_om: Namni maatii isaatiif ajajamuuf of tuulee dide ormi isa cabsanii salphinatti isa bitu.
meaning_en: The defiant son who refused his father's gentle guidance was completely broken and subordinated by cruel strangers.

proverb: "Buufaa bari, kijiba bari, jaldhaaba bari" je'e, tumtichi ilmaan
meaning_om: Hojii fi daldala keessatti dandeettii harkaa qofa osoo hin taane tooftaa haasaa fi dhiheessaa beekuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: In craft and commerce, technical skill alone is insufficient; one must master persuasive negotiation and diplomacy.

proverb: "Maaliif gurra re'eettii irratti iyyita" je'ee korbeesi hoolaa gaafannaan "akka anaaf laaftu godhuu kiyya" je'e korbeessi re'ee
meaning_om: Namni tokko fedhii isaa salphaatti raawwachiifachuuf tooftaa naasuu fi wacaatti dhimma baha.
meaning_en: Creating sensory overload and noisy panic is often used as a deliberate tactic to disorient and secure compliance.

proverb: Harka dhagaa jala seene, suuta suutaan baafatani
meaning_om: Yeroo rakkina ulfaataa fi kiyyoo jabaa keessa galan tasgabbiidhaan, obsaan of bilisa baasu malee hin jarjaran.
meaning_en: A hand caught beneath a crushing boulder must be extricated millimeter by millimeter; volatile crises demand patient delicacy.

proverb: Faranjiin, malaani bishaan gaara baafti
meaning_om: Beekumsa, malaa fi saayinsiidhaan wantoota uumamaan hin danda'amne fakkaatan hunda milkeessuun ni danda'ama.
meaning_en: Through technical ingenuity and applied engineering, foreigners pump water uphill; intelligence conquers physical barriers.

proverb: Kuni tooftaan meeshaa ittiin gurguratanii jette hantuutni
meaning_om: Balaa fi kiyyoo lubbuu dhabsiisu salphistanii ilaaluun gowwummaa guddaadha.
meaning_en: The mouse rationalized the lethal baited trap as mere advertising; foolishly trivializing a fatal danger.

proverb: Namni bishaan daakkii beeku, dakkii keessattii nama dhiita
meaning_om: Namni ogummaa fi beekumsa addaa qabu dandeettii isaatti fayyadamee dhoksaan nama miidhuu danda'a.
meaning_en: An expert swimmer uses his underwater prowess to secretly kick and sabotage others; expertise abused for covert harm.

proverb: Booyyeen nama nyaattiin waan gabraan sodaachisani
meaning_om: Oduu sobaa fi wanta hin jirre uumuudhaan namoota dadhaboo sodaachisanii to'annaa jala oolchu.
meaning_en: Fabricating absurd fairy-tale horrors to keep servants terrified, docile, and completely subservient.

proverb: Luka falmii, harki haa lafa bu'u
meaning_om: Yeroo dhimma guddaa fi lubbuu irratti qabsa'an wanta xiqqoo aarsaa gochuun ooluutu wayya.
meaning_en: In a life-and-death struggle over saving one's limbs, brace with the hand or make minor concessions to preserve the whole.

proverb: Dubbii sii hin tahin, haayaan si hin dhibin, bakkaa si hin argin
meaning_om: Dhimma ofii hin taane keessa seenuu dhiisuu, waadaa hin galle seenuu dhiisuu fi of eeggannoo gochuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Do not meddle in matters not your own; do not bind yourself with careless assent, and steer clear of the scene.

proverb: Niitiin karraan baatu, ati qoqqobaan bahi
meaning_om: Yeroo aariin ka'u walitti bu'iinsa kallattiirraa fagaatanii karaa tasgabbii fi nagaa filachuun maatii baraarsa.
meaning_en: When anger flares and your partner charges through the main gate, take the side hedge; avoid destructive frontal clashes.

proverb: Toosiiboon luynooma hin qabdu
meaning_om: Yeroo dhiphinaa fi qorumsi lubbuu dhufu namni sodaataan iyyuu ija jabinaan falmachuuf dirqama.
meaning_en: Dire emergency and existential necessity erase cowardice; when survival is at stake, even the meekest find ferocious bravery.

proverb: Dhaamonnaan harkifnee, nuun lollaan lakkifne
meaning_om: Waan qananii yookiin salphaadhaaf jecha lola fi jeequmsa keessa galuu mannaa dhiisanii nagaan jiraachuutu caala.
meaning_en: We drew the cover for warmth, but when contested with hostility we yielded; never buy trivial comfort with bloodshed.

proverb: lola leencaa harka tokkotti eeboo, harka tokkotti marga baatu
meaning_om: Balaa guddaa dura dhaabbachuuf qophii lolaa fi mala araaraa lamaanuu qabatanii deemuun ogummaa dhugaati.
meaning_en: Facing the lion, hold a weapon of defense in one hand and fresh grass of peace in the other; prepare for all outcomes.

proverb: Joollee maleeykaa dubbisaa, diddu didi malee muca
meaning_om: Ijoolleen amanamummaa fi qulqullummaan wanta garaa isaanii dubbatu; haqa isaaniis iftoominan simachuu qabu.
meaning_en: Children communicate with angelic purity; if they decline something, their simple, unfeigned refusal should be honored.

proverb: Kiyyaan na duraa hin lolino, jette niitiin dhiirsaan
meaning_om: Maqaa jaalala ofiitiin firaa fi aanaa namaa wajjin walitti bu'iinsa uumuun balaa guddaa akka qabu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: "Do not quarrel with my kin in the name of fighting for me"; never fracture your partner's family out of misguided zeal.

proverb: Dukkanaaf ifa, hiraariif ayliitu barbbaachisa
meaning_om: Akkuma dukkanni ifaan dhabamu, dhiphinaa fi gadadoo jireenyaa keessaa bahuufis sammuu fi fala beekumsaatu furmaata.
meaning_en: Just as physical darkness is pierced by light, emotional anguish and deep distress require intellect and wisdom to overcome.

proverb: Tokkichi waaqa hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni kophaa hafe firaa fi deggersa waan dhabuuf salphaatti kufaatii fi miidhaaf saaxilama.
meaning_en: An isolated individual lacks both divine and communal shield; human beings need solidarity to survive.

proverb: Qubni tokko, fuula hin dhiqu
meaning_om: Hojii guddaa fi hawaasummaa namni tokko qofaan galmaan gahuu hin danda'u; harka walitti qabachuutu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: A single finger cannot wash a face; communal, cooperative effort is required to accomplish significant tasks.

proverb: Qubni tokko, tiiticha hin qabu
meaning_om: Qophaa socho'uun wanta salphaa iyyuu to'achuuf rakkisaadha; tokkummaan humna uuma.
meaning_en: A single finger cannot trap an agile fly; even capturing small opportunities requires coordinated teamwork.

proverb: Arrabni kophaa, irree hin qabu
meaning_om: Dubbiin yookiin himannaan deggersa ummataa fi tokkummaa hin qabne humnaa fi fudhatama dhabee hafa.
meaning_en: Words spoken in isolation possess no real force; speech acquires authority only through collective backing.

proverb: Harki tokko, of hin dhiqu
meaning_om: Namni kamuu gargaarsa nama biraa malee qulqulluu fi guutuu ta'uu hin danda'u; wal deeggaruutu mala.
meaning_en: One hand cannot wash itself; mutual assistance and reciprocity are essential for human cleanliness and survival.

proverb: Beekaa tokko irraa, gowwaa lamaatu caala
meaning_om: Yaada walitti fiduu fi waliin mari'achuun beekumsa nama dhuunfaa qofaa caalaa bu'aa fida.
meaning_en: Two fools in mutual consultation accomplish more than a solitary sage; collective dialogue beats isolated wisdom.

proverb: Kophaa nyaattuun, kopha duuti
meaning_om: Namni ofittummaadhaan namaa wajjin hin qooddanne yeroo rakkinaa fi du'aa firaa fi gargaaraa dhabee bada.
meaning_en: The hoarder who eats in solitary selfishness dies in lonely abandonment, deprived of kin and mourners.

proverb: Tokko ni aara malee, hin bobbahu
meaning_om: Namni kophaa isaa tattaafatu aaree dadhaba malee jijjiirama guddaa fi ifa mul'atu fiduu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A solitary piece of firewood only smolders with irritating smoke; glowing flames require burning logs together.

proverb: Harki tokko kophaa hin shubbisu
meaning_om: Waliigalteen, gammadaniis ta'ee hojiin milkaa'u nama lamaa fi isaa ol barbaada.
meaning_en: One hand alone cannot clap to dance; harmony, agreement, and joy require the meeting of two sides.

proverb: Namni mana tokko jaaru citaa wal hin saamu
meaning_om: Warri galma tokko qaban wal gargaaru malee wal dura dhaabbachuun bu'aa isaanii hin mancaasan.
meaning_en: Those constructing the same roof do not snatch thatch from each other; united teams cooperate to build.

proverb: jabaateef tokko gogaa hin dhifu
meaning_om: Humni dhuunfaa hamma fedhe jabaatus hojii tokkummaa barbaadu qofaan hojjetanii xumuruun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: However physically powerful an individual may be, stretching and pegging a hide requires multiple hands.

proverb: Ilkeen hidhiin bira hin jirre hin toltu
meaning_om: Qaamoleen yookiin namoonni walitti hidhata qaban addaan baanaan miidhaginaa fi eegumsa dhabu.
meaning_en: Teeth exposed without the sheltering grace of lips are both vulnerable and hideous; partners shield one another.

proverb: Guddinni bineensaa buukii wajji, guddinni bishingaa biyyee wajji
meaning_om: Namnis ta'ee uumamni kamuu naannoo fi hawaasa isa deggaru wajjin taanaan qofa milkaa'ina fi guddina argata.
meaning_en: Wildlife flourishes within the shielding thicket, and sorghum thrives in rich soil; flourishing demands community roots.

proverb: Bofni biyyee wajjiin, namni biyyaa wajjiin
meaning_om: Namni lammii fi biyya isaa wajjin qofa kabajamaa fi jabaa ta'ee jiraachuu danda'a.
meaning_en: A snake thrives in intimate communion with the dust, and a human attains true honor rooted in their homeland.

proverb: Kophaa dhiqaan, xurii hin baasu
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi hanqina ofii hunda qofaan sirreessuun hin danda'amu; gorsa fi tumsa namaa barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Scrubbing oneself in isolation leaves the back unwashed; self-improvement and blind spots require trusted helpers.

proverb: Tokkummaan nama jabeessa
meaning_om: Wal ta'iinsaa fi tokkummaan humni namootaa akka dachaan cimu taasisa.
meaning_en: Solidarity and collective harmony multiply individual power, transforming communities into unyielding strongholds.

proverb: Sareen wal nyaattu, waraabeeysa of irraa hin aatu
meaning_om: Yeroo namoonni keessaan wal lolan diina alaa dhufee isaan miidhu ofirraa ittisuu hin danda'an.
meaning_en: Pack dogs tearing into one another cannot bark away the encroaching hyena; internal strife invites predation.

proverb: Bofni walitti marameeti Arba hidha
meaning_om: Namoonni dadhaboon yoo tokkummaa jabaa qabaatan humna diina guddaa fi jabaa kamuu cabsuu danda'u.
meaning_en: Thin serpents coiling tightly together form a cable that ties up an elephant; collective unity fells titans.

proverb: Qunceen wal gargaarteeti muka hiiti
meaning_om: Wanti xiqqaani fi dadhabaan yoo wal gargaare humna cimaa uumuun wanta guddaa to'achuu danda'a.
meaning_en: Fragile strips of inner bark joining forces form a stout rope that binds heavy logs; cooperation yields great power.

proverb: Walii galan, daboon (guuzni) nama hin dhibu
meaning_om: Waliigaltee fi jaalalli yoo jiraate hojiin ulfaataan hawaasaa salphaatti fi gammachuudhaan raawwatama.
meaning_en: Where mutual love and agreement flourish, massive communal cooperative labor feels effortless and joyful.

proverb: heera walii galli fannise, alaanalli hin buufne
meaning_om: Seeraa fi murtee uummanni waliigaleen murteesse eenyuyyuu salphaatti diiguu yookiin cabsuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A customary covenant consecrated by the general assembly cannot be overturned by isolated rogue outlaws.

proverb: Ilkee bakka takka jirtuutu, waa ciniina
meaning_om: Qindoominaa fi tokkummaadhaan yoo socho'an qorumsa jabaa hundumaa salphaatti injifatu.
meaning_en: Only teeth aligned tightly in unison can bite through tough sustenance; united ranks cut through all resistance.

proverb: Harki tokko ni dhiqa malee, xurii hin baasu
meaning_om: Tattaaffiin nama tokkoo qofti bu'aa guutuu hin fidu; wal gargaarsa harka lamaatiin qulqullinni fida.
meaning_en: A solitary hand may splash water, but cannot scour out deeply ground dirt; spotless results require two hands.

proverb: Harka lamaatu wal dhiqa
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu gargaarsa nama biraa barbaada; wal deeggaruun jireenya guutuu taasisa.
meaning_en: Two hands wash each other; mutual assistance and symbiotic friendship make life complete and clean.

proverb: Hancufti ida'aa galaanaati
meaning_om: Gumaachi xiqqoon namuu godhu walitti qabamee qabeenyaa fi humna guddaa uuma.
meaning_en: Modest drops of saliva gathered collectively form a swelling torrent; micro-contributions create massive reserves.

proverb: Caphaan lama, walitti fayyaa tokko
meaning_om: Namoonni hanqina qaban yoo walitti dhufanii wal deeggaran humna guutuu fi bu'a qabeessa ta'u.
meaning_en: Two fractured entities uniting together become one complete, sound organism; mutual support heals shared weakness.

proverb: Warra wal tahe, biddeena tokkootu quubsa
meaning_om: Maatii jaalalaa fi tokkummaa qabuuf qabeenyi xiqqoonis nagaa fi quufa guutuu kenna.
meaning_en: For a united household living in true concord, a single flatbread satisfies all; harmony multiplies scarce bread.

proverb: Wal taha araddaatu, heera fugug mooha
meaning_om: Tokkummaan naannoo fi hawaasa bu'uuraa dhiibbaa fi murtii alaa kamuu mo'atee haqa mirkaneessa.
meaning_en: The close consensus of the local village green defeats distant authoritarian edicts; grassroots unity prevails.

proverb: Kan tuutaa wajji hin nyaanne, hantuutaa wajji nyaata
meaning_om: Namni hawaasatti makamee qooddachuu dide dhumarratti qobummaa fi hiyyummaa keessa bu'a.
meaning_en: He who refuses to fellowship and share meals with his community will eventually dine in isolated squalor with mice.

proverb: Xuuxxoon shantam nama tokkoof ba'aa dha, nama shantamiif boona
meaning_om: Hojiin ulfaataan yoo qoodamee waloon hojjetame salphaa, gammachuu fi boonsaa ta'a.
meaning_en: Fifty bundles of reed thatch break the spine of one lone carrier, but divided among fifty, they are light work and proud fanfare.

proverb: Beekaan, biyya ofiitti hin kabajamu
meaning_om: Namni beekumsa qabu yeroo baay'ee namoota naannoo isaatti argamaniin tuffatama yookiin gatii dhabsiifama.
meaning_en: Familiarity often breeds contempt; people rarely appreciate or acknowledge the wisdom of someone from their own community.

proverb: Namni nama dhaabe, muka nama seeha
meaning_om: Namni nama biraa rakkise yookiin hojii dadhabsiisaa irratti dhiise, dhibee fi dadhabbii nama sanaa hin tilmaamu.
meaning_en: Someone who burdens or makes others wait fails to realize human fatigue and treats them as unfeeling objects.

proverb: Nama kuffisaniif, lukku (handaaqqoo) kuffisani
meaning_om: Nama tuffatan yookiin gadi xiqqeessan irratti wanta xinnoo fi salphaa ta'e godhanii ittiin qoosu.
meaning_en: When people look down on someone, they offer minimal respect or insult them further under guise of an offering.

proverb: Nama tuffatan, sare jalatti dhaanan
meaning_om: Nama tuffatan yookiin jibbaniif kallattiin dubbachuu dhiisanii ergaa tuffii karaa biraatiin dabarsuufi.
meaning_en: Disdain for someone is indirectly shown by mistreating things around them or directing veiled hostility in their presence.

proverb: Warra yarsan, mooti duraa ajjeesan
meaning_om: Gosa yookiin nama tuffatamee fi humna dhabe tokko wanta guddaa inni kabaju duraa balleessuun caalaatti salphisu.
meaning_en: To crush and humiliate a vulnerable group or person, one destroys their greatest pride or protector.

proverb: Ani hamma namaa hin ga'u, namni garaa na hin ga'u
meaning_om: Ofii xinnoo ta'anii wanta guddaa hawwuu, yookiin of tuffachaa warra kaanillee tuffachuu.
meaning_en: Being physically small or humble in status, yet having insatiable desires or finding no one good enough.

proverb: Namni namarra jiru, ciiseeti nama dhiita
meaning_om: Namni humna qabu yookiin aangoorra jiru nama isa jala jiru salphumatti miidha.
meaning_en: Those in superior power or authority easily abuse and suppress those under their control without much effort.

proverb: Hadaamiin, wal qixxaattu malee hin kuftu
meaning_om: Wanti tokko yoo garmalee baay'atee fi madaallii dhabe kufiinsi isaa saffisaa ta'a; badiin wal-faana dhufa.
meaning_en: A top-heavy structure or arrogant collective falls all at once when overdeveloped beyond measure.

proverb: Miilli mata ja'a, mataan miila ja'a
meaning_om: Wal-dhabdee, wal-tuffachuu fi iddoo walii beekuu dhabuu irraan kan ka'e walii galteen dhabamuu.
meaning_en: A state of total confusion, disrespect, and disorder where roles are reversed and no one agrees.

proverb: Jiraa sablisuun, jalaa callisuu dha
meaning_om: Nama dharrooftuu, lolu yookiin falmu mo'achuuf cal'isuutu falli gaariidha.
meaning_en: The most effective way to disarm an aggressive or foolish troublemaker is maintaining dignified silence.

proverb: Iddoo cabsituun jirtuutti, hin guddatani
meaning_om: Bakka namni nama kuffisu, hamilee nama cabsu yookiin hiraarsu jirutti guddinni hin jiru.
meaning_en: No progress or development is possible in an environment dominated by toxic and destructive people.

proverb: Cabsituun, fardaan ushee jetti
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa qabu wanta kabajamaa fi jabaa ta'ellee salphisee tuffata.
meaning_en: A reckless or ignorant person treats valuable and noble things with foolish disrespect.

proverb: Kan harree hin qabne, gaangee namaatiin "har" ja'a
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatii homaa hin qabne qabeenya nama biraatiin of jajuu yookiin ajajuu barbaada.
meaning_en: One who possesses nothing attempts to boss around or show off using someone else's superior property.

proverb: Waraabessi osoo bushaa bushaa ja'uuti harree nyaatee fixe
meaning_om: Wanta tokko tuffachaa fi ceepha'aa garuu hunda isaa fayyadamuu yookiin duguuguu.
meaning_en: Hypocritically disparaging something while consuming or taking full advantage of it to the very end.

proverb: Hin qaanfattuu, dhiirsaan aboo jetti
meaning_om: Namni kabajaa fi safuu hin beekne nama ulfina qabuuf ulfina malu hin kennu.
meaning_en: A shameless or ill-mannered person lacks boundaries and addresses their superiors or partners insolently.

proverb: "Deegii aabboon mana namaa na kaayullee, baaduun waa aannanii miti" jette, haftuun
meaning_om: Rakkinni nama qunnamullee, wanta gaarii fi badaa, sobaa fi dhugaa adda baasanii beekuun hin hafu.
meaning_en: Hard times do not blind a person of dignity from distinguishing genuine quality from cheap substitutes.

proverb: "Doofaa kana heerumuu mannaa, dubrummaa dhaan hafuu naa wayyaa" jette intalti
meaning_om: Nama wallaalaa fi bu'aa hin qabne waliin walitti hidhamuu irra kophaa of danda'anii jiraachuutu filatama.
meaning_en: Remaining single and preserving peace of mind is better than yoking oneself to an ignorant and reckless partner.

proverb: Jaarsa heerumtee mannaa, eda duutee wayya
meaning_om: Jireenya gaa'ilaa kan gammachuu fi abdii hin qabne keessa seenuu caalaa du'a filachuu ibsa.
meaning_en: Suffering an ill-matched, miserable union is portrayed as far worse than an untimely death.

proverb: Adurree ciifte, hantuunni mataarra deema
meaning_om: Hoggantoonni yookiin qaamni seera eegsisu yoo laafe, kanneen sodaatan duraanii ija jabina argatanii roorrisu.
meaning_en: When authority or vigilance sleeps, those formerly timid grow emboldened and overstep boundaries.

proverb: "Dhiirsi humaa naa hin goone, dhuufuun na ajjeese" jette, niitiin
meaning_om: Nama faayidaa homaayyuu hin qabne garuu dhibee fi nuffii qofa nama irratti baay'isu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Describing someone who contributes nothing beneficial yet causes nuisance and annoyance continuously.

proverb: Tiitichi nama ajjeesuu baatu, nama haqqisiisuu hin oolu
meaning_om: Wanti xinnoon yookiin namni dandeettii xiqqaa qabu nama balleessuu baatus, jireenya jeequu fi nuffisiisuu danda'a.
meaning_en: Even if an insignificant adversary or minor nuisance cannot destroy you, it can still cause great disgust, discomfort, and disruption.

proverb: Ableen, tan harsama hin murreetu, nama mure
meaning_om: Meeshaan yookiin namni wanta laafaa tokko hojjechuu dadhabe tasa nama irratti balaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a.
meaning_en: Someone or something deemed incapable of handling simple tasks unexpectedly causes serious injury or harm.

proverb: Xiqqaatulee bofa irra hin ajjatani
meaning_om: Wanta balaa qabu yookiin diina xinnoo ta'ellee tuffatanii of dagachuun hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Dangerous adversaries or threats should never be underestimated simply because they are small.

proverb: Injireen bulleeti, injijiin buluu dadhabne
meaning_om: Rakkina guddaa obsaan dandeessanii osoo jirtanii rakkoo xinnoo fi nuffisiistuudhaan dadhabuu.
meaning_en: Enduring a major hardship only to be worn down and defeated by petty, persistent annoyances.

proverb: Mixii illee taatu, maquma duulaatiin sodaa dha jedhe arbi
meaning_om: Humni tokko yoo wal ta'ee fi gurmaa'ee dhufe, hammamiyyuu xiqqaatu sodaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Numbers and unity create a formidable threat that even the mighty cannot afford to disregard.

proverb: Arbaa fi mixiin wal lolaniiti baallama qabatani, arbi walitti qabamee "xiqqeenyaaf diina hin tuffatanii nurraa laalaa" je'e
meaning_om: Diina xiqqaa ta'e tuffatanii of dagachuun kufaatii guddaaf nama saaxila; of-eeggannoon yeroo hunda barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Never underestimate an adversary based on physical size or stature; small foes can topple the giants.

proverb: Namni galgala, ni gaaroma
meaning_om: Namni yeroo dhumarratti yookiin erga dullomee/rakkate booda amala gaarii fi araara barbaadu ta'a.
meaning_en: People soften, mellow, and seek reconciliation as they grow older or as their day draws to an end.

proverb: Sangaan bara qotu heedata (lakkaawata)
meaning_om: Namni yookiin uumamni dadhabbiin itti baay'ate waggaa fi dhiphina dabarse ni yaadata.
meaning_en: Those who labor long and hard bear the memory and physical toll of every year of hard toil.

proverb: Huccuun miicca lakkaawatti
meaning_om: Wanti tokko deddeebi'amee yoo itti fayyadaman yookiin rukutame suuta suuta miidhamaa fi dhumachaa deema.
meaning_en: Repeated friction, handling, or wear steadily degrades even the most resilient material.

proverb: Jaarsi ture, baay'ee beeka
meaning_om: Muuxannoon jireenyaa fi turtii dheeraan beekumsaa fi hubannaa guddaa namaaf kenna.
meaning_en: Longevity and life experience bestow profound wisdom, knowledge, and understanding.

proverb: Ballaa fi ajjuuzaan, keeyrii hin qabani
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii of danda'uu hin qabne yookiin haalli itti jabaate namaafis ta'e ofiif bu'aa buusuun itti ulfaata.
meaning_en: Those utterly destitute of physical ability and resources find it difficult to render benevolence to others.

proverb: Midhagaa guddatani, fokkisaa dulloomani
meaning_om: Bareedinni fi dargaggummaan kan darbuudha; dullumni uumama namaa kan jijjiiruu fi dadhabsiisudha.
meaning_en: Youth and physical beauty are ephemeral; aging inevitably brings physical decay and frailty.

proverb: Jaartiin jaarsaaf daa'ima
meaning_om: Jaarroleen yeroo dullooman walii isaaniif kunuunsa, marartoo fi jaalala akka daa'imaatti walii kennu.
meaning_en: Aging partners view and protect each other with deep tenderness, vulnerability, and gentle affection.

proverb: Namni moluu qabu, bakka itti tolu hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni hanqina yookiin amala jibbisiisaa qabu bakka hundatti nagaa dhabuu fi komatamuu.
meaning_en: Someone who carries obvious flaws or persistent insecurities finds restlessness wherever they go.

proverb: Jaarsaa fi gaayyaa ganama naqu
meaning_om: Jaarsolii fi wantoota barbaachisoo ta'an ganamaan kunuunsuun aadaa fi safuu Oromootti kabajamaadha.
meaning_en: Providing care, nourishment, and attention to elders early in the day is essential duty and respect.

proverb: Ilmi ni ceeha malee, abbaa hin dabru
meaning_om: Dhaloonni ammayyaa dandeettii fi saffisa qabaatus, seenaa, maqaa fi kabaja abbaa dhalche dhabamsiisuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A son may achieve great agility or success, but the foundational role and legacy of the father remain paramount.

proverb: Dulluma hin muudanii, arrii hin funaanani
meaning_om: Dullumni uumama Waaqaa waan ta'eef jijjiiruun yookiin dhowwuun hin danda'amu; fudhachuutu barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Old age is an inevitable natural process ordained by Providence; it cannot be halted or hidden.

proverb: Dullattiin qoraan hin dhaqattu, ibiddaaf gaabbii hin qabdu
meaning_om: Namni hojii isaaf hin malle yookiin humna hin qabne irraa of qusatus, wanta argamuun quufee nagaadhaan jiraata.
meaning_en: Those freed by age or limitation from strenuous labor enjoy whatever warmth is provided without grievance.

proverb: Raachi bishaan galaa, jaarsi yeroon gala
meaning_om: Namni beekaan yookiin maanguddoon iddoo fi yeroo isaaf malu beekee of eeggannoodhaan socho'a.
meaning_en: A wise person knows their proper place, sets healthy boundaries, and acts with impeccable timing.

proverb: Dubbii gaarii manguddoo irraa fudhatani
meaning_om: Gorsi gaariin, murtiin dhugaa fi araarri maanguddoota muuxannoo qaban irraa argama.
meaning_en: Sound counsel, reconciliation, and righteous judgment are gathered from the wisdom of elders.

proverb: Gorsi ergisaa dha, ayliin handhura
meaning_om: Gorsi namaa gargaaruu danda'a garuu hubannaan ofii kan dhalootaan nama keessa jiruudha.
meaning_en: External advice can assist someone, but innate wisdom and sound judgment must come from within.

proverb: Roobuus, caamuus, ijji misiraa lama
meaning_om: Haalli yoo jijjiiramellee uumamni ykn amalli wanta tokkoo hin jijjiiramu.
meaning_en: No matter how external conditions change, intrinsic nature and fundamental facts remain unchanged.

proverb: Boortaan, ilma hin dhalchiiftu
meaning_om: Of gurguddisuu fi afaaniin dhaadachuun bu'aa qabatamaa hin argamsiisu.
meaning_en: Empty boasting and false pride do not yield practical achievements or real progeny.

proverb: Abbaan, jaalatee hin fokkatu
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu fedhii isaatiin waan badaan ykn salphinni akka isa irra ga'u hin barbaadu.
meaning_en: No one deliberately chooses ugliness, flaws, or misfortune; shortcomings are often beyond personal control.

proverb: Shanyii malee, hantuutni adii hin daltu
meaning_om: Amallii fi wanti hundi sanyii fi hidda dhalootaa irraa dhufa malee tasa hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Characteristics and values stem from origin and heredity; nothing appears without its corresponding root.

proverb: Lukkuun hedduun iyyiteef, hin barihu
meaning_om: Wantoonni yeroo fi sirna isaanii eeggatu malee jarjaraan hin ta'an.
meaning_en: Events unfold according to their designated schedule; commotion and impatience cannot rush time.

proverb: Jarjaraniif, abbaa fi haadha dura hin dhalatani
meaning_om: Wanti hundi tartiiba fi daangaa qaba; ariifachuun seera uumaa hin jijjiiru.
meaning_en: Impatience cannot overturn the natural sequence of events or fundamental hierarchies.

proverb: Bokkaan lafa nyaphaatiis ni rooba
meaning_om: Toli fi arjummaan uumaa nama hundaaf wal qixa; hammeenyi fi jibbi tola Rabbii hin daangessu.
meaning_en: Natural blessings and divine generosity fall impartially on all, even upon adversaries.

proverb: Karaa huurkaan bahuun, baga dhiigni hin argini
meaning_om: Baga balaan guddaan hin dhufin; waan xiqqaatti hafuun galateeffamuu qaba.
meaning_en: It is a relief when great tragedy is avoided and distress remains confined to mere sweat and labor.

proverb: Afaan hin qoraasani, afaan dubbii mi'eessu ganama dhalata
meaning_om: Dandeettiin haasaa fi dubbii bareechuu kennaa uumamaati malee wanta boodarra bitamu miti.
meaning_en: True eloquence and articulate speech are innate gifts rather than artificial affectations.

proverb: Aduun rakkoo namaa hin beektuu, osoo laalanuu dhiiti
meaning_om: Yeroon namaaf hin dhaabbatu; rakkinni namaa yeroo fi uumama hin dhowwu.
meaning_en: Time marches onward indifferently without halting for anyone's troubles or uncompleted tasks.

proverb: Gaalli eegeen saawaa, mataan nama
meaning_om: Wanti tokko amala fi bifa adda addaa of keessatti qabaata; wanti hundi wal-makoodha.
meaning_en: A creature or situation can possess contrasting features; reality is full of unexpected paradoxes.

proverb: "Fuula waaqaatu miidhagsaa, deeminsa abbaatu tolfata" je'e, jaldeessi
meaning_om: Bifa fi uumamni kennaa Waaqayyoo yoo ta'eeyyuu, amala fi deemsa ofii namaatu tolfata.
meaning_en: Physical endowment is determined by God, but posture, conduct, and manners are one's personal duty.

proverb: Uumaa Rabbiitu tolchaa, sansaankaa abbaatu tolfata
meaning_om: Dhalootaa fi bifa Waaqatu kenna, garuu amala gaarii fi adeemsa qajeelaa ofiitu horata.
meaning_en: God grants physical creation, but cultivating upright character and moral habits is up to the individual.

proverb: Dhama'aan dhama raasa
meaning_om: Hojii bu'aa hin qabne irratti ifaajuu ykn dadhabuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Wasting time and energy on an endeavor that yields no profit or substance.

proverb: Gowwaan, bishaan bahar waraabee fixuuf tattaafata
meaning_om: Waan danda'amuu hin dandeenye fi daangaa hin qabne gochuuf tattaafachuu gowwummaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Undertaking an impossible and boundless task through pure lack of sense.

proverb: Sareen gowwaan, dumessatti dutti
meaning_om: Wanta miidhaa nama irra hin geessisne ykn qaqqabamuu hin dandeenye irratti wacuu.
meaning_en: Making useless noise against harmless things that are completely out of reach.

proverb: Dubbii kalessa turte, ar'a hin gaafatani
meaning_om: Wanta darbe fi xumurame deebisanii kaasanii jeequmsa uumuun hin barbaachisu.
meaning_en: Past, settled issues should not be exhumed to stir up fresh controversy.

proverb: Gowwaan, gobeensa akkafeeti firii irraa eeggata
meaning_om: Waan gatii hin qabne irraa bu'aa gaarii fi qooda eeguun gowwummaa ta'uu ibsa.
meaning_en: Harboring unrealistic hopes of gaining valuable sustenance from worthless material.

proverb: Dukkanatti, ija hin baasani
meaning_om: Haala wanti tokko hin danda'amne keessatti of dhiphisuun bu'aa akka hin qabne agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Straining oneself in circumstances where achievement is inherently impossible is useless.

proverb: Kunuu hin jirtuu, kunuu hin cittu, foon dullachaa
meaning_om: Wanti tokko furmaata dhabee, tolus diddee baduus diddee yeroo nama rakkisu.
meaning_en: Refers to an obstinate, indecisive problem or situation that neither resolves nor goes away.

proverb: Arbaan caccabsaaf moorreen (xirinyiin) udaan bakka takkatti guurti
meaning_om: Humna ofii osoo hin beekin waan guddaa injifachuuf yaaluu fi of tuuluu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: An insignificant party foolishly plotting to bring down a giant through trivial means.

proverb: "Waaniin ani lama butee dadhabe" je'e, waraabessi
meaning_om: Wanta lama al tokkotti qabachuuf bololuun lamaanuu dhabsiisa.
meaning_en: Greedily attempting to seize two prizes at once results in losing both completely.

proverb: Gowwaan, bakka loon hin oolinii faltii barbaada
meaning_om: Bakka wanti tokko hin jirretti ykn hin eegamnetti qisaasa'anii barbaaduu ibsa.
meaning_en: Futilely looking for results or resources in a place where they could never exist.

proverb: Sa'a eegee nyaatu, eeganii hin dandayani
meaning_om: Nama amala balleessaa ofii qabu fi gorsa hin fudhanne eeguun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: It is impossible to rescue or monitor someone persistently determined on self-destruction.

proverb: Ibidda dhaame, daaraa hin afuufani
meaning_om: Dhimma xumuramee fi dhabame duubatti deebi'anii ifaajuun faayidaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: It is pointless to invest breath and hope into reviving something entirely defunct and cold.

proverb: Arba argaa, faanta hin barbaadani
meaning_om: Dhugaan ifatti utuu jiruu ragaa biraa barbaaduun yeroo gubuu dha.
meaning_en: When the primary evidence is plainly visible, searching for indirect clues is superfluous.

proverb: Ijaarannee manaa, keessa jirtii nama
meaning_om: Manni ijaarame qofti faayidaa hin qabu; jiraachuu fi nagaan nama keessaati murteessaa.
meaning_en: A physical building has no real meaning; its value comes entirely from human life and harmony.

proverb: Qaalluu rabbi salphise, nama du'utti waamani
meaning_om: Nama ulfina dhabe ykn salphate dhimma bu'aa hin qabne fi gad-aanaa irratti ramadu.
meaning_en: A once-revered figure who has lost standing is reduced to hopeless and unrewarding duties.

proverb: Ooyruu nooleen qotte, waatu itti hafe jettee itti hin debi'in
meaning_om: Wanta ogeessi ykn qotee-bulaan sirriitti hojjete hin shakkin; guutuu ta'uu amani.
meaning_en: Do not question or attempt to redo craftsmanship executed by proven, meticulous experts.

proverb: Niitii ala hiiyte, niiti naa taati jette hin abdatin
meaning_om: Nama amala tasgabbii hin qabne fi ala qofa jaalatu irraa jireenya dhaabbataa eeguun hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Do not expect domestic loyalty and devotion from someone whose heart belongs to aimless roaming.

proverb: Galataa fi haaloon, humaa sii hin ba'u
meaning_om: Haaloo qabachuun fi galata dhabuun ofuma nama miidha malee homaa bu'aa hin qabu.
meaning_en: Harboring bitterness and ingratitude provides zero benefit and only consumes the bearer.

proverb: Nuugiin tumanii nyaatan, humna ba'atterra hin jirtu
meaning_om: Wanti bu'aan isaa baasii ykn dadhabbii isaa hin geenye hojjechuun faayidaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: A yield that does not compensate for the exhausting labor required to extract it is worthless.

proverb: Dhuufuu kutteef, hudduu hin butani
meaning_om: Balleessaa salphaa ykn uumamaa ta'eef tarkaanfii badiisaa fi garmalee ta'e hin fudhatani.
meaning_en: One must never react with destructive overreach or mutilation over trivial, natural lapses.

proverb: Waraana darbanii, jinfuu hin qabatani
meaning_om: Wanta tokko erga murteessanii fi raawwatanii booda, duubatti deebi'anii yaadda'uun bu'aa hin qabu.
meaning_en: Once a decisive action is launched or committed, you cannot retract it or cling to second thoughts.

proverb: Laga kaan keessa dhaabbatanii, kaanitti hin toohani
meaning_om: Bakka jiran dhiisanii ykn dhimma ofii osoo hin xumurin waan fagaatu irratti dhiibbaa gochuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: One cannot meddle in or influence distant matters while still immersed in one's immediate affairs.

proverb: Galanni sirbaa, dafqa
meaning_om: Wanti tokko gammachuu fi bashannana qabaatus, xumurri isaa dadhabbii fi dhiibbaa qabaata.
meaning_en: Even joyous and voluntary activities ultimately demand physical exertion and unavoidable fatigue.

proverb: Harki, nama rukuta malee, humaa hin haleelu
meaning_om: Humni namaa daangaa qaba; namni nama miidhuu danda'a garuu murtee dhumaa kan kennu uumaadha.
meaning_en: Human aggression has natural boundaries; a human strike can injure but cannot decide ultimate destiny.

proverb: Haati duunaan, rimayni due
meaning_om: Hundeen ykn maddii wanta tokkoo yoo bade, wanti isarratti hirkatee jirus ni bada.
meaning_en: When the primary pillar or creator falls, all dependent entities inevitably collapse with it.

proverb: Bishaan madda hin qabne, hin yaa'u, yaa'uus ni cita
meaning_om: Wanti hundee fi bu'uura dhugaa hin qabne yeroo dheeraa hin turu, dafee dhumata.
meaning_en: Anything lacking a genuine root or renewable source is fundamentally unsustainable.

proverb: Soogidda hin waadanii, waan dabre hin yaadani
meaning_om: Wanta bu'aa hin qabne irratti hin dhiphatani; waan darbe yaaduun akkuma soogidda waaduu qisaasa'ina.
meaning_en: Obsessing over irreversible past events is as absurd and pointless as roasting salt.

proverb: Galata bade, gatii hin fudhatani
meaning_om: Gaarummaa namni hubachuu didee fi dhabameef gatii deebisanii argachuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: You cannot extort appreciation or recover dividends from someone resolutely ungrateful.

proverb: Hudduun, udaan dhiqanillee hin baatu
meaning_om: Amalli badaa ykn xuriin uumamaa yeroof dhiqamullee guutummaatti hin dhabamu.
meaning_en: Inherent baseness or deep-rooted character blemishes cannot be wiped away by cosmetic cleaning.

proverb: Dhadhaa ibidda bu'e, waatu irraa naa hafa jette hin eeggatin
meaning_om: Wanti gara badiisa guutuutti seene deebi'ee akka bu'aa buusu hin abdatani.
meaning_en: Do not count on salvaging resources that have slipped into irreversible disaster.

proverb: Gowwaan hin dhalatin, dhalatuus hin guddatin
meaning_om: Gowwummaan ofii fi maatii mara waan salphisuu fi mancaasuuf akka badiisaatti ilaalama.
meaning_en: Folly brings so much grief, shame, and ruin that it is viewed as an unmitigated calamity.

proverb: Gowwaan niitii irraa waraabessa hin dhoorku
meaning_om: Namni hubannoo fi gootummaa hin qabne qabeenyaa fi maatii isaa balaa irraa eeguu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A cowardly, dim-witted guardian is powerless to defend his family against obvious predators.

proverb: Wadalli harree, niitii irraa waraabeysa hin dhoorku
meaning_om: Wanti uumamaan sodaataa fi dadhabaa ta'e dhimma jabinna barbaadu irratti abdii hin qabu.
meaning_en: Weak and cowardly entities by their nature cannot offer protection against true aggression.

proverb: Manni, lafee Harreetiin jaarame, foonii fi dhiiga harreetiin maragamee, rifeensa harreetiin ajjeerame, yeroo waraabeysi yuuse diigama
meaning_om: Wanti bu'uura dadhabaa fi wantoota hin amansiisne irraa tolfame soda fi balaa dura hin dhaabbatu.
meaning_en: Any enterprise built upon fundamentally frail and compromised materials collapses at the first threat.

proverb: Kormaan lukkuu ifii hin nyaatu, namaa hin laatu, foon mataa irratti ba'atee deema
meaning_om: Qabeenya qabanitti ofii fayyadamuu dhabuu fi nama rakkateefis kennuu diduu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Holding resources greedily without putting them to use or letting others benefit from them.

proverb: Jiini hammam ibsu'lle waan halkanii hin dhabu
meaning_om: Wanti kamiyyuu hammam gaarii fi guutuu yoo fakkaate hanqinaa fi mudaa of keessaa hin dhabu.
meaning_en: No matter how radiant or noble something appears, it inevitably contains subtle flaws.

proverb: Kan awwaaletti, du'a hin himani
meaning_om: Wanta namni ofuma isaatiin argee fi raawwate deebisanii itti himuun hin barbaachisu.
meaning_en: It is redundant and foolish to lecture someone about facts they handled personally.

proverb: Niitiin, eega hiikan alagaa dha
meaning_om: Hariiroon gaa'elaa erga citee booda daangaan fi kabajaan alagummaa jiraachuu qaba.
meaning_en: Once a matrimonial contract is formally dissolved, mutual domestic ties turn into those of strangers.

proverb: Uumee hin fixatuu, ajjeesee hin dhifatu
meaning_om: Aangoo fi seera Waaqayyoo kan jireenyaa fi du'aa daangaa akka hin qabne agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Expresses awe at divine sovereignty; the cycle of creation and mortality remains perpetually in God's hands.

proverb: ulee bofaan ajjeesan, wajjuma darbani
meaning_om: Meeshaa wanta summaa'aa fi bala-qabeessa irratti fayyadaman eeggannaaf jedhanii ofirraa gatu.
meaning_en: An instrument contaminated by venomous danger is discarded along with the threat itself.

proverb: Hamartiin namaa hin taane, quba nama nyaatti
meaning_om: Wanti amala, qooda, ykn sadarkaa keetiin wal hin simne yoo fudhatte miidhaa sitti fida.
meaning_en: Adopting a partner, job, or responsibility incompatible with your nature brings persistent friction.

proverb: Kan alaa ol ceehu mana seenaa, kan manaa gad dheyse eeysa seena?
meaning_om: Rakkoon alaa mana dhufamee dandamatama; rakkoon manuma keessaa garuu baqaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: Outside turmoil finds sanctuary inside the home; but when the home itself turns hostile, no shelter remains.

proverb: Kan shan hin horreef, shantamni hin horuufi
meaning_om: Wanta xiqqoo bulchuu fi kunuunsuu dadhaban, waan guddaas qabaatanii bulchuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: One who cannot steward modest means can never successfully oversee abundant resources.

proverb: Qalbiin xiqqoon, dhiirsa nagaya gaafatti
meaning_om: Hubannoo dhabuun fi dhiphinni sammuu wantoota gaggaarii jireenyaa fi nagaa maatii booressa.
meaning_en: Petty-mindedness and lack of emotional depth disrupt domestic calm over trivialities.

proverb: Sareen qalbii hin qabne, awwaala (qabrii) irra teysi
meaning_om: Namni safuu fi naamusa hin beekne bakka sodaatamaa fi ulfina qabu hin kabaju.
meaning_en: A crude and clueless character violates sacred solemnities through total ignorance.

proverb: Miicaa oolan ille, waaroon hin addaattu
meaning_om: Amalli badaa fi uumama keessaa jiru wanta alaan gochuu yaalaniin hin jijjiiramu.
meaning_en: Inherent, deeply ingrained character traits cannot be altered or bleached by superficial efforts.

proverb: Taguugni, kuma dhiqaa ooltullee hin qulqullaawu
meaning_om: Wanti bu'uurri isaa xuraawaa fi gad-aanaa ta'e hammam qulqulleessanillee xurii hin dhabu.
meaning_en: Something inherently dirty or base can never achieve purity no matter how persistently cleansed.

proverb: hammam dhiqaa oolan ille, taguugni siibaa hin tahu
meaning_om: Wanti gatii salphaa qabu ykn amalli gad-aanaan hammam faayameyyuu sadarkaa kabajamaa hin qabatu.
meaning_en: A crude, low-grade entity can never be transformed into refined elegance through mere washing.

proverb: Koobaa dhiqan, xuriin hin baatu
meaning_om: Wanta xurii fi miidhaa tajaajilaa ture irraa mallattoon isaa guutummaatti hin badu.
meaning_en: An instrument steeped in dirt and blood can never entirely erase the residual stain of its past.

proverb: Funyaan saree, hin qulqullaawu
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa yeroo mara waan xuraawaatti qabame kabajaa fi qulqullina hin qabaatu.
meaning_en: A creature constantly probing into filth can never be considered pure, clean, or dignified.

proverb: Namni gaala hate, gad godhatee hin deemu
meaning_om: Balleessaa fi hojii guddaa dhoksuun hin danda'amu; waan ifatti ba'u dhoksuun gowwummaa dha.
meaning_en: One cannot conceal a massive crime or elephantine scandal through petty, laughable secrecy.

proverb: Waan suuqan tullaawaa, dhoysaan humaa hin goone
meaning_om: Wanti dhoksaan walitti kuufame yeroo booda ifatti mul'ata malee dhoysaan hin hafu.
meaning_en: Things stashed away in secret accumulate until they burst into plain view; concealment is futile.

proverb: Madaan nyaattuun jala jirtu, hin fayyitu
meaning_om: Rakkoo bu'uuraa fi summii keessaa osoo hin furin wanti alaan tolfame hin fayyu.
meaning_en: A sore plagued by underlying rot can never close; superficial treatment fails without excising the root.

proverb: Cooma dal'uu irraa dhaban, bakki irraa argatan hin jiru
meaning_om: Bakka wanti tokko caalmaatti irraa eegamu irraa yoo dhabame, iddoo biraatti argachuun hin yaadamu.
meaning_en: If the most abundant primary source yields nothing, looking in subsidiary quarters is entirely futile.

proverb: Silaahiin deega dubbiiti
meaning_om: Wanta ta'ee darbe irratti "silaa akkana ta'ee" jechuun dadhabina fi bu'aa dhabdummaa mul'isa.
meaning_en: Relying on wishful "if onlys" reflects total intellectual helplessness and lack of practical initiative.

proverb: Garbuun jiiydee fi beerri caphe hin kaatu
meaning_om: Wanti hubamee fi humni isaa guutummaatti dhume deebi'ee bakka duraatti hin deebi'u.
meaning_en: Severely ruined commodities and frail elderhood broken by tragedy cannot be restored.

proverb: Ijji allaattiin nyaatte, humaa hin argitu, gurri allaattiin nyaatte, humaa hin dhagayu
meaning_om: Namni hubannoo fi qalbii isaa guutummaatti dhabe waan gaariis ta'ee waan badaa hin hubatu.
meaning_en: When one's critical senses and moral faculties are destroyed, no wisdom or warning can penetrate.

proverb: Hancufa tufan, deebianii hin arraabani
meaning_om: Wanta murteessanii dhiisan ykn gatan deebisanii fudhachuun safuu fi salphina.
meaning_en: One must maintain self-respect and never crawl back to retrieve what was deliberately cast aside.

proverb: Kaleen ar'a hin tahu
meaning_om: Yeroon darbe deebi'ee hin dhufu; waan har'aa irratti xiyyeeffachuun dirqama.
meaning_en: Past moments never return; one must confront present reality rather than cling to bygone days.

proverb: Godaannaaf marqa hin fudhatani
meaning_om: Imala ykn hojii dheeraaf qophii sirrii fi itti fufiinsa qabu gochuu malee waan dafee badu hin qabatan.
meaning_en: One should not select fragile or perishable supplies when undertaking long, demanding journeys.

proverb: Nama beekaa balleessu, gorsi hin qajeelchu
meaning_om: Namni ta'e jedhee osoo beeku cubbuu fi badii hojjetu gorsa namaatiin hin deebi'u.
meaning_en: Counsel is completely lost on an individual whose misconduct is calculated, conscious, and willful.

proverb: Gowwaan mixii irraa, maraka barbaada
meaning_om: Wanta homaa hin qabne irraa waan guddaa fi faayidaa eeguun gowwummaa dha.
meaning_en: It is utter folly to anticipate substantial sustenance or assistance from an impoverished source.

proverb: Iyyaniif, duudaa gurri hin dhagayu
meaning_om: Nama hubachuu hin dandeenye ykn dhagahuu hin feene dirqisiisanii amansiisuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: No volume of shouting can compel understanding from one who is either naturally or willfully deaf.

proverb: Biddeenni abjuu, garaa nama hin guutu
meaning_om: Hawwii fi abjuun qofti bu'aa qabatamaa hin fidu; hojii fi qabatamummaan barbaachisaa dha.
meaning_en: Fanciful dreams and abstract hopes cannot satisfy real, aching hunger or solve practical needs.

proverb: Jiruu deegaa jiruu seetaa, nama du'e kan ka'u seetaa
meaning_om: Jireenyi rakkinaa fi dararaa du'a irraa adda hin ta'u; abdii hin taane qabaachuun bu'aa hin qabu.
meaning_en: Miserable destitution is barely distinguishable from death; unrealistic optimism changes nothing.

proverb: Mana waraabeysaatii, foon liqii hin barbaaddani
meaning_om: Bakka doqnummaan fi hammeenyi jirutti arjummaa fi gargaarsa barbaaduun gowwummaa dha.
meaning_en: One does not expect loans, kindness, or concessions from rapacious, insatiable predators.

proverb: Gowwaan waraabeysatti foon fi'ata
meaning_om: Qabeenya ofii diina isaatti kennanii amananii dhabamsiisuu ibsa.
meaning_en: Trusting one's treasured assets to the safekeeping of the very predator eager to swallow them.

proverb: Achi buutee, faana re'ee Ogaadeen
meaning_om: Wanta guutummaatti badee fi bakki buutee isaa hin beekamne ibsa.
meaning_en: Denotes complete, absolute disappearance where not a single trace, track, or clue survives.

proverb: Bariitu lafa hin arguu, ballaan maa barii gaafata, deemeetuu tabba hin bahuu, naafni maa tattaafata
meaning_om: Wanta dandeettii ofiin ol ta'e fi faayidaa namaaf hin qabne irratti dhiphachuu dhiisuu qabu.
meaning_en: It is futile to expend anguish or ambition on privileges one lacks the capability to utilize.

proverb: Namni waa gurguruu bare, haadha magaalaa geeysee dhaadheeysa
meaning_om: Amalli gurgurtaa fi bu'aa barbaaduu nama keessa galee daangaa yoo dhabe, wanta safuu qabullee daldaluu irraa nama hin deebisu.
meaning_en: When the obsession with commerce and profit knows no bounds, a person loses all shame and commodifies even their own mother.

proverb: Kabiirri hin wallisu, kan bare hin cal'isu
meaning_om: Namni waan tokko bare dhiisuu hin danda'u; amalli baratame yeroo hundumaa ofumaan mul'ata.
meaning_en: A pious teacher does not indulge in worldly chanting, and someone habituated to an action cannot stay restrained.

proverb: Harka hanna bare, dooluutu sossooha
meaning_om: Namni hanna bare osoo harki isaa madaa'ee ykn citellee amala isaa dhiisuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: Even when mutilated or scarred, a hand habitual to theft still reflexes; ingrained vices defy physical deterrence.

proverb: Namni nama hamachuudhaaf oduu jettee jettee odeessu, gaafa waan hamatu dhabe amammoochaati bula
meaning_om: Namni hamii bare dhimma namaa dhiisee nagaan buluu hin danda'u; hamachuun akkuma araadaatti nama qabata.
meaning_en: A compulsive gossip deprived of fresh targets to defame will squirm and gnaw in agony from the sheer craving to slander.

proverb: Buutiin yoo ajjeesan malee, mudhii ciqqaawaniis, boolla seenuu fi nama ciniinuuf fifiiguu hin dhiiftu
meaning_om: Diinni ykn wanti summaa'aan humni isaa yoo laafellee, hammeenya isaa guutummaatti hin dhiisu; eeggannoon barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Unless entirely destroyed, a venomous enemy will persist in trying to strike and cause harm even when severely crippled.

proverb: Jawween yoo waan liqimsitu dhabde, eegee isiiti liqimsiti
meaning_om: Wanti bololaa fi humna qabu yoo waan biraa dhabe gara ofii isaatti garagalee ofuma balleessa.
meaning_en: When predatory power or ravenous greed runs out of external prey, it turns inward and devours itself.

proverb: Diiggalli dulloomee ilkee fixatullee, irgoon hantuuta ciniinuu hin dhiisu
meaning_om: Namni ykn bineensi waan tokko bare dandeettii dhabullee fedhii fi yaalii isaa hin dhiisu.
meaning_en: Even when age strips away physical capacity, natural predatory instincts and lifelong habits stubbornly persist.

proverb: Kan haadhatti bare soddatti
meaning_om: Amalli fi naamusni manatti baratame bakka kamittiyyuu, bakka kabajaattillee ba'ee nama salphisa.
meaning_en: Indisciplined habits tolerated at home will inevitably spill out and cause deep embarrassment in polite society.

proverb: Nyaanne quufnee, akka warra keenyaa sanitti haa faffacaafnuu jette Lukkuun
meaning_om: Amalli uumamaa fi baratame erga fedhiin guuttamee booda deebi'ee mul'ata; quufni qisaasama fida.
meaning_en: Once basic hunger is satisfied, inherent disorderly habits emerge, leading to wasteful and destructive behavior.

proverb: "Mana eegi" jennaan "mana eeguu niin eegaa, waan amala kiyyaa niin godha" jette, lukkuun
meaning_om: Namni itti-gaafatamummaan kennameef amala isaa isa badaa dhiisuu akka hin dandeenye agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Entrusting a duty to someone cannot erase their nature; they will still scratch around and cause their trademark mess.

proverb: Mi'eeffatte Na arraabi je'e soogiddi
meaning_om: Wanti tokko jalqaba irratti nama hawwatee boodarra araada fi dhiibbaa cimaa ta'uu danda'a.
meaning_en: An initial enticing taste draws a person into an irresistible, repetitive indulgence that is difficult to break.

proverb: Injireen nyyaata barte, mooluurratti duuti
meaning_om: Namni faayidaa fi quufa bare bakka wanti dhumetti illee hafee lubbuu isaa dhabuu danda'a.
meaning_en: A parasite spoiled by easy grazing stubbornly lingers over barren, exhausted pickings until it starves.

proverb: Mi'eeffatan Liqeeffatan
meaning_om: Namni waan tokko yoo mi'eeffatee fi jaalate, liqiidhaanis ta'ee argachuuf dhiibbaa ofirra kaaya.
meaning_en: Once a craving takes hold of someone's taste, they will plunge into reckless debt just to sustain the indulgence.

proverb: "Eega nyaadhu naan jettan, akka aadaa kiyyaattiin nyaadha" jette, lukkuun Keeysymmaa dhayxee
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa gad-aanaa ta'e bakka kabajamaa deemullee safeeffachuu dhiisee amala isaa mul'isa.
meaning_en: Even when honored with formal hospitality, an uncouth individual will shamelessly revert to their coarse, messy ways.

proverb: Sabiyyiin dhooksaa barte, guyyaadhaan dinqatti fiigdi
meaning_om: Namni hojii dhoksaa fi amala shakkisiisaa bare ifattiillee amala shakkisiisaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Someone conditioned to stealth and deceit instinctively acts shifty and scurries into hiding even under clear sunlight.

proverb: Sareen bishaan foonii mi'eeffatte, ni deddeebiti
meaning_om: Namni ykn bineensi wanta mi'aawaa fi faayidaa qabu yeroo tokko argate deebisee barbaacha dhufa.
meaning_en: Once a scavenger or opportunist gets a taste of easy delicacies, they become a permanent, recurring fixture.

proverb: Yoo kan Nabii dhufe, kan asaabaa ni hafa
meaning_om: Wanti hunda caalaa guddaa fi ulfaataan yeroo dhufu, kanneen xixiqqoon dursa hin argatan.
meaning_en: When paramount authorities or supreme priorities emerge, secondary matters and subordinates yield precedence.

proverb: Kan dura du'e, dura awwaalani
meaning_om: Wanti hundi tartiiba isaatiin raawwatamuu qaba; dursa kan dhufetu dursa furmaata argata.
meaning_en: Matters must be handled in chronological and orderly succession; first come, first served.

proverb: "Dura kan taa'aarraa" jette jaldettiin
meaning_om: Hojii ykn gargaarsa ofitti dhihoo jiru irraa jalqabuun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: It is most practical and effective to begin duties with whoever or whatever is immediately nearest.

proverb: Gurraattii dhiifteeti, gurra barbaaddi
meaning_om: Wanta guddaa fi qabatamaa harkaa qaban dhiisanii waan xiqqoo fi bu'aa hin qabne barbaacha ifaajuu.
meaning_en: Neglecting substantial, living wealth already in one's possession to chase after petty, cosmetic trifles.

proverb: Dura ni siysani moo, dura hidhi muuxeysani?
meaning_om: Wanti hundi tartiiba qaba; dalagaan dura ta'uu qabu dursa argachuu qaba malee wanta boodaa hin dursani.
meaning_en: Foundational actions must precede dramatic expressions; do not substitute theatrical gesturing for real effort.

proverb: Nyaataafuu dhabnee, miila dhadhaa dibattaa?
meaning_om: Wanta murteessaa fi jireenyaaf barbaachisu dhabanii wanta faayaa fi qisaasamaaf kaachuu dhowwa.
meaning_en: When essential sustenance is lacking, squandering scarce supplies on cosmetic indulgence is unconscionable.

proverb: Iftu duraa, soddaan amba
meaning_om: Namni dura of eeggachuu fi of jiraachisuu qaba; sana booda nama biraaf yaaduun danda'ama.
meaning_en: Self-preservation and personal well-being are paramount before one can extend support to external relations.

proverb: Lubbuu ar'a bulteetu, tan boruu yaada
meaning_om: Dura wanta har'aa furanii nagaan buluun dirqama; sana booda waa'ee boruu yaaduun dhufa.
meaning_en: Securing today's survival is the prerequisite for having any future about which to plan.

proverb: Guddinaa loontu caalaa, mi'aa foon hoolaatu caala
meaning_om: Guddinni qofti gatii wanta tokkoo hin murteessu; qulqullinaa fi mi'aan isaatu caala.
meaning_en: Bulk and massive size do not denote supreme value; finer quality and sweetness often belong to the modest.

proverb: Dubbii tan nama bira jirtu haasawan malee, tan nama bira hin jirre hin haasawani
meaning_om: Dhimma jiru nama bakka sana jiru wajjin mari'atanii furu malee nama hin jirre hamachuun hin barbaachisu.
meaning_en: Address and resolve issues directly with the people present instead of indulging in gossip about the absent.

proverb: Ifii banaa bulanii, balbala hin ergisani
meaning_om: Osoo ofii qullaa fi rakkoo keessa jiranii nama biraaf waan bu'uuraa kennanii of miidhuun gowwummaa dha.
meaning_en: Leaving your own house vulnerable to predators while lending your defensive gate to others is folly.

proverb: Hunqaa mana gahe ala facaasani
meaning_om: Qabeenya qulqullinaan galfate deebisanii bakkee irratti qisaasessuun safuu dha.
meaning_en: Hard-won provisions secured inside the home must never be recklessly squandered in the open.

proverb: Bubbeen dhuftu, dura ija ifiiti qabatani
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan tasa dhufu, dura of baraarsuun dursa argata.
meaning_en: When sudden tempests or peril arrive, protecting one's vision and survival is the urgent first instinct.

proverb: Namaan gorsaa dura, ifiin gorsaatu caala
meaning_om: Nama biraa gorsuun dura amala fi hojii ofii sirreeffachuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Self-reflection and correcting one's own deficiencies must precede any attempt to instruct neighbors.

proverb: Nama qa'ee ifii tolfateetu, qa'ee abbaa qabdu dhaqa
meaning_om: Hojii fi nagaa manaa ofii erga qajeelchanii booda dhimma nama biraa keessa galuun tola.
meaning_en: Only one whose own domestic affairs are in pristine order has the credibility to inspect another's domain.

proverb: Nama mana keessaa haxaawwateetu, mooraa haxaawwata
meaning_om: Hojiin keessaa fi inni ijoon yoo raawwatame qofa kan alaa irratti hojjetama.
meaning_en: Securing and cleaning the interior living space takes precedence before attending to outer perimeters.

proverb: Dandeytiitu baana (diqaalaa) ba'ataa, ormi kan abbaa qabuuhuu dadhabe
meaning_om: Humni fi qabeenyi wanta ulfaataa ta'ellee salphaatti ba'achuu nama dandeessisa; dhabuun waan salphaattuu nama dhiba.
meaning_en: Abundant means can absorb extraordinary anomalies, whereas extreme poverty struggles with basic duties.

proverb: Biyya jechuun, biyyee mitii nama
meaning_om: Biyyi lafa qofaan osoo hin taane hawaasa fi tokkummaa namaatiin ijaaramti.
meaning_en: A nation is defined not by lifeless dirt and terrain, but by its living people, community, and human bond.

proverb: Sa'a mana jiruu, rifeensa hin haadani
meaning_om: Wanta jiru fi bu'aa kennaa jiru yeroo malee dhabamsiisuuf hin ariifatan.
meaning_en: One does not prematurely skin or strip an asset that is currently alive, thriving, and productive.

proverb: Osoo hin kurfaawin, nyaataaf harka hin dhiqatani
meaning_om: Wanta qophiin isaa hin xumuramneef duraan dursee qophaa'uun yeroo gubuu dha.
meaning_en: Do not sit down and wash hands to feast before the dishes have even been prepared and served.

proverb: Nama lafatti wal taheetu, muka wajjiin kora
meaning_om: Tokkummaa fi waliigaltee bu'uuraa yoo qabaatan qofa hojii ulfaataa waliin hojjechuun danda'ama.
meaning_en: Only companions who possess solid mutual trust on flat land can safely venture into perilous heights together.

proverb: Dhaaba kanniisaa, kan duraati muran
meaning_om: Hojii ykn dhimma keessatti wanta dursa dhufe fi dhihoo jiru dura raawwatu.
meaning_en: When harvesting honeycombs, one severs the foremost comb first; progress systematically from the entrance.

proverb: Hookkoon waan dura aanaa fuudhi jette
meaning_om: Wanta of dura jiru fi harka qaqqabu dursa fudhatanii fayyadamuun ogummaadha.
meaning_en: Wisdom dictates pulling in the fruit and opportunities immediately within reach before overextending.

proverb: Amalli hamaan ni qaramaa, barri hamaan hin qaramu
meaning_om: Amala namaa gorsanii fi barsiisanii sirreessuun ni danda'ama, garuu barri ykn qilleensi hamaan harka namaa hin jiru.
meaning_en: Human misconduct can be disciplined and refined, but adverse times and natural disasters defy human control.

proverb: Nama qonnaan si bira kute ni dhaqqabda, nama hormaataan si bira kute hin dhaqqabdu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi loonii fi hormaataa dhalootaan kan baay'atu waan ta'eef, dorgomee qaqqabuun baay'ee ulfaataadha.
meaning_en: Agricultural yields grow seasonally, but livestock multiplies exponentially, making compounding herds impossible to overtake.

proverb: Biyya itti dhalatan malee, biyya itti du'an hin beekani
meaning_om: Jalqaba jireenyaa beekanillee, xumuraa fi dhuma jireenyaa kan beeku Waaqayyo qofa.
meaning_en: While one's origin and birthplace are certain, where and when death will strike remains an absolute mystery.

proverb: Akka itti oolan malee, akka itti bulan hin beekani
meaning_om: Yeroo ammaa jiran beekanillee wanti booda dhufu fi jijjiirama tasaa tilmaamuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: The daylight hours are known and experienced, but sudden evening calamities can disrupt any certainty.

proverb: hamma maqanii fi hamma taa'an hin beekani
meaning_om: Dheerina jireenyaa, umurii, fi daangaa turtiif deemisaa wanti namni beeku hin jiru.
meaning_en: Humans know neither the duration of their earthly sojourn nor the exact boundary of their lifespan.

proverb: Gaafa ka'anii fi gaafa molaawan hin beekani
meaning_om: Carraan jireenyaa, badhaadhinni fi kufaatiin yeroo itti dhufu hin beekamu; jireenyi furguggeedha.
meaning_en: No one can predict the precise day their fortune ascends or the sudden day disaster strips them destitute.

proverb: Qara, waa hin doomsani
meaning_om: Wanta qara qabu, beekaa, ykn nama dandeettii qabu akka inni bu'aa dhabu hin godhani.
meaning_en: One should never deliberately blunt a razor edge, sabotage acute intelligence, or ruin effective assets.

proverb: Gamna gowwoomsuun, jibba barbaaduu dha
meaning_om: Nama dammaqaa fi beekaa sobuuf yaaluun jibbaa fi hammeenya guddaa ofitti fida.
meaning_en: Attempting to swindle an astute, perceptive mind only incites their permanent, focused enmity.

proverb: Beekaa gowwoomsuun, hija guddisa
meaning_om: Nama beekaa gowwoomsuuf yaaluun kasaaraa fi badiisa guddaa ofirraan gaha.
meaning_en: Attempting to deceive a truly knowledgeable person backfires, severely multiplying damages and public disgrace.

proverb: Diina namaa, dutti hin fixne jibbansi hin fageysine
meaning_om: Afaaniin wacuu fi aariin diina hin dhabamsiisu; gocha qabatamaa fi furmaata barbaachisa.
meaning_en: Noisy shouting does not neutralize foes, and silent bitterness never drives adversaries from one's doorstep.

proverb: Kan dhaabbatanii fannisan, taa'anii fuudhuun nama dhiba
meaning_om: Wanta salphaatti liqeessan ykn balleeysan yeroo deebisanii argachuuf yaalan rakkisaa ta'a.
meaning_en: Resources extended casually or lent without formal terms become an agonizing, humiliating trial to reclaim.

proverb: Gurra muran dhagayaatu hafa
meaning_om: Miidhaan alaa yoo ga'ellee, dandeettii fi hubannoon keessaa hin badu.
meaning_en: Mutilating the external ear leaves the internal sense of hearing untouched; persecution cannot crush truth.

proverb: Ijji yoo bayxe, boolli ijaa hin baddu
meaning_om: Wanti tokko yoo badellee, mallattoon fi bakki isaa yeroo mara ni yaadatama.
meaning_en: Even when a precious entity is plucked out and lost, the indelible scar and hollow cavity forever remain.

proverb: Dheebuu ebeloo fi jibbansa haadhaa hin beekani
meaning_om: Miira keessoo namaa fi yaada garaa namni biraa guutummaatti beekuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: Another individual's agonizing inner craving is invisible, just as subtle maternal disfavor stays deeply concealed.

proverb: Miila lama qabaataniif, farda lama hin korani
meaning_om: Humna qaban mara iddoo adda addaatti facaasuun hin ta'u; daangaa ofii beekuun tola.
meaning_en: Having two legs does not empower one to ride two mounts at once; avoid absurdly overextended pursuits.

proverb: Kofla saree, hin beekani
meaning_om: Kofla sobaa fi amala nama sobdootaa amanuun nama miidha; qalbii keessaa beekuun rakkisaadha.
meaning_en: A dog baring its teeth could be playfully smiling or preparing to bite; never trust treacherous, deceitful smiles.

proverb: surreen, sagal dhuufuu hin dhoowwu
meaning_om: Wanti uumamaan dhufu uffannaa fi qofaan hin daangeffamu; wanta dhoksuun hin danda'amne dhoowwuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: Garments cannot contain or stifle involuntary internal gases; outward facades cannot conceal natural eruptions.

proverb: Manni hamadaya malee, hama hin dayu
meaning_om: Manni qabbana alaa ittisuu danda'a garuu nama hamaa fi qalbii badaan dhufe ittisuu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: A dwelling provides physical protection from icy gales, but no walls can insulate against domestic treachery.

proverb: Yoo darbatanuu tulluu hin fullaatu, ijji waan namaa hin fuutu
meaning_om: Hawwii fi ijaan ilaaluun qabeenya namaa ofii hin godhu; wanta hin danda'amneef of hin dhiphisani.
meaning_en: A thrown pebble cannot penetrate a mountain, and hungry eyes cannot confiscate another's rightful possessions.

proverb: Arriin baate, debitee, hin gurraachomtu
meaning_om: Dulloomni fi yeroon darbe deebi'ee hin dhufu; uumama duraatti deebi'uun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: Sprouted silver hair never returns to natural black; lost youth and irreversible aging cannot be unwound.

proverb: Karaan ganna bahee fi maqaan ganna bahe hin fayyu
meaning_om: Badiin yeroo rakkisaa keessatti maqaa irratti dhufe fi daandiin dhangala'aan mancaase hin deebi'u.
meaning_en: A ravine cut by violent monsoon torrents and a name ruined in a moment of crisis leave permanent destruction.

proverb: Goblaa qabaattu malee hin barartu
meaning_om: Dandeettii, humna, fi meeshaa barbaachisu osoo hin qabaatin waan guddaa bira ga'uun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: Without wings, flight is impossible; without foundational ability and resources, grandiose aspirations fail.

proverb: Roobaan, dhukke hin kaasani
meaning_om: Haala hin taane keessatti wanta hin danda'amne gochuuf yaaluun gowwummaa dha.
meaning_en: One cannot kick up clouds of dust while torrential rain is falling; avoid attempting contradictory absurdities.

proverb: Afaan abbaa qabu, qabanii hin cuqqaalani
meaning_om: Namni dubbachuuf mirga qabu fi beeku dubbii isaa irraa dhowwamuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: A voice backed by rightful ownership, conviction, and courage cannot be permanently silenced or muffled.

proverb: Maraataan, ni wayyaawa malee hin fayyu
meaning_om: Amalli badaa fi qoricha hin qabne yeroof tasgabbaa'ullee deebi'ee ka'uu danda'a.
meaning_en: Deep-seated lunacy or chronic vice may enjoy periods of quiet remission, but the core affliction never vanishes.

proverb: Sareen, eegeen hin fuutu
meaning_om: Wanta uumamaan meeshaa fi dandeettii isaaf hin taaneen hojjechuun hin danda'amu.
meaning_en: A dog cannot carry cargo with its tail; do not deploy fundamentally unsuitable tools for serious jobs.

proverb: Hangam itti roobuus, dhagaan hin biqilu
meaning_om: Nama qalbii gogaa fi gorsi hin seenne hammam barsiisanillee hin jijjiiramu.
meaning_en: No deluge of rainfall can coax green shoots from solid rock; no amount of wise counsel can soften a stony heart.

proverb: Horaan baasatti, jawwee baase
meaning_om: Wanta gaarii fi bu'aa eeggachaa osoo jiranii tasa balaa fi waan sodaatamaa argachuu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Anticipating rich gains and prosperity, one inadvertently triggers a deadly, horrifying hazard.

proverb: Gaaf gaaf, dhuufuun albaatii namatti taati
meaning_om: Dogoggorri ykn wanti salphaan tokko yeroo tokko tokko gara balaa fi rakkina guddaatti jijjiirama.
meaning_en: Occasionally, a minor, casual slip escalates unpredictably into an uncontrollable, messy scandal.

proverb: Lubbuu sibiilaaf kaaye, qoraan ajjeesa
meaning_om: Namni balaa fi waraana guddaa irraa oole wanta salphaa fi hin eegamneen miidhamuu ykn du'uu danda'a.
meaning_en: A soul that survived ferocious battles and cold steel can fall victim to a trivial thorn prick.

proverb: Bakka hin dhaqu jedhan, maraatanii dhaqani
meaning_om: Wanta duraan "matumaa hin godhu" jedhan carraan dirqisiisee akka namni raawwatu godha.
meaning_en: Circumstance, desperation, and misfortune can drive a person to the very doorstep they proudly shunned.

proverb: Kan tuffataniitu nama caala, kan jibbaniitu nama dhaala
meaning_om: Namni salphaatti tuffatame yeroo baay'ee milkaa'ee kan tuffate caala; carraan nama jibbaniifis ta'uu danda'a.
meaning_en: The person dismissed with contempt often rises to dominance, and the despised relative ends up as heir.

proverb: Haaduun ani lafeen muruuf filadheetu tiruu muruu irratti caphe
meaning_om: Wanti ykn namni jabaa fi abdachiisaa dha jedhamee amaname wanta salphaa irratti dadhabee fashale.
meaning_en: A blade trusted to split solid bone shattered while cutting tender liver; high hopes dashed on an easy task.

proverb: Nama lafaatu, nama fardaa reebe
meaning_om: Namni humni fi carraan isaa gad-aanaa ta'e isa meeshaa fi gurguddoo qabu injifachuu danda'a.
meaning_en: The unmounted, vulnerable underdog physically outmatched and defeated the proud mounted warrior.

proverb: Nama laafaatu, nama jabaa reebe
meaning_om: Jabinni qaamaa qofti ga'aa miti; gamnummaa fi carraan nama laafaa isa jabaa akka moo'atu godha.
meaning_en: Physical brawn alone is never invincible; courage, strategy, and agility enable the frail to fell giants.

proverb: Nama mancaatu, nama qawwee ajjeese
meaning_om: Meeshaan qofti gootummaa hin kennu; murannoo fi dandeettii namaatu murteessaadha.
meaning_en: Advanced weaponry guarantees nothing; unyielding resolution and raw courage trump technical superiority.

proverb: Gaaf gaaf harreen loon dura galti
meaning_om: Yeroo tokko tokko wanti salphaan fi gad-aanaan wanta kabajamaa fi guddaa dursa argachuu danda'a.
meaning_en: On occasion, the humble donkey leads the way into the homestead while the prized cattle trail behind.

proverb: Osoo dullachi jiruuti, jabbiin duuti
meaning_om: Duuti fi balaan tartiiba umuriitiin hin dhufu; dargaggoon osoo manguddoon jiru darbuu danda'a.
meaning_en: Death and destiny pay no homage to biological seniority; the tender young may fall while the old endure.

proverb: Osoon dhala eeguun, ulfa dhabe
meaning_om: Bu'aa guddaa eegaa osoo jiranii qabeenya fi bu'uura qabaniyyuu dhabanii kasaaruu.
meaning_en: Eagerly anticipating a triumphant birth, one loses the fetus; forfeiting both prospective fruits and core capital.

proverb: Dinqii dinqii, biddeenaatu eelee cabse
meaning_om: Wanti laafaa fi dadhabaa jedhamee yaadamu wanta jabaa fi cimaa sana balleessuu isaa dinqisiifachuu.
