meaning_en: Astonishment of astonishments! The yielding, soft dough managed to shatter the hardened clay griddle.

proverb: Galti mukaa, harka ibiddaati
meaning_om: Wanti kamiyyuu xumura fi dhuma hin oolle qaba; mukni yeroo dhumu ibiddaan gubata.
meaning_en: The ultimate destination and destiny of wood is the fire; everything marches toward its inevitable conclusion.

proverb: Kuyyuubisni, bakka irraa mayretti jiga
meaning_om: Namni ykn wanti amala tokkotti gore xumurri isaas garauma sanatti kofa'ee kufa.
meaning_en: An unstable mound falls precisely in the direction it habitually inclined; ingrained leanings dictate one's collapse.

proverb: Samii barartuus, allaattii, duuti lafuma
meaning_om: Namni hammam ol ka'ee yoo boonellee, xumurri isaa lafa fi du'a; uumamni hundi gara biyyetti deebi'a.
meaning_en: However majestically a bird soars in the high sky, its mortality ends on the ground; no one outsoars death.

proverb: Ilkeen sossoote, buqqa'uu hin ooltu
meaning_om: Wanti bu'uurri isaa laafe fi shakkisiisaa ta'e yeroo booda diigamuun isaa hin hafu.
meaning_en: A loosened tooth is irrevocably destined to fall out; fragile compromises and crumbling ties cannot endure.

proverb: Turtu turti malee, jalloon gala hin ooltu
meaning_om: Wanti jallate ykn namni fagaate yeroo fudhatus gara hundee fi dhugaatti deebi'uun hin hafu.
meaning_en: Though the errant wanderer tarries indefinitely, truth, origins, and natural order will eventually draw her home.

proverb: Baddi galtii baddi galtii, booddeen harree garaa waraabeysaati
meaning_om: Namni yeroo mara of eeggannoo dhabee balaa keessa deddeebi'u dhumni isaa badiisa ta'a.
meaning_en: Recklessly straying into danger time and again, the heedless donkey inevitably ends up inside the predator.

proverb: Yar yarii, booddi du'a
meaning_om: Jireenyi hammam dheeratullee ykn dararri hammam yoo danda'amellee xumurri nama maraa du'a.
meaning_en: No matter how modestly one curtails ambition or endures suffering, the terminal equalizer for all is death.

proverb: Akka boonanitti, waa hin hafani
meaning_om: Booranii fi of tuulanii jiraachuun wanta hundee hin qabneedha; jijjiiramni fi xumuri nama eeggata.
meaning_en: Earthly prestige and arrogant postures are fleeting; human circumstances never stay permanently exalted.

proverb: Biyyaa fi biyye itti debi'u hin oolani
meaning_om: Namni biyya dhalootaa isaatti deebi'uun, akkasumas lafa uumamaatti (qabrii) deebi'uun seera hin oolledha.
meaning_en: Returning to one's native home and returning to the dust of mortality are two inescapable appointments.

proverb: Tiruun lafa buute, huuba fuute
meaning_om: Wanti qulqulluu fi kabajamaa ture yoo bakka gad-aanaatti kufe xuraa'ee gatii dhabuun hin hafu.
meaning_en: Once prime, pristine liver falls into the dirt, it collects grime; noble reputations dropped low become tarnished.

proverb: Guutuun jigu, guutuu hin debi'u
meaning_om: Wanti guutuu fi kabajamaa ture yeroo diigame deebi'ee akka duraatti guutuu ta'uu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: When a towering crown or complete enterprise shatters, no amount of repair can restore its original perfection.

proverb: Dal'uun lafa buute, huuba hin hanqanne
meaning_om: Qabeenyi ykn namni kabajamaan yoo kufe xurii fi salphinni isatti maxxanuun hin hafu.
meaning_en: When the treasured hump of a camel hits the dust, debris clings to it; fallen majesty cannot escape insult.

proverb: Bishaan keessa dhaabadhee, hin jiineen soba
meaning_om: Bakka wanti tokko jiru oolanii fi hojjetanii dhiibbaa ykn qooda isaa irraa qulqulluu of fakkeessuun soba.
meaning_en: Saying one stood submerged in the river without getting soaked is a falsehood; you cannot touch corruption clean.

proverb: Waan hamatanii fi waan nyaatan hin dhabani
meaning_om: Namni hamachuuf yoo fedhe sababa yeroo hunda argata; akkasumas carraan jireenyaa hin dhumatu.
meaning_en: Critics will perpetually invent faults to malign, just as hungry mouths constantly find scraps to chew.

proverb: Waan odeysanii fi waan bobeeysan hin dhabani
meaning_om: Oduun fi dubbiin addunyaa kana irraa matumaa hin dhumu; yeroo mara waatu jiraata.
meaning_en: Sensational tales to chatter about will never run dry, just as the wilderness never runs out of wood to burn.

proverb: Wajji dhalataniif, wajji hin hafani
meaning_om: Obbolummaan dhalatanillee, jireenyaa fi xumura irratti namni hundi qophaa isaati.
meaning_en: Though brothers share the same womb, each possesses a distinct lifespan, private destiny, and separate grave.

proverb: Namni dayma laaqu, quba numa arraaba
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya ykn faayidaa guddaa keessa hojjetu qooda ofii fudhachuun isaa hin hafu.
meaning_en: Whoever handles rich honey inevitably licks his fingers; those managing lucrative funds will taste the perks.

proverb: Kan du'e numa faarsani, kan jiru numa arrabsani
meaning_om: Namoonni erga du'anii booda gaarummaa isaanii faarsu, garuu yeroo jiranitti ceepha'uun hin hafu.
meaning_en: Humanity hypocritically showers the deceased with saintly praise, while treating living souls with scorn.

proverb: "Aayyoo baga nagayaan si hiike" jennaan "osoo abbaan kee jiruu maaltu naa hiiqa" jette haati intalaan
meaning_om: Sababni rakkoo fi dadhabbii hundee isaa osoo jiruu boqonnaan yeroo qofaa furmaata guutuu hin ta'u.
meaning_en: Temporary relief from labor is an illusion as long as the primary agent of perpetual toil remains right beside you.

proverb: Kophee dhiphatteef, miila hin qorani
meaning_om: Wanta alaa fi salphaa ta'e sirreessuu malee wanta bu'uuraa fi qaama ofii hin miidhani.
meaning_en: One does not mutilate one's own flesh to accommodate an ill-fitting shoe; adjust outer tools, not core essentials.

proverb: Bayxu bayxi malee, saree ija hin kuulani
meaning_om: Wanta uumamaan qajeelaa hin taane faayanii fi bareechuuf yaaluun bu'aa hin qabu.
meaning_en: However wide and protruding they appear, one never adorns a dog's eyes with kohl; never waste elegance on base nature.

proverb: Okkotetti, gurra hin godhani
meaning_om: Wanta uumamaan hin qabne fi faayidaa hin qabne irratti dabalanii of hin rakkisani.
meaning_en: One does not fashion ears onto a spherical clay stew-pot; avoid adding absurd, useless appendages to functional designs.

proverb: Ifiin jiroon, uuda hin dhayxu
meaning_om: Wanti gatii fi qulqullina hin qabne bu'aa guddaa fi oomisha qabatamaa hin kennu.
meaning_en: Spurious wild weeds never yield a rich threshing floor; low-quality stock produces no substantial or edible harvest.

proverb: Ifiin jirootu, bishingaa naa taha jettee hin eeggatin
meaning_om: Wanta faayidaa hin qabne irraa waan gaarii fi bu'uuraa eeguun gowwummaa dha.
meaning_en: Never foster illusions that useless field weeds will morph into nutritious sorghum; inferior roots cannot yield staple grain.

proverb: Mixaaxis akka nyaata tolutti, udaan hammaata
meaning_om: Wanti jalqaba irratti mi'aawaa fi salphaa fakkaatu boodarra miidhaa fi rakkina fida.
meaning_en: As sweet and pleasant as sweet potatoes taste upon consumption, their aftermath brings foul and offensive flatulence.

proverb: Goda awwaaldiigeysaa, waraabeysi hin seenu
meaning_om: Bakka bineensi jabaan fi bala-qabeessi jiru waraabeessi illee sodaatee hin seenu.
meaning_en: Even a hungry, brazen hyena avoids descending into the burrow of the digging badger; prudent predators respect lethal lairs.

proverb: Harreen duute ja'anii, karaa hin oolani
meaning_om: Kasaaraan ykn miidhaan yoo ga'ellee jireenyaa fi imala ofii itti fufuu malee hin dhaaban.
meaning_en: One does not cancel an essential journey simply because a pack-beast perished; mission and destiny must press forward.

proverb: Adurree godaanna itti hin himanii, meeshaarratti fi'ani
meaning_om: Nama dhimma murteessuu hin dandeenye marii keessa galchuu dhiisanii akkuma haalatti itti fayyadamu.
meaning_en: One does not hold formal consultations with the domestic cat about moving; one merely packs it with the baggage.

proverb: Erbeen re'ee, na duraa ka'ii malee, narraa achi siqii hin taatu
meaning_om: Wanta gabaabaa fi daangaa qabu keessatti bal'ina fi filannoo hedduun hin jiru.
meaning_en: A diminutive goatskin rug permits one to stand up and vacate, but has no spare room to scooch over; tight limits offer zero leeway.

proverb: Kal'oon dhaddee, raroo fardaa hin taatu
meaning_om: Wanti qoraa fi miidhaa qabu bakka laafaa fi kunuunsa barbaadutti hin fayyadu.
meaning_en: Prickly porcupine hide can never cushion a horse's back; dangerous, hurtful agents cannot serve in gentle capacities.

proverb: Garbuu fi gabra, huddu dhoysani
meaning_om: Wantoota kunuunsa fi eeggannoo addaa barbaadan sirriitti to'achuun barbaachisaadha.
meaning_en: Barley stores and house-servants require vigilant custody; expose either to neglect and you court immediate loss.

proverb: "Bookeen gurra arbaa irra teyse" jennaan, "teysuus maal gooti kaatuus maal gooti" jedhe
meaning_om: Wanti xiqqoon fi humna hin qabne waan guddaa irratti dhiibbaa homaayyuu hin qabu.
meaning_en: When informed that a tiny fly perched on his massive ear, the elephant scoffed that its arrival and departure are utterly irrelevant.

proverb: Killa keysatti, bubbee hin kaasani
meaning_om: Dhimma xiqqoo fi iddoo dhiphaa keessatti jeequmsa guddaa uumuun safuu dha.
meaning_en: One does not whip up a gale inside a small milk bowl; do not create an explosive scandal within a tiny circle.

proverb: Dhiiga adarii keysa hin gangalatani
meaning_om: Wanta xuraa'aa, summaa'aa, fi bala-qabeessa keessa of galchanii of hin balleessani.
meaning_en: One does not wallow in the spilled blood of a savage predator; do not submerge oneself in toxic, ruinous conflicts.

proverb: Baaqelaan dhume jennaan, dhuufuunuu gabaabbatte je'e
meaning_om: Maddi rakkinaa yeroo dhumatu, miidhaan ykn bu'aan isaa inni badaanis waliin dhuma.
meaning_en: When informed the bean supply ran dry, he noted that digestive trouble ceases too; removing the source ends the affliction.

proverb: Dhuufuu harreetii, funyaan hin qabatani
meaning_om: Wanta amala uumamaa bineensaa ykn nama gad-aanaa ta'eef dhiphachuu fi nuffuun hin barbaachisu.
meaning_en: One does not pinch nostrils in outrage over a donkey's flatulence; do not waste noble dignity on base vulgarity.

proverb: Arbi qummuuxxoo hin hokkolu
meaning_om: Namni guddaan fi jabaan rakkoo fi ceepha'a xixiqqoon hin jeeqamu.
meaning_en: A magnificent elephant does not limp from a tiny thorn prick; mighty characters are never derailed by petty irritations.

proverb: Sonbaaf, ablee hin barbaadani
meaning_om: Hojii salphaa fi laafaa ta'eef humna guddaa fi qophii ulfaataa hin barbaachisu.
meaning_en: Cutting soft lung meat does not require a heavy war dagger; do not summon excessive force for effortless chores.

proverb: Citaa tokkoof, manni hin dhimmisu
meaning_om: Wanti xiqqoon fi hanqinni salphaan dhimma guddaa guutummaatti hin mancaasu.
meaning_en: A sound roof does not leak because of a single missing straw; minor cosmetic flaws do not compromise a robust whole.

proverb: Gaagurri, yoo kanniisa itti naqan malee, muka mukarra taa'u
meaning_om: Meeshaan ykn qaamni kamiyyuu hojjettoota fi qabiyyee keessaa yoo dhabe gatii hin qabu.
meaning_en: A beehive is merely dead wood sitting in tree forks unless energized by bees; structures are worthless without substance.

proverb: Waabeen nama hin idduu yoo kanniisaa malee, beekaan nama hin tuquu gadi galoo malee
meaning_om: Namni qajeelaan fi kabajamaan sababa malee nama hin miidhu; gad-aantuutu namatti ka'a.
meaning_en: A drone insect does not deliver a rich bee sting, and a noble wise man never insults or assaults unless fallen from grace.

proverb: Akka dhaba ganda kiyyaa, wadaay kiyyaa wakkiila
meaning_om: Bakka beekaan fi hayyuun dhabametti namni salphaan akka guddaatti tajaajila.
meaning_en: For sheer lack of qualified candidates in our village, my ordinary crony is made chief deputy; scarcity elevates mediocres.

proverb: Wanni tokkotti gale dhume
meaning_om: Wanti hirkannoo tokkicha qofa qabu balaa keessa jira; waan tokkotti hafuun kasaaraa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Whatever relies on a single surviving specimen is teetering on the brink of total extinction; zero redundancy is perilous.

proverb: Mayri citaa, gobeensa hin caalu
meaning_om: Wanti tokko bifa haarawaan dhufullee faayidaa fi amalli isaa isa duraanii irra hin wayyu.
meaning_en: The tender new shoot of common thatch grass is no more nourishing than dry thorns; novel facades bring no real upgrade.

proverb: Hammam dheeratu, gurri mataa hin dabru
meaning_om: Namni hammam yoo guddate fi beekame, maatii, seera, fi aadaa ofii caaluu hin danda'u.
meaning_en: However long an ear might grow, it never surpasses the crown of the head; juniors can never outrank their origins.

proverb: Waan hin jirreef, galmeen gandaan dhaqa jettee boochi
meaning_om: Wanta qabatamaa hin taane fi hin jirreef iyyuu fi dhiphachuun faayidaa hin qabu.
meaning_en: The register cries about having to be carried through town over empty illusions; creating theatrical fuss over nothing.

proverb: Yoo ni dhunganna ja'an nama ciniinti, yoo ni ciniinna ja'an nama dhungatti
meaning_om: Amala nama faallaa fi fudhatama hin qabne, kan waan gaarii fi badaanillee wal hin simne ibsa.
meaning_en: Describing a perverse and erratic personality who attacks gentle affection and repays hostility with sudden affection.

proverb: Owwaatan "si haa oosu" ja'a, usan "si haa cufu" ja'a, way dubbii rabbii
meaning_om: Haala nama kamiyyuu gammachiisuun hin danda'amne, dubbatanis cal'isanis ceepha'amu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: An impossible double-bind where replying invites a curse and remaining silent invites another; a no-win predicament.

proverb: Akka hin dubbanne lubbu akka hin dhunganne huddu
meaning_om: Rakkina filannoo hin qabne; dubbachuunis lubbuu nama gaafata, callisuunis wanta fokkisaa ta'a.
meaning_en: An agonizing dilemma where speaking the truth invites death, yet compliance requires kissing vulgar disgrace.

proverb: Dubbiin, garatti garba taateet qomatti qayra taate
meaning_om: Dhimmi tokko ba'achuu fi garaatti qabachuuf guddoo ta'ee, dubbachuuf immoo waraansa cimaa ta'e.
meaning_en: A tormenting crisis: swallowed within, it drowns like an ocean; spoken aloud, it pierces the chest like a spear.

proverb: Roobaa ka dhufee, sa'aa ka kufee, re'e ta baddee, malli maali?
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan walitti qabamee karaa hunda nama marsee furmaanni dhabamu.
meaning_en: Torrential rain falls, the prized cow is down, and the goat has vanished; multiple disasters striking simultaneously without remedy.

proverb: Akka hin nyaachifne, zangaadaa marqite, akka hin dhiife dhadhaa itti goote
meaning_om: Wanta qormaata qabu garuu faayidaa of keessaa qabu kan dhiisuun ykn fudhachuun rakkisaa ta'e.
meaning_en: She used bitter grain so you would choke on it, yet covered it with rich butter so you could not abandon it; an enticing torment.

proverb: Ol utaaluuf humna hin qabnu, callisuuf haadha teenyaat du'e, jedhe raachi
meaning_om: Rakkina cimaa keessatti gadda ba'achuu dadhabanii fi furmaata fiduufis humna dhabuu.
meaning_en: "We have no strength to leap out, yet we cannot stay quiet when our mother is dead," said the frog; grief compelled to cry out despite helplessness.

proverb: Irraa ka'uf killee tiyya, irra taa'uf lubbuu tiyya, jedhe raachi
meaning_om: Filannoo qabeenya ykn ijoollee ofii baraarsuu fi lubbuu ofii oolchuu gidduutti rakkachuu.
meaning_en: "If I abandon the spot, my eggs perish; if I stay, my own life ends," said the frog; the ultimate choice between offspring and survival.

proverb: Akka hin nyaanne mimmixaa itti naqxe, akka hin dhiifne dhadhaa itti goote
meaning_om: Wanta hawwataa ta'ee garuu gubaa fi rakkina guddaa qabu kan dhiisuun nama dhibu.
meaning_en: Seasoned with burning pepper to make it painful to swallow, yet drenched in butter so you cannot bear to walk away.

proverb: Yoo liqimsite haadhaatu du'a, yoo tufte abbaatu du'a
meaning_om: Murtoo kamiyyuu yoo fudhatan balaa guddaa fi kasaaraa hin oolletu hordofa.
meaning_en: If you swallow, the mother perishes; if you spit it out, the father dies; an absolute, unresolvable tragedy where every path destroys.

proverb: Dhaqan shantamaatu du'a, hafan kudhaniitu du'a
meaning_om: Kasaaraa xiqqaa filachuun dirqama yeroo ta'u; wanti hundi miidhaa qabaatus isa salphaa filachuu.
meaning_en: If you advance, fifty perish; if you hold back, ten will die; grim circumstances forcing the bitter choice of the lesser evil.

proverb: Aannan gaalaa, liqimsitu ni duuta, dhiiftuus ni duuta
meaning_om: Haala rakkisaa kan keessatti furmaanni kamuu balaa hordofsiisu.
meaning_en: Camel's milk in extreme conditions: drinking it proves fatal, yet forsaking it brings death by starvation; caught between two dooms.

proverb: Horuu hin dinnee, hoosisu didde
meaning_om: Hojii tokko jalqabuu jaalatanii xumuruu fi itti-gaafatamummaa ba'achuu diduu.
meaning_en: She did not object to giving birth, but flatly refused to nurse; willing to initiate ventures but shunning daily maintenance.

proverb: Harree eegee hin qabne, nama nama hin qabne, jinnii heera hin qabne, Rabbi namarraa haa qabu
meaning_om: Wanta to'annaa hin qabne, amala badaa fi jeequmsa fidu irraa Waaqayyo akka nama eegu kadhachuu.
meaning_en: A tailless donkey (unsteerable), an unmoored person (unaccountable), and a rogue spirit—may God deliver us from such lawless chaos.

proverb: Waa garii "AH"!
meaning_om: Wanti tokko tokko jechaan ibsamuu kan hin dandeenye, gaddisiisaa fi nama aarsaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.
meaning_en: Certain situations are so deeply infuriating, shocking, or sorrowful that human vocabulary collapses into a solitary, heavy sigh.

proverb: Itti himnaan didde, dhooynaan mufatte
meaning_om: Nama gorsi hin deebisne fi adabbiinis hin sirreessine; amala diddaa fi mufannaa qabu.
meaning_en: Counseled with gentle words, she turned stubborn; reprimanded with physical discipline, she sulked in deep offense; completely unmanageable.

proverb: Itti himan ni diddi, rukutan ni gaggabdi
meaning_om: Nama gorsa hin fudhanne garuu adabbii fi qormaata salphaa hin dandeenye.
meaning_en: When advised, she haughtily defies; when touched with discipline, she melodramatically faints; stubbornly proud yet spinelessly fragile.

proverb: Asiin hudduu, asiin lubbuu harree eeysaan fe'ani
meaning_om: Yeroo madaan fi rakkini qaama hunda qabee bakki hojiif mijatu dhabamu.
meaning_en: Here raw wounds bleed, there its last breath falters—where can one possibly pack the load? Facing absolute exhaustion without recourse.

proverb: "Akkaan itti ragaa sii bahe agartee" jennaan, "akkaan itti si ajaa'ibe wahi agartee" je'een
meaning_om: Namni tokko soba ykn gocha safuu dhabe raawwatee akka waan gaariitti yoo of jajatu, inni biraan immoo qaaniidhaan isa taajjaba.
meaning_en: When a corrupt accomplice boasts of how shamelessly he lied, the companion stares in stunned disgust at his utter lack of honor.

proverb: Gudii guddaa, marqaan bulee afaan guba
meaning_om: Wanta qabbanaa'ee fi darbe seetanii osoo hin eegin deebi'ee balaa fi gubaa fidu.
meaning_en: An astonishing anomaly: porridge kept cold overnight still burns the lips; an old, settled feud suddenly flaring with fresh fury.

proverb: Abbayyaan gurri guddaa, bira ga'an bishaani
meaning_om: Wanti tokko oduu fi odeeffannoodhaan guddatee mul'atus, dhihaatanii yoo ilaalan salphaa fi uumamaamaadha.
meaning_en: The mighty Abbay carries an intimidating reputation from afar, but up close it is merely flowing water; reality deflates myth.

proverb: Roobiin abbayyaa keessaa baatee, fiixessa arraabdi
meaning_om: Qabeenya guddaa fi madda bal'aa qabaatanii waan xiqqoo fi bu'aa hin qabne barbaacha ifaajuu.
meaning_en: A massive hippo abandons the immense waters of the Abbay to lick petty drops of morning dew; leaving abundance to beg for crumbs.

proverb: Ilma abbaan daakkii beeku, galaanni fuudha
meaning_om: Dandeettiin ykn beekumsi abbaa dhalootaan ilmoof hin daddarbu; of eeggannoo dhabuun balaa fida.
meaning_en: The son of an expert swimmer drowns in the river; relying complacently on ancestral prestige without personal competence is fatal.

proverb: Yaa afaan jedhe, fuunyaan gadi ilaalee
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatii hanqina qabu nama biraa irratti mudaa barbaaduu fi ceepha'uu.
meaning_en: "Oh, look at that repulsive mouth!" sneered the nose looking down; hypocritically scorning a companion while sharing the same face.

proverb: Wahiin arge jette, siibuun amaara argitee
meaning_om: Wanta namoota biraatiif baratamee fi salphaa ta'e namni beekumsa hin qabne akka waan guddaatti dinqisiifachuu.
meaning_en: "I have witnessed an incredible wonder!" cried the isolated villager upon seeing a stranger; rustic naivety marveling at the mundane.

proverb: Leenci kanaa, faanti mee ree?
meaning_om: Dhugaan ifatti utuu jiruu ragaa biraa barbaaduun ykn shakkisiisuun bu'aa hin qabu.
meaning_en: Here stands the actual lion in flesh and blood; why are you still bent over looking for tracks? The ultimate proof is right before you.

proverb: Kan argani jettee, cirriin sa'arra kufte
meaning_om: Bololaan fi ariitiin wanta hawwan irratti utaaluun akka nama hin miine of eeggachuu.
meaning_en: Crying "I see my prize!", the greedy oxpecker bird plunged recklessly onto the cow; diving headlong into desire without checking risks.

proverb: Sirban qaama hunda
meaning_om: Hojii tokko yeroo hojjetan guutummaatti itti seenanii qalbii fi humna hunda kennuu qabu.
meaning_en: When dancing, engage your whole body; dedicate undivided passion and complete energy to any chosen pursuit.

proverb: niin sirbaa fi guntutaan dhoyfadhaan walitti hin taatu
meaning_om: Wanta ifatti ta'uu qabu tokko hojjechaa safeeffachuu fi dhoksuuf yaaluun walitti hin dhufu.
meaning_en: Passionate dancing and timidly clutching one's bosom are completely incompatible; boldness permits no coy pretenses.

proverb: Rifeensa mataa, gam tokko haadanii, gamm tokko hin dhiisani
meaning_om: Hojiin kamiyyuu guutuu ta'ee xumuramuu qaba malee walakkaan dhiifamuu hin qabu.
meaning_en: One never shaves half of a head while leaving the other half bushy; never leave duties lopsided and half-finished.

proverb: Gam tokkoon coomanii, gam tookkoon hin haarani
meaning_om: Wanti tokko yoo fooyya'e guutummaatti mul'ata malee gama tokko qofaan hin ta'u.
meaning_en: A creature does not become fat and flourishing on one flank while starving on the other; health must be holistic.

proverb: Dhuufuu fi dalagaan, wal keessa hin taatu
meaning_om: Hojiin kabajamaa fi qulqulluun qoosamaa fi safuu dhabdummaa wajjin wal hin fudhatu.
meaning_en: Crude vulgarity and serious, productive industry cannot coexist; disciplined tasks demand respectful conduct.

proverb: Nama gaangee irra jiruun harka dhiqadhu hin jedhani
meaning_om: Nama deemsa fi imala irra jiru dhimma tasgabbii fi boqonnaa barbaadutti hin waamani.
meaning_en: One does not invite a rider mounted on a traveling mule to wash hands for dinner; suit invitations to reality.

proverb: Kiyyaa fi keenyaan tokkoo miti
meaning_om: Qabeenyi dhuunfaa fi qabeenyi waliinii garaagarummaa guddaa fi to'annaa addaa qaba.
meaning_en: "Mine" and "ours" represent entirely different realms; private ownership brings absolute sovereignty, shared ownership brings compromise.

proverb: Kootiin kan ofii, keenyaan kan warraa
meaning_om: Wanti dhuunfaa ofiitiin murtaa'a, garuu kan waliinii harka hundaatiin bulfama.
meaning_en: "Mine" is subject to solitary personal discretion; "ours" belongs to the collective household with shared claims.

proverb: Tiyyaan manatti gorteeti, teenyaan hulaa dura dabarte
meaning_om: Qabeenyi dhuunfaa mana ofiitti galfama, kan waliinii garuu qoodama dhabee karaatti hafuu danda'a.
meaning_en: "Mine" was secured inside my own homestead, while "ours" drifted past the entrance; shared assets easily get neglected.

proverb: Mana ifii, itti quufuu dadhaban itti dhuufani
meaning_om: Mana ofii keessatti bilisummaa fi nagaan guutuu qabaachuun wanta qabeenya caaludha.
meaning_en: In one's own home, even when food is modest, one enjoys absolute uninhibited liberty, free from foreign eyes.

proverb: Abbaan soogiddaa, waan ifii keessaa hafuu hin tahu
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya qabu waan ofiitti fayyadamuuf nama gaafachuu hin qabu.
meaning_en: The rightful owner of salt need never hold back from sprinkling it into his own food; owner's usage needs no apology.

proverb: Karaa fi karratti, kan lixu tokkuma
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa alaa fi manatti tokkuma; bakki jijjiiramuun nama hin jijjiiru.
meaning_en: Whether journeying on the highway or stepping into the domestic kraal, a man remains the identical character throughout.

proverb: Qanqalloo fi boqqolloo, abbaan tokkuma
meaning_om: Meeshaa fi wanti keessa jiru kan nama tokkoo waan ta'eef addaan baasuun hin barbaachisu.
meaning_en: The leather sack and the maize it holds belong to one and the same master; container and contents form an undivided estate.

proverb: Leeccalloon abbuma kiyya naa yaamaa jette
meaning_om: Meeshaan ykn dhimmi tokko nama isa to'achuu fi sirriitti itti fayyadamu beeku qofa barbaada.
meaning_en: The pliable leather strap pleaded, "Summon only my legitimate master"; sensitive tools yield only to skilled owners.

proverb: Leeccalloon abba yaammatte
meaning_om: Wanti tokko nama isaaf malu fi isa danda'u qofa akka barbaadu agarsiisa.
meaning_en: The whip cried out for its legitimate handler; neglected affairs inevitably demand the return of competent authority.

proverb: Leeccalloon abbaa lama hin qabdu
meaning_om: Dhimmi ykn qabeenyi tokko hoggansa fi to'annaa nama tokkoo qofa jala ta'uu qaba.
meaning_en: A single leather whip cannot answer to two different masters; divided leadership breeds operational disaster.

proverb: Abbaa leeccallootu, leenca jirmaan ariha
meaning_om: Namni abbummaa fi dhugaa qabu gootummaa guddaadhaan mirga isaa kabachiifata.
meaning_en: The authentic master of the whip will boldly charge a lion armed with nothing but a log; rightful ownership breeds fierce courage.

proverb: Mataan keetii, rifeensi keetii miti jechuun waa hin fakkaatu
meaning_om: Wanta walitti hidhata qabu fi addaan hin baane gargar baasanii mormuun gowwummaa dha.
meaning_en: Asserting that the head belongs to you while denying that its hair is yours is absurd and fraudulent sophistry.

proverb: Qumaaxaa qubni faayaa, osolee godni qullubbi
meaning_om: Wanti namoota biraatiif salphaa ta'e namoota rakkatan ykn dhabaniif gatii guddaa qabaata.
meaning_en: To the leper, an imperfect finger-stub is a treasured jewel; to a mongoose, wild garlic in a hole is a royal feast; value is relative.

proverb: Waan ofii irra kufi, waan namaa xurii mormaa
meaning_om: Qabeenya fi mirga ofiitiif murannoon loluu qabu; qabeenyi namaa garuu gatii hin qabu.
meaning_en: Perish boldly in defense of your own rightful patrimony; another's property is mere worthless grime that washes off the neck.

proverb: Niitiin dhirsaaf sabloo hin qabdu
meaning_om: Hariiroo jaalalaa fi gaa'elaa keessatti dhoksaan fi qaanfiin sobaa bakka hin qabu; iftoominni jiraachuu qaba.
meaning_en: Between husband and wife there is no room for theatrical pretense or artificial coyness; true intimacy demands absolute honesty.

proverb: Arrabaa fi ilkeenuu wal dhawan
meaning_om: Namoonni baay'ee walitti dhihoo ta'an yookaan maatiin yeroo tokko tokko walitti bu'uun uumamaadha; dhiheenyi walitti bu'iinsa xiqqoo hin dhabu
meaning_en: Even the tongue and teeth bite and clash occasionally; friction is natural and unavoidable among intimate companions and relatives sharing close proximity

proverb: Wal argan malee walii hin quudhan
meaning_om: Namoonni yoo qaamaan wal arganii mari'atan malee fagootti wal shakkii fi wal dhowwachuun hin hafu; walitti dhufuun jaalalaa fi arjummaa kakaasa
meaning_en: People are reluctant to be generous or concede to one another from afar; face-to-face interaction and presence are required to inspire generosity and understanding

proverb: Wal lolli firaa dhiiga ilkeeti, garii ni liqimsani, garii ni tufani
meaning_om: Wal-dhabiinsi maatii fi fira gidduutti uumamu akka dhiiga ilkeeti; hunda ifatti baasanii hin lolan, gariis garaatti qabatanii obsu, gariis mariin qajeelchu
meaning_en: A quarrel among kin is like bleeding gums: you swallow some blood to guard family honor, and spit some out to clean the wound; kin disputes demand delicate balance

proverb: "Yoo na guddisan hamma arbaan gayaa, yoo na dhiisan hamma tafkiin gaya" jette, dubbiin
meaning_om: Dubbiin yookaan wal-dhabdeen yoo irratti wacanii fi dheeressan baay'ee babal'ata; yoo qalbiin dhiisanii fi callisan garuu salphaatti dhabama
meaning_en: A conflict expands into a massive elephant if people escalate and obsess over it, but shrinks to the size of a flea if dismissed with patient restraint

proverb: Qarri qara hin muru
meaning_om: Namoonni dandeettii, beekumsa yookaan qaxalummaa walqixaa qaban yeroo walitti dhufan salphaatti wal hin gowwoomsan, wal hin kuffisanis; jabaan jabaa beeka
meaning_en: One sharp edge cannot slice through another sharp edge; two equally clever, formidable, or astute minds cannot easily outsmart, deceive, or defeat one another; equals recognize and balance each other

proverb: Joollee fi sareetu, ollaa walitti naqa
meaning_om: Waldhabiinsi ollaawwan gidduutti uumamu yeroo baay'ee sababa tapha ijoollee fi waca beeyladaatiin kan dhufu waan ta'eef, namni guddaan dhimma sanaaf lola keessa galuu hin qabu
meaning_en: It is the squabbles of children and dogs that spark feuds between neighbors; mature adults should not destroy communal peace over the petty clashes of their young or pets

proverb: Buna dhuguu ollaa dhaqanii, dhugaa himuuf shawaa bahani
meaning_om: Ollaa ofii wajjin nagaan jiraachuuf jecha jecha mi'aawaa fi safeeffannaa qofa dubbatu malee, dhugaa hadhooftuu himuun diinummaa waan fiduuf namni fagaatee dhugaa baasa
meaning_en: One visits neighbors for polite hospitality and coffee, but to speak hard, uncomfortable truths, one must journey far away; local proximity demands polite diplomacy over brutal honesty

proverb: Sareen lafe fiddi, nadheen dubbi fiddi
meaning_om: Akkuma sareen alaa lafee barbaaddee manatti deebiftu, dubartoonnis oduu, hasasaa fi dubbii alaa funaananii manatti fidanii lola kakaasu jedhanii ilaalcha ganamaatiin qishnaan mammaaku
meaning_en: A dog brings home bones; women bring home news and disputes; a traditional folk critique of domestic gossip importing outside friction into the household

proverb: Namni dhufnaan, dubbiin dufe
meaning_om: Bakka namni tokko dhufe hundatti waldhabiinsi, oduun fi falmiin hordofee uumama; sababni dubbii dhufiinsa nama sanaatiin walqabata
meaning_en: When the person arrived, the dispute arrived; trouble, controversy, or debate walks in the door right with the person; certain individuals naturally stir conflict

proverb: Liqeeffatan malee, wal diduun hin jiru
meaning_om: Waldhabiinsi fi mufannaan namoota gidduutti yeroo baay'ee sababa liqii fi dhimma qabeenyaatiin uumama malee, namni qabeenyaan wal hin sarbin nagaan jiraata
meaning_en: Unless people enter into borrowing and lending, discord and refusal rarely arise; financial entanglements and unpaid debts are the primary destroyers of harmony

proverb: Warri galgala wacuu fi warri ganama rafu ni bada
meaning_om: Maatiin yeroo boqonnaa galgalaa nagaa dhabee wal dhabuufi ganama bariidhaan ka'ee hin hojjenne jireenyi isaa ni manca'a, hiyyummaatti kufa
meaning_en: The household that spends its evenings in acrimonious squabbling and its mornings sleeping in idleness is doomed to poverty and ruin; peace and morning diligence are essential

proverb: Karaa fi dubbii, osoo argani dhiisani
meaning_om: Daandii gara balaatti nama geessu fi dubbii walxaxaa lola fidu osoo ijaan arganii fi danda'anii karaatti dhiisanii irraa fagaachuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: A perilous road and an escalating dispute are best abandoned while one still has the clear vision and freedom to turn back; knowing when to disengage averts disaster

proverb: Lolli bagaa hin dabarree
meaning_om: Lolaa fi waraanni kamuu dhiiga, miidhaa, gaddaa fi kasaaraa guddaa waan hordofsiisuuf, 'baga nagaan dhumate' jedhanii gammachuun xumuruun hin jiru
meaning_en: A war or battle never passes with genuine relief or celebration; violent conflict invariably leaves behind bloodshed, trauma, and lingering grief that taint any victory

proverb: Joollee fi beeraatu, dhiira waliin gaya
meaning_om: Dhiirri kabajaa, ulfinaa fi guutummaa jireenyaa kan argatu yoo haadha manaa amala gaarii fi ijoollee godhatee bultii dhaabbatedha
meaning_en: It is children and an honorable wife that truly complete a man and fulfill his life's standing; family and progeny establish a man's domestic dignity and social maturity

proverb: Sareen wal loltee waa hedduun nama geessi
meaning_om: Waldhabdee fi qoccolloo namoota gad-aanoo gidduu seensisuun yookaan lola isaanii keessa lixuun nama gara salphinaa fi rakkina hin yaadamneetti geessa
meaning_en: Getting entangled in the squabbles of dogs drags a person into all sorts of unexpected trouble; meddling in petty, vulgar conflicts between others pulls a bystander into disgrace and harm

proverb: Baddee dhayxi malee, nadhetti karaa hin himan
meaning_om: Ilaalcha aadaa durii kan dubartoonni gorsa karaa osoo hin fudhatin fedhii fi mala mataa isaaniitiin deemu jedhanii qishnaan mammaakan calaqqisa
meaning_en: Traditional folk saying claiming that a woman will wander by her own intuition and arrive eventually, so giving her directions is futile; reflects traditional gender banter

proverb: Manni bubbe dhoowwa malee, dubbii hin dhoowwu
meaning_om: Manni ijaarame qilleensa alaa fi qabbana ittisuu danda'us, komii, aarii fi waldhabdee keessoo maatii jalaa namni dhokachuu hin danda'u; nagaan qalbii manarra murteessaadha
meaning_en: A house keeps out the blowing wind, but it cannot keep out disputes; external walls can shelter against cold weather, but they cannot shield a family from internal strife and discord

proverb: Loon waraanaa, waraanatti nama geessani
meaning_om: Qabeenyi humnaan, saamichaan yookaan lolaan ormarraa dhufe nagaa hin fidu; deebi'ee haloo, waraana fi badiisa biraatiif nama saaxila
meaning_en: Livestock plundered through war lead a person straight back into war; wealth gained through violent raids or plunder inevitably attracts counter-raids, retaliation, and ongoing bloodshed

proverb: Wallaalli abbatti beekkomsa fakkaata
meaning_om: Namni hubannoo hin qabne dogoggoraa fi wallaalummaa isaa akka waan beekumsa guddaa ta'etti yaada; of-dagachuun beekaa of sehuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: To an ignorant person, their own ignorance appears as profound knowledge; fools are blind to their lack of understanding and mistake their folly for wisdom

proverb: Buqqee duudaa, bishaan hin seenani
meaning_om: Akkuma buqqee qaawwa hin qabne bishaan keessa hin seenne, sammuu fi qalbii cufamaa keessas gorsiifi beekumsi hin seenu
meaning_en: Water cannot penetrate an unopened gourd; similarly, sound advice, new perspectives, or wisdom cannot enter a closed, stubborn, and unreceptive mind

proverb: Lafti hin beekne qarqara qofa, wanti hin beekne dafqa qofa
meaning_om: Wanta yookaan bakka tokko osoo keessa hin beekin akka laayyootti tilmaamuun dogoggora; wanti tokko alaan salphaa fakkaatus keessi isaa ulfaataadha
meaning_en: An unfamiliar territory appears as mere empty outskirts, and an unfamiliar labor seems like mere casual sweat; underestimating the complexity of unfamiliar places or duties leads to shock

proverb: Wallaalli dukkanaa wajji dhalatani, waa baratan male keessaa hin bahani
meaning_om: Namni hundi uumamaan beekumsa malee dhalata; dukkana doofummaa keessaa ba'uuf barumsaa fi carraaqqiin barachuu dirqama ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: Ignorance is a native darkness in which every human is born; one can only escape and find enlightenment through deliberate, lifelong learning

proverb: Namni hundinuu, quba shaniin nyaata
meaning_om: Namni kamuu hiyyeessas ta'ee sooressa, uumamaan fedhii fi uumama walfakkaataa qaba; namni tokkollee nama biraarra uumamaan caalmaa hin qabu; walqixxummaa namaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Every human being eats with five fingers; irrespective of rank, power, or wealth, all humans share the exact same biological nature and mortal vulnerability; fundamental human equality

proverb: Garaa duude mannaa, karaa duude wayya
meaning_om: Daandiin yoo cufame karaa biraa argachuun ni danda'ama; garuu sammuu fi qalbii gorsi fi dhugaan hin seenne qabaachuun balaa guddaadha
meaning_en: A physically blocked road is far better than a blocked, obtuse heart; a blocked road can be bypassed, but a heart closed to truth brings total ruin

proverb: Hiriyaan, gaachana walii hin ba'attu
meaning_om: Michoomni fi jaalalli hammamiyyuu jabaatu, qorumsa, murtii fi balaa lubbuu isa dhumaa irratti namni kamiyyuu ofuma isaatii of eeguu qaba; itti-gaafatamummaan dhuunfaati
meaning_en: A friend cannot carry a defensive shield on your behalf; no matter how devoted a comrade may be, ultimate personal danger, moral accountability, and mortality must be faced by oneself

proverb: Intalti akkoo hin qabduu, akkoo ofii himatti
meaning_om: Wanta ofii hin qabnee fi hin jirre akka waan qabaniitti sobaan dhaadachuu fi maqaa ormaatiin of faarsuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The girl has no grandmother, yet endlessly brags about her grandmother; mocks those who boast of non-existent pedigree, assets, or connections to fabricate status

proverb: Wallaalaan bitaachaa, bitaa namaati dhaabbata
meaning_om: Namni hubannoo fi ogummaa hin qabne yeroo hunda bakka hin malle dhaabbatee fi gocha hin taane raawwatee nama jeeqaa
meaning_en: The fool is clumsy and stands on the wrong, awkward side of people; an ignorant person lacks social awareness and perpetually creates awkward, disruptive friction

proverb: Dubbii rabbii fi kofla saree hin beekani
meaning_om: Murtiin uumaa iccitii fagoo akka ta'e hunda, amalli nama fakkeessaa isa akka saree ilkaan mul'isuutiis wanta keessa isaanii jiru beekuun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: The designs of God and the grinning grimace of a dog cannot be fathomed; human beings cannot predict divine decrees, nor can they trust treacherous outward smiles

proverb: Himata hin beekne malee gowwaan haqa ni qaba
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii haasaa fi falmii dhabuun haqa isaa akka hin qabne hin agarsiisu; haqa qabaatus afaaniin himachuu dadhabuu danda'a
meaning_en: He may lack the eloquence to plead his case, but a simpleton still possesses genuine rights and truth; inarticulateness does not negate justice

proverb: Tooftaan wallaalaa dhaa, akka dhagaa gaaraa bororeeti
meaning_om: Namni gowwaan mala fi karoora hin qabu; tarkaanfiin inni fudhatu akkuma dhagaa gaara irraa gadi qajeelee homaa hin eegganneetti miidhaa fi balaa fida
meaning_en: The strategy of an ignorant person is like a boulder tumbling uncontrollably down a mountainside; blind, chaotic, and destructive to everything in its path

proverb: Wallaalaan, bishaan keessa dhaabbateeti dheebota
meaning_om: Carraa fi qabeenyi bal'aan naannoo isaatti osoo jiruu, namni doofaan hubannoo dhabuudhaan beela'ee fi dheebotee jiraata
meaning_en: Standing right in the midst of water, the ignorant person suffers from thirst; an oblivious fool starves and suffers amid abundant opportunities through lack of understanding

proverb: Wallaalaaf lafti bal'oo dha
meaning_om: Namni wanta hundumaa hin beekne daangaa, balaa fi qorumsa jireenyaa waan hin tilmaamneef, wanti hundi salphaa fi banaa itti fakkaata
meaning_en: To the ignorant, the earth seems completely boundless; lacking knowledge of pitfalls, boundaries, or dangers, fools operate with naive, oblivious freedom

proverb: Bakka beekaan rakkinaa miila fudhachuu dadhabetti, wallaalaan bal'inaa keessa burraaqa
meaning_om: Bakka balaan dhokataan jiru nama beekaatu dursee yaadda'ee suuta deema; gowwaan garuu balaa sana osoo hin hubatin qoosatti seena
meaning_en: Where the wise person treads with paralyzing caution, the fool frolics in carefree delight; fools rush in where angels fear to tread

proverb: Namni biyyaa bahe, waan biyyaa hin dubbatu
meaning_om: Namni bakka dhimmi sun ta'aa jiruu fagaatee jiru haala qabatamaa naannichaa hin beeku waan ta'eef, dhimma keessoo irratti murteessuu hin qabu
meaning_en: One who has left the homeland should not speak on the local affairs of the homeland; those absent from the immediate ground lack the context to judge

proverb: Kan taa'insatti jibbani, kaatee namatti sirbiti
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu amala isaatiin tuffatamee fi jibbamee jiru, caalaatti of saaxilee waan nama aarsu raawwachuun nuffii fida
meaning_en: She who is already resented while sitting quietly stands up and aggressively dances before people; obnoxious individuals compound their annoyance with brazen showmanship

proverb: Wallaalaan akka nama quba hin qabneeti
meaning_om: Namni beekumsa hin qabne balaa, dhibee fi wanta naannoo isaatti ta'aa jiru hundaaf dantaa dhabee akka nama quba hin qabneetti callisa
meaning_en: An ignorant person behaves as one who is completely oblivious; being blind to underlying realities, they move through crises without the slightest comprehension

proverb: Kan yoo qalan coomuu fi kan dhugaa dubbatu waaqayyootu beeka
meaning_om: Akkuma gabbina foonii keessaa beekuun hanga qalamuutti hin danda'amne, amanamummaa fi qulqullina qalbii namaatis Waaqayyo qofatu beeka
meaning_en: Which cow yields rich fat upon slaughter and which human truly speaks the truth, God alone knows; true internal virtue and honesty are invisible to mere mortals

proverb: Waan beektuun dalayde, boosattiin quba hin qabdu
meaning_om: Hojii qulqullinaa fi aarsaa namni dandeettii qabu raawwatu namni dhibaa'aan fi dadhabaan gatii isaa hin beeku, bakkaas bu'uu hin danda'u
meaning_en: The meticulous industry performed by a skilled, virtuous homemaker is beyond the comprehension of a lazy, slovenly sluggard; incompetence cannot fathom excellence

proverb: Alaa dhufaan, akka mana keessaa quba hin qabu
meaning_om: Namni alaa dhufe yookaan dhimma sana keessa hin jirre iccitii, rakkoo fi wal-xaxaa manicha keessaa waan hin beekneef murtoo sirrii kennuu hin danda'u
meaning_en: An outsider arriving from without understands nothing of what transpires within the walls; external observers are blind to internal domestic complexities

proverb: Joolleen tapha seeteeti, duulaaf boochi
meaning_om: Dhimma balaa fi lubbuu gaafatu akka qoosaatti ilaaluudhaan namoonni bilchina hin qabne wanta humna isaaniitii ol ta'eef dhiphatu; jarjara dhowwa
meaning_en: Mistaking it for playful sport, a child weeps to march off to war; inexperienced people naively romanticize grueling, mortal ordeals

proverb: Harreen dayma ba'achuu malee, mi'aa isaa hin beektu
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya yookaan beekumsa guddaa baatee garuu gatii fi faayidaa isaa hin beekne bu'aa tokkollee irraa hin argatu; dadhabbii bu'aa maleeti
meaning_en: A donkey merely carries the load of honey, yet never tastes its sweetness; describes an uncultured person who transports or holds treasures without ever understanding or enjoying their value

proverb: Harreen dammaaf hin gaabitu
meaning_om: Wanta qaalii fi kabajamaa dhabuun nama gatii isaa hin beekneef gaabbii hin fidu; uumamni gad-aanaan wanta guddaaf quuqama hin qabu
meaning_en: A donkey feels no remorse over missing out on honey; crude and unrefined individuals never mourn the loss of high culture, fine virtues, or intellectual treasures

proverb: Barana qayyattee, jilbaa gadii gubatte
meaning_om: Namni wanta haaraa muuxannoo hin qabne keessa galee of eeggannoo dhabuun dafee balaa fi miidhaa ofirratti fida; ogeessa hin taane balaaf saaxilama
meaning_en: Burning incense for the first time this year, she scorched herself below the knees; inexperienced novices attempting unfamiliar rituals or duties end up clumsily burning themselves

proverb: Namni quba hin qabne, dubbii ija baysa
meaning_om: Namni dhimma sana irratti hubannoo hin qabne yoo marii keessa lixe dubbii qajeelaa jallisee furmaata dhabsiisa; wallaalaan dubbii mancaasa
meaning_en: A person lacking all comprehension blinds the very eye of the dispute; ignorant interlopers meddling in mediation ruin clarity and derail resolution

proverb: Wallaalaa fira hin godhadhu, ofii hin beekuu namaaf hin beeku
meaning_om: Nama qalbii hin qabne wajjin michooma uumuun bu'aa hin qabu; inni ofuma isaatiituu of gargaaruu kan hin dandeenye nama kaaniifis homaa hin godhu
meaning_en: I will not take a fool as an ally; he knows nothing for his own welfare, so he can certainly know nothing for yours; an incompetent person is a liability as a companion

proverb: Kan lole, kan dhume, kan du'e, kan gale maal na gaafatta?
meaning_om: Waraanni fi balaan hundi kasaaraa fi gadda malee bu'aa biraa hin qabu; wanta darbee miidhaa fidu sana odeessuun faayidaa hin qabu jechuu ibsa
meaning_en: Why do you interrogate me about who fought, who fell, who died, and who limped home?; war brings only universal devastation, and recounting its catalog of horrors is agonizing and futile

proverb: "Jaldo! maaliif inaba nyaatta"? jennaan, wallaalaatu na mude je'e
meaning_om: Hattuun yookaan diinni qabeenya namaa yoo saame sababa of-eeggannoo dhabuu abbaatiin akka ta'etti sababeessa; eeggannoo dhabuun saamichaaf karaa bana
meaning_en: When asked 'Baboon, why do you eat the grapes?', he replied, 'An ignorant fool planted them right on my path!'; predators shamelessly blame their victims' lack of vigilance for the theft

proverb: Yoo gowwaatii, dammi dhadhaa dha
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii madaallii hin qabne wanta qaalii fi adda ta'e wantuma salphaa wajjin wal qixxeessee ilaala; gatii dhugaa adda baasuu dadhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: To a fool, precious honey is no different from common cooking butter; an undiscerning mind cannot distinguish between exquisite rarity and ordinary sustenance

proverb: Yoo gowwaatii, aannan dheedhii dha
meaning_om: Namni hubannoo hin qabne wanta uumamaan qulqulluu fi guutuu ta'e illee hanqina qaba jedhee komata; madaallii sirrii dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: To a fool, wholesome fresh milk is considered undercooked; an ignorant critic finds fault with things that are already naturally perfect and whole

proverb: Yoo gowwaatii, halkan guyyaa dha
meaning_om: Namni qalbii dhabe balaa fi wanta isa miidhu osoo hin hubatin akka waan nagaa ta'etti keessa deema; yeroo fi haala adda baasuu dadhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: To a fool, dark night is broad daylight; an oblivious person wanders into perils and taboo darkness with the same reckless casualness as day

proverb: Maaltu itti aana jennaan, "mana gubuu dha" je'e maraataan
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne yookaan tasgabbii dhabe furmaata ijaarsaa dhiisee yeroo hunda gara badiisaa fi diigumsa dhumaatti ariifata
meaning_en: When asked 'What should we do next?', 'Burn down the house!' said the lunatic; unhinged or reckless people always leap to the most destructive, catastrophic extremes

proverb: Keessa hin beektuu, seentee keessummaa bulte
meaning_om: Haala, rakkinaa fi iccitii mana yookaan dhimma tokkoo osoo hin beekin keessa lixanii booda dhiphinaa fi salphina keessatti of argu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Knowing nothing of its internal reality, she stepped in and spent the night as a guest; entering unfamiliar households or commitments blindly leads to unpleasant entrapment

proverb: Keessummaan keessa hin beektuu, mana guddina laalti
meaning_om: Keessummaan bifa alaa fi guddina manaa qofa ilaalti malee, beelaa fi rakkoo maatiin sun keessa jiru hin hubattu; bifa alaan gowwoomuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A guest knows nothing of the internal plight; he merely marvels at the size of the mansion; outward grandeur often masks internal starvation and distress

proverb: Namni du'aa'ii godhuu hin beekne, waan Rabbi jibbuu keessa fida
meaning_om: Wanta kadhatan yookaan hojjetan dandeettii fi beekumsa qabaachuu baannaan, bu'aa gaarii argachuu mannaa badiisaa fi aarii uumaa ofitti fidu
meaning_en: A person who does not know how to pray inadvertently incorporates what God detests; clumsy, unguided supplications or actions invite the very ruin they seek to avert

proverb: Hurreen gowwatti rooba
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne wanta xiqqoo fi salphaa akka waan guddaatti argee fiiga; dhimma laafaa guddisee ilaaluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: To a fool, light mist is a torrential downpour; a simpleton panics or gets overly excited over insubstantial, fleeting phenomena

proverb: Qonna waan fooyyee seetee, dongoraa fuutee ceete
meaning_om: Hojii ulfaataa fi dadhabsiisaa ta'e osoo keessa hin beekin salphaa sehanii itti seenuun booda dhiphina fida; ifaajee hojii tilmaamuu dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Imagining agriculture was easy relief, she grabbed the heavy digging stick and dashed off; satirizes underestimating backbreaking labor before experiencing its agony

proverb: Namni barnoota baratee bakkaan hin gahin, akka nama mana dukkanaa keessa taa'ee ifa alaa qaawaan laaluuti
meaning_om: Beekumsa gartokkee qabaachuun guutummaatti nama hin baasu; barnoota eegalaniis hanga galma isaatti xumuruun ifa guutuu akka argatan taasisa
meaning_en: One who acquires education without completing it is like someone sitting in a dark room watching outside sunlight through a tiny chink; incomplete knowledge leaves one in darkness with only a tantalizing glimpse of illumination

proverb: Waaqni, mirgaa fi bitatti facaafata
meaning_om: Eebbi, rizqiin fi uumamni Waaqayyoo nama kamiifiyyuu bitaas ta'ee mirgatti walqixa dhangala'a; Waaqni loogii malee hundaaf kenna
meaning_en: God distributes His bounty to both the right and the left; divine providence is impartial, scattering blessings, opportunities, and sustenance across all sides without bias

proverb: Wal qixxee nyaattuun, gabatee wal duraa hin fuutu
meaning_om: Namoonni sadarkaa fi kabajaan walqixxee ta'an wal kabajuun maaddii qooddattu malee walirratti hin roorrisan, wal hin saamanis; safeeffannaa fi kabaja waloo agarsiisa
meaning_en: Peers who dine on equal footing do not snatch the serving platter from each other; true equals respect mutual boundaries, share resources fairly, and avoid domineering greed

proverb: Walii ba'attuun wal hin nyaattu
meaning_om: Namoonni yeroo rakkinaa fi dhiphinaa wal tumsanii ba'aa walii baatan amanamummaa qabaatu malee wal irratti shira hin xaxan, wal hin miidhanis
meaning_en: Those who shoulder each other's burdens do not prey upon one another; genuine mutual solidarity and shared struggle create a sacred bond that precludes betrayal and exploitation

proverb: Wal qixxeen, wal fixxe
meaning_om: Namoonni humnaa fi dandeettiin walgitani fi tokkollee isa kaaniif gad jechuu dide yeroo falmiitti seenan, lachuu osoo wal hin mo'atin wal balleessanii kufu
meaning_en: Being matched as exact equals resulted in their mutual destruction; when two evenly matched rivals stubbornly clash without either yielding, the contest ends in mutual ruin

proverb: Warri walirra hin jirre, jabbii walitti naqata
meaning_om: Ollaa fi maatiin wal hin tuffannee fi walirratti roorrisuu hin barbaanne jaalalaa fi nagaan qabeenya isaanii wal faana tikfatu, wal gargaaru
meaning_en: Households that do not hold superiority complexes or domineer over one another corral and pasture their calves together; peaceful mutual aid thrives where neither seeks supremacy

proverb: Kadhaan kadhaa hin caaltu
meaning_om: Harka namaa eeggachuu fi kadhaatti galuun hundaafuu salphina tokkuma; gosti kadhaa kan biraa caalaatti kabajamaa ta'e hin jiru, of danda'uutu caala
meaning_en: One form of begging is no better than another; all begging is fundamentally dependent and demeaning; there is no nobility in requesting handouts, and self-reliance is superior

proverb: Kan akka walii daboo (guuza) walii hin ooltu
meaning_om: Namoonni sadarkaa, qabeenyaa fi humnan walgitan hojii waloomaa fi wal-gargaarsa daboo irratti amanamummaan wal cinaa dhaabbatu malee wal hin dagan
meaning_en: Peers of equal standing never fail to attend one another's communal labor parties (daboo/guuza); true equals honor mutual reciprocity and turn out to help each other cultivate

proverb: "Gurbaan warra soddaa maal uffatee dhaqa" jennaan "warri soddaa maal uffatee eega" je'e
meaning_om: Kabajnii fi qophiin gama lamaaniiyyuu wal madaaluu qaba; namni tokko ormaaf jedhee of miidhee osoo hin taane, akkaataa haala qabatamaatti wal simachuutu mala
meaning_en: When asked 'What fine clothes should the youth wear when visiting the in-laws?', he retorted 'What will the in-laws be wearing to receive him?'; mutual respect and presentation must be reciprocal rather than one-sidedly strained

proverb: Aniis kabiiraan ifiin ja'aa, atiis kabiira ifiin jettaa, duuba eenyuutu harree karaa nuu oofa?
meaning_om: Hundumtuu yoo hoogganaa fi beekaa of godhe hojii qabatamaa fi ba'aa lafaa kan hojjetu hin jiru; hoggansi qofti osoo hin taane hojjetaanis barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: If I proclaim myself a master scholar, and you proclaim yourself a master scholar, who then will drive the pack-donkey on the road?; when everyone insists on being the boss, manual labor is abandoned and the enterprise stalls

proverb: Barri fal'aanaa, takkaa namaaf fondogaa takkaa namaatu fondogsa
meaning_om: Jireenyi fi yeroon yeroo hundumaa jijjiiramaa dha; yeroo tokko carraan namaaf tolee nama gabbisa, yeroo kaan ammoo qorumsa fi dhiphina fida
meaning_en: Time and fortune fluctuate like a spoon; at times circumstances generously feed a person, while at other times they demand grueling toil and resourcefulness

proverb: Waytiin (yeroon) akka najjaaraatii osoo hin beeyne si jaarteeti osoo hin beeyne si diiydi
meaning_om: Yeroon suuta suutaan nama ijaaree sadarkaa fi guddina namaaf kenna, garuu osoo hin beekaminis nama dulloomsee humna nama dhabsiisa
meaning_en: Time operates like a silent carpenter; quietly and imperceptibly it crafts your growth and stature, and just as stealthily it dismantles your youth and vigor

proverb: Aduun hin gortuu, kan gorutti dhiiti
meaning_om: Yeroon fi uumamni nama tokkoofillee hin dhaabbatu; namni kaayyoo fi daandii qajeelaa dhiisee asii fi achi jooru yeroodhaan qabamee dukkanni itti dhufa
meaning_en: Time and the sun halt for no one; those who abandon their proper path to wander aimlessly will inevitably be overtaken by darkness and regret

proverb: Waan barri namaa kenne, haadhaa fi abbaan namaa hin kennine
meaning_om: Carraan, milkaa'innii fi qabeenyi yeroon sun namaaf fidu wanta maatiin illee dandeettii isaaniitiin namaaf laachuu hin dandeenyedha; yeroon nama badhaasa
meaning_en: The opportunities, wealth, and status that favorable times bestow upon an individual surpass even what loving parents could ever provide; power of circumstance

proverb: Kan dabartee hin gaabbin, kan dhufu hin dagatin
meaning_om: Wanta kaleessaa darbee fi kufaatii kanaan duraatiif gaabbiidhaan of miidhuu dhiisanii, gara fuulduraatti qophii fi of eeggannoo jabaa gochuutu mala
meaning_en: Do not paralyze yourself grieving over past mistakes or lost days; keep your focus sharp and your preparations ready for what lies ahead

proverb: Kan darbe, darbi hin dhaqqabu
meaning_om: Wanta yeroodhaan darbee fi qabeenya yookaan carraa jalaa bahe deebisanii argachuun hin danda'amu; waan dabre hordofanii of dadhabsuun bu'aa hin qabu
meaning_en: A missile cast into the air can never overtake what has already slipped away; bygone moments and missed opportunities cannot be retrieved by frantic afterthoughts

proverb: Hamma jirtutti jabaadhu duunaan biyyeen nama nyaatti
meaning_om: Hamma lubbuun qaama keessa jirtutti hojjedhu, carraaqi, jireenya dhandhami; erga du'anii booda wanti hunduu dhumatee biyyeetti makamuun hin oolu
meaning_en: Be strong, industrious, and steadfast while breath remains; once death strikes, the silent soil consumes all; live fully and work vigorously while alive

proverb: Arba baraatu fixe, ilkee isaa baraatu mi'eesse
meaning_om: Yeroon wanta jabaa fi guddaa kamuu suuta dadhabsiisee kuffisa; garuu firiin fi mallattoon gocha isaa yeroo booda gati-jabeessa ta'ee faarfama
meaning_en: Time wears down and fells even the mighty elephant, yet historical time makes its remaining ivory priceless; time levels power but hallows legacy

proverb: Lafa namaa hin taanetti, aduun namatti hin dhihin
meaning_om: Bakka nagaa hin qabne, iddoo alagaa fi naannoo balaa qabu keessatti qabamanii akka hin hafne of eeggachuu; yeroo dhihaatu bakka amansiisaa qabaachuu
meaning_en: In a hostile or unfitting land, may dusk never overtake you; avoid being stranded in dangerous, unwelcoming territory when darkness falls

proverb: "Ilma koo akkamitti na awwaalta" jennaan "akkuma yerootti" je'e ilmi abbaa dhaan
meaning_om: Sirnii fi hojiin kamiinuu haala qabatamaa, dandeettii fi yeroo sana irratti hundaa'ee raawwatama malee hawwii qofaan hin ta'u; qabatamummaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: When the father asked 'How will you bury me, son?', he replied 'According to the times!'; all ceremonies and actions are strictly governed by prevailing resources

proverb: "Abbaa koo na fuusisi" jennaan, "yoo algafraa roobe si qofaa mitii anuu niin fuudha, yoo algafraa roobuu baate ammoo haateetuu ni hiikkamti" je'e, abbaan ilmaan
meaning_om: Gaa'ellii fi jireenyi badhaadhaa bu'aa qonnaa fi rooba irratti hirkata; yoo qabeenyi dhabame maatiin ijaarameyyuu diigamuuf saaxilama
meaning_en: When the son begged for a bride, his father noted that prosperity and marriage hinge on the rains: with rain everyone marries; with drought even wives are divorced

proverb: Dhukkuba baraa fi dhukkuba garaa hin beekani
meaning_om: Balaa fi dhibee yeroon fidu, akkasumas yaadaa fi dhibee dhokataa nama garaa keessa jiru dursee baruun hin danda'amu; qorannoo fagootti eeggachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One cannot foresee the seasonal calamity of an era, nor read the hidden intentions or afflictions of the human heart; future trends and hearts are unpredictable

proverb: Kan buluuf malee, kan galuuf lafti dhiite
meaning_om: Namni mana fi bultii qabu dhihiinsa aduutti yoo gammadu, inni karaa irra jiru garuu dhiphina keessa gala; bakka jireenyaa qabaachuu dursa kennu
meaning_en: Nightfall brings peaceful shelter to the one who lodges, but poses grave peril to the traveler on the road; secure your shelter before dusk arrives

proverb: Boru boruun, muca dulloomsa
meaning_om: Hojii fi tarkaanfii barbaachisaa ta'e yeroo hunda borutti dabarsuun umuriin namaa osoo homaa hin hojjetin akka dhumatu godha; harkifannaan nama moofeesse kuffisa
meaning_en: Saying 'Tomorrow, tomorrow' ages a young person into senility; chronic procrastination drains human vitality and lets life slip away without achievement

proverb: Shanyiin beexala fardaati
meaning_om: Akkuma fardi dhaloota gaarii qabu saffisaa fi dandeettii agarsiisu, namni sanyii fi maatii qajeelaa irraa dhalates amala fi gootummaan of mul'isa
meaning_en: Good lineage is like the refined, steady pace of a thoroughbred; noble heritage and virtuous breeding inevitably show themselves through character and stamina

proverb: Kal'oon gooba kormaa, jiituu dhifan malee, gohgoyduun namaa hin dhifamtu
meaning_om: Wanta yookaan amala tokko yeroo inni laafaa fi jalqaba irra jiru sirreessan malee, erga jabaatee fi goggogee booda jijjiiruun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: The thick hide of a bull's hump can only be stretched and pegged while supple and moist; once dried, it will never yield; discipline must be applied early

proverb: Jimaa fi dubra, walif hin kaayani
meaning_om: Wanti yeroodhaan darbu fi bareedinni uumamaa yeroon fayyadamuu yoo baatan dafee bushaawa; carraa yeroo isaatti fayyadamuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Fresh khat and a maiden cannot be hoarded for each other; perishable prime and youthful beauty must be matched in their due season before they fade

proverb: Mormi caphe, ogeessa hin afatu
meaning_om: Balaa fi miidhaan hundee irraa lubbuu balleesse yaala hin barbaadu; dhimmi deebii hin qabne tattaaffii namaatiin hin fayyu
meaning_en: A snapped neck does not call for a bone-setter; fatal and irreversible destruction is beyond the reach of any healer; recognize absolute ruin

proverb: Tiruun bulte, ni lafooyti
meaning_om: Dhimma hatattamaan xumuramuu qabu yoo tursiisan gatii dhabee laamshaa'a; hojii yeroon raawwachuu dhabuun bu'aa balleessa
meaning_en: Liver kept overnight turns soft and spoilable; dragging out delicate decisions or urgent business causes their value to deteriorate rapidly

proverb: Tiruun bulte, hidda baafti
meaning_om: Waldhabdeen yookaan mufannaan xiqqoon yoo yeroodhaan araaraan hin furamin, suuta suutaan jabaatee diinummaa hin dhumne uuma
meaning_en: Liver kept overnight sprouts tough sinews; an unresolved minor dispute hardens over time into an entrenched, intractable feud; reconcile quickly

proverb: Hokkola oowwatti gubani
meaning_om: Rakkoo, madaa yookaan dogoggora uumame osoo hin babal'atin yeruma sanatti furmaata kennuutu bu'aa fida; ittisa yeroo agarsiisa
meaning_en: A sprain is cauterized while the joint is still warm; painful problems and disciplinary errors must be addressed immediately before the damage sets

proverb: Waan boru hin tolle, ar'a hojjatani
meaning_om: Balaa fi qorumsa gara fuulduraatti hammaatee dhufe nama rakkisu dursee har'a ittisuun ogummaadha; dur-argummaan jireenya baraarsa
meaning_en: What will prove unmanageable tomorrow must be confronted and resolved today; proactive prevention today wards off catastrophe tomorrow

proverb: Harkifattuun niitii, dhiirsaan nama eegdi
meaning_om: Namni dhibaa'aan hojii fi dubbii ofii yeroodhaan hin xumurre dhumarratti dhimma isaa gara walitti bu'iinsa dhiiraatti ceesisee nagaa diiga
meaning_en: A dilatory, slow woman lets domestic chores or disputes slide until her husband is forced into a brawl; procrastination dragging others into conflict

proverb: Hiraata qorsoo, galgalaan jalqabani
meaning_om: Hojii ulfaataa, dheeraa fi dadhabsiisaa ta'e yeroodhaan jalqabanii hojjechuun dirqama; wanta yeroo barbaaduuf qophii duraa gochuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A dinner of roasted grain must be started early at dusk; when facing backbreaking, tedious, or slow-yielding work, start early to finish on time

proverb: Namni hiraanni shuumoo galgalaan itti naqata
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya yookaan filannoo rakkisaa qabu qophii isaa dursee jalqabuu qaba; dandeettii ofii beekanii yeroodhaan socho'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The one whose dinner is tough boiled beans sets the pot on the fire early at evening; those with limited or difficult means must compensate with early planning

proverb: Waa garii erga darbite booda sheenawuu wayya
meaning_om: Balaa fi qorumsa cimaa keessatti iyyanii dhiphachuurra, dura tasgabbaa'anii balaa sana keessaa ba'anii sana booda yaaduutu caala
meaning_en: For certain overwhelming crises, it is better to regret and grieve only after they have fully passed; stay cold-headed during the fire and mourn later

proverb: Haa hafu jedhan, namaa wajji hafani
meaning_om: Dhimma barbaachisaa ta'e dhiisanii dantaa dhabuun dhumarratti nama miidhee duubatti nama hambisa; carraatti fayyadamuu dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Saying 'Let it slide', they ended up left behind with the crowd; apathetic complacency and letting opportunities pass result in being permanently stranded

proverb: Wanni boorawee xaliilawaa, dubbii fi bishaani
meaning_om: Akkuma bishaan boora'e suuta callisee qulqullaa'u, dubbiin fi waldhabdeeniis yoo obsaan yeroo kennaniif tasgabbaa'ee nagaan bu'a
meaning_en: The two things that churn turbid and then settle crystal clear are speech and water; give heated disputes and roiled water time, and clarity will return

proverb: Lola araarri booda jiru hin sodaatin
meaning_om: Walitti bu'iinsa yookaan qorumsa dhuma irratti nagaa, jaalala fi waliigaltee fidu hin sodaatinaa; falmiin dhugaa nagaa bu'uuraa fida
meaning_en: Do not fear a conflict that carries reconciliation in its wake; do not shrink from honest, necessary confrontation when it purges toxicity and secures lasting peace

proverb: Namichi haa hafu jedhe, balaa guddoo'rraa hafa
meaning_om: Wanta xiqqoo fi aarii yerootiif jecha lola keessa galuu dhiisanii dhiifama gochuun balaa fi badiisa lubbuu guddaa jalaa nama baraarsa
meaning_en: The man who said 'Let it pass' escaped a massive calamity; practicing humble forbearance and letting petty provocations slide averts disastrous bloodshed

proverb: Dhugaan waaheela waaqaati
meaning_om: Dhugaan uumaa wajjin hidhata cimaa qaba; namni dhugaa qabu yeroo hundumaa eegumsa fi deeggarsa Waaqayyoo argata
meaning_en: Truth is the steadfast companion of God; righteousness and truth align directly with divine will, ensuring divine protection for the truthful

proverb: Dhugaan ni qallata malee hin citu
meaning_om: Dhugaan yeroo tokko tokko dhiibbaa fi cunqursaatiin xiqqaattee akka baddu fakkaattus, gonkumaa hin dhabamtu, dhuma irratti ni mo'atti
meaning_en: Truth may be stretched thin and suppressed under pressure, but it never snaps; justice may appear fragile for a season, but it is ultimately unbreakable

proverb: Dhugaan dhagaa gaaraa borore
meaning_om: Dhugaan humna jabaa kan namni tokkollee dura dhaabbachuu hin dandeenyedha; akkuma dhagaa gaaraa bororuu wanta dura dhaabbatu hunda dhabamsiisa
meaning_en: Truth is like a massive boulder rolling down a mountainside; once unleashed, it possesses unstoppable momentum that crushes all falsehood in its path

proverb: Dhugaan yeroof hadhaawaa dha
meaning_om: Dhugaa ifatti dubbachuun yeroo sanaaf nama mufachiisuu yookaan hadhaawuu danda'us, booda garuu fayyina, nagaa fi qajeelfama fida
meaning_en: Truth tastes bitter in the immediate moment; candid honesty may sting initially, but it yields wholesome healing, clarity, and peace in the end

proverb: Dhugaa fi bariin dhawaataan ifa baati
meaning_om: Akkuma barii ganamaa suuta jedhee dukkana keessaa ifu, dhugaan dhokattes yeroodhaan suutuma suuta ifatti baatee mul'atti
meaning_en: Truth and daybreak both reveal themselves gradually; no matter how deeply obscured by darkness, truth dawns steadily and inevitably illuminates all

proverb: Dhugaan nama du'e kaasa
meaning_om: Haqni fi dhugaan humna guddaa kan nama miidhamee fi kufe illee deebisee mirkaneessu, maqaa gaarii fi kabaja namaa deebisuu qaba
meaning_en: Truth can resurrect the dead; discovering and declaring the truth vindicates the fallen, restores ruined reputations, and revives justice from the ashes

proverb: Dhugaa malee dhugaatiin nama hin quubsitu
meaning_om: Qananiin fi dhugaatiin alaa nama hin quubsu; boqonnaa fi quufi dhugaan kan argamu qulqullina qalbii fi haqa qabaachuu irraayi
meaning_en: Except for truth, no beverage or luxury truly satisfies a human soul; material indulgence leaves an inner void, whereas living in truth brings deep contentment

proverb: Dhugaan afaan qaban funyaaniin xixiixa
meaning_om: Dhugaa ukkaamsuunii fi dhoksuun hin danda'amu; karaa tokkoon yoo cufan karaa biraatiin dhootee ifatti baati
meaning_en: If you clamp down on the mouth of truth, it whistles out through the nostrils; truth is irrepressible, and attempting to muzzle it only forces it out elsewhere

proverb: Hammam haa turu malee, dhugaan abbaa hin hanqatu
meaning_om: Haqni fi dhugaan yeroo fudhatus dhuma irratti nama isaaf malu bira gahuun isaa hin oolu; haqni yoomiyyuu hin badu
meaning_en: However long it tarries, truth never fails to reach its rightful owner; justice may suffer delays, but it inevitably catches up with the deserving claimant

proverb: Hammam haa turu malee, dhugaan dhufuu hin oolu
meaning_om: Yeroon hangam yoo dheerateyyuu dhugaan dhuma irratti ifa bahee dhufuun isaa seera uumamaati; sobaan dhugaa dhabamsiisuun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: However long it lingers, truth never fails to arrive; the unveiling of facts and moral vindication is an immutable law of nature that time always fulfills

proverb: Namni dhugaan deemu akka nama muuza akaafuuti, namni kijibaan deemu akka nama gobeensa akaafuuti
meaning_om: Dhugaan jireenya mi'aawaa fi boqonnaa qabu namaaf kenna; sobni garuu akkuma qoraa nama waraanee dhiphinaa fi salphina fida
meaning_en: Walking in truth is like roasting sweet bananas—wholesome and satisfying; walking in falsehood is like roasting sharp thorns—producing only pain and frustration

proverb: Namni dhugaa hin quufne, dhugullee hin quufu
meaning_om: Namni qajeelummaa fi haqa fudhachuu didee qalbii gogaa qabu, qabeenyaan fi wanta addunyaatiin gonkumaa hin quufu; bololli isaa hin dhumu
meaning_en: One who cannot find contentment in truth will never be satisfied by any physical drink; moral dishonesty fuels an insatiable, bottomless appetite

proverb: Dhugaa abbaa tokkoof kennani
meaning_om: Falmii keessatti haqni gama lamaanuu hin ta'u; dhugaan tokkicha waan taateef isa dhugaa qabuuf kennama malee loogiin hin jiru
meaning_en: Truth can only be awarded to one rightful party; justice cannot be compromised or divided falsely between opposing sides; truth is indivisible

proverb: Haqni abbaa hin dabarre
meaning_om: Haqni fi qajeelummaan yoo tures abbuma isaaf malu bira darbee nama biraatti hin hafu; murtii sirriin dhuma irratti ni mul'ata
meaning_en: Justice never bypasses its rightful owner; true claims and moral entitlements cannot be permanently diverted to an impostor

proverb: Dhuufuun udaan biraa dhufti, hireen dhugaa biraa dhufti
meaning_om: Akkuma mallattoon qaamaa ka'umsa qabu, badhaadhinnii fi eebbi dhugaanis qajeelummaa fi dhugaa dubbachuu irraa madda
meaning_en: Just as flatulence naturally emanates from physical waste, genuine good fortune and divine blessing spring directly from honest, truthful living

proverb: Haqaa fi eegeen gara duubaati
meaning_om: Haqni akkuma eegee beeyladaa boodarra mul'ata malee jalqabarratti argamuun itti ulfaata; xumura irratti haqni ifa baha
meaning_en: Justice and the tail both bring up the rear; truth and justice often trail behind the initial commotion, manifesting definitively at the end of the journey

proverb: Faarsuu fi dhugaan boodatti
meaning_om: Hojiin yookaan amalli namaa dhugaan kan madaalamu fi faarfamu yeroo inni xumuramuudha malee jalqabarraan miti; dhumni dhugaa baasa
meaning_en: Genuine praise and absolute truth belong at the conclusion; an enterprise or character cannot be authentically judged or praised until its final chapter unfolds

proverb: Dhugaan mana itti galani
meaning_om: Dhugaan dahoo fi mana nagaati; namni dhugaa qabatee jiraatu yeroo hundumaa tasgabbii, boqonnaa fi sodaa malee jiraata
meaning_en: Truth is the sanctuary in which one rests safely; living in truth provides an unshakable shelter of peace of mind, free from fear and paranoia

proverb: Namni dhara dheesse, dhugatti baha
meaning_om: Namni soba, daba fi cubbuu irraa fagaatee qajeelummaa hordofu dhuma irratti nagaa fi dhugaa qulqulluu bira gaha
meaning_en: One who flees falsehood inevitably emerges into the light of truth; rejecting deceit and corruption naturally guides a person to justice and peace

proverb: Kijibaan "hangam takka ceeta" jennaan "hanga dhugaan na dhaqqabu takka numaan ceeha" je'e
meaning_om: Sobduun hamma dhugaan ifatti bahee isa saaxilutti soba isaa itti fufaa deemee orma gowwoomsuuf yaala; ija-jabinna sobdootaa qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: When asked 'How far will you run?', the liar replied, 'I will keep running until truth catches up with me!'; satirizes the brazen audacity of liars who persist until cornered

proverb: Haqaaf yoo jedhan waa hin gubatani
meaning_om: Haqa fi dhugaadhaaf falmachuun qormaata qabaatus dhuma irratti salphinaa fi badiisa irraa nama oolcha malee nama hin balleessu
meaning_en: Standing for justice never leads to true ruin; though the righteous may face heated trials, truth shields them from ultimate spiritual or moral destruction

proverb: Nama jibban illee, haqa hin jibbani
meaning_om: Jibbansi dhuunfaa murtii fi haqa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu hin qabu; diinaaf illee murtii sirrii fi qajeelaa kennuun safuu bu'uuraati
meaning_en: Even if you despise a person, never despise the justice due to them; personal enmity must never corrupt impartial fairness and righteous judgment

proverb: "Saneen" sanumaa, ijji shumburaa lamuma
meaning_om: Wanti bu'uuraan beekamu tokko bifa jijjiirratee yoo dhufe illee amalli isaa hin jijjiiramu; dhugaan uumamaa akkuma jirutitti hafa
meaning_en: 'It is the very same old stock'; a chickpea has only two indentations; no matter how one dresses up reality, fundamental nature remains unalterably identical

proverb: Dhugaa malee kijibni hin moone, abbaa malee ilmi hin moone
meaning_om: Akkuma ilmi ulfinaa fi guddina abbaa dura hin dabre, sobniis yoomiyyuu dhugaa injifachuu hin danda'u; dhugaatu hundarra caala
meaning_en: Falsehood has never triumphed over truth, just as a son cannot usurp or precede his father; truth and paternal roots hold timeless supremacy

proverb: Dhugaan waan lubbuu qabuu jedhe Dooyyo
meaning_om: Dhugaan akkuma qaama lubbuu qabuutti sochootee ifa baati malee hin duutu; dhugaan yoomiyyuu jiraataadha
meaning_en: 'Truth is an entity that possesses a living soul,' said Dooyyo; truth is an active, vibrant force that cannot be killed or buried permanently

proverb: Aduu fi adiin hin dhukattu
meaning_om: Akkuma ifti aduu dhokachuu hin dandeenye, dhugaan qulqulluun fi namni haqaa qabus ifatti mul'ata malee hin dukkanaa'u
meaning_en: Neither the sun nor that which is pure white can ever be shrouded in darkness; absolute truth and pure virtue shine unmistakably bright

proverb: Namni dhugaan du'e akka jiru fakkaata
meaning_om: Namni haqaaf wareegame maqaa gaarii fi seenaa bara baraatiin yaadatama; gootummaan dhugaa du'a boodas jiraata
meaning_en: One who died in the service of truth lives on as though still breathing; moral martyrs for justice attain eternal life through indelible honor and legacy

proverb: Kijibni akka dukkanaati, dhugaan akka daawwitiiti
meaning_om: Sobni wanta hunda marsee nama jaamsa, dhugaan garuu akkuma daawwitii qulqulluu hanqinaa fi miidhagina ifatti mul'isa
meaning_en: Falsehood is like blinding darkness; truth is like an unblemished mirror; deceit obscures and confuses, while truth reflects reality with flawless clarity

proverb: "Sobni dhume" jette, tumtuun kasala fixxee
meaning_om: Namni wanta ittiin nama gowwoomsu yookaan meeshaa sobaa dhabe yeroo qullaa hafu akka waan qulqulluu ta'etti fakkeessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'The deceit has ended,' said the smith upon running out of charcoal; mocks someone claiming moral reform only because their means of cheating ran dry

proverb: Dhugaa dubbatan waaqaatu jaalata, harka dhiqatan garaatu jaalata
meaning_om: Qulqullinni afaanii (dhugaan) Waaqayyo biratti eebbifamaadha; akkuma qulqullinni qaamaa fayyaa garaaf tolu, dhugaanis jireenya miidhagsa
meaning_en: Speaking truth pleases God, just as washing one's hands pleases the stomach; moral cleanliness delights heaven as physical hygiene nurtures health

proverb: Ciisomni dubbii na dhoowwe, dhugaan callisuu na dhoowwe
meaning_om: Nagaaf jedhanii callisuun madaalawaa ta'us, dhugaan jirtu garuu dantaa dhabuu dhowwitee nama dubbachiisti; falmii qalbii agarsiisa
meaning_en: The desire for peaceful settlement forbade me to argue, yet truth forbade me to keep silent; captures the moral struggle between diplomatic peace and vocalizing truth

proverb: Ijji baddu imimmaan hin badu
meaning_om: Qaamni yookaan qabeenyi yoo dhabameluu, gaddi, miiraa fi miidhaan keessoo itti fufa; rakkina walirraa hin cinne ibsa
meaning_en: Even if the physical eye is lost to blindness, tears still flow; material deprivation or physical mutilation cannot extinguish human grief and sorrow

proverb: Garaan kaasaa (dhukkubu) hin raffisu, dhugaan hin callisiisu
meaning_om: Akkuma dhukkubni garaa hirriiba nama dhowwatu, dhugaa beekuunii fi qalbii qabaachuunis wanta dabaa ilaaluun callisanii taa'uu nama dhowwa
meaning_en: A churning, aching stomach permits no sleep; righteous truth allows no silence; a conscience burdened by truth cannot remain passively quiet before injustice

proverb: Hamma dhugaan dhufutti, sobni barcumaara teessi
meaning_om: Dhugaan ifa baatee murtii hanga argatutti, yeroof sobni aangoo fi iddoo kabajamaa qabattee boonuun ishee hin oolu; garuu kan yerooti
meaning_en: While truth is on its way, falsehood sits comfortably upon the throne; a lie can travel round the world and usurp honor while truth is putting on its shoes

proverb: Kijiba baranaa mannaa, dhugaa bar hegeree wayya
meaning_om: Bu'aa yeroo gabaabaa sobaan argamurra, haqa fi milkaa'ina qulqulluu yeroodhaan booda dhufu obsaan eeggachuutu kabaja qaba
meaning_en: Better to wait for next year's honest truth than to profit from this year's quick lie; delayed integrity brings lasting honor over instant, corrupt gains

proverb: Dhugaa dubbatanii, lafa aduun namatti lixe bulan
meaning_om: Dhugaa fi haqa dubbachuuf jecha salphinaa fi baqannaa yoo fidellee hin sodaatinaa; dhugaa qabatanii bakka argametti buluutu ulfina
meaning_en: Speak the truth fearlessly, and be ready to spend the night wherever the setting sun catches you; endure exile or homelessness rather than betraying truth

proverb: Dhugaan ganama badde, galgala galti
meaning_om: Dhugaan yeroo gabaabaaf ganama yoo dhokatteyyuu, guyyaan osoo hin dhihin galgala ifatti baatee gara qe'eetti deebi'uun ishee hin hafu
meaning_en: Truth that went missing in the morning returns home safely by evening; temporary confusion or concealment cannot prevent truth's inevitable homecoming

proverb: Hidda mukaa lolaatu (bishaan) baasaa, hidda dubbii dhugaatu baasa
meaning_om: Akkuma lolaan bishaanii biyyee dhiqee hundee mukaa mul'isu, dhugaanis shiraa fi soba qulqulleessee hundee dubbichaa ifatti baasa
meaning_en: Just as rushing floodwaters wash away topsoil to expose tree roots, uncompromising truth strips away deceit to lay bare the deepest roots of a dispute

proverb: Rabbiin dhugaarraa karra bane
meaning_om: Waaqayyo dhugaa fi haqaaf karaa fi eegumsa banaa godheera; dhugaan gufuu kamuu cabsitee milkii fi injifannoo argatti
meaning_en: God has thrown open the grand gateway for truth; divine order guarantees an open pathway for justice that no human barrier can close

proverb: Dhugaan boru bariiti
meaning_om: Dhugaan abdii gara fuulduraati; akkuma boriin ifa fidu dhugaanis dukkana sobaa dhabamsiisee iftoomina bara baraa fida
meaning_en: Truth is tomorrow's certain dawn; no matter how pitch-black today's injustice may feel, truth arrives with the inevitable brilliance of sunrise

proverb: Abbaaf dhugaa dha, waan nyaatu dhabe, aayyoof dhugaa dha waan kennitu dhabde
meaning_om: Rakkina diinagdee keessatti gama lamaaniiyyuu sababa qabatamaa fi haqa qabaachuu; wal komachuun furmaata akka hin taane ibsa
meaning_en: It is the plain truth for the father, he found no food; and it is truth for the mother, she had nothing to serve; recognizes mutual, tragic helplessness in poverty

proverb: Dhugaan diirama huqqattee galgala gabbatti, Dharti diirama gabbatteeti galgala huqqatti
meaning_om: Dhugaan jalqaba irratti laaftuu fi dadhabduu fakkaatus boodarra jabaatti; sobni ammoo jalqabarratti boonee dhuma irratti kufa
meaning_en: Truth is lean and frail in the morning but fattens by evening; falsehood struts plump in the morning but is withered by dusk; the arc of justice

proverb: Namni waan arge dubbata
meaning_om: Ragaan dhugaa wanta ijaan argame qofaadha; namni qajeelaan oduu namaa osoo hin taane waan qabatamaan arge ragaa baha
meaning_en: A person speaks of what his own eyes have witnessed; reliable speech and credible testimony are grounded strictly in firsthand eyewitness evidence

proverb: Dhugaa, waaqa hin dhoksani
meaning_om: Waaqayyo wanta hundumaa waan beekuuf, cubbuu fi soba dhoksuun hin danda'amu; qulqullummaa fi amanamummaa qabaachuun dirqama
meaning_en: From God, truth can never be concealed; divine omniscience sees into all hidden chambers; human attempts at holy deceit are utterly futile

proverb: Haqni bakka hin wallaalu
meaning_om: Haqni akkuma nama qalbii qabuutti daandii isaa sirriitti beeka; yeroo dheerateyyuu bakka sirrii fi nama isaaf malu bira ni gaha
