meaning_en: Justice never forgets its address or loses its bearings; truth possesses an infallible compass that unfailingly guides it to its righteous mark

proverb: Dhugaan habbuuqan ni hadhaawa, liqimsan ni mi'aawa
meaning_om: Dhugaa dura fudhachuun ulfaataa fi hadhaawaa ta'us, erga qalbiin amantanii fudhatanii booda nagaa fi boqonnaa mi'aawaa namaaf kenna
meaning_en: Truth is bitter while swished in the mouth, but sweet once swallowed; accepting hard facts hurts initially, but produces deep, lasting peace once digested

proverb: Miciirratan, bifa jijjiirratani
meaning_om: Namni jireenya keessatti qorumsa, dafqaa fi tattaaffii cimaa keessa darbu qofa jireenya isaa jijjiiree milkaa'ina fi bifaa haaraa gonfachuu danda'a
meaning_en: Only through rigorous exertion, trials, and enduring pressure does one transform one's condition and appearance; true transformation requires enduring hardship

proverb: Darbatan gabbatani
meaning_om: Qabeenya yookaan yaada ofii arjummaadhaan ormaaf yoo gumaachanii fi dabarsanii kennan, deebi'ee barakaa fi badhaadhina guddaa namaaf fida
meaning_en: By sharing, investing, and casting away possessions generously, one ultimately prospers and flourishes; selfless generosity multiplies returns

proverb: Takka liqimsaatu, balaa dhidhimsa
meaning_om: Yeroo aarii fi mufannaan dhufe aarii sana yeruma tokko garaatti liqimsanii obsuun balaa fi lola guddaa dhalachuuf ture dhabamsiisa
meaning_en: A single swallow sinks a looming disaster into the depths; swallowing one's anger or pride for a brief moment averts catastrophic conflict and bloodshed

proverb: Waan nama gabbisaa hin beekani
meaning_om: Nama tokkoof kan milkaa'ina, fayyaa fi boqonnaa fidu wanta inni hawwu qofa osoo hin taane waan hin yaadamne ta'uu danda'a; carraan dhokataadha
meaning_en: One never truly knows what will nourish and elevate a person; true life breakthroughs often emerge from unexpected circumstances or modest opportunities

proverb: Garaa fi harreen ba'a jaalatti
meaning_om: Garaan akkuma harree ba'aa hin nuffineetti yeroo hundumaa nyaata dabalataa barbaada; bololli garaa fi fedhiin qaamaa hin quufu
meaning_en: The belly and the donkey both love a heavy pack; physical appetite is as insatiable as a donkey that endlessly bears cargo, always demanding more

proverb: Liqimsaa guddinaa hin quufani
meaning_om: Wanta tokko yeroo tokkotti humnaan liqimsuun nama hin quubsu; jireenyi fi badhaadhinni suutuma suuta madaallii qabaatee kan dhufuudha
meaning_en: One is not satisfied by the mere largeness of a single mouthful; true satiety and lasting success come from steady, patient nourishment rather than frantic gulps

proverb: Galaanaatu walitti yaa'a malee, garaan walitti hin yaa'u
meaning_om: Bishaan laggeenii salphaatti walitti makamee tokko ta'uu danda'a, garuu qalbii fi yaada namootaa walitti fiduun baay'ee ulfaataadha
meaning_en: Rivers effortlessly merge into a single stream, but human hearts do not blend so easily; human nature is characterized by deep individuality and conflicting desires

proverb: Masluufni, hangam masluufa tahu, nyaata hin hifatu
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya isaa hunda qisaasee fixu illee fedhii garaa fi nyaata isaatiif dadhabbii hin qabu; fedhiin qoonqoo hin dhumatu
meaning_en: However careless a spendthrift may be with resources, he never grows weary of eating; even the most ruined squanderers retain an active appetite

proverb: Haraaraan qoonqoo hin dhumtu
meaning_om: Fedhiin foonii fi dharraan nyaataa hanga lubbuun jirtutti yeroo hunda haaroma malee gonkumaa hin dhumatu; of to'achuu barsiisa
meaning_en: The craving of the throat never expires; physical appetite renews itself endlessly day after day, requiring continuous moral self-control

proverb: Jaarsaa fi qanqalloon, guutu malee hin dhaabbatani
meaning_om: Akkuma qanqalloon qullaa dhaabbachuu hin dandeenye, maanguddoonis soorata gaarii fi kunuunsa yoo dhabe humna dhabee kufa; kunuunsa maanguddootaa barsiisa
meaning_en: An elder and a leather grain sack cannot stand upright unless filled; frail elders collapse without warm nourishment and attentive care

proverb: Bismilla jennee nyaannee, bismillaa malees nyaannee waanuna wayyaatu nama quubsa
meaning_om: Jecha afaanii fi fakkeessummaa qofaan osoo hin taane, wanti jireenyaaf bu'aa qabeessa ta'e qulqullinaa fi qabatamummaa qabaachuu qaba
meaning_en: Whether we ate invoking blessings or ate without it, only substance that is genuinely wholesome satisfies; practical quality matters more than verbal formulas

proverb: Waraabessi hamma qoonqoo isatiif fiigu, lubbu isaatiif hin fiigu
meaning_om: Namni bololaa fi danta-qabeessi fedhii dhuunfaa fi faayidaa argachuuf kan inni dhama'u, balaa ofirraa ittisuuf kan inni yaalu caala; bololli ija jaamsa
meaning_en: The hyena does not run as desperately for its own life as it runs for its appetite; insatiable greed drives predators to exert far more frenzy than self-defense

proverb: Namni waa nyaatu, waan isa nyaatu hin argu
meaning_om: Namni gammachuu fi faayidaa yerootti booji'ame balaa fi shira isa duubaan isa dhabamsiisaa jiru arguuf qalbii dhaba; dammaqina dhabuu akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: One indulging in a feast does not see what is devouring him from behind; consumed by momentary pleasure, people remain oblivious to looming ruin

proverb: Waraabessi foon hin fe'atu
meaning_om: Namni amalli isaa bolola ta'e wanta argate yeruma sana nyaatee fixa malee boriif hin qusatu; diinni qabeenya qabu hunda dhabamsiisa
meaning_en: A hyena does not pack meat for later transport; an insatiable predator devours everything on the spot without conserving; hoarders of vice cannot save

proverb: Midhaan namatti mi'aawu afaan namaa keessa hin turu
meaning_om: Wanti baay'ee gaarii fi jaalatamaa ta'e yeroo gabaabaa keessatti dhumata; qananiin daftee liqimfamti waan ta'eef eeggannoon barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: Food that tastes truly delicious does not stay long in the mouth; delightful experiences and precious goods are consumed swiftly and vanish fast

proverb: "Maaliif walitti qabamtan" Jennaan "Wajji dhalootaatu walitti nu fide" jette, "maaliif gamaa gamana laaltan "jennaan "garaatu bakka takka nu hin jire" jette, Allaattiin
meaning_om: Namoonni sanyii fi dhiigaan tokko ta'anis, fedhii fi dantaa dhuunfaatiin gara adda addaatti ilaalu; tokkummaan firaa loogii dantaatiin qoroma
meaning_en: When asked why they flock together, the vultures cited shared kinship; when asked why they look in opposite directions, they replied that each has its own belly; shared roots coexist with individual self-interest

proverb: Hunqaan gaafa beelaa fi qoriin gaafa quufaa adda adda
meaning_om: Gargaarsi yeroo rakkinaa fi beelaatti namaaf godhamu gatii guddaa qaba; yeroo quufaa wanti guddaanuu akka yeroo beelaatti nama hin gammachiisu
meaning_en: A tiny handful of grain during famine and an overflowing wooden bowl in times of plenty are worlds apart; assistance during acute crisis holds immense value

proverb: Garaachi sodaa hin qabu
meaning_om: Beellii fi fedhiin garaa daangaa fi sodaa hundumaa cabsee nama deemsisa; namni beela'e balaa sodaachisaa keessa illee ni seena
meaning_en: The stomach knows no fear; agonizing hunger forces a person to brave mortal terrors and cast aside caution to secure sustenance

proverb: Bilchaatu kunuu nu gaya, bilchaatu baatu kunuu nurraa bula
meaning_om: Wanta harkaa qabanitti quufuu fi haala jiru obsaan fudhachuun jireenya tasgabbeessa; waan argametti galateeffachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: If it cooks, this suffices us; if it fails to cook, it will keep till morning; serene contentment that accepts whatever outcome with equanimity

proverb: Ilmoon buutii buutii dha
meaning_om: Diinni yookaan namni amala badaa qabu ilmoon isaas amalummaasaa dhaaluun summii fi miidhaa fida; hundeen hamaan firii hamaa dhalcha
meaning_en: The offspring of a viper is a viper; wickedness, venom, and hostility are inherited; do not expect gentle virtue from the brood of an enemy

proverb: Shanyii ibiddaa, daaraatu nama guba
meaning_om: Wanta humnaa fi balaa qabu keessaa wanti xiqqoon hafe illee miidhaa geessisuu danda'a; sanyiin jabaa yoomiyyuu hin tuffatamu
meaning_en: Offspring of fire: even the remaining ashes will burn you; the legacy or descendants of formidable power retain dangerous heat and must not be trifled with

proverb: Hoolaa, garaa keysi re'ee dha
meaning_om: Namni alaan garraamii fi tasgabbaa'aa fakkaatu keessoo isaatti amala lolaa, jal'aa fi dheekkamaa qabaachuu danda'a; bifa alaan gowwoomuu dhowwa
meaning_en: The gentle sheep carries a frisky goat inside its belly; someone who appears outwardly docile and mild often harbors a stubborn, fiery temper within

proverb: Abbaan harree ilmoon hoo?
meaning_om: Maatiin yookaan abbaan amala badaa fi gowwummaa qabaannaan, ilmoonis akkuma abbaa ishee taati malee wanta addaa hin taatu
meaning_en: If the sire is a donkey, what can you expect of the offspring?; like father, like son; do not expect refined nobility from the foal of an ass

proverb: Haadha arkan malee, intala gad hin dhiisan
meaning_om: Bultii fi fuudha keessatti amala intalaa baruuf dursa haadha qorachuun barbaachisaadha; akkasumas kabajni haadhaa eegamuu qaba
meaning_en: Unless the mother is formally seen and consulted, the daughter is not given away; assessing the mother's character is vital in betrothal

proverb: Ilmoon raachaa, osoo fiigiinsa hin barre, utaalcha barti
meaning_om: Amalli uumamaa fi sanyiin dhalootaan nama keessa jiru osoo hin baratin ofumaan mul'ata; hundeen namaa adeemsa namaa murteessa
meaning_en: The young frog learns to leap before it ever learns to run; innate instinct and ancestral traits manifest spontaneously without formal training

proverb: Ilmoo googarrii'rraa, waan gaara keeysaa hin dhaban
meaning_om: Namni hundee fi naannoo dhaloota isaa irraa hin fagaatu; amalli fi haalli bakka guddinaa yeroo hunda nama keessatti mul'ata
meaning_en: From the chicks of the wild francolin, wilderness habits are never absent; an individual's native origins and roots remain stamped on their behavior

proverb: Haragni, lafaa ka'uurraa muka qabata
meaning_om: Namni hirkataa ta'e jalqabuma irraa of danda'uu dhabee nama biraatti hirkachuu amaleeffata; hirkattummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: A creeping vine clings to a tree from the moment it rises off the dirt; some individuals are constitutionally dependent and lean on others

proverb: Xiqqaattullee, ilmoon qeeyransaa buburree hin dhabdu
meaning_om: Gootummaan, amalli fi dandeettiin sanyii cimaa ijoollummaa irraa kaasee mallattoon isaa ni mul'ata; hundeen gaariin xiqqeenyatti beekama
meaning_en: However tiny, a leopard's cub never lacks its spots; innate excellence, nobility, and courage are visibly stamped on great offspring from early youth

proverb: Ilma bineensaa, faanti gara mukaa
meaning_om: Namni kamiinuu bakka uumama isaatti fi gara amala sanyii isaatti harkifama malee gara biraatti hin deemu; hundee ofiitti deebi'uu ibsa
meaning_en: For the young of a forest beast, its tracks inevitably lead back into the deep woods; everyone naturally gravitates back to their ancestral home and ways

proverb: Ilmi eeysymatti mayraa, intalti adaadatti
meaning_om: Dhaloonni fi amalli ijoollee firoota dhiigaa kan akka eessumaa fi adaadaa calaqqisiisa; hariiroo dhiigaa fi dhiibbaa firoomaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: A son naturally takes after his maternal uncle; a daughter leans toward her paternal aunt; traditional kinship observations on inherited temperament

proverb: Muka hundeen mi'aawu, firiin isaa ni mi'aawa
meaning_om: Maatiin, bu'uurri fi qajeelchi ganamaa gaarii taanaan, dhaloonni fi firiin hojii isaatiis qajeelaa fi milkaa'aa ta'a
meaning_en: A tree whose root is sweet bears sweet fruit; noble beginnings, virtuous parenting, and sound foundations inevitably yield good offspring and success

proverb: Cuqun biqi ajaawa, rahaanni biqi urgaawa
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa qabu jalqabuma irraa gocha hamaa agarsiisa; namni qulqulluun immoo daa'imummaa isaatii kaasee arjummaa fi kabajaan beekama
meaning_en: The wild thistle sprouts with a foul stench; sweet basil sprouts with fragrance; human character reveals its true scent from the earliest shoots of youth

proverb: Haadhaatu booraa ilmoon daalattii dha
meaning_om: Ijoolleen amala, bifaa fi haala maatii isaanii hordoftee dhalatti malee wanta addaa hin taatu; hundee fi firii wal fakkaatu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The mother is dun-colored, and the offspring is dusty gray; an offspring naturally mirrors the modest traits, flaws, and color of its mother

proverb: Keeysa keeysaa, adurreen bineensa
meaning_om: Wanti yookaan namni alaan madaqaa fi garraamii fakkaatu keessa isaatti amala uumamaa isa duraanii fi balaa dhokataa qabaata
meaning_en: Deep beneath the surface, the household cat remains a wild beast; someone who appears tame, gentle, and cultivated still harbors raw, primal instincts

proverb: Mucaaniis numa fincaanee, haatiniis ittuma idaate
meaning_om: Balleessaa fi hanqina xiqqoo ijoolleen uumte irratti, maatiin yookaan namni guddaan isa caalaa badii guddaa dabalanii haala mancaasuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The child wet the bed, and the mother added her own waste on top; when a junior commits a small blunder, the elder makes things ten times worse through gross irresponsibility

proverb: Shanyii buqqee, miciraantu hadhaawa
meaning_om: Hundee fi maatii amala badaa qabu keessaa wanti dhalatu hunduu jalqabuma irraa amala summaa'aa fi rakkisaa qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: From a bitter gourd seedline, even the tiny embryo shoot tastes bitter; negative character and toxic tendencies are detectable even in the youngest sprout

proverb: Roobni shankoora mi'eeyseeti, hargeeysa hadheeyse
meaning_om: Carraan yookaan eebbi walfakkaataan namoota hundaaf yoo dhufe illee, akkaataa amala fi qalbii isaaniitti bu'aa garaagaraa calaqqisiisu
meaning_en: The exact same rain sweetens the sugarcane while intensifying the bitterness of the aloe; identical opportunities produce noble virtue in the good and venom in the wicked

proverb: Harreen harrumaa, garaa jalli aduma
meaning_om: Bifa alaa yookaan faaya muraasaan gowwoomuu hin qaban; namni amala gad-aanaa qabu faaya akkamiiyyuu yoo uffate amalli isaa hin jijjiiramu
meaning_en: A donkey is still a donkey, even with a white underbelly; cosmetic patches of color or superficial charm cannot disguise fundamentally coarse character

proverb: Shanyiin, takka malee, lama hin qabdu
meaning_om: Namni hundee, aadaa fi sanyii tokkicha qaba malee amanamummaa fi eenyummaa garaagaraa qabaachuu hin danda'u; qajeelummaa eenyummaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: A seedline is singular; it cannot have two roots; an individual possesses one authentic lineage and identity and cannot live with divided loyalties

proverb: Ani soorettii hin amanu, hamma isheen awwaala keessa waggaa geessutti
meaning_om: Qabeenyi fi haalli namoota sooreeyyii yeroo hunda jijjiiramaa waan ta'eef, waadaa fi amanamummaa isaanii irratti guutummaatti hirkachuun balaa qaba; amantii qorachuun barbaachisa
meaning_en: Wealth and social standing are fickle and fleeting; one should never place blind trust in the promises or loyalty of the rich until final permanence is proven; caution around fickle affluence

proverb: "Boruun si fuudhaan na hin sobin" jette, haftuun
meaning_om: Waadaa sobaa fi abdii bu'uura hin qabneen yeroo namaa gubuun safuu dha; namni wanta qabatamaa fi dhugaa ta'e qofa barbaada
meaning_en: Do not string someone along with false promises of tomorrow; people weary of perpetual delays and demand concrete, honest commitment over evasive hopes

proverb: Garaa ofiituu, wallaalaaf qoricha itti dhugani
meaning_om: Nama ofii fi qaama ofiituu wanti keessa jiru guutummaatti osoo hin beekamin amantiidhaan soorata; jireenyi hundi amantii fi abdii irratti hundaa'a
meaning_en: Even into one's own stomach, one ingests medicine without seeing its internal path; life and survival inherently require faith and trusting the process

proverb: Hiriyaan wal hin amanne, malkaa sagalitti wal kasasti
meaning_om: Michoomni amanamummaa dhabe yeroo hunda shakkiidhaan kan guutame waan ta'eef, bakka hundatti wal falmii fi waldhabdee hin dhumne uuma
meaning_en: Comrades who lack mutual trust end up dragging each other into litigation at every river crossing; absence of trust breeds ceaseless suspicion and conflict

proverb: Hiriyaa wal hin amanne, kakuun amma amma
meaning_om: Bakka amantiin dhugaa hin jirretti namoonni soba dhoksuuf irra deddeebi'anii kakatu; kakuu baay'isuun mallattoo amantii dhabuuti
meaning_en: Between companions who fundamentally distrust each other, oaths must be sworn incessantly; excessive oath-taking is the clearest symptom of broken trust

proverb: Haati hattuun, ilmoo isii hin amantu
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatii amala badaa fi shira qabu namni hunduu akkasaatti waan hamaa hojjeta jedhee waan yaaduuf nama kamiinuu hin amanu
meaning_en: A thieving mother does not trust her own child; corrupt, dishonest people project their own vices onto everyone else and can never trust even their kin

proverb: Jeedalloon nama gabaabaa fi nama barate hin amaninaa jette
meaning_om: Namoota gamnummaa fi mala addaa qaban irraa of eeggachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu qishnaadhaan ibsa; beekumsa fi haaxummaa amanuu dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Trust neither a short person nor an educated one,' said the jackal; folk satire counseling caution around those with sharp wits, intellectual tools, or hidden resourcefulness

proverb: Kooraa irratti bahu malee, heerumuu koo hin amanu jette haftuun
meaning_om: Wanti tokko qabatamaan harka nama gahee xumura hin argetti waadaa fi haasaa afaaniitiin amanuun akka hin danda'amne agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Until I am physically mounted on the horse's saddle, I will not believe I am truly wed,' said the spinster; do not trust verbal promises until the deed is sealed

proverb: Namni kijiba irratti wal tahe, dhugaa irratti adda baha
meaning_om: Hariiroo fi tokkummaan soba irratti ijaarame bu'uura hin qabu; gaafa dhugaan dhuftu shakkii fi walitti bu'iinsaan ni diigama
meaning_en: Those who banded together upon a lie will scatter when confronted with the truth; corrupt alliances forged in deceit shatter the moment facts emerge

proverb: Niitiin dhiirsaa wajji nyaachuu didde, takkaa nyaatteeti garaa qabdi, takkaa kaayatteeti lafaa qabdi
meaning_om: Namni tola yookaan qooda dhihaateef didu sababa dhokataa qaba; deeggarsa dhowwachuun faayidaa dhokataa qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A wife who refuses to dine with her husband either has a full belly from secret snacking, or has stashed a private portion away; uncooperativeness conceals hidden options

proverb: "Ogeessi heddummaatee, ani madaa tana hin fayyu" je'e, jaldeessi
meaning_om: Hojiin yookaan rakkoon tokko yoo abbaa baay'ate furmaata dhabee manca'a; ogeeyyiin garmalee baay'achuun hojii fashaleessa
meaning_en: 'With too many healers fussing over it, I will never recover from this sore,' said the baboon; too many cooks spoil the broth; excessive meddling prevents resolution

proverb: Sa'a toora qarree oolu, maqaan isaa "arruma galee" dha
meaning_om: Namni yeroo hundumaa bakka balaan jiru naannawu jireenyi isaa yaaddoo fi shakkii keessaa hin ba'u; balaatti dhihaachuun kasaaraa fida
meaning_en: A cow that grazes along the edge of the cliff is named 'Did it make it back today?'; living perpetually on the brink of disaster invites tragic ruin

proverb: turu na hin eeginaa, dhaamsa tiiticha
meaning_om: Wanti yeroo gabaabaa qabu yookaan bakka amansiisaa hin taane dafee darba; jireenyi namaas yeroodhaaf qofa akka ta'e yaadachiisa
meaning_en: 'Do not count on my long stay,' is the farewell message of the fly; emphasizes brevity, fragile transience, and swift departure from dangerous perches

proverb: Wal barre malee, wal hin agarre
meaning_om: Namoonni yeroo dheeraa waliin turanis amala dhugaa fi iccitii walii hubachuu dhabuu danda'u; wal baruun qaamaa kan qalbii hin ta'u
meaning_en: We grew accustomed to each other, yet never truly perceived each other; superficial familiarity often blinds people to the authentic soul within

proverb: "Daddaftee na dhungatte, waa fira kiyyaa mitii" jette, intalti
meaning_om: Namni osoo kabaja fi seera hin eegin dantaa fi fedhii dhuunfaatiif jarjaru jaalala dhugaa osoo hin taane faayidaa barbaaduu isaa saaxila
meaning_en: 'You rushed to kiss me with frantic haste, you are certainly no true kin of mine,' said the maiden; premature physical intimacy betrays selfish lust rather than respect

proverb: Aayyadaa dhiisii, foon ifiituu hin amanin
meaning_om: Balaa fi qorumsi nama dhiyoo irraayyuu dhufuu waan danda'uuf, of eeggannoo guutuu qabaachuu qabu malee namatti garmalee hirkachuun balaadha
meaning_en: Never mind stepmothers; do not place absolute trust even in your own flesh; practice vigilant self-reliance, for even our own bodies and blood can fail us

proverb: Tiitichi "niitiin heerumii dhaammadhaa manaa bahaa" je'e
meaning_om: Bakki itti deeman yookaan hojiin seenan balaa lubbuu kan qabu ta'uu beekanii qophii dhumaa gochuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'Advise my wife to remarry, for I am flying out of the house,' said the fly; venturing into environments of such lethal danger that return is virtually hopeless

proverb: "Ala kanaa anuma himani"  je'e, waraabeysi
meaning_om: Namni amala badaadhaan beekamu bakka hundaatti maqaan isaa akka ka'u beeka; yakka ofiitiif qaanfii dhabuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Throughout this entire wilderness, it is always me they talk about,' said the hyena; the notorious villain proudly assumes that every alert or story revolves around his crimes

proverb: Abbaa fi ilma hangafaatu, haadhaa wajji deema
meaning_om: Maatii keessatti itti gaafatamummaa fi eegumsa bu'uuraa kan qaban abbaa fi ilma hangafaati; isaan lamaan utubaa maatiiti
meaning_en: In a traditional household, the father and the firstborn son bear primary responsibility and custody over the mother and domestic welfare; pillars of family leadership

proverb: "Abbaan kee eenyu" jennaan, "aayyoon tiyya farda" jette gaangeen
meaning_om: Namni hundee hiyyeessa yookaan salphaa qabu dhoksuuf jedhee gara fira sooressaa fi kabajamaatti qofa of hirkisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: When asked about its father, the mule bragged that its mother is a horse; satirizes ashamed people who conceal modest paternal roots while boasting of prestigious maternal ties

proverb: "Abbaan kee maal dalaga" jennaan, "dachii baqayxe hodha" jette
meaning_om: Hojii uumamaan hin danda'amne fi bu'aa hin qabne akka waan guddaatti odeessanii of jajuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: When asked about her father's trade, she claimed he stitches up cracked earth; mocks inventing absurd, impossible occupations to disguise uselessness or lack of work

proverb: Aduunyaan sagalii, waa kudhanii miti
meaning_om: Addunyaa kanarratti wanti hundi guutuu miti; jireenyi namaa yeroo hundumaa hanqina muraasa qabaata malee gonkumaa hin guuttamu
meaning_en: The world is nine, it is never ten; worldly existence is inherently imperfect and incomplete; perfection and absolute fullness belong to God alone

proverb: Afaan baalagee, hanga qarbataati bal'ata
meaning_om: Namni adabaa fi safeeffannaa hin qabne waan afaaniin baasu hin to'atu; arrabni isaa daangaa malee nama arrabsa
meaning_en: The mouth of a vulgar boor is as wide and undisciplined as an inflated leather water-skin; uncouth individuals speak with reckless, wounding vulgarity

proverb: Afaan dubbii bare bulluqa alanfata
meaning_om: Namni araada dubbii fi falmii qabu wanta isa gubu fi isa miidhu illee osoo hin eeggatin dubbachuuf kaata; arraba to'achuu dadhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A mouth addicted to talking will even chew scalding porridge; compulsive talkers are so desperate to speak that they blurt out things to their own injury

proverb: Alaa ni boonaa, manaa ni booya
meaning_om: Namni alatti akka sooressaatti of jaju mana isaatti beelaa fi dhiphina hamaa keessa jiraachuu qishnaadhaan saaxila; fakeessummaa jireenyaa ibsa
meaning_en: Outdoors he struts in haughty pride, while inside his home he weeps in misery; satirizes putting on an opulent public facade while living in secret destitution

proverb: Alaa rarra'a, manaa manca'a
meaning_om: Namni alatti of bareechee mul'atu qe'een isaa fi bultiin isaa garuu kan diigame ta'uu agarsiisa; bifa alaan gowwoomuu dhowwa
meaning_en: Outside he displays flashy adornments, while at home his foundation is in ruins; critiques individuals who invest in outward show while neglecting their core home

proverb: Alaa kopheen ciiq ciiq, manaa garaan cir cir
meaning_om: Uffannaa fi faaya alaa bitachuuf jedhanii wanta lubbuuf barbaachisu dhabanii beela'uu ceepha'a; dursa dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: Outside his fine leather shoes squeak proudly, while at home his starved belly churns in pain; mocks prioritizing stylish shoes over daily nourishment

proverb: Ala silaa dubbii ni beekaa, irra deddeebi'uuni balleessa
meaning_om: Namni ergaa gaarii qabaatuyyuu dubbii irra deddeebisee dheeressuun kabaja dhabsiisa; gabaabbinaan dubbachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: He possesses good oratorical skill, but spoils his speech through tedious, endless repetition; unmeasured verbosity ruins good points

proverb: Allaattii laga buute ta raachaa raaw'atte
meaning_om: Yeroo diinni cimaan naannoo namaatti dhufe dadhaboonni dafanii miidhaaf saaxilamu; humna guddaa dura baqachuun dirqama
meaning_en: When the bird of prey swoops down upon the river, the doomed frog's business is finished; the arrival of a predator seals the fate of the vulnerable

proverb: Anaa magani, farda kee albaatii laali
meaning_om: Dhimma ormaatiin qabamuu dhiisii dura qabeenyaa fi rakkoo manaa keetii isa manca'aa jiru qoradhu; of eeggannoo maatii dursuu
meaning_en: Spare me your pious talk; go inspect your own horse's diarrhea!; stop meddling in other people's affairs when your own assets are collapsing

proverb: Ayliin ganda keessan amma dhufte, ganda keenya sagal bulte
meaning_om: Beekumsi ati haarawa seete nutti himuuf kaate durumaan kan bira dabarree fi kan beeknudha; beekumsa ormaa salphisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The knowledge that just dawned upon your village spent nine nights in ours; you are enthusiastically preaching what we mastered long ago

proverb: Baalagummaan dhukkuba gaaffii hin qabne
meaning_om: Amala badaa, naamus-dhablummaa fi safeeffannaa dhabuun dhibee cimaa hawaasa jeequudha; safuu dhabuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Insolence and boorishness are an undisputed pathology; being uncouth and devoid of moral decency is a destructive behavioral disease

proverb: "Bada tan gabbaartii harree" jennaan, "gabbaartii sanuu warra keenyaatu itti wal tahe" jette intalti
meaning_om: Wanta ormi tuffatu illee yoo ta'e waliigaltee fi nagaan maatii waldanda'ee jiraachuun salphina ormaa caala; nagaa maatii dursuu
meaning_en: When mocked that her dowry was only a donkey, the maiden replied that her families were united upon it; domestic accord surpasses outside prestige

proverb: Bakka dubri lafa guutetti, dullumti na qabde jedhe jaarsi
meaning_om: Carraan fi bareedinni osoo naannoo jiruu humnaa fi umuriin dhabamuun gaabbii fida; carraatti yeroon fayyadamuu dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Where maidens crowd the land, infirm old age has seized me,' lamented the old man; grieving the arrival of abundant opportunity after one's prime has passed

proverb: Bakka dhiirri hin jirretti, darasaa ragaa tahi jette dubri
meaning_om: Bakka namni cimaa fi dhimma sanaaf ta'u dhabametti wantuma argame bakka buufatanii dhimma geggeeffachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: In the absence of experienced men, the maiden called the timid student as witness; settling for whatever makeshift substitute is available

proverb: Ballaan mana gubeeti, ifee illaali jedhe
meaning_om: Wanta bu'uuraa barbadeessanii faayidaa yeroo gabaabaaf jedhanii gammaduu ceepha'a; gowwummaa fi of-balleessuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: The blind man burned down his house and said, 'Watch how it illuminates!'; satirizes destroying one's indispensable shelter for an outcome one cannot even enjoy

proverb: Ballaan walitti boo'u, ija wal hin argu
meaning_om: Namoonni rakkinaa fi dhabamuu walfakkaataa qaban gadda walii qooddachuuf yaalanis wal gargaaruuf humna hin qaban; dhiphina waloo ibsa
meaning_en: When blind men weep together, neither can see the tears of the other; mutual sympathy among the completely helpless cannot produce practical relief

proverb: Baraatu badee sangaa na hachisiise jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Rakkoo fi hiyyummaa yerootti sababeeffatanii gocha seeraan alaa fi hanna raawwachuu ceepha'a; balleessaa ofii yeroorratti fe'uu dhowwa
meaning_en: 'The times turned so wretched they made me steal an ox,' said the man; critiques blaming economic hardship to excuse blatant moral corruption and crime

proverb: Baraatu beeka jedhe, Gurmuu Masqalee lafa gurgure
meaning_om: Egeree osoo hin yaadin qabeenya bu'uuraa fi lafa ofii gurguranii qisaasessuu ceepha'a; maqaa jijjiiramaatiin qe'ee balleessuu dhowwa
meaning_en: 'The modern era knows best,' said Gurmu Masqale, and sold off his ancestral land; condemns parting with permanent ancestral heritage for fleeting cash

proverb: Beekaan galgala dhufa
meaning_om: Namni qalbii fi ogummaa qabu dubbii fi falmii hin jarjarsu; erga hundi tasgabbaa'ee aariin qabbanaa'ee booda fala fida
meaning_en: The truly wise mediator arrives by evening; wise minds do not rush into daytime shouting; they wait until passions cool to deliver durable solutions

proverb: Bishaan ni maraate jedheeti bulluqa dhuge
meaning_om: Wanta balaa qabu akka waan qorichaatti fudhatanii of miidhuu; sababa bu'uura hin qabneen balaatti seenuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Declaring that the water has gone crazy, he drank boiling water; making absurd rationalizations to plunge headlong into self-destructive behavior

proverb: Bishaan gadi deemuun hin dhibu, ol deebi'uu malee
meaning_om: Badiisaa fi kufaatti seenuun baay'ee salphaadha; garuu erga kufee booda deebi'anii sirraa'uunii fi ol ka'uun aarsaa guddaa gaafata
meaning_en: Water flowing downhill encounters no trouble; reversing course uphill is the true ordeal; moral decline is effortless, but climbing back to integrity is grueling

proverb: Boolla ija leenca du'ee, gogorriin bara tokko keessaa dhugdi
meaning_om: Gootni yookaan aangoo-qabeessi yoo kufe, warri dadhaboon isa sodaachaa turan iyyuu irratti roorrisanii itti taphatu
meaning_en: From the empty eye-socket of a fallen lion, the meek partridge drinks for a season; when mighty powers collapse, the lowliest creatures feast on their remains

proverb: Boona malee ijji takkuma
meaning_om: Of tuulummaa fi koora ormaa yoo dhiisan, namummaan fi uumamni hundumaa walqixa; namni uumamaan nama hin caalu
meaning_en: Pompous pride aside, human eyes are physically identical; strip away artificial arrogance, and all mortals share the same vulnerable nature

proverb: Caaccuun warratti galtee, qaraaruu diradhu
meaning_om: Dhimmi fi sirni heeraa erga xumuramee booda murtii dhufe fudhatanii dhiphina jiru obsaan danda'uun dirqama
meaning_en: The sacred Caaccuu emblem has retired home; now gird yourself with bitter patience; once the ritual verdict is sealed, accept the hard reality

proverb: Coqorsaa na qabe jettee hin dubbatin, teephaan si qabaa
meaning_om: Rakkina salphaa fi bu'uura hin qabneef iyyanii dhiphachuu dhiisuu; dhiphinni sobaa balaa isa caalaa cimaa ofitti fida
meaning_en: Do not whine that soft grass has snared you, lest real leather thongs bind you; stop complaining of petty hurdles lest real catastrophe discipline you

proverb: Diddiga garaa dhufe, ilkeen hin deebisu
meaning_om: Dubbii fi dhugaa garaa keessaa ifatti ba'uuf ka'e humnaan ukkaamsanii dhowwuun hin danda'amu; aarii fi dhiphinni ifa baha
meaning_en: Vomit surging from the stomach cannot be stopped by the teeth; deep-seated grievances and burning truths cannot be contained behind closed lips

proverb: "Du'aan dhufaa" jennaan, "bokoku maa didaa" jedhe
meaning_om: Balaa dhumaa kan hin oolle jalaa baqachuun waan hin danda'amneef, wanta mudatu hundumaa obsaan fudhachuuf garaa murachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When told death was coming, he said, 'Why should I refuse to bloat?'; facing absolute, unavoidable doom with dark, fatalistic resignation

proverb: Du'aan nama hin dhabu jiraan nama hin qabu
meaning_om: Duuti yeroo hundumaa nama argatti, garuu namni lubbuun jiru yeroo baay'ee fira dhugaa fi gargaaraa dhabee qofummaan rakkata; dhiphina jireenyaa ibsa
meaning_en: Death never lacks an appointment with humans, yet the living person often lacks a single true companion; life is plagued by lonely isolation

proverb: Dubbii Ala karaarratti fixu, Anniyya kora itti qabata
meaning_om: Gosoonni fi hawaasni adda addaa akkaataa amala, aadaa fi heera isaaniitiin dhimma furu; wanti tokko bakka tokkotti salphaa, kaanitti ulfaataadha
meaning_en: Disputes that the Ala clan settles informally on the roadside, the Anniyya clan convenes a full formal council to debate; cultural differences in mediation

proverb: Dubbii dubbii, yaa dhuufuu qullubbii
meaning_om: Haasaan fi falmiin baay'atee qulqullina dhabe akkuma dhuufuu qullubbiitti nama jibbisiisa, nuffii fida; haasaa bu'aa dhabeessa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Endless, repetitive chatter is like flatulence after eating garlic—foul and utterly unbearable; reproaches exhausting, nauseating arguments

proverb: Dubbii fi murtiin, kan waaqaa caala
meaning_om: Beekumsi, haasaanii fi murtiin namaa kamiinuu murtii fi dhugaa Waaqayyoo gadi; haqni dhugaan kan uumaa bira qofa jira
meaning_en: In legal deliberation and final verdict, God's decree surpasses all human arbitration; divine justice reigns supreme over all mortal courts

proverb: Dubbii dubbii fakkaataa, namaa nama fakkaata
meaning_om: Dubbiin hundi qulqullina hin qabu akkuma namni hundi goota yookaan jabaa hin taane; bifa qofaan osoo hin taane bu'uuraan madaaluu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Words superficially resemble wise speech, just as any body resembles a true human; distinguish hollow rhetoric from wisdom

proverb: Dubbiin, hanga abbaan gahe geessi
meaning_om: Waldhabdeen yookaan falmiin tokko fudhatama kan argatuu fi bakka kan gahu hanguma dandeettii fi murannoo abbaa dhimmaa sanaati
meaning_en: A dispute travels only as far as its champion has the strength and resolve to carry it; the success of a grievance depends on the advocate's stamina

proverb: Dubbiin wallaalaaf na bira kutte jetti malee, beekaati na bira kutte hin jettu
meaning_om: Nama beekaatu dubbii toftaadhaan qoratee hundee ishee fura; gowwaan garuu osoo hin hubatin bira darbee wanta hunda mancaasa
meaning_en: The dispute says, 'an ignorant fool stepped past my core', but never says that of a wise man; the wise untangle disputes while fools bypass the point

proverb: Dubbiin tan joollee fakkaatuu fi tan manguddoo fakkaatuu jira
meaning_om: Haasaan hundi tokko miti; gariin salphaa fi kan qoosaa yoo ta'u, gariin immoo kan bilchinaa fi murtii jabaa of keessaa qabuudha
meaning_en: Speech has two forms: that which resembles frivolous child's babble, and that which carries seasoned elder gravity; distinguish the two

proverb: Dubbatan dubbii lamaa, dhiisan ergarama
meaning_om: Iccitii yookaan mufannaa jiru yoo dubbatan lola fida, yoo garaatti dhiisan immoo qaamaa fi sammuu namaa miidha; qormaata cimaadha
meaning_en: Spoken aloud, it creates double dispute; left unsaid, it festers into agonizing torment; caught in the dilemma between domestic explosion and silent ulcers

proverb: Duudaan gaafa gurra qabu waan dhagaye odeessa
meaning_om: Namni carraa yookaan beekumsa haaraa argate of to'achuu dadhabee wantuma argee fi dhaga'e hunda bakkeetti facaasa; dammaqina dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The deaf man, on the rare day he acquires hearing, broadcasts every single sound he heard; novices gaining new information blab without discretion

proverb: Duuti sheenaa dhabde hin jirtu
meaning_om: Namni kamuu yeroo du'u wanti inni yaade, hawwii fi gaabbiin osoo hin xumuramin hafuun hin oolu; duuti yeroo hunda sheenaa qabdi
meaning_en: There is no death that is devoid of regret; every human departure leaves behind unfinished dreams, unsaid words, and aching remorse

proverb: Dura deeman malee, duubaan hin deemani, yoo du'anii dabran malee
meaning_om: Jireenyi gara fuulduraatti deema malee duubatti hin deebi'u; wanta darbeef yaadda'uu dhiisanii gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachuu qabu
meaning_en: One marches forward, never backward, unless passing into death; life is an irreversible progression toward the future; only corpses are dragged back

proverb: durillee erbe jette tan takkaa jibrii hin qotatin
meaning_om: Wanta bu'uuraa hojjechuu dhiisanii wantuma gad-aanaa fi salphaa ta'e akka waan filannoo ofiitti dhiheessuun qaanii ofii dhoksuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'I've always preferred rawhide rags,' said she who never planted cotton; making sour-grapes excuses for wearing rags when one simply refused to cultivate

proverb: Dhaba'rra jirtii, dhabaneey mana jirti
meaning_om: Osoo beellii fi dhabinsi jiru ka'anii hojjechuu dhiisanii manatti taa'uun hiyyummaa dachaa fida; dhibaa'ummaa yeroo rakkinaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Scarcity stalks the land, yet the shiftless sluggard sits idle at home; idling during a famine compounds poverty into absolute starvation

proverb: Dhabduun, diddu of fakkeessiti
meaning_om: Wanta argachuuf humna fi carraa hin qabne akka waan fedhii ofiitiin didaniitti fakkeessuun qaanii dhokfachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: She who lacks options pretends to be the one refusing; someone denied a prize or rejected pretends they turned it down by personal choice

proverb: Dhabaarraa hin liqeeffatani, kan qaburraa qabsiifatan malee
meaning_om: Nama homaa hin qabne irraa deeggarsa eeguun bu'aa hin qabu; gargaarsi fi mormiin kan argamu nama dandeettii fi qabeenya qabu biraayi
meaning_en: One does not borrow from someone who lacks; from one who has fire, one lights a flame; seek resources and aid from those who possess the means

proverb: Dhiirri dhiirsa hin qabu, kan liqeesseef malee
meaning_om: Dhiirri kamuu bilisa ta'ee jiraatus, namni inni liqii irraa qabu garuu dhiibbaa fi kabaja isa dhabsiisa; liqiin garbummaa akka ta'e ibsa
meaning_en: A free man recognizes no overlord, except the creditor to whom he owes a debt; unpaid debt is the only force that enslaves an independent man

proverb: Dhukkuba lukkuuti gaala hin qalani
meaning_om: Rakkoo xiqqoo fi salphaa ta'eef aarsaa guddaa fi qabeenya qaalii hin qisaasani; madaallii furmaataa eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: For a chicken's passing illness, one does not sacrifice a camel; never expend massive, catastrophic costs to resolve minor, inconsequential ailments

proverb: Dhukkuba karaa deemu, hashare goromsaan bitatte
meaning_om: Balaa ormaa isa nama hin tuqne ofitti waamanii qabeenya guddaa itti dhabuu ceepha'a; dhimma nama hin ilaallanne keessa galuu dhowwa
meaning_en: A passing illness on the highway, she traded a pregnant heifer to contract it; paying an exorbitant price to import unnecessary, toxic trouble into one's life

proverb: Dhungoo goggoyduun, ilmoo namaa hin guddifne
meaning_om: Jecha mi'aawaa fi jaalala afaanii qofaan ijoollee guddifachuun hin danda'amu; soorata, uffataa fi qabeenya qabatamaatu barbaachisa
meaning_en: Dry, empty kisses never reared a child; sentiment and affectionate words alone cannot feed or clothe a dependent; parenting requires tangible provision

proverb: Eenyurra dhaabbattee, eenyu hamatta jette dachiin
meaning_om: Hunduu dachee Waaqayyoo irra jiraachaa nama biraa tuffachuu fi hamachuun safuu dha; hundumtuu uumama tokko ta'uu yaadachiisa
meaning_en: 'Upon whom do you stand while slandering another?', challenged the Earth; human beings all rest upon the same ground; none has the standing to look down on others

proverb: Ergaa hamtuun lola fiddi
meaning_om: Ergamaan dubbii hin dandeenye ergaa jallisee yookaan jecha hadhaawaa itti dabalee lola guddaa dhalcha; ergaa sirriitti dabarsuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A tactless or malicious messenger sparks war; delivering messages with hostility, distortion, or harsh arrogance transforms a simple inquiry into conflict

proverb: Ergaan ergaramaa dha barbaaddi
meaning_om: Namni dhimmaaf ergame dadhabbii, qorra, beelaa fi qormaata karaa obsaan danda'uu qaba; amanamummaa ergaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Running an errand requires enduring hardship and toil; serving as a faithful messenger demands perseverance through fatigue, weather, and hunger

proverb: Fageenyaa hin hafani, yoo wal quufan malee
meaning_om: Fageenyi lafaa jaalalleewwan addaan hin dhowwu; kan walirraa nama hambisu jaalala dhabuu fi wal jibbuu qofaadha
meaning_en: People are never kept apart merely by geographic distance, unless they have grown tired of each other; alienation of the heart is the true divide

proverb: Parda bade, farda jiruun barbaadani
meaning_om: Qabeenya bade yookaan dhimma rakkisaa furuuf wantuma akkasaatti humna qabuun gargaaramu; jabaan jabaa barbaada
meaning_en: A lost horse is tracked down using a living horse; to recover lost assets or solve formidable crises, employ equivalent, vigorous resources

proverb: Fira jettee wal yaamti, qullaa wal dhokfatti
meaning_om: Afaaniin firooma odeessanii qalbii fi iccitii dhugaa garuu wal duraa dhoksuu ceepha'a; firooma sobaa fi amantee dhabuu saaxila
meaning_en: They call one another kin, yet hide their vulnerabilities and nakedness from each other; critiques hollow, superficial kinship that lacks true trust

proverb: Foon ifii hin nyaanne, allaattiif dhiisani
meaning_om: Wanta ofii itti fayyadamuu hin dandeenye nama kaaniif dhiisuu yookaan gatuu; dantaa dhabuu fi qisaasama agarsiisa
meaning_en: Meat that one cannot eat oneself, one abandons to the scavenging birds; discarding what could nourish others simply because one has lost appetite

proverb: Fuudhuun qaanii hin qabu
meaning_om: Sirnaan fuudhanii bultii ijaarrachuun aadaa fi safuu kabajamaadha malee yeelloo hin qabu; gaa'ila jajjabeessa
meaning_en: Taking a spouse in honorable marriage bears no shame; wedlock is a sacred, lawful institution that brings social dignity rather than embarrassment

proverb: Gaafa tolu, ni tottola
meaning_om: Yeroo carraan namaaf dhufe wanti hundi milkaa'ee nagaan namaaf ta'a; yeroo milkii agarsiisa
meaning_en: When fortune turns favorable, every single thing flourishes effortlessly; in seasons of blessing, all enterprises succeed in harmony

proverb: Gaafa na kaaseen, aayyoo gurguraa karra baase
meaning_om: Namni gowwummaa fi bololaan qabame yeroo qabeenya yookaan carraa argatu wanta safuu hunda dagatee maatii ofii iyyuu salphisa
meaning_en: The very day fortune elevated me, I took my own mother to the gate to hawk her for sale; biting satire on instant wealth turning a fool into a monster

proverb: Gabiiba roobee? "jennaan," kan dur roobeefuu harka lafaatti rigata" jedhe
meaning_om: Osoo rakkinaa fi ba'aa duraaniirraa hin bayyanatin wanta haaraa dabalataan yaadda'uu dhiisuu; miidhaan duraa akka hin dhumne ibsa
meaning_en: Asked 'Did the new autumn rain fall?', he replied, 'We are still scrubbing our hands in the mud from the last downpour!'; overwhelmed by previous burdens

proverb: Gabrichi quufe, gonbisaa goftaa dhiita
meaning_om: Namni gadi aanaan yeroo quufee fi carraa argate arjummaa nama isa soore sana dagatee gocha tuffii fi gantummaa raawwata
meaning_en: A servant stuffed with food kicks his master's grain granary; unprincipled subordinates turn arrogant and bite the hand that fed them once satiated

proverb: Gaararraan waan agarte fakkaatti
meaning_om: Namni dhaabbii fi qajeelfama hin qabne akkuma gararraatti bakka dhaqe hundatti amala jijjiirrata; amanamummaa dhabuu saaxila
meaning_en: The chameleon takes on the color of whatever it gazes upon; critiques fickle, unprincipled opportunists who shape-shift to match every crowd

proverb: Gadhee fi baarreen afaan bal'atti
meaning_om: Namni amala hin qabne akkuma meeshaa afaan bal'aatti wanta dhufe hunda afaaniin baasa, daangaa hin qabu; afaan eeggachuu dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A scoundrel and a wide milking pail both have cavernous, gaping mouths; ill-mannered people have no filter and blab endlessly without shame

proverb: Gadheen ofuma ishii dhiira seeti
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii fi naamus-qabeessa hin taane of tuulummaadhaan akka gootaa fi nama guddaatti of lakkaa'a; koora sobaa ibsa
meaning_en: An unprincipled scoundrel imagines himself to be a formidable man; someone lacking virtue, grit, or honor deludes himself into thinking he is a champion

proverb: Galaana laga guute, ta cirrachaa raaw'atte
meaning_om: Balaan yookaan mootummaan cimaan yeroo guutee dhufe wantoonni laafaa fi xixiqqoon salphaatti dhabamu; humna guddaa dura baqachuun dirqama
meaning_en: When the flash flood crests the riverbanks, the gravel's business is finished; when overwhelming forces move, small obstacles are utterly swept away

proverb: Galaanaa fi waraanni gaafa nama hanqisa
meaning_om: Balaawwan gurguddoo akka lolaa fi lola bishaanii karooraa fi imala namaa dhaabsisuun daandii nama duraa cufu; of eeggannoo cimaa barbaadu
meaning_en: A raging flood and sudden warfare derail a traveler on his appointed day; nature's storms and human conflicts brutally disrupt human plans

proverb: Galaanni waan ofii kaa'e, ofumaaf fuudha
meaning_om: Wanti yeroon yookaan carraan namaaf kenne yeroo biraatti deebi'ee fudhatamuu danda'a; qabeenyi addunyaa kan dhaabbataa miti
meaning_en: What the river flood left behind, it eventually sweeps away itself; earthly fortunes deposited by circumstance will inevitably be reclaimed by time

proverb: Ganama ganama aannoleen, waatii isaaniitti mar'atani
meaning_om: Maatiin yeroo hunda ijoollee ofiitiif dhiphata, mararfannaa fi jaalala agarsiisa; jaalalli maatii yeroo hundumaa haaromaa jiraata
meaning_en: Every single morning, milking cows low tenderly for their calves; maternal devotion and family affection are natural, daily renewing rhythms

proverb: Ganamaan bahaniif, waaqa jalaa hin bahani
meaning_om: Hammamiyyuu yoo fiiganii fi carraaqan murtii fi beekumsa Waaqayyoo jalaa miliquun hin danda'amu; qooda uumaa amanuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Though you set out in the earliest dawn, you cannot escape from God; no amount of early haste can step outside divine omniscience and sovereign destiny

proverb: Garatti heexoo dhugii, ilkee dhadhaa dibadhu
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi qorumsa keessoo obsaan danda'aa, orma duratti garuu fuula ifaa fi kabaja qabaadhaa; miira ofii to'achuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Drink bitter medicine into your stomach, but anoint your teeth with butter; endure inner trials with fortitude while showing a dignified, smiling face to the world

proverb: Geeyriin afurtama bulti
meaning_om: Aariin fi haloon dhalate yeroodhuma sana hin dhumatu; hanga qabbanaa'utti yeroo fudhata waan ta'eef of eeggannoo gochuu qabu
meaning_en: A deep grievance lingers for forty days; wounded passions and bitter grudges do not vanish overnight; give tempers time and space to cool

proverb: Geeyriin karaarratti baatu malee, hin dhumtu
meaning_om: Waldhabiinsi dhokatee ture hanga ifatti bahee marii fi seeraan furmaata argatutti nagaa hin buusu; iftoomina barbaada
meaning_en: A smoldering grievance does not conclude until it is brought out into the open; hidden grudges must be aired publicly before genuine peace can be achieved

proverb: Gorsi abbaa dura, faaruun abbaa duuba
meaning_om: Nama yoo gorsan fuulletti itti himuutu tola, yoo faarsan garuu duuba isaatti ta'uutu kabaja qaba malee of-tuulummaa hin fidu
meaning_en: Counsel should be delivered face-to-face; praise should be spoken behind one's back; correct a friend directly, but praise them to others to prevent vanity

proverb: Gowwaatu kan maraatetti kofla
meaning_om: Namni qalbii qabu rakkinaa fi dhibee ormaatti hin kolfu; gowwaan garuu balaa ormaa akka qoosaatti ilaala
meaning_en: It is a fool who laughs at a madman; only someone lacking empathy and self-awareness finds amusement in another human being's tragic mental collapse

proverb: Gowwaa fi xalaayaan, waan qaban gad hin dhiisani
meaning_om: Gowwaan akkuma waraqaa barreeffama baatee jiruutti wantuma qabatee jiru sanatti cicha malee jijjiirama hin beeku; mata-jabinna ceepha'a
meaning_en: A fool and a letter never let go of what they hold; an obstinate simpleton clings stubbornly to whatever opinion he grasped, incapable of nuance or adaptation

proverb: Guddinni nama garii guddina harreeti
meaning_om: Dhaabbanni qaamaa guddaa ta'us sammuu fi qalbii qabaachuu dhabuu ceepha'a; guddinni qaamaa ulfina namaaf hin kennu
meaning_en: The stature of certain men is merely the bulk of a donkey; massive physical size is utterly worthless when unaccompanied by intellect, dignity, and wisdom

proverb: Guutu malee hin balaqu
meaning_om: Waci, mufannaan fi aariin afaan bahee kan mul'atu yeroo dhiphinni daangaa darbuudha; dhiphinni yoo baay'ate nama dubbachiisa
meaning_en: It does not slosh over unless it is filled to the very brim; a person only erupts into outward fury or public protest when pushed past their endurance

proverb: Gurra dura, gurraattii wayya
meaning_om: Oduu fi beekamtii sobaa isa bu'aa hin qabne caalaa, qabeenya qabatamaa kan akka re'ee gurraattii qabaachuutu wayya
meaning_en: A tangible, humble black goat is far superior to hollow renown and empty praise; practical ownership outweighs famous illusions

proverb: Haa ta'u malee haa ta'uu, xuuriin dhala keef haa ga'u
meaning_om: Namni balleessaa fi daba hojjetu adabbiin gocha isaa dhaloota isaattiyyuu akka darbu akeekkachiisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Let it happen as you will, but know that the curse of your wicked deeds will land upon your own children; karmic reckoning upon lineage

proverb: "Haadha wadaay waddeessaa, dila kana dandeessa" jennaan "hin dandayu dirqii, hin dadhabu risqii" jette
meaning_om: Namni cunqursaa fi roorroo didus, tattaaffii fi rizqii jireenyaa barbaaddachuuf garuu dadhabbii hin qabu
meaning_en: 'I can never tolerate unjust force, but I never tire of honest provision,' said the hardworking woman; defiance against tyranny paired with industry

proverb: Hangayoon lagaa jiigdee, mukni maa jala bade
meaning_om: Balaa uumamaa yookaan kufaatii guddaa dhufeef nama dadhabaa fi wanta dhimma hin qabne komachuun sirrii miti
meaning_en: The entire riverbank collapsed, so why scapegoat the fallen wood caught beneath it?; do not blame minor casualties for monumental structural disasters

proverb: "Hantuuta naan jettu goblaan qaba, shinbirroo naan jettu ilkeen qaba" jette shinbirroon halkanii
meaning_om: Namni yookaan dhimmi gama lamaanuu qabu akkaataa barbaadetti amala isaa jijjiirrachuun kiyyoo jalaa baha
meaning_en: 'Call me a rodent and I show wings; call me a bird and I bare teeth,' said the bat; exploiting ambiguity and dual identities to slip out of trouble

proverb: Hantuuta baareerra taa'u, baarreef jecha dhiisani
meaning_om: Nama balleessaa qabu tokko miidhuun qabeenya gati-jabeessa bira jiru waan balleessuuf obsaan bira darbu
meaning_en: A rat perched on a precious milk-pail is spared lest the vessel shatter; tolerating a nuisance to protect a far more valuable asset

proverb: Hatticha lammichaaf dhabani
meaning_om: Nama balleessaa qabu tokko sababa maatii yookaan fira isaa isa kabajamaatiif jedhanii dhiifama godhuufi
meaning_en: They refrained from punishing the thief solely out of respect for his noble clan; extending mercy to a miscreant to honor his family

proverb: Hamma feete dulloomtu, habaleen kuchoo hin hanqattu
meaning_om: Dubartiin umuriin yoo deeme illee bareedinaa fi kabaja qe'ee isheetiif xiyyeeffannaa kennuu hin dhiiftu
meaning_en: However advanced in years she becomes, an elder woman never abandons styling her tresses; self-respect and dignity endure through old age

proverb: Hangafa doofe, quxisuu karra dhaala
meaning_om: Mirgi hangafummaa dandeettii fi naamusarratti hirkata malee, namni gowwaan hangafa ta'us bulchiinsa maatii dhabuu danda'a
meaning_en: If the firstborn is an incompetent fool, the youngest inherits the family estate; merit and capability supersede mere birth order

proverb: Handaaqqoo ija diddiiminni, hanga risaan gaaraa bu'uuti
meaning_om: Namni laafaan boonu fi dhaadatu hanga nama jabaa wajjin wal argutti qofa ija jabaata; doorsisi sobaa dafee dhaama
meaning_en: The hen glares with puffed-up fury only until the eagle swoops from the mountain; empty bravado vanishes the moment a real force appears

proverb: Hantuutni qalbii qabdu, warra manaa wajjiin nyaatti
meaning_om: Namni dammaqaa fi ogummaa qabu naannoo isaatti walsimee nagaan jiraachuun carraatti fayyadama
meaning_en: A wise mouse dines in harmony alongside the family; an intelligent, tactful person adapts to their host community to thrive safely

proverb: Harreen fincaanuu hin oolle, fincaannaan illee eegee hin tolle
meaning_om: Gochi namoota amala dhabeeyyii yeroo hundumaa dogoggoraa fi salphina of keessaa hin dhabu; amala xuraa'aa ceepha'a
meaning_en: A donkey cannot help urinating, yet when it does, it fouls its own tail; crude, undisciplined actors inevitably soil their own dignity in everything they do

proverb: "Harreen baddee waan gaari himtanii, habalee fi waraanaan dirmadhaa, waan hamtu himtani" je'e waraabessi
meaning_om: Balaan namarra gahu ormaaf gammachuu yoo ta'e, firaaf ammoo gadda ta'uu; dantaa wal-faallaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'You celebrate a lost donkey, yet rally with spears lamenting disaster!' said the hyena; what brings feast to the predator brings mourning to the owner

proverb: "Har" jennaan harreen gurra dhaabde
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa qabu wanta isaaf ta'uu fi barate qofaaf deebii kenna; qajeelfama salphaa qofa hubachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: At the crude bray of 'Har!', the donkey pricked up its ears; undisciplined beings only respond to basic, accustomed commands

proverb: Harraagessa lama hin darbatani
meaning_om: Kaayyoo lama yeroma tokkotti qabachuuf yaaluun lamaanuu akka dhaban nama godha; xiyyeeffannoo tokko qabaachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: One does not cast stones at two crows at the same time; trying to bag two targets at once splits focus and ensures both fly away

proverb: "Harreen badde" jennaan, bakka itti hin feene dhaqxi jedhe
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi kasaaraa mudate keessatti illee cinaa gaarii tokko arguun of jajjabeessuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When told the pack-donkey was lost, he said, 'At least it escaped to where nobody can saddle it!'; finding silver linings even in misfortune

proverb: Heelleen beeratti burraaqa
meaning_om: Haalli rakkisaan yookaan balaan dhufe namoota dadhaboo illee wanta hin taane akka raawwatan dirqisiisa
meaning_en: A dangerous chasm makes even a frail old woman skip and jump; terrifying crises force extraordinary agility out of the most frail

proverb: Heera badaa, mataa ofiitiif dhabani
meaning_om: Seerri jal'aa fi hoggansi qajeelummaa hin qabne namuma seera sana baase illee dhuma irratti miidha
meaning_en: Under an unjust customary law, one's own head finds no shelter; crooked legislation eventually boomerangs to devour its own authors

proverb: Heera badaa, abba mursiisani
meaning_om: Namni shiraa fi seera dabaa ormaaf qopheesse murtii sanumaan ofii isaatii akka adabamu taasisu
meaning_en: An unjust law: they compel its very author to pronounce it upon himself; forcing the deviser of a trap to swallow his own verdict

proverb: Heera qomaaf kaaye, adurreen hin fuune
meaning_om: Qabeenyi yookaan dhimmi eegumsa cimaa qabu ormaan hin saamamu; of eeggannoon milkaa'ina fida
meaning_en: The choice cut kept guarded for the chest, the prowling cat could not steal; vigilant custody successfully protects prized assets

proverb: Hijaan (haluun) qoree dhoqqee keessaati
meaning_om: Jibbansi fi haloon dhokatee ture osoo hin yaadin nama waraana; diina dhokataa irraa of eeggachuun dirqama
meaning_en: A concealed grudge is like a thorn buried in slippery mud; invisible to the eye, it stabs your foot when you least expect it

proverb: Himachuu wallaaltee, daanyaa komatte
meaning_om: Namni dhimma isaa ragaa fi seeraan dhiheeffachuu dadhabe murtii dhufeef namoota qajeeltoo komachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Incapable of articulating her own grievance, she blamed the judge; someone who bungles their case blames the court for their failure

proverb: Hin barihu jetteeti manatti udaante, bariinaan waliin rakkatte
meaning_om: Dukkanni yeroo dhumu akka ifti dhufu dagatanii gocha qaanii raawwachuun booda salphina guddaa fida
meaning_en: Thinking dawn would never arrive, she fouled the house; when daylight broke, she was trapped in her own mess; dark sins meet daylight shame

proverb: Hirriibni obboleessa du'aati
meaning_om: Hirriibni qaamaa fi sammuu akka waan du'aatti nama laamsheessa; dammaqina dhabuu fi of dagachuu irraa of eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: Sleep is the twin brother of death; slumber strips away awareness and defense, leaving a person as helpless as a corpse; guard your vigilance

proverb: Hoojjaan ganaana jimaati
meaning_om: Dheerina qaamaa qabaachuun qofti humnaa fi bu'aa dhugaa hin argamsiisu; wanti bu'uuraa dandeettii fi jabinadha
meaning_en: Tallness alone is merely the thin foliage of a khat branch; physical height without inner substance, grit, or intellect is completely hollow

proverb: Horiin abbaa hedduu, alaa hin galle
meaning_om: Qabeenyi yookaan hojiin itti gaafatamummaa ifa ta'e hin qabne dantaa dhabuun ni bada; abbummaa tokko barbaada
meaning_en: Livestock with multiple negligent owners never make it home from pasture; collective property without clear accountability perishes outside

proverb: Horiin abbaa hedduu, baqa hin bahu
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan dhufe qabeenyi nama baay'ee jala jiru murtii hatattamaa dhabuudhaan dafee saammama
meaning_en: Livestock belonging to too many masters never escapes the stampede; divided leadership prevents decisive flight during an ambush

proverb: Horru horarratti, deegnu magaalatti wali dhufna
meaning_om: Jireenyi garagaggaltoo dha; har'a sooromanii yoo boonanis bor walitti deebi'uun hin oolu; namatti hin roorrisinaa
meaning_en: Whether we prosper by the mineral springs or end up impoverished in the marketplace, we will meet again; fortunes fluctuate, so never mistreat people

proverb: Ibidda jibrii seene, dhaamsuun nama dhiba
meaning_om: Waldhabdee fi aarii maatii keessatti hidda fageeffate dhaamsuun baay'ee ulfaataadha; balaan suuta boba'u daran hamaadha
meaning_en: A fire that has penetrated deep into raw cotton is nearly impossible to extinguish; smoldering internal feuds resist all peacemaking

proverb: Ifirra dhaabii laali jette oborraan
meaning_om: Nama biraatti hirkachuu dhiisii dura of dandeessi; wanta ofii qoradhuu sana booda murteessi
meaning_en: 'Stand firmly on your own feet and look out,' said the threshold beam; achieve independent stability before passing judgment on the world

proverb: Ihi, ihii tokko dubbiin tolfataa, tokko duubbii dha
meaning_om: Dubbiin bifa lama qaba; tokko jaarsummaa fi ijaarsaa yoo ta'u, inni biraan ammoo hamii fi diigumsa fida; arraba calaluu barsiisa
meaning_en: 'Ah, ah!', one kind of speech builds understanding, while another is pure malicious backbiting; distinguish constructive words from destructive slander

proverb: Ijaa fi firummaa, waan xiqqootu balleessa
meaning_om: Akkuma iji huuba xiqqoodhaan miidhamtu, firoomnis jechaa fi qoccolloo laafaatiin salphaatti diigamuu dandeessi; of eeggannoo cimaa barbaaddi
meaning_en: Both the eye and family ties are spoiled by a tiny speck; just as a minuscule piece of grit blinds the eye, a petty argument shatters fragile kinship

proverb: Ijaan qalaan, gogaa hin muru
meaning_om: Hawwii fi kajeellaan wanta tokko ijaan ilaaluun qofti bu'aa qabatamaa hin fidu; hojii harkaa fi tarkaanfii qabatamaatu barbaachisa
meaning_en: Slaughtering an animal merely with one's eyes does not slice the leather hide; wishing, staring, and longing accomplish nothing without physical labor

proverb: Ijji osoo wal agartee, lafa namaa hin agartu
meaning_om: Jaalalli yookaan xiyyeeffannaan cimaan yeroo nama dhuunfatu, wantoota naannoo jiran hundumaa dagachiisa; jaalalli ija jaamsa
meaning_en: While two eyes are locked in an intimate gaze, they perceive nothing of the ground beneath them; intense passion or obsession blinds one to surrounding risks

proverb: Ilkeen nama hundaanuu fira
meaning_om: Ilkaan nama kamiifiyyuu kolfitee bareedina agarsiisti; garuu kolfi alaa sun jaalala dhugaa keessaa qabaachuu isaatiif wabii miti
meaning_en: Teeth smile in apparent friendship with anyone; outward grinning and pleasant smiles are extended indiscriminately and do not prove sincere loyalty

proverb: Ilmi dulloomeeti, abbaan lafa qota
meaning_om: Ijoolleen dhibaa'oo taatee osoo jirtuu maanguddoon dhama'ee maatii sooruu ceepha'a; qooda hojii fi guddina jallate saaxila
meaning_en: The young son acts decrepit and lazy, while his aged father toils at plowing the soil; sharply rebukes healthy youth lounging while elderly parents labor

proverb: Intala haadhaa fi, akkoo jiddutti ergaramte
meaning_om: Dhimma fi ajaja qaamolee lamaanii gidduutti qabamanii ba'aa ulfaataadhaan dhiphachuu agarsiisa; gidduutti rakkachuu ibsa
meaning_en: A maiden run ragged carrying conflicting errands between mother and grandmother; trapped between two demanding authorities who pull in opposite directions

proverb: Intalli akka hin qabne, akka ofii himatti
meaning_om: Namni safeeffannaa fi aadaa hin beekne bakka seera hawaasaa eeguu qabutti wantuma fedhii dhuunfaa isaa qofa afaaniin baasa
meaning_en: A maiden devoid of proper upbringing merely boasts of her own selfish whims; undisciplined people substitute social etiquette with vulgar self-centeredness

proverb: Isiin hammaattu, hamtu dha jedha
meaning_om: Amalli badaanii fi gara-jabinni deebii walfakkaataa fida; namni gaarummaa dhabe kabaja ormarraa hin argatu
meaning_en: Because she is habitually cruel, he bluntly calls her wicked; harsh treatment and toxicity naturally invite unflattering, blunt labels in return

proverb: Itti hagooggiin dhungoo hin taatu
meaning_om: Wanta dhugaa fi jaalalaan raawwatamuu qabu tokko aguuggii fi fakkeessummaa alaan bakka buusuun hin danda'amu; qulqullummaa barbaada
meaning_en: Veiling one's face with a cloth does not make a kiss; artificial barriers, formalities, and cold pretenses cannot replace authentic warmth and intimacy

proverb: Jaartiin akkuma beekanitti of fannisani jette
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu dhimma, furmaataa fi carraa isaa akkaataa dandeettii fi beekumsa isaatti hoogganata; itti-gaafatamummaa ofii ibsa
meaning_en: 'One hangs oneself according to one's own methods,' said the old woman; everyone handles their desperate dilemmas and affairs using their own peculiar strategy

proverb: Jabaan jannata falma
meaning_om: Gootni fi namni murannoo cimaa qabu bakka kamiyyuu yoo deeme mirgaa fi kabaja isaatiif falmata malee laayyootti hin jilbeeffatu
meaning_en: The truly resolute champion fights with determination even for paradise; a brave soul never submits passively, but actively strives for the highest prize

proverb: Jabaan gabbara haadhaa falma, laafaan kan obboleettii wallaala
meaning_om: Namni jabaan mirga fagoo jiru illee qabatee falmata; namni dabeessi garuu wanta harka isaatti dhufe iyyuu dhabee qullaa hafa
meaning_en: The assertive man fiercely claims bride-wealth for his mother, while the weakling neglects even his sister's rightful due; boldness vs. timid forfeiture

proverb: Jazbaa fi sareen ganama rafti
meaning_om: Namni qalbii fi kaayyoo jireenyaa hin qabne akkuma beeyladaatti yeroo hojii ganamaa rafee dabarsa; dhibaa'ummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: The clueless simpleton and the hound sleep through the morning; unmotivated souls snooze through prime hours of enterprise like idle beasts

proverb: Jimaa fi maraataa hidha jabeessani
meaning_om: Wanta dafee baduufi nama qalbii hin qabne to'achuuf eeggannoo fi hidhaa cimaa gochuun barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: For perishable khat and a volatile madman, tie the bindings tight; volatile people and delicate goods require firm containment to prevent ruin

proverb: Joolleen maqaa barte, tuutaa keessa yaamti
meaning_om: Namni bilchina hin qabne iccitii dhaga'e bakka hin malleetti uummata duratti baasee nama qaaneessa; qaanfii dhabuu ijoollee agarsiisa
meaning_en: A child who just learned a private name shouts it out in the middle of a gathering; indiscreet novices blurt out sensitive secrets in public

proverb: Joollee fi fuulli dhoksaa hin qabani
meaning_om: Daa'imman wanta argan hunda afaaniin baasu, fuulli namas miira keessoo ifatti calaqqisa malee dhoksuu hin danda'u
meaning_en: Children and the human face have no secrets; youngsters speak without a filter, just as facial expressions involuntarily betray inner truth

proverb: Kabiirri heddummaatu, dhukkubsataan ni du'a
meaning_om: Hoggantoonni fi ogeeyyiin dhimma tokkorratti wal-morkatan furmaata dhabsiisanii balaa dhumaa fidu; hoggansa tokko barbaada
meaning_en: When master healers multiply around the bed, the patient perishes; conflicting experts and too many authorities bungle the cure

proverb: kadiir lama hin deebi'u
meaning_om: Murtiin yookaan tarkaanfiin seeraa al tokko xumuramee darbe hin deebifamu; carraan dabarsan lammata hin argamu
meaning_en: A decisive decree does not return twice; an opportunity seized or a fatal judgment rendered is permanent and cannot be replayed

proverb: Kakachuu fi abaaruun, tokkummaa sheeyxaanaati
meaning_om: Afaaniin kakuu sobaa heddummeessuu fi nama abaaruun hojii hamaa nagaa fi safuu hawaasaa barbadeessuudha
meaning_en: Flippant oath-taking and chronic cursing are the league of Satan; habituating one's tongue to oaths and malice destroys spiritual and social peace

proverb: Kan dhiqaniitu nama dhiqa jette qoriin
meaning_om: Wanti ati kunuunsitee fi qulqulleeffattee qabatte deebisee si tajaajila; tajaajilli kabajaa fi qulqullina irratti hirkata
meaning_en: 'It is the bowl you wash that washes you,' said the food bowl; whatever you clean, maintain, and respect will in turn serve and nourish you

proverb: Kan alaa guntaa, kan manaa mancaa
meaning_om: Namni orma duratti dabeessa fi callisaa ta'e mana isaatti haadha manaa fi ijoolleerratti abbaa irree ta'uu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Outside he is a blunt, timid stump; at home he is a slashing machete; condemns cowards who cower before strangers but terrorize their own families

proverb: kan dura ol seene, balbala namatti cufa
meaning_om: Namni dura carraa yookaan aangoo argate warra hafe akka hin guddanneef karaa duraa cufuun ofittummaa isaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: The one who entered first slams the door in the faces of those behind him; selfish gatekeepers who shut out others once their own success is secured

proverb: Kan eessa geessu, bakkalchi bariisaa baati
meaning_om: Namni deemsa fagoo fi dhimma cimaaf qophaa'e ganama bariidhaan ka'ee socho'uu akka qabu akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: Whither is your grand journey, that the morning star rises while you still idle?; urges prompt departure and early starts for ambitious expeditions

proverb: Kan ajjeechaaf dhufe, huccuu darbaniif hin deebi'u
meaning_om: Diinni lubbuu balleessuuf dhufe faayidaa xiqqoon yookaan sossobaan hin deebi'u; balaa guddaaf qophii cimaa barbaachisa
meaning_en: He who came to take your life will not turn back because you toss him a shirt; a mortal enemy cannot be bought off with petty appeasement

proverb: Kan hin maraanne hoolaa dha, kan maraachuu hin oolle saree dha
meaning_om: Namni amala garraamii qabu yoomiyyuu nagaa hin dhabu, inni amala lolaa qabu garuu dhuma irratti jeequmsa kakaasuun isaa hin oolu
meaning_en: That which never goes mad is the gentle sheep; that which inevitably turns rabid is the unruly dog; true natures ultimately express themselves

proverb: Kan hiyyeessaa kenne, alata waaqaa argata
meaning_om: Nama rakkatee fi harka-qalleessa gargaaruun eebba guddaa fi balbala barakaa Waaqayyo biraa namaaf bana
meaning_en: He who gives to the destitute receives an open gate of blessing from God; charity to the poor is a direct investment in divine grace

proverb: kan garaa lixe, obboleessi hin dhaalu
meaning_om: Wanta qabatamaan nyaatamee fi liqimfame namni biraa saamuus ta'ee dhaaluu hin danda'u; qabeenya nyaatan qofatu kan ofiiti
meaning_en: What has entered your stomach, not even your own brother can inherit; the only wealth you truly own is that which you have consumed for life

proverb: Kan gaalli garboo elmamu callisee dheedu, re'eettiin copha dheengee hin geenyeef dhadhaabbata nama kutti
meaning_om: Namni gumaacha guddaa godhu callisee yoo hojjetu, inni bu'aa homaayyuu hin qabne wacaa fi dhaadannoo baay'isa
meaning_en: While the camel yielding huge pails grazes in silence, the goat screeches over a tiny drop; greatest contributors are quiet, smallest are loud

proverb: Kan ergaa dhaqee afaan haxaawwaterra, kan ergaa didee hudduu haxaawwate wayya
meaning_om: Nama osoo hin hojjatin sobee ergaa nyaate caalaa, inni ifatti 'hin deemu' jedhee dide amansiisaadha; iftoomina dursuu
meaning_en: Better the rebel who refuses an errand honestly than the deceiver who goes and wipes his mouth lying; upfront refusal beats covert betrayal

proverb: Kan galli kee hin oolle, manni kee onaa?
meaning_om: Namni kamuu gara qe'ee isaatti deebi'uun waan hin oolleef, mana ofiitiif eeggannoo gochuu fi qe'ee ofii kunuunsuun dirqama
meaning_en: Since your return home is inevitable, why treat your house like an abandoned ruin?; never neglect your home, family, or foundation while away

proverb: Kan ofii bakka bulu hin qabneetu, Keessummaa yaammata
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiiyyuu rakkoo fi dhabamuu keessa jiru nama biraatiif waadaa qananii gala; humna ofii wallaaluu ceepha'a
meaning_en: He who has nowhere to sleep himself invites a houseguest; satirizes resourceless individuals who extend grand invitations they cannot honor

proverb: Kan tokko hin guunne, lama qoraafatti
meaning_om: Wanta salphaa tokko qulqullinaan hojjechuu dadhabanii ba'aa dabalataa fi hojii lammaffaa keessa seenanii of salphisuu
meaning_en: She who cannot manage a single dish scrapes two; failing to handle one modest responsibility while greedily biting off double the burden

proverb: Kan muka nyaatee fi kan mutaa nyaate waluma qixa
meaning_om: Namni badii guddaa hojjetee fi inni yakka seeraa raawwate lamaanuu balaa keessa jiru; balleessaan hundi adaba hordofsiisa
meaning_en: He who swallowed wood and he who swallowed a sharp awl end up equally dead; indulging in lethal folly kills you regardless of the tool

proverb: Kan itti goomtu, udaan irra taa'ee wallisa
meaning_om: Nama tola oolaniifii fi naamusatti qajeelchanitu deebisee amala fokkisaa fi salphina mul'isa; galata dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The one you meticulously cleaned and groomed sits upon dung and sings; lavishing care on a degenerate only for them to wallow in filth

proverb: Kan taa'ee dadhabe, dhangalaasee guura
meaning_om: Namni hojii bu'a qabeessa dhabe dhiphinaa fi hojii faayidaa hin qabne uumee yeroo guba; dhibaa'ummaa fi bu'aa dhablummaa ibsa
meaning_en: He who grew weary of sitting idle spills the grain only to gather it again; people devoid of purpose invent pointless, exhausting busywork

proverb: Kan quuqaa nama fudhachiise, dhaga nama ba'achiisa
meaning_om: Kaka'umsa, quuqamaa fi fedhii guddaa qabaachuun wanta humnaa olii fakkaatu illee akka hojjetan nama dandeessisa; quuqamni humna
meaning_en: That which instills deep passion in a person empowers him to carry boulders; genuine inner conviction enables mortals to shoulder gigantic burdens

proverb: Kanniisni ciniinsaan nama aarsee, dammaan nama araarsa
meaning_om: Qormaanni fi adabbiin bu'aa gaarii qabu dura yoo nama madeesse illee dhuma irratti firii mi'aawaa fida; obsa barsiisa
meaning_en: The bee angers you with its sting, then reconciles you with its honey; the hardships and discipline along the path are rewarded by sweet fruit

proverb: kanniisarraa dammaatu argama, nagayarraa jaalalaatu argama
meaning_om: Akkuma damma kanniisarree argatan, jaalallii fi badhaadhinnis kan dagaagu yoo nagaan bu'e qofaadha; nagaan hundarra caala
meaning_en: From bees comes sweet honey; from peace springs enduring love; authentic affection, harmony, and prosperity can only flourish where peace reigns

proverb: Kanniisa damma mi'aawaa tolchu ta'uutu, tiiticha damma san balleessu hin ta'in
meaning_om: Hawaasa keessatti nama wanta gaarii ijaaruu fi bu'aa fidu ta'i malee, nama wanta gaarii ijaarame mancaasu hin ta'in
meaning_en: Strive to be the bee that produces sweet honey; never be the pestilential fly that fouls that honey; contribute value rather than sabotaging good work

proverb: Karaa dhufan waa hin galani jedhe jaarsi
meaning_om: Imalli fi jireenyi yeroo hunda jijjiirama barbaada; dogoggora duraan dhufe irra deebi'uu dhiisanii karaan biraa furmaata ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'One does not return by the same trail one came,' said the elder; never repeat the same flawed route; experience demands choosing improved paths

proverb: Karran dheeraan, jilba nama cabsa
meaning_om: Adeemsi dheeraan fi daandiin nuffisiisaan humna namaa dadhabsiisa; dhimma dhedheereessuun miidhaa fida
meaning_en: A long, steep gateway breaks a person's knees; endless bureaucratic delays or protracted negotiations exhaust litigants and break endurance

proverb: Keeyrii karaan labbaa dha
meaning_om: Nama tola ooluufii fi keeyrii barbaaduuf karaan carraa yeroo hunda banaadha; gaarummaan iddoo fi daangaa hin dhabu
meaning_en: For noble deeds and charity, the road is wide open expanse; the opportunities to perform good in this world are infinite and unrestricted

proverb: Kashlabiin guuza hin taatu
meaning_om: Namni amala hin qabnee fi hojii jibbu hojii waloomaa keessatti qooda bu'aa qabu hin gumaachu; nama qajeelaa wajjin hojjechuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A shiftless vagabond is useless for a communal labor party; disciplined, collective farming requires reliable workers, not unruly slackers

proverb: karaan goojjoo fi manni dhaalaa duuduu hin oolu
meaning_om: Wanti bu'uura jabaa hin qabnee fi kunuunsa dhabe yeroo booda bada; qabeenya dhaabbataa ofiin ijaarrachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: The path to a makeshift hut and an unkempt inherited house inevitably become overgrown; assets that are not constantly tended disintegrate

proverb: Karri qotaa bana bula
meaning_om: Namni qotatee quufe nagaa fi qabeenya waan qabuuf sodaa malee jiraata; hojiin tasgabbii fi badhaadhina fida
meaning_en: The cattle gate of an industrious farmer rests open through the night; honest, hard labor brings such abundant peace and security that fear vanishes

proverb: Korma hamaa, hokkola keessa moohani
meaning_om: Diina cimaa fi roorristaa ta'e yeroo inni dadhabee fi carraan isa mudatetti to'achuun ogummaadha; carraatti fayyadamuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A vicious bull is subdued while he limps with a sprain; strike or bridle a formidable adversary when temporary vulnerability weakens him

proverb: Kuruphoon takka dhaltii ree'een teenya hin dhaga'in
meaning_om: Fakkeenya laafaa ormarraa dhufe maatiin akka hin fudhanne eeggachuu; oomisha xiqqoo ormaa akkeessuu dhowwa
meaning_en: The wild antelope bears only a single kid; let not our domestic goats hear of it!; never allow underperforming outside standards to infect your herd

proverb: Lama na hin fuunfattani jette jaartiin qullubbii hatte
meaning_om: Namni yakkaan qabame yookaan saaxilame lammata akka of hin saaxille of eeggannoo godhachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'You will not sniff my breath a second time,' said the old woman who stole the garlic; once caught red-handed, a person avoids repeating the incriminating act

proverb: Leenca ajjeesuuf gara lolaa
meaning_om: Galma guddaa fi bu'aa addaa argachuuf balaa fi qorumsa guddaa dura dhaabbachuun dirqama; gootummaan bu'uura
meaning_en: To slay the lion, one must march into the battle; extraordinary triumphs and great prizes require confronting formidable perils head-on

proverb: Lip liphii aduutu, amna nama fuusisa
meaning_om: Mallattoon yeroo darbuu fi dhihiinsi aduu imaltuun saffisaan akka tarkaanfatu isa godha; yerootti fayyadamuun dirqama
meaning_en: It is the flickering descent of the setting sun that spurs the traveler's steps; the fleeting ticking of time compels urgent momentum

proverb: Lolli dura ijaan dhufa
meaning_om: Walitti bu'iinsii fi lola kamiinuu osoo meeshaan hin jalqabin dura ilaalcha aarii fi ija dhiibuu irraa eegala; mallattoo lolaa dursee hubachuu
meaning_en: War arrives first through the eyes; conflicts always begin with hostile glares and angry stares long before weapons are drawn

proverb: Lolli qotataa fi haqqisaan gaaf gaafi
meaning_om: Namni nagaa fi hojjetataan yeroo hundumaa lola hin barbaadu; yoo inni aaree lolaaf ka'e dhimmi cimaan akka isa muudate agarsiisa
meaning_en: A dedicated plowman brawling and sudden vomiting are rare anomalies; when an ordinarily quiet, hardworking man fights, extreme provocation occurred

proverb: Lolli qeerransaa, abbaa re'ee irratti laallatani
meaning_om: Qorumsa fi balaa dhufe dura dhaabbachuuf abbuma dhimmi ilaallatuutu dursa aarsaa kaffala; itti gaafatamummaan kan abbaati
meaning_en: A battle with an attacking leopard is weighed upon the goat-owner; the person whose livelihood is directly threatened must lead the defense

proverb: Lubbuu fi lukkuun wal hin fakkaatani
meaning_om: Lubbuun namaa qaalii fi bakka bu'aa kan hin qabneedha; akka lukkuutti salphaatti miidhamuu yookaan wareegamuu hin qabdu
meaning_en: Human life and a chicken bear no comparison; human life is sacred, priceless, and irreplaceable; never treat human blood like poultry

proverb: Lukkuun fayyaa dhabde jennaan, tiruu re'ee liqimsiisaa jedhe
meaning_om: Wanta gatii xiqqaa qabuuf jedhanii qabeenya qaalii fi madaallii hin qabne qisaasessuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Told that the chicken was sick, he advised feeding it rich goat liver!; satirizes prescribing an outrageously expensive cure for a cheap problem

proverb: Malaan-nyaataa, afaan daymarra mi'aawa
meaning_om: Namni haaxummaa fi gowwoomsaan nama saamee nyaachuu bare, dafqaan nyaachuu mannaa shiraan argachuun caalaatti itti tola; amala badaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: To a cunning freeloader, food gained by deceit tastes sweeter than honey; scoundrels take perverse pleasure in swindling rather than working

proverb: Manni citaa rooba hin dahu
meaning_om: Wanti bu'uura laafaa qabu balaa fi qorumsa cimaa jalaa nama hin oolchu; wanta amansiisaa fi jabaa ta'etti hirkachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A fragile thatched shelter cannot fully hold off a raging tempest; rely on solid, resilient foundations rather than flimsy makeshifts

proverb: Marqaa fi aduun dhukkuba hin qabani
meaning_om: Nyaanni gabbataa fi oowwi uumamaa fayyaa fi humna namaaf kenna malee miidhaa hin fidu; wantoota bu'uuraa galateeffachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Nutritious warm porridge and morning sunlight bring no disease, only vitality and health; cherish simple natural provisions

proverb: Mataa buletti imaamata marani
meaning_om: Namoota bilchina, muuxannoo fi kabaja qabaniif aangoo fi ulfinni ni kennama; bakka maluuf iddoo kennuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Upon a clean, venerable head one winds the turban of leadership; high honors and authority belong to mature and worthy elders

proverb: Midhaan ambaa daggalaa, mucaan ambaa qancara
meaning_om: Wanta ormaa fi nama ormaatti hirkachuun quufa dhugaa fi guddina amansiisaa hin fidu; kan ofiitiin jiraachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Another's grain fields yield mere wild weeds to you, and rearing another's child yields sorrow; foreign reliance brings no true harvest

proverb: Midhaan bulchan malee, dalagaa hin bulchani
meaning_om: Hojii fi itti-gaafatamummaa yeroodhaan xumuruun barbaachisaa dha; dalagaa borutti harkifachiisuun kasaaraa fida
meaning_en: Grain may be stored overnight, but honest labor must never be postponed until tomorrow; prioritize prompt industry over procrastination

proverb: Midhaan mana duubaa malee, midhaan gaara duubaa nu hin godhin
