meaning_om: Qabeenya dhihoo fi harka qaqqabutti galateeffachuu; wanta fagoo fi qabatamaa hin taane abdatee dhiphachuu irraa eeggachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Bless us with grain right behind our homestead, rather than distant harvests across the mountains; grant accessible, peaceful sustenance

proverb: Miilli deemu, dhalti rimaya qabsiisa
meaning_om: Socho'uunii fi tattaaffiin bakka garagaraa deemanii carraaqquun firii fi qabeenya haaraa akka argamsiisu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The wandering foot causes female stock to conceive; enterprise, travel, and active mobility bring fruitful multiplication and new opportunities

proverb: Miila lafaan didan, bakki irraan ajjatan waa hin jiru
meaning_om: Haala qabatamaa fi dhugaa jireenyaa didanii bakka biraatti nagaa argachuun akka hin danda'amne; qabatamummaa fudhachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A foot that refuses to touch the dirt has nowhere else to step; one cannot reject reality and expect to find solid footing in life

proverb: Moluu cabbii dandeesse, bakakkaaf abdatu
meaning_om: Namni qorumsa cimaa kanaan dura dabarse rakkina haaraa kamiifiyyuu akka hin jilbeeffanne abdatu; jabinna muuxannoo agarsiisa
meaning_en: A bald head that withstood punishing hail is counted upon against lightning; proven veterans of severe trials are trusted to weather coming crises

proverb: Muka, kan caayaa qabu jala taa'ani
meaning_om: Nama yookaan bakka eegumsa, arjummaa fi nagaa namaaf kennu biratti dahoo barbaadatu malee kan bu'aa hin qabneetti hin hirkatan
meaning_en: One rests beneath the tree that provides generous shade; seek shelter, patron, or company with those who truly protect and nurture

proverb: Mukni baalaan boona
meaning_om: Namnis akkuma mukti damee fi baalaan bareedu, maatii, ijoollee fi fira isaatiin kabajamaa fi jabaa ta'a; tokkummaa firaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: A tree takes pride in its abundant foliage; an individual derives dignity, defense, and splendor from children, kin, and community

proverb: Nama fardaan barbaadaniitu, miilaan nama barbaada
meaning_om: Namni ati yeroo dheeraa qabeenyaa fi humnaan dhabdee eeggachaa turte ofumaan salphaatti sitti dhufe; carraa hin eegamne ibsa
meaning_en: The very person sought far and wide on horseback now seeks you on foot; an unexpected, humble encounter with someone long pursued

proverb: Nama farda koo yaabbateetu, guddina koo beeka
meaning_om: Namni sadarkaa, qabeenyaa fi ulfina kee keessa galee dhandhame qofatu gatii kee isa dhugaa beeka malee ormi alaa hin hubatu
meaning_en: Only the one who has mounted my noble steed can measure my greatness; true stature is understood only by those who experience its power

proverb: Nama halkan kana buleetu, kan boruu yaada
meaning_om: Dura lubbuu fi nagaa har'aa mirkaneeffatanii buluutu dursa; sana booda waa'ee egeree karoorfatu; qabatamummaa duraa ibsa
meaning_en: It is the one who survives this night who plans for tomorrow; securing present life takes precedence over daydreaming about distant days

proverb: "Nama hin qabnu akka hin jenne si qabna, mana nuu eegi akka hin jenne siihuu ni eegna" jette, haati intalaan
meaning_om: Nama gargaarsaaf hin taane garuu dhabamus hin barbaadamne; ba'aa fi kunuunsa dabalataa ta'uu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'We cannot say we lack family because we have you; yet we cannot trust you to guard the house because we must guard you,' said the mother; affectionate dilemma of useless kin

proverb: Nama hin tuqaminitti dubbiin baala
meaning_om: Namni dhiphinni fi miidhaan dhuunfaan isa hin tuqin dhibee ormaa akka laayyootti fi salphaatti laala; quuqama dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: To the person untouched by injury, the dispute is as light as a dried leaf; those spared personal suffering easily minimize the anguish of victims

proverb: Nama maraate haadaan hidhani, haada maraate maaliin hidhani
meaning_om: Namni balleessaa uumu seeraan adabama; garuu yoo seerri fi hoggansi ofii isaatiiyyuu jallate furmaanni baay'ee rakkisaadha
meaning_en: A madman is restrained with rope, but with what can one bind an unhinged rope?; when the very instrument of law and order turns corrupt, all remedy fails

proverb: Nama mooyyee irra taa'u, kaasuun hin oolamu
meaning_om: Namni bakka isaaf hin malle fi safeeffannaa hawaasaa cabsee taa'u salphatanii ari'amuun isaa hin oolu; daangaa ofii beekuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Whoever sits atop the grain mortar is bound to be ordered off; occupying an inappropriate, taboo seat invites inevitable public dismissal

proverb: Nama si hin gargaarre jala gad hin godhatin
meaning_om: Nama faayidaa fi eegumsa tokkollee siif hin gooneef jedhtee kabaja ofii salphisuu fi jilbeeffachuun sirrii miti; bilisummaa ofii eeggachuu ibsa
meaning_en: Do not grovel or bend low beneath someone who offers you no aid; never trade away your dignity and independence for an unhelpful patron

proverb: Nama sii hin kenninetti dhaba hin himatin
meaning_om: Nama gara-jabeessa fi tola siif hin oolleetti rakkinaa fi hiyyummaa kee himachuun of salphisuu qofa fida; qaanii ofii eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Do not lament your poverty to someone who has never extended a handout; confiding lack in a confirmed miser brings only cold ridicule

proverb: Nama rafee, saani duubaa dibicha dhale
meaning_om: Dhibaa'ummaan fi of-dagannoon carraa fi barakaa akka namarraa hanqisu; dammaqinni fi tiksuun bu'aa qabeessa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: For the man who slept through the night, his cow calved a bull-calf instead of a dairy heifer; negligent slumber costs one prime fortunes

proverb: Namni bishaan sagal dhuge baalagee dha
meaning_om: Wanta hundumaa keessatti madaallii dhabuu fi bololaan socho'uun naamusa nama dhabsiisa; of-to'achuu dhabuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: A person who drinks water nine times without pause is ill-mannered; a complete lack of physical moderation and poise reveals coarse, vulgar breeding

proverb: Namni duulli itti hirphe dulloome
meaning_om: Qabsoon walirraa hin cinne, lolli fi dhiphinni jireenyaa nama jabaa illee dafee moofeessee humna dhabsiisa; qorumsa jireenyaa ibsa
meaning_en: The man upon whom military campaigns piled endlessly grew prematurely aged; unrelenting battles and chronic hardships grind down even the stoutest heart

proverb: Namni dubra rimaya qabsiise, baatii dhalattu jibba
meaning_om: Namni badii fi yakka seeraan alaa raawwate guyyaa wanti sun ifatti bahee saaxilamu fi adabbiin dhufu sodaata; sodaata saaxilamuu ibsa
meaning_en: He who impregnated an unmarried maiden dreads the month she gives birth; perpetrators of hidden crimes dread the inevitable hour of public exposure

proverb: Namni gaafa minilnk duude, "hadaraa minilik" jedha
meaning_om: Namni yeroon jijjiiramuu hin hubatin wantuma bara durii sana qabatee waamuun boodatti hafummaa agarsiisa; dammaqina dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The man who went deaf during Menelik's era still swears 'By Menelik's pledge!'; mocks people stuck in obsolete eras, oblivious to revolutionary shifts

proverb: Namni du'a hin beekne, waan Rabbi jibbu tuttuqa
meaning_om: Namni xumura jireenyaa fi ajala hin yaadanne cubbuu fi balleessaa gurguddaa keessa seenee Waaqayyoon mufachiisa; dammaqina amantii dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: He who has no consciousness of mortal death flirts with what God abominates; forgetting mortality makes a person recklessly arrogant and sinful

proverb: Namni gubatee hin beekne, ibiddaan taphata
meaning_om: Namni miidhaa fi qorumsa balaan fidu argee hin beekne wanta balaa qabu keessa seenee akka qoosaatti ilaala; muuxannoo dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: One who has never experienced burns plays casually with fire; naive, inexperienced people flirt recklessly with hazards because they do not know the pain

proverb: Namni gatiidhaan bitame, gatii namaa hin beekuu gatitti namarraa hin dhaabbatu
meaning_om: Namni garbummaa fi salphina keessatti guddate kabaja namummaa hin beeku; aangoo yoo argates roorroo fi dhiibbaa daangaa malee raawwata
meaning_en: A person bought with money knows nothing of human dignity; he never climbs down from people's shoulders; enslaved minds turn into ruthless tyrants

proverb: Namni fafeen, harree dha, ribbii fuudha
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa fi safeeffannaa hin qabne yeroo hunda balaa fi salphina haaraa ofitti qaba; amalli xuraa'aan dhibee fida
meaning_en: A scandalous person is like an uncouth donkey; he endlessly contracts parasite worms; degraded behavior perpetually attracts foul trouble

proverb: Namni jiile hin qusatu
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan cimaan lubbuu namaatti dhufe namni wanta qabeenyaa qusachuuf hin yaadu; dura lubbuu oolfachuuf wanta hunda dabarsee kenna
meaning_en: A person seized by mortal terror does not practice frugality; in life-and-death crises, individuals sacrifice every asset to buy their breath

proverb: Namni biyya isaatiif lolu daymarra mi'awa namni biyyaan lolu heexoo caala hadhaawa
meaning_om: Biyya ofiitiif wareegamuun kabajaa fi jaalala zalaalamii namaaf kenna; biyya ofiitti garagaluun garuu salphinaa fi jibba guddaa fida
meaning_en: He who fights for his homeland is sweeter than honey, but a traitor fighting against his land is more bitter than kosso; patriotism vs. treason

proverb: Namni lafatti wal shakke, muka wajji hin koru
meaning_om: Namoonni bu'uura amanamummaa hin qabne hojii bala-qabeessa fi walxaxaa keessatti waliin hirmaachuu hin danda'an; amantii qabaachuun dirqama
meaning_en: Those who distrust each other on the ground do not climb trees together; mutual suspicion precludes taking high-stakes, perilous risks as partners

proverb: Namni ofii rafaa bule, kan taa'aa buleef hin beeku
meaning_om: Namni qananii fi boqonnaa keessa oole dhiphinaa fi dammaqina nama rakkataa sanaa hubachuu hin danda'u; garaagarummaa jireenyaa ibsa
meaning_en: He who slept peacefully through the night understands nothing of the one who sat awake in vigil; comfort cannot fathom the exhaustion of struggle

proverb: Namni ofii nyaatu, hiyyeessaa hin yaadu
meaning_om: Namni quufaa fi ofittoo ta'e beelaa fi dhiphina nama harka-qalleessaa hin yaadatu; quufaan beela'aaf hin mararfatu
meaning_en: He who indulges his own belly gives no thought to the poor; comfortable satiety breeds callousness toward the gnawing hunger of the destitute

proverb: Namni muka irraa kufe, hanga lafa gahutti waa heddu yaada
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan dhufee fi kufaatiin qaqqabe, namni yeruma sana keessatti dhimmoota hedduu fi gaabbii keessa seena; saffisa yaadaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: The person tumbling from a tree ponders a thousand thoughts before hitting the ground; the shock of downfall compresses a lifetime of desperate realizations into seconds

proverb: Namni waraabessa yaabbate, koottu siin huddeelladhaa je'a
meaning_om: Namni ofii isaatiiyyuu balaa lubbuu galaafatu keessa jiru nama biraatiif dahoo fi wabii ta'uu akka danda'u dhaadachuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: One riding on a hyena says, 'Come, let me give you a piggyback ride!'; mocks helpless individuals in grave danger offering protection to others

proverb: Namni ollaa fi duugdaan ol ejja
meaning_om: Guddinni, kabajnii fi milkaa'inni nama tokkoo deeggarsa ollaa gaarii fi jabinna firoota isaatiin mirkanaa'a; tokkummaan bu'uura
meaning_en: A person steps upward in status through neighbors and a sturdy kin backbone; social advancement rests entirely on communal goodwill and clan support

proverb: Naggada wallaalteeti, magaalaa komatti
meaning_om: Dandeettii fi beekumsa daldalaa dhabuu ofii dagatanii haala gabaatti sababeeffachuu ceepha'a; hanqina ofii ormatti fe'uu dhowwa
meaning_en: Failing to understand the rules of trade, she blames the marketplace; incompetent merchants blame the market rather than their own lack of skill

proverb: Natti hin hafin sitti haa hafuu jette dhabduun sungoo facaaftee
meaning_om: Gaddi fi dhiphinni ofirra jiru ormattis akka darbu hawwuu; namni carraa dhabe nama biraatiifis carraa gaarii dhowwachuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: 'Let it not be left on me, let it be left upon you!' said the barren woman casting rue herbs; malicious spite wishing one's own tragedy onto others

proverb: Niin gaggabaa mucaa narraa qabaa jettte jaartiin
meaning_om: Dadhabbii fi humna dhabuu ofii beekanii ba'aa humnaa olii osoo hin kufin namaaf daddabarsuu; daangaa humna ofii beekuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'I am swooning, take the child from me!' said the old woman; knowing one's physical limits and handing over delicate burdens before collapse

proverb: Niitiin deeminsa guddattu, mana namaatti gubaati
meaning_om: Nama bakka isaaf hin malle naannawuun amaleeffate balaan yoo mudate salphinaa fi miidhaa guddaa keessa gala; qe'ee ofii eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A woman addicted to wandering outside gets burned in a stranger's house; restless rovers who abandon home eventually get caught in outside catastrophes

proverb: Nusaani dhibba liqeeffatani
meaning_om: Qabeenya xiqqoo fi bu'uura hin qabne irratti hirkachuudhaan baasii fi liqii daangaa hin qabne keessa lixanii of kuffisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: From a minuscule fraction, they contracted a hundred loans; taking on mountains of debt against negligible, nonexistent capital; financial madness

proverb: Nyaataan nyaatee nama nyaachisa
meaning_om: Namni dura of jiraachisee fi humna horate qofa nama biraa gargaaruu fi sooruu danda'a; of dandeessisuun nama gargaaruuf bu'uura
meaning_en: By nourishing oneself, one earns the vitality to feed others; you must secure your own strength and sustenance before you can nourish dependents

proverb: Obboleettiin koo san dhaltee niin kakadha malee, saniif dhaltee hin kakadhu
meaning_om: Jaalallii fi kabajni fira dhiigaatiif qaban kan nama alagaa wajjin wal hin gahu; dhiigni dhiigaaf dursa kenna
meaning_en: I swear oaths because my sister gave birth, but I do not swear on behalf of her husband's clan; blood ties command loyalty, not outside affines

proverb: Obbollessa akkanaa, nama dhiisii waraabessilleen ni qaba
meaning_om: Obboleessa yookaan fira faayidaa fi deeggarsa hin qabne, kan gargaarsa malee ba'aa qofa ta'e qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Such a worthless brother: let alone humans, even a hyena possesses one!; scathing critique of a completely useless, unhelpful sibling

proverb: Ofiifuu ni ciisaa, gaala maa danqita
meaning_om: Wanti tokko ofuma isaatiiyyuu dadhabaa fi kan socho'uu hin dandeenye ta'ee osoo jiruu, eeggannoo dabalataatiin of rakkisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The camel is already collapsed flat; why bother putting hobbles on it?; mocks wasting restrictive effort on someone who is already completely incapacitated

proverb: Okkoteen, waan hin nyaanneef gubatti
meaning_om: Namni hojii fi dadhabbii guddaa baatee garuu bu'aa sana osoo hin dhandhamin dhiphatu agarsiisa; tajaajila bu'aa dhabeessa ibsa
meaning_en: The clay pot gets scorched over food it will never taste; portrays unappreciated servants who toil and suffer to produce feasts they never enjoy

proverb: Oromoon waan fedhe haa jedhu, garaan natti as haa jedhu, jedhe goobanaan
meaning_om: Faayidaa dhuunfaa fi garaa guuttachuuf jedhee sabaa fi safuu dabarsee gurguruu ceepha'a; gantummaa garaatiin beekamu saaxila
meaning_en: 'Let the Oromo people say what they will, so long as my belly turns full toward me,' said Goobana; historic archetype of traitorous self-interest over people

proverb: Osoleen dhagaa gubbaa ooltee, dhagaa jalatti duuti
meaning_om: Namni bakka balaa fi qorumsaa keessa boonee oolu dhuma irratti wantuma sanumaan kuffifamee dhumata; balaatti taphachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The hare spends all day sunning atop the rock, only to die crushed beneath it; living recklessly around dangerous perches leads to sudden doom

proverb: Osoo gowwaan taa'uu, beekaan dubbii fannisa
meaning_om: Nama beekaatu dubbii laaftuutti hin dhiisu; wanta furmaata barbaadu iddoo madaalawaatti tursiisee araara qopheessa
meaning_en: While the fool sits indifferent, the wise mediator suspends the dispute for measured counsel; the wise deliberate while fools ignore issues

proverb: Osoo kan ilkee soddomii jiruuti, kan ilkee takkaa rigaa naa kennaa jedhe
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii fi qabeenya hin qabne wanta nama qabuufillee hin malle dharra'ee of salphisuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: While those with thirty teeth sat unbothered, the man with a solitary tooth demanded a tooth-cleaning stick; absurd vanity from the deficient

proverb: Osoo nyaachuu isii hin beekini, harka dhiqatte
meaning_om: Wanta qabatamaan hin mirkanoofneef dursee qophaa'anii of gowwoomsuu; carraa hin dhufeef jarjaruu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Before even knowing if food would be offered, she washed her hands to dine; jumping the gun and preparing for phantom hospitality

proverb: Osoo waan argan taatee, dhuufuun daalattii dha
meaning_om: Wanti dhokataan tokko bifa qabatamaa qabaatee osoo mul'atee namni hundi qaanii isaa arga ture; qaanii dhokataa ibsa
meaning_en: If flatulence were visible to the eye, it would be dusty gray; if secret vices had tangible forms, human shame would cloud the air

proverb: Qa'ee suguyyaa sareen hin hanqattu, dhiigaa cumaa malee foon nyaata hin argattu, maaltu dhiba ree abbaa foon ofii jabeeffatu
meaning_om: Bakka bu'aa hin qabneetti kajeellaadhaan rarra'uun salphina fida; abbaan qabeenyaa qabeenya ofii eeggachuun mirga isaati
meaning_en: At the tick's yard the dog lingers, finding only dried blood, no meat; why blame the owner who tightly guards his own feast?; protect your own

proverb: Qaqqabaan muchaa, luugutti nama dabarsa
meaning_om: Wanta dhowwamaa yookaan balaa qabu tuttuquun suuta suutaan gara gocha guutuutti nama geessa; jalqaba irratti of eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: Fumbling with the teat leads directly to suckling; toying with temptation and lingering around taboo boundaries inevitably ends in full surrender

proverb: Qalameen hundi bishaan hin dhugduu, garii eeguma cuuphxi
meaning_om: Namoonni hundi wanta tokko keessa guutummaatti hin seenan; gariin toftaa fi of eeggannoodhaan xiqqoo yaalee baha
meaning_en: Not all baboons drink deeply from the river; some merely dip their tails; different people engage with ventures cautiously rather than diving fully

proverb: Qarri tilmaamaan beeka, wallaalaan dirree baasan beeka
meaning_om: Nama qaxaleef mallattoo xiqqoon hubachuun salphaadha; gowwaa garuu qabatamaan harka qabanii yoo agarsiisan malee hin baru
meaning_en: The astute person understands from subtle calculation; the fool grasps it only when dragged into the open field; intelligence catches hints

proverb: Qirraarii kennanii, farsoo nama hin dhoowwatani
meaning_om: Wanta guddaa erga eegalanii yookaan kennanii booda, wanta itti aanu isa bu'uuraa dhowwachuun safuu cabsa; hojii guutuun xumuruu barsiisa
meaning_en: Having served the appetizer brew, one does not withhold the celebratory beer; once you initiate hospitality or commitments, carry them through to completion

proverb: Qoricha mukaa aarsanii, budawa hin faarsani
meaning_om: Balaadhaaf furmaata barbaadaa gama biraatiin ammoo madda balaa sanaa jajuun wal-dhahaadha; diina ofii faarsuu dhowwa
meaning_en: While burning medicinal herbs against evil, one does not praise the witch; never flatter the very source of toxicity while attempting to cure its poison

proverb: Raafuu nyaatee rafuu dide, dubbaa nyaatee dubbii dide
meaning_om: Nama haalli hunduu hin tasgabbeessine, wanta kennameef hunda mormuu fi amala dhabuu agarsiisu ceepha'a; nama quubsa hin qabne
meaning_en: Eating greens, he refused to sleep; eating squash, he refused to speak; critiques impossible, contrary individuals who find pretexts to be dissatisfied with everything

proverb: Rabbi, harka waa kennu hiyyummatti hin aansu
meaning_om: Namni arjaa ta'ee tola oolu Waaqayyo jalaa hin balleessu; arjummaan deebitee eebba fi badhaadhina fidi malee hiyyummaa hin fidu
meaning_en: God never allows the generous, giving hand to fall into destitution; divine providence faithfully replenishes and shelters those who practice open-handed charity

proverb: Rabbiin waa dhiira quufaa jennaan, osoo guyyaa salaasaa (lammaffoo) magaalaa watar dhayxee agartee jedhen
meaning_om: Hawaasni dhabamuu fi beela keessa jiruu akka waan quufeetti odeeffamu ceepha'a; qabatamni lafarra jiru kan biraati
meaning_en: When told 'God has satisfied the men', he retorted, 'If only you witnessed Tuesday market at Watar!'; punctures naive propaganda with the stark reality of rural scarcity

proverb: Reefki refka jedhe, kan jiraa awwaale
meaning_om: Balaa fi dhiphina duraanii irratti balleessaa guddaa kan biraa raawwachuudhaan haala daran mancaasuu qishnaadhaan balaaleffata
meaning_en: 'Corpse upon corpse!', cried the gravedigger who buried a living soul; piling a horrific, unpardonable blunder on top of an already tragic crisis

proverb: Re'een hortu adaadii dha
meaning_om: Wanti fuulduratti bu'aa guddaa fiduu fi milkaa'u mallattoo isaa jalqabuma irraa mul'isa; sanyiin gaariin calaqqisa
meaning_en: A doe destined to multiply into a vast flock is recognized by her healthy white markings; promising investments and productive ventures display early marks of vigor

proverb: Re'een tulluu gubbaa dhaabbattu, sa'a raaree keessa jiru caalaa fago agarti
meaning_om: Bakki fi sadarkaan namni irra jiru ilaalcha isaa murteessa; namni ilaalcha bal'aa fi bakka olka'aa qabu fagoo arga
meaning_en: The goat perched atop the mountain peak sees farther than the prized cow grazing down in the valley; elevated perspective beats ground-level prestige

proverb: Rooba quufaan, nama leenyoo hin qabne
meaning_om: Gammachuu yeroo gabaabaatti dagamee qophii gara fuulduraatiif meeshaa ittisaa dhabuu ceepha'a; of-dagannoo balaaleffata
meaning_en: Overjoyed and soaked by the glorious rain, he forgets he possesses no cape to dry himself; celebrating abundance while unprepared for its chill

proverb: Salaalee kola argattee, Ala shiiraa argatte maal gaafatta
meaning_om: Bakki hunduu kennaa fi eebba uumamaa isaaf malu qaba; uumaan nama hundaaf akkaataasaatti rizqii qooduu ibsa
meaning_en: Salale was blessed with fertile pastures, and Ala was blessed with rich loam; what more can one ask?; divine providence endows each community with unique bounty

proverb: Samiiti nyaara butaati, dachii qeensa keessi
meaning_om: Aarii fi dallansuu daangaa hin qabne keessa galee uumama mara morkachuu fi of miidhuu agarsiisa; aarii to'annaa dhabde ibsa
meaning_en: Scowling in fury at the high heavens, while digging his claws into the soil; describes wild, impotent rage that lashes out at heaven and earth alike

proverb: Sangaa gaafa beelaa, maganiitu nyaate
meaning_om: Wanta gara fuulduraatti yeroo rakkinaaf qusatame osoo faayidaa hin kennin balaan tasaa mancaasuu gaddaan ibsa; karoora fashale
meaning_en: The prize ox reserved for seasons of famine was suddenly devoured by epidemic disease; heartbreaking loss when emergency reserves perish before use

proverb: Sangaa gaafa boojjii mana hin dhoorkani, inninuu dadhabee dhiisa
meaning_om: Aarii yookaan kaka'umsa yerootiif daangaa darbe humnaan dhowwuu mannaa, yeroo kennaniifii ofumaan akka tasgabbaa'u gochuutu mala
meaning_en: Do not violently bar the stall door against an ox in heat; he will exhaust his frenzy and settle on his own; give volatile passions time to run their course

proverb: Silaa niin du'aa, maalfin sirra bu'aa jedhe buqqataan
meaning_om: Namni kufaatiin yookaan badiin isaa mirkanaa'e balaa dabalataa hin sodaatu; wanta qabate sanatti cichuun ofumaan dhumachuu filata
meaning_en: 'I am doomed to die anyway, why should I dismount from you?', said the swollen tick; someone facing ruin holds on recklessly without fear of the end

proverb: "Sirbitu maa hin sirbine" jennaan, "hangaan qabu luluu yoomiin hifadhe, hangi kunuu qooda obboleessa kiyyaati" jette intalti
meaning_om: Dandeettii fi qabeenya ofiitiin boonuun mirga ta'us, dhimma maatii fi safuu daangaa eeguun barbaachisaa ta'uu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: When challenged to dance boldly, the maiden retorted that she readily moves what is hers, though noting family claims; assertive defense of one's dignity

proverb: Soddaa deddeebi'uu heddummeessu, booddee mooyyeerra taa'i jedhaniin
meaning_om: Safeeffannaa fi kabajni fira soddaatiif qaban kan eegamu yoo daangaan jiraatedha; deddeebi'anii nuffisiisuun kabaja dhabsiisee salphina fida
meaning_en: An in-law who visits too frequently is eventually told to sit on the mortar; over-familiarity and lingering destroy the solemn respect owed to in-laws

proverb: Soddaan huuba ijaati
meaning_om: Hariiroon soddoommaa baay'ee laafaa fi safeeffannaa guddaa barbaada; akkuma iji huuba hin dandeenye, soddaanis mufannaa xiqqoon jeeqama
meaning_en: An in-law is like a speck in the eye; affinal relations are exquisitely delicate and sensitive; the slightest insult or misstep causes deep, painful irritation

proverb: Soddaa biratti daboo hin kadhatani
meaning_om: Warra soddaa duratti hiyyummaa fi kadhaa ofii mul'isuun safuu cabsa; kabaja maatii eeggachuun dirqama
meaning_en: Before one's in-laws, one never begs for communal charity or labor; maintain dignified independence and modesty before your affinal relations

proverb: Shahaadaa fi kafana nu hin dhoorkin
meaning_om: Kadhannaa amantii isa dhumaati; Waaqayyo xumura jireenyaa gaarii, qulqullina amantii fi awwaalcha kabajamaa akka namaaf laatu hawwachuu
meaning_en: Deny us not the final testimony of faith nor the honorable shroud; an earnest prayer for dying in grace, spiritual purity, and honorable burial

proverb: Sheenaan kutte, rahaamata hin qabdu
meaning_om: Erga dhimmi tokko badee fi carraan darbee booda gaabbuun furmaata hin fidu; yeroon of eeggannoo dhabuun kasaaraa fida
meaning_en: Belated remorse after the damage is severed carries no mercy; weeping over irreversible errors cannot restore what was destroyed through negligence

proverb: Sheenaa fi eegeen gama boodaati
meaning_om: Gaabbiin yeroo hunda erga gochi sun raawwatamee booda dhufa malee dura hin dhufu; osoo hin hojjatin dura yaaduu barsiisa
meaning_en: Remorse and the tail both bring up the rear; regret inevitably follows after the action is done; think carefully before acting to prevent rear-guard sorrow

proverb: Tafkiin lafatti wal nyaattee, namarratti waliin baati
meaning_om: Diinonni yookaan namoonni keessaan wal jibban faayidaa ormaa saamuuf yeroo dhufu tokkummaa uumanii namatti ka'u
meaning_en: Fleas feud among themselves on the dirt floor, yet band together to mount a human host; rivals unite when a shared target for exploitation appears

proverb: Tafkiin lafatti of hin dandeenye namarratti taphatti
meaning_om: Namni ofuma isaatiiyyuu humna hin qabne dahoo ormaatiin fayyadamee nama jabaatti roorrisuuf yaaluu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: The flea that cannot even sustain itself in the dirt dances arrogantly upon a human; weaklings acting bold only because they hitch onto a host

proverb: Tan namaa hiiytee tee hiite
meaning_om: Nama biraatti shira xaxanii fi waldhabdee uumanii gaa'ila isaanii diigan, deebitee bultiin ofiitiis ni diigamti; cubbuun deebii qaba
meaning_en: She conspired to untie another woman's marriage, only to find her own knots undone; malicious saboteurs face the collapse of their own household

proverb: Tan wagn duumtee daaktu qabduutu hundukkoo dhawata
meaning_om: Namni qophii duraa fi meeshaa hojii qabu yeroo qorumsi dhufe dhiphina malee nagaan jiraata; qophiin sodaa dhabsiisa
meaning_en: She whose flour is ground when clouds gather sips her warm soup at ease; the diligent homemaker with provisions ready fears no oncoming storm

proverb: Tarreen dhaddee, tanuma duraatu bishaan dhuga
meaning_om: Dorgommii fi jireenya keessatti namni dursa qabatee fi carraaqqii gochuun dura bu'e bu'aa argata; duubatti hafuun dhabama fida
meaning_en: In a marching line of porcupines, only the foremost one drinks clear water; those in the vanguard seize the spoils, while laggards get muddied dregs

proverb: Tapha keessa ijji bada
meaning_om: Qoosaa fi tapha daangaa darbe keessatti osoo hin yaadin balaa guddaan fi qaama miidhamuun dhalata; tapha keessattis of eeggannoo barsiisa
meaning_en: In the midst of careless play, an eye is permanently lost; unrestrained horseplay and reckless teasing easily escalate into catastrophic injury

proverb: Teeyriin bifa bineensaatiif duuti
meaning_om: Bareedinni fi faayilli daangaa darbe yeroo baay'ee balaa fi diinummaa nama irratti kakaasa; qabeenya ofii mul'isuun balaa fida
meaning_en: The bird is hunted down and killed for its beautiful plumage; conspicuous beauty, rare talent, or visible wealth attracts deadly envy and hunter traps

proverb: Teeyrii argan fufaa hin argani, fufaa argan teeyrii hin argani
meaning_om: Carraan fi meeshaan hojiif barbaachisu yeroo hundumaa wal hin simu; qophii fi carraan wal dhabuun dhiphina fida
meaning_en: When they spot the bird, they lack the bow; when they have the arrow ready, no bird appears; the frustrating mismatch of timing and opportunity

proverb: Teenya teenyumaa, shilingiin qamisa binne
meaning_om: Qabeenya ofiitiin wanta fedhan bitatanii bilisummaan itti fayyadamuun boona; kan ofiitti amanamuu ibsa
meaning_en: What is ours is truly ours; with our own shilling we purchased the shirt; proud independence in enjoying what was bought with one's own sweat

proverb: Tee ayliin haga bulteeti, teenya booroo bulte
meaning_om: Beekumsi fi muuxannoon kee kan ammaati, kan keenya garuu kan hundee fi seenaa dheeraa qabuudha; muuxannoo ganamaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Your cleverness is merely overnight knowledge; ours has resided in the inner council chamber for ages; generational wisdom over new upstarts

proverb: Tiiticha magaalaa ooleetu, nama baadiyyaa oolerra caala
meaning_om: Biyya arguun, deemsi fi hawaasa ammayyaa keessa ooluun dammaqinaa fi beekumsa addaa namaaf kenna; imalli sammuu bana
meaning_en: A fly that spent the day in the marketplace is sharper than a man who spent it isolated in the bush; exposure and travel sharpen the mind

proverb: Tokko namaaf makmaaka, tokko namatti makmaaka
meaning_om: Haasaan fi mammaaksi bifa lama qaba; gariin gorsaaf yoo ta'u gariin ammoo qishnaa fi arrabsoof kan darbatamuudha; qalbii qabaachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: One person quotes a proverb to counsel and uplift you, while another hurls a proverb to ridicule you; cultivate discernment to understand intent

proverb: Ulfina mataa, mormi hin dhageenye
meaning_om: Namni dhihoo jiru yookaan gadi aanaan tokko kabajaa fi sadarkaa nama guddaa isa utubu sana hubachuu dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The supporting neck failed to perceive the noble honor of the head; subordinates or intimates often fail to appreciate the greatness beside them

proverb: utaalchatti kuruphoon teeyrii ni mooti
meaning_om: Hojii fi dandeettii dhuunfaa keessatti namni hunduu bakka itti cimaa ta'e qaba; dandeettiin addaa nama hundarra mul'ata
meaning_en: In ground leaping agility, the tiny antelope beats the soaring bird; every creature excels within its own natural element and specialized talent

proverb: Waa godhee, waa bira godhe
meaning_om: Gocha tokko raawwatee osoo hin tasgabbiin wanta biraa dabalatee xaxaa uumuu; dhimma dhimma irratti fe'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: He performed one deed, and immediately engineered another complication beside it; compounding actions and creating multilayered intrigue

proverb: Waa hin bittuu, waa hin gurgurtuu, sareen hujii malee magaalaa baatee ulee dabalatti
meaning_om: Namni dhimma fi hojii qabatamaa hin qabne bakka koraa fi gabaatti jooruun salphinaa fi reebicha qofa ofitti fida; dhibaa'ummaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: Neither buying nor selling, the idle dog wanders to market only to earn a beating; aimlessly loafing in commercial centers invites unprovoked trouble

proverb: Waabeen asii hin badnee, madda irraa bade
meaning_om: Rakkoon mul'atu hanqina naannoo qofaa miti; hundee fi hoggansa bu'uuraa irraa manca'ee dhufe; hundee rakkoo qorachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: The river did not fail here; it dried up right at its mountain spring; the crisis is foundational and leadership-level, not a minor local symptom

proverb: Waan gowwaan nyaate, afaan isaa irratti beekani
meaning_om: Namni qalbii fi safeeffannaa hin qabne iccitii fi hanqina isaa dhoksuu hin danda'u; gochi isaa battalatti fuula isaarratti saaxilama
meaning_en: What the fool has devoured is recognized right on his greasy lips; simpletons lack the discretion to conceal their crimes, blunders, or indulgences

proverb: Waatoo jala waatu jira
meaning_om: Wanta alaan nagaa fakkaatu duuba iccitii, shira yookaan dhimmi dhokataan jiraachuu agarsiisa; eeggannoo fi qorannoo barbaada
meaning_en: Beneath the woven straw mat, something hidden lies; things are not as innocent as they seem; beneath polite facades lurk hidden plots or secrets

proverb: Waatti gamaa iyyaa, malaanuu lukkuu tiyya
meaning_om: Balaan yookaan dubbiin fagootti ka'e garuu xiyyeeffannaan isaa gara qabeenya fi jireenya kiyyaatti ta'uu hubachuu; dammaqina agarsiisa
meaning_en: Something screams from across the river, yet its true target is my own hen; distant commotion or legislation that is calculated to strike one's assets

proverb: Waaree nagayaan galte, aannan mi'aawa
meaning_om: Hojiin fi imalli yoo nagaan xumurame bu'aan isaa gammachuu fi tasgabbii guutuu namaaf kenna; nagaan bu'uura gammachuuti
meaning_en: When the midday pasture concludes with safe homecoming, the milk tastes sweet; prosperity and abundance can only be savored when accompanied by peace

proverb: Wadalli harree, araddaa lamatti hin iyyu
meaning_om: Dhiirri yookaan gootni hundee fi iddoo tokkotti kabajaa fi sagalee qabaata malee bakka hundaatti akka fedhetti hin dhaadatu; daangaa ofii beekuu
meaning_en: A male donkey does not bray in two separate village commons; a leader or champion holds legitimate sway and voice within his own territory, not abroad

proverb: Wal bira jireenyaa, ijji mataa hin agarre
meaning_om: Dhiheenyi qaamaa yoo jiraateyyuu wanta ofirra jiru hundumaa arguun akka hin danda'amne; of-hubannoo dhabuu fi dhiheenya gowwoomsu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Though living in closest proximity, the eye never saw the top of its own head; physical closeness does not mean complete insight into one's own blind spots

proverb: Walii naasuun warra keenyaa, ilkee koflaati jedhe waraabessi
meaning_om: Hawaasa amanamummaa dhabe keessatti jaalallii fi mararfannaan fakkeessummaa qofa ta'uu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a; firooma sobaa saaxila
meaning_en: 'The only sympathy our family shows is grinning with bared teeth,' said the hyena; bitter satire on hollow, predatory families whose 'love' is menacing mockery

proverb: Waliin ga'een dirrisaan, sinbira garbuu ficcisiisa
meaning_om: Hojiin yoo qindoominaa fi tokkummaan hojjetame bu'aa guddaa fida; diina yookaan qorumsa hunda mo'achuun danda'ama
meaning_en: Coordinated shouting along the perimeter makes the thieving birds drop the stolen barley; united teamwork protects the harvest and defeats pests

proverb: Waraana dheeraa fi obboleessa dureessa, anbaan sodaachisani
meaning_om: Meeshaa jabaa fi deeggarsa fira cimaa qabaachuun hawaasa keessatti kabajaa fi sodaa ormaa namaaf fida; firi gaachana namaati
meaning_en: With an extra-long spear and an affluent brother, one easily intimidates adversaries; formidable weapons and powerful kin provide unbeatable deterrence

proverb: Waraabessi biyya isa hin beekne dhaqee, "ani wadaajaa kal'oo naa afaa" jedhe
meaning_om: Namni amala badaadhaan beekamu bakka orma namni isa hin beekne dhaqee akka nama qulqulluu fi amantiitti of dhiheessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The hyena went to a country where he was unknown and declared, 'I am a cleric; spread a prayer rug for me!'; wolves masquerading as holy men among strangers

proverb: Waraabessi buquqa nyaataaf, majaan isaa adii dha
meaning_om: Gochi, nyaannii fi jireenyi namni tokko keessa oolu bu'aa fi mallattoo isaatiin ifatti mul'ata malee hin dhokatu; ragaan keessaa ifa baha
meaning_en: Because the hyena feeds on dry bleached bones, his droppings are chalky white; one's diet, habits, and secret vices inevitably leave unmistakable traces

proverb: Warra keenyaaf filaan hin tahu jedhe jaldeessi
meaning_om: Wanta aadaa, amala fi uumama ofiitiin wal hin simne fudhachuun bu'aa hin qabu; wanta ofii madaalu qofa fayyadamuu barsiisa
meaning_en: 'For our kind of people, a hair-comb is completely useless,' said the baboon; rejecting tools, luxuries, or customs that have no practical relevance to one's reality

proverb: Yaa arraba, siifan kabalame jedhe gurri
meaning_om: Dogoggoraa fi arrabsoo afaaniin baheen miidhaan fi rukuttaan qaama guutuu irratti dhufa; arraba eeggachuu dhabuun qaama mara miidha
meaning_en: 'Oh tongue, it is because of you that I was slapped!' lamented the ear; reckless, provocative words spoken by the tongue bring physical beatings down on the innocent head

proverb: Yaa bir bir, osoon burqaa kee beekuu na nyaattaa jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Nama hundee, ka'umsa fi dadhabina isaa beektu dura dhaabbatanii sodaachuu dhiisuu; hundee beekuun humna namaaf kenna
meaning_en: 'Oh churning brook, do you think you can drown me when I know your very spring?', said the man; refusing to be intimidated by a power whose modest origin you know

proverb: Yaa dhabanee tiyya dhabarra naaf jirtaa, mataa fufaa gootee nama'rra naaf jirtaa
meaning_om: Nama homaa hin qabne garuu of tuulummaa fi boonaan orma caaluuf yaalu qishnaan ceepha'a; qullaa ta'anii boonuun qaaniidha
meaning_en: Oh my destitute one: you sit mired in total poverty, yet you hold your head haughtily above everyone!; mocks destitute folks who display unbearable vanity

proverb: Yaa marqa, kan si jibbu barri haa jibbu
meaning_om: Nyaata aadaa fi qananii bu'uuraa tuffachuu dhowwuu; wanta jireenyaaf nama utubu hunda galataan simachuuf eebbisuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Oh beloved porridge, may the harsh times curse whoever despises you!; praise of humble staple food, condemning anyone snobbish enough to look down on daily bread

proverb: Yeroo takka niitii dhiiraatiin taa'ani, yeroo takka haadha dhiiraatiin taa'ani
meaning_om: Dubartiin jireenya keessatti kabajaa fi sadarkaa garaagaraa keessa dabarti; yeroo dargaggummaa dhiirsaan, yeroo dullumaa ammoo ilmaan boonti
meaning_en: At one season a woman reigns honored as the wife of a hero; in the next season she reigns honored as the mother of a hero; the dignified cycle of womanhood

proverb: Abbaa hin qabduu akaakkayyuuf boochi
meaning_om: Wanta dhihoo fi bu'uuraa isa dhabame dhiisanii, wanta fagoo fi dhiibbaa hin qabne irratti dhiphachuu ceepha'a; dursa dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: Lacking even a father, she mourns for a grandfather; satirizes neglecting immediate, pressing essentials to fret over distant, secondary concerns

proverb: Abbaan Abbayyii Gaaraati
meaning_om: Wanti guddaan fi beekamaan kamuu hundee fi madda bu'uuraa irraa akka dhufe; ka'umsa ofii beekuu fi kabajuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The father of the mighty Abay River is the mountain; all monumental creations, forces, and leaders originate from humble, enduring roots

proverb: Abbaan quba hin qabuu qubeen quba fixxe
meaning_om: Abbaan dhimmaa osoo homaa hin beekin wanti inni qopheesse yookaan barreesse balaa fi miidhaa guddaa irratti fiduu ibsa
meaning_en: The master was oblivious, yet the written letter wore out his fingers; undertaking actions or signing agreements whose catastrophic fallout one fails to foresee

proverb: Abbaan taa’aa bulu gundoon jala hin bultu
meaning_om: Namni dhibaa'aa fi hojii hin qabne qabeenya xiqqoollee tursiisuu hin danda'u; itti-gaafatamummaan dhabamuun badiisa fida
meaning_en: Under a master who lounges idly all night, not even a woven basket endures; negligence and sloth quickly dissolve even the simplest possessions

proverb: Abbaan manaa hanga manaa gaha
meaning_om: Abbaan manaa eegumsa, kabajaa fi itti gaafatamummaa guutuu qe'ee isaatiif qaba; manni kabajamaa kan ta'u kabaja abbaatiini
meaning_en: The master of the house equals the entire household; the presence, dignity, and leadership of the family head define the stature of the home

proverb: Abbaa dhoksitee haadhan kakatte
meaning_om: Dhugaa bu'uuraa isa guddaa dhoksanii wanta biraatiin soba mirkaneessuuf yaaluu; amanamummaa dhabuu fi shira agarsiisa
meaning_en: She concealed the father and swore an oath upon the mother; dodging the primary truth to take evasive, selective oaths on lesser points

proverb: Abbaanuu hin gallee Fardaaf booyanii
meaning_om: Lubbuu fi nama bu'uuraa dhiisanii qabeenya fi meeshaa laafaaf yaadda'uu; madaallii dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The master himself has not returned, yet they weep for the horse; lamenting material property while the human life is missing and in peril

proverb: "Abbatu of mara" jedhe Bofti
meaning_om: Namni kamuu nageenya, kabajaa fi daangaa ofiitiif ofumaan of eeggachuu fi of to'achuu akka qabu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'It is oneself that must coil itself into readiness,' said the serpent; personal defense, discipline, and posture are entirely one's own responsibility

proverb: Abjuu sodaaf hirriba hin dhabani
meaning_om: Balaa yookaan qorumsa dhufe sodaatanii wanta jireenyaaf bu'uura ta'e dhiisuun hin danda'amu; ija-jabinnaan jiraachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Fearing nightmares, one does not abandon sleep; never let fear of possible failure or danger paralyze you from taking necessary life actions

proverb: Abotee deegaa ija bobaasu ormi gootummaa seeti
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi beela keessaa kan ka'e aaruu fi bifa jijjiirrachuu namaa ormi akka jabinaatti ilaaluu; hubannoo dhabuu saaxila
meaning_en: A destitute man glaring with burning eyes from sheer hunger, outsiders mistake for fierce bravery; misreading agony as heroic confidence

proverb: Ablee qara lamaa beekaatu itti fayyadama
meaning_om: Wanta gama lamaanuu miidhaa fiduu danda'u dandeettii fi of eeggannoo guddaadhaan qabachuu akka barbaachisu ibsa
meaning_en: A double-edged blade requires an expert to wield; powerful, dangerous instruments or strategies must be handled with utmost skill to avoid self-injury

proverb: Addunyaan fixeensa ganamaati
meaning_om: Qabeenyi, jireenyii fi qananiin addunyaa yeroodhaaf malee dhaabbataa miti; dafee harca'ee bada waan ta'eef itti boonuu hin qaban
meaning_en: This earthly life is like morning dew; transient, fragile, and quickly evaporating under the sun; do not become arrogant over fleeting earthly possessions

proverb: Adurreen ilmoo ofii nyaattu caacuu Indaaqqoof hin naatu
meaning_om: Namni maatii fi fira ofii irratti gara-jabeessa ta'e ormaaf mararfannaa tokkollee hin qabaatu; gara-jabeessa amanuu dhowwa
meaning_en: A cat that consumes her own kittens will never spare the chicks of a chicken; one who is cruel to their own kin will show no mercy to outsiders

proverb: Addaatef ilkaan alanfachuu hin dhiisu
meaning_om: Bareedinni wanta tokkoo faayidaa fi hojii isaa isa bu'uuraa hin dhabamsiisu; wanti hunduu tajaajila uumamaa isaatiif oola
meaning_en: Even if teeth gleam bright white, they never cease their rough chewing; aesthetic beauty does not exempt anyone or anything from functional duty

proverb: Adala gowwoomsuun suuta suuta
meaning_om: Diina yookaan nama dammaqaa fi bala-qabeessa to'achuuf toftaa tasgabbaa'aa fi suuta jedhu fayyadamuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: Outwitting a wildcat must be done slowly and stealthily; subduing a sharp, volatile opponent requires patient, undetectable strategy

proverb: Addeessi callee dira
meaning_om: Yeroo ifti fi haalli mijataan argame wanta rakkisaa fi xiyyeeffannaa barbaadu hojjetanii milkeessuun danda'ama; carraatti fayyadamuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The clear moon provides light enough to string fine beads; when favorable conditions appear, take advantage to accomplish delicate tasks

proverb: Addeessi qoree baasa
meaning_om: Iftoominni fi dhugaan bakka jiranitti rakkoo fi balaa dhokataa salphaatti adda baasanii furmaata itti kennuun ni danda'ama
meaning_en: Bright moonlight enables one to extract the thorn; clarity, truth, and transparency expose hidden hazards and allow them to be safely removed

proverb: Afaan kijiba bare ni hollata
meaning_om: Namni soba amaleeffate yeroo dhugaan dhiyaattu qalbii dhabee naasuudhaan hollata; sobni sodaa fi saaxilamummaa fida
meaning_en: A mouth habituated to falsehood trembles when confronted with truth; chronic liars reveal their guilt through visible nervousness and stuttering

proverb: Afaan dhadhaqaan gandaan nama dhaqa
meaning_om: Namni afaan isaa hin to'anne oduu fi hasasa bu'aa hin qabneen bakka hunda deemee of salphisa; arraba eeggachuu dhowwa
meaning_en: A mouth that chatters loosely makes one roam shamelessly through the village; undisciplined talk drives a person into disgraceful social loitering

proverb: Afaaniin sheekuseen lukaan gara mukaa
meaning_om: Afaaniin amantii fi gaarummaa odeessaa gochaan garuu shiraa fi hanna raawwachuuf socho'uu ceepha'a; fakkeessummaa saaxila
meaning_en: Muttering prayers with the mouth, while the feet sneak toward the fruit tree to steal; biting satire on pious hypocrites masking greedy theft with prayer

proverb: Afaan gaariin afaa gaarii caala
meaning_om: Namatti dubbii mi'aawaa fi kabajaan dubbachuun qananii meeshaa alaa caalaa qalbii namaa boqochiisa; afaan gaariin jaalala uuma
meaning_en: Gracious, polite speech provides far greater comfort than a soft mattress; gentle courtesy soothes the human soul better than physical luxury

proverb: Afaan gaariin nama mootomsa afaan hamaan nama ajjeesa
meaning_om: Akkaataan dubbii namaa sadarkaa olaanaatti nama baasa yookaan gara badiisaa fi du'aatti nama geessa; humna arrabaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: Gracious speech crowns a person king; destructive speech leads one to execution; one's words hold the power of life, leadership, and ruin

proverb: Afaaniin maqanii miilan hooda dhaqu
meaning_om: Afaaniin waan sana jibbee fi dhiise fakkeessanii gochaan garuu gara wanta dhowwameetti deemuu; fakkeessummaa fi dharraa saaxila
meaning_en: Taking evasive detours with speech, while walking straight into the taboo shrine with one's feet; pretending disinterest while physically chasing the vice

proverb: “Anaan akkanatti diriirfattee teessu tun tan bor heerumuuf taatu” jette haftuun
meaning_om: Wanta carraan isaa dhumate abdatee haala qabatamaa jiru dagachuudhaan of gowwoomsuu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'This relaxed self of mine lounging with legs outstretched will surely wed tomorrow,' said the spinster; clinging to delusional romance while idling

proverb: Arjaan kennee hin quufu
meaning_om: Namni arjummaa amaleeffate yeroo hunda nama gargaaruu fi qabeenya qooduudhaan gammachuu argata malee hin nuffu
meaning_en: A truly generous person never tires of giving; magnanimous souls find their deepest joy and purpose in sharing, never begrudging the needy

proverb: Asheetaa fi bareeda bira hin dabran
meaning_om: Wanti hawwataan, bareedaa fi mi'aawaa ta'e yeroo hunda xiyyeeffannaa namaa harkisa; uumamni bareedina jaalata
meaning_en: Beside fresh roasting ears and stunning beauty, no traveler passes without stopping; natural splendor and sweet bounty command attention

proverb: Ana haa nyaatuu haadharra si haa nyaatuu haadha warraa wayya
meaning_om: Abaarsi yookaan mufannaan haadhaa kan haadha manaa caalaa balaa qaba; jaalallii fi kabajni haadhaaf kennamu hundarra caala
meaning_en: Better to hear 'may it eat you' from an angry wife than to hear 'may it eat me' from a grieving mother; a mother's pain carries fatal spiritual weight

proverb: Alanfachaa oolanis bishaan hin caccabu
meaning_om: Wanta uumamaan hin danda'amne fi jijjiiramuu hin dandeenye irratti tattaaffii bu'aa hin qabne dhiisuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Though you chew it from dawn till dusk, water cannot be broken into bites; do not exhaust your energy trying to crush what is inherently unyielding

proverb: Ajaawe jedhanii qaama ofii muranii hin gatani
meaning_om: Fira yookaan qabeenya ofii sababa hanqina yookaan amala badaa qabaateef salphaatti gatuun hin danda'amu; obsaan kunuunsuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Because it emits a foul odor, one does not hack off one's own limb; never discard flawed kin or personal foundations over temporary embarrassment

proverb: Arrabni xiqqoo hin qabdu
meaning_om: Jechi yookaan arrabsoo xiqqoo fakkaattu illee miidhaa guddaa fi lola lubbuu galaafatu uumuu dandeessi; afaan eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: The tongue knows no small scale; even a tiny, careless slip of the tongue can ignite monumental feuds and destroy lives; weigh every syllable

proverb: Amanamummaan saantima tokkorra
meaning_om: Namni qabeenya xiqqoo irratti hin amanamne wanta guddaa irrattis hin amanamu; amanamummaan waan xiqqaarraa eegala
meaning_en: Integrity begins with a single cent; honesty is tested in managing pennies; one who cheats over a copper coin cannot be trusted with a kingdom

proverb: “Arsii sadiin afaan qabee sadii tiyya rabbiin afaan qabe”jedhe hayyichi Arsii Daamuu Osuu dubbii kophaa fixaa ture
meaning_om: Beekumsa, ogummaa fi araara jaarsolii gurguddoo kan waldhabdee bal'aa nagaan tasgabbeessanii fi uumaa amanatan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Three times I held back the fury of Arsi, and three times God held my own tongue,' said the sage Daamuu Osuu; historical mastery in solitary peacemaking

proverb: Bara eeganii barruu horatu
meaning_om: Wanta tokkorratti milkaa'uuf yeroo fi haala qabatamaa naannoo eeggachuun, karooraan socho'uun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Achieving lasting prosperity requires understanding the times and adapting actions to the right season; timing and patience yield wealth

proverb: Bakka garaan jiru miilli ganamfata
meaning_om: Namni wanta jaalate, dharra'ee fi qalbii itti kenne argachuuf dafee barii ka'ee ifaaja malee hin dhibaa'u
meaning_en: When one's heart is truly set on an ambition or love, one rises at first light to pursue it; passion inspires early action

proverb: “Baalleen bor margaa kan du’e maal arga?” jette gogorriin namicha harkaa baatee
meaning_om: Qabeenya yookaan faaya dhabuu caalaa lubbuun hafuutu dursi; lubbuun yoo jiraatte wanti bade hundi deebi'ee bakka bu'a
meaning_en: 'Feathers will sprout again tomorrow, but what can a corpse see?' said the escaping partridge; preserving life is far superior to saving superficial assets

proverb: Barri hamaan mukarraa baala fixa, namarraa haala fixa
meaning_om: Akkuma hongeen muka irraa baala harcaaftu, dhiphinni fi rakkinni hamaanis amala gaarii fi safeeffannaa namootaa balleessa
meaning_en: Just as a harsh drought strips the tree of its foliage, severe poverty and suffering degrade the moral conduct and courtesy of people

proverb: Baajii jalaan qululluun bishaan dhuga
meaning_om: Nama humna yookaan dandeettii qabuun qixxaachuuf jedhanii tooftaa fi dhoksaadhaan dhimma ofii bakkaan gahachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Under the cover of the meek, the aggressive one drinks water; using subtle positioning and stealth to secure benefits beneath unassuming fronts

proverb: Baddu baddi malee saree ija hin dhiqan
meaning_om: Wanta uumama isaatiin kabaja hin qabne yookaan nama gorsa hin fudhanneef aarsaa fi kunuunsa gatii hin qabne dhiisuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Let it go blind if it must, but one does not wash a dog's eyes; do not waste noble, ceremonial efforts on fundamentally base and unappreciative entities

proverb: Bara leenci nama nyaate, deeroon nama kajeelti
meaning_om: Yeroo warri jajjaboon nama miidhanii fi kabajni namaa salphatetti, warri laafaanis ija jabina argatanii irratti roorrisuu jalqabu
meaning_en: When the terrifying lion begins devouring humans, even the frail gazelle eyes a man with contempt; fallen status invites disrespect from the meekest

proverb: Bakka loon hin oollee koboota hin guuran
meaning_om: Bakka madda qabeenyaa yookaan carraan hin jirretti bu'aa eeggachuun abjuu duwwaadha; waan hin jirre barbaaduu dhowwa
meaning_en: Where cattle never grazed, one does not search for dry dung cakes; it is futile to search for rewards in places devoid of the underlying resource

proverb: Baajii gaafni gadii gurri oli
meaning_om: Haalli wanta tokkoo faallaa fi walxaxaa ta'ee kan wal hin simne ta'uu ibsa; wanta bifa addaa fi bitaa nama dhibu agarsiisa
meaning_en: For the downward-horned cow, the horn points low while the ear stands high; describes an awkward contradiction or mismatched reality

proverb: “Bagan kufes bagan ka’es, kan na qabuuf natti fiiges kan na qaluuf natti fiiges arge” jette dullattiin sa’aa
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi qorumsa keessa darbuun fira dhugaa isa nama gargaaruu fi diina hamaa isa kufaatii namaa hawwu adda baasuuf bu'aa qaba
meaning_en: 'Glad I stumbled and glad I rose, for I discovered who rushed to rescue me and who rushed with a knife to slaughter me,' said the old cow; adversity reveals true motives

proverb: Balballi warra morkaa osoo hin cufamne bula
meaning_om: Namoonni walmorkii fi wal hin jaalanne keessa jiran wal shakkii fi nagaa dhabuudhaan yaaddoo keessa bulan malee tasgabbii hin qaban
meaning_en: The gate of a household consumed by bitter rivalry is left unlocked all night; internal friction and stubborn spite destroy basic domestic security

proverb: Bara barri dabe, bishaantu muka natti yaaba
meaning_om: Yeroon yoo jijjiiramee fi haalli yoo dabe, wanti uumamaan hin danda'amne illee ta'ee roorroon nama mudata; jireenya furguggoo ibsa
meaning_en: When the epoch turns crooked, water itself climbs the tree to drown me; an expression of bewilderment when cosmic order seems inverted against one

proverb: Barbaree harkaan dhaabanii, gubaa yaadan
meaning_om: Wanta balaa qabu ofumaan jalqabanii yookaan uumanii booda miidhaa isaa dhandhamuuf sodaachuun gowwummaadha; gochi bu'aa qaba
meaning_en: Having deliberately planted hot chili with your own hands, you now fret over the burning sting; do not initiate fiery actions if you cannot endure the consequences

proverb: Bakkuma amma jirtu sanitti yoo dhugaa arguu dadhabde, eessumattuu arguuf hin jirtu
meaning_om: Dhugaan, nagaanii fi bilchinni keessoo ofii fi qabatama amma jiran keessaa madda malee bakka jijjiiruun hin argamu; of qoruu barsiisa
meaning_en: If you cannot perceive truth right where you currently stand, you will discover it nowhere else; enlightenment begins with confronting present reality

proverb: Bakka itti kufte caalaa, bakka itti mucucaatte yaadadhu
meaning_om: Kufaatii booddee caalaa, sababaa fi ka'umsa dogoggorri duraa itti jalqabe qorachuun irra deebi'amee akka hin kufne nama gargaara
meaning_en: More than the place where you hit the ground, remember the slippery spot where your foot first lost traction; examine root causes to prevent future falls

proverb: Bakka garbiin hin jirretti, dhaddachatti sirbu
meaning_om: Bakka namni beekaa fi jabaan hin jirretti, warri dandeettii hin qabne akka waan hayyuu ta'aniitti of tuulanii kora jeeqaa
meaning_en: Where the true champion is absent, fools dance insolently in the seat of justice; when authentic authority is missing, charlatans strut unchecked

proverb: Bada hoolaa waatu si foola
meaning_om: Namni amala garraamii fakkaatu yoo gocha qaanii yookaan amala fokkisaa dhoksaatti qabaate saaxilanii ceepha'uuf kan gargaaruudha
meaning_en: Woe unto the sheep, an unsavory stench clings to you; exposes someone posing as meek and harmless who secretly carries foul, untrustworthy conduct

proverb: Bada re’ee, awwaalli kee qe’ee
meaning_om: Re'een akkuma qe'eetti qalamtee dhumattu, namni amala dadhabaa fi eeggannoo hin qabnes salphaatti manumatti salphata
meaning_en: Woe unto the goat, your grave is right in the homestead yard; an unadventurous, undisciplined creature meets its end without ever leaving the compound

proverb: Bakka hin galletti hin lolan
meaning_om: Bakka nagaan itti hin deebine yookaan iddoo dahoo hin qabnetti lola banuun balaadha; dursanii bu'uura ofii mirkaneeffatu
meaning_en: Do not launch a battle in a land where you have no shelter or refuge; never start hostilities unless you possess a secure fallback position

proverb: Bara hantuutni leenca moote, leencatu boolla hantuutaatti gala
meaning_om: Yeroon yoo jijjiiramee fi haalli yoo dabe, inni jabaan duraanii salphatee isa dadhabaa jala galuuf dirqama; jijjiirama baraa agarsiisa
meaning_en: In the era when the mouse overcomes the lion, the lion is forced to take refuge in the mouse's hole; historical inversions where giants submit to dwarfs

proverb: Baraa fi murxuxxee gadi jedhanii dabarfatu
meaning_om: Akkuma dhagaa wacaafaan darbatamu jalaa gad jedhanii milqan, yeroo rakkinni fi bara hamaan dhufus tasgabbiin gad of qabanii dabarsu
meaning_en: Adverse times and flying sling-stones are survived by ducking low; in seasons of tyranny and acute crisis, survival requires lying low and keeping a quiet profile

proverb: Baay'atu dammuu ni hadhaawa
meaning_om: Wanti kamiyyuu hammam mi'aawaa fi gaarii yoo ta'e illee yoo daangaa dabre nama nuffisiisa; madaallii jireenyaa eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: If taken in excess, even rich honey becomes unpalatably bitter; anything, no matter how delightful or good, turns repulsive when overdone

proverb: Bakka qeerransi ka'e, jaldeessi taa'a
meaning_om: Bakka namni jabaan fi kabajamaan dhiisee deeme namni dandeettii hin qabnee fi salphaan bu'ee of tuula; bakka bu'iinsa gad-aanaa saaxila
meaning_en: Where the leopard stood up and departed, the baboon takes a seat; an inferior, comical upstart moves in to occupy the vacated chair of a true powerhouse

proverb: Bara bishaan hammaate, yaatuu nama kajeela
meaning_om: Yeroo dhabinsi fi beelli hammaatetti wanta duraan tuffatamaa ture illee akka qabeenyaatti barbaadanii kajeelu
meaning_en: In the season when water dries up, one covets even stagnant puddle seepage; extreme scarcity forces people to value what was once despised

proverb: Balbala cufachurra, afaan cufachuu wayya
meaning_om: Manni cufamus arrabni yoo eegamuu baate badii fi lola fida; nagaa dhugaaf afaan ofii to'achuutu balbala manaa caala
meaning_en: Better to shutter your mouth than to lock your doorway; locking external gates does nothing if an uncontrolled tongue inside continues to ignite conflict

proverb: Bara bofni nama hidduu hammeesse, lootuun nama kajeelti
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan guddaan fi roorroon nama weerare, namoonni dadhaboonis sodaata dhabanii nama irratti tuffii agarsiisu
meaning_en: In the season when deadly vipers intensify their strikes, even the harmless lizard boldly sizes up a human; crisis emboldens minor pests to show contempt

proverb: Baalli geeshoo fi baalli jimaa wal fakkaatus, kan farsoof oolu garuu baala geeshooti
meaning_om: Wanti bifa alaan walfakkaatu faayidaa fi uumama keessootiin adda ta'uu; bifa qofaan osoo hin taane faayidaan madaaluu barsiisa
meaning_en: Though the leaves of hops (geeshoo) and khat look alike, only hops brew the traditional beer; external resemblance cannot substitute for specific functional purpose

proverb: Beekaa bira dhahanii, wallaalaa dirra dhahani
meaning_om: Nama qalbii qabuuf mallattoo fi fakkeenyaan hubachiisuun gahaadha; nama gowwaa garuu qabatamaan adabanii malee hin sirreeffamu
meaning_en: Near a wise person, you merely strike the earth; a fool must be thrashed directly upon his back; subtlety guides the wise, but fools require blunt force

proverb: Beerri dhiirsa hin qabne, booya fardaa dhaqxi
meaning_om: Namni nama isaaf dhimmu yookaan maatii hin qabne dhimma bu'aa hin qabne fi kan nama biraa keessatti dhiphatee yeroo guba
meaning_en: A woman without a husband joins the mourning wake for a horse; someone devoid of purposeful family anchors wastes emotional energy on irrelevant affairs

proverb: Qoreen miila namaa madeessiti, hiriyaa gadheen garuu sammuu namaa madeessiti
meaning_om: Miidhaan qaamaa yeroon fayyuu kan danda'u ta'us, dhiibbaan fi summiin hiriyaa badaarraa dhufu sammuu fi qalbii barbadeessa
meaning_en: A thorn merely punctures the foot, but a toxic companion poisons and wounds the mind; moral corruption from bad friends is far worse than physical injuries

proverb: Beekumsa kee guyyaa tokkoof yoo dagatte, inni immoo guyyaa lamaaf si dagata
meaning_om: Ogummaa fi beekumsi yoo yeroo hunda itti hin fayyadamnee fi hin leenjine dafee nama jalaa bada; cichoomina qabaachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: If you neglect your skill for a single day, it will abandon you for two days; professional mastery and scholarship decay rapidly without daily practice

proverb: Biyya ofii gaaddisa darguu aduun nama hin argu; biyya ormaa yaa gaaddisa mukaa aduun nama dhuga
meaning_om: Biyya ofii keessatti kabajaa, nagaa fi dahoo guutuutu jira; biyya ormaa keessatti garuu qananiin yoo jiraateyyuu salphinni fi roorroon nama miidha
meaning_en: In your homeland there is deep communal shelter where the burning sun cannot touch you; in foreign lands even under a tree, the sun saps your life; home is dignity

proverb: Bishaanifuu marqaan haa xinnaatu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi yoo jiraatellee qusannaan jiraachuutu mala; waan hunda qisaasessuu dhiisuu
meaning_en: Even when resources seem boundless, one should exercise moderation and not waste

proverb: Bishaan wal hin eegu
meaning_om: Yeroon fi carraan namaaf hin dhaabbatu; akkuma yaa'a bishaanii wanti hunduu yeroodhaan darba
meaning_en: Time and opportunity wait for no one; just like flowing water, events pass irreversibly

proverb: Bitata wallaalanii gabaa abaran
meaning_om: Hanqinaa fi wallaalummaa ofii dagatanii haala yookaan namoota biraa komachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Blaming external circumstances or institutions for failures caused by one's own ignorance or lack of skill

proverb: Bishaan mixiin lagaa waraabdeen jaldeessi qaama dhiqata
meaning_om: Dadhabbiifi dafqa nama laafaa ykn hiyyeessaa namni humna qabu bu'aa dhuunfaaf saamuusaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: The powerful and unscrupulous casually consume and exploit the hard-won toil of the weak

proverb: Bishaan sareen waraabde sarematu dhuga
meaning_om: Wanta qulqullina hin qabne yookaan karaa badaadhaan argame namni amala qabu itti hin dhimmaamu
meaning_en: What is produced through corrupt or base means is only fit for and consumed by base individuals

proverb: Biiftuun lama baatus jaaman hin argu
meaning_om: Ragaan fi dhugaan hammamiyyuu ifa yoo ta'e namni qalbii cufatee fi hubannaa hin qabne hin argu
meaning_en: No amount of glaring evidence or truth can enlighten someone whose mind is willfully closed or blind

proverb: Boochistuun booya hin argattu
meaning_om: Namni wanta hunda fakkeessummaan fi bu'aadhaaf qofa hojjetu gaafa rakkoo jaalala dhugaa dhaba
meaning_en: One who performs deeds out of superficial pretense or mercenary gain will find no genuine sympathy when in need

proverb: Boqqoolloon osoo gubatu kolfa
meaning_om: Rakkinaa fi dhiphina cimaa keessatti iyyuu hamilee dhabuu dhiisanii fuula ifaa agarsiisuu; akkasumas gowwaan badii isaatti kolfuu
meaning_en: Showing good cheer in the face of agonizing trials; or oblivious fools laughing while being ruined

proverb: Bungulloo fudhattee dhagaa nama yaadachiifti
meaning_om: Tola oolmaa namaaf godhame fudhatanii booda wanta nama miidhu yookaan gara-jabina calaqqisiisuu
meaning_en: Receiving benevolence only to repay it with hard-heartedness or cold, unyielding ingratitude

proverb: Buukkoo fuuti bannaan booyichi bade
meaning_om: Maddi jeequmsaa yookaan namni waldhabdee kakaasu yoo dhabame nagaan battalatti bu'a
meaning_en: Removing the root instigator of domestic strife instantly restores quiet, relief, and peace

proverb: Buqqeen lagatti marmaartu cabuun ishee hin oolu
meaning_om: Namni yeroo hunda bakka balaan jirutti deddeebi'u dhumarratti kufaatii fi miidhaa jalaa hin bahu
meaning_en: Persistently flirting with danger and volatile environments inevitably results in total destruction

proverb: Buna lubbuuf xaaxahu, warri naa tolii kadhata
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi gidiraa nama tokkoo irra dhaabbatanii namoonni biraa faayidaa fi gammachuu ofii hawwuu
meaning_en: Rejoicing over benefits and savoring enjoyment extracted from the painful suffering of another

proverb: Badduun fira ishee yoo hamattee, baddu baatuun dhiirsa ishee hamatti
meaning_om: Safuu dhabuun sadarkaa qaba; nama fira hamaturra kan manasaa fi iccitii bultii isaa saaxilutu caalaatti badaadha
meaning_en: Slandering relatives is bad, but exposing and defaming one's own spouse is the pinnacle of shameless depravity

proverb: Balaliitee balaliitee allaattiin lafa hin hanqattu
meaning_om: Namni hammamiyyuu ol ka'ee yoo boone, dhumni isaa gad of deebisuu fi gara uumamaatti deebi'uudha
meaning_en: However high one rises in pride or ambition, mortality and earthly limits eventually bring everyone down

proverb: Bara fuggisoo harreen gara manaa, sareen gara margaa
meaning_om: Yeroo sirnii fi aadaan jallate, iddoon kabajamaa fi gad-aanaan wal jijjiiree seeraan ala ta'uu
meaning_en: When times turn upside down, natural order is inverted; the unworthy are exalted and the worthy displaced

proverb: Beekaan namaa afaan cufata malee hulaa hin cufatu
meaning_om: Namni hubataan arraba isaa to'atee nagaa eeggata, garuu keessummaa fi nama rakkateef arjummaa balbala isaa banaa godha
meaning_en: A wise person exercises strict discipline over his tongue, yet keeps his doorway wide open in hospitality and generosity

proverb: Billaachi otoo ofii hin uffatiin dhakaatti uffisti
meaning_om: Ofii isaatiiyyuu hiyyeessa fi qullaa ta'anii, nama biraatiif akka waan qabeenya qabaniitti tola ooluuf yaaluu
meaning_en: Attempting to provide for or reform others when one is completely destitute and helpless oneself

proverb: Bishaan maaltu goossa jennaan, waan achi keessa jiru gaafadhu jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Qulqullinaa fi amala wanta tokkoo baruuf wantoota isa keessa jiraatanii fi bu'aa isaa ilaaluun gahaadha
meaning_en: To evaluate the quality of a system or environment, examine the condition of those who inhabit it

proverb: Boftiifi raachi hanga ganni darbutti wal faana jiraatu
meaning_om: Yeroo rakkina waloomaatti diinonni uumamaa illee dirqamaan nagaa buusanii waliin dabarsu
meaning_en: Dire shared emergencies compel natural adversaries to declare temporary truces and coexist peacefully

proverb: Bulbuluma bulbuli, hangan dhugu anuu beeka jedhe namtichi
meaning_om: Namoonni haala dhimma tokkoo jijjiiruuf hammamiyyuu yoo dhama'an, namni dammaqaan daangaa fi dantaa ofii beeka
meaning_en: No matter how others dilute terms or disguise a situation, a discerning person remains in firm control of their consumption

proverb: Bishaan nama nyaateef daakuu hin dhiisani
meaning_om: Balaan tasa uumamee jedhanii hojii fi jireenya itti fufuu dhiisuun hin ta'u; sodaaf kaayyoo hin dhiisani
meaning_en: One does not abandon an essential craft or life pursuit simply because accidents and tragedies happen

proverb: Caldheensi dhama dubbiiti
meaning_om: Haasaa baay'isuu caalaa cal'isanii yaaduu fi tasgabbaa'uun bu'uura ogummaa fi kabajaati
meaning_en: Dignified silence constitutes the deepest essence and strength of wisdom, far surpassing idle chatter

proverb: Cophaa bakka hundaa si hin dhabanii jennaan, “ati ka maalif deemtu na argite” jedheen Cophaan warra Loodee
meaning_om: Balleessaa ofii osoo hin ilaalin amala nama biraarra nanna'anii qeequu saaxiluu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Rebuking hypocritical accusers whose very presence at the scene proves they are guilty of the same conduct

proverb: Cittorratti fanxoon ni hammaatti
meaning_om: Rakkina duraan jiru irratti balaan isa caalaa hamaa fi suukanneessaan dabalamee dhufuu
meaning_en: An already agonizing and annoying predicament is overtaken by a far more lethal and catastrophic calamity

proverb: Coollayaan roobaa hin badadu
meaning_om: Bakka gargaarsii fi eebbi jirutitti namni rakkate dafee hin badu; dahoo argatee dandamata
meaning_en: A struggling person does not perish when placed in an environment of collective abundance and care

proverb: Cidha nadhoon feete aannan qodaa hin hanqatu
meaning_om: Dubartoonni yoo dhimma tokko jaalatanii fi itti murteessan wanti hunduu guutuu fi mi'aawaa ta'a
meaning_en: When women enthusiastically mobilize behind an event or household goal, resources and success are guaranteed

proverb: Caalan kan miicu, Caaltuun kan irratti miicamtu
meaning_om: Hawaasa keessatti tokko abbaa taayitaa ta'ee yoo roorrisu, inni biraan immoo miidhamaa fi ba'aa baatu ta'uu ibsa
meaning_en: Reflects social inequality where one party enjoys command and action, while the subordinate partner absorbs all the abrasive friction

proverb: Cubbuun bishaanii, harka buleen nama nyaachisa
meaning_om: Wanta qulqulluu fi madda jireenyaa ta'e yoo mancaasan adabbiin isaa firiin salphinaa fi xurii ta'ee deebi'a
meaning_en: Sins committed against sacred resources rebound as degrading deprivation and moral pollution

proverb: Cabaan baqaqatti irkate
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu dadhabaa ta'e nama akka isaatti humna hin qabneetti hirkatee kufaatii dachaa mudachuu
meaning_en: A compromised, vulnerable person relying for support on someone equally fragile, guaranteeing mutual collapse

proverb: Daaraan bubbetti hirkatti
meaning_om: Wanti laafaa fi bu'uura hin qabne wanta isa faffacaasu irratti hirkachuun badiisa fida
meaning_en: Leaning for support upon an unstable, violent force that will only scatter and destroy you

proverb: “Dubbanaan dubbii fixnee, yaabbannaan kooraa guunnee, kana caalaa miciif nu komattaa intaloo?” jedhe Daamuu Osuu namittiin tuffattee jennaan
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii, ogummaa fi gootummaan guutuu ta'e tokko umurii yookaan bifa isaatiin tuffatamuu mormuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Righteously refuting superficial contempt by demonstrating that one possesses unmatched mastery in both counsel and physical prowess

proverb: Dubbiin lafaa dubbii lafeeti
meaning_om: Dhimmi lafaa dhimma eenyummaa, dhiigaa fi lubbuuti malee salphaatti kan ilaalamu miti
meaning_en: Land disputes are existential conflicts touching the very marrow of ancestral lineage and identity

proverb: Durattuu durii malayyaa, Waaqo lama tahe
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan oduu duraanuu nuffisiisaa ture irratti ammas xaxaa haaraa dabalanii dubbii dheeressuu
meaning_en: Piling new complications onto an already ancient, tiresome drama; compounding an exhausted story

proverb: Dhiiraaf iyyani, dubartiin sakoo birmatti
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan cimaan qe'eetti dhufe namni kamuu osoo dhiiraa fi dubartii hin jedhin qabeenyaa fi maatii baraaruuf birmata
meaning_en: In moments of grave domestic peril, all hands rally to the defense, regardless of gender or conventional roles

proverb: Deegaa gabaabaa wayya akka buyyuun gahutti, sooressa dheeraa wayya akka gabaan arfutti
meaning_om: Haalli qabeenyaa fi bifti namaa wal simachuun barbaachisaadha; hiyyeessi wanta xiqqoon gahuu danda'a, sooreessi garuu akka mul'atutti tola
meaning_en: Modest means best suit modest needs, while abundance matches prominent stature; proportion in all circumstances

proverb: Dhungoo alagaarra ciniinnaa firaa wayya
meaning_om: Miidhaan fira dhiigaarraa dhufe jaalala qabaachuu danda'a; tola oolmaan ormaa garuu shiraa fi dantaa dhokataa qabaachuu mala
meaning_en: A painful reprimand from kin is rooted in care, whereas the flattering affection of an outsider often masks deceit

proverb: Dhunguun ormaa ifa keessatti
meaning_om: Hariiroo fi nagaan nama alagaa wajjin godhamu ifatti malee iccitii fi dhoksaan akka hin taane of eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Familiarity and affection with outsiders must be transparent and formal, avoiding dubious secrets or blind trust

proverb: Daaloo miila qabuuf miilan deemsa dhabu
meaning_om: Nama biraatti hirkachuuf jedhanii dandeettii fi carraaqqii mataa ofii dhiisuun kasaaraa fi salphina fida
meaning_en: Having an able-bodied servant or friend does not mean you should abandon your own feet; do not let helpers replace self-reliance

proverb: Dhiira kokkolfaa niitiin dhiirsa hin seetu
meaning_om: Dhiirri yeroo hundumaa qoosaa fi kofla baay'isu mana isaatti kabajaa fi ulfina abbaa warraatti malu dhabuu danda'a
meaning_en: A man who is perpetually joking and frivolous loses authoritative dignity in his household; familiar laughter erodes domestic respect

proverb: Dhiira waraannuu hin boochisne dubbiin boochisti
meaning_om: Miidhaan qaamaa isa jabaa hin laaffifne illee, arrabsoo fi jechi hamaanii qalbii seenee akka inni gaddus taasisa
meaning_en: A warrior immune to the agony of spear wounds is broken to tears by cutting words; emotional insult pierces deeper than cold steel

proverb: Duuti biyya wajjii komii hin qabu
meaning_om: Balaan yookaan qorumsi ummata mara mudate akka carraa walootti fudhatama malee namni tokko komii addaa hin qabaatu
meaning_en: Perishing alongside one's community bears no bitter grievance; collective calamity is endured with shared, uncomplaining fortitude

proverb: “Duuti biyya wajjii hirriba” jette hindaaqqoon
meaning_om: Gaddi fi qorumsi uummata wajjin baatan nama hin dhiphisu; tokkummaan ba'aa hunda salphisa
meaning_en: 'Dying together with the flock is as peaceful as sleep,' said the hen; facing disaster in collective unity removes the sting of terror

proverb: “Duruu boontaa ka ruufan si maranii ka tuutan si dhaqanii” jette namittiin masaanun duunan
meaning_om: Goonni fi ulfinni du'a booda namaaf godhamu wanta duraan dhabame hin bakka bu'u; qishnaa hinaaffaa fi du'aa agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'You were arrogant all along, now look at you wrapped in a turban and escorted by crowds!' said the woman at her co-wife's funeral; bitter rivalry scoffing at funeral pomp

proverb: Dhiira barri kuffise, sareetu jala girrisa
meaning_om: Gootni yeroon kufise namoota dadhaboo fi salphoo ta'aniin illee akka tuffatamu agarsiisa; carraan jijjiiramuu saaxila
meaning_en: A valiant man felled by adverse times is barked at even by common curs; misfortune exposes the mighty to the insolence of the base

proverb: Dhadhaa kana baasu malee, baasee dhugu malee lubbuun na hin deebitu
meaning_om: Fedhii dhuunfaa fi qananii tokko argachuuf bolola daangaa darbee fi dhiphina cimaa qabaachuu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'Unless I extract this butter and drink it down, my soul will not revive!'; satirizes desperate gluttony and obsessing over self-indulgence

proverb: Dugdaa fi ollaan lafaa ka’an
meaning_om: Namni guddinaa fi kabaja kan argatu deeggarsa fira dhiigaa fi nagaa ollaa qabaachuuni; tokkummaan madda milkaa'inaati
meaning_en: A person rises through a sturdy kin backbone and reliable neighbors; social elevation rests upon domestic solidarity and neighborhood goodwill

proverb: Dhabe jettee hin booyin, qaba jettee hin boonin
meaning_om: Jireenyi garagaggaltoo dha; dhabuu keessatti abdii hin kutatin, qabaachuu keessattis of hin tuulin; madaallii jireenyaa eeggadhu
meaning_en: Weep not in despair over poverty, nor boast arrogantly in times of wealth; maintain noble equanimity through life's fluctuating cycles

proverb: Dhalootan hin beekan, namarraa baratan
meaning_om: Namni beekumsa qabatee hin dhalatu; ogummaa fi dandeettiin kamuu gorsa, barnootaa fi muuxannoo hawaasaarraa argama
meaning_en: No one is born omniscient; wisdom, tradecraft, and manners are learned from community teachers and elders; value learning

proverb: Dheeraan utaalchaan mallaan, gabaabaan hulluuquu malee
meaning_om: Namni hunduu akkaataa uumamaa fi dandeettii isaatti fala barbaaddata; gabaabbachuun mala dhabuu jechuu miti
meaning_en: While the tall man schemes how to leap over, the short man simply ducks beneath; every build and temperament has its own agile solution

proverb: Daakkiyyeen ofiin ceeti malee, namaan hin ceetu
meaning_om: Namni dandeettii dhuunfaa qabu ofuma isaatiif milkaa'a malee ba'aa nama biraa baatee ceesisuu hin danda'u; of-danda'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: A duck swims across the river alone; it cannot ferry passengers; individual capability does not equate to the capacity to carry dependents

proverb: Dubbii barbaada sareen gabaa baati
meaning_om: Namni tasgabbii hin qabnee fi lola barbaadu bakka wacii fi namni baay'atutti seenee balaa ofitti fida; amala rakkisaa saaxila
meaning_en: Seeking a fight, the hound strolls into the crowded market; troublemakers intentionally visit crowded spaces to provoke conflicts and earn beatings

proverb: Dubbii warra sadii akka saditti fixan: kan gowwaa sossobaan, kan hayyuu dhugaan, kan luynaa sodaachisuun
meaning_om: Akkaataa amala namaatti dubbii furuun ogummaadha; beekaaf dhugaa, gowwaaf laafina, dabeessaaf ammoo jabina agarsiisuun fala fida
meaning_en: Disputes with three types are resolved in three ways: appease the fool with flattery, reason with the wise with plain truth, and subdue the coward with intimidation

proverb: Dubartii sadi dhoksaan, sadi gorsaan, sadi obsaan bulfatu
meaning_om: Bultii keessatti amala dubartootaa adda baasanii beekuudhaan; tokko iccitii eeguun, kaan gorsaan, kaan immoo obsa cimaadhaan hoogganu
meaning_en: In domestic governance, three types of women are managed with discreet secrecy, three with gentle advice, and three with steadfast patience

proverb: Dubartiin dheertuu malee beeytuu hin qabdu
meaning_om: Ilaalcha aadaa ganamaa isa beekumsi fi murtii koraa kan dhiiraati jedhee amanu qishnaan calaqqisiisa
meaning_en: A traditional patriarchal folk adage asserting that women may possess tall physical stature, but lack deep judicial wisdom; reflects historical gender views

proverb: Dubartiin furdoo malee guddoon hin jirtu
meaning_om: Ilaalcha durii isa hoggansaa fi ulfinni kora biyyaa dhiira qofaaf mala jedhu calaqqisiisa
meaning_en: Traditional patriarchal saying claiming that women may have physical bulk, but lack political greatness; reflects ancient customary gender divisions

proverb: “Dadhabbii koo taati malee hafa kee hin taatu” jette dhaddeen dinnicha haatee
meaning_om: Namni kaayyoo fi dantaa ofiitiif murannoon ka'e dadhabina osoo hin jibbini wanta barbaadu dhuunfachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'It will cost my utmost sweat, but none will be spared for you,' said the porcupine unearthing potatoes; stubborn determination to finish the prize despite fatigue

proverb: Dhugaa dubbachuu hin sodaatin, garuu dafii achii deemi
meaning_om: Dhugaa qajeelaan dubbatan yeroo baay'ee namoota aarsuu fi mufachiisuu waan danda'uuf, dhugaa baasanii balaarraa of eeguun ogummaadha
meaning_en: Never fear to speak the unvarnished truth, but be quick to step away once spoken; truth provokes anger, so pair honesty with tactical self-preservation

proverb: Duuti maqaan isaa hin tolu, ykn ni ture jedhu ykn ni ariifate jedhu
meaning_om: Duuti yoomiyyuu yoo dhufte komii namootaa jalaa hin baatu; maatiin yeroo hunda gaddaan komachuu irraa hin dhaabbatu
meaning_en: Death never enjoys a good reputation: people complain either that he lingered too long in suffering, or departed too abruptly; human grief is never satisfied

proverb: Duulli gaalaa dhaqee muka gaalaa jala taa'e, simbirti gaalaa dhaqxee irra teesse
meaning_om: Namni humnaa fi qabeenyaan wal caalus wantuma uumamaa walirra taa'ee qooddata; sadarkaan kamuu lafa tokkorratti wal qunnama
meaning_en: The camel-mounted troop arrived and rested beneath the acacia tree, while the tiny bird flew in and perched atop its branches; power and fragility sharing one tree

proverb: Dhageettee boottii dhoorgaa
meaning_om: Gaddi cimaan yoo nama mudate illee, orma duratti salphina dhoksuu fi jabinna agarsiisuuf jecha ijaan osoo hin booyin danda'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Hearing tragic news, she stoically restrains her tears; exercising supreme emotional discipline to avoid breaking down in front of onlookers

proverb: Dammaan qabatanii biyyoo arraabu
meaning_om: Waadaa fi faayidaa mi'aawaa namatti agarsiisanii booda garuu salphinaa fi hiyyummaa keessatti nama dhiisuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Lured by the promise of honey, they ended up licking dirt; seduced by sweet promises of luxury only to be abandoned in squalor

proverb: Daa’ima sooressaa dhungachuun gabbara fakkaatti
meaning_om: Nama qabeenya qabu biratti wanti tolaa godhan hunduu akka dantaa fi faayidaa barbaaduutti waan lakkaa'amuuf, of eeggannoo gochuun tola
meaning_en: Kissing a wealthy man's child looks like paying homage or a bride-price; innocent affection directed at the rich is cynically misinterpreted as flattery

proverb: Daakaniif hin marqan, yaadaniif hin argan
