meaning_om: Yaadaan dhiphachuun qofti wanta hawwan namaaf hin fidu; karoorri gara hojii qabatamaatti jijjiiramuu qaba
meaning_en: Grinding flour is not the same as cooking porridge, and merely wishing achieves no treasure; execution and labor must follow preparation

proverb: Dhamaatuun dhama raaftee, ro’oo komatti
meaning_om: Dandeettii dhabuu ofii dagatanii meeshaa hojii komachuun gowwummaadha; hanqina ofii ormatti fe'uu dhowwa
meaning_en: The clumsy churner shakes watery, butterless milk and blames the vessel; an incompetent worker blames their tools for their own failure

proverb: Dullacha alba’u abbaatu gara eegee baata
meaning_om: Rakkoo fi dhiphina maatii ofii kan salphina fidu namni biraa hin baatu; abbumatu obsee danda'a
meaning_en: An old cow afflicted with diarrhea, its master must bear the tail; the messy, embarrassing liabilities of one's own family must be handled by oneself

proverb: Duutuun du’a namatti gammaddi
meaning_om: Namni ofiisaatiiyyuu kufaatiif qophaa'e gadda ormaatti kolfuu fi gammaduun gowwummaa cimaadha; carraa ofii dagachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The doomed wretch rejoices over someone else's death; mocks foolish mortals who gloat over a neighbor's demise while standing in death's shadow themselves

proverb: Du’aatu du’a namaa oola
meaning_om: Balaan yookaan qorumsi xiqqoon dhufe wanta isa caalaa lubbuu balleessu jalaa nama oolchuun barakaa ta'uu danda'a
meaning_en: A minor brush with death spares one from absolute fatality; enduring a painful misfortune often averts a far greater, terminal catastrophe

proverb: Dhiisuuf kaloo jabbilee, haleeluuf loon warra soddaa, jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Filannoo rakkisaa fi dantaa wal-faallaa gidduutti qabamanii fala dhabuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'To spare it, that is the grazing ground of our young calves; to strike them, they are the cattle of my in-laws,' said the man; caught in a delicate dilemma

proverb: Deegan malee, Rabbiin hin beekani
meaning_om: Namni yeroo quufee fi qanani'u uumaa dagata; gaafa beellii fi dhiphinni hammaatu qofa qalbii jijjiirratee kadhannatti deebi'a
meaning_en: Unless stripped by destitution, humans rarely acknowledge God; comfort breeds complacency, while desperate poverty drives mortals to prayer

proverb: Dhalli namaa otoo nyaattu diida laalti
meaning_om: Namni wanta harkaa qabutti quufuu dhabee, yeroo sooratus yaaddoo fi kajeellaan gara waan biraatti ija dhiiba; bolola uumamaa ibsa
meaning_en: Even while eating, a human being gazes restlessly out into the distant plain; human appetite is perpetually unsatisfied, gazing beyond present bread

proverb: Dhirsi hamaan maaf hin nyaatiin jedhe niitii dhaana
meaning_om: Namni hammeenyaaf ka'e sababa bu'uura hin qabne uumee nama nagaa irratti roorrisa; roorroo sababa sobaa saaxila
meaning_en: A cruel husband beats his wife demanding 'Why haven't you eaten?!'; tyrannical bullies invent the most absurd, inverted excuses to justify abuse

proverb: Duulli biyya wajjinii godaansa
meaning_om: Qabsoon fi ba'aan ulfaataan yoo tokkummaan baatamaniif sodaan dhabamee akka imala nagaatti salphaa ta'a
meaning_en: A military campaign undertaken shoulder to shoulder with your community feels like a migration; collective solidarity turns terrifying war into common duty

proverb: “Dhabaafi malee, fooniif nu uume” jette sareen
meaning_om: Namni hiyyummaa fi dhabamuu keessa jiru qananii fi sooroma hawwaa of jajjabeessuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'It is only for want of luck, otherwise He created us specifically to feast on meat,' said the dog; finding humorous comfort in lofty appetites despite poverty

proverb: Dawaa ofii beekan namaa kudhaamu
meaning_om: Muuxannoo, furmaata fi gorsa ofii qoratanii bu'aa isaa argan qofa namaaf gumaachuun barbaachisaadha; wanta beekan qofa gorsu
meaning_en: A healing remedy one has personally tested, one ties as an amulet for another; offer counsel and remedies only when verified by your own experience

proverb: Erga waraabessi darbee, sareen dutti
meaning_om: Balaan yookaan diinni erga bira darbee booda gootummaa sobaa agarsiisuun dabeessummaa saaxila; yeroon lolaa darinaan dhaadachuun qaaniidha
meaning_en: After the hyena has safely vanished, the hound barks with ferocious courage; mocks cowardly bluster unleashed only after the danger has departed

proverb: Fagoon qabrii qofa
meaning_om: Addunyaa kanarratti fageenyi lafaa kamiinuu imalaan ni dhaqqabama; kan gonkumaa deebii hin qabne du'a qofaadha
meaning_en: The only insurmountable distance is the grave; no geographic road is truly impassable so long as one lives; death alone constitutes permanent exile

proverb: Foon foonirratti hin muran
meaning_om: Wanta duraanuu rakkinaa fi dhiphina qabu irratti ba'aa biraa dabalanii dhiphina dachaa uumuun safuu cabsa
meaning_en: One does not slice raw meat on top of meat; do not pile fresh injuries or excessive burdens upon an already wounded and tender situation

proverb: Fardi laalan wal qixa, raasaa gahu wal dida
meaning_om: Namoonni bifa alaan walfakkaatanis qorumsaa fi hojii qabatamaa keessatti dandeettiin isaanii adda baha; dandeettiin dirreerratti beekama
meaning_en: Inspected at rest, horses look equally fine, but reaching the marshy ravine their true stamina divides them; true grit is proven in the mud

proverb: Fayyaan cululleedha
meaning_om: Fayyaan qaamaa baay'ee laafaa fi saffisaan qilleensatti bararee kan baduudha; yeroo fayyaan jiru eeggannoo cimaan qabachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Physical health is as elusive and swift as a hawk; vitality can take flight in a fleeting instant; cherish and guard your wellness while it lasts

proverb: Fayyaan faaya
meaning_om: Badhaadhinni fi faayilli hundarra caalu qaama fayyaa qabaachuudha; fayyaa malee qabeenyi fi uffanni bareedaan gatii hin qabu
meaning_en: Sound health is the supreme jewel of life; physical well-being outshines gold, fine robes, and all outward decorations

proverb: Foolii gaariin kanniisa harkisa
meaning_om: Amalli gaariin, safeeffannaan fi arjummaan namoota gaggaarii fi barakaa gara ofiitti harkisa; gaarummaan jaalala uuma
meaning_en: A sweet fragrance naturally draws the honeybees; noble character, warmth, and integrity effortlessly attract upright companions and blessings

proverb: Fira fakkaatee risaan simbira nyaate
meaning_om: Diinni fi saamtun fira fakkaatee dhihaachuun dhoksaatti miidhaa guddaa nama irraan gaha; michuu sobaa irraa of eeggachuun dirqama
meaning_en: Disguised as a friend, the eagle devoured the little songbird; insidious predators use false kinship and trust to lure and destroy victims

proverb: Fuula itti hin quufne itti beela’u
meaning_om: Nama jaalatan isa duraan fuula ifaan wal argaa turan dhabuun gara gaddaa fi dharraa cimaatti nama geessa; jaalala dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: Before the beloved face one could never see enough of, one now languishes in starving grief; the painful agony of missing a cherished soul

proverb: Fardi biraan nama gaha malee, hin waraanu
meaning_om: Meeshaan yookaan gargaarsi namaa hanga bakka murteessaatti nama geessa malee, qabsoo fi gootummaan kan nama mataa isaati
meaning_en: A horse carries you right up to the enemy, but it will not fight the battle for you; tools can position you, but personal courage must strike

proverb: Foon qocaaf lafa kaayan allaattiin hin fudhattu
meaning_om: Wanti nama dhuunfaatiif murtaa'ee fi eebba isaaf ta'e ormaan hin saammamu; qooda ofiitti amanuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Meat set out specifically for the land tortoise, the soaring hawk does not snatch; that which is divinely allotted to you cannot be stolen by rivals

proverb: Fira nama hin gaafannerra, hiyyeessa mana namaatii hin baane wayya
meaning_om: Fira dhiigaa kan yeroo dhibee nama hin yaanne caalaa, harka-qalleessa mana namaa oolee jaalala fi nagaa qooddatuutu kabajama
meaning_en: Better an impoverished dependent who stays warmly by your hearth than wealthy kin who never check on your health; presence beats cold blood

proverb: Firri firuma, alagaan alaguma
meaning_om: Hammamiyyuu yoo wal dhaban firomni dhiigaa hin hafu; alagaan garuu yoo tola oolaniifillee daangaa fageenyaa qaba; dhiiga dursuu ibsa
meaning_en: Kin remains kin, and a stranger remains an outsider; family bonds endure through disputes, while outsiders always maintain emotional boundaries

proverb: Fincaan lukkuu kan arge haa himu
meaning_om: Wanta hin jirre, kan hin danda'amne fi soba bu'uura hin qabne akka ragaatti dhiheessuu balaaleffata
meaning_en: Whoever has ever laid eyes on chicken urine, let him speak up!; challenges impossible, absurd claims and fabricated testimonies

proverb: Farda kophaa fiiguu fi nama kophaa himatu hin amaniin
meaning_om: Morkataa fi falmii nama biraa osoo hin dhaggeeffatin dhugaan nama tokkoo qofti amansiisaa hin ta'u; murtii dura gama lamaanuu dhagahuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Do not trust a solitary galloping horse to be fastest, nor a solitary litigant's unverified grievance; justice requires hearing both sides before judging

proverb: Fagaatan malee mi’aa biyyaa hin beekani
meaning_om: Biyya ofii fi qe'ee dhalootaa keessaa bahee yoo rakkina alagaa hin dhandhamne, ulfinaa fi qananii biyya ofii baruun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: Unless one wanders far abroad, one cannot truly appreciate the sweetness of one's homeland; exile teaches the priceless value of home

proverb: Fokkisaan nama qabata malee, nama hin kadhatu
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa fi safuu hin qabne tolaa fi eeyyama namaatiin osoo hin taane roorroo fi dhiibbaadhaan nama dhiphisa; saalfii dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A coarse, repulsive person imposes himself by intrusive force rather than courteous request; boorish entitlement trampling social boundaries

proverb: Foon lakkayi jennaan “rajiijiin tokko” jedhe
meaning_om: Wanta bu'aa hin qabne fi laafaa ta'e akka waan gati-jabeessaatti lakkaa'anii heddummina fakkeessuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a; qulqullina dhabuu saaxila
meaning_en: Told to count the prime meat cuts, he shouted 'Chewy gristle counts as one!'; mocks inflating inventory or counting worthless scraps as substantial value

proverb: Firaan boonu malee firatti hin boonan
meaning_om: Humni fi kabajni namaa fira isaatiin kan dhufu waan ta'eef, firuma ofiitti of tuuluu fi boonuu dhiisanii wal kabajuutu mala; fira tuffachuu dhowwa
meaning_en: One derives pride and strength from kin, but one must never strut in haughty pride against kin; never demean the very family that forms your backbone

proverb: Gadamoojjii ginna, gadaan dhiltee dhinna
meaning_om: Sirna Gadaa keessatti maanguddoonni eebbaa fi heera eeguudhaan hawaasa akka nagaa fi badhaadhinatti ceesisan faarsuun aadaa kabajuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Through the sacred Gadamojjii elders, the Gadaa generational cycle preserves and safely transitions society; celebrating democratic ancestral continuity

proverb: Gadaan siqoo deemti, siixxee amba geetti
meaning_om: Sirnii fi heerri Oromoo suutuma suuta dhiibbaa gaarii fi iftoomina isaa fageenyatti babal'isee kabaja akka argatu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The Gadaa era moves forward step by measured step, and its sacred Siqqee staff reaches foreign horizons; lawful governance steadily expands

proverb: Gaarri haga dhiiban qaba, haga dhiisan qaba
meaning_om: Qorumsi fi morkiin kamiinuu daangaa qaba; wanta humnaa olii dhiibuu dhiisanii bakka isaatti dhiisuun ogummaadha
meaning_en: A mountain has a limit to how far it can be pushed, and a point where it must be left alone; recognize insurmountable bounds and withdraw in time

proverb: Garaan yoo booyan imimmaan bu’a
meaning_om: Gaddi fi dhiphinni dhugaan kan garaa keessaa madde yeroo hunda bifa qabatamaa fi imimmaaniin calaqqisa malee hin dhokatu
meaning_en: When the heart truly weeps within, authentic tears inevitably fall; genuine inward sorrow cannot be faked or concealed

proverb: Gamni waan kennaniif fudhatee, kan hafteef booya
meaning_om: Namni qaxaleen carraa yeroof argame harkatti galfatee osoo hin quufin isa hafe dabalataan argachuuf toftaa uuma; dantaa fageessuu ibsa
meaning_en: The shrewd operator takes whatever is handed to him, yet laments for whatever portion was withheld; maximizing gain through tactical dissatisfaction

proverb: Garaan udaan baatu dubbii baatuu hin dadhabu
meaning_om: Garaan namaa xurii fi dhibee ulfaataa baatee osoo danda'uu, iccitii fi dubbii dhagaye garaatti qabachuu dadhabuun salphinadha; arraba eeggachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A stomach that contains vile physical waste should not fail to contain mere spoken words; if your body holds filth, your mind should hold secrets

proverb: Gabataa qullaa qabataa bullaa
meaning_om: Hiyyummaa, dhabamuu fi beela hamaa keessa taa'anii obsaan dabarsuu; wanti sooratan dhabamus tasgabbiin buluu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Clutching an empty wooden platter, we endure through the night; captures the stoic dignity of impoverished households weathering bare starvation

proverb: Garaacha dheedhii garaatti beeki
meaning_om: Rakkina, hanqinaa fi gadda mana ofii keessaa baasanii ormatti odeessuu dhiisanii garaatti qabatanii obsuun safeeffannaadha; iccitii maatii eeguu
meaning_en: Keep tough, unchewable tripe hidden inside your own stomach; keep domestic hardships, disputes, and embarrassments strictly inside the household

proverb: Gamni obsaan gaara diiga
meaning_om: Namni ogummaa fi obsa qabu rakkoo fi gufuu hammamiyyuu guddaa ta'e suutuma suuta tarkaanfatee diigee bira darba; obsi humna hundarra caala
meaning_en: With patient persistence, a shrewd person levels a mountain; insurmountable barriers collapse before methodical, unhurried strategy

proverb: Gowwaan gurra babal’ata
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne wanta nama hin fayyanne fi oduu gandaa hunda funaanuuf gurra bana; dantaa dhabuu fi yeroo gubuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A fool spreads his ears wide to catch every passing rumor; simpletons waste their lives eagerly listening to frivolous and toxic village gossip

proverb: Gadheen qalbii hin qabdu, kan darbe hin yaadatu
meaning_om: Namni amala badaa qabu tola oolmaa duraan isaaf godhame yookaan balaa kanaan dura isa mudate dagatee deebisee dogoggora keessa gala; galata dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: A wretched scoundrel possesses no memory; he forgets both the favors once shown to him and the disasters that previously crushed him; unteachable ingratitude

proverb: Goshoo wal gante, afaan haga lagaa gaha
meaning_om: Yeroo namoonni shira wajjin xaxan wal ganan, iccitiin bahee wal arrabsuu fi wal saaxiluun isaanii dachee guutuu qaqqaba
meaning_en: Conspirators who double-cross one another open mouths as wide as the river in mutual recrimination; fallen partners blab all mutual filth

proverb: “Gabaabbadhus anumatu abbaa keetii” jedhe harreen gaangeen
meaning_om: Sadarkaa fi qabeenyaan yoo caalanillee, hundee fi maatii ofii tuffachuun safuudha; abbummaan dhaabbata qaamaan hin jijjiiramu
meaning_en: 'Short and humble as I am, I am still your sire,' said the donkey to the towering mule; social elevation does not erase ancestral paternity

proverb: Galanni mooyyee darbaa
meaning_om: Akkuma mooyyeen midhaan tultuudhaaf tajaajiltee booda bakkeetti gatamtu, namni tajaajila guddaa kennes yeroo baay'ee galata dhabee gatamuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: The reward of the grain mortar is being tossed into the bushes once pounding is done; faithful tools and tireless servants are discarded when no longer needed

proverb: Gadi deemtuun harree ribbii fuuti, sanuu waggaatti dhalti
meaning_om: Namni bakka isaaf hin malle naannawu balaa fi dhibee dabalataaf of saaxila malee bu'aa addaa hin argamsiisu; jooruu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A wandering she-donkey catches parasitic worms, and even with all her roaming she foals only once a year; restless wandering brings disease, not profit

proverb: Gadi galtuun warra soddaatti galti
meaning_om: Namni firaa fi qabeenya ofii dhabee kufe iddoo saalfannaa isaatti hirkachuuf dirqama; deegni daangaa safuu cabsa
meaning_en: The desperate destitute outcast ends up retreating to his in-laws' compound for food; extreme poverty forces a man to swallow his deepest pride

proverb: Galee hin galle, hatee hin hanne, hattuu gowwaa qorri gube
meaning_om: Murtii hatattamaa fudhachuu dadhabanii gidduutti daddaaquun kasaaraa fi dararaa fida; shakkiin nama miidha
meaning_en: Neither safely home nor gone raiding, having neither secured loot nor stayed innocent, the indecisive thief froze in the cold; paralysis brings ruin

proverb: “Gufuunnana ati gufuu gufumayyuu, anumti dheebisaa haa galuu” jedhe waraabessi
meaning_om: Nama jabaa fi qajeeltoo jijjiiruu dadhabanis dantaa dhuunfaa ofii fi nagaa ofii eeggachuun gara qe'eetti galuu wayya
meaning_en: 'Tree stump, you remain stubbornly fixed; let me at least go home watered!' said the hyena; recognizing an immovable obstacle and moving on to self-care

proverb: Garaan Qotiyyoo ciisuu, kan qotiyyoo dhaabbatuti
meaning_om: Namni hojii dhibaa'ee taa'us akkuma isa dhama'ee hojjetuu fedhii nyaataa fi qananii qabaata; garuu hojii malee nyaanni hin jiru
meaning_en: The appetite of the ox lying down inert matches the appetite of the ox standing at the plow; lazy loafers possess the same huge bellies as hardworking laborers

proverb: Ganna darbeen mana hin ijaaran
meaning_om: Carraa fi yeroo darbe irratti hirkachuun hin danda'amu; qophiin har'aa fi carraaqqiin ammaa egeree ijaaruuf barbaachisaadha
meaning_en: With the monsoon rains of a past year, one cannot thatch today's house; past accomplishments and bygone seasons cannot shelter today's living needs

proverb: Geerarsi gocha booda
meaning_om: Osoo hojiin hin xumuramin fi injifannoon hin mirkanaayin dura dhaadachuun gowwummaadha; gootni gochaan booda geerara
meaning_en: Heroic war-chanting belongs after the victory is won; never boast of valor before the battle; let tangible deeds precede vocal celebration

proverb: Guyyaa guuranii, halkan daakkatan
meaning_om: Hojii fi yeroo sirnaan qooddachuun milkaa'ina fida; yeroo hojiitti qabeenya walitti qabanii yeroo boqonnaatti gara faayidaatti jijjiiru
meaning_en: Gathering grain by daylight, and grinding flour by night; diligent, round-the-clock industry and methodical management build domestic abundance

proverb: Gaaddidduun ganamaa galgala hin jiru
meaning_om: Dargaggummaan, humni fi carraan ganama jireenyaa keessatti mul'atu yeroo dullumaa ni bada; yerootti fayyadamuun dirqama
meaning_en: The long shadow cast by the morning sun exists no more at dusk; youthful vigor and early opportunities vanish as life's evening falls

proverb: Gaadan waan biyyaa, nyaatan waan garaa
meaning_om: Waraanaa fi qabsoo keessatti maqaa sabaatiif wareegamanis, dhimma lubbuu tursiisuuf garuu soorata qabatamaatu barbaachisa
meaning_en: One stalks the wild hunt for communal renown, but one eats to satisfy the private stomach; balancing public civic duty with biological survival

proverb: Gowwaan bakka rafu hunda mana se’a
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne iddoo yeroof oole yookaan qubate akka qe'ee dhaabbataatti yaadee of dagata; hundee dhaabbataa dhabuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A fool imagines every place he sleeps overnight to be his permanent home; naive wanderers mistake temporary shelter for enduring roots

proverb: Gowwaan boollatti baqatee, itti hoo’inaan mana se’a
meaning_om: Rakkoo yookaan kiyyoo bala-qabeessa keessa seenee sababa boqonnaa yeroo xiqqoo argateef akka waan milkaa'eetti yaaduu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A fool seeks refuge in a pitfall, and because it shields him from the cold wind, mistakes it for a home; celebrating dangerous, temporary comfort in a trap

proverb: Gowwaan farda ergisaatiin boona
meaning_om: Qabeenya ormaatiin of tuuluu fi akka waan kan ofiitiitti boonanii of gowwoomsuu balaaleffata; kan ofii qabaachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A fool struts proudly upon a borrowed horse; mocks vain individuals who puff themselves up with borrowed wealth, vehicles, or borrowed titles

proverb: Garaa irraa du’aniif, gurraa du’anii
meaning_om: Namni kabajaa, maqaa fi seenaa ofiitiif jedhee wareegamu malee salphina beelaatiin du'uun ulfina akka hin qabne ibsa
meaning_en: Did they die for mere bread, or did they perish for the defense of honor?; dying for lofty principles confers immortality, while perishing for appetite brings shame

proverb: Garaan har’aaf, maqaan har’aa fi boru
meaning_om: Fedhiin garaa fi nyaanni har'uma dhumata; maqaa gaariin fi seenaan qajeelaan garuu dhaloota boriitiif illee darbee jiraata; naamusaf dursa kennu
meaning_en: The stomach is satisfied only for today, but an honorable name endures for today, tomorrow, and forever; prioritize lasting reputation over fleeting appetite

proverb: Gadhee garaan fincaani
meaning_om: Namni amala hin qabne waan sooratu fi waan hojjetuuf gatii hin kennu; fedhii foonii isaatiif qofa jiraatee safuu fi ulfina dhabsiisa
meaning_en: To a base scoundrel, the stomach is treated with as little dignity as urine; an unprincipled boor reduces his entire existence to crude, undignified consumption

proverb: Gurri abbaaf hubboodha
meaning_om: Odeeffannoo, maqaa fi kabajni nama dhuunfaa abbumaaf gati-jabeessa; namni kamuu wanta isa ilaallatuuf dursa xiyyeeffannaa kenna
meaning_en: To its owner, the ear is as precious as a vital water jar; one's own reputation, perception, and name are uniquely treasured by oneself

proverb: Garagalii waaqaa, miilli mataa hooqa
meaning_om: Yeroo haalli jireenyaa furguggamee fi sirni jijjiirame, wanti uumamaan gadi aanaa ture ol ka'ee isa guddaa irratti aangooma
meaning_en: In God's mysterious inversion, the foot reaches up to scratch the head; when times turn upside down, former underlings rule over their masters

proverb: Garagalii hatticha iyyaa?
meaning_om: Yeroo inni yakka hojjete ofuma isaatii iyyee akka waan miidhamaatti orma saaxiluuf yaalu qishnaadhaan mormuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: An outrageous inversion: the thief screams the robbery alarm!; satirizes brazen criminals who play the victim and shout down the rightful owner

proverb: Gorsaa fi sooqidda osoo hin gaafatamin hin kennin
meaning_om: Gorsi nama hin barbaadinitti yoo kenname tuffatama; akkuma soogidda nyaata hin gaafatamnetti dabaluun nyaaticha balleessuuti
meaning_en: Advice and salt: never dispense either until requested; offering unsolicited counsel is as destructive as dumping salt into a pot without tasting

proverb: Gowwaan dhume jennaan “ani jira” jedhe gowwaan
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne wanta salphina ta'e illee akka waan faayidaatti fudhatee of saaxila; of-walaalummaa gowwootaa ibsa
meaning_en: When they announced 'Fools have gone extinct!', a fool jumped out crying 'Here I am!'; simpletons possess an uncanny gift for self-indictment

proverb: Guyyaan cidhaa cidhuma
meaning_om: Guyyaan gammachuu fi kabajaa kanuma faaruu fi qananiiti malee gaddaa fi lolaaf iddoo hin qabu; yeroo gammachuutti gammaduu barsiisa
meaning_en: The wedding day is purely a wedding day; dedicated festive hours must not be spoiled by grievances or work; celebrate celebrations fully

proverb: Galgalli harree waraabessa
meaning_om: Harreen yoo galgala alatti hafte waraabessaan nyaatamuun ishee hin oolu; namni of eeggannoo dhabe balaa jalaa hin ba'u
meaning_en: The evening of the stray donkey belongs to the hyena; leaving one's assets or self unshielded at nightfall guarantees they become prey

proverb: Gatii ibiddi gubeef bishaan irratti naquun na qabbaneessa malee na hin fayyisu
meaning_om: Balaa fi miidhaa guddaa gaheef furmaanni yeroo xiqqoo boqonnaa kenna malee madaa sana guutummaatti hin fayyisu
meaning_en: Pouring water over a fresh burn soothes the searing heat, but does not heal the flesh; temporary palliatives should not be mistaken for complete cures

proverb: Gowwaan hundaan lola
meaning_om: Namni qalbii fi safeeffannaa hin qabne bakka dhaqe hundatti nama hunda wajjin wal dhabee nagaa dhabsiisa; amala rakkisaa ceepha'a
meaning_en: A fool picks a fight with every single person; someone devoid of wisdom and emotional discipline finds an enemy in every room

proverb: Goota faarsuun gootummaa irraa horachuuf
meaning_om: Gootota sabaa faarsuun akka dhaloonni haaraan gootummaa, murannoo fi jaalala biyyaa irraa dhaalu taasisa
meaning_en: One sings the praises of a valiant hero to inherit and cultivate courage from his example; honoring legends inspires bravery in youth

proverb: Gaarii namaa irra badaa ofii wayya
meaning_om: Wanta nama biraa isa bareedaa hawwuu mannaa, wantuma mataa ofii isa hanqina qabutti quufanii jiraachuutu ulfina qaba
meaning_en: Better to rely upon one's own humble, imperfect belongings than to covet the splendid property of another; self-reliance brings peace

proverb: Gowwaa kolfisiisanii ilkaan lakkaahu
meaning_om: Namni qalbii hin qabne kolfisiisanii fi faarsanii iccitii fi hanqina isaa hunda salphaatti afaan keessaa baafatu
meaning_en: By provoking a fool into careless laughter, onlookers count every tooth; flattering a simpleton makes him disclose all his private weaknesses

proverb: Gara mirgaa ta’e gara bitaa laalaa nama si gargaaru barbaaduun yeroo kee hin fixin; gara olii laalii 'Yaa Waaqayyo' jedhi, kan si fedhufi kan si eegu ni argatta
meaning_om: Gargaarsa namaarratti hirkachuu dhiisanii uumaa ofiitti amanamuun nagaa, abdii fi furmaata dhugaa namaaf kenna; kadhannaa Waaqayyoo barsiisa
meaning_en: Do not exhaust your life desperately looking left and right for mortal benefactors; turn your gaze upward to God, your ultimate protector

proverb: Goondaan wal qabatteet laga ceeti
meaning_om: Uumamni dadhabaan fi xiqqaaniyyuu yoo tokkummaa jabaa uuman balaa fi qorumsa guddaa laga ce'uu danda'u; tokkummaan humna
meaning_en: Holding firmly to one another in linked chains, tiny ants cross the swollen river; collective solidarity enables the fragile to conquer impossible torrents

proverb: Garaan nyaatu garaacha nyaatu
meaning_om: Bololli daangaa darbee fi dharraan foonii nama to'achuudhaan dhuma irratti qaamaa fi jireenya namaa keessaa mancaasa; bolola dhowwa
meaning_en: The stomach that craves to devour is the very stomach that gets consumed; insatiable greed and uncontrolled appetites end up devouring the host

proverb: Hangam amantus hantuutni adurree mootii hin godhattu
meaning_om: Hariiroon diina uumamaa wajjin godhamu daangaa qabaachuu qaba; nama balaa sitti fiduuf aangoo dabarsee kennuun of balleessuudha
meaning_en: However trusting she may be, a mouse never crowns a cat as sovereign; never surrender your governance or security into the hands of a natural predator

proverb: Harreen mana waraabessaa waamicha deemte deebitee hin galtu
meaning_om: Nama uumamaan si nyaachuuf kajeelu biratti tola ykn afeerraa barbaacha deemun gara du'aatti of geessuudha; kiyyoo diinaa saaxila
meaning_en: A donkey that accepts a dinner invitation to the hyena's den never returns; naive victims who visit a predator's territory walk into their own slaughter

proverb: Harreen waraabessa waliin gabaa hin deemtu
meaning_om: Namni laafaan nama isa nyaachuuf fiigu wajjin michoomuu fi imala waliinii gochuun balaa hin oolledha; hiriyaa bala-qabeessa dhowwa
meaning_en: A donkey does not journey to the market alongside a hyena; the defenseless should never enter into travel partnerships with ruthless predators

proverb: Hantuutni gowwaan adurree ragaa waamatti
meaning_om: Nama dantaa fi diinummaa sirratti qabu akka gargaaraatti yookaan ragaatti dhiheeffachuun gowwummaa isa dhumaati
meaning_en: The foolish mouse summons the cat to be her courtroom witness; utter folly of calling upon one's mortal enemy to vouch for one's cause

proverb: Hiyyummaan qabataa miti ni dabra
meaning_om: Rakkinnii fi dhabinsi yeroof nama mudate dhaabbataa miti; tattaaffii fi eebba Waaqaatiin jijjiiramee badhaadhinni dhufa; abdii horachiisa
meaning_en: Poverty is not an indelible brand; it is a passing season; through diligent labor and divine blessing, destitution gives way to prosperity

proverb: Hiyyeessaa tolu, dhaltii ajjeesa
meaning_om: Namni carraa dhabe yeroo xiqqoo bayyanatee jireenyi itti tolu ammas balaan biraa dhufee qabeenya bu'uuraa dhabsiisa; carraa dhabuu ibsa
meaning_en: Just when fortune begins favoring a pauper, his prime breeding cow dies; describes cruel, compounding ill-luck that strikes right at recovery

proverb: “Har’allee moo?” jedhe namittiin ofii cidha ooltee ijoolleen beelofne jennaan
meaning_om: Ofii quufanii qanani'aa oolanii dhiphinaa fi beela maatii ofii dagachuun gara-jabinnaa fi itti-gaafatamummaa dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Today again?!' snapped the mother returning from a banquet when told her children were hungry; selfish parents who indulge abroad while neglecting dependents

proverb: Horii abbaa hin qabne hundumatu kajeela
meaning_om: Qabeenya, maatii yookaan biyya eegduu fi hoggansa qajeelaa hin qabne ormi hundi saamuufi miidhuuf itti garagala; eegumsa dhabuu saaxila
meaning_en: Livestock that lack a master are coveted by every rogue; assets, children, or communities left unguarded become prey for opportunists

proverb: Hantuutni qalbii qabu tuulaa tumatee boollattin gala
meaning_om: Namni qalbii fi dur-argii qabu yeroo qananii fi oomishaatti boriif qusatee of qopheessa; qusannaa fi of eeggannoo barsiisa
meaning_en: A wise mouse secures its stockpile from the grain heap, then retreats into its burrow; industrious preparation followed by safe discretion

proverb: Harkaa dhabuun harkaa cabuu
meaning_om: Hiyyummaan fi qabeenya dhabuun akkuma qaama miidhamuutti nama laamsheesse hojii fi guddina nama dhowwa; dhiphina deegaa ibsa
meaning_en: Lacking resources in hand is like having fractured arms; poverty paralyzes human potential and enterprise just like a physical handicap

proverb: Haadhatu gaarree, ilmoon mummuxaa
meaning_om: Maatiin duraanuu hanqina fi amala badaa qabu ilmoonis amalummaasaa hordoftee akkasaanii taati; hundee fi firii wal fakkaatu ibsa
meaning_en: The mother is an odd bald-faced cow, and her offspring is a slippery, hairless runt; an eccentric, flawed stock invariably produces matching progeny

proverb: Haga humna ishee tafkiin dorrobdi
meaning_om: Uumamni hunduu hanguma dandeettii fi humna isaatiin ba'aa baata malee wanta humnaa olii hin yaalu; daangaa ofii beekuu barsiisa
meaning_en: A flea conceives and carries eggs strictly to the scale of her tiny frame; every being must limit their ambitions and burdens to their real capacity

proverb: Hiyyummaan teessoo duuba nama teessisti
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi hawaasa keessatti kabajaa fi sagalee dhabee gara duubaatti dhiibama; dhiibbaa qabeenyi ulfina irratti qabu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Poverty forces a person to take a seat behind the back row; lack of material wealth pushes capable individuals into the marginalized shadows

proverb: Haati gowwaa deesse osoo ciniinsifattu jiraatti
meaning_om: Ilma qalbii hin qabne guddifachuun yeroo hunda yaaddoo, qaanii fi dhiphina walirraa hin cinne maatiitti fida; gowwummaan dhalootaa gadda
meaning_en: A mother who gave birth to a fool lives in perpetual labor contractions; raising an incorrigible child is an endless, agonizing torment for parents

proverb: “Haga beekan mana eegan” jette jaartiin
meaning_om: Namni kamiyyuu dandeettii fi humna qabu hundaan itti gaafatamummaa ofii ba'achuuf carraaquu qaba; tattaaffii dhuunfaa jajjabeessa
meaning_en: 'One defends the homestead according to one's best strength,' said the old woman; do your utmost with whatever resources and vigor you possess

proverb: Haadha gowwaa deesse, hidhiin jalli madaa
meaning_om: Balleessaa fi gocha qaanii ijoolleen raawwatuuf haati yeroo hunda saalfattee hidhii ciniinnaa dhiphina keessa jiraatti
meaning_en: For the mother who bore a fool, her lower lip is perpetually raw from biting it in shame; parents constantly blush and bite their tongues over a fool's deeds

proverb: Harree ganama badde, galgala kurkuriin hin agartu
meaning_om: Wanta yeroo dheeraa dura badee fi fagaate yeroo dhihaatetti carraaqqii laafaadhaan argachuun hin danda'amu; qophii fi yerootti fayyadamuun dirqama
meaning_en: A donkey lost at dawn cannot be recovered at dusk by squinting through the twilight; neglected problems cannot be solved with belated half-measures

proverb: Handariin maal raqaa, rumichi maal ooydaa
meaning_om: Wanti tokko kan isaaf hin malle wajjin wal hin qunnamu; namni kamiinuu bakka uumamaa fi faayidaa isaatiif malu qofa barbaada
meaning_en: What business has a sacred horn-cup with a dead carcass, and what business has a vulture with farmland?; keep distinct things in their proper domains

proverb: Hora dhaqanii dhoqqee hin lagatan
meaning_om: Hojii bu'aa guddaa qabu keessa yoo seenan qormaata, dafqa fi dhiphina isa hordofee dhufu danda'uun dirqama; miidhaa bu'aa wajjin dhufu fudhachuu
meaning_en: Having traveled to the mineral springs, one cannot shrink from the mud; when pursuing valuable goals, accept the accompanying mess and hardships

proverb: Haga dhugaan kophee baafattuu, dharti addunyaa waliin geetti
meaning_om: Sobni fi ololli saffisaan kan tamsa'u yoo ta'u, dhugaan suuta qoramee ifatti bahuuf yeroo fudhata; oduu dafanii amanuu dhowwa
meaning_en: While truth is still untying its shoes, falsehood has circled the entire earth; lies spread with lightning speed, while verified truth arrives with slow dignity

proverb: “Haatee duute jennaan duruu qorsomaan bulla” jedhe mucaan
meaning_om: Namni duraanuu dhiphinaa fi hiyyummaa keessa ture balaa haaraatti hin rifatu; rakkina baree danda'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: When told 'Your mother died', the boy replied, 'We've been sleeping on dry crusts all along!'; chronic deprivation hardens a person against new shocks

proverb: Haguma duuge duugee cawwichi cawwummaa waakkate
meaning_om: Wanta uumama isaatiin jabaa fi amala badaa qabu hammamiyyuu yoo leenjisan jijjiiramuu diduu ceepha'a; gorsa didaa agarsiisa
meaning_en: However thoroughly he scraped and rubbed it, the coarse hide refused to soften; no amount of labor can reform an incorrigibly stubborn, crude nature

proverb: Himan didduun du’a hin diddu
meaning_om: Gorsa maatii fi jaarsolii tuffatanii diduun nama dandeessisus, badiisaa fi du'a gocha sana hordofee dhufu jalaa miliquun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: She who refuses wise counsel cannot refuse death; a headstrong rebel can easily dismiss words of advice, but cannot evade the fatal doom that follows

proverb: Himan didaa jiraa awwaalaa
meaning_om: Namni gorsa dhagahuu didee fi dhugaa tuffatu akkuma nama du'etti lakkaa'ama; qalbii dhabuun du'a qaamaa caala
meaning_en: He who refuses all advice is like burying a living person; an obstinately unteachable fool is socially, intellectually, and morally as dead as a corpse

proverb: Hiyyeessa booyicha hin gorsinaa, innuu keessaa naqaa
meaning_om: Nama duraanuu rakkinaa fi dhiphina keessa jiruuf gorsa dabalataa kennuun hin barbaachisu; inni miidhaa jireenyaa sirriitti beeka
meaning_en: Do not lecture an impoverished person on how to weep; he is already deeply steeped in mourning; do not patronize those who intimately know suffering

proverb: Haadhaa hin qabduu akkoof boossi
meaning_om: Wanta dhihoo fi murteessaa jireenyaa dhabanii osoo jiranii, wanta fagoo fi dhiibbaa xiqqaa qabuuf dhiphachuu ceepha'a; dursa dhabuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Lacking even a mother of her own, she weeps for a distant grandmother; satirizes neglecting immediate, pressing grief to weep over remote concerns

proverb: Harki abaaboo namaa kennu ni urgaawa
meaning_om: Namni nama biraatiif tola oolee fi jaalala gumaache duraan dursee qalbii fi jireenyi isaa nagaa fi eebba argata; arjummaan bu'aa fida
meaning_en: The hand that gives a fragrant flower to another retains the sweet fragrance; performing generous, loving acts blesses the giver first and foremost

proverb: Hanga laga ceetutti naacha hin arrabsin
meaning_om: Hanga balaa yookaan qorumsa keessaa nagaan baatutti diina qoccoluu fi aarsuu dhiisi; of-eeggannoon imala xumuruu barsiisa
meaning_en: Until you have safely crossed the river, do not taunt the crocodile; never prematurely antagonize a dangerous power while you remain within its reach

proverb: Hiriyaa kee dhugaa harka lamaanin qabadhu
meaning_om: Michuu amansiisaa fi qajeelaa argachuun ulfaataa waan ta'eef, jaalala fi kunuunsa guddaadhaan eeggachuu qabu; gatii hiriyyummaa ibsa
meaning_en: Clasp a true, tested friend with both of your hands; genuine loyalty is rare and priceless; hold fast to authentic companions with all your strength

proverb: Harki harka hin nyaatu, diina ofii malee
meaning_om: Namoonni sanyii fi hidda tokko qaban wal hin miidhan; yoo gantummaan fi diinummaan keessoo uumame malee tokkummaan wal eega
meaning_en: A hand does not turn to bite another hand, unless one has become an enemy to oneself; members of the same body protect each other unless madness strikes

proverb: Heeruma dharranee, heerumnaan rarraane
meaning_om: Wanta tokko osoo keessa hin beekin dharra'anii erga argatanii booda qorumsa fi dhiphina isaatiin rakkachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: We hungered eagerly for marriage, yet having married, we were left dangling in exhaustion; romantic daydreams dashed by grueling domestic burdens

proverb: Hantuutni guyyaan gahe, funyaan adurree ulatti
meaning_om: Namni kufaatiin fi badiin isaa dhihaate beekaa gara wanta isa dhabamsiisutti dhihaatee of saaxila; balaatti taphachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A mouse whose fated doom has arrived goes and sniffs the cat's nose; when someone is destined for ruin, their own reckless hubris walks them into the trap

proverb: Hiriyaan dhugaa daawwitiidha
meaning_om: Michuun qajeelaan hanqinaa fi gaarummaa kee osoo hin dhoksin akkuma jirutti sitti agarsiisee si sirreessa malee sobaan si hin jajatu
meaning_en: A true friend is a faithful mirror; honest companions reflect your genuine strengths and flaws candidly to help you grow, without false flattery

proverb: Harki qullaan fuula hin ibsu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi ykn wanti harkaa qaban yoo hin jiraanne jireenya keessatti kabajaa fi bifa bareedaa qabaachuun ulfaataadha; hiyyummaan nama miidha
meaning_en: An empty hand cannot wash or brighten the face; without material means and industry, one cannot command respect, comfort, or social dignity

proverb: Hantuut jennaan “an gara mi’aa hin jiru” jedhe
meaning_om: Namni balleessaan beekamu yeroo maqaan isaa dhawamu qalbii qabaatee of qulqulleessuuf shakkii jalaa bahuuf yaaluu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: When called out as a mouse, it claimed to have no taste for sweet things; satirizes a known thief or rogue making transparent excuses to deflect guilt

proverb: Hantuunni haadha jalatti gumbii uraa barti
meaning_om: Ijoolleen amala badaas ta'ee gocha hannaatiif maatii irraa baratti; gorsiifi fakkeenyi maatii dhalootarratti dhiibbaa guddaa qaba
meaning_en: Under its mother, the young mouse learns to drill into the grain bin; children absorb vices, habits, and deceit directly from parental example

proverb: Haati mimmixaa kanuma kootu guba jetti
meaning_om: Namni kamuu wanta ofii isaatii hojjete ykn qabu hunda caalaa jabaa fi gati-jabeessa godhee ilaala; of-jaallachuu fi wanta ofii faarsuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: The mother of the chili pepper boasts that her own burns hottest; everyone naturally exaggerates the potency, quality, or merit of their own belongings

proverb: Hin guddattuu jennaan baratu dhumee jedhe
meaning_om: Namni dhibaa'ummaa fi dadhabina isaatiin milkaa'ina dhabe sababa yeroo fi haalaatti qabatee of qulqulleessuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: When asked why he failed to grow, he blamed the end of the era; satirizes lazy individuals who blame the times for their own lack of achievement

proverb: Hoolaan abbaa abdatte, diboo duuba bulchiti
meaning_om: Namni nama biraarratti garmalee hirkatee of eeggannoo dhiise balaaf saaxilamee qullaa hafa; of-danda'uu fi dammaqina barsiisa
meaning_en: A sheep that put blind faith in its owner ends up spending the night outside the pen; over-reliance on others leads to abandonment and peril

proverb: Hiyyeessaaf hin qalan, kan qalame nyaata
meaning_om: Hiyyeessi dhimma isaatiif addatti kabajamee keessummoomuu baatus, waan argamee fi qoodame irraa qooda fudhachuun jireenya dabarsa
meaning_en: People do not slaughter livestock specifically in honor of the pauper; he simply partakes in whatever carcass has already been dressed

proverb: “Hoolaan maaliif na baqata” jette jaartiin, akka inni itti deebi'ee jifatu hin barree
meaning_om: Namni tokko diinni yoo duubatti harkifate akka waan sodaatetti yaaduun gowwummaadha; inni humna kuufatee deebi'ee dhawuuf qophaa'a
meaning_en: 'Why does the sheep retreat from me?' wondered the old woman, not realizing it was backing up to charge; mistaking a foe's tactical retreat for flight

proverb: Hammaatanis hammaaranis dhuma hin ooltu
meaning_om: Qabeenyi qusatanii ykn qisaasanii yoo itti fayyadaman dhuma irratti dhumuun isaa hin oolu; wanti addunyaa hunduu kan dhumatuudha
meaning_en: Whether you ration it with tiny pinches or scoop it with both hands, provisions will eventually finish; all earthly supplies are finite

proverb: Harreen ofiifuu hin galtuu loon galchitii ree?
meaning_om: Namni ofuma isaatiituu dhimma mataa isaa geggeessuu dadhabe hojii guddaa fi nama biraa hoogganuu hin danda'u
meaning_en: The donkey cannot even return home on its own; can it herd the cattle home?; one who cannot manage his own life cannot lead others

proverb: Harree hin qabnu, waraabessaanis wal hin dhabnu jedhan
meaning_om: Hiyyummaa fi dhabamuu keessa jiraataniyyuu balaa fi qorumsa irraa bilisa ta'uun akka hin danda'amne; rakkinni hiyyeessas hin dhiisu
meaning_en: 'We possess no donkey, yet we never fail to encounter the hyena'; destitute people are not spared from danger; calamity stalks even the penniless

proverb: “Hantuutni boolla lamaa ala bulti” jedha Oromoon
meaning_om: Filannoo lama gidduutti shakkii fi jarjaraan oliif gadi daddaaquun dhumarratti bakka dhabanii kophummaa fi balaaf nama saaxila
meaning_en: 'A mouse with two burrows sleeps out in the cold,' says the proverb; wavering between two options leads to paralysis and forfeiting both

proverb: Ilmi ka abbaa caalu, ka abbaa dhaanu
meaning_om: Ilaalcha qishnaa fi aariiti; dhaloonni ammaa abbootii caalle jedhanii boonan garuu safuu fi kabaja maatii cabsuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: A bitter, satirical proverb: the son who claims to 'surpass' his father merely beats his father; rebuking rebellious youth who mistake disrespect for greatness

proverb: Ilma ka dhalchaniif haa maqaa abbaa waamsisuuf
meaning_om: Ijoolleen kan guddifamtu seenaa, kabajaa fi maqaa maatii gara dhaloota boriitti akka dabarsituuf; sanyii tursiisuu ibsa
meaning_en: A son is reared to uphold, preserve, and honor his father's name and lineage; progeny is the vessel of ancestral memory and family dignity

proverb: Intala waa lama jaalattu gabaa hin baasinaa
meaning_om: Namni xiyyeeffannaa tokko hin qabnee fi fedhii lamaan dhiphatu hojii qajeelaa hin hojjetu; qabeenya qisaasee deebi'a
meaning_en: Do not send to market a maiden torn between two cravings; someone with divided desires will squander resources and achieve neither goal

proverb: Ijoolleen gubattee beektu cinaa ibiddaa hin dhaabbattu
meaning_om: Namni balaa ykn qorumsi duraan irra gahee miidhame of eeggannoo godhata malee lammata balaatti hin dhihaatu
meaning_en: A child who knows what a burn feels like does not play near the hearth; those who have tasted the pain of failure never repeat the mistake

proverb: Itillee naa ergisi jennaan warra rafee hin bulle jiraayi jedhe namichi
meaning_om: Wanta jireenya ofiitiif murteessaa ta'e ormaaf kennanii ofii rakkachuun akka hin danda'amne qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: When asked to lend his sleeping hide, the man said 'Go live with folks who never sleep!'; refusing to surrender one's basic personal necessities to others

proverb: Ilma eessatti bahaa eegan dhaaba gombisatti argan
meaning_om: Ilma irraa guddinni fi milkaa'inni guddaan eegamaa ture dhibaa'aa ta'ee manatti hafuun abdii kutannaa maatiitti fida
meaning_en: A son from whom great feats were expected is discovered loafing against the granary post; great familial expectations dashed by lazy inertia

proverb: Ilma abbaa jalatti of sodaate bineensumatu nyaata
meaning_om: Daa'ima yoo garmalee doorsisanii fi hamilee cabsan, alatti ija-jabina dhabee diina dura dhaabbachuu dadhaba
meaning_en: A son who is thoroughly cowed and terrified under his father will be eaten by wild beasts; crushing a child's spirit leaves him defenseless in the world

proverb: Ilmi horu hora baata, ilmi deegu daaraa baata
meaning_om: Ilmi carraaqqaan qabeenya maatii guddisa; inni dhibaa'aan garuu qabeenya jiru qisaasee maatii salphisa
meaning_en: The industrious son leads herds to rich mineral springs; the shiftless son carries dust and ashes; children either elevate or ruin family fortunes

proverb: Ibidda rafe huubni too’achuu kajeelti
meaning_om: Yeroo gootni ykn aango-qabeessi yeroof tasgabbaa'e, warri laafaanis akka waan isa caalaniitti irratti boonuuf yaalu
meaning_en: Over dormant embers, flimsy chaff dares to assert dominion; weak opportunists become brazen only when formidable giants are asleep

proverb: Irra turuun farda uruu
meaning_om: Wanta tokkorratti garmalee daddagaluun ykn daangaa malee tursiisuun wanticha miidhee mancaasa; madaallii yeroo eeguu barsiisa
meaning_en: Remaining mounted too long creates sores on the horse's back; overstaying, dragging out an issue, or overworking a good thing ruins its value

proverb: Ijji hin saalfanne cimmaan nama laalti
meaning_om: Namni safuu fi qaanfii hin beekne hanqinaa fi xurii ofii utuu qabuu ija-jabinnaan nama dura dhaabbatee ceepha'a
meaning_en: A shameless eye stares down a person even while coated in rheum; an unprincipled scoundrel acts righteous and judgmental despite glaring defects

proverb: Ilmoon leencaa leencuma
meaning_om: Ilmoon sanyii gootaa irraa dhalatte gootummaa fi kabaja sanyii isheetii hin dhabdu; hundeen gaariin gochaan mul'ata
meaning_en: The offspring of a lion is nothing less than a lion; noble courage, dignity, and natural majesty are inherited and proven through blood

proverb: Ilkeen waraabessaa gubbaan tokko keessan immoo adda adda
meaning_om: Namoonni alaan nagaa fi tokkummaa fakkeessanii keessaan garuu garaa walxaxaa fi shira qabaatan saaxila
meaning_en: The teeth of a hyena look uniform on the surface, but inside they are jagged and contradictory; deceptive harmony masking discord

proverb: Intalli bareedde jennaan ija babaafte
meaning_om: Faaruu fi jaja ormaatiin dagamanii adabaa fi safeeffannaa dhabuun of salphisuu qishnaadhaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: Told she was pretty, the maiden popped her eyes out in bizarre exaggeration; unearned flattery makes a foolish person act absurdly

proverb: Ija jabeessarraa sirbi hin fokkisu
meaning_om: Namni murannoo, ija-jabinaa fi amantaa ofirratti qabu wanta hojjetu hundumaa miidhagsee bakkaan gaha
meaning_en: From a bold, confident performer, no step looks ugly; genuine self-assurance, charisma, and conviction lend grace to any action

proverb: Ijjii fi ijoolleen tika baddi
meaning_om: Ijji yoo of hin to'anne gara wanta hin taanetti akka kajeeltu hunda, ijoolleenis hordoffii maatii malee karaa badaa qabatti
meaning_en: Both the wandering eye and growing children go astray without constant guardianship; moral discipline and vigilance are indispensable

proverb: Ijji gaara duubatti wahiin ifirraa hin garre tan if keeysaa guurani jette Oromoon!
meaning_om: Wanta fagoo fi dhimma ormaa qorachuu dura, hanqina, xurii fi dogoggora mataa ofii qulqulleeffachuutu dursi
meaning_en: The eye that cannot see past the mountain cleanses the speck inside itself first; remove the dirt from your own eye before policing distant affairs

proverb: Ilkaan hamma wal waqartu, utuu nyaata alanfattee, qaata na quubsite jedhe garaan
meaning_om: Waldhabdee fi wal qoccolloo bu'aa hin qabne dhiisanii hojii qabatamaa jireenyaaf bu'aa fidu irratti xiyyeeffachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: 'Rather than gnashing against one another, had you chewed grain, you would have sated me long ago!' said the stomach; stop bickering and start working

proverb: Ibiddaan duraa wal beeknaa, utubaa qofa narraa qabaa jette eeleen manni gubannaan
meaning_om: Namni qorumsa duraan bare rakkoo sana hin sodaatu; wanti inni yaadda'u balaa isa haaraa fi humnaa ol ta'e qofa
meaning_en: 'Fire and I are ancient acquaintances; just shield me from the falling wooden pillar!' said the baking griddle; veteran survivors fear only unprecedented blows

proverb: Intallii haati jajju hin heerumtu
meaning_om: Faaruu fi jaja daangaa darbeen nama guddisuun ormi akka shakku yookaan akka abdii ol-aanaa qabaatee mufatu taasisa
meaning_en: The maiden excessively praised by her mother never gets married; exaggerated maternal boasting creates suspicion or impossible standards that deter suitors

proverb: Ilmi akkoon guddiftu duudda duubaan laga ce’a
meaning_om: Ijoolleen garmalee qananiifamtee fi adaba malee guddifamte ija-jabina dhabdee sodaa fi dadhabbii keessa jiraatti
meaning_en: A son pampered by his grandmother crosses the river facing backward; excessive spoiling breeds timidity, dependence, and lack of fortitude

proverb: Isa ati baalaan martee fidde gabaan sirratti barteetii didde
meaning_om: Shiraa fi hanqina ofii dhoksuuf yaalanis, hawaasni dammaqaan dhugaa jiru beekee fudhachuu dida; sobaan nama gowwoomsuun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: What you carefully wrapped in leaves to sell, the marketplace saw through and rejected; transparent flaws cannot be concealed from the observant public

proverb: Jilbiiffatanii bara dheeraa jiraachurra, dhaabbatanii guyyaa tokkollee ta’u jiraachuu wayya
meaning_om: Garbummaa fi salphina jala jiraachuurra, bilisummaa fi kabajaan guyyaa gabaabaaf illee jiraatanii wareegamuutu ulfina qaba
meaning_en: Better to live standing tall for a single day than to survive on one's knees for long ages; noble freedom and dignity surpass prolonged subjugation

proverb: Jiille hin jiiltuu qooqattuu deebitii
meaning_om: Namni balaa kanaan dura isa mudaterraa osoo hin baratin fedhii garaa fi dantaa yeroof jedhee ammas balaatti deebi'a
meaning_en: Jiille never learns from fear; driven by appetite, it returns right back to danger; reckless greed makes fools forget previous close calls

proverb: Jaarsi aduu fi oduu jaalata
meaning_om: Maanguddoof wanti boqonnaa fi gammachuu kennu ho'a aduu ganamaa fi haasaa seenaa ykn oduu qooddachuudha; amala jaarsolii ibsa
meaning_en: An old man cherishes gentle morning sunshine and storytelling; seasoned elders naturally crave warm sun for their bones and conversation for their spirit

proverb: Jooraa ooltus sareen waan hin jirre hin fuutu
meaning_om: Hammamiyyuu yoo fiiganii fi dhama'an wanta uumamaan hin jirree fi carraan hin kennine argachuun hin danda'amu
meaning_en: Though it scavenges all day, a dog cannot retrieve what does not exist; exhaustive searching cannot conjure up resources that simply are not there

proverb: “Jiruu warra irraa” jette ekeraan
meaning_om: Jireenyi addunyaa kanarratti dhiphina, wacaa fi tattaaffii walirraa hin cinne ta'uu isaa du'aan wal bira qabuun gaddaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'It is merely the ceaseless turmoil of the living,' observed the departed spirit; detached, haunting reflection on the exhausting, noisy toil of earthly life

proverb: Waan dhufu hin beekani, saree tana akaayii barsiisaa, jedhe jaarsi
meaning_om: Bara hongee fi rakkina hin beekamneef dursee qophaa'uu fi wanta hin baramne illee yoo ta'e akka madaqan gochuun ogummaa ta'uu agarsiisa
meaning_en: One never knows what the future may bring, so train this dog to eat roasted grain; extreme foresight and preparing even carnivores for unthinkable famine

proverb: Kan soogiddi ittoo mi'eesse, barbareen maqaa itti fudhatte
meaning_om: Namni hojii bu'uuraa fi qabatamaa hojjete osoo hin galateeffamin, namni wacaa fi miidhagina alaa agarsiisu beekamtii fudhachuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: While salt quietly perfected the stew's flavor, chili pepper ran away with the fame; silent catalysts are overlooked while showy elements take credit

proverb: Dhulaandhula garaa jiru, saani cinaacha arraaba
meaning_om: Madda rakkoo isa dhugaa fi keessoo jiru dhiisanii, wanta alarratti mul'atu qofa furuuf dhama'uun bu'aa akka hin qabne agarsiisa
meaning_en: For the botfly grub festering inside its gut, the cow licks its ribs; treating external, superficial symptoms while the real parasite eats within

proverb: Gama sanaa garbuun asheete jennaan, warra sodaanne malee yoom argaa dhabne jedhe jaldeessi
meaning_om: Carraan yookaan faayidaan jiru ifatti mul'atus, balaa fi morkataa jabaa dura jiru sodaachuudhaan bira gahuun akka hin danda'amne ibsa
meaning_en: 'The barley is ripe across the gorge', they said; 'We fear the fierce farmers, not that our eyes failed to see it!' said the baboon; knowing the cost of risk

proverb: Arrabni ofii gaaddisa ooltee, abbaa aduu oolchiti
meaning_om: Jechi arrabaan laayyootti dubbatamu abbaa isaatiif lola, hidhaa, reebichaa fi dararaa cimaa fiduu akka danda'u akeekkachiisa
meaning_en: The tongue rests comfortably in the cool shade of the mouth, while exposing its owner to sweat under the burning sun; words cause physical beatings

proverb: Madaa keenyatu bakka bade jedhe jaldeessi
meaning_om: Hanqina, rakkina yookaan qaanii ofii isa dhokfachuun hin danda'amne fi bakka ifatti mul'atu irratti uumame qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'It is our sore that chose a shameful, awkward location,' said the baboon; making wry, humorous excuses for glaring defects that cannot be hidden

proverb: Akka isaa beekaaf, bofa miila dhorke
meaning_om: Namni amala hamaa fi roorristaa qabu akka ummata hin balleessineef Waaqayyo humnaa fi dandeettii dhowwachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: Knowing what havoc it would wreak, God denied the serpent legs; tyrants and malevolent souls are divinely restrained by lack of power

proverb: Cidha gannaa abbaatu ofiin dida; du'a gannaa Rabbiitu namaan dida
meaning_om: Rakkina nama harkaa qabu ofirraa ittisuun ni danda'ama, garuu murtii du'aa fi ajala uumaan fide qorichi biraa hin jiru
meaning_en: A rainy season wedding can be declined by human choice; but a rainy season death can only be turned away by God; human vs. divine agency

proverb: Cilee ta'uuf gubannee, cilee taanees gubanne jedhe mukni
meaning_om: Gidiraa fi dhiphina walirraa hin cinne keessa jiraachuu; qorumsi tokko osoo hin dhumatin kan biraan itti fufuu ibsa
meaning_en: 'We were scorched to turn into charcoal, and as charcoal, we were burned again!' said the timber; enduring relentless, cyclical torment without relief

proverb: Ni nyaanna jettanis ni nyaanna; hin nyaannu jettanis ni nyaanna jedhe waraabessi
meaning_om: Diinni yookaan roorristaan gara-jabeessi kadhannaa fi mormii namaatiif dantaa akka hin qabnee fi akeeka isaa raawwachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'Whether you say we will eat you or say we will not, we devour you regardless,' said the hyena; an unyielding predator ignores all moral appeals

proverb: Akkan itti dhales, akkan arraabbadhus anatu beeka, jette xaddeen
meaning_om: Hojii rakkisaa fi adda ta'e abbuma keessa jirutu beeka; qorumsa dhuunfaa nama biraa tilmaamuun akka hin danda'amne ibsa
meaning_en: 'Both how I birthed and how I lick my quilled young clean, I alone understand,' said the porcupine; delicate, agonizing duties are known only to the bearer

proverb: Bulu cooma, jedhe jaldeessi mixii barbaachatti bofa dhagaa jalaa baasee
meaning_om: Yeroo balaan lubbuu galaafatu tasa nama mudatu, bu'aa xiqqoo barbaadan dhiisanii lubbuun hafuun qofti milkaa'ina hundarra caaluudha
meaning_en: 'Merely making it through the night alive is pure feast,' said the baboon, unearthing a serpent while hunting ants; survival overrides petty gains

proverb: Korma dhugaan booratu, biyyeen ija hin buutu
meaning_om: Namni haqa qabatee fi qalbii qulqulluun lolu gochi isaa deebisee isa hin miidhu; qajeelummaan gaachana namaaf ta'a
meaning_en: A bull that paws the earth in righteous battle does not blind itself with dust; he who fights with genuine righteousness is shielded from self-injury

proverb: Mana haadha kootiin dhaqa jettee, goraa bira hin darbin
meaning_om: Carraa fi qabeenya amma harkaa qabdu tuffattee abdii fuulduraatiif wanta jiru hin dhiisin; qabatamummaa ammaa dursuu
meaning_en: Do not pass by the ripe blackberries on the trail saying 'I am going to feast at my mother's house'; never bypass present bread for future promises

proverb: Kofoo namaa ergisanii, 'irra hin taa'in' hin jedhan
meaning_om: Wanta tokko erga tola kennanii yookaan liqeessanii booda, itti fayyadama isaa irratti daangaa dhiphoo gochuun safuu cabsa
meaning_en: Having lent someone a pair of trousers, one does not order them not to sit; do not offer tools or gifts while forbidding their natural, practical use

proverb: Na nyaattu na nyaadhu malee, bishaan ol hin yaa'u, jette harreen waraabessaan
meaning_om: Diinni sababa sobaa uumee nama miidhuuf yoo ka'e, soba isaa saaxilanii dhugaa irratti dhaabbachuun gootummaadha
meaning_en: 'Devour me if you must, but water does not flow uphill!' said the donkey to the hyena; exposing an oppressor's absurd pretexts while facing death

proverb: Namni ulee baatee hin deemne, sareef sagadaa deema
meaning_om: Namni of ittisaa fi qophii hin qabne wantoota salphoo fi dadhaboo duratti illee kabajaa dhabee jilbeeffachuuf dirqama
meaning_en: A traveler who carries no walking-staff walks bowing down before stray dogs; failing to prepare defenses reduces a person to groveling before petty nuisances

proverb: Namni gurraachi jiilche, gufuu gubataa baqata
meaning_om: Namni duraan balaa yookaan miidhaa guddaan naafate wanta balaa sana fakkaatu hundumaa sodaadhaan dheessa; dhiibbaa naasuu ibsa
meaning_en: The person deeply traumatized by a black predator runs in panic from a charred tree stump; past trauma causes individuals to jump at harmless shadows

proverb: Situ diriiree of qochisiise, jedhe gaarri lafa diriiraa gadi ilaalee
meaning_om: Namni daangaa fi kabaja ofii eeggachuu dhiisee laafina agarsiisu ormaaf saaxilamee akka dhiitamu qishnaan ceepha'a
meaning_en: 'It is your own flat softness that invited you to be plowed,' said the mountain looking down at the plain; being overly passive invites exploitation

proverb: Garaa nagaya qabu sukkuumuun, dhukkuba itti fiduudha
meaning_om: Dhimma nagaan tasgabbaa'ee jiru keessa lixanii qorqoruun waldhabdee fi aarii hin barbaachifne uuma; nagaa jiru jeequu dhowwa
meaning_en: Massaging a healthy, peaceful belly only induces cramping sickness; unnecessarily meddling in quiet, settled situations stirs up gratuitous conflict

proverb: Baga dhufte jennaan, kajeelaa garaan ciise
meaning_om: Namni dantaa fi faayidaa qofa barbaadu simannaa kabajaa fi safeeffannaa akka carraa dhuunfannaatti lakkaa'ee itti gammada
meaning_en: Told 'Welcome!', the greedy moocher's stomach relaxed in contentment; an opportunist seizes customary politeness as license to feast and overstay

proverb: Kan akka fardaa nyaatu gaafa akka namaa nyaatu du'a
meaning_om: Namni yeroo hundumaa qananii fi quufa daangaa malee bare, gaafa hiyyummaan ykn dhabinsi dhufe danda'ee jiraachuu hin danda'u
meaning_en: He who habitually feeds like a horse dies on the day he is fed like a human; people accustomed to luxury and excess collapse when lean seasons hit

proverb: Midhaan warra raatuu bona bona nyaatu
meaning_om: Maatiin qalbii fi qusannaa hin qabne oomisha argame akkuma dhufeen qisaasee fixa malee yeroo gannaatiif hin hambifatu; qisaasama ceepha'a
meaning_en: The grain of a foolish household is devoured right during the dry harvest; improvident families feast during plenty without storing for the lean winter

proverb: Keessummaa qamalee raafuu keessatti argu
meaning_om: Nama amala badaa fi hanna amaleeffateen wajjin ooluun bakka badiisaa fi salphinaatti nama geessa; hiriyaa saaxila
meaning_en: A monkey's houseguest is caught right in the middle of the cabbage garden; keeping company with thieves and scavengers lands one red-handed in the crime

proverb: Arrumaa salaattee arrumaa maraatte
meaning_om: Amala wal-faallaa fi qalbii jijjiiramaa qabaachuu; yeroo gabaabaa keessatti qajeelummaa irraa gara gocha fokkisaatti jijjiiramuu ceepha'a
meaning_en: On the exact day he performed his prayers, on that very day he committed madness; censures shocking, volatile hypocrisy and rapid moral collapse

proverb: Yaanni karaa hin dhaleessu
meaning_om: Taa'anii yaadaan dhiphachuun qofti deemsa fi hojii namaaf hin xumuru; miilaan tarkaanfatanii hojjechuutu furmaata fida
meaning_en: Mere worrying and rumination do not shorten a long road; passive anxiety covers no distance; progress requires physical, determined steps

proverb: Qilleensarratti mana hin ijaaran
meaning_om: Wanta bu'uura hin qabne, odeessa sobaa fi abdii bu'uura dhabeerratti jireenyaa fi karoora ijaaruun kufaatii fida
meaning_en: One does not erect a home upon the blowing wind; plans, relationships, and institutions built on empty rumors and groundless hopes will collapse

proverb: Ni turra malee ni urra, jette boonbiin
meaning_om: Hojiin tokko yeroollee yoo fudhate cichoominaa fi obsaan yoo itti fufan dhuma irratti milkaa'uun akka danda'amu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'We may tarry long, but we will bore through,' said the wood-boring beetle; slow, methodical perseverance penetrates the most impenetrable barriers

proverb: Alaa manatti galan
meaning_om: Namni hammamiyyuu alatti yoo oolee fi adeeme, dhumni isaa fi bakki boqonnaa isaa mana isaati; maatii fi hundee ofiitti deebi'uu barsiisa
meaning_en: From the outside world, one always returns home; no matter how far one roams, one's true rest, roots, and sanctuary reside at home

proverb: Kokkolfaa nama nyaatti gonfaan
meaning_om: Namni fira fakkaatee kolfaa fi fuula ifaadhaan namatti dhihaatu keessaan garuu shira hamaadhaan nama miidhuu danda'a; kofla sobaa saaxila
meaning_en: Smiling sweetly, the cloaked hyena devours a person; treacherous hypocrites who mask venomous intentions beneath charming smiles

proverb: Kormi biyya ofiitti bookkisu biyya ormaatti ni mar'ata
meaning_om: Namni naannoo isaatti goota fakkaatee dhaadatu, bakka ormaa fi nama isa hin beekne keessatti sodaa fi salphinaan liqimfama
meaning_en: The bull that roars aggressively on his home ground merely moans like a heifer in foreign lands; local bravado withers into timidity abroad

proverb: Muka biyya jiruun mana ijaaran
meaning_om: Wanta harkaa qabanii fi qabeenya naannoo jiruun dhimma ofii xumuruu malee wanta hin jirre hawwuun bu'aa hin qabu; qabatamummaa barsiisa
meaning_en: With the timber native to the country, one builds the house; construct your life and projects using accessible, local resources and allies

proverb: Haatee durbaa jennaan, dur kaa jedhe mucaan
meaning_om: Wanta ifa ta'ee fi uumamaan beekamu akka waan haaraatti yeroo odeessan, bu'aa dhabdummaa isaa qishnaadhaan mul'isuu
meaning_en: When told 'Your mother was once a maiden', the child shrugged 'Of course, ages ago!'; mocks people who announce obvious common knowledge as profound news

proverb: Galle, jette lafoon farda jala galtee
meaning_om: Dadhabbii fi saffisa nama cimaatiin fayyadamaa ofii isaatiis akka waan isa qixxee hojjeteetti boonu saaxila
meaning_en: 'We have arrived!', boasted the footman trudging beneath the galloping horse; mocks an underling claiming shared glory from a superior's speed

proverb: Worruma keennaa harreen hin taane, jedhe namichi booyyee ari'ee
meaning_om: Wanta ofii argachuu dadhaban akka waan barbaachisaa hin taaneetti tuffatanii qaanii dhokfachuu qishnaadhaan ibsa
meaning_en: 'In our family, a donkey is worthless anyway,' said the hunter after failing to catch the wild pig; classic rationalization and sour grapes

proverb: Suuta ejjatan suuta qoreen nama waraanti
meaning_om: Deemsaa fi jireenya keessatti of eeggannoodhaan socho'uun miidhaa fi balaa dhufu daran salphisa; tasgabbiin bu'aa fida
meaning_en: If you tread with gentle care, the thorn pierces with less venom; walking with measured vigilance cushions the blow of unavoidable hazards

proverb: Dhukkubni na ajjeesuu hin jirre hamaaf tolaa addaan naaf baase
meaning_om: Qorumsi fi dhukkubni cimaan fira dhugaa isa garaadhaa namaaf dhiphatuu fi isa kufaatii namaa hawwu ifatti saaxila
meaning_en: The affliction that did not destroy me cleanly separated my well-wishers from my ill-wishers; surviving a crisis clarifies true relationships

proverb: Ija jirtu qorsa buusani
meaning_om: Wanta qabatamaan jiru kunuunsuu fi wallaanuutu bu'aa fida; nama lubbuun jiruuf gargaarsa gochuutu du'a booda booyuu caala
meaning_en: One instills medicinal drops into an eye while it is still alive; provide care, resources, and honor to the living while they are still here to benefit

proverb: Ka qotiyyoon iyyu qacceen iyyiti
meaning_om: Namni ba'aa fi dadhabbii hojichaa baatu callisaa osoo jiruu, inni homaa hin hojjenne wacaa fi komii baay'isa; roorroo saaxila
meaning_en: Where the laboring plow-ox should be groaning from toil, it is the whip that screams; the idle overseer makes all the noise while the laborer bleeds

proverb: Ni ta'a jennaan harree qallee, hin ta'u jennaan harree gannee
meaning_om: Ejjennoo fi murannoo dhabuudhaan gorsa ormaa hunda hordofanii wanta fokkisaa raawwachuu fi booda kasaaruu ceepha'a
meaning_en: Told 'it is halal', we butchered a donkey; told 'it is haram', we abandoned the meat; mocks spineless people tossed about by every conflicting opinion

proverb: Gonfoon calqaba baddeet dhoofnan kutaa hanqatte
meaning_om: Wanti jalqabuma irraa karoora fi bu'uura sirrii hin qabne yeroo xumuramuuf ka'u hanqinaa fi fashala fida
meaning_en: The crown was flawed from its inception; when woven, it fell short of covering the partition; poor beginnings guarantee defective conclusions

proverb: Hiriyaa garaa firaa, gadheetuu garaa hiraa
meaning_om: Michuu dhugaa kan akka firaatti siif yaadu qabaachuun kabajadha; hiriyaa gadheen garuu dhiphinaa fi gadda qofa namaaf kenna
meaning_en: A comrade with the heart of true kin brings solace; an unprincipled scoundrel only divides and breaks your heart; choose companions wisely

proverb: Boriif boorri jiraa
meaning_om: Rakkinnii fi dhiphinni har'aa yoo hammaatellee, boriif ifti fi abdii haaraan jira; jireenyi itti fufa waan ta'eef abdii hin kutatani
meaning_en: For tomorrow, there is another radiant dawn; present troubles do not end the world; sunrise brings renewed hope and fresh possibilities

proverb: Sabab jette ballaan farda yaabdee
meaning_om: Namni carraa yookaan haala uumame sababeeffatee wanta duraan hawwaa ture tokko ija-jabinnaan raawwachuu qishnaan agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'A fine pretext!' cried the blind woman as she hoisted herself onto the horse; seizing upon an accidental circumstance as an excuse to do what one always craved

proverb: Ijoolleen gajee torbaa anatuu keessaa korma, jedhee geerare namichii
meaning_om: Namoota dadhaboo fi homaa hin taane keessatti of tuuluun gootummaa dhugaa akka hin taane; jabaa keessatti madaalamuutu caala
meaning_en: 'Among seven puny weaklings, I am the mighty stud bull!' boasted the man in war chant; mocks cheap bravado that feels heroic only among the helpless

proverb: Yaa Waaq siifan ka'a, achumaanan gaayyaa koo fudhadha jette jaartiin
meaning_om: Hojii qulqulluu fi amantii fakkeessanii fedhii dhuunfaa fi qananii fooniitiif dursa kennuu qishnaadhaan saaxila
meaning_en: 'O God, for Your sake I rise to pray; and while on my feet, I will snatch my tobacco pipe,' said the old woman; disguising selfish indulgence behind pious prayer

proverb: Niitiin afaan kaa'a barte, kabaluuf jennaan afaan bante
meaning_om: Qananii fi tola oolmaa daangaa darbeen gowwoomanii yeroo adabbiin dhufuyyuu akka waan qananiitti yaaduu qishnaan ibsa
meaning_en: A wife habituated to sweet morsels popped in her mouth opened wide when her husband raised a hand to slap her; comical blindness to disciplinary wrath

proverb: Qeesii mataa sabbataa, amajaaja dabboo sanbataa
meaning_om: Nama faaya fi maqaa amantiitiin of mul'isee garuu qalbii fi jireenyaan soorata fi dantaa qofa hordofu balaaleffata
meaning_en: A priest sporting a pious turban, yet obsessed with Sabbath loaves; satirizes religious functionaries motivated by ceremonial food rather than spiritual virtue

proverb: Yaa Rabbi sooressa ajjeesi, nyaannee dhugnaa jedhee abbateen taskaara yaade
meaning_om: Namni ofittoo ta'e faayidaa garaa isaatiif jedhee balaa fi du'a nama biraa hawwachuu qishnaadhaan saaxila; gara-jabina qoonqoo ibsa
meaning_en: 'O God, kill a wealthy man so that we may eat and drink,' prayed the parasite dreaming of funeral feasts; monstrous selfishness wishing death for a banquet

proverb: Aaki jedhan waa tufan, mammaakan waa himan
meaning_om: Mammaaksi akka laayyootti kan darbatamu osoo hin taane, dhimma bu'uuraa fi gorsa jabaa dabarsuuf kan fayyaduudha; ogummaa dubbii barsiisa
meaning_en: Saying 'Aak!', one expels throat phlegm; reciting a proverb, one delivers vital counsel; proverbs are purposeful instruments of instruction, not idle noise

proverb: Mana eegaan bara eega, jette sareen
meaning_om: Hojii idilee hojjechaa haala naannoo fi jijjiirama yeroo hordofuun ogummaadha; dammaqina qabaachuu agarsiisa
meaning_en: 'While guarding the house, I keep an eye on the changing times,' said the dog; staying vigilant over one's daily duties while observing broader environmental shifts

proverb: Akka garaakoo, jette sareen nama gararraan bishaan dhugdi
meaning_om: Yeroo eeggannoon dhabametti namni gadi aanaan seeraa fi aadaa cabsee wanta isaaf hin malle raawwachuun of jajuu saaxila
meaning_en: 'Just as suits my pleasure,' said the dog drinking water upstream from the humans; an unruly subordinate insolently taking advantage of lax oversight

proverb: Akka abaluun sirbaan boquu nama jallisa
meaning_om: Dandeettii fi uumama ofii dhiisanii nama biraa akkeessuuf yaaluun salphinaa fi miidhaa qaamaa fida; kan ofiitiin jiraachuu barsiisa
meaning_en: Dancing in imitation of someone else only dislocates one's neck; blindly copying another's unique style leads to clumsy failure and self-inflicted harm

proverb: Lafa rukutanii maggaanyaa ofiin qixxeessu
meaning_om: Dhiphinaa fi dhukkubbii keessoo furuu dadhabanii gocha aariitiin wanta dhimma hin qabne irratti aarii baasuun bu'aa hin qabu
meaning_en: Beating the dirt with a fist trying to match the rhythm of one's stomach colic; futile, frantic gestures venting internal agony upon the earth

proverb: Kopheen muka yaabdee seexanatu na kuffise jettaa? jette seexanni
meaning_om: Dogoggoraa fi gowwummaa mataa ofiitiin balaatti kufuun orma yookaan seexana komachuu ceepha'a; itti-gaafatamummaa baachuun dirqama
meaning_en: 'You climbed a tree wearing slippery shoes, and now you blame Satan for falling?!' asked the devil; rebuking fools who blame demons for self-inflicted blunders
